sense_5770f3818f9f331b262664b04a19cdb3.text: Mi hermano es más alto que yo.
sense_5770f3818f9f331b262664b04a19cdb3.translation: My brother is taller than me.

sense_5770f3818f9f331b262664b04a19cdb3.text: Es más barato comprar el libro en la librería que comprarlo online.
sense_5770f3818f9f331b262664b04a19cdb3.translation: It's cheaper to buy the book in the bookshop than to buy it online.

sense_2b7681270df19816303f722f2f2ea498.text: ¡Enséñame el vestido que llevaste en la fiesta!
sense_2b7681270df19816303f722f2f2ea498.translation: Show me the dress that you wore to the party!

sense_2b7681270df19816303f722f2f2ea498.text: Ese es el teléfono que yo quiero.
sense_2b7681270df19816303f722f2f2ea498.translation: That's the phone that I want.

sense_a953d0ad265dee9ff26a6031a4cb5dee.text: Te recojo en el coche de mi padre.
sense_a953d0ad265dee9ff26a6031a4cb5dee.translation: I'll come get you in my father's car.

sense_a953d0ad265dee9ff26a6031a4cb5dee.text: ¿Esa no es la casa de Susana?

sense_e41759d5c24f9fe8a27c2405a7fdf595.text: Se usa la palanca de cambios para cambiar las marchas.
sense_e41759d5c24f9fe8a27c2405a7fdf595.translation: You use the gear shift to change the gears.

sense_e41759d5c24f9fe8a27c2405a7fdf595.text: Voy a comprar otro traje de baño para el verano.
sense_e41759d5c24f9fe8a27c2405a7fdf595.translation: I'm going to buy another bathing suit for the summer.

sense_4892c22ebe1a386aa50fb7432101aa9a.text: Vamos a la fiesta esta noche ¿no?
sense_4892c22ebe1a386aa50fb7432101aa9a.translation: We're going to the party tonight, aren't we?
You signed the contract, didn't you?

sense_4c0fe90e11a09a0a48bf0c0983c4c859.translation: We should call them, shouldn't we?
Why don't I come with you?

sense_ca21d09890e7ec90fe6181728acdc27e.text: Me encantaría ganar dinero a espuertas.
sense_ca21d09890e7ec90fe6181728acdc27e.translation: I would love to earn lots of money.

sense_5f142c5b7953da8a8df68bbf50af4d71.text: El circuito transporta una corriente de 1 A.
sense_5f142c5b7953da8a8df68bbf50af4d71.translation: The circuit carries a current of 1 A.

sense_5f142c5b7953da8a8df68bbf50af4d71.text: La intensidad de la corriente eléctrica se mide en A.
sense_5f142c5b7953da8a8df68bbf50af4d71.translation: The intensity of an electric current is measured in A.

sense_7ae3ee6e8084a572fba6d65fc529d446.text: La leche está en el refrigerador.
sense_7ae3ee6e8084a572fba6d65fc529d446.translation: The milk is in the refrigerator.

sense_7ae3ee6e8084a572fba6d65fc529d446.text: La pelota está en el tejado.
sense_7ae3ee6e8084a572fba6d65fc529d446.translation: The ball is on the roof.

sense_9d16a970880408a46d398b118d113625.text: El teléfono estaba encima de la mesa.
sense_9d16a970880408a46d398b118d113625.translation: The telephone was on top of the table.

sense_9d16a970880408a46d398b118d113625.text: El gato está en el tejado.
sense_9d16a970880408a46d398b118d113625.translation: The cat is on the roof.

sense_6b6635f70ce715c2ea5516e200671fe1.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_6b6635f70ce715c2ea5516e200671fe1.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_7c952a2ddbe26390fed8ad0912efdc10.text: No te puedes imaginar lo increíble que es Palenque.
sense_7c952a2ddbe26390fed8ad0912efdc10.translation: You can't imagine how incredible Palenque is.

sense_7c952a2ddbe26390fed8ad0912efdc10.text: Lo raro es que nunca he visto a Bruce durante el día.
sense_7c952a2ddbe26390fed8ad0912efdc10.translation: The weird thing is that I've never seen Bruce during the day.

sense_a58e4bdd4d76f85ce9d520053749cfb4.text: Conseguí unas manzanas deliciosas en el mercado.
sense_a58e4bdd4d76f85ce9d520053749cfb4.translation: I got some delicious apples at the market.
I bought some very interesting books.

sense_22364d5c388a97afaf6559aa0ef94cab.text: Habrá que ir a por leche cuando lleguemos.
sense_22364d5c388a97afaf6559aa0ef94cab.translation: We'll need to go out for milk when we get there.

sense_22364d5c388a97afaf6559aa0ef94cab.text: ¿Has ido a por tu hijo a la escuela?
sense_22364d5c388a97afaf6559aa0ef94cab.translation: Have you picked up your son from school?

sense_24176e368f09ebc9743365b91d125466.translation: The issue is yet to be resolved.

sense_ef30bad2063fdd3f627eee1fc22003e8.text: Me quebré el dedo jugando al baloncesto.
sense_ef30bad2063fdd3f627eee1fc22003e8.translation: I broke my finger playing basketball.

sense_ef30bad2063fdd3f627eee1fc22003e8.text: Voy a quitarme la chaqueta porque tengo mucho calor.
sense_ef30bad2063fdd3f627eee1fc22003e8.translation: I'm going to take off my jacket because I'm really hot.

sense_4a8c64f3bbb4054361e398da484ddad3.text: Me duché y me vestí lo más rápido que pude.
sense_4a8c64f3bbb4054361e398da484ddad3.translation: I showered and got dressed as fast as I could.
I got up very late today.

sense_d76ec64587304a051d631fca526c2ae4.text: Me fui temprano porque estaba cansado.
sense_d76ec64587304a051d631fca526c2ae4.translation: I left early because I was tired.

sense_d76ec64587304a051d631fca526c2ae4.text: No me quedaré tranquila hasta que no llamen para decir que han llegado.
sense_d76ec64587304a051d631fca526c2ae4.translation: I won't relax until they call to say they've arrived.

sense_46f6e8303c7c3ab5e14f3746eb7612cc.text: ¡No te me mueras! La ambulancia ya llega.
sense_46f6e8303c7c3ab5e14f3746eb7612cc.translation: Don't you die on me! The ambulance will be here soon.

sense_46f6e8303c7c3ab5e14f3746eb7612cc.text: La película era larguísima, pero me la vi entera.
sense_46f6e8303c7c3ab5e14f3746eb7612cc.translation: It was a very long movie, but I saw it to the end.

sense_08cdd6c4b92b083b8b0df1107b66bc2f.text: La comida maravillosa del restaurante se une a la decoración modernista lujosa.
sense_08cdd6c4b92b083b8b0df1107b66bc2f.translation: The restaurant's fantastic food is complemented by their luxurious modernist decor.

sense_08cdd6c4b92b083b8b0df1107b66bc2f.text: Ese tipo es un trabajador fantástico. En él se unen la confianza y la habilidad.
sense_08cdd6c4b92b083b8b0df1107b66bc2f.translation: That guy's a fantastic worker. He's the epitome of confidence and skill.

sense_26bf251e31e71688f671395f0552e582.text: Conseguí unas manzanas deliciosas en el mercado.
sense_26bf251e31e71688f671395f0552e582.translation: I got some delicious apples at the market.
I bought some very interesting books.

sense_74073b932c0870d6bc5979c1deec1371.text: Necesitamos una moneda más para completar el conjunto.
sense_74073b932c0870d6bc5979c1deec1371.translation: We need one more coin to complete the set.
I've only got one candy left.

sense_fcc54c086f53765d794e455195f5694e.text: Compré uno para mí y otro para ti.
sense_fcc54c086f53765d794e455195f5694e.translation: I bought one for me and another for you.
How many coins do you need? - Just one.

sense_684be912917b73884bd4e74523bd4542.text: Este año no viajaremos al extranjero.
sense_684be912917b73884bd4e74523bd4542.translation: We won't be going abroad this year.
How long does it take you to go to work?

sense_17bfeadf217c689ba850f0735e10aaa4.text: Se subió al coche y se fue.
sense_17bfeadf217c689ba850f0735e10aaa4.translation: He got in the car and left.

sense_17bfeadf217c689ba850f0735e10aaa4.text: Súbete al muro para ver mejor.
sense_17bfeadf217c689ba850f0735e10aaa4.translation: Get up on the wall to get a better view.

sense_cd47f8b0791fd51114eef75e44e288da.text: Me gusta hacer ejercicio al aire libre.
Nos sentamos al fondo de la sala.
sense_cd47f8b0791fd51114eef75e44e288da.translation: We sat at the back of the room.

sense_1f28a18ab76657fd8dc81b2ee26e1f79.text: Duérmete ya, que mañana nos vamos temprano en la mañana.
sense_1f28a18ab76657fd8dc81b2ee26e1f79.translation: Go to sleep already. Tomorrow we're leaving early in the morning.

sense_357201cccaae5e69f96974969cc73061.text: El coche es del padre de un amigo.
sense_357201cccaae5e69f96974969cc73061.translation: The car belongs to a friend's dad.

sense_357201cccaae5e69f96974969cc73061.text: El libro del maestro tiene las repuestas a la prueba.
sense_357201cccaae5e69f96974969cc73061.translation: The teacher's book has the answers to the test.

sense_e637949177411886296c5b189016f0e9.text: Se dice que ganó su fortuna jugando al póquer.
sense_e637949177411886296c5b189016f0e9.translation: People say he won his fortune playing poker.

sense_ce9fc8354f41c8a937d401c513089b69.text: Sin mis lentes, leo con mucha dificultad.
sense_ce9fc8354f41c8a937d401c513089b69.translation: Without my glasses, I read with great difficulty.

sense_ce9fc8354f41c8a937d401c513089b69.text: Los contenidos de esa caja son frágiles. Manipula con cuidado.
sense_ce9fc8354f41c8a937d401c513089b69.translation: The contents of that box are fragile. Handle it with care.

sense_4c17a8b55fa67a290cabed570b6658ae.text: Para la cena, vamos a tener pollo con vegetales.
sense_4c17a8b55fa67a290cabed570b6658ae.translation: For dinner, we're going to have chicken with vegetables.

sense_4c17a8b55fa67a290cabed570b6658ae.text: Voy a cenar con mis padres.
sense_4c17a8b55fa67a290cabed570b6658ae.translation: I'm going to have dinner with my parents.

sense_cea7da9658b6a1c5e1f85b11db9f9c59.text: Ella no aprobó, pero yo sí.
sense_cea7da9658b6a1c5e1f85b11db9f9c59.translation: She didn't pass, but I did.

sense_cea7da9658b6a1c5e1f85b11db9f9c59.text: Yo sí quiero acompañarlos a Disney.
sense_cea7da9658b6a1c5e1f85b11db9f9c59.translation: I do want to go with you to Disney World.

sense_e9014e3e4de2ea15c16ec0bd29d19b6e.translation: You really could have told him.

sense_e9014e3e4de2ea15c16ec0bd29d19b6e.text: Se hace el tonto pero bien sabía que no nos había pagado.
sense_e9014e3e4de2ea15c16ec0bd29d19b6e.translation: He's pretending he didn't, but he knew full well he hadn't paid us.

sense_0a2a67c08a09c40c3f079eb338c4b46f.text: Bien nos vamos, bien no, pero hay que decidirlo ya.
sense_0a2a67c08a09c40c3f079eb338c4b46f.translation: We either go or we don't, but we need to decide.

sense_0a2a67c08a09c40c3f079eb338c4b46f.text: Tenemos que mudarnos, bien este año, bien el que viene.
sense_0a2a67c08a09c40c3f079eb338c4b46f.translation: We have to move, whether it's this year or next.

sense_b8bab17c71daab9920a9a41f218a522e.text: ¡Mira lo que has hecho! ¡Has roto las sillas!
sense_b8bab17c71daab9920a9a41f218a522e.translation: Look at what you did! You broke the chairs!
Let's give the winners a big hand!

sense_4bbaec418a46702c820dd9df76958fda.text: He picado unas cebollas. Eché las que estaban podridas.
sense_4bbaec418a46702c820dd9df76958fda.translation: I chopped up some onions. I threw out the ones that were rotten.

sense_4bbaec418a46702c820dd9df76958fda.text: ¡Qué lindas chompas! Me gustan las verdes.
sense_4bbaec418a46702c820dd9df76958fda.translation: What nice sweaters! I like the green ones.

sense_2d180e69f631bbb2fdd13fe5bf74ef18.text: La leche está en el refrigerador.
sense_2d180e69f631bbb2fdd13fe5bf74ef18.translation: The milk is in the refrigerator.

sense_2d180e69f631bbb2fdd13fe5bf74ef18.text: La pelota está en el tejado.
sense_2d180e69f631bbb2fdd13fe5bf74ef18.translation: The ball is on the roof.

sense_f7c03d746c9c60dd214d555b94d2db0e.text: Inspiré y espiré como me pidió la doctora.
sense_f7c03d746c9c60dd214d555b94d2db0e.translation: I breathed in and out as the doctor asked me to.

sense_a8423394b9ec0dc435827fc44d05772b.text: Clara es alta y rubia como su madre.
sense_a8423394b9ec0dc435827fc44d05772b.translation: Clara is tall and blonde like her mom.

sense_a8423394b9ec0dc435827fc44d05772b.text: Quiero ser como tú eres, alegre y simpático.
sense_a8423394b9ec0dc435827fc44d05772b.translation: I want to be like you are, cheerful and friendly.

sense_2476f3f89650ec482855a716a41023a9.text: Yo no gano tanto dinero como te imaginas.
sense_2476f3f89650ec482855a716a41023a9.translation: I don't make as much money as you think.

sense_2476f3f89650ec482855a716a41023a9.text: Me pregunto si este restaurante es tan bueno como la gente dice.
sense_2476f3f89650ec482855a716a41023a9.translation: I wonder if this restaurant is as good as people say.

sense_e28d7f44967d3ac052dd2584eeb86adc.text: Camila declaró en el juicio como testigo.
sense_e28d7f44967d3ac052dd2584eeb86adc.translation: Camila testified at the trial as a witness.

sense_e28d7f44967d3ac052dd2584eeb86adc.text: Como presidenta de esta compañía, estoy muy orgullosa de su excelente trabajo.
sense_e28d7f44967d3ac052dd2584eeb86adc.translation: As CEO of this company, I'm really proud of your excellent work.

sense_56cae0242f91a924e9dc37615f17097a.text: Tienes que explicarme el modo como hiciste esas enchiladas.
sense_56cae0242f91a924e9dc37615f17097a.translation: You have to tell me how you made those enchiladas.

sense_56cae0242f91a924e9dc37615f17097a.text: No me gusta la manera como te hablan tus alumnos.
sense_56cae0242f91a924e9dc37615f17097a.translation: I don't like the way your students speak to you.

sense_0c748dcf55f25eb5f39aa5fae23d0ec7.text: Los escoceses son como muy abiertos, ¿no?
sense_0c748dcf55f25eb5f39aa5fae23d0ec7.translation: The Scots seem to be very open, aren't they?

sense_0c748dcf55f25eb5f39aa5fae23d0ec7.text: Pablo sonaba enojado o como cansado.
sense_0c748dcf55f25eb5f39aa5fae23d0ec7.translation: Pablo sounded angry or maybe tired.

sense_d290ab2da3d73a104b18392c77a8a9ca.text: Como estaba cansada, Lucía se fue a casa.
sense_d290ab2da3d73a104b18392c77a8a9ca.translation: Lucia went home because she was tired.

sense_d290ab2da3d73a104b18392c77a8a9ca.text: Como la paciente tenía dolor, le dimos analgésicos.
sense_d290ab2da3d73a104b18392c77a8a9ca.translation: The patient was in pain, so we gave her painkillers.

sense_248bf8d476fcb82518ceffa51150c1e9.text: Verás como todo va a ir bien.
sense_248bf8d476fcb82518ceffa51150c1e9.translation: I'm sure everything is going to be fine.

sense_3731780450988cacfcb3797a0671c0d7.text: Los neumáticos viejos pueden emplearse como asientos para columpios.
sense_3731780450988cacfcb3797a0671c0d7.translation: Old tires can be used as swings.
I use my phone as a computer.

sense_e1cae0479ac1af9ceea90e67c7b21157.text: Es mucho más simpática cuando la conoces bien.
sense_e1cae0479ac1af9ceea90e67c7b21157.translation: She is much nicer when you get to know her.

sense_e1cae0479ac1af9ceea90e67c7b21157.text: Es más guapo que su hermano.
sense_e1cae0479ac1af9ceea90e67c7b21157.translation: He is more handsome than his brother.

sense_7565c4bebb95be1a607bcc9801de9e6f.translation: Do you know Pablo? He's so good looking!

sense_bf1e0f81d16461735a043a1d21327e8b.text: "¡Ya voy!", dijo David al escuchar el timbre.
sense_bf1e0f81d16461735a043a1d21327e8b.translation: "I'm coming!" said David when he heard the doorbell.

sense_bf1e0f81d16461735a043a1d21327e8b.text: Tengo que ir a hacer una llamada. Ya vengo.
sense_bf1e0f81d16461735a043a1d21327e8b.translation: I have to go make a phone call. I'll be right back.

sense_a91bd5a138d707474a48a92f87d1999f.text: Me las vas a pagar. Ya vas a ver.
sense_a91bd5a138d707474a48a92f87d1999f.translation: You're going to pay for that. Just wait and see.

sense_a91bd5a138d707474a48a92f87d1999f.text: Perdón, pero ya conseguí una pareja de baile. - Ya veo.
sense_a91bd5a138d707474a48a92f87d1999f.translation: I'm sorry, but I already found a dance partner. - I see.

sense_5546ceb6edcf3fa2c9329c476d8a657c.translation: Knock it off! I'm trying to focus.

sense_26e2eb2fd78d5377f961fef475a9f928.text: Esta no es la camisa que quería.
sense_26e2eb2fd78d5377f961fef475a9f928.translation: This is not the shirt I wanted.

sense_26e2eb2fd78d5377f961fef475a9f928.text: Este no es el plato que pedí.
sense_26e2eb2fd78d5377f961fef475a9f928.translation: This is not the meal I ordered.

sense_e024ed79f333da7ad7ac98fcd6692cf2.text: ¿Qué falda te gusta más? - Esta es muy bonita.
sense_e024ed79f333da7ad7ac98fcd6692cf2.translation: Which skirt do you like better? - This one is really pretty.

sense_e024ed79f333da7ad7ac98fcd6692cf2.text: Me voy a llevar este; el gorro chico no me queda.
sense_e024ed79f333da7ad7ac98fcd6692cf2.translation: I'm going to take this one; the small hat doesn't fit me.

sense_f539194a2cfe6f5f19280aa07d96e448.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_f539194a2cfe6f5f19280aa07d96e448.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_293ab59265d32712e67be36daae9f0c0.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_7120ca5c626e246e791ac6e4e26025dd.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_7120ca5c626e246e791ac6e4e26025dd.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_7120ca5c626e246e791ac6e4e26025dd.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_7120ca5c626e246e791ac6e4e26025dd.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_2b16781f5cafd68119e9f42d6e555b91.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_2b16781f5cafd68119e9f42d6e555b91.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_2b16781f5cafd68119e9f42d6e555b91.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_2b16781f5cafd68119e9f42d6e555b91.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_2f1574ca7dcda36e51dfdb935ed545fe.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_2f1574ca7dcda36e51dfdb935ed545fe.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_79596d229247afc8bf39d5bd41c5828b.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_79596d229247afc8bf39d5bd41c5828b.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_76ad11df61a53f1ceb68d429ccf7c10c.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_76ad11df61a53f1ceb68d429ccf7c10c.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_7c253a21db0526a78200aeee8fb859d1.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_7c253a21db0526a78200aeee8fb859d1.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_7c253a21db0526a78200aeee8fb859d1.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_7c253a21db0526a78200aeee8fb859d1.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_c85238b445f11b5f37f77322555c27ef.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_c85238b445f11b5f37f77322555c27ef.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_4a7ff053f9cc8d9ca0e1bb482740eda1.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_4a7ff053f9cc8d9ca0e1bb482740eda1.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_4a7ff053f9cc8d9ca0e1bb482740eda1.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_4a7ff053f9cc8d9ca0e1bb482740eda1.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_3537b9be532efb4a05971a6ac8f77d44.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_3537b9be532efb4a05971a6ac8f77d44.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_d6370f09b13c019d8a21e7f4606d538a.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_d6370f09b13c019d8a21e7f4606d538a.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_263c99e1109e4d23a107dbc72d8db9b3.translation: How should I do it? Like this?

sense_586e5aa2be6c03363b6c5b5f68ecbcc2.text: Solía cocinar la paella así para mis hijos.
sense_586e5aa2be6c03363b6c5b5f68ecbcc2.translation: I used to cook paella like that for my kids.
I love it when you dance like that.

sense_59c7bd097051a77dbea707ea1949aa60.text: ¿Y así acaba la película? - Sí, el protagonista muere.
sense_59c7bd097051a77dbea707ea1949aa60.translation: And is that how the movie ends? - Yeah, the main character dies.

sense_59c7bd097051a77dbea707ea1949aa60.text: Eladia y Pedro se conocieron en una fiesta. - Así nos conocimos también Ángel y yo.

sense_ecc4a5ea57170a4448ced3d1274d7464.text: Ahí voy a hacer la compra.
sense_ecc4a5ea57170a4448ced3d1274d7464.translation: I'm just going to get the groceries.

sense_f92a4a382a32c7eb3b35abff475ce1b8.text: Necesitamos una moneda más para completar el conjunto.
sense_f92a4a382a32c7eb3b35abff475ce1b8.translation: We need one more coin to complete the set.
I've only got one candy left.

sense_9573d46588f78730054edb4697fb7ed4.text: Compré uno para mí y otro para ti.
sense_9573d46588f78730054edb4697fb7ed4.translation: I bought one for me and another for you.
How many coins do you need? - Just one.

sense_de702cf8afc48d47702c11402c4175c0.text: La comida maravillosa del restaurante se une a la decoración modernista lujosa.
sense_de702cf8afc48d47702c11402c4175c0.translation: The restaurant's fantastic food is complemented by their luxurious modernist decor.

sense_de702cf8afc48d47702c11402c4175c0.text: Ese tipo es un trabajador fantástico. En él se unen la confianza y la habilidad.
sense_de702cf8afc48d47702c11402c4175c0.translation: That guy's a fantastic worker. He's the epitome of confidence and skill.

sense_08d2aacfb3cf6186f1857a41f7866f83.text: Me bajo una parada antes que la tuya.
sense_08d2aacfb3cf6186f1857a41f7866f83.translation: I get off one stop before yours.

sense_08d2aacfb3cf6186f1857a41f7866f83.text: Descubrí quién era el asesino diez páginas antes del final.
sense_08d2aacfb3cf6186f1857a41f7866f83.translation: I discovered who the murderer was ten pages before the end.

sense_d47fe5b0ea801661aaee5d3ef242095d.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_d47fe5b0ea801661aaee5d3ef242095d.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_fbec262698dd44b3977f4ab5988cc024.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_2e919910728dd7b857a269c1693828ae.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_2e919910728dd7b857a269c1693828ae.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_2e919910728dd7b857a269c1693828ae.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_2e919910728dd7b857a269c1693828ae.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_08d23775d2514937e337bfb9b363c6de.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_08d23775d2514937e337bfb9b363c6de.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_08d23775d2514937e337bfb9b363c6de.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_08d23775d2514937e337bfb9b363c6de.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_fb80e1fb2eb6b818f4e4c19b5a9744bb.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_fb80e1fb2eb6b818f4e4c19b5a9744bb.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_de614840abcc474779d9698548c73a8a.text: Duerme muy poco los fines de semana.
sense_de614840abcc474779d9698548c73a8a.translation: He doesn't sleep much on weekends.
We don't see much of each other lately.

sense_13ab2eb123867307f36ded5e98c13f3f.text: Hay pocos que se molestarían en ayudarlo como tú.
sense_13ab2eb123867307f36ded5e98c13f3f.translation: There are few who would bother helping him like you do.

sense_13ab2eb123867307f36ded5e98c13f3f.text: Menos mal que pocos piensan como él.
sense_13ab2eb123867307f36ded5e98c13f3f.translation: It's just as well not many people think like he does.

sense_488f47250957b60164340206cec96f43.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_fb87c3c374a34d6003cad12691d7a5c7.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_fb87c3c374a34d6003cad12691d7a5c7.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_fb87c3c374a34d6003cad12691d7a5c7.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_fb87c3c374a34d6003cad12691d7a5c7.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_4a99172ba733c4306019c2dc69d0b07d.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_4a99172ba733c4306019c2dc69d0b07d.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_4a99172ba733c4306019c2dc69d0b07d.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_4a99172ba733c4306019c2dc69d0b07d.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_0740fc53d118af39107f5c4fea256c15.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_04915fa24ea4b22c5241b90e275233c4.text: La artesanía que venden en el mercado está toda hecha a mano.
sense_04915fa24ea4b22c5241b90e275233c4.translation: The crafts sold at the market are all handmade.

sense_749e455c544f4c9773624046aa8d81aa.text: Me gustan los filetes bien hechos.
sense_749e455c544f4c9773624046aa8d81aa.translation: I like my steak well done.

sense_7bf6601dbc13600cf4c1bcfd26874007.text: Después de la mudanza, estaba hecha polvo.
sense_7bf6601dbc13600cf4c1bcfd26874007.translation: I was completely exhausted after we moved.

sense_7bf6601dbc13600cf4c1bcfd26874007.text: Esta casa está hecha un asco.

sense_4d3f02674c5bba5faefdbda32cd3aaec.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_4d3f02674c5bba5faefdbda32cd3aaec.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_4d3f02674c5bba5faefdbda32cd3aaec.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_4d3f02674c5bba5faefdbda32cd3aaec.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_51f51ad3a4f25ff15fb9c0ff501db755.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_51f51ad3a4f25ff15fb9c0ff501db755.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_51f51ad3a4f25ff15fb9c0ff501db755.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_51f51ad3a4f25ff15fb9c0ff501db755.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_e149ee5a9d66c4e54c3fa0662271e301.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_c40b515aff8cd2fe45e6aba057971fea.text: Creo que es prudente que mantengamos este secreto entre nosotras por ahora.
sense_c40b515aff8cd2fe45e6aba057971fea.translation: I think it's prudent for us to keep this secret between ourselves for now.

sense_c40b515aff8cd2fe45e6aba057971fea.text: Si no nos quieren ayudar a construir el castillo de arena, no hay problema. Lo haremos nosotras. No necesitamos de su ayuda.
sense_c40b515aff8cd2fe45e6aba057971fea.translation: If you don't want to help us build our sandcastle, it's fine. We'll do it ourselves. We don't need your help.

sense_e26092b0a494956d63e52183145e07c0.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_e26092b0a494956d63e52183145e07c0.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_f6be6e1a6b4383fcd4c88efe03df3509.text: Ella misma diseñó su propio vestido de novias.
sense_f6be6e1a6b4383fcd4c88efe03df3509.translation: She designed her own wedding dress herself.

sense_f6be6e1a6b4383fcd4c88efe03df3509.text: En este mismo sitio, en esta misma fecha, tu madre y yo decidimos casarnos.
sense_f6be6e1a6b4383fcd4c88efe03df3509.translation: In this very place, on this same day, your mother and I decided to get married.

sense_2d74d7e7cc763d05c64a5187daa44f60.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_2d74d7e7cc763d05c64a5187daa44f60.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_d569c85a3242dcbc92440ee5108dfbaa.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_d569c85a3242dcbc92440ee5108dfbaa.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_eaa4bfc8118d9e32f9b71b49ac470c26.text: Estoy cansada, pero no por ello voy a rendirme.
sense_eaa4bfc8118d9e32f9b71b49ac470c26.translation: I'm tired, but I'm not going to give up because of it.

sense_eaa4bfc8118d9e32f9b71b49ac470c26.text: Si quieres algo, lucha por ello.
sense_eaa4bfc8118d9e32f9b71b49ac470c26.translation: If you want something, fight for it.

sense_41aefc7746e9530443afc58df362d976.text: Antonio dice que no se acuerda de ella.
sense_41aefc7746e9530443afc58df362d976.translation: Antonio says he doesn't remember her.

sense_41aefc7746e9530443afc58df362d976.text: Me acuerdo que la primera vez que vi "El imperio contraataca", lloré al final.
sense_41aefc7746e9530443afc58df362d976.translation: I remember that the first time I saw "The Empire Strikes Back", I cried at the end.

sense_4f1ba4b55da8ebc7c83ced8bc0250eb1.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_4f1ba4b55da8ebc7c83ced8bc0250eb1.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_4f1ba4b55da8ebc7c83ced8bc0250eb1.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_4f1ba4b55da8ebc7c83ced8bc0250eb1.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_83ee44459ccfc91e51cc5fe8a1d8d4b7.text: Marisol se acaba de comer una caja entera de pasas.
sense_83ee44459ccfc91e51cc5fe8a1d8d4b7.translation: Marisol just ate an entire box of raisins.

sense_83ee44459ccfc91e51cc5fe8a1d8d4b7.text: ¿Por qué le pusiste pasas al relleno? ¡Sabes que las odio!
sense_83ee44459ccfc91e51cc5fe8a1d8d4b7.translation: Why did you add raisins to the stuffing? You know I hate them!

sense_b36b25806885d029142a2d7275c8ff0e.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_b36b25806885d029142a2d7275c8ff0e.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_b36b25806885d029142a2d7275c8ff0e.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_b36b25806885d029142a2d7275c8ff0e.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_eddb18174a18edc62a23f89a699477a4.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_eddb18174a18edc62a23f89a699477a4.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_3d9cf7b8270adb5b346e84211a468d9a.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_3d9cf7b8270adb5b346e84211a468d9a.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_3d9cf7b8270adb5b346e84211a468d9a.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_3d9cf7b8270adb5b346e84211a468d9a.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_3ac99e1ac2d0d30d294b2c425201cb19.text: Hablé con un señor del ayuntamiento, un tal Rodríguez.
sense_3ac99e1ac2d0d30d294b2c425201cb19.translation: I spoke with a gentleman from city hall, a man named Rodriguez.

sense_3ac99e1ac2d0d30d294b2c425201cb19.text: Un tal señor Martín ha llamado preguntando por ti.
sense_3ac99e1ac2d0d30d294b2c425201cb19.translation: A Mr. Martin called for you.

sense_be25db474312ae10ecfe57689e922473.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_be25db474312ae10ecfe57689e922473.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_7c63de54e13aa07c45975ff67dea3eb8.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_7c63de54e13aa07c45975ff67dea3eb8.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_40baff36122b8b05bfa1cf458dba4754.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_40baff36122b8b05bfa1cf458dba4754.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_40baff36122b8b05bfa1cf458dba4754.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_40baff36122b8b05bfa1cf458dba4754.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_8206022e46aff1290ddfa63a4d81930d.text: Hay una gran cantidad de dinero en esa maleta.
sense_8206022e46aff1290ddfa63a4d81930d.translation: There is a large amount of money in that suitcase.

sense_8206022e46aff1290ddfa63a4d81930d.text: Se puede ganar un montón de dinero al invertir sabiamente.
sense_8206022e46aff1290ddfa63a4d81930d.translation: One can make a lot of money by investing wisely.

sense_a57d2492b9645ee68f8d5925d1878b25.text: ¿Me prestas $20? - ¡Claro que no! Todavía me debes $50.
sense_a57d2492b9645ee68f8d5925d1878b25.translation: Can I borrow $20? - No, you can't! You still owe me $50.

sense_a57d2492b9645ee68f8d5925d1878b25.text: Papá, ¿me ayudarás a hacer la tarea de matemáticas esta noche? - ¡Claro que sí!
sense_a57d2492b9645ee68f8d5925d1878b25.translation: Dad, will you help me with my math homework this evening? - Of course I will!

sense_73f3a24ae13bc8f0909aa79ae904f19e.text: Margarita se negó a hacerlo. Claro que yo en su lugar también me hubiera negado.
sense_73f3a24ae13bc8f0909aa79ae904f19e.translation: Margarita refused to do it. Mind you, I would have refused too in her place.

sense_73f3a24ae13bc8f0909aa79ae904f19e.text: ¿Lo haces tú? - Claro, para que si sale mal me eches la culpa a mí.
sense_73f3a24ae13bc8f0909aa79ae904f19e.translation: Will you do it? - Oh sure, so you can blame me if it goes wrong.

sense_5b9ecbf73452b1ed50a1a5d4191b8dbf.text: ¿Nos vemos donde el teatro del otro día?
sense_5b9ecbf73452b1ed50a1a5d4191b8dbf.translation: Shall we meet by the theater we went to the other day?

sense_5b9ecbf73452b1ed50a1a5d4191b8dbf.text: Se van a reunir todos los primos donde tu tía para cenar.
sense_5b9ecbf73452b1ed50a1a5d4191b8dbf.translation: All the cousins will gather at your aunt's for dinner.

sense_aa518176c5af0feb26351d118305b61c.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_aa518176c5af0feb26351d118305b61c.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_1d2220cf5df4f84c432515a39deef6fd.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_1d2220cf5df4f84c432515a39deef6fd.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_d8f94107a3b34fd9b91668d86de4efaf.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_66003480f711226885756e3d41086350.text: En esta economía, los trabajos seguros no abundan.
sense_66003480f711226885756e3d41086350.translation: In this economy, there aren't a lot of secure jobs.

sense_66003480f711226885756e3d41086350.text: No te encarames en esa silla, ¡no es segura!
sense_66003480f711226885756e3d41086350.translation: Don't climb up on that chair. It isn't secure!

sense_1d46fdf827c1b2121fe8ecb1183edfa7.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_1d46fdf827c1b2121fe8ecb1183edfa7.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_1d46fdf827c1b2121fe8ecb1183edfa7.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_1d46fdf827c1b2121fe8ecb1183edfa7.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_0da520ed535555ee17d462bc074a2798.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_0da520ed535555ee17d462bc074a2798.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_c27d7648caa5b9891b18bd15483ae79a.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_c27d7648caa5b9891b18bd15483ae79a.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_5ee04644fbb683652eca0504ceebbb00.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_5ee04644fbb683652eca0504ceebbb00.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_5ee04644fbb683652eca0504ceebbb00.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_5ee04644fbb683652eca0504ceebbb00.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_77c724ae162f8dab59a2e24967f7a94d.text: No soy muy amigo de la tecnología, pero entiendo su importancia.
sense_77c724ae162f8dab59a2e24967f7a94d.translation: I don't really like technology, but I understand its importance.

sense_77c724ae162f8dab59a2e24967f7a94d.text: Los británicos son muy amigos de hacer bricolaje y siempre están comprando artículos para la casa.
sense_77c724ae162f8dab59a2e24967f7a94d.translation: The British love doing DIY and are always buying articles for the home.

sense_8060cecc105608c1cc74ec2c8447bd50.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_035477ec6004ecd938ee3f8abe807fd7.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_2630a92612e54008fbb3c6ed58254842.text: La empresa emitió su estado de pérdidas y ganancias.
sense_2630a92612e54008fbb3c6ed58254842.translation: The company issued its profit and loss statement.

sense_01042fb0d7963323e4af23f272bfa3f2.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_01042fb0d7963323e4af23f272bfa3f2.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_01042fb0d7963323e4af23f272bfa3f2.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_01042fb0d7963323e4af23f272bfa3f2.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_a8761ca8c4a01d7ecc6fe547af6af9a0.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_a8761ca8c4a01d7ecc6fe547af6af9a0.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_a8761ca8c4a01d7ecc6fe547af6af9a0.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_a8761ca8c4a01d7ecc6fe547af6af9a0.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_27f96110a1157f46fc8c9256c0a3e9c9.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_27f96110a1157f46fc8c9256c0a3e9c9.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_fe2599c99c7df82b20e8fc8a97064de6.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_fe2599c99c7df82b20e8fc8a97064de6.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_09f53823bf29abc3a35b0663a685814a.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_09f53823bf29abc3a35b0663a685814a.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_09f53823bf29abc3a35b0663a685814a.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_09f53823bf29abc3a35b0663a685814a.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_38e8f095db9fa5ef5fdf451f81314167.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_38e8f095db9fa5ef5fdf451f81314167.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_a801687fab021ca049ee7955d220cd54.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_a801687fab021ca049ee7955d220cd54.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_4c3d65e0831a905801ccf413a26718af.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_4c3d65e0831a905801ccf413a26718af.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_4c3d65e0831a905801ccf413a26718af.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_4c3d65e0831a905801ccf413a26718af.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_47038cc776c9d02df3ea18c858b87199.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_47038cc776c9d02df3ea18c858b87199.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_ac8f98d08513e8e95950a273d58a8365.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_ac8f98d08513e8e95950a273d58a8365.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_24997dfaa8689e7c913d02d5fca5ebfb.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_24997dfaa8689e7c913d02d5fca5ebfb.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_24997dfaa8689e7c913d02d5fca5ebfb.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_24997dfaa8689e7c913d02d5fca5ebfb.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_58fa92e215a7be89e65acf365bc6ef8a.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_58fa92e215a7be89e65acf365bc6ef8a.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_fa3fb6aac25937ae2042360bbb474764.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_fa3fb6aac25937ae2042360bbb474764.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_60609088a6a3e5c3c6106d85e88c7e4a.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_60609088a6a3e5c3c6106d85e88c7e4a.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_2812cf109c83495f177f9439f9b6f258.text: ¡Mujer, no te enfades! Lo hice sin mala intención.
sense_2812cf109c83495f177f9439f9b6f258.translation: Come on, don't be angry! I meant no harm.

sense_2812cf109c83495f177f9439f9b6f258.text: ¡Mujer, pero si era broma! ¿Creíste que lo decía en serio? - Pues sí.
sense_2812cf109c83495f177f9439f9b6f258.translation: But it was a joke! Did you think I was being serious? - Well, yes, I did.

sense_b6b667664828ac361693711c04f8119d.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_b6b667664828ac361693711c04f8119d.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_b6b667664828ac361693711c04f8119d.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_b6b667664828ac361693711c04f8119d.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_27dc6dbcc69aaccc3bdffb0c82458f98.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_27dc6dbcc69aaccc3bdffb0c82458f98.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_27dc6dbcc69aaccc3bdffb0c82458f98.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_27dc6dbcc69aaccc3bdffb0c82458f98.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_c5b3490280287b17fe94650a9b361c36.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_842f8d237ebaf5ed37ebd46dd354f377.text: Hoy es el cumpleaños de nuestra hermana.

sense_fda1a82b33c54421aadd92481c0a230e.text: ¿Sus fotos del viaje salieron bien? Las nuestras están oscuras.
sense_fda1a82b33c54421aadd92481c0a230e.translation: Did your pictures from the trip turn out okay? Ours came out dark.

sense_fda1a82b33c54421aadd92481c0a230e.text: ¿Tu perro ya viene cuando lo llamas? El nuestro todavía es muy cachorro.
sense_fda1a82b33c54421aadd92481c0a230e.translation: Your dog already comes when he is called? Ours is still too young.

sense_389e029a602d045119120c47511a345d.text: Allí fue cuando se dio cuenta de que podía cambiar.
sense_389e029a602d045119120c47511a345d.translation: That's when he realized he could change.

sense_389e029a602d045119120c47511a345d.text: Hasta allí llegamos, pero ese día cambió todo entre nosotras.
sense_389e029a602d045119120c47511a345d.translation: We were ok up to then, but that day everything changed between us.

sense_e99137f7f693455f8cfa9360afabbbf2.text: Tienen todo lleno de mierda. Nunca limpian nada.
sense_e99137f7f693455f8cfa9360afabbbf2.translation: Their place is disgusting. They never clean.

sense_e99137f7f693455f8cfa9360afabbbf2.text: La casa está hecha una mierda. A ver cuando nos ponemos a limpiar un poco.
sense_e99137f7f693455f8cfa9360afabbbf2.translation: The house is filthy. We need to get down to some cleaning.

sense_357181c33b1bffc7e7eb15b5542344aa.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_357181c33b1bffc7e7eb15b5542344aa.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_345b0e67e32c4501a93b6cc341f446ff.text: Esta no es la camisa que quería.
sense_345b0e67e32c4501a93b6cc341f446ff.translation: This is not the shirt I wanted.

sense_345b0e67e32c4501a93b6cc341f446ff.text: Este no es el plato que pedí.
sense_345b0e67e32c4501a93b6cc341f446ff.translation: This is not the meal I ordered.

sense_e8a4958a832e903857dec81893686050.text: ¿Qué falda te gusta más? - Esta es muy bonita.
sense_e8a4958a832e903857dec81893686050.translation: Which skirt do you like better? - This one is really pretty.

sense_e8a4958a832e903857dec81893686050.text: Me voy a llevar este; el gorro chico no me queda.
sense_e8a4958a832e903857dec81893686050.translation: I'm going to take this one; the small hat doesn't fit me.

sense_4d454bbcab9032b64baf342522847a60.text: Tengo que limpiar la casa porque hoy viene mi mamá.
sense_4d454bbcab9032b64baf342522847a60.translation: I have to clean the house because my mom is coming today.

sense_4d454bbcab9032b64baf342522847a60.text: ¿Qué le vas a regalar a mamá para el Día de la Madre? - Es una sorpresa.
sense_4d454bbcab9032b64baf342522847a60.translation: What are you going to give Mom for Mother's Day? - It's a surprise.

sense_772855edbffc67f26564cad711c249ee.text: Estos no son mis lentes. Quiero los míos.
sense_772855edbffc67f26564cad711c249ee.translation: These aren't my glasses. I want mine.

sense_772855edbffc67f26564cad711c249ee.text: Este asiento es el mío. El tuyo es ese otro.
sense_772855edbffc67f26564cad711c249ee.translation: This seat is mine. Yours is that one there.

sense_0cc3e11f86e115cc1ace5cdd3bcc5e34.text: Se fue sin explicación y me partió el corazón.
sense_0cc3e11f86e115cc1ace5cdd3bcc5e34.translation: She left without explanation and broke my heart.

sense_0cc3e11f86e115cc1ace5cdd3bcc5e34.text: Le dijeron que si no pagaba la deuda, le iban a partir las piernas.
sense_0cc3e11f86e115cc1ace5cdd3bcc5e34.translation: They told him that if he didn't pay the debt, they were going to break his legs.

sense_bdb2b96e4c590233ef8250f307245490.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_bdb2b96e4c590233ef8250f307245490.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_bdb2b96e4c590233ef8250f307245490.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_bdb2b96e4c590233ef8250f307245490.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_c23cdc4b696b1595c11a4d31798518ab.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_c23cdc4b696b1595c11a4d31798518ab.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_0b7175f4f59cf86c831899f9c7d018ee.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_0b7175f4f59cf86c831899f9c7d018ee.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_d02320313b97e4b0ba674cd0131f5484.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_d02320313b97e4b0ba674cd0131f5484.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_d02320313b97e4b0ba674cd0131f5484.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_d02320313b97e4b0ba674cd0131f5484.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_7213ed69ca92669dede80d108fe6cd32.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_7213ed69ca92669dede80d108fe6cd32.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_7213ed69ca92669dede80d108fe6cd32.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_7213ed69ca92669dede80d108fe6cd32.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_1cbbcb2d40564d6536ca24a04b29e26c.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_1cbbcb2d40564d6536ca24a04b29e26c.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_a37e2d2cdd496288aac9a11002adcc42.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_a37e2d2cdd496288aac9a11002adcc42.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_a37e2d2cdd496288aac9a11002adcc42.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_a37e2d2cdd496288aac9a11002adcc42.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_9a2c374ab0ddad66c4b49af72ae063f0.text: Hoy es el cumpleaños de nuestra hermana.

sense_a5e1dd20f83598a00ed1ce31e1a5ff04.text: ¿Sus fotos del viaje salieron bien? Las nuestras están oscuras.
sense_a5e1dd20f83598a00ed1ce31e1a5ff04.translation: Did your pictures from the trip turn out okay? Ours came out dark.

sense_a5e1dd20f83598a00ed1ce31e1a5ff04.text: ¿Tu perro ya viene cuando lo llamas? El nuestro todavía es muy cachorro.
sense_a5e1dd20f83598a00ed1ce31e1a5ff04.translation: Your dog already comes when he is called? Ours is still too young.

sense_3272bcc447a4c20f4d87d7e5e2054739.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_3272bcc447a4c20f4d87d7e5e2054739.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_beddcf0243f0b06c2a3a84fcd8e3f4bf.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_beddcf0243f0b06c2a3a84fcd8e3f4bf.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_9907b9a23fbf7401156eb9e6eff28b17.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_9907b9a23fbf7401156eb9e6eff28b17.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_9907b9a23fbf7401156eb9e6eff28b17.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_9907b9a23fbf7401156eb9e6eff28b17.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_2e61c250aeda54e7b9058bfe9692a33c.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_2e61c250aeda54e7b9058bfe9692a33c.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_4f93f719dce17387879389a5536f8dbd.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_4f93f719dce17387879389a5536f8dbd.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_4f93f719dce17387879389a5536f8dbd.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_4f93f719dce17387879389a5536f8dbd.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_bca3e2934f08bc6c2f671f899d17fcf3.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_bca3e2934f08bc6c2f671f899d17fcf3.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_6c5a8c7ade29de88bf0db708923bd6f4.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_6c5a8c7ade29de88bf0db708923bd6f4.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_ae7a0db168d604f599cf9201f5b02da2.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_ae7a0db168d604f599cf9201f5b02da2.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_ae7a0db168d604f599cf9201f5b02da2.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_ae7a0db168d604f599cf9201f5b02da2.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_64ea0c087a670f35a3afa97cd4430f98.text: Cada vez que te veo, me enamoro más.
sense_64ea0c087a670f35a3afa97cd4430f98.translation: Every time I see you, I fall in love even more.

sense_64ea0c087a670f35a3afa97cd4430f98.text: Por cada tres que compras, te llevas uno gratis.
sense_64ea0c087a670f35a3afa97cd4430f98.translation: For every three that you buy, you get another one free.

sense_f6782cadf4b940af8fc3921fe1ec71df.text: Las cosas siguen cada vez mejor.
sense_f6782cadf4b940af8fc3921fe1ec71df.translation: Things keep getting better and better.

sense_f6782cadf4b940af8fc3921fe1ec71df.text: ¿Echas de menos vivir en Nueva York? - Cada vez más.
sense_f6782cadf4b940af8fc3921fe1ec71df.translation: Do you miss living in New York? - More and more.

sense_a2c4fa7b718c457977db9f045c1246de.text: Papi, ¿cuándo nos dará la vez a subir los caballitos?
sense_a2c4fa7b718c457977db9f045c1246de.translation: Daddy, when will it be our turn to ride the merry-go-round?

sense_9d7d5e91b31178d843340e7094259867.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_9d7d5e91b31178d843340e7094259867.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_9d7d5e91b31178d843340e7094259867.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_9d7d5e91b31178d843340e7094259867.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_9c09480b73942c8aaca16de922630287.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_9c09480b73942c8aaca16de922630287.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_c1413985608b28753e526c7167883ba4.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_c1413985608b28753e526c7167883ba4.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_c1413985608b28753e526c7167883ba4.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_624db8ea54505c6476e5ce6bcdca2d3a.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_f07935b44e1adb9f59c5d9d1e69f5315.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_f07935b44e1adb9f59c5d9d1e69f5315.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_23772c3b735b2f2357be32c5e6f48d1f.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_23772c3b735b2f2357be32c5e6f48d1f.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_23772c3b735b2f2357be32c5e6f48d1f.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_9b2e0c0ee2497c6f683edda4efbaf23e.text: A cierto individuo se le vio huyendo de la escena del crimen.
sense_9b2e0c0ee2497c6f683edda4efbaf23e.translation: A certain individual was seen fleeing the scene of the crime.

sense_9b2e0c0ee2497c6f683edda4efbaf23e.text: La incidencia durante el partido fue obra de ciertas personas, no de todos los fanáticos.
sense_9b2e0c0ee2497c6f683edda4efbaf23e.translation: The incident during the match was the work of certain individuals, not all the fans.

sense_7a45aff897dd3cfe875cc1ca68fa111e.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_7a45aff897dd3cfe875cc1ca68fa111e.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_7a45aff897dd3cfe875cc1ca68fa111e.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_7a45aff897dd3cfe875cc1ca68fa111e.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_4657d8ebf700a3c3ff7cacf170ffb0ce.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_4657d8ebf700a3c3ff7cacf170ffb0ce.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_4657d8ebf700a3c3ff7cacf170ffb0ce.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_4657d8ebf700a3c3ff7cacf170ffb0ce.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_078422e406e213938ae83141e82bf2d7.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_078422e406e213938ae83141e82bf2d7.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_078422e406e213938ae83141e82bf2d7.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_078422e406e213938ae83141e82bf2d7.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_dc8c06687448a4f09785abb91b8d41a6.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_dc8c06687448a4f09785abb91b8d41a6.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_dc8c06687448a4f09785abb91b8d41a6.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_dc8c06687448a4f09785abb91b8d41a6.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_fb1b0793f6ede69db24865378665a8a3.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_7d3e0783221cc57aeaa99d7cdcd552a8.text: Entre menos te quejes, más caso te haré.
sense_7d3e0783221cc57aeaa99d7cdcd552a8.translation: The less you complain, the more you'll get my attention.
The more you work, the more you'll earn.

sense_96fd6c5167e18ebd5fd1eef1a95d4229.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_96fd6c5167e18ebd5fd1eef1a95d4229.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_96fd6c5167e18ebd5fd1eef1a95d4229.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_96fd6c5167e18ebd5fd1eef1a95d4229.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_efff8d9ce02e63d69ad6d33b6ffd0faa.text: Esos son los churros más deliciosos de toda la ciudad.
sense_efff8d9ce02e63d69ad6d33b6ffd0faa.translation: Those are the most delicious churros in the whole city.

sense_2d6e6c014e7ad5e2619f78b1d53e5db5.text: He visto esta película pero esas no todavía.
sense_2d6e6c014e7ad5e2619f78b1d53e5db5.translation: I've seen this movie but not those ones yet.

sense_2d6e6c014e7ad5e2619f78b1d53e5db5.text: ¿Has probado estos caramelos? - ¡Sí, esos me encantan!
sense_2d6e6c014e7ad5e2619f78b1d53e5db5.translation: Have you tried these chocolates? - Yes, I love those ones!

sense_d184df4db105bc22d9356dcbfdaf4022.text: Conseguí unas manzanas deliciosas en el mercado.
sense_d184df4db105bc22d9356dcbfdaf4022.translation: I got some delicious apples at the market.
I bought some very interesting books.

sense_ff9837b638c22b315202be13f7301e27.text: Necesitamos una moneda más para completar el conjunto.
sense_ff9837b638c22b315202be13f7301e27.translation: We need one more coin to complete the set.
I've only got one candy left.

sense_00d265c11074463a0e5f3bb0b80a3a47.text: Compré uno para mí y otro para ti.
sense_00d265c11074463a0e5f3bb0b80a3a47.translation: I bought one for me and another for you.
How many coins do you need? - Just one.

sense_17deb802d2797a9cc976f8f91a57fdbf.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_17deb802d2797a9cc976f8f91a57fdbf.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_17deb802d2797a9cc976f8f91a57fdbf.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_17deb802d2797a9cc976f8f91a57fdbf.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_8f1d934f6e744963627943f4a161e1e6.text: No soy muy amigo de la tecnología, pero entiendo su importancia.
sense_8f1d934f6e744963627943f4a161e1e6.translation: I don't really like technology, but I understand its importance.

sense_8f1d934f6e744963627943f4a161e1e6.text: Los británicos son muy amigos de hacer bricolaje y siempre están comprando artículos para la casa.
sense_8f1d934f6e744963627943f4a161e1e6.translation: The British love doing DIY and are always buying articles for the home.

sense_492a56805fd322d30f6b0d037d5aab3b.text: Pues, chica, no sé cómo voy a resolver el problema.
sense_492a56805fd322d30f6b0d037d5aab3b.translation: Well, I don't know how I'm going to solve the problem.

sense_2937f29786b893fff4c93bd34486cf93.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_2937f29786b893fff4c93bd34486cf93.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_891ffc75e819616dd57022c42b126af3.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_891ffc75e819616dd57022c42b126af3.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_5d5e391c3ed36f46f46cf61310c6c539.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_5d5e391c3ed36f46f46cf61310c6c539.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_5d5e391c3ed36f46f46cf61310c6c539.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_5d5e391c3ed36f46f46cf61310c6c539.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_ca4d5821c7ff923f99f89da4c3792742.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_ca4d5821c7ff923f99f89da4c3792742.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_ca4d5821c7ff923f99f89da4c3792742.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_ca4d5821c7ff923f99f89da4c3792742.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_96d80f846ef266fecccc9498bf52be1c.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_96d80f846ef266fecccc9498bf52be1c.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_5194f787caf208f4924732a72100b0fd.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_5194f787caf208f4924732a72100b0fd.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_5194f787caf208f4924732a72100b0fd.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_5194f787caf208f4924732a72100b0fd.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_01d7f4093dd6d787bc2924b315afb500.text: Por mi cuenta, yo ya terminé la tarea.
sense_01d7f4093dd6d787bc2924b315afb500.translation: I already finished my homework on my own.

sense_f06e236ce8617e1ed36477975b0861e8.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_f06e236ce8617e1ed36477975b0861e8.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_118bcf7c13540ce4ba12bb1c8902300c.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_118bcf7c13540ce4ba12bb1c8902300c.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_f335a66b021faa2b88220a1bc81c7263.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_2877adbbdbba1e80ca6b6e8df454d1ef.text: Estoy cansado. - Pues vete a dormir.
sense_2877adbbdbba1e80ca6b6e8df454d1ef.translation: I am tired. - Go to sleep then.
I don't know what to tell you, then.

sense_b89dc848e5e526dafd223f9f4acec0b1.text: Fueron a rescatar el pájaro, pero ya estaba muerto.
sense_b89dc848e5e526dafd223f9f4acec0b1.translation: They went to rescue the bird, but it was already dead.

sense_b89dc848e5e526dafd223f9f4acec0b1.text: Aunque mi autora preferida está muerta, siento que la conozco a través de sus cuentos.
sense_b89dc848e5e526dafd223f9f4acec0b1.translation: Although my favorite author is dead, I feel like I know her through her stories.

sense_c26ff143cf8c13eb19f67cbfa11b240f.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_c26ff143cf8c13eb19f67cbfa11b240f.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_c26ff143cf8c13eb19f67cbfa11b240f.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_c26ff143cf8c13eb19f67cbfa11b240f.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_8bcafe599b41bf50a94313abac57c9f7.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_8bcafe599b41bf50a94313abac57c9f7.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_8bcafe599b41bf50a94313abac57c9f7.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_8bcafe599b41bf50a94313abac57c9f7.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_423893d6e79272e4467ef5b8cfc99fe9.text: Todavía no he visto esa película.
sense_423893d6e79272e4467ef5b8cfc99fe9.translation: I still haven't seen that movie.

sense_423893d6e79272e4467ef5b8cfc99fe9.text: Todavía tengo que comprarle un regalo.
sense_423893d6e79272e4467ef5b8cfc99fe9.translation: I still have to buy him a present.

sense_029b1589887ab36e7541d8a73c9fc815.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_029b1589887ab36e7541d8a73c9fc815.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_029b1589887ab36e7541d8a73c9fc815.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_029b1589887ab36e7541d8a73c9fc815.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_8ad635d16825eb35d2b95c0e7a6f8bdc.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_8ad635d16825eb35d2b95c0e7a6f8bdc.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_8ad635d16825eb35d2b95c0e7a6f8bdc.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_8ad635d16825eb35d2b95c0e7a6f8bdc.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_8c29df8bcae7417cf0cd9356844ce831.text: La corriente de este enchufe es de 220 V.
sense_8c29df8bcae7417cf0cd9356844ce831.translation: The current of this plug is 220 V.

sense_8c29df8bcae7417cf0cd9356844ce831.text: La diferencia de potencial entre los dos polos de la pila es de 1 V.
sense_8c29df8bcae7417cf0cd9356844ce831.translation: The difference of potential between the two poles of the battery is 1 V.

sense_03003431fb103ec13e349461b2a0a699.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_03003431fb103ec13e349461b2a0a699.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_03003431fb103ec13e349461b2a0a699.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_03003431fb103ec13e349461b2a0a699.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_a4cfafb686f436e8ebdaf73d5eb22375.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_a4cfafb686f436e8ebdaf73d5eb22375.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_a4cfafb686f436e8ebdaf73d5eb22375.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_a4cfafb686f436e8ebdaf73d5eb22375.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_ebab46da69a000f41e3d4c7071bdf8ba.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_ebab46da69a000f41e3d4c7071bdf8ba.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_986ff3c571a05edef715d064e93548bf.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_986ff3c571a05edef715d064e93548bf.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_986ff3c571a05edef715d064e93548bf.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_986ff3c571a05edef715d064e93548bf.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_060befef4e9a1d80f93d9550d1513632.text: Si corrieras más, estarías en mejor forma.
sense_060befef4e9a1d80f93d9550d1513632.translation: If you ran more, you'd be in better shape.

sense_060befef4e9a1d80f93d9550d1513632.text: Gaby se ha mantenido en buena forma corriendo todos los días al levantarse.
sense_060befef4e9a1d80f93d9550d1513632.translation: Gaby has kept fit by running every morning when she gets up.

sense_d2ebea26f664794e5b1c49852e648b19.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_d2ebea26f664794e5b1c49852e648b19.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_c63e9a4f593f6a4a43c88ba429d93a1a.text: En cualquier caso, su decisión es firme.
sense_c63e9a4f593f6a4a43c88ba429d93a1a.translation: In any case, his decision is final.

sense_c63e9a4f593f6a4a43c88ba429d93a1a.text: Puedo ir con mis hijos a cualquier país de vacaciones.
sense_c63e9a4f593f6a4a43c88ba429d93a1a.translation: I can take my children to any country on vacation.

sense_24e609386904bccd0f687aa9417b72be.text: Hola, chicas, ¿cómo están? ¿Vinieron sin sus novios?
sense_24e609386904bccd0f687aa9417b72be.translation: Hi, guys, how are you? Did you come without your boyfriends?

sense_24e609386904bccd0f687aa9417b72be.text: Bueno, chicos, yo ahora ya me despido de ustedes. - ¿Por qué te vas tan temprano?
sense_24e609386904bccd0f687aa9417b72be.translation: Well, guys, I'll say goodbye now. - Why are you leaving so early?

sense_f876d400d4c0bb842b509dd00ca6ca0c.text: Esos son los churros más deliciosos de toda la ciudad.
sense_f876d400d4c0bb842b509dd00ca6ca0c.translation: Those are the most delicious churros in the whole city.

sense_c0f24afb2be997d4863651beadf32415.text: He visto esta película pero esas no todavía.
sense_c0f24afb2be997d4863651beadf32415.translation: I've seen this movie but not those ones yet.

sense_c0f24afb2be997d4863651beadf32415.text: ¿Has probado estos caramelos? - ¡Sí, esos me encantan!
sense_c0f24afb2be997d4863651beadf32415.translation: Have you tried these chocolates? - Yes, I love those ones!

sense_683d374a4d33a275e9e8e1bd34912eba.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_683d374a4d33a275e9e8e1bd34912eba.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_683d374a4d33a275e9e8e1bd34912eba.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_683d374a4d33a275e9e8e1bd34912eba.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_9fbd4b2b83ec9789e4a8f98e7056362e.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_9fbd4b2b83ec9789e4a8f98e7056362e.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_9fbd4b2b83ec9789e4a8f98e7056362e.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_9fbd4b2b83ec9789e4a8f98e7056362e.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_a289c18f231a6136f7adc5373178cef9.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_0437e6c090f55a7217ff10cb22ce25cb.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_0437e6c090f55a7217ff10cb22ce25cb.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_0437e6c090f55a7217ff10cb22ce25cb.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_0437e6c090f55a7217ff10cb22ce25cb.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_74cb226bb0a6a678911f039748e58df1.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_74cb226bb0a6a678911f039748e58df1.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_74cb226bb0a6a678911f039748e58df1.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_74cb226bb0a6a678911f039748e58df1.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_e6e67a833a2161ab189bc4fedd7be478.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_e6e67a833a2161ab189bc4fedd7be478.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_e6e67a833a2161ab189bc4fedd7be478.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_e6e67a833a2161ab189bc4fedd7be478.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_d8835ea124849a106c71838076625293.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_d8835ea124849a106c71838076625293.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_d8835ea124849a106c71838076625293.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_d8835ea124849a106c71838076625293.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_31a2621ce77681387b3f759af146226d.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_31a2621ce77681387b3f759af146226d.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_31a2621ce77681387b3f759af146226d.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_31a2621ce77681387b3f759af146226d.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_107e151f658f4b5fc8ad08016de2bbe9.text: Casi sería mejor quedarnos en casa.
sense_107e151f658f4b5fc8ad08016de2bbe9.translation: It might be better if we just stay at home.
I think I'd rather not know.

sense_bc2c25bcbd6b9f3ad336a06b0d647b5e.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_bc2c25bcbd6b9f3ad336a06b0d647b5e.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_500d9f0034edafa39864af3495b83aac.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_500d9f0034edafa39864af3495b83aac.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_500d9f0034edafa39864af3495b83aac.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_500d9f0034edafa39864af3495b83aac.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_21b985e8941116cb4179d96107224608.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_21b985e8941116cb4179d96107224608.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_bbe11acd497991503c175970f8696ff3.translation: So many people have come to the party!
It's taken you ages to get here!

sense_cf03da0a7928db68d7ff4488dc50f742.text: ¡Cuánto quiero que me lleves a ese restaurante de nuevo!
sense_cf03da0a7928db68d7ff4488dc50f742.translation: I want you to take me back to that restaurant so badly!

sense_c9cb0cbd33222a3bbe45857f3307acff.text: Los niños siempre están al cuidado de una empleada doméstica.
sense_c9cb0cbd33222a3bbe45857f3307acff.translation: The children are always in a maid's care.

sense_c9cb0cbd33222a3bbe45857f3307acff.text: Contratamos a un enfermero para estar al cuidado de mi suegro.
sense_c9cb0cbd33222a3bbe45857f3307acff.translation: We hired a nurse to look after my father-in-law.

sense_374e0831a9ba79e6b17d95a563e5a7bc.text: Me trae sin cuidado lo que digas.
sense_374e0831a9ba79e6b17d95a563e5a7bc.translation: I don't care what you say.

sense_374e0831a9ba79e6b17d95a563e5a7bc.text: Pierde cuidado: yo me ocupo de que llegue a tiempo.
sense_374e0831a9ba79e6b17d95a563e5a7bc.translation: Don't worry! I will see to it that he arrives in time.

sense_ef76cad2efe44d158a64996078a47e42.translation: I don't know which one she wants.

sense_06583bdc2953fc09d823625857f18ebd.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_06583bdc2953fc09d823625857f18ebd.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_231a9459cf7cfbe995fe490a12b5692c.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_231a9459cf7cfbe995fe490a12b5692c.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_231a9459cf7cfbe995fe490a12b5692c.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_231a9459cf7cfbe995fe490a12b5692c.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_d778338a7b53832b108c4a27d113a177.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_d778338a7b53832b108c4a27d113a177.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_d778338a7b53832b108c4a27d113a177.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_d778338a7b53832b108c4a27d113a177.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_0ddb8241733d5cf74bdddc6c440c3606.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_0ddb8241733d5cf74bdddc6c440c3606.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_94dfeb6150590b0591c2682c4d126902.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_94dfeb6150590b0591c2682c4d126902.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_94dfeb6150590b0591c2682c4d126902.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_94dfeb6150590b0591c2682c4d126902.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_8fdf8ef66c9b476ac59cab5c68f90b87.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_8fdf8ef66c9b476ac59cab5c68f90b87.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_f15fd67f5623a225509b4423d8dbb69b.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_f15fd67f5623a225509b4423d8dbb69b.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_f15fd67f5623a225509b4423d8dbb69b.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_f15fd67f5623a225509b4423d8dbb69b.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_61fc8efdb39e076ab56ce322662537bb.text: Había cientos de personas en el concierto.
sense_61fc8efdb39e076ab56ce322662537bb.translation: There were hundreds of people at the concert.

sense_61fc8efdb39e076ab56ce322662537bb.text: Solo damos una bebida por persona.
sense_61fc8efdb39e076ab56ce322662537bb.translation: We're only giving out one drink per person.

sense_b4eb5d7dfeb5cf11dc3264c45768298c.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_b4eb5d7dfeb5cf11dc3264c45768298c.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_b4eb5d7dfeb5cf11dc3264c45768298c.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_b4eb5d7dfeb5cf11dc3264c45768298c.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_b272bdbb33bb072c82760c9a4008a272.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_b272bdbb33bb072c82760c9a4008a272.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_b272bdbb33bb072c82760c9a4008a272.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_b272bdbb33bb072c82760c9a4008a272.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_c32e6dd83fde0ff22a5966e2081b4de8.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_8b5549580b797466c88266d81f281871.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_8b5549580b797466c88266d81f281871.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_091d37ce03cc429ebe9db75a6bc2fe40.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_091d37ce03cc429ebe9db75a6bc2fe40.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_091d37ce03cc429ebe9db75a6bc2fe40.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_091d37ce03cc429ebe9db75a6bc2fe40.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_5647520788e1750d33c367fe47130ae8.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_5647520788e1750d33c367fe47130ae8.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_ec202cd9185a2a0e1a369a5896531125.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_ec202cd9185a2a0e1a369a5896531125.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_ec202cd9185a2a0e1a369a5896531125.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_ec202cd9185a2a0e1a369a5896531125.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_9e29618417b56daed38b9aeebaa166f5.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_9e29618417b56daed38b9aeebaa166f5.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_d8922634a8112adba73d2699ba964c77.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_d8922634a8112adba73d2699ba964c77.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_d8922634a8112adba73d2699ba964c77.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_d8922634a8112adba73d2699ba964c77.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_cd410706c47fe62d76fe326fb9ed3253.text: Había cientos de personas en el concierto.
sense_cd410706c47fe62d76fe326fb9ed3253.translation: There were hundreds of people at the concert.

sense_cd410706c47fe62d76fe326fb9ed3253.text: Solo damos una bebida por persona.
sense_cd410706c47fe62d76fe326fb9ed3253.translation: We're only giving out one drink per person.

sense_20d6f2c7e6ee25b3a0c91122ba58f496.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_20d6f2c7e6ee25b3a0c91122ba58f496.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_20d6f2c7e6ee25b3a0c91122ba58f496.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_20d6f2c7e6ee25b3a0c91122ba58f496.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_c35089f0d402b5a0bf499fb67fdf2a03.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_c35089f0d402b5a0bf499fb67fdf2a03.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_c35089f0d402b5a0bf499fb67fdf2a03.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_c35089f0d402b5a0bf499fb67fdf2a03.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_577f08850a77080afaa39b0af6ddf718.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_82100f161da5bb6d6aae3eef537ca8d7.text: Se adelantó a sus dudas y tenía listas las respuestas.
sense_82100f161da5bb6d6aae3eef537ca8d7.translation: He anticipated their doubts and he had answers ready.

sense_82100f161da5bb6d6aae3eef537ca8d7.text: Iba a ordenar la casa esta tarde, pero mi mujer se me adelantó.
sense_82100f161da5bb6d6aae3eef537ca8d7.translation: I was going to tidy the house this afternoon, but my wife beat me to it.

sense_15709377230e0c778de8101daf9866b2.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_15709377230e0c778de8101daf9866b2.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_12c30e9535b5100c92fd29f0aec141ac.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_12c30e9535b5100c92fd29f0aec141ac.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.
