sense_fea8da917a4b15b48ea3bd8ff3d7203e.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_fea8da917a4b15b48ea3bd8ff3d7203e.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_fea8da917a4b15b48ea3bd8ff3d7203e.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_fea8da917a4b15b48ea3bd8ff3d7203e.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_3cc771ee6e3a16adfb41c4b3f7f8e361.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_3cc771ee6e3a16adfb41c4b3f7f8e361.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_3cc771ee6e3a16adfb41c4b3f7f8e361.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_3cc771ee6e3a16adfb41c4b3f7f8e361.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_213940ceabd1f081129efb1682bbcc51.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_213940ceabd1f081129efb1682bbcc51.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_32413308dea2d5f59e1b3c4def832de7.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_32413308dea2d5f59e1b3c4def832de7.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_32413308dea2d5f59e1b3c4def832de7.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_32413308dea2d5f59e1b3c4def832de7.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_27f19fd79b70c45f0c4cfcb29c445cbb.text: Hoy es el cumpleaños de nuestra hermana.

sense_abcf4e932006fa77dbd538d0592c85a8.text: ¿Sus fotos del viaje salieron bien? Las nuestras están oscuras.
sense_abcf4e932006fa77dbd538d0592c85a8.translation: Did your pictures from the trip turn out okay? Ours came out dark.

sense_abcf4e932006fa77dbd538d0592c85a8.text: ¿Tu perro ya viene cuando lo llamas? El nuestro todavía es muy cachorro.
sense_abcf4e932006fa77dbd538d0592c85a8.translation: Your dog already comes when he is called? Ours is still too young.

sense_98cea4408ed74f2c2f63ac0ffdd8cdce.text: Recuerden escribir sobre las dos caras del papel.
sense_98cea4408ed74f2c2f63ac0ffdd8cdce.translation: Remember to write on both sides of the piece of paper.

sense_98cea4408ed74f2c2f63ac0ffdd8cdce.text: Son dos caras de la misma moneda.
sense_98cea4408ed74f2c2f63ac0ffdd8cdce.translation: They are two sides of the same coin.

sense_d6439b4448453fd94e56805d8181d180.text: No pongas esa cara después de toda la suerte que has tenido.
sense_d6439b4448453fd94e56805d8181d180.translation: Don't give me that look after all the luck you've had.

sense_574d54f63654bc3ba46ad9cb04e1e8d1.text: Mi hermano habla francés e inglés.
sense_574d54f63654bc3ba46ad9cb04e1e8d1.translation: My brother speaks French and English.

sense_574d54f63654bc3ba46ad9cb04e1e8d1.text: Caballeros e hidalgos pertenecían a la clase alta de la sociedad antigua.
sense_574d54f63654bc3ba46ad9cb04e1e8d1.translation: Knights and noblemen belonged to old society upper class.

sense_48719365df524c86b745c09beff20d8e.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_48719365df524c86b745c09beff20d8e.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_48719365df524c86b745c09beff20d8e.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_48719365df524c86b745c09beff20d8e.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_f647d65685dcf49323bab7cf259f302a.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_f647d65685dcf49323bab7cf259f302a.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_f647d65685dcf49323bab7cf259f302a.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_f647d65685dcf49323bab7cf259f302a.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_1ee8d945851610ac484d4740985366a6.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_1ee8d945851610ac484d4740985366a6.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_05144ab833d2e30762deb9611c7d08cf.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_05144ab833d2e30762deb9611c7d08cf.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_9532cae05810cef12b84ff44f2765a4d.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_9532cae05810cef12b84ff44f2765a4d.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_9532cae05810cef12b84ff44f2765a4d.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_9532cae05810cef12b84ff44f2765a4d.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_a049a325fad9e581eae8908137c44044.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_a049a325fad9e581eae8908137c44044.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_a049a325fad9e581eae8908137c44044.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_a049a325fad9e581eae8908137c44044.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_45fec6c909c926588fc3d04f665dc79c.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_45fec6c909c926588fc3d04f665dc79c.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_d104f9407821876f41bf6ffcfc066425.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_d104f9407821876f41bf6ffcfc066425.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_d104f9407821876f41bf6ffcfc066425.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_d104f9407821876f41bf6ffcfc066425.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_63a19511c7b6b183dce9697a9b69df92.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_63a19511c7b6b183dce9697a9b69df92.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_63a19511c7b6b183dce9697a9b69df92.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_63a19511c7b6b183dce9697a9b69df92.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_c56b9c958a97d3cfa4ff301361052e3b.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_c56b9c958a97d3cfa4ff301361052e3b.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_c56b9c958a97d3cfa4ff301361052e3b.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_c56b9c958a97d3cfa4ff301361052e3b.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_f80af33365596f35104a8bfb04880954.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_f80af33365596f35104a8bfb04880954.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_f80af33365596f35104a8bfb04880954.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_f80af33365596f35104a8bfb04880954.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_2a345354275fe0d732e9392601918c18.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_2a345354275fe0d732e9392601918c18.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_2a345354275fe0d732e9392601918c18.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_2a345354275fe0d732e9392601918c18.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_13c0d23478fd08b5e6c4826041da36f2.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_13c0d23478fd08b5e6c4826041da36f2.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_e94898c531a82015377fdc7c25b45504.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_e94898c531a82015377fdc7c25b45504.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_e94898c531a82015377fdc7c25b45504.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_e94898c531a82015377fdc7c25b45504.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_c87092fb669b40caf54afa7fcac798ab.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_c87092fb669b40caf54afa7fcac798ab.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_c87092fb669b40caf54afa7fcac798ab.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_c87092fb669b40caf54afa7fcac798ab.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_7680288a6cf7902c14ba0bd72794ddb9.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_7680288a6cf7902c14ba0bd72794ddb9.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_7680288a6cf7902c14ba0bd72794ddb9.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_7680288a6cf7902c14ba0bd72794ddb9.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_da56204c741e0f4930e1436e628dbf62.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_da56204c741e0f4930e1436e628dbf62.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_d75da7f94f4013239f66a0391ed5e34c.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_d75da7f94f4013239f66a0391ed5e34c.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_d00932ff5ebe6c6ae1579f5113fe6ad9.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_d00932ff5ebe6c6ae1579f5113fe6ad9.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_d00932ff5ebe6c6ae1579f5113fe6ad9.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_d00932ff5ebe6c6ae1579f5113fe6ad9.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_237bb57eca40ac78c5216a9e747f6924.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_237bb57eca40ac78c5216a9e747f6924.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_237bb57eca40ac78c5216a9e747f6924.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_237bb57eca40ac78c5216a9e747f6924.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_1e417ff866f9a4d139e05bcec6ce2f37.text: Te veo después de las clases.
Yo regreso a mi pueblo cuando acaban las clases y empiezan las vacaciones de verano.
sense_1e417ff866f9a4d139e05bcec6ce2f37.translation: I return to my hometown when school is over and the summer break starts.

sense_8c3ed5451f74fe5b476da1da10b8fecd.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_8c3ed5451f74fe5b476da1da10b8fecd.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_51b71d06d73e3f1f786ff8d782479f50.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_51b71d06d73e3f1f786ff8d782479f50.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_f27dc66ed5674c9cbaf19ab5058a3c99.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_f27dc66ed5674c9cbaf19ab5058a3c99.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_f27dc66ed5674c9cbaf19ab5058a3c99.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_f27dc66ed5674c9cbaf19ab5058a3c99.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_6371fb3bd9244b941b3a1d8c92c6bdd4.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_6371fb3bd9244b941b3a1d8c92c6bdd4.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_6371fb3bd9244b941b3a1d8c92c6bdd4.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_6371fb3bd9244b941b3a1d8c92c6bdd4.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_54b0ffea15ce37eeb8a036a61d9187ad.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_54b0ffea15ce37eeb8a036a61d9187ad.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_54b0ffea15ce37eeb8a036a61d9187ad.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_54b0ffea15ce37eeb8a036a61d9187ad.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_556fb69300e79f7ae7caa5c6db376900.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_f628207e190ba2c8efdf27457562aaa6.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_f628207e190ba2c8efdf27457562aaa6.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_f628207e190ba2c8efdf27457562aaa6.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_f628207e190ba2c8efdf27457562aaa6.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_18dca638f31c817a9d98ec1811a16bb5.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_18dca638f31c817a9d98ec1811a16bb5.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_d4ab1b2423da550b69b5cf81b7a0b70c.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_8aaf6b5fa7750669a60a816b9ae65a52.text: ¡Mujer, no te enfades! Lo hice sin mala intención.
sense_8aaf6b5fa7750669a60a816b9ae65a52.translation: Come on, don't be angry! I meant no harm.

sense_8aaf6b5fa7750669a60a816b9ae65a52.text: ¡Mujer, pero si era broma! ¿Creíste que lo decía en serio? - Pues sí.
sense_8aaf6b5fa7750669a60a816b9ae65a52.translation: But it was a joke! Did you think I was being serious? - Well, yes, I did.

sense_587b66541e85d3c9a17235526d05afb9.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_587b66541e85d3c9a17235526d05afb9.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_587b66541e85d3c9a17235526d05afb9.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_587b66541e85d3c9a17235526d05afb9.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_337a515b6f1b6edeff1817e4d4d922a2.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_337a515b6f1b6edeff1817e4d4d922a2.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_337a515b6f1b6edeff1817e4d4d922a2.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_337a515b6f1b6edeff1817e4d4d922a2.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_53384e83720ca8c27e49660af031492e.text: Ella misma diseñó su propio vestido de novias.
sense_53384e83720ca8c27e49660af031492e.translation: She designed her own wedding dress herself.

sense_53384e83720ca8c27e49660af031492e.text: En este mismo sitio, en esta misma fecha, tu madre y yo decidimos casarnos.
sense_53384e83720ca8c27e49660af031492e.translation: In this very place, on this same day, your mother and I decided to get married.

sense_e3a878737f286a3ec6ca7852e49eae86.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_e3a878737f286a3ec6ca7852e49eae86.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_e3a878737f286a3ec6ca7852e49eae86.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_e3a878737f286a3ec6ca7852e49eae86.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_d3a7db8f0bc856d79565acb637f08741.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_d3a7db8f0bc856d79565acb637f08741.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_d3a7db8f0bc856d79565acb637f08741.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_d3a7db8f0bc856d79565acb637f08741.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_395d823e2ec60a42e35971deccc1fd66.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_395d823e2ec60a42e35971deccc1fd66.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_395d823e2ec60a42e35971deccc1fd66.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_395d823e2ec60a42e35971deccc1fd66.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_91300fafedc0330fee5402029b457b9b.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_91300fafedc0330fee5402029b457b9b.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_91300fafedc0330fee5402029b457b9b.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_91300fafedc0330fee5402029b457b9b.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_67daf8fbbd9c54f05a9613096ec5197d.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_67daf8fbbd9c54f05a9613096ec5197d.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_67daf8fbbd9c54f05a9613096ec5197d.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_67daf8fbbd9c54f05a9613096ec5197d.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_e90ba6e59c35d8b01b29a933e9f5b0db.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_e90ba6e59c35d8b01b29a933e9f5b0db.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_e90ba6e59c35d8b01b29a933e9f5b0db.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_e90ba6e59c35d8b01b29a933e9f5b0db.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_aef132cc420d19cb4bfe6362f0da8edd.text: Haz un boceto del edificio visto desde abajo.
sense_aef132cc420d19cb4bfe6362f0da8edd.translation: Draw a sketch of the building seen from below.

sense_aef132cc420d19cb4bfe6362f0da8edd.text: Íbamos para abajo en el elevador cuando se descompuso.
sense_aef132cc420d19cb4bfe6362f0da8edd.translation: We were going down in the elevator when it broke down.

sense_48e87e8bcefca500e4fbd52dfa7f602c.text: La riada arrastró los carros calle abajo.
sense_48e87e8bcefca500e4fbd52dfa7f602c.translation: The flood swept the cars down the road.

sense_1a255a536afbf369464d5811f9fe855f.text: Aceptamos a niños de 12 años para abajo.
sense_1a255a536afbf369464d5811f9fe855f.translation: We admit children aged 12 or under.

sense_1a255a536afbf369464d5811f9fe855f.text: Todo el equipo fue despedido, de la coordinadora para abajo.
sense_1a255a536afbf369464d5811f9fe855f.translation: The entire team was fired, from the coordinator down.

sense_802897595546222c50cd30b80a28c8a4.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_802897595546222c50cd30b80a28c8a4.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_2af879d2cef081594bbde5e4dfdb65eb.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_2af879d2cef081594bbde5e4dfdb65eb.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_e377079c0377ccb77732aa6e9ccf47fc.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_e377079c0377ccb77732aa6e9ccf47fc.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_e377079c0377ccb77732aa6e9ccf47fc.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_e377079c0377ccb77732aa6e9ccf47fc.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_b907e1142b7b6166a78485ae9af05fde.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_b907e1142b7b6166a78485ae9af05fde.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_1f8b662037954927d2c0ae8abb1c95ab.text: Nos casamos y a la vuelta de tres años tuvimos nuestro primer bebé.
sense_1f8b662037954927d2c0ae8abb1c95ab.translation: We got married and three years later we had our first baby.

sense_1f8b662037954927d2c0ae8abb1c95ab.text: A la vuelta de siete meses de vivir en la calle, por fin encontró trabajo.
sense_1f8b662037954927d2c0ae8abb1c95ab.translation: After seven months of living on the streets, he finally found a job.

sense_5fcc7d07256d6bcee8b1e7331fba120f.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_5fcc7d07256d6bcee8b1e7331fba120f.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_5fcc7d07256d6bcee8b1e7331fba120f.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_5fcc7d07256d6bcee8b1e7331fba120f.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_a072a95eec21d291542fa49b13510c71.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_a072a95eec21d291542fa49b13510c71.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_a072a95eec21d291542fa49b13510c71.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_a072a95eec21d291542fa49b13510c71.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_1b6a5aaa3f1cef84123917bd955cc9e4.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_1b6a5aaa3f1cef84123917bd955cc9e4.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_1b6a5aaa3f1cef84123917bd955cc9e4.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_1b6a5aaa3f1cef84123917bd955cc9e4.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_a1a33ebffefe1e3647e739f5f7c87477.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_a1a33ebffefe1e3647e739f5f7c87477.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_a1a33ebffefe1e3647e739f5f7c87477.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_a1a33ebffefe1e3647e739f5f7c87477.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_99f4a4cfbc84bae656f957f2f72a3bf8.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_99f4a4cfbc84bae656f957f2f72a3bf8.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_99f4a4cfbc84bae656f957f2f72a3bf8.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_99f4a4cfbc84bae656f957f2f72a3bf8.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_579058b08e6abd2c5f906385df586c2b.text: Me gusta jugar al bingo por el dinero.
sense_579058b08e6abd2c5f906385df586c2b.translation: I love playing Bingo for money.
Does anybody want to play tennis with me?

sense_7fca37f0ef11cab14f0e4e1466616dfb.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_7fca37f0ef11cab14f0e4e1466616dfb.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_7fca37f0ef11cab14f0e4e1466616dfb.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_7fca37f0ef11cab14f0e4e1466616dfb.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_2b42abadac2abe53106a55da28f795ab.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_2b42abadac2abe53106a55da28f795ab.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_2b42abadac2abe53106a55da28f795ab.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_2b42abadac2abe53106a55da28f795ab.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_8657ef5e4724e0060e83ef5cef2f867e.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_9d894c1ce62d87de6df678153bc95022.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_c027e7b1bd4518625a23f54084c92972.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_c027e7b1bd4518625a23f54084c92972.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_53313bb6068ce7d32edc2d22a0eaec64.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_53313bb6068ce7d32edc2d22a0eaec64.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_53313bb6068ce7d32edc2d22a0eaec64.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_53313bb6068ce7d32edc2d22a0eaec64.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_2e18b54a568065031f06fe730350964b.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_2e18b54a568065031f06fe730350964b.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_a1f037987c97d05600e2edd30c257652.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_a1f037987c97d05600e2edd30c257652.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_390e155d08d1507989a264afc826b27d.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_b20c9276cb07a5a27d04502824d085df.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_b20c9276cb07a5a27d04502824d085df.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_b20c9276cb07a5a27d04502824d085df.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_b20c9276cb07a5a27d04502824d085df.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_e8ad00fe1148f5d52b575c373dc8eed2.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_e8ad00fe1148f5d52b575c373dc8eed2.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_e8ad00fe1148f5d52b575c373dc8eed2.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_e8ad00fe1148f5d52b575c373dc8eed2.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_8f6c0ed148a326ecc564a76b378005e9.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_8f6c0ed148a326ecc564a76b378005e9.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_bceab1d3937aa9fc4706321bd05d33b2.text: Pablo ama a su esposa con todo su ser.
sense_bceab1d3937aa9fc4706321bd05d33b2.translation: Pablo loves his wife with all his heart.

sense_bceab1d3937aa9fc4706321bd05d33b2.text: Yo te amo, Ana, y quiero pasar el resto de mi vida contigo.
sense_bceab1d3937aa9fc4706321bd05d33b2.translation: I love you, Ana, and I want to spend the rest of my life with you.

sense_46186905c891c7d42338adaafa9fd06d.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_46186905c891c7d42338adaafa9fd06d.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_46186905c891c7d42338adaafa9fd06d.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_46186905c891c7d42338adaafa9fd06d.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_a704c2cf2ff41028088e6aac839db14e.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_af5b096bc9541d5c5589ed6366f8ca38.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_af5b096bc9541d5c5589ed6366f8ca38.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_af5b096bc9541d5c5589ed6366f8ca38.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_af5b096bc9541d5c5589ed6366f8ca38.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_4c6afce9836769a3ff6167bd1b93dfce.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_4c6afce9836769a3ff6167bd1b93dfce.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_4c6afce9836769a3ff6167bd1b93dfce.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_4c6afce9836769a3ff6167bd1b93dfce.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_df3c778c9a2d9fb4dc6744c8fb5fe732.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_df3c778c9a2d9fb4dc6744c8fb5fe732.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_2f247b2b0052f0de34791d9e0ad1dfb4.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_2f247b2b0052f0de34791d9e0ad1dfb4.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_6128aed19465f4b54e991fe4f5108b28.text: Eramos el huerto para sembrar nuestras primeras semillas.
sense_6128aed19465f4b54e991fe4f5108b28.translation: We've laid out the beds in our vegetable garden to plant our first seeds.

sense_6128aed19465f4b54e991fe4f5108b28.text: Don Pedro ya eró el jardín para que pongamos las semillas de tomate.
sense_6128aed19465f4b54e991fe4f5108b28.translation: Don Pedro has already prepared the ground for us to sow the tomato seeds.

sense_7898ce008fca0681cb2f338c6e5c408e.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_7898ce008fca0681cb2f338c6e5c408e.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_7898ce008fca0681cb2f338c6e5c408e.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_7898ce008fca0681cb2f338c6e5c408e.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_eb6c1a91d0b843f804853c80d103b318.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_eb6c1a91d0b843f804853c80d103b318.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_80d7daa47f9f21e20eb472cd9370bc82.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_80d7daa47f9f21e20eb472cd9370bc82.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_ec627d4f2aaacdea9907e22bb55c4738.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_ec627d4f2aaacdea9907e22bb55c4738.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_ec627d4f2aaacdea9907e22bb55c4738.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_ec627d4f2aaacdea9907e22bb55c4738.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_428333671538626684a1b926f0fda2d7.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_428333671538626684a1b926f0fda2d7.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_428333671538626684a1b926f0fda2d7.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_428333671538626684a1b926f0fda2d7.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_63db4de997782ed6dd37a525274eb9b6.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_63db4de997782ed6dd37a525274eb9b6.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_40a1ba03455eaf91e2597ad594f74e5c.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_40a1ba03455eaf91e2597ad594f74e5c.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_40a1ba03455eaf91e2597ad594f74e5c.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_40a1ba03455eaf91e2597ad594f74e5c.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_477a6d6a6f7e722cd2034798df869a1e.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_477a6d6a6f7e722cd2034798df869a1e.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_477a6d6a6f7e722cd2034798df869a1e.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_477a6d6a6f7e722cd2034798df869a1e.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_75c429a3f00c198623a40d94ce1ae0eb.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_75c429a3f00c198623a40d94ce1ae0eb.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_75c429a3f00c198623a40d94ce1ae0eb.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_75c429a3f00c198623a40d94ce1ae0eb.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_d049189ed01e930672d0df8374160890.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_cdedddd253ce0a7ead92e7cd7dea7710.text: No te preocupes, los niños vendrán ya comidos.
sense_cdedddd253ce0a7ead92e7cd7dea7710.translation: Don't worry. The children will have eaten before they come.

sense_cdedddd253ce0a7ead92e7cd7dea7710.text: Será un partido difícil, así que vengan bien comidos y dormidos.
sense_cdedddd253ce0a7ead92e7cd7dea7710.translation: It will be a tough game, so make sure you eat well and have a good night's sleep.

sense_2b6409206dcdd964f6faf09fa444748b.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_2b6409206dcdd964f6faf09fa444748b.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_2b6409206dcdd964f6faf09fa444748b.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_2b6409206dcdd964f6faf09fa444748b.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_432e3eb54521afe51446e5dbd71266c6.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_432e3eb54521afe51446e5dbd71266c6.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_432e3eb54521afe51446e5dbd71266c6.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_432e3eb54521afe51446e5dbd71266c6.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_5e53d9bbba7aa5fccd4cf58a23bf7389.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_5d58404a340bfe83f1e10998bf546417.text: Así que no comes carne. ¿Y pescado? - Tampoco.
sense_5d58404a340bfe83f1e10998bf546417.translation: So, you don't eat meat. What about fish? - No, no fish either.

sense_5d58404a340bfe83f1e10998bf546417.text: Pues si no te gusta el nombre Lucía, ¿qué si le ponemos Maribel? - ¡Tampoco!
sense_5d58404a340bfe83f1e10998bf546417.translation: Well, if you don't like the name Lucía, what if we call her Maribel? - No! Not that either.

sense_d5e2c5cdfdd35b219acac8c902058564.text: Armó un follón cuando compré una marca diferente de cereal.
sense_d5e2c5cdfdd35b219acac8c902058564.translation: She kicked up a real fuss when I bought a different brand of cereal.

sense_d5e2c5cdfdd35b219acac8c902058564.text: El comportamiento del cantante en el restaurante ha armado un gran escándalo.
sense_d5e2c5cdfdd35b219acac8c902058564.translation: The behavior of the singer in the restaurant has caused a big scandal.

sense_0505c18c0863bed26ba3b02957d0a747.text: Se armó una discusión sobre quién iba a tomar la última galleta.
sense_0505c18c0863bed26ba3b02957d0a747.translation: An argument broke out over who was going to get the last cookie.

sense_0505c18c0863bed26ba3b02957d0a747.text: Ni te imaginas el lío que se armó cuando despidieron a nuestro jefe.
sense_0505c18c0863bed26ba3b02957d0a747.translation: You can't even imagine the chaos that went down when our boss was fired.

sense_2860716f8214b87a7e8048134be9f505.text: ¿Por qué no quieres decirme lo que te pasa?
sense_2860716f8214b87a7e8048134be9f505.translation: Why won't you tell me what's the matter with you?

sense_2860716f8214b87a7e8048134be9f505.text: Ya acabé de pelar las patatas. Dime qué tengo que hacer ahora.
sense_2860716f8214b87a7e8048134be9f505.translation: I finished peeling the potatoes. Tell me what I have to do now.

sense_2658d14745779f6dc996aac0b8e56601.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_2658d14745779f6dc996aac0b8e56601.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_2658d14745779f6dc996aac0b8e56601.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_2658d14745779f6dc996aac0b8e56601.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_60c0a2d28b81f55e23cd8524e2a725ce.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_60c0a2d28b81f55e23cd8524e2a725ce.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_18852fc9860c9dfb9fc4b10bd0bd3b67.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_18852fc9860c9dfb9fc4b10bd0bd3b67.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_18852fc9860c9dfb9fc4b10bd0bd3b67.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_18852fc9860c9dfb9fc4b10bd0bd3b67.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_c9a020c19b5c671edcb202ff1569a59e.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_c9a020c19b5c671edcb202ff1569a59e.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_801d932dd6337d2569e994a0903f9de4.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_801d932dd6337d2569e994a0903f9de4.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_e02479505b9e752c1da25ec388077415.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_e02479505b9e752c1da25ec388077415.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_5de5bd6488dcb8de90c6cc11e3a0fe83.text: Mediaron tres meses entre los dos ataques.
sense_5de5bd6488dcb8de90c6cc11e3a0fe83.translation: The two attacks were separated by three months.

sense_5de5bd6488dcb8de90c6cc11e3a0fe83.text: ¿Cuánto tiempo medió entre esta conversación y la muerte de su suegra?
sense_5de5bd6488dcb8de90c6cc11e3a0fe83.translation: How long was there between this conversation and the death of your mother-in-law?

sense_72ae7798fd37206d57a183c3ece3162b.text: Grandes diferencias median entre las dos religiones.
sense_72ae7798fd37206d57a183c3ece3162b.translation: There are significant differences between the two religions.

sense_72ae7798fd37206d57a183c3ece3162b.text: Entre nosotros mediaba una gruesa pared.
sense_72ae7798fd37206d57a183c3ece3162b.translation: There was a thick wall between us.

sense_08e13a55efe4de7caccdd82533a9f823.text: Factores personales mediaron en su desempeño durante aquel mes.
sense_08e13a55efe4de7caccdd82533a9f823.translation: Personal factors affected her performance that month.

sense_08e13a55efe4de7caccdd82533a9f823.text: La policía investiga las circunstancias que mediaron en el homicidio de una mujer en Tarragona.
sense_08e13a55efe4de7caccdd82533a9f823.translation: The police are investigating the circumstances involved in the homicide of a woman in Tarragona.

sense_4658375f56316b7d414d7c061d1b8936.text: ¿Qué falda te gusta más? - Esta es muy bonita.
sense_4658375f56316b7d414d7c061d1b8936.translation: Which skirt do you like better? - This one is really pretty.

sense_4658375f56316b7d414d7c061d1b8936.text: Me voy a llevar este; el gorro chico no me queda.
sense_4658375f56316b7d414d7c061d1b8936.translation: I'm going to take this one; the small hat doesn't fit me.

sense_960ce0f3a7cad076c050a7b1efebee50.text: Esta no es la camisa que quería.
sense_960ce0f3a7cad076c050a7b1efebee50.translation: This is not the shirt I wanted.

sense_960ce0f3a7cad076c050a7b1efebee50.text: Este no es el plato que pedí.
sense_960ce0f3a7cad076c050a7b1efebee50.translation: This is not the meal I ordered.

sense_389e96acb3d2d0a6a04ce1f257a68674.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_389e96acb3d2d0a6a04ce1f257a68674.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_b6fedad9f16f9352dd6f5a5c4b2a5c50.text: ¿Con quién diablo te crees que hablas?
sense_b6fedad9f16f9352dd6f5a5c4b2a5c50.translation: Who on earth do you think you're talking to?
How the hell do you know that?

sense_3f6f59a9240cb83a7f736d505b5366e6.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_3f6f59a9240cb83a7f736d505b5366e6.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_3f6f59a9240cb83a7f736d505b5366e6.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_3f6f59a9240cb83a7f736d505b5366e6.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_ecda446d3237328d3d54026047ee6e7e.text: Pues, chica, no sé cómo voy a resolver el problema.
sense_ecda446d3237328d3d54026047ee6e7e.translation: Well, I don't know how I'm going to solve the problem.

sense_9dd23a90510a3c6b1c10910d71519111.text: Cuanto más trabaja, más rico se hace.
sense_9dd23a90510a3c6b1c10910d71519111.translation: The more he works, the richer he gets.
The more he gets, the more he wants.

sense_e73e48628aa77f641c93e8a235c2b547.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_e73e48628aa77f641c93e8a235c2b547.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_e73e48628aa77f641c93e8a235c2b547.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_e73e48628aa77f641c93e8a235c2b547.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_2bf339015ac14804cafd74c61a37e664.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_2bf339015ac14804cafd74c61a37e664.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_3f0a417613feafb06f74237a44e5d181.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_3f0a417613feafb06f74237a44e5d181.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_3f0a417613feafb06f74237a44e5d181.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_3f0a417613feafb06f74237a44e5d181.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_53c446dc6456c9b6c2822f8211938664.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_53c446dc6456c9b6c2822f8211938664.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_53c446dc6456c9b6c2822f8211938664.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_53c446dc6456c9b6c2822f8211938664.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_c28e33ccaccffb4502807b39de7cce8b.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_c28e33ccaccffb4502807b39de7cce8b.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_c2ede5edb41b8c29e90ccfc5f9c5060c.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_c2ede5edb41b8c29e90ccfc5f9c5060c.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_c2ede5edb41b8c29e90ccfc5f9c5060c.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_c2ede5edb41b8c29e90ccfc5f9c5060c.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_afd678a6a0f2b55d4aee4580800e2807.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_afd678a6a0f2b55d4aee4580800e2807.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_afd678a6a0f2b55d4aee4580800e2807.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_afd678a6a0f2b55d4aee4580800e2807.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_8bbf057c982c35f25041efa45a109b3d.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_8bbf057c982c35f25041efa45a109b3d.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_055e1f56acbb2baedee0f3cff8241a55.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_7283e824293abe1fc948a9975f5e7d18.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_7283e824293abe1fc948a9975f5e7d18.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_7283e824293abe1fc948a9975f5e7d18.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_7283e824293abe1fc948a9975f5e7d18.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_4f9f87c23b181af67083a5ec3f9798ce.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_4f9f87c23b181af67083a5ec3f9798ce.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_4f9f87c23b181af67083a5ec3f9798ce.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_4f9f87c23b181af67083a5ec3f9798ce.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_199ad5ec41911633d4c510f5b39ee885.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_199ad5ec41911633d4c510f5b39ee885.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_310597aef101965504374ed95884372b.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_310597aef101965504374ed95884372b.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_310597aef101965504374ed95884372b.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_310597aef101965504374ed95884372b.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_f73fde9e0d4c6a0006e65500f3e60eac.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_f73fde9e0d4c6a0006e65500f3e60eac.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_f73fde9e0d4c6a0006e65500f3e60eac.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_f73fde9e0d4c6a0006e65500f3e60eac.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_6c1b46e389afa538bcfa3cca7e0a61f2.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_6c1b46e389afa538bcfa3cca7e0a61f2.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_6c1b46e389afa538bcfa3cca7e0a61f2.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_6c1b46e389afa538bcfa3cca7e0a61f2.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_105d65c2e627e845d4e5ac2f608256d2.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_384f784fc52a938312943ccca6e68ba2.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_384f784fc52a938312943ccca6e68ba2.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_384f784fc52a938312943ccca6e68ba2.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_384f784fc52a938312943ccca6e68ba2.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_db9eb24968606d81fac8ef08f23eb8e0.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_db9eb24968606d81fac8ef08f23eb8e0.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_db9eb24968606d81fac8ef08f23eb8e0.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_db9eb24968606d81fac8ef08f23eb8e0.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_7aee0b988b1a829b2768b6c0f7eab27e.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_7aee0b988b1a829b2768b6c0f7eab27e.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_e7cbde46448c2047275e0b000c4749c8.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_e7cbde46448c2047275e0b000c4749c8.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_e7cbde46448c2047275e0b000c4749c8.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_e7cbde46448c2047275e0b000c4749c8.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_d7b6363f042d9b6c3da32b7965bbc8ec.text: ¿Crees que en el futuro los humanos poblarán otros planetas?
sense_d7b6363f042d9b6c3da32b7965bbc8ec.translation: Do you think humans will populate other planets in the future?

sense_d7b6363f042d9b6c3da32b7965bbc8ec.text: Los colonos tenían órdenes de poblar y desarrollar la isla desierta.
sense_d7b6363f042d9b6c3da32b7965bbc8ec.translation: The settlers had orders to populate and develop the desert island.

sense_c8783afd434cf7ae03f3e8ae33dcac32.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_c8783afd434cf7ae03f3e8ae33dcac32.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_c8783afd434cf7ae03f3e8ae33dcac32.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_c8783afd434cf7ae03f3e8ae33dcac32.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_5675b3261cc08b760e8b0a006c0bcb3a.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_5675b3261cc08b760e8b0a006c0bcb3a.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_7c08bc86ef44024d16a097b664767eac.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_7c08bc86ef44024d16a097b664767eac.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_64015735b0b615902ac7a37db7694156.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_64015735b0b615902ac7a37db7694156.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_64015735b0b615902ac7a37db7694156.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_64015735b0b615902ac7a37db7694156.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_20c760a19a5b0be5365e7bc6d689aa6b.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_20c760a19a5b0be5365e7bc6d689aa6b.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_a3ff28c5895411a45447e88fdce50645.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_a3ff28c5895411a45447e88fdce50645.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_40dd482c618bd398ae1104a34cf89e86.text: Tengo los mejores recuerdos de la casa de lago de mis abuelos.
sense_40dd482c618bd398ae1104a34cf89e86.translation: I have the best memories from my grandparents' lake house.

sense_40dd482c618bd398ae1104a34cf89e86.text: Tengo un recuerdo vívido de la vez que visité el Panteón de Dolores en el DF.
sense_40dd482c618bd398ae1104a34cf89e86.translation: I have a vivid memory of the time I visited Dolores Cemetery in Mexico City.

sense_ff0f06220347ca24587f82ff1c5ee5c7.text: El programa era tan aburrido que me dormí.
sense_ff0f06220347ca24587f82ff1c5ee5c7.translation: The program was so boring that I fell asleep.

sense_ff0f06220347ca24587f82ff1c5ee5c7.text: Me dormí a las 6 de la mañana.
sense_ff0f06220347ca24587f82ff1c5ee5c7.translation: I fell asleep at 6 in the morning.

sense_263bf5150a0b4e3d50afe06b4ba0a802.text: No te duermas o no acabarás a tiempo.
sense_263bf5150a0b4e3d50afe06b4ba0a802.translation: Don't slack off or you won't finish in time.

sense_263bf5150a0b4e3d50afe06b4ba0a802.text: Por dormirse se perdió la clave para ganar el premio.
sense_263bf5150a0b4e3d50afe06b4ba0a802.translation: He missed the clue to win the prize because he didn't stay on his toes.

sense_789f5a435c3499042e46b0769f5a5d6a.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_789f5a435c3499042e46b0769f5a5d6a.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_789f5a435c3499042e46b0769f5a5d6a.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_789f5a435c3499042e46b0769f5a5d6a.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_53696adc40d9703d5740faf140356c07.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_d543baa80b7d67c7dcfb74dac21ad600.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_d543baa80b7d67c7dcfb74dac21ad600.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_d543baa80b7d67c7dcfb74dac21ad600.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_d543baa80b7d67c7dcfb74dac21ad600.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_5edb2b810db782eb31b1bdd4b7624679.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_5edb2b810db782eb31b1bdd4b7624679.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_5edb2b810db782eb31b1bdd4b7624679.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_5edb2b810db782eb31b1bdd4b7624679.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_243c5c09e0b1d53f0376fd743b948186.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_243c5c09e0b1d53f0376fd743b948186.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_44432ed1795159e6c864244132ecf001.text: Ella hace la cama todas las mañanas.
sense_44432ed1795159e6c864244132ecf001.translation: She makes the bed every morning.

sense_44432ed1795159e6c864244132ecf001.text: El espacio que tengo en mi cama doble es tan lujoso.
sense_44432ed1795159e6c864244132ecf001.translation: The space I have in my double bed is so luxurious.

sense_cc0218618f055b0c791ac49ee270b3ee.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_cc0218618f055b0c791ac49ee270b3ee.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_cc0218618f055b0c791ac49ee270b3ee.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_cc0218618f055b0c791ac49ee270b3ee.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_63fd1fc0f0367655e6dae80108b48ca3.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_63fd1fc0f0367655e6dae80108b48ca3.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_63fd1fc0f0367655e6dae80108b48ca3.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_63fd1fc0f0367655e6dae80108b48ca3.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_490811eb2e3c6efcbfe8af015d038336.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_490811eb2e3c6efcbfe8af015d038336.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_490811eb2e3c6efcbfe8af015d038336.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_490811eb2e3c6efcbfe8af015d038336.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_db1846541732a52ec8b33a8dc6317e80.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_db1846541732a52ec8b33a8dc6317e80.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_db1846541732a52ec8b33a8dc6317e80.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_db1846541732a52ec8b33a8dc6317e80.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_c7d7ad3a2e90e06e297bc334105d10b8.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_c7d7ad3a2e90e06e297bc334105d10b8.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_c7d7ad3a2e90e06e297bc334105d10b8.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_c7d7ad3a2e90e06e297bc334105d10b8.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_7ef59044625e6dda90b3e89433a1b118.text: Hoy es el cumpleaños de nuestra hermana.

sense_e68db6b9878280ef76b392c3836e5638.text: ¿Sus fotos del viaje salieron bien? Las nuestras están oscuras.
sense_e68db6b9878280ef76b392c3836e5638.translation: Did your pictures from the trip turn out okay? Ours came out dark.

sense_e68db6b9878280ef76b392c3836e5638.text: ¿Tu perro ya viene cuando lo llamas? El nuestro todavía es muy cachorro.
sense_e68db6b9878280ef76b392c3836e5638.translation: Your dog already comes when he is called? Ours is still too young.

sense_8a8f046f47ebff2b74ecff4d15dc052a.text: Estoy cansada, pero no por ello voy a rendirme.
sense_8a8f046f47ebff2b74ecff4d15dc052a.translation: I'm tired, but I'm not going to give up because of it.

sense_8a8f046f47ebff2b74ecff4d15dc052a.text: Si quieres algo, lucha por ello.
sense_8a8f046f47ebff2b74ecff4d15dc052a.translation: If you want something, fight for it.

sense_e8863f86377c378ecd9851f3286833d8.text: China es el país más poblado del mundo.
sense_e8863f86377c378ecd9851f3286833d8.translation: China is the world's most populous country.

sense_e8863f86377c378ecd9851f3286833d8.text: Se está invirtiendo mucho dinero en países en vías de desarrollo.
sense_e8863f86377c378ecd9851f3286833d8.translation: A lot of money is being invested in developing countries.

sense_aa22c2ab7488a0e36858fc837dca44f8.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_aa22c2ab7488a0e36858fc837dca44f8.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_aa22c2ab7488a0e36858fc837dca44f8.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_aa22c2ab7488a0e36858fc837dca44f8.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_1fc029a42f1d8f4043e1082beeaac996.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_1fc029a42f1d8f4043e1082beeaac996.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_1fc029a42f1d8f4043e1082beeaac996.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_1fc029a42f1d8f4043e1082beeaac996.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_8ae7599f627cde5b43f941d345c1e6d0.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_8ae7599f627cde5b43f941d345c1e6d0.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_8ae7599f627cde5b43f941d345c1e6d0.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_8ae7599f627cde5b43f941d345c1e6d0.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_115cd3e645b5cf41b922b24a116e814c.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_115cd3e645b5cf41b922b24a116e814c.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_115cd3e645b5cf41b922b24a116e814c.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_115cd3e645b5cf41b922b24a116e814c.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_166e664fa4a97db083531c7ea2cb5ad3.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_166e664fa4a97db083531c7ea2cb5ad3.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_166e664fa4a97db083531c7ea2cb5ad3.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_166e664fa4a97db083531c7ea2cb5ad3.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_61a27bda5169792f0869eb60143d94b2.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_61a27bda5169792f0869eb60143d94b2.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_61a27bda5169792f0869eb60143d94b2.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_61a27bda5169792f0869eb60143d94b2.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_2d59dbd30c3754015099422edc4e24f0.text: Armó un follón cuando compré una marca diferente de cereal.
sense_2d59dbd30c3754015099422edc4e24f0.translation: She kicked up a real fuss when I bought a different brand of cereal.

sense_2d59dbd30c3754015099422edc4e24f0.text: El comportamiento del cantante en el restaurante ha armado un gran escándalo.
sense_2d59dbd30c3754015099422edc4e24f0.translation: The behavior of the singer in the restaurant has caused a big scandal.

sense_241345cd6fd82c6d48d0f422f469ef41.text: Se armó una discusión sobre quién iba a tomar la última galleta.
sense_241345cd6fd82c6d48d0f422f469ef41.translation: An argument broke out over who was going to get the last cookie.

sense_241345cd6fd82c6d48d0f422f469ef41.text: Ni te imaginas el lío que se armó cuando despidieron a nuestro jefe.
sense_241345cd6fd82c6d48d0f422f469ef41.translation: You can't even imagine the chaos that went down when our boss was fired.

sense_6e08578e1addf5761e64d74073e68f94.text: En esta economía, los trabajos seguros no abundan.
sense_6e08578e1addf5761e64d74073e68f94.translation: In this economy, there aren't a lot of secure jobs.

sense_6e08578e1addf5761e64d74073e68f94.text: No te encarames en esa silla, ¡no es segura!
sense_6e08578e1addf5761e64d74073e68f94.translation: Don't climb up on that chair. It isn't secure!

sense_828d597937d1734be34c01e7dd4f2dda.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_828d597937d1734be34c01e7dd4f2dda.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_828d597937d1734be34c01e7dd4f2dda.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_828d597937d1734be34c01e7dd4f2dda.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_49c0b8daae47ad61f10166247b45e21d.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_49c0b8daae47ad61f10166247b45e21d.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_105d09806e2acc0bab3cd4302d48ad43.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_105d09806e2acc0bab3cd4302d48ad43.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_496fe61f96ac58e4875652f140d81a3c.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_496fe61f96ac58e4875652f140d81a3c.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_496fe61f96ac58e4875652f140d81a3c.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_496fe61f96ac58e4875652f140d81a3c.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_179e01e0e4b20fff86c5c033854c0e28.text: Es buena cocinera, pero le falta experiencia.
sense_179e01e0e4b20fff86c5c033854c0e28.translation: She's a good cook, but she lacks experience.

sense_179e01e0e4b20fff86c5c033854c0e28.text: Hubo tantos asistentes que faltaban sillas en la sala.
sense_179e01e0e4b20fff86c5c033854c0e28.translation: There were so many attendants that the room was short of chairs.

sense_da19cdfef5508e7c0c9b8a462e422fba.text: A la sopa le faltan 10 minutos.
Faltan dos meses para que sea Navidad.
sense_da19cdfef5508e7c0c9b8a462e422fba.translation: There are two months to go till Christmas.

sense_482d80bd085432bf3b84536ee7c56714.text: Luke es una persona totalmente falta de empatía.
sense_482d80bd085432bf3b84536ee7c56714.translation: Luke is a person with no empathy whatsoever.

sense_482d80bd085432bf3b84536ee7c56714.text: Sería falto de ética que revelara los detalles del caso.
sense_482d80bd085432bf3b84536ee7c56714.translation: It would be unethical for me to disclose the details of the case.

sense_7d20430f43f30c6daf8f84b8005d7f46.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_7d20430f43f30c6daf8f84b8005d7f46.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_f55cac27b2eb9e5aeb51c6097a2b3ffe.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_f55cac27b2eb9e5aeb51c6097a2b3ffe.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_c6ea24169766720558fdb397cf5e75e3.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_c6ea24169766720558fdb397cf5e75e3.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_865766f71b4b2f80df242f1a8cefbdca.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_865766f71b4b2f80df242f1a8cefbdca.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_865766f71b4b2f80df242f1a8cefbdca.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_865766f71b4b2f80df242f1a8cefbdca.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_3c121ef41a8c2eb7c44fd658a13631e8.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_3c121ef41a8c2eb7c44fd658a13631e8.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_3c121ef41a8c2eb7c44fd658a13631e8.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_3c121ef41a8c2eb7c44fd658a13631e8.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_dfd100e1c89f8a92ed14963f29d5c7c9.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_dfd100e1c89f8a92ed14963f29d5c7c9.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_c610be0ed9c107b746e0d2b9b3891a64.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_c610be0ed9c107b746e0d2b9b3891a64.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_c610be0ed9c107b746e0d2b9b3891a64.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_c610be0ed9c107b746e0d2b9b3891a64.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_150a191841f7dc0d4e114be566982d79.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_a258a01a0d66ebb3aa4c7546243fd5cd.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_a258a01a0d66ebb3aa4c7546243fd5cd.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_a258a01a0d66ebb3aa4c7546243fd5cd.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_a258a01a0d66ebb3aa4c7546243fd5cd.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_2bf488b9cbe0d72d96a6c2ead8b86f98.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_2bf488b9cbe0d72d96a6c2ead8b86f98.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_2bf488b9cbe0d72d96a6c2ead8b86f98.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_2bf488b9cbe0d72d96a6c2ead8b86f98.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_851fe9d89e145d9dfa57806b5c25c12c.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_851fe9d89e145d9dfa57806b5c25c12c.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_1698553f83b3d10acad4950d85ecc2ea.text: ¡Carajo con esta cafetera! Necesitamos comprar otra.
sense_1698553f83b3d10acad4950d85ecc2ea.translation: This damn coffeemaker! We need to buy another one.
Where the hell did I put my wallet?

sense_a89c8ec388be4fe5914ff28e5ee246d2.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_a89c8ec388be4fe5914ff28e5ee246d2.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_9cfecb3cc5253e720ac0ef0036edb108.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_9cfecb3cc5253e720ac0ef0036edb108.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_d767d204104cc3248fdebd7772f1ceef.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_d767d204104cc3248fdebd7772f1ceef.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_d767d204104cc3248fdebd7772f1ceef.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_d767d204104cc3248fdebd7772f1ceef.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_0a4cdc815e142637eb0db3485c980063.text: Leer un libro es perderse en otro mundo.
sense_0a4cdc815e142637eb0db3485c980063.translation: To read a book is to get lost in another world.

sense_0a4cdc815e142637eb0db3485c980063.text: Esperamos una hora para que el autor firmara nuestra copia de su libro.
sense_0a4cdc815e142637eb0db3485c980063.translation: We waited an hour for the author to sign our copy of his book.

sense_583d651c342322cccf913bac8ed11ad5.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_583d651c342322cccf913bac8ed11ad5.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_583d651c342322cccf913bac8ed11ad5.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_583d651c342322cccf913bac8ed11ad5.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_2e4a508084c5364add0ba445933abdef.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_2e4a508084c5364add0ba445933abdef.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_2e4a508084c5364add0ba445933abdef.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_2e4a508084c5364add0ba445933abdef.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_cf47d0b672ef722a1bf84b6ffcd826e2.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_cf47d0b672ef722a1bf84b6ffcd826e2.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_cf47d0b672ef722a1bf84b6ffcd826e2.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_cf47d0b672ef722a1bf84b6ffcd826e2.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_9877931aa34e17ef1345b125184f3c09.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_9877931aa34e17ef1345b125184f3c09.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_9877931aa34e17ef1345b125184f3c09.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_9877931aa34e17ef1345b125184f3c09.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_46a2409dc2bc007f09e16315f873a94b.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_46a2409dc2bc007f09e16315f873a94b.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_46a2409dc2bc007f09e16315f873a94b.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_46a2409dc2bc007f09e16315f873a94b.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_b3e2eef05d3a56786463b287ed97a62b.text: Esos policías perros nos pidieron una mordida.
sense_b3e2eef05d3a56786463b287ed97a62b.translation: Those lowlife cops asked us for a bribe.

sense_b3e2eef05d3a56786463b287ed97a62b.text: La compañera de Ricardo es bien perra; siempre lo pone en evidencia frente a la jefa.
sense_b3e2eef05d3a56786463b287ed97a62b.translation: Ricardo's coworker is a piece of garbage; she always calls him out in front of their boss.

sense_217b89c61eb5766e14fafc14d23dac06.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_217b89c61eb5766e14fafc14d23dac06.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_6722e12df77ed9887a9ba43d00f43f44.text: Esta silla es la mía. La tuya es esa otra.
sense_6722e12df77ed9887a9ba43d00f43f44.translation: This chair is mine. Yours is that one there.

sense_6722e12df77ed9887a9ba43d00f43f44.text: Esta no es mi raqueta; la mía lleva mi nombre escrito.
sense_6722e12df77ed9887a9ba43d00f43f44.translation: This isn't my racket; mine has my name written on it.

sense_ffe63195cc7b87a1e64051613ebec649.text: Estos no son mis lentes. Quiero los míos.
sense_ffe63195cc7b87a1e64051613ebec649.translation: These aren't my glasses. I want mine.

sense_ffe63195cc7b87a1e64051613ebec649.text: Este asiento es el mío. El tuyo es ese otro.
sense_ffe63195cc7b87a1e64051613ebec649.translation: This seat is mine. Yours is that one there.

sense_2d09f0aa39d02de1fc57846dd911faed.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_2d09f0aa39d02de1fc57846dd911faed.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_2d09f0aa39d02de1fc57846dd911faed.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_2d09f0aa39d02de1fc57846dd911faed.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_9a4566c71972b932e43ac6002bd6c385.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_9a4566c71972b932e43ac6002bd6c385.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_9a4566c71972b932e43ac6002bd6c385.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_9a4566c71972b932e43ac6002bd6c385.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_1c38099563c7a24104299fb5bf6733a8.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_1c38099563c7a24104299fb5bf6733a8.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_0bf10c7a43f1b7f66f795e3ab1770770.text: No me gustó el final de la película.
sense_0bf10c7a43f1b7f66f795e3ab1770770.translation: I didn't like the end of the movie.

sense_0bf10c7a43f1b7f66f795e3ab1770770.text: Yo quería ver una película de miedo, pero mi novio quería ver una comedia romántica.
sense_0bf10c7a43f1b7f66f795e3ab1770770.translation: I wanted to watch a scary movie, but my boyfriend wanted to watch a romantic comedy.

sense_90b521f58e1c26357bfc69f64ade1598.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_90b521f58e1c26357bfc69f64ade1598.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_90b521f58e1c26357bfc69f64ade1598.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_90b521f58e1c26357bfc69f64ade1598.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_7ae8eb96d5ccf7b886dfb5210efa1434.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_7ae8eb96d5ccf7b886dfb5210efa1434.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_7ae8eb96d5ccf7b886dfb5210efa1434.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_7ae8eb96d5ccf7b886dfb5210efa1434.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_2b9c9921b6b947d201a4f2091d91f4fb.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_d3565714a4780edcb8aa17a9b65c3ba3.text: Yo no vuelvo a este sitio nunca jamás.
sense_d3565714a4780edcb8aa17a9b65c3ba3.translation: I'll never ever come back to this place.

sense_833fd3668da3f88d41d3a20e2c64cec3.text: ¿Cuántas hay? - Deben de ser unas cuantas mil.
sense_833fd3668da3f88d41d3a20e2c64cec3.translation: How many are there? - There must be several thousand.

sense_833fd3668da3f88d41d3a20e2c64cec3.text: Miles de personas acudieron al acto.
sense_833fd3668da3f88d41d3a20e2c64cec3.translation: Thousands of people attended the event.

sense_cfe4dcfaa262beab0a5708a7d2ce9dc8.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_cfe4dcfaa262beab0a5708a7d2ce9dc8.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_fdcae388d3c4f35317afe8bcd177bfef.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_fdcae388d3c4f35317afe8bcd177bfef.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_fdcae388d3c4f35317afe8bcd177bfef.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_fdcae388d3c4f35317afe8bcd177bfef.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_1f632df69b9e705c2751fc7f9796620d.text: El avión hizo un extraño al despegar.
sense_1f632df69b9e705c2751fc7f9796620d.translation: The plane made a strange movement while taking off.

sense_1f632df69b9e705c2751fc7f9796620d.text: El elefante hizo un extraño cuando vio el ratón.
sense_1f632df69b9e705c2751fc7f9796620d.translation: The elephant shied when he saw a mouse.

sense_1bd53b22ed94941924e34fe09cc7e9c8.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_1bd53b22ed94941924e34fe09cc7e9c8.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_1bd53b22ed94941924e34fe09cc7e9c8.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_1bd53b22ed94941924e34fe09cc7e9c8.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_012d15e4b483cb43f5b943e3ce74ee6a.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_012d15e4b483cb43f5b943e3ce74ee6a.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_012d15e4b483cb43f5b943e3ce74ee6a.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_012d15e4b483cb43f5b943e3ce74ee6a.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_6dc44b7f4bc346f71576fde5ba99518d.text: Me gusta jugar al bingo por el dinero.
sense_6dc44b7f4bc346f71576fde5ba99518d.translation: I love playing Bingo for money.
Does anybody want to play tennis with me?

sense_d063333a9204cce726bb2b681d69b00b.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_d063333a9204cce726bb2b681d69b00b.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_e1a1788048e810e0d1d14faa017f6591.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_e1a1788048e810e0d1d14faa017f6591.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_e1a1788048e810e0d1d14faa017f6591.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_e1a1788048e810e0d1d14faa017f6591.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_dc84f05e2f32f1c98545f3d73c0c5fc9.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_dc84f05e2f32f1c98545f3d73c0c5fc9.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_cbd76f0187b06299a67a8bdb7508f542.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_cbd76f0187b06299a67a8bdb7508f542.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_cb203e1fa0e4af9b2a953b3d4d20d640.text: Solo quiero un sorbo. Tú puedes beber el resto.
sense_cb203e1fa0e4af9b2a953b3d4d20d640.translation: I just want a sip. You can drink the rest.

sense_cb203e1fa0e4af9b2a953b3d4d20d640.text: Haz lo que tengas que hacer, y olvídate del resto.
sense_cb203e1fa0e4af9b2a953b3d4d20d640.translation: Do what you have to do, and forget about the rest.

sense_ea89b946ddf1775ceb6a6c94c4e73bb2.text: Bernardo es un piloto de prueba para un fabricante de aviones.
sense_ea89b946ddf1775ceb6a6c94c4e73bb2.translation: Bernardo is a test pilot for an airplane manufacturer.

sense_ea89b946ddf1775ceb6a6c94c4e73bb2.text: No me gusta el pescado. - Pero nunca has probado como lo preparo yo. Haz la prueba.
sense_ea89b946ddf1775ceb6a6c94c4e73bb2.translation: I don't like fish. - But you've never tried it the way I make it. Try it.

sense_d73c573bd3e2a940a5afce732a97819d.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_d73c573bd3e2a940a5afce732a97819d.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_d73c573bd3e2a940a5afce732a97819d.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_d73c573bd3e2a940a5afce732a97819d.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_7cde641a2f002c19d2b2bc4322a5c97b.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_7cde641a2f002c19d2b2bc4322a5c97b.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_7cde641a2f002c19d2b2bc4322a5c97b.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_7cde641a2f002c19d2b2bc4322a5c97b.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_c25ef475106c811d30a95c0e35040042.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_4267e54ac6639b22d91dbc41583c44ad.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_4267e54ac6639b22d91dbc41583c44ad.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_783a0539563c17dea4415c0503b83909.text: Eliza no tiene trato con Ben desde que rompieron.
sense_783a0539563c17dea4415c0503b83909.translation: Eliza has had nothing to do with Ben since they broke up.

sense_783a0539563c17dea4415c0503b83909.text: Rob tiene poco trato con sus compañeros de trabajo porque él está casado y ellos están solteros.
sense_783a0539563c17dea4415c0503b83909.translation: Rob doesn't really interact with his coworkers because he's married and they're single.

sense_9d980621e63da4356ad12a7ea4aabedf.text: En el carro, los niños deben sentarse detrás.
sense_9d980621e63da4356ad12a7ea4aabedf.translation: In a car, children should sit in the back.

sense_9d980621e63da4356ad12a7ea4aabedf.text: La casa tiene un jardín grande detrás.
sense_9d980621e63da4356ad12a7ea4aabedf.translation: The house's got a large garden at the back.

sense_0804621575fc6b83b20b2fe4c7893b65.text: Me siento a gusto en este café. Tiene buenas vibraciones.
sense_0804621575fc6b83b20b2fe4c7893b65.translation: I like to be in this café. It has good vibes.

sense_0804621575fc6b83b20b2fe4c7893b65.text: ¿De verdad nos tenemos que ir? Me encuentro muy a gusto aquí, sentada al sol.
sense_0804621575fc6b83b20b2fe4c7893b65.translation: Do we really have to leave? It's so nice here, sitting in the sun.

sense_bcfa51c7a2a0fb4da66d36597d7f8fc6.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_bcfa51c7a2a0fb4da66d36597d7f8fc6.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_5889ec2fd71ca2de012f269ab175a470.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_5889ec2fd71ca2de012f269ab175a470.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_5889ec2fd71ca2de012f269ab175a470.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_5889ec2fd71ca2de012f269ab175a470.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_fa272e29a56c87ecd7551bdb1de1c45c.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_fa272e29a56c87ecd7551bdb1de1c45c.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_fa272e29a56c87ecd7551bdb1de1c45c.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_fa272e29a56c87ecd7551bdb1de1c45c.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_08545f7b2aa9359de6c540014b7d3201.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_edf42cf558e5f1f1a694f5750bfe1cac.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_edf42cf558e5f1f1a694f5750bfe1cac.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_edf42cf558e5f1f1a694f5750bfe1cac.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_edf42cf558e5f1f1a694f5750bfe1cac.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_6ea6133c3e4ad1dd105757d63a35b751.text: Es muy bonito que tengas una atención con tu abuela llevándole flores.
sense_6ea6133c3e4ad1dd105757d63a35b751.translation: It was very thoughtful of you to take your grandmother flowers.

sense_6ea6133c3e4ad1dd105757d63a35b751.text: Julia y su marido nos hicieron la atención de invitarnos para celebrar su aniversario en familia.
sense_6ea6133c3e4ad1dd105757d63a35b751.translation: Julia and her husband were kind enough to invite us along to celebrate their anniversary with them.

sense_a2fbdd86bf69504377f4aaf0db026021.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_4aebc637474e2327eb93412a3fa55ae8.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_4aebc637474e2327eb93412a3fa55ae8.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_4aebc637474e2327eb93412a3fa55ae8.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
