sense_4aebc637474e2327eb93412a3fa55ae8.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_ca10cf73f5e4e6c7971bd6eb5fc67399.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_ca10cf73f5e4e6c7971bd6eb5fc67399.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_ca10cf73f5e4e6c7971bd6eb5fc67399.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_ca10cf73f5e4e6c7971bd6eb5fc67399.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_7bacea5b0a4fb1a1fc7f19a8250b51db.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_7bacea5b0a4fb1a1fc7f19a8250b51db.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_2446d199c0410b3656c3050af727a46b.text: Desde ayer acá está muy enfadada conmigo.
sense_2446d199c0410b3656c3050af727a46b.translation: She's been really mad at me since yesterday.

sense_2446d199c0410b3656c3050af727a46b.text: Trabajo aquí de un mes acá.
sense_2446d199c0410b3656c3050af727a46b.translation: I've been working here for a month now.

sense_7ee5ddbb3bcd4dd8d2ceb19d3ebb4476.text: Disculpa, no te he visto trabajando allí. Me pondré los cascos.
sense_7ee5ddbb3bcd4dd8d2ceb19d3ebb4476.translation: I'm sorry, I didn't see you there working. I'll put headphones in.

sense_7ee5ddbb3bcd4dd8d2ceb19d3ebb4476.text: Disculpe, por favor. ¿Me dice dónde está la parada del metro?
sense_7ee5ddbb3bcd4dd8d2ceb19d3ebb4476.translation: Excuse me, please. Can you tell me where the subway station is?

sense_707fcc4f795e6c4cfa37616063495832.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_707fcc4f795e6c4cfa37616063495832.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_707fcc4f795e6c4cfa37616063495832.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_707fcc4f795e6c4cfa37616063495832.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_3c17038b49be7b8fbb7b6b7dc1ab8bf2.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_3c17038b49be7b8fbb7b6b7dc1ab8bf2.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_3c17038b49be7b8fbb7b6b7dc1ab8bf2.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_3c17038b49be7b8fbb7b6b7dc1ab8bf2.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_3962859c9d6607e73662fd85468eb894.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_3962859c9d6607e73662fd85468eb894.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_3962859c9d6607e73662fd85468eb894.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_3962859c9d6607e73662fd85468eb894.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_6038b353a1a12787ffc702dc9134f983.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_6038b353a1a12787ffc702dc9134f983.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_6038b353a1a12787ffc702dc9134f983.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_6038b353a1a12787ffc702dc9134f983.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_12693361c2736c12d985bcca0ea1e567.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_12693361c2736c12d985bcca0ea1e567.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_12693361c2736c12d985bcca0ea1e567.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_12693361c2736c12d985bcca0ea1e567.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_73fe963dbf8968b376639fe086aa29a1.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_73fe963dbf8968b376639fe086aa29a1.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_62676ade961036a961851bd0713af06a.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_62676ade961036a961851bd0713af06a.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_e1b3a0bd374b5b3952be25d8ac8130a6.text: En mi sueño, los dinosaurios todavía vagaban por la tierra.
sense_e1b3a0bd374b5b3952be25d8ac8130a6.translation: In my dream, dinosaurs still roamed the Earth.

sense_e1b3a0bd374b5b3952be25d8ac8130a6.text: Él es tan despistado; es como si viviera en un sueño.
sense_e1b3a0bd374b5b3952be25d8ac8130a6.translation: He's so absent-minded; it's as if he lives in a dream.

sense_d28556dacfbf78fa1fbcb32279a9f4ec.text: Sueño con tener una casa grande y mucho dinero.
sense_d28556dacfbf78fa1fbcb32279a9f4ec.translation: I dream of having a big house and lots of money.

sense_d28556dacfbf78fa1fbcb32279a9f4ec.text: Ella soñó con el actor famoso.
sense_d28556dacfbf78fa1fbcb32279a9f4ec.translation: She dreamed about the famous actor.

sense_00ababb30afb3779eacc54ec83361dc8.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_00ababb30afb3779eacc54ec83361dc8.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_00ababb30afb3779eacc54ec83361dc8.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_00ababb30afb3779eacc54ec83361dc8.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_deceb6706d7c89a617acfbeb2dd47505.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_deceb6706d7c89a617acfbeb2dd47505.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_deceb6706d7c89a617acfbeb2dd47505.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_deceb6706d7c89a617acfbeb2dd47505.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_df32f93afba4d4a1cc6adc52c4d8184f.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_df32f93afba4d4a1cc6adc52c4d8184f.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_df32f93afba4d4a1cc6adc52c4d8184f.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_df32f93afba4d4a1cc6adc52c4d8184f.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_056ec4c7bf52aa0f35183c2691c20b17.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_bb7a68d86a51590e2a4c70c0068a9686.text: ¡Me pone negra que la gente sea tan maleducada!
sense_bb7a68d86a51590e2a4c70c0068a9686.translation: It drives me crazy when people are so rude!

sense_73a4c3e3613ab6f9f219ab654c6de3fb.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_73a4c3e3613ab6f9f219ab654c6de3fb.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_73a4c3e3613ab6f9f219ab654c6de3fb.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_73a4c3e3613ab6f9f219ab654c6de3fb.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_bbf94a5292a902e8a22c18bb06618079.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_bbf94a5292a902e8a22c18bb06618079.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_bbf94a5292a902e8a22c18bb06618079.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_bbf94a5292a902e8a22c18bb06618079.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_4cf59979dedcc72887cdfc1f65686352.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_4cf59979dedcc72887cdfc1f65686352.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_4cf59979dedcc72887cdfc1f65686352.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_4cf59979dedcc72887cdfc1f65686352.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_2382c331fdcc4f22f62ce5964540c6bf.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_2382c331fdcc4f22f62ce5964540c6bf.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_2382c331fdcc4f22f62ce5964540c6bf.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_2382c331fdcc4f22f62ce5964540c6bf.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_661862e806e48504d1e70e3b6e3a3da5.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_661862e806e48504d1e70e3b6e3a3da5.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_661862e806e48504d1e70e3b6e3a3da5.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_661862e806e48504d1e70e3b6e3a3da5.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_b1fa1405f91e4da172ac8d64c3c25df0.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_b1fa1405f91e4da172ac8d64c3c25df0.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_1f84ad1bc7d84dda3e3deedbab63e0e9.text: Un día en la playa me suena perfecto.
sense_1f84ad1bc7d84dda3e3deedbab63e0e9.translation: A day on the beach sounds perfect.

sense_bc8af16a23a58471cebdf1b06e0b66be.text: Sentí mucha pena cuando se murió mi actor preferido.
sense_bc8af16a23a58471cebdf1b06e0b66be.translation: I felt really sad when my favorite actor died.

sense_bc8af16a23a58471cebdf1b06e0b66be.text: Me da mucha pena verlos partir.
sense_bc8af16a23a58471cebdf1b06e0b66be.translation: It makes me so sad to see them leave.

sense_9c32d4b59cb4fac2d74a8a4c9856c721.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_7b04f5245ec7792ef69de201d5f7c3d1.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_7b04f5245ec7792ef69de201d5f7c3d1.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_7b04f5245ec7792ef69de201d5f7c3d1.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_7b04f5245ec7792ef69de201d5f7c3d1.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_d1fdd49000fb98539e314ae750a38650.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_428f6d5a190653b21365ad728e4551e6.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_428f6d5a190653b21365ad728e4551e6.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_428f6d5a190653b21365ad728e4551e6.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_428f6d5a190653b21365ad728e4551e6.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_838479f45c38141566d2c569394bb7d3.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_838479f45c38141566d2c569394bb7d3.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_838479f45c38141566d2c569394bb7d3.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_838479f45c38141566d2c569394bb7d3.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_44cdc085666bc9eca1ea2fdb23687c29.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_44cdc085666bc9eca1ea2fdb23687c29.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_bd4e4956000a9d1141c5a8fac1f96be0.text: ¿Es tuyo el carro que está bloqueando el mío?
sense_bd4e4956000a9d1141c5a8fac1f96be0.translation: Is that car that's blocking mine yours?

sense_bd4e4956000a9d1141c5a8fac1f96be0.text: ¿Esta pulsera es tuya? La encontré en el piso.
sense_bd4e4956000a9d1141c5a8fac1f96be0.translation: Is this bracelet yours? I found it on the floor.

sense_c6102a6d60289e8398c35b1eecfb4d31.text: Esta copa de vino es mía. La tuya está en la mesa.
sense_c6102a6d60289e8398c35b1eecfb4d31.translation: This glass of wine is mine. Yours is on the table.

sense_fab6003bdd49cb816699b0f84a35b91e.text: Esos niños no le hacen caso a nadie. ¡Solo campan por sus respetos!
sense_fab6003bdd49cb816699b0f84a35b91e.translation: Those kids don't listen to anyone. They just do as they please!

sense_fab6003bdd49cb816699b0f84a35b91e.text: Desde que cerraron la estación de policía, los criminales campan a sus anchas por aquí.
sense_fab6003bdd49cb816699b0f84a35b91e.translation: Since the police station was closed, criminals wander freely around here.

sense_056fe3320b9602d12ca4ee065ff6f526.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_056fe3320b9602d12ca4ee065ff6f526.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_056fe3320b9602d12ca4ee065ff6f526.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_056fe3320b9602d12ca4ee065ff6f526.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_264b6de4934f7ba8353fd04195c77e36.text: Le di un baño de chocolate a las galletas.
sense_264b6de4934f7ba8353fd04195c77e36.translation: I covered the cookies with a chocolate coating.

sense_264b6de4934f7ba8353fd04195c77e36.text: Se le da un baño de almíbar al bizcocho antes de rellenarlo.
sense_264b6de4934f7ba8353fd04195c77e36.translation: The sponge cake is soaked in syrup before filling it.

sense_8f6b450495482f86997a2465869a6237.text: Fueron amigos durante años y después se hicieron novios.
sense_8f6b450495482f86997a2465869a6237.translation: They were friends for years and then they started going out.
How long have they been dating?

sense_b058b9a9deaf282332e441086515f278.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_b058b9a9deaf282332e441086515f278.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_b058b9a9deaf282332e441086515f278.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_b058b9a9deaf282332e441086515f278.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_409f9633ab0d2c9ad7766e93720db128.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_409f9633ab0d2c9ad7766e93720db128.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_409f9633ab0d2c9ad7766e93720db128.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_409f9633ab0d2c9ad7766e93720db128.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_9542bef1c0bde788bc8b409670b416dd.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_9542bef1c0bde788bc8b409670b416dd.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_f22aba74ae9f654745dff69b2f625302.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_f22aba74ae9f654745dff69b2f625302.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_f22aba74ae9f654745dff69b2f625302.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_f22aba74ae9f654745dff69b2f625302.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_61bf029df70af2e156949f616a7bbcc4.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_61bf029df70af2e156949f616a7bbcc4.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_6ca30f8ed2a2da0a45b4a4709bb7c538.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_6ca30f8ed2a2da0a45b4a4709bb7c538.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_6ca30f8ed2a2da0a45b4a4709bb7c538.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_6ca30f8ed2a2da0a45b4a4709bb7c538.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_50022fe8328af92691be617929083816.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_50022fe8328af92691be617929083816.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_50022fe8328af92691be617929083816.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_50022fe8328af92691be617929083816.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_2e3f669e86f8cda7842f84146c6383d6.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_de3170c8f56ccf9664df3f64ce503d5d.text: No soy muy amigo de la tecnología, pero entiendo su importancia.
sense_de3170c8f56ccf9664df3f64ce503d5d.translation: I don't really like technology, but I understand its importance.

sense_de3170c8f56ccf9664df3f64ce503d5d.text: Los británicos son muy amigos de hacer bricolaje y siempre están comprando artículos para la casa.
sense_de3170c8f56ccf9664df3f64ce503d5d.translation: The British love doing DIY and are always buying articles for the home.

sense_3a9408cf401d455d366f87a0c093f8e2.text: Espero estar a tu vera toda la vida, mi amor.
sense_3a9408cf401d455d366f87a0c093f8e2.translation: I hope to be with you all my life, my love.

sense_3a9408cf401d455d366f87a0c093f8e2.text: Tenía que quedarme quieto y sentarme a la vera de mi madre durante la misa.
sense_3a9408cf401d455d366f87a0c093f8e2.translation: I had to stay put and sit next to my mother during the mass.

sense_2e611de29b1509946494510217b9a459.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_2e611de29b1509946494510217b9a459.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_2e611de29b1509946494510217b9a459.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_2e611de29b1509946494510217b9a459.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_93936517ed87e4dbf7cdc1bc6f4caded.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_93936517ed87e4dbf7cdc1bc6f4caded.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_93936517ed87e4dbf7cdc1bc6f4caded.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_93936517ed87e4dbf7cdc1bc6f4caded.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_d6f1f69032b9b8efb6799a9e1cae113f.text: El hotel tiene una situación ideal cerca de la playa.
sense_d6f1f69032b9b8efb6799a9e1cae113f.translation: The hotel is ideally situated near the beach.

sense_d6f1f69032b9b8efb6799a9e1cae113f.text: La situación del restaurante es céntrica.

sense_235600c957451dfdcc92c9c8c008e58e.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_235600c957451dfdcc92c9c8c008e58e.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_235600c957451dfdcc92c9c8c008e58e.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_235600c957451dfdcc92c9c8c008e58e.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_05615f681c189749e385b2362388608a.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_05615f681c189749e385b2362388608a.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_05615f681c189749e385b2362388608a.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_05615f681c189749e385b2362388608a.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_7fb8ffc8166631bd7fe44432210a6051.text: Se busca oficial u oficiala de fontanería.
Se solicita oficial electricista para realizar trabajos en una fábrica de ropa.
sense_7fb8ffc8166631bd7fe44432210a6051.translation: Time-served electrician required to carry out jobs at a clothes factory.

sense_1420e9da74a7237597e98fc5cbb865b9.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_1420e9da74a7237597e98fc5cbb865b9.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_6e4d5c6b76ca4c226e50a60f159895b3.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_6e4d5c6b76ca4c226e50a60f159895b3.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_4e4df8b817633562d62b473c8134935f.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_4e4df8b817633562d62b473c8134935f.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_4e4df8b817633562d62b473c8134935f.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_4e4df8b817633562d62b473c8134935f.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_38ebc80332633af8c5c6796af4603528.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_38ebc80332633af8c5c6796af4603528.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_38ebc80332633af8c5c6796af4603528.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_38ebc80332633af8c5c6796af4603528.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_95f5d9f47f6349ef2e3ee5036c044e67.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_95f5d9f47f6349ef2e3ee5036c044e67.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_95f5d9f47f6349ef2e3ee5036c044e67.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_95f5d9f47f6349ef2e3ee5036c044e67.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_5ccc4feb4639d39813fa55b941d5134e.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_5ccc4feb4639d39813fa55b941d5134e.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_5ccc4feb4639d39813fa55b941d5134e.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_5ccc4feb4639d39813fa55b941d5134e.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_e6b70ac8f51235bed72422143775f42a.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_4a97c127e1eb65c4290d875469f1046d.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_4a97c127e1eb65c4290d875469f1046d.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_4a97c127e1eb65c4290d875469f1046d.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_4a97c127e1eb65c4290d875469f1046d.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_25921616d46e840d3918c6cad5e46b7d.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_25921616d46e840d3918c6cad5e46b7d.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_25921616d46e840d3918c6cad5e46b7d.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_25921616d46e840d3918c6cad5e46b7d.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_73c9ce9422687a716abc39f81683d60f.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_73c9ce9422687a716abc39f81683d60f.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_73c9ce9422687a716abc39f81683d60f.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_73c9ce9422687a716abc39f81683d60f.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_851ae96fed275f68a7a51e5f45fb9b75.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_851ae96fed275f68a7a51e5f45fb9b75.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_851ae96fed275f68a7a51e5f45fb9b75.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_851ae96fed275f68a7a51e5f45fb9b75.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_2cc179798d4f506c7271420b21bcb341.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_2cc179798d4f506c7271420b21bcb341.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_2cc179798d4f506c7271420b21bcb341.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_2cc179798d4f506c7271420b21bcb341.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_7bd3ec3b73688a350da45d4f79123689.text: Fueron a rescatar el pájaro, pero ya estaba muerto.
sense_7bd3ec3b73688a350da45d4f79123689.translation: They went to rescue the bird, but it was already dead.

sense_7bd3ec3b73688a350da45d4f79123689.text: Aunque mi autora preferida está muerta, siento que la conozco a través de sus cuentos.
sense_7bd3ec3b73688a350da45d4f79123689.translation: Although my favorite author is dead, I feel like I know her through her stories.

sense_0b73d6f0611f28b43d3e36f2b5d08f0f.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_0b73d6f0611f28b43d3e36f2b5d08f0f.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_0b73d6f0611f28b43d3e36f2b5d08f0f.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_0b73d6f0611f28b43d3e36f2b5d08f0f.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_f9e2d6b858f79825a9c2d536c9cfa075.text: ¡Me encanta tu casa! ¿Tú misma la decoraste?
sense_f9e2d6b858f79825a9c2d536c9cfa075.translation: I love your house! Did you decorate it yourself?

sense_f9e2d6b858f79825a9c2d536c9cfa075.text: Me encanta tomarme un chocolate caliente cuando hace frío afuera.
sense_f9e2d6b858f79825a9c2d536c9cfa075.translation: I love drinking hot chocolate when it's cold out.

sense_95260f04be1fe87d1b2cb0d494da1bbc.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_95260f04be1fe87d1b2cb0d494da1bbc.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_95260f04be1fe87d1b2cb0d494da1bbc.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_95260f04be1fe87d1b2cb0d494da1bbc.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_751b19e77166879feb16e4e52ba7ec42.text: Es imposible hacer tantas cosas al mismo tiempo.
sense_751b19e77166879feb16e4e52ba7ec42.translation: It's impossible to do so many things at the same time.

sense_751b19e77166879feb16e4e52ba7ec42.text: Parecía un sueño imposible, pero seguí intentándolo y al final lo conseguí.
sense_751b19e77166879feb16e4e52ba7ec42.translation: It seemed an impossible dream, but I persevered, and eventually I succeeded.

sense_5b24e384c7eb505c1d4397d3667b27fc.text: El vagabundo no se había lavado en semanas y estaba imposible.
sense_5b24e384c7eb505c1d4397d3667b27fc.translation: The bum hadn't washed in weeks and looked filthy.

sense_5b24e384c7eb505c1d4397d3667b27fc.text: Cuando la depresión era aguda, no salía de su cama y se veía imposible.
sense_5b24e384c7eb505c1d4397d3667b27fc.translation: During moments of severe depression, she didn't leave her bed and looked filthy.

sense_19811cad00bd8c182f40a46d00c79057.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_19811cad00bd8c182f40a46d00c79057.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_19811cad00bd8c182f40a46d00c79057.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_19811cad00bd8c182f40a46d00c79057.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_d02af784cdffce909ab227116c53df35.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_d02af784cdffce909ab227116c53df35.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_d02af784cdffce909ab227116c53df35.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_d02af784cdffce909ab227116c53df35.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_6d6e520e065b7ba575b038db59715eff.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_865dea31747c21d8d6f38cb9db57a698.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_865dea31747c21d8d6f38cb9db57a698.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_865dea31747c21d8d6f38cb9db57a698.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_865dea31747c21d8d6f38cb9db57a698.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_dfcf10b8bcb0771a899c20c1ff64bd5e.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_dfcf10b8bcb0771a899c20c1ff64bd5e.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_f619d613f41d55b67c05566a6d446a1c.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_f619d613f41d55b67c05566a6d446a1c.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_8d053fdeecd898cfd077e84fd13c00f2.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_8d053fdeecd898cfd077e84fd13c00f2.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_e3397c573a8d77be311cf8a716cb3ee2.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_e3397c573a8d77be311cf8a716cb3ee2.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_e3397c573a8d77be311cf8a716cb3ee2.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_e3397c573a8d77be311cf8a716cb3ee2.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_b22a9577844cf48776ea9e59b0fec88c.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_b22a9577844cf48776ea9e59b0fec88c.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_55aae8f618707ec164d8be9ff24e8f36.text: Eramos el huerto para sembrar nuestras primeras semillas.
sense_55aae8f618707ec164d8be9ff24e8f36.translation: We've laid out the beds in our vegetable garden to plant our first seeds.

sense_55aae8f618707ec164d8be9ff24e8f36.text: Don Pedro ya eró el jardín para que pongamos las semillas de tomate.
sense_55aae8f618707ec164d8be9ff24e8f36.translation: Don Pedro has already prepared the ground for us to sow the tomato seeds.

sense_e7ebc4454834cfa21d449043f6a3687d.text: ¡Qué sal tiene para bailar el tango, mano!
sense_e7ebc4454834cfa21d449043f6a3687d.translation: She's an unbelievable tango dancer, man!

sense_e7ebc4454834cfa21d449043f6a3687d.text: Es un tipo con mucha sal. A todo el mundo le cae bien.
sense_e7ebc4454834cfa21d449043f6a3687d.translation: He's a really charming guy. Everyone likes him.

sense_be3cf24e04134378d445119d9ac10282.text: David lleva una vida aburrida, sin el menor accidente.
sense_be3cf24e04134378d445119d9ac10282.translation: David leads a boring, uneventful life.

sense_be3cf24e04134378d445119d9ac10282.text: El resto del día pasó sin accidentes, lo que me alivió mucho.
sense_be3cf24e04134378d445119d9ac10282.translation: The rest of the day passed uneventfully, which was a great relief.

sense_76a95a985887384bc9347d8cf743411b.text: Este cuadro es mejor que el otro que pintaste.
sense_76a95a985887384bc9347d8cf743411b.translation: This painting is better than the other one you painted.

sense_76a95a985887384bc9347d8cf743411b.text: Mi batido es mejor que el tuyo.
sense_76a95a985887384bc9347d8cf743411b.translation: My milkshake is better than yours.

sense_b0504ba1ac8cf222fb25fd63b09380ab.translation: I think it would be better to tell them.

sense_613f4dc3f4b70d992c13c7d36fde4929.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_204991a28166d9615a7567cfe48f325f.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_204991a28166d9615a7567cfe48f325f.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_204991a28166d9615a7567cfe48f325f.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_204991a28166d9615a7567cfe48f325f.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_74539bafcfe3770a116289eda0eca7be.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_74539bafcfe3770a116289eda0eca7be.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_74539bafcfe3770a116289eda0eca7be.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_74539bafcfe3770a116289eda0eca7be.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_58de79957c3584abbfeec01f44544bb2.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_58de79957c3584abbfeec01f44544bb2.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_c4b9b7461760cb71a624124389908b2a.text: La peli era malísima; solo se salvaba el actor principal.
sense_c4b9b7461760cb71a624124389908b2a.translation: The film was really bad; the main actor was the only one who was ok.

sense_c4b9b7461760cb71a624124389908b2a.text: Los considero a todos unos vagos; no se salva nadie.
sense_c4b9b7461760cb71a624124389908b2a.translation: I consider them all lazy, without exception.

sense_6cdd03512e53c044eadbd06171e0eeb0.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_7810c96d736dac399d9fd6f01f437318.text: No podré seguir trabajando hoy porque Internet está fuera de línea.
sense_7810c96d736dac399d9fd6f01f437318.translation: I won't be able to keep working today because the Internet is down.

sense_7810c96d736dac399d9fd6f01f437318.text: Como no vivo cerca de una universidad, hice mis estudios en línea.
sense_7810c96d736dac399d9fd6f01f437318.translation: Since I don't live near a university, I did my courses online.

sense_7fed691e8eafd6755b3e596849598c23.text: Nuestra preferencia sería algo en la línea del diseño original.
sense_7fed691e8eafd6755b3e596849598c23.translation: Our preference would be something along the lines of the original design.

sense_7fed691e8eafd6755b3e596849598c23.text: La estrategia de ventas será en líneas generales lo mismo, pero vamos a cambiar algunos detalles.
sense_7fed691e8eafd6755b3e596849598c23.translation: The sales strategy will be broadly speaking the same, but we're going to change a few details.

sense_e5202bc9c06adb9ae841abe529c0b2a6.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_e5202bc9c06adb9ae841abe529c0b2a6.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_3f934cb3224b560992ff18b3ed16e3f2.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_3f934cb3224b560992ff18b3ed16e3f2.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_3f934cb3224b560992ff18b3ed16e3f2.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_3f934cb3224b560992ff18b3ed16e3f2.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_bf221ce83e5a0dde73196aa6909ce4f2.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_bf221ce83e5a0dde73196aa6909ce4f2.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_1525d8e21a3c25269fb63428bab916ab.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_1525d8e21a3c25269fb63428bab916ab.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_dca0d7af4686ee5edae4ef080621bd5f.text: Don Pablo, ya puede pasar al despacho.
sense_dca0d7af4686ee5edae4ef080621bd5f.translation: Pablo, if you'd like to go into the office now, sir.

sense_dca0d7af4686ee5edae4ef080621bd5f.text: Recibí una carta de don Pedro.
sense_dca0d7af4686ee5edae4ef080621bd5f.translation: I received a letter from Peter.

sense_ec0668606aafc22dcf815f22cc4fb1dc.text: Me refería a ellas, las que están sentadas allá.
sense_ec0668606aafc22dcf815f22cc4fb1dc.translation: I was referring to them, the ones sitting over there.

sense_e5f4cb225d43656ef5da1755824084ad.text: Ese cuadro de Van Gogh es hermoso.
sense_e5f4cb225d43656ef5da1755824084ad.translation: That Van Gogh painting is beautiful.

sense_e5f4cb225d43656ef5da1755824084ad.text: Es hermoso cómo el paisaje se une con el mar al amanecer.
sense_e5f4cb225d43656ef5da1755824084ad.translation: It's beautiful how the landscape meets the sea at dawn.

sense_4b205500d13554ef5b16556df6eb47d4.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_4b205500d13554ef5b16556df6eb47d4.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_3921de43890eb18553d31dcf30178850.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_3921de43890eb18553d31dcf30178850.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_055430c6e242b0ecd1046f378ec1b665.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.

Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_0bd0950369a4a4c3f0ea172dd9f3404a.text: Pablo es el estudiante favorito de la maestra.
sense_0bd0950369a4a4c3f0ea172dd9f3404a.translation: Pablo is the teacher's favorite student.

sense_0bd0950369a4a4c3f0ea172dd9f3404a.text: El Sr. Finley es un maestro en la escuela primaria Jefferson.
sense_0bd0950369a4a4c3f0ea172dd9f3404a.translation: Mr. Finley is a teacher at Jefferson Elementary School.

sense_32e4036092c65e6d5c4c42f6f5211c9b.text: Voy andando al colegio todos los días.
sense_32e4036092c65e6d5c4c42f6f5211c9b.translation: I walk to school every day.

sense_32e4036092c65e6d5c4c42f6f5211c9b.text: "Cuando ando, me canso mucho", le dijo la anciana a su médico.
sense_32e4036092c65e6d5c4c42f6f5211c9b.translation: "When I walk, I get very tired," the old woman told her doctor.

sense_3a10db74dca7e72786f4641e41df807d.text: En el verano ella anda en bicicleta al trabajo.
sense_3a10db74dca7e72786f4641e41df807d.translation: In the summer she takes her bike to work.

sense_3a10db74dca7e72786f4641e41df807d.text: Yo siempre ando en tren cuando regreso al hogar.
sense_3a10db74dca7e72786f4641e41df807d.translation: I always take the train when returning home.

sense_e9a9104542f9b248658ffd5210f99384.text: ¡Qué andar tan raro tienen esos jóvenes!
sense_e9a9104542f9b248658ffd5210f99384.translation: The way those youths walk is really strange!

sense_e9a9104542f9b248658ffd5210f99384.text: Se le nota en el andar que tiene mucho dolor.
sense_e9a9104542f9b248658ffd5210f99384.translation: You can tell by the way she walks that she's in a lot of pain.

sense_69ec8eae3ecb741ed911d13061869d26.text: Me gusta todo de ti, hasta los andares.
sense_69ec8eae3ecb741ed911d13061869d26.translation: I like everything about you, even the way you walk.

sense_69ec8eae3ecb741ed911d13061869d26.text: El Charlot de Charlie Chaplin tiene unos andares totalmente inconfundibles.
sense_69ec8eae3ecb741ed911d13061869d26.translation: The way Charlie Chaplin's tramp walks is completely unmistakeable.

sense_be4fb3a23e2d2b8796b320112ac18257.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_e5a340b0be18643881883aac83910755.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_e5a340b0be18643881883aac83910755.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_e5a340b0be18643881883aac83910755.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_e5a340b0be18643881883aac83910755.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_5bba07996cc1727bf67774add509c205.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_5bba07996cc1727bf67774add509c205.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_c94e307866d2eb8ac4e29ed9485a40e2.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
