sense_538bf63c8ce4b0b30f5705bdfec427c5.text: Los dos gobiernos tratan de evitar que se rompan las relaciones entre sus dos países.
sense_538bf63c8ce4b0b30f5705bdfec427c5.translation: Both governments are trying to avoid breaking off relations between their two countries.

sense_0e8a0b77a90c13b71fa7a2ea0f9661b9.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_0e8a0b77a90c13b71fa7a2ea0f9661b9.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_0e8a0b77a90c13b71fa7a2ea0f9661b9.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_0e8a0b77a90c13b71fa7a2ea0f9661b9.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_ddb217e9286562a3a83fff5f48fa44e6.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_ddb217e9286562a3a83fff5f48fa44e6.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_013558139666eb3f18c5575f5e17ad00.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_013558139666eb3f18c5575f5e17ad00.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_cf71d2f1a3b434b4e41c0f7d7a2d2ad5.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_cf71d2f1a3b434b4e41c0f7d7a2d2ad5.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_cf71d2f1a3b434b4e41c0f7d7a2d2ad5.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_cf71d2f1a3b434b4e41c0f7d7a2d2ad5.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_bdac68fe72832bcb844df8bb2b895f7e.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_bdac68fe72832bcb844df8bb2b895f7e.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_bdac68fe72832bcb844df8bb2b895f7e.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_bdac68fe72832bcb844df8bb2b895f7e.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_40d8b6a7543e4dc38e7eb1fb1a2137fc.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_40d8b6a7543e4dc38e7eb1fb1a2137fc.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_075253c1ed53c2d0a28446ab16596397.text: Fueron a rescatar el pájaro, pero ya estaba muerto.
sense_075253c1ed53c2d0a28446ab16596397.translation: They went to rescue the bird, but it was already dead.

sense_075253c1ed53c2d0a28446ab16596397.text: Aunque mi autora preferida está muerta, siento que la conozco a través de sus cuentos.
sense_075253c1ed53c2d0a28446ab16596397.translation: Although my favorite author is dead, I feel like I know her through her stories.

sense_001c05ee4de26a935996485e5f913fb5.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_001c05ee4de26a935996485e5f913fb5.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_001c05ee4de26a935996485e5f913fb5.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_001c05ee4de26a935996485e5f913fb5.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_f6a91372dbfdda82714c22804288d751.text: Me pidió que escribiera una disculpa al grupo.
sense_f6a91372dbfdda82714c22804288d751.translation: He asked me to write an apology to the group.

sense_69891c3dc2ddafff9379dbed8cca08b1.text: Disculpa, no te he visto trabajando allí. Me pondré los cascos.
sense_69891c3dc2ddafff9379dbed8cca08b1.translation: I'm sorry, I didn't see you there working. I'll put headphones in.

sense_69891c3dc2ddafff9379dbed8cca08b1.text: Disculpe, por favor. ¿Me dice dónde está la parada del metro?
sense_69891c3dc2ddafff9379dbed8cca08b1.translation: Excuse me, please. Can you tell me where the subway station is?

sense_1f97acb1f79dcf577fc7208fff58f9cb.text: Este año se me juntaron todas las desgracias.
sense_1f97acb1f79dcf577fc7208fff58f9cb.translation: This year it was just one bad thing after another.

sense_1f97acb1f79dcf577fc7208fff58f9cb.text: Se juntó la tormenta con la explosión de gas.
sense_1f97acb1f79dcf577fc7208fff58f9cb.translation: The storm came right on top of the gas explosion.

sense_e1a1e0ef3f2aee44e11e266aa5c3f9b4.text: Fueron amigos durante años y después se hicieron novios.
sense_e1a1e0ef3f2aee44e11e266aa5c3f9b4.translation: They were friends for years and then they started going out.
How long have they been dating?

sense_e8c0b052bb3c982f2f4e1bf0220f6e0f.text: Hubo demasiadas bajas y tuvieron que cancelar la clase ese semestre.
sense_e8c0b052bb3c982f2f4e1bf0220f6e0f.translation: So many students dropped the class that they had to cancel it for that semester.

sense_e8c0b052bb3c982f2f4e1bf0220f6e0f.text: La empresa ha tenido muchas bajas por las condiciones de trabajo peligrosas.
sense_e8c0b052bb3c982f2f4e1bf0220f6e0f.translation: The company has had a lot of people leave because of dangerous working conditions.

sense_39867e43383f1a62864bc303465ff3ce.text: Corro el peligro de volverme loca planificando esta boda.
sense_39867e43383f1a62864bc303465ff3ce.translation: I'm in danger of going crazy planning this wedding.

sense_39867e43383f1a62864bc303465ff3ce.text: Ten en cuenta el peligro que supone conducir una motocicleta.
sense_39867e43383f1a62864bc303465ff3ce.translation: Take into account how dangerous it is to ride a motorcycle.

sense_08a34d4e7da4d9ee4ca91d9bbf994c55.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_ffab0a588ed07b86c9cbc8a81d76ade1.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_ffab0a588ed07b86c9cbc8a81d76ade1.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_ffab0a588ed07b86c9cbc8a81d76ade1.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_ffab0a588ed07b86c9cbc8a81d76ade1.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_81cd8b15a97fad85c1f1819c833fc76f.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_81cd8b15a97fad85c1f1819c833fc76f.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_81cd8b15a97fad85c1f1819c833fc76f.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_81cd8b15a97fad85c1f1819c833fc76f.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_2b941ade760990c62a055d31fee41046.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_2b941ade760990c62a055d31fee41046.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_ecabb74a12810b11236ee8affe44acf7.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_ecabb74a12810b11236ee8affe44acf7.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_ecabb74a12810b11236ee8affe44acf7.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_ecabb74a12810b11236ee8affe44acf7.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_4ee1065c9ae2045048e4d2e90c7e8edc.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_4ee1065c9ae2045048e4d2e90c7e8edc.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_4ee1065c9ae2045048e4d2e90c7e8edc.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_4ee1065c9ae2045048e4d2e90c7e8edc.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_4f830399eeb1ba791f66d0c83ce1b645.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_4f830399eeb1ba791f66d0c83ce1b645.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_4f830399eeb1ba791f66d0c83ce1b645.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_4f830399eeb1ba791f66d0c83ce1b645.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_5d669dd40676fbd250b411c31a1615df.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_5d669dd40676fbd250b411c31a1615df.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_5d669dd40676fbd250b411c31a1615df.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_5d669dd40676fbd250b411c31a1615df.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_5f8b8ac787e700d20df7e3bfd43607b7.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_5f8b8ac787e700d20df7e3bfd43607b7.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_5f8b8ac787e700d20df7e3bfd43607b7.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_5f8b8ac787e700d20df7e3bfd43607b7.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_0c9963eb29d73ba759c18c7fc961779d.text: Se fue sin explicación y me partió el corazón.
sense_0c9963eb29d73ba759c18c7fc961779d.translation: She left without explanation and broke my heart.

sense_0c9963eb29d73ba759c18c7fc961779d.text: Le dijeron que si no pagaba la deuda, le iban a partir las piernas.
sense_0c9963eb29d73ba759c18c7fc961779d.translation: They told him that if he didn't pay the debt, they were going to break his legs.

sense_57f6048c7f6526dfbe6850790f4e4a50.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_57f6048c7f6526dfbe6850790f4e4a50.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_57f6048c7f6526dfbe6850790f4e4a50.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_57f6048c7f6526dfbe6850790f4e4a50.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_92f1402bf27c03ee62d001a9ae3f9ad6.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_92f1402bf27c03ee62d001a9ae3f9ad6.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_92f1402bf27c03ee62d001a9ae3f9ad6.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_92f1402bf27c03ee62d001a9ae3f9ad6.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_bbb374b17fb6fe75198cb74e274daae7.text: Esos policías perros nos pidieron una mordida.
sense_bbb374b17fb6fe75198cb74e274daae7.translation: Those lowlife cops asked us for a bribe.

sense_bbb374b17fb6fe75198cb74e274daae7.text: La compañera de Ricardo es bien perra; siempre lo pone en evidencia frente a la jefa.
sense_bbb374b17fb6fe75198cb74e274daae7.translation: Ricardo's coworker is a piece of garbage; she always calls him out in front of their boss.

sense_8f6c9d049cd1111334c869812547dc9b.text: ¿Es tuyo el carro que está bloqueando el mío?
sense_8f6c9d049cd1111334c869812547dc9b.translation: Is that car that's blocking mine yours?

sense_8f6c9d049cd1111334c869812547dc9b.text: ¿Esta pulsera es tuya? La encontré en el piso.
sense_8f6c9d049cd1111334c869812547dc9b.translation: Is this bracelet yours? I found it on the floor.

sense_ca612ed5e59475f05b2442f9eaa05329.text: Esta copa de vino es mía. La tuya está en la mesa.
sense_ca612ed5e59475f05b2442f9eaa05329.translation: This glass of wine is mine. Yours is on the table.

sense_013014e93f2a244da84c4d626a50650d.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_013014e93f2a244da84c4d626a50650d.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_013014e93f2a244da84c4d626a50650d.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_013014e93f2a244da84c4d626a50650d.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_c1c571608543a7e16801c3f2403c7dd0.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_c1c571608543a7e16801c3f2403c7dd0.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_c1c571608543a7e16801c3f2403c7dd0.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_c1c571608543a7e16801c3f2403c7dd0.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_f99147ad052aa12c93c2d5ed5eb9bc36.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_f99147ad052aa12c93c2d5ed5eb9bc36.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_5110d73981029639477658f52a89dfb6.text: Mi jefe es un sargento. Se pasa el día mangoneándonos.
sense_5110d73981029639477658f52a89dfb6.translation: My boss is a tyrant. He won't stop bossing us around all day.

sense_5110d73981029639477658f52a89dfb6.text: No soy un sargento; solo quiero que todo esté perfecto.
sense_5110d73981029639477658f52a89dfb6.translation: I'm not a tyrant; I just want everything to be perfect.

sense_78e20a2842a2b48dc366c012f7b2dc78.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_e8ab20de25ce66dd9a4477fbfc7339ad.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_e8ab20de25ce66dd9a4477fbfc7339ad.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_e8ab20de25ce66dd9a4477fbfc7339ad.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_e8ab20de25ce66dd9a4477fbfc7339ad.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_2903d83c650dcf1049dd014c9ea7eba4.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_2903d83c650dcf1049dd014c9ea7eba4.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_2903d83c650dcf1049dd014c9ea7eba4.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_2903d83c650dcf1049dd014c9ea7eba4.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_42df3801f750bbfba5aae1099810d171.text: Es importante no perder el contacto con la realidad.
sense_42df3801f750bbfba5aae1099810d171.translation: It's important not to lose touch with reality.

sense_42df3801f750bbfba5aae1099810d171.text: Nuestro hijo adoptivo quiere ponerse en contacto con su madre biológica.
sense_42df3801f750bbfba5aae1099810d171.translation: Our adopted son wants to get in touch with his biological mother.

sense_465c2a9182946ae67a035e82a28bbb53.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_465c2a9182946ae67a035e82a28bbb53.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_465c2a9182946ae67a035e82a28bbb53.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_465c2a9182946ae67a035e82a28bbb53.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_8e0b91456af014970fb8983536d9834e.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_8e0b91456af014970fb8983536d9834e.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_8e0b91456af014970fb8983536d9834e.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_8e0b91456af014970fb8983536d9834e.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_d7edc309828d0efed5c06c0a83fe3677.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_d7edc309828d0efed5c06c0a83fe3677.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_2908a08ccdd47c7ea3f1c970e3c501e5.text: Cuanto más trabaja, más rico se hace.
sense_2908a08ccdd47c7ea3f1c970e3c501e5.translation: The more he works, the richer he gets.
The more he gets, the more he wants.

sense_98958de27700697755af4f1dee45207c.translation: So many people have come to the party!
It's taken you ages to get here!

sense_438245d346a9d534c50a912e06589939.text: ¡Cuánto quiero que me lleves a ese restaurante de nuevo!
sense_438245d346a9d534c50a912e06589939.translation: I want you to take me back to that restaurant so badly!

sense_c331d82387da04ff69106a2002f957a0.text: Después de pasar el invierno encerrado, Leonel había echado carnes.
sense_c331d82387da04ff69106a2002f957a0.translation: After spending the winter indoors, Leonel had put on a lot of weight.

sense_c331d82387da04ff69106a2002f957a0.text: Luz quiere estar de pocas carnes para lucir bien en su nuevo bikini.
sense_c331d82387da04ff69106a2002f957a0.translation: Luz wants to be skinny to look good in her new bikini.

sense_fdc00b386d508ebce0e83a9a4374377b.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_fdc00b386d508ebce0e83a9a4374377b.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_b922e5768cf64910ef18fc1e53c3ed53.text: Este año voy a correr la maratón.
sense_b922e5768cf64910ef18fc1e53c3ed53.translation: I'm running the marathon this year.

sense_24ae9610a186fbba521350df6deddba0.text: Ese cuadro de Van Gogh es hermoso.
sense_24ae9610a186fbba521350df6deddba0.translation: That Van Gogh painting is beautiful.

sense_24ae9610a186fbba521350df6deddba0.text: Es hermoso cómo el paisaje se une con el mar al amanecer.
sense_24ae9610a186fbba521350df6deddba0.translation: It's beautiful how the landscape meets the sea at dawn.

sense_71773366b5ae53b90dfb995e715f994c.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_71773366b5ae53b90dfb995e715f994c.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_71773366b5ae53b90dfb995e715f994c.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_71773366b5ae53b90dfb995e715f994c.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_a73886caa2e26cff602380af388b3d77.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_a73886caa2e26cff602380af388b3d77.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_126d393dbd19d66f6961235034edaa1d.text: Es la catedrática del departamento de historia.
sense_126d393dbd19d66f6961235034edaa1d.translation: She's head of the History Department.

sense_126d393dbd19d66f6961235034edaa1d.text: Me han trasladado al departamento de mercadeo.
sense_126d393dbd19d66f6961235034edaa1d.translation: I've been transferred to the marketing department.

sense_a9d2ca6a581ad79c4d5bb834a56ea198.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_a9d2ca6a581ad79c4d5bb834a56ea198.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_a9d2ca6a581ad79c4d5bb834a56ea198.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_a9d2ca6a581ad79c4d5bb834a56ea198.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_48a10168671d8c9d60f8ce2586bbea6b.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_48a10168671d8c9d60f8ce2586bbea6b.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_48a10168671d8c9d60f8ce2586bbea6b.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_48a10168671d8c9d60f8ce2586bbea6b.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_34b997376de0961633ef5255e57908f4.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_84ac1d216306377328b0dfeef4327078.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_84ac1d216306377328b0dfeef4327078.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_84ac1d216306377328b0dfeef4327078.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_84ac1d216306377328b0dfeef4327078.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_eb3068541a0bef52f267c20e1abcf316.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_eb3068541a0bef52f267c20e1abcf316.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_eb3068541a0bef52f267c20e1abcf316.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_eb3068541a0bef52f267c20e1abcf316.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_303824c24fd3758166ffaaa299ea0138.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_303824c24fd3758166ffaaa299ea0138.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_303824c24fd3758166ffaaa299ea0138.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_303824c24fd3758166ffaaa299ea0138.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_ae62b0de0c5570932ad960b8ee92e9d8.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_ae62b0de0c5570932ad960b8ee92e9d8.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_ae62b0de0c5570932ad960b8ee92e9d8.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_ae62b0de0c5570932ad960b8ee92e9d8.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_13b74ed7a9d2ee2c2c9cb388fdb83a8f.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_13b74ed7a9d2ee2c2c9cb388fdb83a8f.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_27356039f4485546ad95dce829182199.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_27356039f4485546ad95dce829182199.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_27356039f4485546ad95dce829182199.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_27356039f4485546ad95dce829182199.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_c25879297d1b51d92313a5c8a97a6106.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_c25879297d1b51d92313a5c8a97a6106.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_c25879297d1b51d92313a5c8a97a6106.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_c25879297d1b51d92313a5c8a97a6106.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_ce1e4913eae05bcc14e14ab1e27467b1.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_657f2da726d12cefa676033b8bac4aee.text: La peli era malísima; solo se salvaba el actor principal.
sense_657f2da726d12cefa676033b8bac4aee.translation: The film was really bad; the main actor was the only one who was ok.

sense_657f2da726d12cefa676033b8bac4aee.text: Los considero a todos unos vagos; no se salva nadie.
sense_657f2da726d12cefa676033b8bac4aee.translation: I consider them all lazy, without exception.

sense_f11b0f5d7225ebb5838a700107854784.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_f11b0f5d7225ebb5838a700107854784.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_12ef3d2da2f32058b6ed59fd869ddde2.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_12ef3d2da2f32058b6ed59fd869ddde2.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_12ef3d2da2f32058b6ed59fd869ddde2.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_12ef3d2da2f32058b6ed59fd869ddde2.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_5bee77c48be9efc63c25fb8a950ed53d.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_5bee77c48be9efc63c25fb8a950ed53d.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_5bee77c48be9efc63c25fb8a950ed53d.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_5bee77c48be9efc63c25fb8a950ed53d.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_59181f0f15fa61b968956e2d14a3dc6d.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_59181f0f15fa61b968956e2d14a3dc6d.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_c201bd7260bab1ee37b9749926288acf.text: El libro santo de los judíos es la Tora.
sense_c201bd7260bab1ee37b9749926288acf.translation: The holy book of the Jewish people is the Torah.

sense_c201bd7260bab1ee37b9749926288acf.text: Dicen que el sótano de la catedral está lleno de reliquias santas.
sense_c201bd7260bab1ee37b9749926288acf.translation: They say that the basement of the cathedral is full of holy relics.

sense_d28189f21da03b5e0235c46675162283.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_67577e401a9247bb26b48ce3d0df4194.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_67577e401a9247bb26b48ce3d0df4194.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_f6e06af6889e0bfc40c0c0193897999a.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_f6e06af6889e0bfc40c0c0193897999a.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_f6e06af6889e0bfc40c0c0193897999a.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_f6e06af6889e0bfc40c0c0193897999a.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_ee768845effbf9bace21ce81fa257af9.translation: I was sorry to see her looking so pale.

sense_ee768845effbf9bace21ce81fa257af9.text: Nos apena mucho tener que informarles de que el concierto de hoy ya no tendrá lugar.
sense_ee768845effbf9bace21ce81fa257af9.translation: We're very sorry to have to inform you that today's concert will not now take place.

sense_afeab58a5570148ec6ffda8c34e90c1f.text: ¿Con quién diablo te crees que hablas?
sense_afeab58a5570148ec6ffda8c34e90c1f.translation: Who on earth do you think you're talking to?
How the hell do you know that?

sense_cf2edece3b106eab16c730a1be6b6ea8.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_cf2edece3b106eab16c730a1be6b6ea8.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_cf2edece3b106eab16c730a1be6b6ea8.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_cf2edece3b106eab16c730a1be6b6ea8.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_2c5814e66721425ac64aed6dbc437cf3.text: El tribunal decretó el embargo de su casa.
sense_2c5814e66721425ac64aed6dbc437cf3.translation: The court ordered the seizure of her house.

sense_2c5814e66721425ac64aed6dbc437cf3.text: La compañía fue amenazada con el embargo de sus bienes.
sense_2c5814e66721425ac64aed6dbc437cf3.translation: The company was threatened with the seizure of its property.

sense_b7d1ae091c08a47c7911a45060e26bd4.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_b7d1ae091c08a47c7911a45060e26bd4.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_5fdb5c9bcf3d683bf1699af4335f9be7.text: Todos los estudiantes del grupo son muy capaces.
sense_5fdb5c9bcf3d683bf1699af4335f9be7.translation: All the students in the group are very able.

sense_5fdb5c9bcf3d683bf1699af4335f9be7.text: Es sorprendente que sea capaz de levantarme todos los días a las cinco de la mañana para ir a trabajar.
sense_5fdb5c9bcf3d683bf1699af4335f9be7.translation: It's surprising that I'm able to get up every day at five in the morning to go to work.

sense_961f08dd955be54168158e488b25af71.text: ¡Dime tonto otra vez si eres capaz!
sense_961f08dd955be54168158e488b25af71.translation: Call me a fool again if you dare!

sense_961f08dd955be54168158e488b25af71.text: Miguel no fue capaz de decirle al público lo que verdaderamente creía.
sense_961f08dd955be54168158e488b25af71.translation: Miguel could not bring himself to tell the audience what he really believed.

sense_c075aef04097f51c1d68a75ba48b4fb5.text: Aún no llegó; capaz que esté en un atasco.
sense_c075aef04097f51c1d68a75ba48b4fb5.translation: He's not here yet; he could be stuck in traffic.

sense_c075aef04097f51c1d68a75ba48b4fb5.text: Capaz que nieve con el frío que está haciendo.
sense_c075aef04097f51c1d68a75ba48b4fb5.translation: It might snow with this cold weather.

sense_5e6c4474d8b0660a6d99d478509c853f.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_8e9d7fdc629d28f08bcf25358f88ad12.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_8e9d7fdc629d28f08bcf25358f88ad12.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_8e9d7fdc629d28f08bcf25358f88ad12.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_8e9d7fdc629d28f08bcf25358f88ad12.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_4d4e06fda457d3002e368b6a27c6b77e.text: Me carga que siempre la escojan a ella.
sense_4d4e06fda457d3002e368b6a27c6b77e.translation: It gets on my nerves that they always choose her.

sense_4d4e06fda457d3002e368b6a27c6b77e.text: Me carga tener que aguantar la novia de mi hermano.
sense_4d4e06fda457d3002e368b6a27c6b77e.translation: I can't stand having to put up with my brother's girlfriend.

sense_d362606e7cf8a03508cca40a31e8e94f.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_d362606e7cf8a03508cca40a31e8e94f.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_d0d197eb33004af10adec1557cd6bae8.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_d0d197eb33004af10adec1557cd6bae8.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_d0d197eb33004af10adec1557cd6bae8.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_d0d197eb33004af10adec1557cd6bae8.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_9a2b97eaadd004561fe4e6da86dca3d1.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_9a2b97eaadd004561fe4e6da86dca3d1.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_6508c4af41cf21caba1a29a2301987f1.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_6508c4af41cf21caba1a29a2301987f1.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_178619c0706c1e5c10147190b30bb302.text: La ropa de corte boho me llama la atención.
sense_178619c0706c1e5c10147190b30bb302.translation: I think boho-style clothing is very striking.

sense_178619c0706c1e5c10147190b30bb302.text: Le gustan los muebles de corte modernista.

sense_a6acafd69c43e98d10b5890391117a45.text: Menudo corte; no me lo esperaba.
sense_a6acafd69c43e98d10b5890391117a45.translation: He practically bit my head off; I wasn't expecting that.

sense_a6acafd69c43e98d10b5890391117a45.text: ¡Vaya corte que me dio la actriz cuando le pedí su autógrafo!
sense_a6acafd69c43e98d10b5890391117a45.translation: The actress practically snapped my head off when I asked her for her autograph.

sense_509eaaaf535ccc7bb4315711b1490e3c.text: ¡Qué corte estar desnuda delante del médico!
sense_509eaaaf535ccc7bb4315711b1490e3c.translation: How embarrassing being naked in front of the doctor!

sense_509eaaaf535ccc7bb4315711b1490e3c.text: Es un corte estar con gente cuando se muestran escenas de sexo en la tele.
sense_509eaaaf535ccc7bb4315711b1490e3c.translation: It's embarrassing to have other people there when there are sex scenes on television.

sense_cb4f1ee78d7cd7032a59c09d9ca1ce53.text: El gobierno se equivocó con esta medida.
sense_cb4f1ee78d7cd7032a59c09d9ca1ce53.translation: The government got it wrong with this policy.

sense_cb4f1ee78d7cd7032a59c09d9ca1ce53.text: La empresa reconoce que se equivocó con su respuesta.
sense_cb4f1ee78d7cd7032a59c09d9ca1ce53.translation: The company recognizes that it got its response wrong.

sense_8c27900cedd7e8d7efe4406232bf57a5.text: Mi madre se equivocó de tren y, por consiguiente, no llegó aquí hasta la una de la madrugada.
sense_8c27900cedd7e8d7efe4406232bf57a5.translation: My mother got on the wrong train and, as a result, she didn't get here till one in the morning.

sense_8c27900cedd7e8d7efe4406232bf57a5.text: Te equivocaste de mes. El cumpleaños de Fernando es el dos de julio y no el dos de junio.
sense_8c27900cedd7e8d7efe4406232bf57a5.translation: You got the month wrong. Fernando's birthday is the second of July not the second of June.

sense_d6bdf8557bf4c2fb1c7898b24c990a5f.translation: Hey, listen! Don't take any notice of him.
Come on! Don't let me down now.

sense_5801102e976fa134c91e1e4d01cd21ad.text: Te apuesto que no lloverá el día de tu boda; no te preocupes.
sense_5801102e976fa134c91e1e4d01cd21ad.translation: I bet you that it won't rain on your wedding day; don't worry.

sense_5801102e976fa134c91e1e4d01cd21ad.text: Te apuesto $15 a que no eres capaz de encestar la pelota diez veces seguidas.
sense_5801102e976fa134c91e1e4d01cd21ad.translation: I'll bet you $15 that you can't sink the ball ten times in a row.

sense_13df94a9f68de563e6a2e3b4ede885f3.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_13df94a9f68de563e6a2e3b4ede885f3.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_0021a52e79b028ed1001d93fc024655e.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_0021a52e79b028ed1001d93fc024655e.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_0021a52e79b028ed1001d93fc024655e.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_0021a52e79b028ed1001d93fc024655e.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_3c48324a2abb17aa448b92c1c20e3ec7.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_3c48324a2abb17aa448b92c1c20e3ec7.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_6d3591fc169b5fee49493c1bb0b313b7.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_6d3591fc169b5fee49493c1bb0b313b7.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_6d3591fc169b5fee49493c1bb0b313b7.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_6d3591fc169b5fee49493c1bb0b313b7.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_83a75c1ef8b199ea2f0d7f5286ddb539.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_83a75c1ef8b199ea2f0d7f5286ddb539.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_83a75c1ef8b199ea2f0d7f5286ddb539.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_83a75c1ef8b199ea2f0d7f5286ddb539.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_f74dd11ed5107808958770390c2ab589.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_f74dd11ed5107808958770390c2ab589.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_9515af479a70390971d16a53bd99c8bd.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_9515af479a70390971d16a53bd99c8bd.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_9515af479a70390971d16a53bd99c8bd.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_9515af479a70390971d16a53bd99c8bd.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_3eab98b10acf1d2a51570e9dba807723.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_3eab98b10acf1d2a51570e9dba807723.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_b3f29b76dbc6379e10cc9db5307677c6.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_b3f29b76dbc6379e10cc9db5307677c6.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_a23fa7bffbcaf8f6b0376b8f69b1a9d4.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_a23fa7bffbcaf8f6b0376b8f69b1a9d4.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_a23fa7bffbcaf8f6b0376b8f69b1a9d4.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_a23fa7bffbcaf8f6b0376b8f69b1a9d4.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_9c24d7825f7d795e3ea83af43893c8a6.text: Me parece que el ministro debería dimitir.
sense_9c24d7825f7d795e3ea83af43893c8a6.translation: I think the minister should resign.

sense_9c24d7825f7d795e3ea83af43893c8a6.text: ¿Qué te pareció la serie sobre la familia real? - Me pareció una tontería.
sense_9c24d7825f7d795e3ea83af43893c8a6.translation: What did you think of the series about the royal family? - I thought it was nonsense.

sense_83c81928211670981421fa0acc26697e.text: Se fue sin explicación y me partió el corazón.
sense_83c81928211670981421fa0acc26697e.translation: She left without explanation and broke my heart.

sense_83c81928211670981421fa0acc26697e.text: Le dijeron que si no pagaba la deuda, le iban a partir las piernas.
sense_83c81928211670981421fa0acc26697e.translation: They told him that if he didn't pay the debt, they were going to break his legs.

sense_57adba029d999ebed187108558775d86.text: Ya casi llegas. Estás muy cerca. ¡Caliente, caliente!
sense_57adba029d999ebed187108558775d86.translation: You're almost there. You're really close. You're getting warm!

sense_b38edea66e27b4734af7e64f3a0093c3.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_b38edea66e27b4734af7e64f3a0093c3.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_5293f003eb6f5f9eb0ac7a56d92b0723.text: ¿Cuántas hay? - Deben de ser unas cuantas mil.
sense_5293f003eb6f5f9eb0ac7a56d92b0723.translation: How many are there? - There must be several thousand.

sense_5293f003eb6f5f9eb0ac7a56d92b0723.text: Miles de personas acudieron al acto.
sense_5293f003eb6f5f9eb0ac7a56d92b0723.translation: Thousands of people attended the event.

sense_ca1337ef29be42a547e431fbcceb0e0b.text: No permiten el uso de celulares inteligentes en el museo.
sense_ca1337ef29be42a547e431fbcceb0e0b.translation: They don't allow smart phones in the museum.

sense_ca1337ef29be42a547e431fbcceb0e0b.text: El nuevo edificio inteligente en el centro usa la mitad de la energía de un edificio normal.
sense_ca1337ef29be42a547e431fbcceb0e0b.translation: The new smart building downtown uses half of the energy of a regular building.

sense_ff75ec46a1fee6b530701edb719f25ac.text: "No hay nada que temer", dijo el mago.
sense_ff75ec46a1fee6b530701edb719f25ac.translation: "There's nothing to fear," said the magician.

sense_ff75ec46a1fee6b530701edb719f25ac.text: "Yo no le temo a la muerte", dijo el temerario motociclista.
sense_ff75ec46a1fee6b530701edb719f25ac.translation: "I don't fear death," said the daredevil motorcyclist.

sense_ec25553d552c9324f9733f294c7787af.text: La culpa es tuya. - ¿Mía? ¡Hay que joderse! ¡Pero si yo ni siquiera estaba aquí!
sense_ec25553d552c9324f9733f294c7787af.translation: It's your fault. - My fault? For fuck's sake! But I wasn't even here!

sense_ec25553d552c9324f9733f294c7787af.text: No me dejaron ustedes nada de comida. - ¡Te jodes! Es tu culpa por llegar tarde.
sense_ec25553d552c9324f9733f294c7787af.translation: You didn't leave any food for me. - Tough shit! It's your fault for being late.

sense_7af72745c086ade2e0683eaeca3c6fbc.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_7af72745c086ade2e0683eaeca3c6fbc.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_360e0f3abb1ee1067b5b0f7b2972778d.text: En mi sueño, los dinosaurios todavía vagaban por la tierra.
sense_360e0f3abb1ee1067b5b0f7b2972778d.translation: In my dream, dinosaurs still roamed the Earth.

sense_360e0f3abb1ee1067b5b0f7b2972778d.text: Él es tan despistado; es como si viviera en un sueño.
sense_360e0f3abb1ee1067b5b0f7b2972778d.translation: He's so absent-minded; it's as if he lives in a dream.

sense_580b2ac2e568a1b69fcc24cdacbfc5b9.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_580b2ac2e568a1b69fcc24cdacbfc5b9.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_580b2ac2e568a1b69fcc24cdacbfc5b9.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_580b2ac2e568a1b69fcc24cdacbfc5b9.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_544ce8a7d717f222e640c13000358f5d.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_544ce8a7d717f222e640c13000358f5d.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_5092e0fa44c16ebda39c8ee76cdec797.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_5092e0fa44c16ebda39c8ee76cdec797.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_e0b83904c89a163c5125539767fa066d.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_6e4e253c4a401fe27ca47d306544e47c.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_6e4e253c4a401fe27ca47d306544e47c.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_6e4e253c4a401fe27ca47d306544e47c.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_6e4e253c4a401fe27ca47d306544e47c.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_7b883eece41a4a320c3ffef2cacc6c81.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_7b883eece41a4a320c3ffef2cacc6c81.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_7b883eece41a4a320c3ffef2cacc6c81.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_7b883eece41a4a320c3ffef2cacc6c81.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_21749cadbcaca23a7ecfe3f7e91caef4.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_21749cadbcaca23a7ecfe3f7e91caef4.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_485e5d3f34e98d01a94737d920d54160.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_485e5d3f34e98d01a94737d920d54160.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_485e5d3f34e98d01a94737d920d54160.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_485e5d3f34e98d01a94737d920d54160.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_3844b616e876963f3dcd3362ac827be4.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_3844b616e876963f3dcd3362ac827be4.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_3844b616e876963f3dcd3362ac827be4.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_3844b616e876963f3dcd3362ac827be4.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_4de2f23d54443ad4f70ce8b578e4692d.text: Me encanta observar la salida de las estrellas en una noche despejada.
sense_4de2f23d54443ad4f70ce8b578e4692d.translation: I love watching the stars come out on a clear night.

sense_4de2f23d54443ad4f70ce8b578e4692d.text: Esa salida del sol que vimos en Grecia fue la más hermosa que he visto en mi vida.
sense_4de2f23d54443ad4f70ce8b578e4692d.translation: That sunrise that we saw in Greece was the most beautiful I have ever seen.

sense_2fbb6e1466c122d04ddf201efc542140.text: Siempre nos partimos de risa con las salidas de Samu.
sense_2fbb6e1466c122d04ddf201efc542140.translation: Samu always cracks up with the hilarious things he says.
She comes out with some really funny things.

sense_d76a6030fb13e9a7253dfd146b2a1d49.text: El alumno escribió su ensayo de 20 páginas en una noche.
sense_d76a6030fb13e9a7253dfd146b2a1d49.translation: The student wrote his 20-page essay in one night.

sense_047313055d0ef18da5c5085675f1fd13.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_047313055d0ef18da5c5085675f1fd13.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_047313055d0ef18da5c5085675f1fd13.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_047313055d0ef18da5c5085675f1fd13.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_1868b1ab6ab8ae84fb91da56e49be9f1.text: Leer un libro es perderse en otro mundo.
sense_1868b1ab6ab8ae84fb91da56e49be9f1.translation: To read a book is to get lost in another world.

sense_1868b1ab6ab8ae84fb91da56e49be9f1.text: Esperamos una hora para que el autor firmara nuestra copia de su libro.
sense_1868b1ab6ab8ae84fb91da56e49be9f1.translation: We waited an hour for the author to sign our copy of his book.

sense_c4935444fe291f4327876c9296f6fa2b.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_c4935444fe291f4327876c9296f6fa2b.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_28b00d57ae4db4e1a2e8c8e2f618af3e.text: Si corrieras más, estarías en mejor forma.
sense_28b00d57ae4db4e1a2e8c8e2f618af3e.translation: If you ran more, you'd be in better shape.

sense_28b00d57ae4db4e1a2e8c8e2f618af3e.text: Gaby se ha mantenido en buena forma corriendo todos los días al levantarse.
sense_28b00d57ae4db4e1a2e8c8e2f618af3e.translation: Gaby has kept fit by running every morning when she gets up.

sense_4ee716f43fa7a8e25331c74b136a0453.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_4ee716f43fa7a8e25331c74b136a0453.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_4ee716f43fa7a8e25331c74b136a0453.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_4ee716f43fa7a8e25331c74b136a0453.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_e29d95ff34143bea606beb1f0a36d011.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_e29d95ff34143bea606beb1f0a36d011.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_298d55b9616dc9665ae3b69f7f839569.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_298d55b9616dc9665ae3b69f7f839569.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_8d65370414250d50bc07387c50ea527f.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_8d65370414250d50bc07387c50ea527f.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_8d65370414250d50bc07387c50ea527f.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_8d65370414250d50bc07387c50ea527f.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_808055fe1c158235d0f0325192650bb3.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_bec0c493a64a398f3da84eb7e193d5de.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_bec0c493a64a398f3da84eb7e193d5de.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_bec0c493a64a398f3da84eb7e193d5de.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_bec0c493a64a398f3da84eb7e193d5de.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_6c9a1c664006d925c019439318640921.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_6c9a1c664006d925c019439318640921.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_6c9a1c664006d925c019439318640921.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_6c9a1c664006d925c019439318640921.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_9cfa9a4b08278dc8b389e0156bf04244.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_9cfa9a4b08278dc8b389e0156bf04244.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_527dfb0412d5dbb99867949e79ecac0f.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_ec08989019ecd4db325b97dd7f7b6f5e.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_ec08989019ecd4db325b97dd7f7b6f5e.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_ec08989019ecd4db325b97dd7f7b6f5e.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_ec08989019ecd4db325b97dd7f7b6f5e.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_691b823176ca487ccead43ec8fdf299f.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_691b823176ca487ccead43ec8fdf299f.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_aa8325e4d8639a5e4fe94f8bb78f766b.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_aa8325e4d8639a5e4fe94f8bb78f766b.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_aa8325e4d8639a5e4fe94f8bb78f766b.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_aa8325e4d8639a5e4fe94f8bb78f766b.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_8404991160f07d0168fc26d45534f3b3.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_8404991160f07d0168fc26d45534f3b3.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_8404991160f07d0168fc26d45534f3b3.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_8404991160f07d0168fc26d45534f3b3.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_734813415e139d16c63e2587b0df9a04.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_ec3856e4d0d590ffd53a7eb5f1e445b3.text: Podría ayudarlo pero no me da la gana.
sense_ec3856e4d0d590ffd53a7eb5f1e445b3.translation: I could help him but I don't feel like it.

sense_ec3856e4d0d590ffd53a7eb5f1e445b3.text: Quiero cumplir 18, trabajar y ganar mi propio dinero para comprar lo que me dé mi regalada gana.
sense_ec3856e4d0d590ffd53a7eb5f1e445b3.translation: I want to turn 18, get a job, and have my own money to buy whatever I damn well please.

sense_0ea78e5e446536b0a90e6b6fd12d2aa1.text: Me dan ganas de ir a las montañas.
sense_0ea78e5e446536b0a90e6b6fd12d2aa1.translation: I feel like going to the mountains.

sense_0ea78e5e446536b0a90e6b6fd12d2aa1.text: ¡Qué ganas tengo de salir a bailar!
sense_0ea78e5e446536b0a90e6b6fd12d2aa1.translation: I can't wait to go out dancing!

sense_19e129270e807247aa42fb0fbca2dba0.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_19e129270e807247aa42fb0fbca2dba0.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_19e129270e807247aa42fb0fbca2dba0.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_19e129270e807247aa42fb0fbca2dba0.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_92f73f2ba724e1982276789cccb877ea.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_92f73f2ba724e1982276789cccb877ea.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_92f73f2ba724e1982276789cccb877ea.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_92f73f2ba724e1982276789cccb877ea.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_192c730a253a7e728b11353b842e81f8.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_192c730a253a7e728b11353b842e81f8.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_192c730a253a7e728b11353b842e81f8.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_192c730a253a7e728b11353b842e81f8.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_15d340b33b62fe0f26e2b731af8e7521.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_15d340b33b62fe0f26e2b731af8e7521.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_15d340b33b62fe0f26e2b731af8e7521.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_15d340b33b62fe0f26e2b731af8e7521.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_ce49afe96c733365271630f37276a5f2.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_ce49afe96c733365271630f37276a5f2.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_ce49afe96c733365271630f37276a5f2.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_ce49afe96c733365271630f37276a5f2.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_b60ed31114d55701cc0d7600003de636.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_c3bdec08675d6b7099a0f94d49f4dd1e.text: La comida maravillosa del restaurante se une a la decoración modernista lujosa.
sense_c3bdec08675d6b7099a0f94d49f4dd1e.translation: The restaurant's fantastic food is complemented by their luxurious modernist decor.

sense_c3bdec08675d6b7099a0f94d49f4dd1e.text: Ese tipo es un trabajador fantástico. En él se unen la confianza y la habilidad.
sense_c3bdec08675d6b7099a0f94d49f4dd1e.translation: That guy's a fantastic worker. He's the epitome of confidence and skill.

sense_e80f34edf9a3fffd0e097c574ae7dcb6.text: ¿Acaso no te acuerdas que te toca pagar?
sense_e80f34edf9a3fffd0e097c574ae7dcb6.translation: I guess you've forgotten it's your turn to pay, have you?

sense_e80f34edf9a3fffd0e097c574ae7dcb6.text: ¿Acaso no es la guerra la industria más poderosa?
sense_e80f34edf9a3fffd0e097c574ae7dcb6.translation: Isn't war the most powerful industry?

sense_ec962790d77faa414c5f06f562760067.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_ec962790d77faa414c5f06f562760067.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_2ae4df1049c357d769a73b867dcd009d.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_2ae4df1049c357d769a73b867dcd009d.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_1e2ac5f560288fa815f30ce8790c9abc.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_1e2ac5f560288fa815f30ce8790c9abc.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_1e2ac5f560288fa815f30ce8790c9abc.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_1e2ac5f560288fa815f30ce8790c9abc.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_b452f678a359af11763886a169ffb4ac.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_b452f678a359af11763886a169ffb4ac.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_cca36e0f2bb5ebfe0fbdcdef6dc2944f.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_cca36e0f2bb5ebfe0fbdcdef6dc2944f.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_829b20716e09eb0d588c52144fee80e3.text: Aquel coche estacionado allá es mío.
sense_829b20716e09eb0d588c52144fee80e3.translation: That car parked over there is mine.

sense_829b20716e09eb0d588c52144fee80e3.text: Me gusta mucho aquella casa que hay en lo alto de la colina.
sense_829b20716e09eb0d588c52144fee80e3.translation: I really like that house on top of the hill.

sense_a82f968a96a368163c9526307949eb61.text: No sé tú pero yo prefiero aquel.
sense_a82f968a96a368163c9526307949eb61.translation: I don't know about you but I prefer that one.

sense_a82f968a96a368163c9526307949eb61.text: Aquella es más grande que esta.
sense_a82f968a96a368163c9526307949eb61.translation: That one is bigger than this one.

sense_fc6ef12ac390c825061ef3ee7912ca09.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_fc6ef12ac390c825061ef3ee7912ca09.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_fc6ef12ac390c825061ef3ee7912ca09.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_fc6ef12ac390c825061ef3ee7912ca09.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_d454ea4694831a08939e6f5bd41c41db.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_d454ea4694831a08939e6f5bd41c41db.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_d343def6bd614b67636f7a0316095f97.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_d343def6bd614b67636f7a0316095f97.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_d343def6bd614b67636f7a0316095f97.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_d343def6bd614b67636f7a0316095f97.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_3a3dea4f8ba5e47accbe9ddf5e0432a0.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_3a3dea4f8ba5e47accbe9ddf5e0432a0.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_5004ee677d18d0a6cc777e6319959a0a.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_5004ee677d18d0a6cc777e6319959a0a.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_cdb91c1670caf7d3e72b4b57d5294528.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_cdb91c1670caf7d3e72b4b57d5294528.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_8d28437e1fe665f3b5927950d9cc4f60.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_8d28437e1fe665f3b5927950d9cc4f60.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_8d28437e1fe665f3b5927950d9cc4f60.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_8d28437e1fe665f3b5927950d9cc4f60.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_6a26178616e0836dd2586e7042a62c26.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_6a26178616e0836dd2586e7042a62c26.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_726d0931e1b78586ba7b668f35ea7657.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_726d0931e1b78586ba7b668f35ea7657.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_f9454d4256a31a978e3fb099fd6e1f2b.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_f9454d4256a31a978e3fb099fd6e1f2b.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_c7c89791616a816211947e988145e579.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_c7c89791616a816211947e988145e579.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_c7c89791616a816211947e988145e579.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_c7c89791616a816211947e988145e579.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_39de4024934c24662badc46c92443278.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_39de4024934c24662badc46c92443278.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_ba41c9e4c3c4d0ca713990bc952efa5d.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_53f1e921a563480a4040944f456094cd.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_53f1e921a563480a4040944f456094cd.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_53f1e921a563480a4040944f456094cd.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_53f1e921a563480a4040944f456094cd.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_d6c625f352721d2cd19671227e1462ba.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_d6c625f352721d2cd19671227e1462ba.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_d6c625f352721d2cd19671227e1462ba.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_d6c625f352721d2cd19671227e1462ba.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_9136e64d56ca56117a89f97632c0a5fb.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_9136e64d56ca56117a89f97632c0a5fb.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_0eeca3b59c990d7987e748f1ff301702.text: La cirugía es la única esperanza que nos queda.
sense_0eeca3b59c990d7987e748f1ff301702.translation: Surgery is the only hope we have left.

sense_0eeca3b59c990d7987e748f1ff301702.text: Tú eres nuestra última esperanza de ganar.
sense_0eeca3b59c990d7987e748f1ff301702.translation: You're our last hope of winning.

sense_33d68f1d5c1a33931faa8363bcbd7f02.text: La doctora no esperanzó al paciente porque algo podría salir mal.
sense_33d68f1d5c1a33931faa8363bcbd7f02.translation: The doctor didn't get her patient's hopes up because it was possible something could go wrong.

sense_33d68f1d5c1a33931faa8363bcbd7f02.text: El hecho de que un señor de 70 años pueda escalar el Everest debería esperanzar a todos los mayores de 60 años.
sense_33d68f1d5c1a33931faa8363bcbd7f02.translation: The fact that a 70-year-old man can climb Everest should give hope to all over-60s.

sense_8f7d5a2b59db3c37e099ff60e0ea2adb.text: En lo que respecta al servicio, no recibimos ninguna queja.
sense_8f7d5a2b59db3c37e099ff60e0ea2adb.translation: With regard to the service, we haven't received any complaints.

sense_8f7d5a2b59db3c37e099ff60e0ea2adb.text: Por lo que a mí respecta, considero que esta información es suficiente.
sense_8f7d5a2b59db3c37e099ff60e0ea2adb.translation: As far as I'm concerned, I think information is sufficient.

sense_a89aa884239f2db2e86fd61368f75d29.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_a89aa884239f2db2e86fd61368f75d29.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_fd1e90037f7b81bf29d70e5135b4eef9.text: Me parece que el ministro debería dimitir.
sense_fd1e90037f7b81bf29d70e5135b4eef9.translation: I think the minister should resign.

sense_fd1e90037f7b81bf29d70e5135b4eef9.text: ¿Qué te pareció la serie sobre la familia real? - Me pareció una tontería.
sense_fd1e90037f7b81bf29d70e5135b4eef9.translation: What did you think of the series about the royal family? - I thought it was nonsense.

sense_498b1289636befb77fa49158ca90ed76.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_498b1289636befb77fa49158ca90ed76.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_498b1289636befb77fa49158ca90ed76.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_498b1289636befb77fa49158ca90ed76.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_a966cb9c90f7265738776f0a2af339c1.text: Las piezas se calientan y se sueldan.
sense_a966cb9c90f7265738776f0a2af339c1.translation: The parts are heated up and welded together.

sense_a966cb9c90f7265738776f0a2af339c1.text: Los circuitos se sueldan con estaño.
sense_a966cb9c90f7265738776f0a2af339c1.translation: The circuits are soldered together with solder.

sense_07ddea0ea77cd31e220b5b44928522e4.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_07ddea0ea77cd31e220b5b44928522e4.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_07ddea0ea77cd31e220b5b44928522e4.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_07ddea0ea77cd31e220b5b44928522e4.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_e0df14ad55a226d50bb9ca25e80739ba.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_e0df14ad55a226d50bb9ca25e80739ba.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_e0df14ad55a226d50bb9ca25e80739ba.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_e0df14ad55a226d50bb9ca25e80739ba.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_161de15b6fdab699e5a542d337366e3b.text: El saco de tu papá te hace bolsas.
sense_161de15b6fdab699e5a542d337366e3b.translation: Your father's coat looks baggy on you.

sense_161de15b6fdab699e5a542d337366e3b.text: Cuando te doblas así, se forman bolsas en tu vestido.
sense_161de15b6fdab699e5a542d337366e3b.translation: When you bend down like that, your dress bunches up.

sense_c572c1929a18c2f38dac9398052deff4.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_c572c1929a18c2f38dac9398052deff4.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_c572c1929a18c2f38dac9398052deff4.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_c572c1929a18c2f38dac9398052deff4.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_a19293c158cf72bf04b6362b3cc795c6.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_a19293c158cf72bf04b6362b3cc795c6.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_65080b57cb3660249510834c7762d067.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_65080b57cb3660249510834c7762d067.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_65080b57cb3660249510834c7762d067.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_65080b57cb3660249510834c7762d067.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_075d47f0884b5a69f2d9fe00e4c68acd.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_075d47f0884b5a69f2d9fe00e4c68acd.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_075d47f0884b5a69f2d9fe00e4c68acd.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_31e414d2b598dab8650112024614433a.text: La disciplina y el honor informan su naturaleza como soldado.
sense_31e414d2b598dab8650112024614433a.translation: He is a soldier who believes in discipline and honor.
Her silhouette hints at her beauty.

sense_4abf063d6e9bbdc0daf6dadaa208837b.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_865dd918d687e7f6f6e781cb6325e3fa.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_865dd918d687e7f6f6e781cb6325e3fa.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_865dd918d687e7f6f6e781cb6325e3fa.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_865dd918d687e7f6f6e781cb6325e3fa.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_a88bf02192dabea1f1bc099b03f08ad8.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_a88bf02192dabea1f1bc099b03f08ad8.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_a88bf02192dabea1f1bc099b03f08ad8.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_a88bf02192dabea1f1bc099b03f08ad8.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_7195cd5da0235a7f8cf83bf59e4c9451.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_7195cd5da0235a7f8cf83bf59e4c9451.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_d7f7c774c69fca4d0db201a76c2d9167.text: Las piezas se calientan y se sueldan.
sense_d7f7c774c69fca4d0db201a76c2d9167.translation: The parts are heated up and welded together.

sense_d7f7c774c69fca4d0db201a76c2d9167.text: Los circuitos se sueldan con estaño.
sense_d7f7c774c69fca4d0db201a76c2d9167.translation: The circuits are soldered together with solder.

sense_f2e9bf4cadac74a0feb7066e18c20cef.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_f2e9bf4cadac74a0feb7066e18c20cef.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_41757c4dcb959e59d57354da1b6dc56a.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_41757c4dcb959e59d57354da1b6dc56a.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_41757c4dcb959e59d57354da1b6dc56a.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_5c8136dca136c62e45a74c4d3cfe8c80.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_5c8136dca136c62e45a74c4d3cfe8c80.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.
