sense_5c8136dca136c62e45a74c4d3cfe8c80.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_1585abd28fdf6ddbb20a3f6c04e36284.text: Me gusta jugar al bingo por el dinero.
sense_1585abd28fdf6ddbb20a3f6c04e36284.translation: I love playing Bingo for money.
Does anybody want to play tennis with me?

sense_242c390b277d4718f4a8e9539e5fa3fc.text: Fue un trago para nosotros cuando se murió mi abuelo.
sense_242c390b277d4718f4a8e9539e5fa3fc.translation: It was a hard for us when my grandfather passed.

sense_242c390b277d4718f4a8e9539e5fa3fc.text: Vivir en una ciudad sin buena transportación pública fue un trago.
sense_242c390b277d4718f4a8e9539e5fa3fc.translation: Living in a city without good public transportation was terrible.

sense_f522ec80991005ceba8782badb7f1019.text: Enrique y sus amigos siempre están de marcha.
sense_f522ec80991005ceba8782badb7f1019.translation: Enrique and his friends are always out on the town.

sense_f522ec80991005ceba8782badb7f1019.text: Había mucha marcha en esa fiesta.
sense_f522ec80991005ceba8782badb7f1019.translation: That was a very lively party.

sense_eeaeceb0aea2de3e8bd89be4e56606d8.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_eeaeceb0aea2de3e8bd89be4e56606d8.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_58007bd0ba7b7b560bd45a6d88129c7f.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_58007bd0ba7b7b560bd45a6d88129c7f.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_58007bd0ba7b7b560bd45a6d88129c7f.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_58007bd0ba7b7b560bd45a6d88129c7f.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_f3418c2b26c78b769d6fc6d8ca29b274.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_f3418c2b26c78b769d6fc6d8ca29b274.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_09add601ba594771ea9d201319ddb034.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_09add601ba594771ea9d201319ddb034.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_9addb385d23ef3e8f6c59b76288f6d91.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_9addb385d23ef3e8f6c59b76288f6d91.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_9addb385d23ef3e8f6c59b76288f6d91.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_9addb385d23ef3e8f6c59b76288f6d91.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_bd248d96a51ec8b55f35c27f0566e4fb.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_bd248d96a51ec8b55f35c27f0566e4fb.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_bd248d96a51ec8b55f35c27f0566e4fb.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_bd248d96a51ec8b55f35c27f0566e4fb.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_074d946bdc0d7906aeb930d662d878f1.text: Ofrecemos un menú simple que le agrada al común de la gente.
sense_074d946bdc0d7906aeb930d662d878f1.translation: We offer a simple menu that pleases most people.

sense_074d946bdc0d7906aeb930d662d878f1.text: En diez años pasará al olvido, como el común de los actores secundarios.
sense_074d946bdc0d7906aeb930d662d878f1.translation: In ten years he will be forgotten, just like any other supporting actor.

sense_e6c2ff089669fa59d7889c05e61eca9c.text: Este método se seguía usando hasta bien entrado el siglo XX.
sense_e6c2ff089669fa59d7889c05e61eca9c.translation: This method continued to be used until well into the 20th century.

sense_e6c2ff089669fa59d7889c05e61eca9c.text: El ladrón se ocultó y, ya entrada la noche, penetró en la casa.
sense_e6c2ff089669fa59d7889c05e61eca9c.translation: The thief hid and, once night had fallen, he entered the house.

sense_73829acde001313a049bf87646397d27.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_73829acde001313a049bf87646397d27.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_73829acde001313a049bf87646397d27.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_73829acde001313a049bf87646397d27.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_d8d73002f37626cfc6175f894a227460.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_d8d73002f37626cfc6175f894a227460.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_d8d73002f37626cfc6175f894a227460.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_d8d73002f37626cfc6175f894a227460.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_b5abcfcc686fbcbe4694ed3a10c18a17.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_b5abcfcc686fbcbe4694ed3a10c18a17.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_b5abcfcc686fbcbe4694ed3a10c18a17.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_b5abcfcc686fbcbe4694ed3a10c18a17.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_1f784d8a638be319519f5e1d619f3356.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_1f784d8a638be319519f5e1d619f3356.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_1f784d8a638be319519f5e1d619f3356.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_1f784d8a638be319519f5e1d619f3356.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_66152f7a95b5b713bd2f7dbfd418bd7a.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_66152f7a95b5b713bd2f7dbfd418bd7a.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_66152f7a95b5b713bd2f7dbfd418bd7a.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_66152f7a95b5b713bd2f7dbfd418bd7a.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_147ac518e3e720f16ae42a5f7b122b77.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_147ac518e3e720f16ae42a5f7b122b77.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_d4439a16e802ae5aba0a7e13c0c845a4.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_d4439a16e802ae5aba0a7e13c0c845a4.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_1e9f017fda0f332a6de1201a0dd34278.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_1e9f017fda0f332a6de1201a0dd34278.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_1e9f017fda0f332a6de1201a0dd34278.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_1e9f017fda0f332a6de1201a0dd34278.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_f0ff05c47f62d628fe2386a499731797.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_f0ff05c47f62d628fe2386a499731797.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_f0ff05c47f62d628fe2386a499731797.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_f0ff05c47f62d628fe2386a499731797.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_b7f84666c7331047b0ef727eb94d42b5.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_b7f84666c7331047b0ef727eb94d42b5.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_fc28cfb544b0df63a7d8021ba2400cbb.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_fc28cfb544b0df63a7d8021ba2400cbb.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_fc28cfb544b0df63a7d8021ba2400cbb.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_fc28cfb544b0df63a7d8021ba2400cbb.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_f2aaec14efc39904dd7c6d8f2c05f12d.text: Pablo ama a su esposa con todo su ser.
sense_f2aaec14efc39904dd7c6d8f2c05f12d.translation: Pablo loves his wife with all his heart.

sense_f2aaec14efc39904dd7c6d8f2c05f12d.text: Yo te amo, Ana, y quiero pasar el resto de mi vida contigo.
sense_f2aaec14efc39904dd7c6d8f2c05f12d.translation: I love you, Ana, and I want to spend the rest of my life with you.

sense_3d12102d7b5afc156a6559a93270a9a1.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_3d12102d7b5afc156a6559a93270a9a1.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_3d12102d7b5afc156a6559a93270a9a1.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_3d12102d7b5afc156a6559a93270a9a1.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_a5db99d28e039a8b7ceae5b743116e8b.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_a5db99d28e039a8b7ceae5b743116e8b.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_a5db99d28e039a8b7ceae5b743116e8b.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_a5db99d28e039a8b7ceae5b743116e8b.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_5dcb33053a91592b869f6dd65ff206f8.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_5dcb33053a91592b869f6dd65ff206f8.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_5dcb33053a91592b869f6dd65ff206f8.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_5dcb33053a91592b869f6dd65ff206f8.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_1c996030be1355254f16037a95f7c04c.text: Mi padre era víctima de una rara dolencia.
sense_1c996030be1355254f16037a95f7c04c.translation: My father suffered from a rare illness.

sense_1c996030be1355254f16037a95f7c04c.text: Falleció víctima de un accidente cerebrovascular.

sense_32bcf5edc1f00b5e40158a3958fad79a.text: La empresa emitió su estado de pérdidas y ganancias.
sense_32bcf5edc1f00b5e40158a3958fad79a.translation: The company issued its profit and loss statement.

sense_66cc367628d717a43ac0f8db0ba11152.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_84c8e3731b609fa50589a1d497344988.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_84c8e3731b609fa50589a1d497344988.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_84c8e3731b609fa50589a1d497344988.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_84c8e3731b609fa50589a1d497344988.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_d53b32a897b64d4d4e5fc81f2ddadde6.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_d53b32a897b64d4d4e5fc81f2ddadde6.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_d53b32a897b64d4d4e5fc81f2ddadde6.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_d53b32a897b64d4d4e5fc81f2ddadde6.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_8aa169d42fa1cf058749dac52e111a97.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_8aa169d42fa1cf058749dac52e111a97.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_41174f6fa26d765c840646f95a649622.text: Me parece que el ministro debería dimitir.
sense_41174f6fa26d765c840646f95a649622.translation: I think the minister should resign.

sense_41174f6fa26d765c840646f95a649622.text: ¿Qué te pareció la serie sobre la familia real? - Me pareció una tontería.
sense_41174f6fa26d765c840646f95a649622.translation: What did you think of the series about the royal family? - I thought it was nonsense.

sense_33c92b1f91cf7aff90bdadfd4c5a8ee6.text: Me lesioné la pierna jugando al fútbol.
sense_33c92b1f91cf7aff90bdadfd4c5a8ee6.translation: I injured my leg playing soccer.

sense_33c92b1f91cf7aff90bdadfd4c5a8ee6.text: Cuando se rompió la pierna, tuvieron que sacrificar el caballo.
sense_33c92b1f91cf7aff90bdadfd4c5a8ee6.translation: When the horse broke its leg, it had to be put down.

sense_ae10edd1e1b85d3a161be13d23591d55.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_346b417e1c635689ba318f9da741ecd3.text: Este año voy a correr la maratón.
sense_346b417e1c635689ba318f9da741ecd3.translation: I'm running the marathon this year.

sense_d4d116f06d2409d3fca9d7748c9ba323.text: Es necesario que un notario dé fe de la firma del contrato.
sense_d4d116f06d2409d3fca9d7748c9ba323.translation: It is necessary for a notary to witness the signing of the contract.

sense_d4d116f06d2409d3fca9d7748c9ba323.text: Estos hechos dan fe de que la situación está llegando al límite.
sense_d4d116f06d2409d3fca9d7748c9ba323.translation: These events testify that the situation is reaching its limits.

sense_8447f536deefd8012fb534e28aa4fde8.text: Me encanta el cine mucho más que el teatro.
sense_8447f536deefd8012fb534e28aa4fde8.translation: I love the cinema much more than the theater.

sense_8447f536deefd8012fb534e28aa4fde8.text: Claudia está haciendo su tesis sobre el cine italiano de mediados del siglo XX.
sense_8447f536deefd8012fb534e28aa4fde8.translation: Claudia is writing her thesis on mid-20th century Italian cinema.

sense_fe64be851c77c115a8a7e7d4695b7a18.text: Me hice el propósito de ir al gimnasio.
sense_fe64be851c77c115a8a7e7d4695b7a18.translation: I made a resolution to go to the gym.

sense_fe64be851c77c115a8a7e7d4695b7a18.text: ¿Cuál es tu propósito de Año Nuevo? - ¡Viajar lo más que pueda!
sense_fe64be851c77c115a8a7e7d4695b7a18.translation: What's your New Year's resolution? - To travel as much as I can!

sense_76c92b2373e6d51aa281312f4ab93303.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_76c92b2373e6d51aa281312f4ab93303.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_1a5790236651b5d1799f751f4fd81be8.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_1a5790236651b5d1799f751f4fd81be8.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_1a5790236651b5d1799f751f4fd81be8.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_1a5790236651b5d1799f751f4fd81be8.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_205dd4a4004c9ed6731f6ee8736fb6e9.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_205dd4a4004c9ed6731f6ee8736fb6e9.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_fa9faa2e9b96fa38cee5f9f360e2d7ae.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_fa9faa2e9b96fa38cee5f9f360e2d7ae.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_6c849235e09570232d612685f4863fc2.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_6c849235e09570232d612685f4863fc2.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_723ef8362214ef85bf7667c866d12673.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_723ef8362214ef85bf7667c866d12673.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_cc91fee3200cf26f6c5cc3c23fbc735b.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_cc91fee3200cf26f6c5cc3c23fbc735b.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_cc91fee3200cf26f6c5cc3c23fbc735b.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_cc91fee3200cf26f6c5cc3c23fbc735b.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_96b996d6a2e486464e003d6572e5a542.text: Los ladrones le hicieron un puente a tres coches y los robaron.
sense_96b996d6a2e486464e003d6572e5a542.translation: The thieves hot-wired three cars and stole them.

sense_96b996d6a2e486464e003d6572e5a542.text: Se me olvidó la llave del carro, pero no importa porque ahorita le hago un puente.
sense_96b996d6a2e486464e003d6572e5a542.translation: I forgot the car key, but it doesn't matter because I'll just hot-wire it.

sense_82797fd5a59fcbd48bb66b52b86ebaeb.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_82797fd5a59fcbd48bb66b52b86ebaeb.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_0f2a53537847c826f4c61d1a79179b81.text: Yo tengo muy buena memoria para las caras.
sense_0f2a53537847c826f4c61d1a79179b81.translation: I have a very good memory for faces.

sense_0f2a53537847c826f4c61d1a79179b81.text: Con la edad, cada vez me falla más la memoria.
sense_0f2a53537847c826f4c61d1a79179b81.translation: With age, my memory is failing me more and more.

sense_278475944c4a99a7a3959d2c01d0115c.text: Esos policías perros nos pidieron una mordida.
sense_278475944c4a99a7a3959d2c01d0115c.translation: Those lowlife cops asked us for a bribe.

sense_278475944c4a99a7a3959d2c01d0115c.text: La compañera de Ricardo es bien perra; siempre lo pone en evidencia frente a la jefa.
sense_278475944c4a99a7a3959d2c01d0115c.translation: Ricardo's coworker is a piece of garbage; she always calls him out in front of their boss.

sense_5b4cc6b9715e5fc63898dae4043c13d3.text: Me parece que el ministro debería dimitir.
sense_5b4cc6b9715e5fc63898dae4043c13d3.translation: I think the minister should resign.

sense_5b4cc6b9715e5fc63898dae4043c13d3.text: ¿Qué te pareció la serie sobre la familia real? - Me pareció una tontería.
sense_5b4cc6b9715e5fc63898dae4043c13d3.translation: What did you think of the series about the royal family? - I thought it was nonsense.

sense_e65ec702da4f2f126600fc79695cff0a.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_e65ec702da4f2f126600fc79695cff0a.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_e65ec702da4f2f126600fc79695cff0a.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_e65ec702da4f2f126600fc79695cff0a.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_d1709391bcfb5ef3a16dad4b94fcbbb4.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_d1709391bcfb5ef3a16dad4b94fcbbb4.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_e10b5db2845cd9ae983d0807e19076c6.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_e10b5db2845cd9ae983d0807e19076c6.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_d00011e2ca1cf335d6766fd11373bf04.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_d00011e2ca1cf335d6766fd11373bf04.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_d00011e2ca1cf335d6766fd11373bf04.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_d00011e2ca1cf335d6766fd11373bf04.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_a990dc6c7eef1c571f06aa8f9903917c.text: ¿Vas a ir a visitar a tu amigo esta noche?
sense_a990dc6c7eef1c571f06aa8f9903917c.translation: Are you going to visit your friend tonight?

sense_a990dc6c7eef1c571f06aa8f9903917c.text: El cirujano visitó al paciente el día después de la operación.
sense_a990dc6c7eef1c571f06aa8f9903917c.translation: The surgeon visited the patient the day after the surgery.

sense_023b8086fae8891aa96577a63fc358fd.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_023b8086fae8891aa96577a63fc358fd.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_023b8086fae8891aa96577a63fc358fd.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_023b8086fae8891aa96577a63fc358fd.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_01e7fe07883ecfb94a05e9174945ecd0.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_01e7fe07883ecfb94a05e9174945ecd0.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_01e7fe07883ecfb94a05e9174945ecd0.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_01e7fe07883ecfb94a05e9174945ecd0.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_a8f5daad8e261d6ba2854230773feb17.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_a8f5daad8e261d6ba2854230773feb17.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_a8f5daad8e261d6ba2854230773feb17.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_a8f5daad8e261d6ba2854230773feb17.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_7f094c7d9749bbff6d0ad0f68dc45cfc.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_7f094c7d9749bbff6d0ad0f68dc45cfc.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_7f094c7d9749bbff6d0ad0f68dc45cfc.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_7f094c7d9749bbff6d0ad0f68dc45cfc.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_4e44cad34a7f0e6fda9aed124fa04341.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_4e44cad34a7f0e6fda9aed124fa04341.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_4e44cad34a7f0e6fda9aed124fa04341.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_4e44cad34a7f0e6fda9aed124fa04341.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_3a2ed2fe079972cc4cabf9334f6fa6dc.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_3a2ed2fe079972cc4cabf9334f6fa6dc.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_3a2ed2fe079972cc4cabf9334f6fa6dc.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_3a2ed2fe079972cc4cabf9334f6fa6dc.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_f5a50ae65abc252e58b3ca1ac50b9f8c.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_f5a50ae65abc252e58b3ca1ac50b9f8c.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_f5a50ae65abc252e58b3ca1ac50b9f8c.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_f5a50ae65abc252e58b3ca1ac50b9f8c.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_18a62b88bb48054a87753723d6400e7c.text: ¿No preferirías ir de vacaciones al extranjero este año?
sense_18a62b88bb48054a87753723d6400e7c.translation: Wouldn't you rather vacation abroad this year?

sense_18a62b88bb48054a87753723d6400e7c.text: Prefiero que se lo digas tú porque a ti te hace más caso.
sense_18a62b88bb48054a87753723d6400e7c.translation: I'd rather you told him because he listens to you more.

sense_5de377eac480a83f6a44f84aff15e289.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_c69be2f3a9f0d8913858429ccb14a035.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_c69be2f3a9f0d8913858429ccb14a035.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_c69be2f3a9f0d8913858429ccb14a035.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_c69be2f3a9f0d8913858429ccb14a035.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_d63ae75822c892502dd5b7075d2ae781.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_d63ae75822c892502dd5b7075d2ae781.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_d63ae75822c892502dd5b7075d2ae781.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_d63ae75822c892502dd5b7075d2ae781.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_11dae3658426a2d3e79af67762a28795.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_11dae3658426a2d3e79af67762a28795.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_d5de97cbe2b88f56369d99410b7e1d65.text: Hay que comprar una sartén nueva porque esta ya no sirve.
sense_d5de97cbe2b88f56369d99410b7e1d65.translation: We need to buy a new frying pan because this one is no good any more.
Is this one any good to you?

sense_3c12ead23e957ba1e38c9b984d673993.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_3c12ead23e957ba1e38c9b984d673993.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_4bf0a8af0c25e59e1e784a86f8185254.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_4bf0a8af0c25e59e1e784a86f8185254.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_3dc99d4349e294adc7bd7388c0d8f5dd.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_3dc99d4349e294adc7bd7388c0d8f5dd.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_3dc99d4349e294adc7bd7388c0d8f5dd.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_3dc99d4349e294adc7bd7388c0d8f5dd.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_2b3bea7116fe7e6ea8143441e88c068f.text: Se notaba que en el interior tenía mucha pena por su hija.
sense_2b3bea7116fe7e6ea8143441e88c068f.translation: You could see that deep down she was very sad about her daughter.

sense_7e2a6024e93c7af559b73d9a6a4eca36.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_7e2a6024e93c7af559b73d9a6a4eca36.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_7e2a6024e93c7af559b73d9a6a4eca36.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_7e2a6024e93c7af559b73d9a6a4eca36.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_328205acc38a58ab546730f5aee80ff9.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_328205acc38a58ab546730f5aee80ff9.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_328205acc38a58ab546730f5aee80ff9.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_328205acc38a58ab546730f5aee80ff9.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_d1e733323886ce613d9d2fc7e20e54b6.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_b3f9e14834505ff5a8a5c282b5f6b7ad.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_b3f9e14834505ff5a8a5c282b5f6b7ad.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_b3f9e14834505ff5a8a5c282b5f6b7ad.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_b3f9e14834505ff5a8a5c282b5f6b7ad.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_62abf6422a11c3a36a56e37659a21c8c.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_62abf6422a11c3a36a56e37659a21c8c.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_62abf6422a11c3a36a56e37659a21c8c.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_62abf6422a11c3a36a56e37659a21c8c.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_abcccb83806355267be9938e170fc84c.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_abcccb83806355267be9938e170fc84c.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_23f1ab58ffabee68a6e8cd4f53326909.text: Hay algunas medidas que podemos tomar en lo que se refiere al presupuesto.
sense_23f1ab58ffabee68a6e8cd4f53326909.translation: There are some measures we can take with regards to the budget.

sense_23f1ab58ffabee68a6e8cd4f53326909.text: En lo que se refiere a los empleados nuevamente contratados, tenemos que estar de acuerdo en cuanto a la capacitación.
sense_23f1ab58ffabee68a6e8cd4f53326909.translation: As far as new hires are concerned, we have to all be on the same page with regard to training.

sense_aeb74b14ba709a2a772de3cb36d6b68c.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_aeb74b14ba709a2a772de3cb36d6b68c.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_aeb74b14ba709a2a772de3cb36d6b68c.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_aeb74b14ba709a2a772de3cb36d6b68c.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_62ced15da9b747f8bd317a6285f4bfa4.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_62ced15da9b747f8bd317a6285f4bfa4.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_62ced15da9b747f8bd317a6285f4bfa4.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_62ced15da9b747f8bd317a6285f4bfa4.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_f445d304e1a29cbfff294d4de3c076a4.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_a2563717022c6158467441bbe3a553a3.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_a2563717022c6158467441bbe3a553a3.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_a2563717022c6158467441bbe3a553a3.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_a2563717022c6158467441bbe3a553a3.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_5fb26ca1ad30e0bfcc9a5f8f9a3ab05d.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_5fb26ca1ad30e0bfcc9a5f8f9a3ab05d.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_5fb26ca1ad30e0bfcc9a5f8f9a3ab05d.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_5fb26ca1ad30e0bfcc9a5f8f9a3ab05d.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_35d65ab99dbd065788288d3f3c19e845.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_35d65ab99dbd065788288d3f3c19e845.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_4a3285a506e156ba9e7e7e19c78171cd.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_4a3285a506e156ba9e7e7e19c78171cd.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_97330e7b7fdf6cfa2fb59841a0f9ec1d.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_97330e7b7fdf6cfa2fb59841a0f9ec1d.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_97330e7b7fdf6cfa2fb59841a0f9ec1d.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_97330e7b7fdf6cfa2fb59841a0f9ec1d.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_0ed7350d83380baf08abb936d767ccf2.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_0ed7350d83380baf08abb936d767ccf2.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_fd4db67d22fe0f9d8024689518f9ee9a.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_fd4db67d22fe0f9d8024689518f9ee9a.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_fd4db67d22fe0f9d8024689518f9ee9a.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_fd4db67d22fe0f9d8024689518f9ee9a.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_3453a1a22237df6490f8a5e9d9b2c3d8.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_3453a1a22237df6490f8a5e9d9b2c3d8.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_ae387a2acaa4d79070d150853ce7d8ec.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_ae387a2acaa4d79070d150853ce7d8ec.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_ae387a2acaa4d79070d150853ce7d8ec.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_ae387a2acaa4d79070d150853ce7d8ec.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_948f19f95978bfa3e8e99193e9c74d06.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_948f19f95978bfa3e8e99193e9c74d06.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_948f19f95978bfa3e8e99193e9c74d06.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_948f19f95978bfa3e8e99193e9c74d06.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_279a63d4b98c274da56ceccc664a417e.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_279a63d4b98c274da56ceccc664a417e.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_279a63d4b98c274da56ceccc664a417e.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_279a63d4b98c274da56ceccc664a417e.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_9897e3148600d497a667b139d03b9ce0.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_9897e3148600d497a667b139d03b9ce0.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_fb7bb416ed02f447af7d4fb9ceebe5ae.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_fb7bb416ed02f447af7d4fb9ceebe5ae.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_fb7bb416ed02f447af7d4fb9ceebe5ae.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_fb7bb416ed02f447af7d4fb9ceebe5ae.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_19889db35f5c5fa5d7cc9ab78c7fe026.text: Se me perdió la pareja de este arete.
sense_19889db35f5c5fa5d7cc9ab78c7fe026.translation: I've lost the earring that goes with this one.

sense_19889db35f5c5fa5d7cc9ab78c7fe026.text: ¿Por qué solo llevas un calcetín? - No encuentro la pareja.
sense_19889db35f5c5fa5d7cc9ab78c7fe026.translation: Why are you only wearing one sock? - I can't find the other one.

sense_e03b19fcedcee5647d0c0fe2afac4df2.text: Voy a enviar cien tarjetas de Navidad.
sense_e03b19fcedcee5647d0c0fe2afac4df2.translation: I am going to send out a hundred Christmas cards.

sense_e03b19fcedcee5647d0c0fe2afac4df2.text: ¿Puedo pagar con mi tarjeta de débito?
sense_e03b19fcedcee5647d0c0fe2afac4df2.translation: Can I pay with my debit card?

sense_155c9226073c3da15d4ce16d2a751d38.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_155c9226073c3da15d4ce16d2a751d38.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_155c9226073c3da15d4ce16d2a751d38.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_155c9226073c3da15d4ce16d2a751d38.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_5ea8b5cb7ff9c7ca3bb3fa21644334d8.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_5ea8b5cb7ff9c7ca3bb3fa21644334d8.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_6e36e0e7cfbbc9b6859baf9407063e3e.text: Las temperaturas bajas amenazan con helar los cultivos.
sense_6e36e0e7cfbbc9b6859baf9407063e3e.translation: The low temperatures threaten to freeze the crops.

sense_6e36e0e7cfbbc9b6859baf9407063e3e.text: El viento helado heló las flores.
sense_6e36e0e7cfbbc9b6859baf9407063e3e.translation: The frigid wind froze the flowers.

sense_22ec458fa13d8adaa061b68d307cfc4b.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_22ec458fa13d8adaa061b68d307cfc4b.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_22ec458fa13d8adaa061b68d307cfc4b.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_22ec458fa13d8adaa061b68d307cfc4b.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_a5f52a8914b5c3c844b7c01440aef567.translation: So many people have come to the party!
It's taken you ages to get here!

sense_d6f182038644ca02f7f342e13368bb55.text: ¡Cuánto quiero que me lleves a ese restaurante de nuevo!
sense_d6f182038644ca02f7f342e13368bb55.translation: I want you to take me back to that restaurant so badly!

sense_c88e0455682f82266558a56d1b150e34.text: Por mi cuenta, yo ya terminé la tarea.
sense_c88e0455682f82266558a56d1b150e34.translation: I already finished my homework on my own.

sense_af7df6f87610874fb692f3bfd43f8f07.text: Disculpa, no te he visto trabajando allí. Me pondré los cascos.
sense_af7df6f87610874fb692f3bfd43f8f07.translation: I'm sorry, I didn't see you there working. I'll put headphones in.

sense_af7df6f87610874fb692f3bfd43f8f07.text: Disculpe, por favor. ¿Me dice dónde está la parada del metro?
sense_af7df6f87610874fb692f3bfd43f8f07.translation: Excuse me, please. Can you tell me where the subway station is?

sense_be0a3b4ae6ce992109d2818423ba1de0.text: Se fue sin explicación y me partió el corazón.
sense_be0a3b4ae6ce992109d2818423ba1de0.translation: She left without explanation and broke my heart.

sense_be0a3b4ae6ce992109d2818423ba1de0.text: Le dijeron que si no pagaba la deuda, le iban a partir las piernas.
sense_be0a3b4ae6ce992109d2818423ba1de0.translation: They told him that if he didn't pay the debt, they were going to break his legs.

sense_e6534a1321235d92a82d209788d47458.text: El alumno escribió su ensayo de 20 páginas en una noche.
sense_e6534a1321235d92a82d209788d47458.translation: The student wrote his 20-page essay in one night.

sense_b6f448be56181c6e9fcce00e3d544769.text: Por favor, cepíllate los dientes; tu aliento apesta.
sense_b6f448be56181c6e9fcce00e3d544769.translation: Please brush your teeth; your breath stinks.

sense_b6f448be56181c6e9fcce00e3d544769.text: Mi hermana tiene un diente de oro.
sense_b6f448be56181c6e9fcce00e3d544769.translation: My sister has a gold tooth.

sense_e9f4c16753acae9881addc77c8e56bff.text: No le tire patadas a su hermano.
Su perro me tiró un mordisco.

sense_448ab8805d0fa919713bddf5cc40fd22.text: Las fiestas ya no me tiran.
sense_448ab8805d0fa919713bddf5cc40fd22.translation: Parties don't appeal to me anymore.
He is not interested in studying medicine.

sense_7b5d9db432dbf5587deef4f7c855388c.text: El plato tiraba a dulce más que nada.
sense_7b5d9db432dbf5587deef4f7c855388c.translation: The dish was more sweet than anything else.

sense_7b5d9db432dbf5587deef4f7c855388c.text: Tienes que beberte el té cuando esté tirando a frío.
sense_7b5d9db432dbf5587deef4f7c855388c.translation: You have to drink the tea when it is cooling down.

sense_12db30aacbe305ff0d0bc4035d23133a.text: El bebé se tiró un eructo tras tomarse su biberón.
sense_12db30aacbe305ff0d0bc4035d23133a.translation: The baby burped after having his bottle.

sense_12db30aacbe305ff0d0bc4035d23133a.text: La primera vez que se tiró un pedo delante de su novio se avergonzó.
sense_12db30aacbe305ff0d0bc4035d23133a.translation: The first time she farted in front of her boyfriend, she was embarrassed.

sense_3ae6aa43bc1208336e0b15d26632c9d8.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_3ae6aa43bc1208336e0b15d26632c9d8.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_3ae6aa43bc1208336e0b15d26632c9d8.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_3ae6aa43bc1208336e0b15d26632c9d8.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_04ffa6dad52fcda4fceed249b84ddee5.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_04ffa6dad52fcda4fceed249b84ddee5.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_04ffa6dad52fcda4fceed249b84ddee5.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_04ffa6dad52fcda4fceed249b84ddee5.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_14c6df6e40a7ecfe4bb8147cb436958f.translation: I just want to make you happy.
What do you want for Christmas?

sense_ec583dd8f66b48ea69f1f5be8466a913.translation: "How can I help you?," asked the butler.
Would you like something to drink?

sense_b4e06f1d725a020257b28d04a208ba2e.text: ¿Están pensando tú y Jorge en tener un bebe?
sense_b4e06f1d725a020257b28d04a208ba2e.translation: Are you and Jorge planning to have a baby?

sense_b4e06f1d725a020257b28d04a208ba2e.text: La mujer sostenía una beba recién nacida entre sus brazos.
sense_b4e06f1d725a020257b28d04a208ba2e.translation: The woman was holding a newborn baby in her arms.

sense_fa11cb57b22c2a1cfb85d86d5b4754f8.text: Estoy encantado con el rendimiento del equipo.
sense_fa11cb57b22c2a1cfb85d86d5b4754f8.translation: I'm delighted with the team's performance.

sense_fa11cb57b22c2a1cfb85d86d5b4754f8.text: Estaría encantado de acompañarte al baile.
sense_fa11cb57b22c2a1cfb85d86d5b4754f8.translation: I would be delighted to accompany you to the ball.

sense_ae8a0342e62f69ed6bd10a55d1f78ed8.text: ¡Me encanta tu casa! ¿Tú misma la decoraste?
sense_ae8a0342e62f69ed6bd10a55d1f78ed8.translation: I love your house! Did you decorate it yourself?

sense_ae8a0342e62f69ed6bd10a55d1f78ed8.text: Me encanta tomarme un chocolate caliente cuando hace frío afuera.
sense_ae8a0342e62f69ed6bd10a55d1f78ed8.translation: I love drinking hot chocolate when it's cold out.

sense_9968e344b2c2c86b2f822af20763138b.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_9968e344b2c2c86b2f822af20763138b.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_0f008993ce42b73a44d97de960ac65b8.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_0f008993ce42b73a44d97de960ac65b8.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_a93cb91b006e32a244f0ecf4676bfb3d.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_a93cb91b006e32a244f0ecf4676bfb3d.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_a93cb91b006e32a244f0ecf4676bfb3d.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_a93cb91b006e32a244f0ecf4676bfb3d.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_2649b0ca1d0aadccdc37e14a0c2ad06d.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_2649b0ca1d0aadccdc37e14a0c2ad06d.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_2649b0ca1d0aadccdc37e14a0c2ad06d.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_2649b0ca1d0aadccdc37e14a0c2ad06d.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_6d7fca0b0a1aade9a9e0eec0d1ecb656.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_6d7fca0b0a1aade9a9e0eec0d1ecb656.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_d18463ad631f5b252d1d30dfaf49d78f.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_d18463ad631f5b252d1d30dfaf49d78f.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_d18463ad631f5b252d1d30dfaf49d78f.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_d18463ad631f5b252d1d30dfaf49d78f.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_a0052c134b787f85d63c149d721e0173.text: Tuvimos que quedarnos en casa porque estaba cayendo un chaparrón.
sense_a0052c134b787f85d63c149d721e0173.translation: We had to stay home because it was pouring rain.

sense_a0052c134b787f85d63c149d721e0173.text: Está cayendo una buena nevada. Ponle las cadenas a las ruedas.
sense_a0052c134b787f85d63c149d721e0173.translation: It's snowing hard. Put the chains on the tires.

sense_1ed773de4753a921ccd8eaeb4e72ff2a.text: No bebo porque el alcohol me cae mal.
sense_1ed773de4753a921ccd8eaeb4e72ff2a.translation: I don't drink because alcohol disagrees with me.
You look great in that dress!

sense_91c26b696d2df131652bfd2f26a39c60.text: Me cae muy bien tu hermano; siempre me hace sonreír.
sense_91c26b696d2df131652bfd2f26a39c60.translation: I really like your brother; he always makes me smile.

sense_91c26b696d2df131652bfd2f26a39c60.text: Me marché porque me cae mal tu primo con sus bromas ofensivas.
sense_91c26b696d2df131652bfd2f26a39c60.translation: I had to leave because I can't stand your cousin and his offensive jokes.

sense_371670d7c7d890e84e6beeaf54a1cc5c.text: Que Harvard la hubiera rechazado, le cayó mal.
sense_371670d7c7d890e84e6beeaf54a1cc5c.translation: She wasn't pleased that Harvard rejected her.

sense_371670d7c7d890e84e6beeaf54a1cc5c.text: El embarazo de mi hermana pequeña no cayó bien en la familia.
sense_371670d7c7d890e84e6beeaf54a1cc5c.translation: My little sister's pregnancy shocked the entire family.

sense_800598b3c8841ce0dfda16fe4462819b.text: Mi bebé está llorando porque se cae de sueño.
sense_800598b3c8841ce0dfda16fe4462819b.translation: My baby is crying because he's very sleepy.

sense_800598b3c8841ce0dfda16fe4462819b.text: Me caigo de cansancio, pero tengo que estudiar para el examen de mañana.
sense_800598b3c8841ce0dfda16fe4462819b.translation: I am really tired, but I have to study for tomorrow's exam.

sense_020591a8112285306e580152e4b96ed7.text: Tengo a mi hijo con la voz tomada por una laringitis.
sense_020591a8112285306e580152e4b96ed7.translation: My son's lost his voice due to laryngitis.

sense_020591a8112285306e580152e4b96ed7.text: Tengo la voz tomada y no sé cómo voy a dar la presentación esta tarde.
sense_020591a8112285306e580152e4b96ed7.translation: I've lost my voice and don't know how I'm going to give the presentation this afternoon.

sense_d7c28c54b22275a1bed2384de3f70dd8.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_d7c28c54b22275a1bed2384de3f70dd8.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_d7c28c54b22275a1bed2384de3f70dd8.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_d7c28c54b22275a1bed2384de3f70dd8.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_db757f2f7035b51b84d4e37d529f35f4.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_db757f2f7035b51b84d4e37d529f35f4.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_d1498317f501ac9f9580b786055c3a53.text: El libro santo de los judíos es la Tora.
sense_d1498317f501ac9f9580b786055c3a53.translation: The holy book of the Jewish people is the Torah.

sense_d1498317f501ac9f9580b786055c3a53.text: Dicen que el sótano de la catedral está lleno de reliquias santas.
sense_d1498317f501ac9f9580b786055c3a53.translation: They say that the basement of the cathedral is full of holy relics.

sense_4362d1baeb68bd94fe6fba746f7dc579.text: Me lesioné la pierna jugando al fútbol.
sense_4362d1baeb68bd94fe6fba746f7dc579.translation: I injured my leg playing soccer.

sense_4362d1baeb68bd94fe6fba746f7dc579.text: Cuando se rompió la pierna, tuvieron que sacrificar el caballo.
sense_4362d1baeb68bd94fe6fba746f7dc579.translation: When the horse broke its leg, it had to be put down.

sense_90b13e6548564b2b117453a5564ebc48.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_90b13e6548564b2b117453a5564ebc48.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_57198161fd0043ac7baa37a8a1b4efe2.text: Me encanta ir de excursiones y explorar la naturaleza.
sense_57198161fd0043ac7baa37a8a1b4efe2.translation: I love to go on hikes and explore nature.

sense_57198161fd0043ac7baa37a8a1b4efe2.text: Estas semanas que hemos pasado en el campo me han ayudado a entrar en contacto con la naturaleza.
sense_57198161fd0043ac7baa37a8a1b4efe2.translation: These weeks we've spent in the countryside have helped me to get in touch with nature.

sense_b42fb3b95522875d72af0e5a89fa342c.text: Ella misma diseñó su propio vestido de novias.
sense_b42fb3b95522875d72af0e5a89fa342c.translation: She designed her own wedding dress herself.

sense_b42fb3b95522875d72af0e5a89fa342c.text: En este mismo sitio, en esta misma fecha, tu madre y yo decidimos casarnos.
sense_b42fb3b95522875d72af0e5a89fa342c.translation: In this very place, on this same day, your mother and I decided to get married.

sense_9681179e5e6145e05c710711befaab66.text: ¿Por qué no estás listo, coño? Vamos a estar tarde.
sense_9681179e5e6145e05c710711befaab66.translation: For fuck's sake, why aren't you ready yet? We're going to be late.

sense_9681179e5e6145e05c710711befaab66.text: ¿Cuántas veces voy a tener que decirte, coño? ¡No lo hice!
sense_9681179e5e6145e05c710711befaab66.translation: For fuck's sake, how many times am I going to have tell you? I didn't do it!

sense_abeb0654a7d4af5794081aef2867e4ce.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_abeb0654a7d4af5794081aef2867e4ce.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_b84f44c68596b153ac4e3dcaac56c8e1.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_b84f44c68596b153ac4e3dcaac56c8e1.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_b84f44c68596b153ac4e3dcaac56c8e1.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_b84f44c68596b153ac4e3dcaac56c8e1.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_b1339b755ede3729cf9adee7e1f492bf.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_b1339b755ede3729cf9adee7e1f492bf.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_203d25cb1c4bfa7d05b482857626586b.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_203d25cb1c4bfa7d05b482857626586b.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_0edcafa3764ac4c282c43e7529941414.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_0edcafa3764ac4c282c43e7529941414.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_0edcafa3764ac4c282c43e7529941414.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_0edcafa3764ac4c282c43e7529941414.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_30229b7bb09da2c9dbd07ee6cf14b1c2.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_30229b7bb09da2c9dbd07ee6cf14b1c2.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_30229b7bb09da2c9dbd07ee6cf14b1c2.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_30229b7bb09da2c9dbd07ee6cf14b1c2.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_ec9cbd3af2acb4f5fef2ed7525b62818.text: Aquel coche estacionado allá es mío.
sense_ec9cbd3af2acb4f5fef2ed7525b62818.translation: That car parked over there is mine.

sense_ec9cbd3af2acb4f5fef2ed7525b62818.text: Me gusta mucho aquella casa que hay en lo alto de la colina.
sense_ec9cbd3af2acb4f5fef2ed7525b62818.translation: I really like that house on top of the hill.

sense_751cdaf4e268dca658d3ae1cafe61d4a.text: No sé tú pero yo prefiero aquel.
sense_751cdaf4e268dca658d3ae1cafe61d4a.translation: I don't know about you but I prefer that one.

sense_751cdaf4e268dca658d3ae1cafe61d4a.text: Aquella es más grande que esta.
sense_751cdaf4e268dca658d3ae1cafe61d4a.translation: That one is bigger than this one.

sense_f223fecb13eb504b6f4b1fcb76091050.text: No me gustó el final de la película.
sense_f223fecb13eb504b6f4b1fcb76091050.translation: I didn't like the end of the movie.

sense_f223fecb13eb504b6f4b1fcb76091050.text: Yo quería ver una película de miedo, pero mi novio quería ver una comedia romántica.
sense_f223fecb13eb504b6f4b1fcb76091050.translation: I wanted to watch a scary movie, but my boyfriend wanted to watch a romantic comedy.

sense_4ca13730106b5433b4f7de02f6a455da.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_4ca13730106b5433b4f7de02f6a455da.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_b60eb7d2eefcbd56b6e510cd10221e01.translation: This is a fine mess you've got us into!

sense_953c98550f38cfe3cad5767402ecf3a0.text: Tuvimos que quedarnos en casa porque estaba cayendo un chaparrón.
sense_953c98550f38cfe3cad5767402ecf3a0.translation: We had to stay home because it was pouring rain.

sense_953c98550f38cfe3cad5767402ecf3a0.text: Está cayendo una buena nevada. Ponle las cadenas a las ruedas.
sense_953c98550f38cfe3cad5767402ecf3a0.translation: It's snowing hard. Put the chains on the tires.

sense_62accec64ee79a0e6c274553817ae592.text: No bebo porque el alcohol me cae mal.
sense_62accec64ee79a0e6c274553817ae592.translation: I don't drink because alcohol disagrees with me.
You look great in that dress!

sense_e7504e5789ece0c11588c50848e4e25c.text: Me cae muy bien tu hermano; siempre me hace sonreír.
sense_e7504e5789ece0c11588c50848e4e25c.translation: I really like your brother; he always makes me smile.

sense_e7504e5789ece0c11588c50848e4e25c.text: Me marché porque me cae mal tu primo con sus bromas ofensivas.
sense_e7504e5789ece0c11588c50848e4e25c.translation: I had to leave because I can't stand your cousin and his offensive jokes.

sense_50d404c3184dbb4351d3f5ad6a70630b.text: Que Harvard la hubiera rechazado, le cayó mal.
sense_50d404c3184dbb4351d3f5ad6a70630b.translation: She wasn't pleased that Harvard rejected her.

sense_50d404c3184dbb4351d3f5ad6a70630b.text: El embarazo de mi hermana pequeña no cayó bien en la familia.
sense_50d404c3184dbb4351d3f5ad6a70630b.translation: My little sister's pregnancy shocked the entire family.

sense_c52f6ba4a94ff73b5e0ca91ca9f00563.text: Mi bebé está llorando porque se cae de sueño.
sense_c52f6ba4a94ff73b5e0ca91ca9f00563.translation: My baby is crying because he's very sleepy.

sense_c52f6ba4a94ff73b5e0ca91ca9f00563.text: Me caigo de cansancio, pero tengo que estudiar para el examen de mañana.
sense_c52f6ba4a94ff73b5e0ca91ca9f00563.translation: I am really tired, but I have to study for tomorrow's exam.

sense_97255df9e5b4a2e0c9a6e502d5abd48d.text: Hay algunas medidas que podemos tomar en lo que se refiere al presupuesto.
sense_97255df9e5b4a2e0c9a6e502d5abd48d.translation: There are some measures we can take with regards to the budget.

sense_97255df9e5b4a2e0c9a6e502d5abd48d.text: En lo que se refiere a los empleados nuevamente contratados, tenemos que estar de acuerdo en cuanto a la capacitación.
sense_97255df9e5b4a2e0c9a6e502d5abd48d.translation: As far as new hires are concerned, we have to all be on the same page with regard to training.

sense_73df6206f743e442f92a48e8a1afacf0.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_73df6206f743e442f92a48e8a1afacf0.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_73df6206f743e442f92a48e8a1afacf0.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_73df6206f743e442f92a48e8a1afacf0.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_234613ea82ab664156e352326bf44c98.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_234613ea82ab664156e352326bf44c98.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_4ba1aa58e982cf82aae2181b7f96cd2f.text: ¡Me encanta tu casa! ¿Tú misma la decoraste?
sense_4ba1aa58e982cf82aae2181b7f96cd2f.translation: I love your house! Did you decorate it yourself?

sense_4ba1aa58e982cf82aae2181b7f96cd2f.text: Me encanta tomarme un chocolate caliente cuando hace frío afuera.
sense_4ba1aa58e982cf82aae2181b7f96cd2f.translation: I love drinking hot chocolate when it's cold out.

sense_c09b426ba6f27a9867682498775576b3.text: Han llevado al paciente a la unidad de cuidados intensivos.
sense_c09b426ba6f27a9867682498775576b3.translation: They've taken the patient to the intensive care unit.

sense_c09b426ba6f27a9867682498775576b3.text: Lean el primer párrafo en la Unidad 11 y respondan a las preguntas.
sense_c09b426ba6f27a9867682498775576b3.translation: Read the first paragraph in Unit 11 and answer the questions.

sense_39961035e1b4164279a7c7e4269f9e00.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_ec7ab7910ba47e2e0267854083d20ecb.text: Este año voy a correr la maratón.
sense_ec7ab7910ba47e2e0267854083d20ecb.translation: I'm running the marathon this year.

sense_44416e6b4958e4a5157e333d2967b120.text: Si me permite, señora, creo que puedo arreglar la puerta.
sense_44416e6b4958e4a5157e333d2967b120.translation: If I may, ma'am, I think I can fix the door.

sense_e1ff20b62d28e9894a8bc79801f46414.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_e1ff20b62d28e9894a8bc79801f46414.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_e1ff20b62d28e9894a8bc79801f46414.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_e1ff20b62d28e9894a8bc79801f46414.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_09e988cce2073f6427d229f1189dbad0.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_09e988cce2073f6427d229f1189dbad0.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_c7d2a3c77e4d14d0d9cb7df2112e1eff.text: Dame cinco minutos; quiero darle una pasada al vestido antes de irnos.
sense_c7d2a3c77e4d14d0d9cb7df2112e1eff.translation: Give me five minutes; I want to iron the dress really quickly before we leave.

sense_c7d2a3c77e4d14d0d9cb7df2112e1eff.text: Perdón por mi aspecto algo desaliñado, pero estaba apurado y no tuve tiempo de darle una pasada a la camisa.
sense_c7d2a3c77e4d14d0d9cb7df2112e1eff.translation: Sorry that I look a little scruffy, but I was in a hurry and didn't have time to run the iron over my shirt.

sense_b91ee13b8ca21c966255b75ca0cf96dd.text: La fiesta de Mari fue una pasada.
El restaurante nos cobró un recargo por llegar tarde. - ¡Qué pasada!
sense_b91ee13b8ca21c966255b75ca0cf96dd.translation: The restaurant added on a charge for being late. - What a rip off!

sense_685428060ebbe725716e33773ba79ce8.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_0c9caf32588afd34e7a199cac11ec7f8.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_0c9caf32588afd34e7a199cac11ec7f8.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_0c9caf32588afd34e7a199cac11ec7f8.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_0c9caf32588afd34e7a199cac11ec7f8.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_3e122c2fd1aabdd5134ef22a91c81b88.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_3e122c2fd1aabdd5134ef22a91c81b88.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_3e122c2fd1aabdd5134ef22a91c81b88.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_3e122c2fd1aabdd5134ef22a91c81b88.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_d05a3684408098f249e4974f9809bf4d.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_d05a3684408098f249e4974f9809bf4d.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_7ceb0f30ff2b58da06f6d5becb441329.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_7ceb0f30ff2b58da06f6d5becb441329.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_75ea5c96b390834f98ac0ac10b635452.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_23e6a561499d1eb8ffa9e999bbb046fd.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_23e6a561499d1eb8ffa9e999bbb046fd.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_23e6a561499d1eb8ffa9e999bbb046fd.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_862bde902623b08d2cdd1d87fa78039a.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_6259351ffce1b77c8f5429bab7207757.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_6259351ffce1b77c8f5429bab7207757.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_8742a107f474c8965dfea76d80a35c0f.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_8742a107f474c8965dfea76d80a35c0f.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_8742a107f474c8965dfea76d80a35c0f.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_8742a107f474c8965dfea76d80a35c0f.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_35f83bba818b2f2a4a67e61b6d903963.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_35f83bba818b2f2a4a67e61b6d903963.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_494adf7ccb4e5c94b5d25745b287ecf7.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_494adf7ccb4e5c94b5d25745b287ecf7.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_d4dc8affa2679c07a4ef71423988daa9.text: Este es un broche precioso. ¿Dónde lo compraste?
sense_d4dc8affa2679c07a4ef71423988daa9.translation: This is a beautiful brooch. Where did you buy it?

sense_d4dc8affa2679c07a4ef71423988daa9.text: La vista desde la peña está preciosa.
sense_d4dc8affa2679c07a4ef71423988daa9.translation: The view from the cliff is beautiful.

sense_bf9ee2c3dc748e7fe773c0377345334a.text: La chica estaba vendiendo naranjas en el mercado.
sense_bf9ee2c3dc748e7fe773c0377345334a.translation: The girl was selling oranges in the market.

sense_cdf3861f427bd991651ab58fd9eb1f7b.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_cdf3861f427bd991651ab58fd9eb1f7b.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_9e0c880bab37add799d258fd28d31db3.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_2ab7e019495f949e64cb121512a8478c.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_2ab7e019495f949e64cb121512a8478c.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_2ab7e019495f949e64cb121512a8478c.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_2ab7e019495f949e64cb121512a8478c.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_6211cba14956bc8bb8c4e48f25ded471.text: Mis camisetas tiene mucha carga sentimental para mí.
sense_6211cba14956bc8bb8c4e48f25ded471.translation: My T-shirts hold a lot of sentimental value for me.

sense_6211cba14956bc8bb8c4e48f25ded471.text: Por su carga violenta, no podemos recomendar esta película a familias.
sense_6211cba14956bc8bb8c4e48f25ded471.translation: Because of its violent content, we cannot recommend this movie for families.

sense_606b4170bdf126428b57000feb73fe08.text: Me carga que siempre la escojan a ella.
sense_606b4170bdf126428b57000feb73fe08.translation: It gets on my nerves that they always choose her.

sense_606b4170bdf126428b57000feb73fe08.text: Me carga tener que aguantar la novia de mi hermano.
sense_606b4170bdf126428b57000feb73fe08.translation: I can't stand having to put up with my brother's girlfriend.

sense_031b67f39615516301583f23a7c31e5f.text: Pedro estaba pidiendo pon a la estación del tren.
sense_031b67f39615516301583f23a7c31e5f.translation: Peter was asking for a ride to the train station.

sense_031b67f39615516301583f23a7c31e5f.text: ¿Me das pon a casa? Se me dañó el carro y me quedé a pie.
sense_031b67f39615516301583f23a7c31e5f.translation: Can you give me a ride home? My car broke down and I'm stuck.

sense_006c38427f703a2e01ce6bcce3ca6b79.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_006c38427f703a2e01ce6bcce3ca6b79.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_53478a5e7508304169e4a6b2783277c7.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_53478a5e7508304169e4a6b2783277c7.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_53478a5e7508304169e4a6b2783277c7.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_53478a5e7508304169e4a6b2783277c7.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_8ff6bb1ff509cdb8f2bd3a790843e05a.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_8ff6bb1ff509cdb8f2bd3a790843e05a.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_8ff6bb1ff509cdb8f2bd3a790843e05a.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_8ff6bb1ff509cdb8f2bd3a790843e05a.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_a98fa32ac1daf6720f2091e3bcda9ae3.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_dac847fac6b22563e5563f731e2770ab.text: El avión hizo un extraño al despegar.
sense_dac847fac6b22563e5563f731e2770ab.translation: The plane made a strange movement while taking off.

sense_dac847fac6b22563e5563f731e2770ab.text: El elefante hizo un extraño cuando vio el ratón.
sense_dac847fac6b22563e5563f731e2770ab.translation: The elephant shied when he saw a mouse.

sense_9c76860f6e6bded20f3824df0459194d.text: La tormenta proyectó la barca a través de la bahía.
sense_9c76860f6e6bded20f3824df0459194d.translation: The storm flung the small boat across the bay.

sense_9c76860f6e6bded20f3824df0459194d.text: El choque repentino proyectó a los pasajeros del bus hacia delante.
sense_9c76860f6e6bded20f3824df0459194d.translation: The sudden jolt threw the passengers on the bus forward.

sense_f664ee3730bbe9a9a12161fd9ebdb3f9.text: Los corderos comenzaron a balar intensamente cuando vieron al lobo.
sense_f664ee3730bbe9a9a12161fd9ebdb3f9.translation: The lambs began bleating intensely when they saw the wolf.

sense_f664ee3730bbe9a9a12161fd9ebdb3f9.text: Los corderos perdidos balaron hasta ser rescatados por el pastor.
sense_f664ee3730bbe9a9a12161fd9ebdb3f9.translation: The lost lambs bleated until the shepherd rescued them.

sense_dc9fcbca159923843be850da0a398325.text: Seguramente estarás bromeando. ¡Las manzanas son mucho mejores que las naranjas!
sense_dc9fcbca159923843be850da0a398325.translation: You must be joking. Apples are much better than oranges!
I'm sure she won't go without telling us.

sense_2fb4ca97ff21a2f4075e8567ac59c519.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_2fb4ca97ff21a2f4075e8567ac59c519.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_0bcb3a083127c2309aa267f1bed87f88.text: Podría ayudarlo pero no me da la gana.
sense_0bcb3a083127c2309aa267f1bed87f88.translation: I could help him but I don't feel like it.

sense_0bcb3a083127c2309aa267f1bed87f88.text: Quiero cumplir 18, trabajar y ganar mi propio dinero para comprar lo que me dé mi regalada gana.
sense_0bcb3a083127c2309aa267f1bed87f88.translation: I want to turn 18, get a job, and have my own money to buy whatever I damn well please.

sense_0690bec9261188374a262df3c5f55517.text: Me dan ganas de ir a las montañas.
sense_0690bec9261188374a262df3c5f55517.translation: I feel like going to the mountains.

sense_0690bec9261188374a262df3c5f55517.text: ¡Qué ganas tengo de salir a bailar!
sense_0690bec9261188374a262df3c5f55517.translation: I can't wait to go out dancing!

sense_b5f00afc5eca0276e357d90c4541ea46.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_b5f00afc5eca0276e357d90c4541ea46.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_b5f00afc5eca0276e357d90c4541ea46.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_b5f00afc5eca0276e357d90c4541ea46.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_603a3ef8facbe17f968294e36bed4e0c.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_603a3ef8facbe17f968294e36bed4e0c.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_603a3ef8facbe17f968294e36bed4e0c.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_603a3ef8facbe17f968294e36bed4e0c.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_2ac749b8d3b9220891d37584dce73ead.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_2ac749b8d3b9220891d37584dce73ead.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_2ac749b8d3b9220891d37584dce73ead.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_2ac749b8d3b9220891d37584dce73ead.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_b29af274c075695bde679b306e2392f1.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_b29af274c075695bde679b306e2392f1.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_e2fa11c3a501e38d862dc201d1e11265.text: Estas áreas protegidas aportan beneficios importantes para el bienestar humano.
sense_e2fa11c3a501e38d862dc201d1e11265.translation: These protected areas offer significant benefits for human well-being.

sense_e2fa11c3a501e38d862dc201d1e11265.text: Nuestras oficinas están dentro del área metropolitana de Washington DC.
sense_e2fa11c3a501e38d862dc201d1e11265.translation: Our offices are located within the metropolitan area of Washington DC.

sense_82769653c7ba7ea3d962d7c06b317095.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_82769653c7ba7ea3d962d7c06b317095.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_82769653c7ba7ea3d962d7c06b317095.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_82769653c7ba7ea3d962d7c06b317095.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_214770d319090502c950413bec87a46e.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_214770d319090502c950413bec87a46e.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_214770d319090502c950413bec87a46e.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_214770d319090502c950413bec87a46e.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_07a085db1b603f2a36facdafd35f012b.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_07a085db1b603f2a36facdafd35f012b.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_07a085db1b603f2a36facdafd35f012b.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_07a085db1b603f2a36facdafd35f012b.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_2a07c2d8a0690c4a6180c08f2c7a36b9.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_2a07c2d8a0690c4a6180c08f2c7a36b9.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_2a07c2d8a0690c4a6180c08f2c7a36b9.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_2a07c2d8a0690c4a6180c08f2c7a36b9.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_0eb97751c92df1838c7831916ca460a9.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_0eb97751c92df1838c7831916ca460a9.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_0eb97751c92df1838c7831916ca460a9.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_0eb97751c92df1838c7831916ca460a9.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_2a90bec3a9bbe8f8782446717ed3c94d.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_2a90bec3a9bbe8f8782446717ed3c94d.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_36262e9baeebc73c5c7d2ded157cc9de.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_36262e9baeebc73c5c7d2ded157cc9de.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_dc9aec7a6c8dd377e816c50909cf6d74.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_dc9aec7a6c8dd377e816c50909cf6d74.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_dc9aec7a6c8dd377e816c50909cf6d74.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_dc9aec7a6c8dd377e816c50909cf6d74.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_f2b44884f41e24a73b025ca9a9c6bbcb.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_f2b44884f41e24a73b025ca9a9c6bbcb.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_f2b44884f41e24a73b025ca9a9c6bbcb.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_f2b44884f41e24a73b025ca9a9c6bbcb.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_2e148029345c7b49e642ee145a1943e6.text: Encontré un cabello en la sopa. ¡Guácala!
sense_2e148029345c7b49e642ee145a1943e6.translation: I found a hair in my soup. Yuck!

sense_2e148029345c7b49e642ee145a1943e6.text: Tiene el cabello tan largo que a veces lo pisa al caminar.
sense_2e148029345c7b49e642ee145a1943e6.translation: Her hair is so long that she sometimes steps on it when she walks.

sense_422a27ecdde00f909b08aad1547d4013.text: Antonio dice que no se acuerda de ella.
sense_422a27ecdde00f909b08aad1547d4013.translation: Antonio says he doesn't remember her.

sense_422a27ecdde00f909b08aad1547d4013.text: Me acuerdo que la primera vez que vi "El imperio contraataca", lloré al final.
sense_422a27ecdde00f909b08aad1547d4013.translation: I remember that the first time I saw "The Empire Strikes Back", I cried at the end.

sense_1eff3c47a3133853b3f3d8d507bed86b.text: La artesanía que venden en el mercado está toda hecha a mano.
sense_1eff3c47a3133853b3f3d8d507bed86b.translation: The crafts sold at the market are all handmade.

sense_7cfd089c1d1df0260c6e7b28d5053736.text: Me gustan los filetes bien hechos.
sense_7cfd089c1d1df0260c6e7b28d5053736.translation: I like my steak well done.

sense_2cf8a02af577261c6d96d9dacb8ecf4a.text: Después de la mudanza, estaba hecha polvo.
sense_2cf8a02af577261c6d96d9dacb8ecf4a.translation: I was completely exhausted after we moved.

sense_2cf8a02af577261c6d96d9dacb8ecf4a.text: Esta casa está hecha un asco.

sense_6351aedec4165431fdf7cf292fffaa89.text: Por la presente le comunico que ha sido aceptado en nuestra facultad.
sense_6351aedec4165431fdf7cf292fffaa89.translation: I am writing to inform you that you have been accepted as a member of our faculty.

sense_6351aedec4165431fdf7cf292fffaa89.text: Por medio de la presente le informo que renuncio a mi puesto como contador.
sense_6351aedec4165431fdf7cf292fffaa89.translation: I hereby inform you that I am resigning from my position as accountant.

sense_094e7c38dcde832ccda426d6a3e9981a.text: Mis hijas estudian en un colegio cerca de la casa.
sense_094e7c38dcde832ccda426d6a3e9981a.translation: My daughters study at a school near our house.

sense_094e7c38dcde832ccda426d6a3e9981a.text: El hijo de mi jefe asiste al mismo colegio que mi hija.
sense_094e7c38dcde832ccda426d6a3e9981a.translation: My boss's son goes to the same school as my daughter.

sense_e47fa04cf60ca688863ab1d3d1459ddd.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_e47fa04cf60ca688863ab1d3d1459ddd.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_04605c99fb525492a615696fa64a31a5.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_04605c99fb525492a615696fa64a31a5.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_ae17839d704fbc9e68551a9a1e3e34fc.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_490b63140648d4b8e817538828e8726f.text: Me tomó toda la noche, pero ya terminé de pasar mi tesis a limpio.
sense_490b63140648d4b8e817538828e8726f.translation: It took all night, but I finished writing the final version of my thesis.

sense_490b63140648d4b8e817538828e8726f.text: Cuando me corrijas el borrador, voy a pasarlo a limpio para entregárselo mañana al maestro.
sense_490b63140648d4b8e817538828e8726f.translation: After you correct my rough draft, I am going to print out a clean copy to turn in to my teacher tomorrow.

sense_b81a0746a22348f374da76e699ff42dc.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_b81a0746a22348f374da76e699ff42dc.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_2765f06bf601c8959606d0fc758a824e.text: Duerme muy poco los fines de semana.
sense_2765f06bf601c8959606d0fc758a824e.translation: He doesn't sleep much on weekends.
We don't see much of each other lately.

sense_570e388f209960de28f5b0d4dc15d0ad.text: Hay pocos que se molestarían en ayudarlo como tú.
sense_570e388f209960de28f5b0d4dc15d0ad.translation: There are few who would bother helping him like you do.

sense_570e388f209960de28f5b0d4dc15d0ad.text: Menos mal que pocos piensan como él.
sense_570e388f209960de28f5b0d4dc15d0ad.translation: It's just as well not many people think like he does.

sense_a45c3677efdb7b0900db8e7ddc591971.text: Mi primo está enamorado de mi mejor amiga.
sense_a45c3677efdb7b0900db8e7ddc591971.translation: My cousin is in love with my best friend.

sense_a45c3677efdb7b0900db8e7ddc591971.text: ¡Estás enamorada y no lo puedes negar!
sense_a45c3677efdb7b0900db8e7ddc591971.translation: You're in love and you can't hide it!

sense_860a921ee13d12fcc50bd4b2377783e5.text: "Con estos versos, seguro la enamoro," dijo el poeta.
sense_860a921ee13d12fcc50bd4b2377783e5.translation: "With these verses, I'm sure to make her fall in love," said the poet.

sense_860a921ee13d12fcc50bd4b2377783e5.text: Enamoré a mi mujer haciéndome pasar por escritor, y en eso me convertí.
sense_860a921ee13d12fcc50bd4b2377783e5.translation: I made my wife fall in love with me by pretending to be a writer, and that's what I became.

sense_c4b981c3084b4f7fd041acdcb107525e.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_c4b981c3084b4f7fd041acdcb107525e.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_c4b981c3084b4f7fd041acdcb107525e.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_c4b981c3084b4f7fd041acdcb107525e.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_d0141589de0d4270c11b246f445bd246.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_d0141589de0d4270c11b246f445bd246.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_d0141589de0d4270c11b246f445bd246.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_d0141589de0d4270c11b246f445bd246.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_bf9b9cdf12f53339d8c7fa6065403f90.text: ¡Me pone negra que la gente sea tan maleducada!
sense_bf9b9cdf12f53339d8c7fa6065403f90.translation: It drives me crazy when people are so rude!

sense_fc4e131f42fe730e358a4a48498aa6b9.text: Nací en 1920 y, en aquellos días, no teníamos televisión.
sense_fc4e131f42fe730e358a4a48498aa6b9.translation: I was born in 1920, and in those days, we didn't have television.

sense_fc4e131f42fe730e358a4a48498aa6b9.text: Aquellas montañas a lo lejos son las más altas del país.
sense_fc4e131f42fe730e358a4a48498aa6b9.translation: Those mountains in the distance are the tallest in the country.

sense_a9a8a2726e9e01a776069b8191ac5456.text: Vi unas camisas parecidas a estas hace un tiempo, pero me gustaron más aquellas.
sense_a9a8a2726e9e01a776069b8191ac5456.translation: I saw some shirts like these ones a while ago, but I liked those more.

sense_a9a8a2726e9e01a776069b8191ac5456.text: ¿Te acuerdas de los sánduches que hacían aquí antes? - Sí, aquellos eran muy buenos.
sense_a9a8a2726e9e01a776069b8191ac5456.translation: Do you remember the sandwiches they used to make here? - Yeah, those were really good.

sense_b4159d959cbcbea8ad269a177ab256f1.text: Estas sillas son baratas, pero aquellas son más bonitas.
sense_b4159d959cbcbea8ad269a177ab256f1.translation: These chairs are cheap, but those ones are nicer.

sense_b4159d959cbcbea8ad269a177ab256f1.text: No quiero estos melocotones. Quiero aquellos.
sense_b4159d959cbcbea8ad269a177ab256f1.translation: I don't want these peaches. I want those ones.

sense_bc6ceb2eb8ead45909ebb726d648410d.text: Aquel coche estacionado allá es mío.
sense_bc6ceb2eb8ead45909ebb726d648410d.translation: That car parked over there is mine.

sense_bc6ceb2eb8ead45909ebb726d648410d.text: Me gusta mucho aquella casa que hay en lo alto de la colina.
sense_bc6ceb2eb8ead45909ebb726d648410d.translation: I really like that house on top of the hill.

sense_b23b509aab14e4cf45243d87428db395.text: No sé tú pero yo prefiero aquel.
sense_b23b509aab14e4cf45243d87428db395.translation: I don't know about you but I prefer that one.

sense_b23b509aab14e4cf45243d87428db395.text: Aquella es más grande que esta.
sense_b23b509aab14e4cf45243d87428db395.translation: That one is bigger than this one.

sense_8b260900b2c4702bd3e00ce545223d48.text: En esta economía, los trabajos seguros no abundan.
sense_8b260900b2c4702bd3e00ce545223d48.translation: In this economy, there aren't a lot of secure jobs.

sense_8b260900b2c4702bd3e00ce545223d48.text: No te encarames en esa silla, ¡no es segura!
sense_8b260900b2c4702bd3e00ce545223d48.translation: Don't climb up on that chair. It isn't secure!

sense_db6fd9993014fb02ebc42b394ffe0dec.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_db6fd9993014fb02ebc42b394ffe0dec.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_139c303e483a528e2070a291b7f07450.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_139c303e483a528e2070a291b7f07450.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_139c303e483a528e2070a291b7f07450.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_139c303e483a528e2070a291b7f07450.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_22c77d6aec560cfc1cec1fef9a5408ec.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_22c77d6aec560cfc1cec1fef9a5408ec.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_22c77d6aec560cfc1cec1fef9a5408ec.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_22c77d6aec560cfc1cec1fef9a5408ec.translation: Would you let me finish talking?
