sense_8b95b76bcd32df3986787d91fb1bb4af.text: La tienda está abierta por si quieres ir a comprar leche.
sense_8b95b76bcd32df3986787d91fb1bb4af.translation: The store is open in case you want to go buy milk.

sense_7d587b7625ef17eac079446c3ad33b02.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_7d587b7625ef17eac079446c3ad33b02.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_7d587b7625ef17eac079446c3ad33b02.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_7d587b7625ef17eac079446c3ad33b02.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_520b73aa448966670d49867bfe3fe06d.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_520b73aa448966670d49867bfe3fe06d.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_520b73aa448966670d49867bfe3fe06d.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_520b73aa448966670d49867bfe3fe06d.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_72fcba27b088a0073e5b05c411ea8348.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_3185bd43ac0ac1f4de156af3f60bac1b.text: Te veo después de las clases.
Yo regreso a mi pueblo cuando acaban las clases y empiezan las vacaciones de verano.
sense_3185bd43ac0ac1f4de156af3f60bac1b.translation: I return to my hometown when school is over and the summer break starts.

sense_0be1a7abe5c0e485e76441e025bd8e27.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_0be1a7abe5c0e485e76441e025bd8e27.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_36e69c9ffd1bc1a8f27e7eb4f6856f76.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_36e69c9ffd1bc1a8f27e7eb4f6856f76.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_18e7f5eb8fd5e8138753ab60e14c5f76.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_18e7f5eb8fd5e8138753ab60e14c5f76.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_18e7f5eb8fd5e8138753ab60e14c5f76.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_18e7f5eb8fd5e8138753ab60e14c5f76.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_cff089825e95a4c52ef7146cef2aa5cb.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_cff089825e95a4c52ef7146cef2aa5cb.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_cff089825e95a4c52ef7146cef2aa5cb.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_cff089825e95a4c52ef7146cef2aa5cb.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_a863332ad40ac74837601a7f2f60f4bd.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_a863332ad40ac74837601a7f2f60f4bd.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_a863332ad40ac74837601a7f2f60f4bd.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_a863332ad40ac74837601a7f2f60f4bd.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_a3562a98c59a977b350e66945f675ae2.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_a3562a98c59a977b350e66945f675ae2.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_a3562a98c59a977b350e66945f675ae2.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_a3562a98c59a977b350e66945f675ae2.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_3fd9849a04b9c4fad38976f567aa19d8.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_3fd9849a04b9c4fad38976f567aa19d8.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_2e2880d988b2434997b744e56847d004.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_2e2880d988b2434997b744e56847d004.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_2e2880d988b2434997b744e56847d004.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_2e2880d988b2434997b744e56847d004.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_d92272a4edb8a5e62c285b7d9ff67113.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_d92272a4edb8a5e62c285b7d9ff67113.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_d92272a4edb8a5e62c285b7d9ff67113.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_d92272a4edb8a5e62c285b7d9ff67113.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_dca1b77df076f7f0fd780255ff73a1b0.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_dca1b77df076f7f0fd780255ff73a1b0.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_dca1b77df076f7f0fd780255ff73a1b0.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_dca1b77df076f7f0fd780255ff73a1b0.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_bdcf669f9367ad447c392e29c56e2134.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_bdcf669f9367ad447c392e29c56e2134.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_bdcf669f9367ad447c392e29c56e2134.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_bdcf669f9367ad447c392e29c56e2134.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_245fb9ce870170bed9a57faf05c161fe.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_245fb9ce870170bed9a57faf05c161fe.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_245fb9ce870170bed9a57faf05c161fe.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_245fb9ce870170bed9a57faf05c161fe.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_a76e23e67e1049a175161870bf1c344a.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_a76e23e67e1049a175161870bf1c344a.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_a76e23e67e1049a175161870bf1c344a.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_a76e23e67e1049a175161870bf1c344a.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_f957e6bed7775e76619ff6453c8a6677.text: El programa era tan aburrido que me dormí.
sense_f957e6bed7775e76619ff6453c8a6677.translation: The program was so boring that I fell asleep.

sense_f957e6bed7775e76619ff6453c8a6677.text: Me dormí a las 6 de la mañana.
sense_f957e6bed7775e76619ff6453c8a6677.translation: I fell asleep at 6 in the morning.

sense_4488a1179adad61c08b4f17be25e903e.text: No te duermas o no acabarás a tiempo.
sense_4488a1179adad61c08b4f17be25e903e.translation: Don't slack off or you won't finish in time.

sense_4488a1179adad61c08b4f17be25e903e.text: Por dormirse se perdió la clave para ganar el premio.
sense_4488a1179adad61c08b4f17be25e903e.translation: He missed the clue to win the prize because he didn't stay on his toes.

sense_88d0fed0a2cc09e51585f4c24462c644.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_88d0fed0a2cc09e51585f4c24462c644.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_88d0fed0a2cc09e51585f4c24462c644.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_88d0fed0a2cc09e51585f4c24462c644.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_c0644e4fdcf39f1c9c7e0dabb0aea5f0.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_c0644e4fdcf39f1c9c7e0dabb0aea5f0.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_c0644e4fdcf39f1c9c7e0dabb0aea5f0.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_c0644e4fdcf39f1c9c7e0dabb0aea5f0.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_0b3ae310bdb599155c55aa9b08d0efad.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_0b3ae310bdb599155c55aa9b08d0efad.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_0516a9d4aacdb5e54f74756d5cbc04c5.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_0516a9d4aacdb5e54f74756d5cbc04c5.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_0516a9d4aacdb5e54f74756d5cbc04c5.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_0516a9d4aacdb5e54f74756d5cbc04c5.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_ebb1a5b7e5682e7708cd4a02436815ab.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_ebb1a5b7e5682e7708cd4a02436815ab.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_ebb1a5b7e5682e7708cd4a02436815ab.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_ebb1a5b7e5682e7708cd4a02436815ab.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_98e97cf15b18e3fa20c5cb34668ea1ab.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_98e97cf15b18e3fa20c5cb34668ea1ab.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_0414f26d132f046726a8a08ca965931d.text: La culpa es tuya. - ¿Mía? ¡Hay que joderse! ¡Pero si yo ni siquiera estaba aquí!
sense_0414f26d132f046726a8a08ca965931d.translation: It's your fault. - My fault? For fuck's sake! But I wasn't even here!

sense_0414f26d132f046726a8a08ca965931d.text: No me dejaron ustedes nada de comida. - ¡Te jodes! Es tu culpa por llegar tarde.
sense_0414f26d132f046726a8a08ca965931d.translation: You didn't leave any food for me. - Tough shit! It's your fault for being late.

sense_98e9f0570a3113a7c44112a5ad2fb957.text: Pablo ama a su esposa con todo su ser.
sense_98e9f0570a3113a7c44112a5ad2fb957.translation: Pablo loves his wife with all his heart.

sense_98e9f0570a3113a7c44112a5ad2fb957.text: Yo te amo, Ana, y quiero pasar el resto de mi vida contigo.
sense_98e9f0570a3113a7c44112a5ad2fb957.translation: I love you, Ana, and I want to spend the rest of my life with you.

sense_aa59db2e1b7575286b6a71b39b20a7a5.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_aa59db2e1b7575286b6a71b39b20a7a5.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_b8e01f4c7df763fd6101a0e0a761cd3a.text: ¡Me pone negra que la gente sea tan maleducada!
sense_b8e01f4c7df763fd6101a0e0a761cd3a.translation: It drives me crazy when people are so rude!

sense_756c22a39a2f2822824c36be665c6e20.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_756c22a39a2f2822824c36be665c6e20.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_0ea82870a3977250ed7fcdb976260dbf.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_0ea82870a3977250ed7fcdb976260dbf.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_3be6662e0e9a5d17ffea9bd0089b7660.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_3be6662e0e9a5d17ffea9bd0089b7660.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_3be6662e0e9a5d17ffea9bd0089b7660.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_3be6662e0e9a5d17ffea9bd0089b7660.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_78e530228ed583a07ff3f2f1f9554845.text: Ser bailarina requiere de disciplina, fuerza y voluntad.
sense_78e530228ed583a07ff3f2f1f9554845.translation: Being a ballerina requires discipline, strength, and will.

sense_78e530228ed583a07ff3f2f1f9554845.text: Es la voluntad de los votantes que esta ley sea rechazada.
sense_78e530228ed583a07ff3f2f1f9554845.translation: It is the will of the voters that this law be overturned.

sense_5994d0177c6e2ff018847fc15637ca89.text: Dicen que el alcalde recibió dinero de fuentes sospechosas.
sense_5994d0177c6e2ff018847fc15637ca89.translation: They say that the mayor received money from shady sources.

sense_5994d0177c6e2ff018847fc15637ca89.text: La víctima recibió un fuerte golpe al lado de la cabeza.
sense_5994d0177c6e2ff018847fc15637ca89.translation: The victim received a strong blow to the side of the head.

sense_f132dde3e0ac274a7a914cd384d741b3.text: El equipo visitante fue recibido con silbidos y abucheos.
sense_f132dde3e0ac274a7a914cd384d741b3.translation: The visiting team was received with whistles and jeers.

sense_f132dde3e0ac274a7a914cd384d741b3.text: Nos recibió personalmente en el aeropuerto.
sense_f132dde3e0ac274a7a914cd384d741b3.translation: He personally welcomed us at the airport.

sense_45b358b49c690ee1a6fc44f7e7b1ee23.text: Mi hermana se recibió de ingeniera en Georgia Tech.
sense_45b358b49c690ee1a6fc44f7e7b1ee23.translation: My sister graduated as an engineer from Georgia Tech.
How many students will graduate this year?

sense_0bad7b56da85daf5f1c57f21c85cfc95.text: Mis abuelos son naturales de Italia, pero emigraron a Nueva York en los años 40.
sense_0bad7b56da85daf5f1c57f21c85cfc95.translation: My grandparents are natives of Italy, but they emigrated to New York in the 1940s.

sense_0bad7b56da85daf5f1c57f21c85cfc95.text: He vivido aquí desde que era un niño, pero, en realidad, soy natural de las Islas Canarias.
sense_0bad7b56da85daf5f1c57f21c85cfc95.translation: I've been living here since I was a kid, but I actually come from the Canary Islands.

sense_fc06d06981a8e41878ec8122b8502ba9.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_fc06d06981a8e41878ec8122b8502ba9.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_da071dbd6b11cb6df43c3433c092e764.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_da071dbd6b11cb6df43c3433c092e764.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_da071dbd6b11cb6df43c3433c092e764.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_da071dbd6b11cb6df43c3433c092e764.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_6c3bcbd741a695b0e7c189834f121a0c.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_6c3bcbd741a695b0e7c189834f121a0c.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_69db9d4fe8f04786c2c68babc8d9eb95.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_69db9d4fe8f04786c2c68babc8d9eb95.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_5238d14dc319582788438c70ed3f5f43.text: Si las miradas mataran, ya no estaría aquí.
sense_5238d14dc319582788438c70ed3f5f43.translation: If looks could kill, I would not be here.
Her sad look conveyed a lot.

sense_09d227bc3dc35c647176d167cb487916.text: El policía le clavó la mirada al hombre sospechoso.
sense_09d227bc3dc35c647176d167cb487916.translation: The police offer fixed his eyes on the suspicious man.

sense_09d227bc3dc35c647176d167cb487916.text: Tomás bajó la mirada porque estaba avergonzado.
sense_09d227bc3dc35c647176d167cb487916.translation: Tomas looked away because he was embarrassed.

sense_8fe8aab8a0dd40c760b645e42ebc7d40.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_8fe8aab8a0dd40c760b645e42ebc7d40.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_f89aa2347b52fefc1f97abab3f83f9e8.text: Cuando yo era joven, no estaba bien mirado que una pareja se juntase sin estar casada.
sense_f89aa2347b52fefc1f97abab3f83f9e8.translation: When I was young, it was frowned upon for a couple to live together without being married.

sense_f89aa2347b52fefc1f97abab3f83f9e8.text: Si es lo que de verdad quieres hacer, no deberías preocuparte de si está bien o mal mirado.
sense_f89aa2347b52fefc1f97abab3f83f9e8.translation: If that's what you really want to do, you shouldn't worry whether it's something people approve or don't approve of.

sense_9d89cdc270fb4f3e38c4bf1e0529200f.text: Ya es hora de rendirte a la evidencia y admitir que te equivocaste.
sense_9d89cdc270fb4f3e38c4bf1e0529200f.translation: It's time to bow to the evidence and admit that you are wrong.

sense_9d89cdc270fb4f3e38c4bf1e0529200f.text: Ramírez se rindió ante la evidencia, se dio cuenta de que lo habían atrapado y confesó que era culpable.
sense_9d89cdc270fb4f3e38c4bf1e0529200f.translation: Ramirez faced the facts, realized that he'd been caught, and confessed he was guilty.

sense_479f4261005d6721e256f11d5741043d.text: El entrevistador dejó al político en evidencia con preguntas incisivas.
sense_479f4261005d6721e256f11d5741043d.translation: The interviewer showed the politician up with incisive questions.

sense_479f4261005d6721e256f11d5741043d.text: Una investigación científica puso en evidencia la falsedad de la supuesta cura.
sense_479f4261005d6721e256f11d5741043d.translation: A scientific investigation demonstrated the falsity of the alleged cure.

sense_2b2d44ef601a966e54e4fa09930f2275.text: Huele a gas en este cuarto.
sense_2b2d44ef601a966e54e4fa09930f2275.translation: It smells like gas in this room.

sense_a56f77a3e3489df5f4ff440cdd719074.text: Este acuerdo me huele a corrupción.
A mi papá le huele que el vecino se está robando sus periódicos.
sense_a56f77a3e3489df5f4ff440cdd719074.translation: My father suspects that the neighbor is stealing his newspapers.

sense_0fa6f358c1534bf7c2f1eb319a31a1aa.text: Las olas eran muy grandes, pero los expertos surfistas fueron dueños de la situación.
sense_0fa6f358c1534bf7c2f1eb319a31a1aa.translation: The waves were very big, but the expert surfers were in control of the situation.

sense_0fa6f358c1534bf7c2f1eb319a31a1aa.text: La reunión empezó a desmoronarse hasta que el abogado habló y se hizo dueño de la situación.
sense_0fa6f358c1534bf7c2f1eb319a31a1aa.translation: The meeting was starting to fall apart until the lawyer spoke and took control of the situation.

sense_b382bfd71ffff5d7126d7a630d6af960.text: ¿Averiguaste qué era lo que le pasaba?
sense_b382bfd71ffff5d7126d7a630d6af960.translation: Did you find out what was wrong with him?

sense_b382bfd71ffff5d7126d7a630d6af960.text: No me sé el número de Gabriela, pero te lo puedo averiguar.
sense_b382bfd71ffff5d7126d7a630d6af960.translation: I don't know Gabriela's number, but I can find out for you.

sense_3e8e9a8a1cd50185a53f7501f84a95c2.text: Ese comentario no me hizo ninguna gracia.
sense_3e8e9a8a1cd50185a53f7501f84a95c2.translation: I didn't find that comment at all funny.

sense_3e8e9a8a1cd50185a53f7501f84a95c2.text: No te rías; no tiene gracia.

sense_681e835c5019cf0690ba3f8364da851a.translation: We all want to grow old gracefully.

sense_b71c3f8d7f1db238e6ac7e973cdc58bd.text: Me pidieron trabajar todo el fin de semana. ¡Vaya gracia!
sense_b71c3f8d7f1db238e6ac7e973cdc58bd.translation: I've been asked to work all weekend. Great!

sense_b71c3f8d7f1db238e6ac7e973cdc58bd.text: ¡Qué gracia tener que sacar al perro cuando está lloviendo!
sense_b71c3f8d7f1db238e6ac7e973cdc58bd.translation: How annoying having to take the dog out when it's raining!

sense_2395d29620edae474c73db36543f55e7.text: Quiero hacerle un regalo para darle las gracias.
sense_2395d29620edae474c73db36543f55e7.translation: I'd like to give him a present as a thank you.
Thank you for all your help.

sense_9f304f5760283c44a8d8d9c1c6284916.text: Doy gracias al cielo por tener un hijo tan simpático.
sense_9f304f5760283c44a8d8d9c1c6284916.translation: I thank heaven that I have such a nice son.

sense_9f304f5760283c44a8d8d9c1c6284916.text: Tengo que dar las gracias a Juan Franco Agudo por haberme dado esta oportunidad.
sense_9f304f5760283c44a8d8d9c1c6284916.translation: I must thank Juan Franco Agudo for giving me this opportunity.

sense_eb94798cc6d25e50fcf0383f2423402f.text: Dicen que el alcalde recibió dinero de fuentes sospechosas.
sense_eb94798cc6d25e50fcf0383f2423402f.translation: They say that the mayor received money from shady sources.

sense_eb94798cc6d25e50fcf0383f2423402f.text: La víctima recibió un fuerte golpe al lado de la cabeza.
sense_eb94798cc6d25e50fcf0383f2423402f.translation: The victim received a strong blow to the side of the head.

sense_391a807914a253c9b4e7bcc0ed465fed.text: El equipo visitante fue recibido con silbidos y abucheos.
sense_391a807914a253c9b4e7bcc0ed465fed.translation: The visiting team was received with whistles and jeers.

sense_391a807914a253c9b4e7bcc0ed465fed.text: Nos recibió personalmente en el aeropuerto.
sense_391a807914a253c9b4e7bcc0ed465fed.translation: He personally welcomed us at the airport.

sense_ef4356b741f1eabf5de050fa0e66d43a.text: Mi hermana se recibió de ingeniera en Georgia Tech.
sense_ef4356b741f1eabf5de050fa0e66d43a.translation: My sister graduated as an engineer from Georgia Tech.
How many students will graduate this year?

sense_a84f77c096c6221c7efb15c06d73bd55.text: Juan estuvo practicando para darle efecto al balón.
sense_a84f77c096c6221c7efb15c06d73bd55.translation: Juan has been practicing making the ball swerve.

sense_a84f77c096c6221c7efb15c06d73bd55.text: ¿Cómo se le da efecto a la pelota?
sense_a84f77c096c6221c7efb15c06d73bd55.translation: How do you get the ball to swerve?

sense_e133f2e03572a3a6a5c22cafe392127f.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_e133f2e03572a3a6a5c22cafe392127f.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_e133f2e03572a3a6a5c22cafe392127f.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_e133f2e03572a3a6a5c22cafe392127f.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_c084d360ca1b880c98b4094188d40b21.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_c084d360ca1b880c98b4094188d40b21.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_c084d360ca1b880c98b4094188d40b21.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_c084d360ca1b880c98b4094188d40b21.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_abc6fda7dfc746c68a4138ec54fa0f34.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_6be6dddfa463a7d9913bdacdc4ade3e0.text: Las redes sociales me ayudan a mantener las relaciones con mis compañeros de la preparatoria.
sense_6be6dddfa463a7d9913bdacdc4ade3e0.translation: Social networks help me to keep in touch with my high-school classmates.

sense_6be6dddfa463a7d9913bdacdc4ade3e0.text: Los dos gobiernos tratan de evitar que se rompan las relaciones entre sus dos países.
sense_6be6dddfa463a7d9913bdacdc4ade3e0.translation: Both governments are trying to avoid breaking off relations between their two countries.

sense_19655c436ba3a5844f6aef9e042e2aec.text: El seguro de desempleo debe guardar relación con los ingresos obtenidos previamente.
sense_19655c436ba3a5844f6aef9e042e2aec.translation: Unemployment insurance should be related to previously earned income.

sense_19655c436ba3a5844f6aef9e042e2aec.text: Los dos casos no guardan relación alguna el uno con el otro.
sense_19655c436ba3a5844f6aef9e042e2aec.translation: The two cases bear absolutely no relation to each other.

sense_0cc4e7a93231a69833ed8f7f3f5c58ed.text: Juan y Gaby llevan tres meses de relación.
sense_0cc4e7a93231a69833ed8f7f3f5c58ed.translation: Juan and Gaby have been going out for three months.

sense_0cc4e7a93231a69833ed8f7f3f5c58ed.text: ¿Sabías que Rubén ya no mantiene su relación con aquella mujer casada?
sense_0cc4e7a93231a69833ed8f7f3f5c58ed.translation: Did you know Ruben wasn't going out with that married woman anymore?

sense_d76ae6355227e26a63f00f1a4db40784.text: Nuestra tienda le da una buena relación entre precio y calidad.
sense_d76ae6355227e26a63f00f1a4db40784.translation: Our store offers value for money.

sense_d76ae6355227e26a63f00f1a4db40784.text: Esta marca cuesta un poco más, pero tiene la mejor relación calidad-precio.
sense_d76ae6355227e26a63f00f1a4db40784.translation: This brand costs a little more, but it is the best value.

sense_8b2748cd0ea286135ae67e3dd83b4a2e.text: La tienda está abierta por si quieres ir a comprar leche.
sense_8b2748cd0ea286135ae67e3dd83b4a2e.translation: The store is open in case you want to go buy milk.

sense_dc7621e5aea7432694ac45518967634e.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_dc7621e5aea7432694ac45518967634e.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_dc7621e5aea7432694ac45518967634e.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_dc7621e5aea7432694ac45518967634e.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_bc01fff9ccbd0b1f1a7f71ac0acc2edd.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_bc01fff9ccbd0b1f1a7f71ac0acc2edd.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_59884056dd1df914451b2dcebb8eebc2.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_59884056dd1df914451b2dcebb8eebc2.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_4d66d492e9610cfbdb5c81a5b88d706e.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_4d66d492e9610cfbdb5c81a5b88d706e.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_20f332158f3f261ce01727dcfa2102f5.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_20f332158f3f261ce01727dcfa2102f5.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_20f332158f3f261ce01727dcfa2102f5.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_20f332158f3f261ce01727dcfa2102f5.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_10f2dcc14f0ba29fc6da7a814071d735.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_10f2dcc14f0ba29fc6da7a814071d735.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_10f2dcc14f0ba29fc6da7a814071d735.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_10f2dcc14f0ba29fc6da7a814071d735.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_7b77f2fc31400482e3aed30a609961af.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_7b77f2fc31400482e3aed30a609961af.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_7b77f2fc31400482e3aed30a609961af.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_7b77f2fc31400482e3aed30a609961af.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_86741133ab7d6f673a4722593b4fbae6.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_86741133ab7d6f673a4722593b4fbae6.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_97c7bc977ec723de34ef167ae14d1bb3.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_97c7bc977ec723de34ef167ae14d1bb3.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_97c7bc977ec723de34ef167ae14d1bb3.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_97c7bc977ec723de34ef167ae14d1bb3.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_b09eaddba3356939f59a7b64c8ca8385.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_b09eaddba3356939f59a7b64c8ca8385.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_65cfd6fbf673f6f6113dd6127986e655.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_65cfd6fbf673f6f6113dd6127986e655.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_65cfd6fbf673f6f6113dd6127986e655.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_65cfd6fbf673f6f6113dd6127986e655.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_9a360685b2f028ecef08ae385674fffa.text: Se busca oficial u oficiala de fontanería.
Se solicita oficial electricista para realizar trabajos en una fábrica de ropa.
sense_9a360685b2f028ecef08ae385674fffa.translation: Time-served electrician required to carry out jobs at a clothes factory.

sense_26cecafe2aab72f319cd1a30ea8d1ffc.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_26cecafe2aab72f319cd1a30ea8d1ffc.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_abd51e577d909f2194792fd88c369186.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_abd51e577d909f2194792fd88c369186.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_8b8a30907f449f36f56cab09557be95e.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_8b8a30907f449f36f56cab09557be95e.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_8b8a30907f449f36f56cab09557be95e.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_8b8a30907f449f36f56cab09557be95e.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_28d4a2bddd00e1e06fbd96fef1bc0e2a.text: Creo que su intención era viajar y trabajar en el extranjero.
sense_28d4a2bddd00e1e06fbd96fef1bc0e2a.translation: I think traveling and working abroad were part of her plans.

sense_28d4a2bddd00e1e06fbd96fef1bc0e2a.text: Lo siento. No era mi intención faltarle el respeto a tu padre.
sense_28d4a2bddd00e1e06fbd96fef1bc0e2a.translation: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to disrespect your father.

sense_192f6994444e0c744c13eaebe611aea9.text: Nunca tuvieron intenciones de ayudarnos. Lo dijeron solo para quedar bien.
sense_192f6994444e0c744c13eaebe611aea9.translation: They never intended to help us. They said it just to make themselves look good.

sense_192f6994444e0c744c13eaebe611aea9.text: Teníamos intenciones de ir al cine, pero acabamos en la disco.
sense_192f6994444e0c744c13eaebe611aea9.translation: We intended to go to the movies, but ended up in the disco.

sense_f61b0261461bee48650249dc9fb49ff7.text: Tengo los mejores recuerdos de la casa de lago de mis abuelos.
sense_f61b0261461bee48650249dc9fb49ff7.translation: I have the best memories from my grandparents' lake house.

sense_f61b0261461bee48650249dc9fb49ff7.text: Tengo un recuerdo vívido de la vez que visité el Panteón de Dolores en el DF.
sense_f61b0261461bee48650249dc9fb49ff7.translation: I have a vivid memory of the time I visited Dolores Cemetery in Mexico City.

sense_0ea1c7bccd634aa7539410b9b9d44016.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_0ea1c7bccd634aa7539410b9b9d44016.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_61892276d64b33fdb91d5c013a57c366.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_61892276d64b33fdb91d5c013a57c366.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_d73ee20031777f998ab98af40de87502.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_d73ee20031777f998ab98af40de87502.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_79e19589856ef6ed30a5af8480b7ff7c.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_79e19589856ef6ed30a5af8480b7ff7c.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_79e19589856ef6ed30a5af8480b7ff7c.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_79e19589856ef6ed30a5af8480b7ff7c.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_1a4e8161a8c4c4b2c2051f1175de4690.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_1a4e8161a8c4c4b2c2051f1175de4690.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_789ecfe1a51c02ccf4df404beed58959.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_789ecfe1a51c02ccf4df404beed58959.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_ae32090c10a745a5bab3dde77caa2df8.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_ae32090c10a745a5bab3dde77caa2df8.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_fa128bdda64a166800b013fd96c7219f.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_fa128bdda64a166800b013fd96c7219f.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_0d15fbb93183aac6d97311c561785647.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_0d15fbb93183aac6d97311c561785647.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_0d15fbb93183aac6d97311c561785647.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_0d15fbb93183aac6d97311c561785647.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_ade94e91d8b4b9699e5dbacfa969796e.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_ade94e91d8b4b9699e5dbacfa969796e.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_ade94e91d8b4b9699e5dbacfa969796e.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_ade94e91d8b4b9699e5dbacfa969796e.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_8f20118c6b4581394f1032252ec3cedf.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_8f20118c6b4581394f1032252ec3cedf.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_8f20118c6b4581394f1032252ec3cedf.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_8f20118c6b4581394f1032252ec3cedf.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_656aff14eb1ff457bf3cff43e34dd180.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_656aff14eb1ff457bf3cff43e34dd180.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_b48f715338394afe83f32165d9671a72.text: Me pidió que escribiera una disculpa al grupo.
sense_b48f715338394afe83f32165d9671a72.translation: He asked me to write an apology to the group.

sense_b8761a049debb0fcb5e960412a345190.text: Disculpa, no te he visto trabajando allí. Me pondré los cascos.
sense_b8761a049debb0fcb5e960412a345190.translation: I'm sorry, I didn't see you there working. I'll put headphones in.

sense_b8761a049debb0fcb5e960412a345190.text: Disculpe, por favor. ¿Me dice dónde está la parada del metro?
sense_b8761a049debb0fcb5e960412a345190.translation: Excuse me, please. Can you tell me where the subway station is?

sense_583c3498c8150ed66adb45c348948847.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_583c3498c8150ed66adb45c348948847.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_8b4bb44fb79c6cdc691e529909ac17e0.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_8b4bb44fb79c6cdc691e529909ac17e0.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_c1cd86cbd00a06a2dfda1ae56bb8a526.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_c1cd86cbd00a06a2dfda1ae56bb8a526.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_c1cd86cbd00a06a2dfda1ae56bb8a526.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_c1cd86cbd00a06a2dfda1ae56bb8a526.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_6a027cb06e6cdd312d8fa8b84b8411d0.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_6a027cb06e6cdd312d8fa8b84b8411d0.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_c0e0a77bab280417b4a68e0a777a6e5c.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_c0e0a77bab280417b4a68e0a777a6e5c.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_c0e0a77bab280417b4a68e0a777a6e5c.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_c0e0a77bab280417b4a68e0a777a6e5c.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_67e803b652014e519f726f255cfe3ead.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_67e803b652014e519f726f255cfe3ead.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_a69afc51cddcd7b1287c19b65f5f0275.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_a69afc51cddcd7b1287c19b65f5f0275.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_a69afc51cddcd7b1287c19b65f5f0275.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_a69afc51cddcd7b1287c19b65f5f0275.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_b6694f65f66518792aba3e5593a3ff03.text: Marte era el dios romano de la guerra.
sense_b6694f65f66518792aba3e5593a3ff03.translation: Mars was the Roman god of war.

sense_b6694f65f66518792aba3e5593a3ff03.text: Los antiguos griegos creían en muchos dioses.
sense_b6694f65f66518792aba3e5593a3ff03.translation: The ancient Greeks believed in many gods.

sense_b6302b7877ed1bee542e01befaffd2a2.text: Abrazar a tu bebé te hace sentir una felicidad total.
sense_b6302b7877ed1bee542e01befaffd2a2.translation: Hugging your baby gives you a feeling of total happiness.

sense_b6302b7877ed1bee542e01befaffd2a2.text: Te amo, y tu felicidad es lo único que me importa.
sense_b6302b7877ed1bee542e01befaffd2a2.translation: I love you, and your happiness is all that matters to me.

sense_9470b6ebbc655c11869e0987c340a30a.text: ¡Felicidades en sus bodas de plata! ¡Cómo pasa el tiempo!
sense_9470b6ebbc655c11869e0987c340a30a.translation: Congratulations on your silver wedding anniversary! Time flies!

sense_9470b6ebbc655c11869e0987c340a30a.text: Nos hemos comprometido, nos casaremos en mayo. - ¡Felicidades! ¡Cuánto me alegro!
sense_9470b6ebbc655c11869e0987c340a30a.translation: We're engaged. We're getting married in May. - Congratulations! I'm so glad!

sense_f3584ceca08b9b97ec2f2a9a9753fc58.text: ¡Feliz Navidad! - ¡Sí, felicidades! Vendrán a cenar en Nochevieja, ¿verdad?
sense_f3584ceca08b9b97ec2f2a9a9753fc58.translation: Merry Christmas! - Yes, Merry Christmas! You're coming for dinner on New Year's Eve, aren't you?

sense_f7d268b69631ddf78d0e771852f838d6.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_f7d268b69631ddf78d0e771852f838d6.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_f7d268b69631ddf78d0e771852f838d6.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_f7d268b69631ddf78d0e771852f838d6.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_6f5cf64176859eceeea822e791f19088.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_6f5cf64176859eceeea822e791f19088.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_6f5cf64176859eceeea822e791f19088.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_6f5cf64176859eceeea822e791f19088.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_5f02bfe6e991ecfcab018a454bec263c.text: Mi padre era víctima de una rara dolencia.
sense_5f02bfe6e991ecfcab018a454bec263c.translation: My father suffered from a rare illness.

sense_5f02bfe6e991ecfcab018a454bec263c.text: Falleció víctima de un accidente cerebrovascular.

sense_699d88985366591e8c47d101b4b7501e.text: Me parece que el ministro debería dimitir.
sense_699d88985366591e8c47d101b4b7501e.translation: I think the minister should resign.

sense_699d88985366591e8c47d101b4b7501e.text: ¿Qué te pareció la serie sobre la familia real? - Me pareció una tontería.
sense_699d88985366591e8c47d101b4b7501e.translation: What did you think of the series about the royal family? - I thought it was nonsense.

sense_9833f2fdbe42e4b1831641ac0575a8a1.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_9833f2fdbe42e4b1831641ac0575a8a1.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_9833f2fdbe42e4b1831641ac0575a8a1.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_9833f2fdbe42e4b1831641ac0575a8a1.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_dfc7d63ad12ce2d31593f5044d729d7e.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_dfc7d63ad12ce2d31593f5044d729d7e.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_dfc7d63ad12ce2d31593f5044d729d7e.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_dfc7d63ad12ce2d31593f5044d729d7e.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_a9d66b5209b090ebb001ce5172be6457.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_fe9e2dd04c641b65cbcf5f1706f9bf3b.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_00cb876c156a8a394c4dc0b5b61a1f38.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_00cb876c156a8a394c4dc0b5b61a1f38.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_00cb876c156a8a394c4dc0b5b61a1f38.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_00cb876c156a8a394c4dc0b5b61a1f38.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_03089c250c299b341842e29d1dd249fc.text: Creo que es prudente que mantengamos este secreto entre nosotras por ahora.
sense_03089c250c299b341842e29d1dd249fc.translation: I think it's prudent for us to keep this secret between ourselves for now.

sense_03089c250c299b341842e29d1dd249fc.text: Si no nos quieren ayudar a construir el castillo de arena, no hay problema. Lo haremos nosotras. No necesitamos de su ayuda.
sense_03089c250c299b341842e29d1dd249fc.translation: If you don't want to help us build our sandcastle, it's fine. We'll do it ourselves. We don't need your help.

sense_0acc1d5ce4024e205b638bf4fbb4650a.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_0acc1d5ce4024e205b638bf4fbb4650a.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_aad3b923abd10ae12ab389a301458c32.text: Estaba tan asustado después de ver al fantasma que no podía hablar.
sense_aad3b923abd10ae12ab389a301458c32.translation: He was so scared after seeing the ghost that he couldn't speak.

sense_aad3b923abd10ae12ab389a301458c32.text: ¿Por qué estás asustado? Es solo un gatito. No te va a hacer nada.
sense_aad3b923abd10ae12ab389a301458c32.translation: Why are you scared? It's just a kitten. It's not going to hurt you.

sense_834d1e00a40a17e84ad64d252de3a2a4.text: A ver quién es el guapo que se come esto.
sense_834d1e00a40a17e84ad64d252de3a2a4.translation: Let's see who's brave enough to eat this.

sense_834d1e00a40a17e84ad64d252de3a2a4.text: Se cree el guapo por haber defendido a esas viejitas.
sense_834d1e00a40a17e84ad64d252de3a2a4.translation: He thinks he's brave because he defended those little old ladies.

sense_4ba3d22b915091dbc383c57f7ae5218c.text: Mamá, voy a salir esta noche. - ¡Que te lo has creído, guapa! Tienes que estudiar.
sense_4ba3d22b915091dbc383c57f7ae5218c.translation: Mom, I'm going out tonight. - You must be joking! You have to study.

sense_4ba3d22b915091dbc383c57f7ae5218c.text: ¿Pagas tú las cervezas? - Oye, guapo, que te toca pagar a ti. Yo pagué la última vez.
sense_4ba3d22b915091dbc383c57f7ae5218c.translation: Will you pay for the beers? - Hey, it's your turn to pay. I paid last time.

sense_640510c3b5bda1759c310c17c4faab53.text: No compramos la casa porque esquinaba con un taller.
sense_640510c3b5bda1759c310c17c4faab53.translation: We didn't buy the house because it was around the corner from a repair shop.

sense_640510c3b5bda1759c310c17c4faab53.text: El accidente tuvo lugar donde el parque esquina con la calle principal.
sense_640510c3b5bda1759c310c17c4faab53.translation: The accident happened on the corner of the park and main street.

sense_0b897f8519fe30f4d112a4dcbc89518d.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_0b897f8519fe30f4d112a4dcbc89518d.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_0b897f8519fe30f4d112a4dcbc89518d.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_0b897f8519fe30f4d112a4dcbc89518d.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_5989a1954d97fb46e6403a77a375cc88.text: A ver quién es el guapo que se come esto.
sense_5989a1954d97fb46e6403a77a375cc88.translation: Let's see who's brave enough to eat this.

sense_5989a1954d97fb46e6403a77a375cc88.text: Se cree el guapo por haber defendido a esas viejitas.
sense_5989a1954d97fb46e6403a77a375cc88.translation: He thinks he's brave because he defended those little old ladies.

sense_64840ad057b37f3ceff12ae685e3c6df.text: Mamá, voy a salir esta noche. - ¡Que te lo has creído, guapa! Tienes que estudiar.
sense_64840ad057b37f3ceff12ae685e3c6df.translation: Mom, I'm going out tonight. - You must be joking! You have to study.

sense_64840ad057b37f3ceff12ae685e3c6df.text: ¿Pagas tú las cervezas? - Oye, guapo, que te toca pagar a ti. Yo pagué la última vez.
sense_64840ad057b37f3ceff12ae685e3c6df.translation: Will you pay for the beers? - Hey, it's your turn to pay. I paid last time.

sense_cc3a4f143768d4185cd0f5fd5b1da82b.text: He's pretty stuck up and likes to lord it over other people.
sense_cc3a4f143768d4185cd0f5fd5b1da82b.translation: Es bastante creído y le gusta tratar a los demás con prepotencia.

sense_cc3a4f143768d4185cd0f5fd5b1da82b.text: I deserve more respect. I'm tired of having a boss who always lords it over me.
sense_cc3a4f143768d4185cd0f5fd5b1da82b.translation: Yo merezco más respeto. Estoy harto de tener un jefe que siempre me trate despóticamente.

sense_cb9ccc58f58c2d58ea0293c7f92e216e.text: ¡Pedazo de mi alma! Ven a darme un beso.
sense_cb9ccc58f58c2d58ea0293c7f92e216e.translation: My darling! Come give me a kiss.

sense_cb9ccc58f58c2d58ea0293c7f92e216e.text: Ese pedazo de güey chocó contra la puerta de la cochera.
sense_cb9ccc58f58c2d58ea0293c7f92e216e.translation: That idiot crashed into the garage door.

sense_274c2173cc9627dba4f184e38bd21a69.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_274c2173cc9627dba4f184e38bd21a69.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_74e3fd1502f9f5aa8db1b82f2e549cc5.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_74e3fd1502f9f5aa8db1b82f2e549cc5.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_74e3fd1502f9f5aa8db1b82f2e549cc5.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_74e3fd1502f9f5aa8db1b82f2e549cc5.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_2678b803a3a8dd3cf17434756cb07709.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_2678b803a3a8dd3cf17434756cb07709.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_beda416d1d6550093332207a10658cc4.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_beda416d1d6550093332207a10658cc4.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_01e226bf51ae13b1418aaacda1ff6130.text: Se vieron obligados a hacer sus necesidades en un balde.
sense_01e226bf51ae13b1418aaacda1ff6130.translation: They were obliged to relieve themselves in a bucket.
Has the dog done his business?

sense_41d2a0fd560e59c520e38ac308b7131a.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_41d2a0fd560e59c520e38ac308b7131a.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_41d2a0fd560e59c520e38ac308b7131a.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_41d2a0fd560e59c520e38ac308b7131a.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_e89f7f8f926250953407676eb577593f.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_e89f7f8f926250953407676eb577593f.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_a3648105f02ee188c060c53f7f9ea138.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_a3648105f02ee188c060c53f7f9ea138.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_f16e97d7dc6d713201a461a3ba1a1e11.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_f16e97d7dc6d713201a461a3ba1a1e11.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_f16e97d7dc6d713201a461a3ba1a1e11.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_f16e97d7dc6d713201a461a3ba1a1e11.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_d960863ced85a20f531484e902d0770d.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_d960863ced85a20f531484e902d0770d.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_d960863ced85a20f531484e902d0770d.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_d960863ced85a20f531484e902d0770d.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_899088a4ee55c5082776d9a4bb532e66.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_899088a4ee55c5082776d9a4bb532e66.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_e1693989750039c5ab69eaf856f2114f.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_e1693989750039c5ab69eaf856f2114f.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_e1693989750039c5ab69eaf856f2114f.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_e1693989750039c5ab69eaf856f2114f.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_92ac4c3985056323c17718bd8e577c4e.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_92ac4c3985056323c17718bd8e577c4e.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_92ac4c3985056323c17718bd8e577c4e.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_92ac4c3985056323c17718bd8e577c4e.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_b04d192e9fbe5d51ec2e0a5a00dc9bd4.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_b04d192e9fbe5d51ec2e0a5a00dc9bd4.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_b04d192e9fbe5d51ec2e0a5a00dc9bd4.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_b04d192e9fbe5d51ec2e0a5a00dc9bd4.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_7cf296980c017a697c29400eac08ae61.text: Me parece que el ministro debería dimitir.
sense_7cf296980c017a697c29400eac08ae61.translation: I think the minister should resign.

sense_7cf296980c017a697c29400eac08ae61.text: ¿Qué te pareció la serie sobre la familia real? - Me pareció una tontería.
sense_7cf296980c017a697c29400eac08ae61.translation: What did you think of the series about the royal family? - I thought it was nonsense.

sense_3020cdf6d48cf2cbc608eb226a3c9dbe.text: Tuvimos que quedarnos en casa porque estaba cayendo un chaparrón.
sense_3020cdf6d48cf2cbc608eb226a3c9dbe.translation: We had to stay home because it was pouring rain.

sense_3020cdf6d48cf2cbc608eb226a3c9dbe.text: Está cayendo una buena nevada. Ponle las cadenas a las ruedas.
sense_3020cdf6d48cf2cbc608eb226a3c9dbe.translation: It's snowing hard. Put the chains on the tires.

sense_cf1e3f2b953b9f1efc699aaa6db5025f.text: No bebo porque el alcohol me cae mal.
sense_cf1e3f2b953b9f1efc699aaa6db5025f.translation: I don't drink because alcohol disagrees with me.
You look great in that dress!

sense_773da526243d456d12727a9198deaa91.text: Me cae muy bien tu hermano; siempre me hace sonreír.
sense_773da526243d456d12727a9198deaa91.translation: I really like your brother; he always makes me smile.

sense_773da526243d456d12727a9198deaa91.text: Me marché porque me cae mal tu primo con sus bromas ofensivas.
sense_773da526243d456d12727a9198deaa91.translation: I had to leave because I can't stand your cousin and his offensive jokes.

sense_f91ce11955555559d247266c620c5e4c.text: Que Harvard la hubiera rechazado, le cayó mal.
sense_f91ce11955555559d247266c620c5e4c.translation: She wasn't pleased that Harvard rejected her.

sense_f91ce11955555559d247266c620c5e4c.text: El embarazo de mi hermana pequeña no cayó bien en la familia.
sense_f91ce11955555559d247266c620c5e4c.translation: My little sister's pregnancy shocked the entire family.

sense_bcab338fd0768b244f3b0c7f154f0f09.text: Mi bebé está llorando porque se cae de sueño.
sense_bcab338fd0768b244f3b0c7f154f0f09.translation: My baby is crying because he's very sleepy.

sense_bcab338fd0768b244f3b0c7f154f0f09.text: Me caigo de cansancio, pero tengo que estudiar para el examen de mañana.
sense_bcab338fd0768b244f3b0c7f154f0f09.translation: I am really tired, but I have to study for tomorrow's exam.

sense_ed0ad27380826b791294edd47e72b8a1.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_ed0ad27380826b791294edd47e72b8a1.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_ed0ad27380826b791294edd47e72b8a1.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_ed0ad27380826b791294edd47e72b8a1.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_3e799cde80bf55a8e1ce1cdb30ffeb4e.text: Este es un broche precioso. ¿Dónde lo compraste?
sense_3e799cde80bf55a8e1ce1cdb30ffeb4e.translation: This is a beautiful brooch. Where did you buy it?

sense_3e799cde80bf55a8e1ce1cdb30ffeb4e.text: La vista desde la peña está preciosa.
sense_3e799cde80bf55a8e1ce1cdb30ffeb4e.translation: The view from the cliff is beautiful.

sense_84a3c9a35d1baf16731695f9ff5d0bd5.text: Es la tercera vez que lo llamo y no contesta. ¿Dónde está?
sense_84a3c9a35d1baf16731695f9ff5d0bd5.translation: This is the third time I call him and he doesn't answer. Where is he?

sense_84a3c9a35d1baf16731695f9ff5d0bd5.text: Hay un error en el tercer compás. Debería ser un acorde mayor.
sense_84a3c9a35d1baf16731695f9ff5d0bd5.translation: There's a mistake on the third bar. It should be a major chord.

sense_c1a84b884ce70697da097062d1bf9cd6.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_12211a857952e4267259e52b113bb08f.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_12211a857952e4267259e52b113bb08f.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_12211a857952e4267259e52b113bb08f.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_12211a857952e4267259e52b113bb08f.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_e0ddd077e2f65371418aeb04e14962de.text: Dos horas después del accidente, sufrió un proceso hemorrágico interno.
sense_e0ddd077e2f65371418aeb04e14962de.translation: She suffered internal hemorrhage two hours after the accident.

sense_e0ddd077e2f65371418aeb04e14962de.text: Los dolores de cabeza se le complicaron con un proceso gripal.
sense_e0ddd077e2f65371418aeb04e14962de.translation: In addition to his headaches, he developed flu complications.

sense_bb83eb4298fe6fa74a17edd793eaa8c0.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_bb83eb4298fe6fa74a17edd793eaa8c0.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_bb83eb4298fe6fa74a17edd793eaa8c0.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_bb83eb4298fe6fa74a17edd793eaa8c0.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_1649e8ec9be4fb4a87db6479c73cd000.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_1649e8ec9be4fb4a87db6479c73cd000.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_1583de5d6964525e61851c7a9addfeaf.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_1583de5d6964525e61851c7a9addfeaf.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_40deab9c86a77320f6a17e167eaba9ab.text: Pedro estaba pidiendo pon a la estación del tren.
sense_40deab9c86a77320f6a17e167eaba9ab.translation: Peter was asking for a ride to the train station.

sense_40deab9c86a77320f6a17e167eaba9ab.text: ¿Me das pon a casa? Se me dañó el carro y me quedé a pie.
sense_40deab9c86a77320f6a17e167eaba9ab.translation: Can you give me a ride home? My car broke down and I'm stuck.

sense_4132625e3871748cf471c1a684bd6d11.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_4132625e3871748cf471c1a684bd6d11.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_4132625e3871748cf471c1a684bd6d11.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_4132625e3871748cf471c1a684bd6d11.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_e980e46322a86c3ad0d41135164d69b4.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_e980e46322a86c3ad0d41135164d69b4.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_f95bac847b38caeec9b3dbb0a2d8f800.text: El programa era tan aburrido que me dormí.
sense_f95bac847b38caeec9b3dbb0a2d8f800.translation: The program was so boring that I fell asleep.

sense_f95bac847b38caeec9b3dbb0a2d8f800.text: Me dormí a las 6 de la mañana.
sense_f95bac847b38caeec9b3dbb0a2d8f800.translation: I fell asleep at 6 in the morning.

sense_78f278708f3e60a02a9aada81fead3d2.text: No te duermas o no acabarás a tiempo.
sense_78f278708f3e60a02a9aada81fead3d2.translation: Don't slack off or you won't finish in time.

sense_78f278708f3e60a02a9aada81fead3d2.text: Por dormirse se perdió la clave para ganar el premio.
sense_78f278708f3e60a02a9aada81fead3d2.translation: He missed the clue to win the prize because he didn't stay on his toes.

sense_2902ae632b2624791a82f95722acd013.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_2902ae632b2624791a82f95722acd013.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_2902ae632b2624791a82f95722acd013.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_2902ae632b2624791a82f95722acd013.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_244f702b83ea9f543f29a6d7ce05836d.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_244f702b83ea9f543f29a6d7ce05836d.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_244f702b83ea9f543f29a6d7ce05836d.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_244f702b83ea9f543f29a6d7ce05836d.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_7b8fd28e0dc92c14909e5958325d86de.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_7b8fd28e0dc92c14909e5958325d86de.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_7a6134ef0e6e9caa9570a456684c92c2.translation: Put your money away. It's my treat.
Have a drink. It's on us.

sense_51d533efaa530090170dd6f51149cdb4.text: Es la tercera vez que lo llamo y no contesta. ¿Dónde está?
sense_51d533efaa530090170dd6f51149cdb4.translation: This is the third time I call him and he doesn't answer. Where is he?

sense_51d533efaa530090170dd6f51149cdb4.text: Hay un error en el tercer compás. Debería ser un acorde mayor.
sense_51d533efaa530090170dd6f51149cdb4.translation: There's a mistake on the third bar. It should be a major chord.

sense_638ab98fe14a8fcb5aab177ff9db5cce.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_638ab98fe14a8fcb5aab177ff9db5cce.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_638ab98fe14a8fcb5aab177ff9db5cce.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_638ab98fe14a8fcb5aab177ff9db5cce.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_f5c4d601e86a1e05c7db741be39b7362.text: Los corderos comenzaron a balar intensamente cuando vieron al lobo.
sense_f5c4d601e86a1e05c7db741be39b7362.translation: The lambs began bleating intensely when they saw the wolf.

sense_f5c4d601e86a1e05c7db741be39b7362.text: Los corderos perdidos balaron hasta ser rescatados por el pastor.
sense_f5c4d601e86a1e05c7db741be39b7362.translation: The lost lambs bleated until the shepherd rescued them.

sense_54532f9f1e752d3e79e282b220dc1cd9.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_54532f9f1e752d3e79e282b220dc1cd9.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_54532f9f1e752d3e79e282b220dc1cd9.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_54532f9f1e752d3e79e282b220dc1cd9.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_6f40fe90b188dffd23c6c2ebb89036fe.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_6f40fe90b188dffd23c6c2ebb89036fe.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_6f40fe90b188dffd23c6c2ebb89036fe.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_6f40fe90b188dffd23c6c2ebb89036fe.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_44f444929b644d9e46f595efbe89dbf8.text: La estrella se cubrió el rostro con una bufanda.
sense_44f444929b644d9e46f595efbe89dbf8.translation: The star covered her face with a scarf.

sense_44f444929b644d9e46f595efbe89dbf8.text: Ese bebé tiene el rostro como un querubín de Botticelli.
sense_44f444929b644d9e46f595efbe89dbf8.translation: That baby has a face like a Botticelli cherub.

sense_88e663ebd4f938f8af4fb3880af301a6.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_88e663ebd4f938f8af4fb3880af301a6.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_6b19da8d072206058600e6a6eba720a7.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_6b19da8d072206058600e6a6eba720a7.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_6b19da8d072206058600e6a6eba720a7.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_6b19da8d072206058600e6a6eba720a7.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_809b81812585aa3f9b4cad74a337a1ad.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_809b81812585aa3f9b4cad74a337a1ad.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_809b81812585aa3f9b4cad74a337a1ad.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_809b81812585aa3f9b4cad74a337a1ad.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_1686c306a0dbc71f4443415c49f45402.text: No digas que sí sin más. Piénsalo bien antes.
sense_1686c306a0dbc71f4443415c49f45402.translation: Don't say yes just like that. Think it over first.

sense_1686c306a0dbc71f4443415c49f45402.text: Piénsalo dos veces antes de contestar. La pregunta es delicada.
sense_1686c306a0dbc71f4443415c49f45402.translation: Think twice before answering. The question is tricky.

sense_0c798ff20e6c9629b864c294e49a0e4e.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_0c798ff20e6c9629b864c294e49a0e4e.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_0c798ff20e6c9629b864c294e49a0e4e.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_0c798ff20e6c9629b864c294e49a0e4e.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_f2e65a8f71eff03d107864864eea7e4f.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_f2e65a8f71eff03d107864864eea7e4f.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_0a6ba56d4e5bb288507176c9dcc249f3.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_0a6ba56d4e5bb288507176c9dcc249f3.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_0a6ba56d4e5bb288507176c9dcc249f3.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_0a6ba56d4e5bb288507176c9dcc249f3.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_712fd7a2285261f55ea9b9fc7d72be2d.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_712fd7a2285261f55ea9b9fc7d72be2d.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_712fd7a2285261f55ea9b9fc7d72be2d.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_712fd7a2285261f55ea9b9fc7d72be2d.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_073021394a557ea3f9f4c89a2af85c31.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_073021394a557ea3f9f4c89a2af85c31.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_073021394a557ea3f9f4c89a2af85c31.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_073021394a557ea3f9f4c89a2af85c31.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_6bab97be9b427eb3448d319bdea14ade.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_6bab97be9b427eb3448d319bdea14ade.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_6bab97be9b427eb3448d319bdea14ade.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_6bab97be9b427eb3448d319bdea14ade.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_9015afb45fd947b1c6f51ec749e7ccde.text: Julián presenció la llegada de mis tíos.
sense_9015afb45fd947b1c6f51ec749e7ccde.translation: Julián was present when my uncle and aunt arrived.
I wasn't there when the incident happened.

sense_3faec3c52760861027adf58b0526caeb.text: Nuestro hijo solo cursa segundo de primaria.
sense_3faec3c52760861027adf58b0526caeb.translation: Our son is only in second grade.

sense_3faec3c52760861027adf58b0526caeb.text: Ángeles cursaba primero en la universidad cuando conoció a Antonio.
sense_3faec3c52760861027adf58b0526caeb.translation: Angeles was in her first year of college when she met Antonio.

sense_7c17e5200773e0bd928106035d0567b3.text: Disculpa, no te he visto trabajando allí. Me pondré los cascos.
sense_7c17e5200773e0bd928106035d0567b3.translation: I'm sorry, I didn't see you there working. I'll put headphones in.

sense_7c17e5200773e0bd928106035d0567b3.text: Disculpe, por favor. ¿Me dice dónde está la parada del metro?
sense_7c17e5200773e0bd928106035d0567b3.translation: Excuse me, please. Can you tell me where the subway station is?

sense_3523ee39fd2f5270f925d08dd7ff2433.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_3523ee39fd2f5270f925d08dd7ff2433.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_3523ee39fd2f5270f925d08dd7ff2433.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_3523ee39fd2f5270f925d08dd7ff2433.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_1e02925a190e30c61ac32a3ac6975a19.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_1e02925a190e30c61ac32a3ac6975a19.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_58c71099feb0f336d949a3ffb04cf727.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_58c71099feb0f336d949a3ffb04cf727.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_58c71099feb0f336d949a3ffb04cf727.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_58c71099feb0f336d949a3ffb04cf727.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_1e865ae09ebb1c26656c69909d5487cf.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_1e865ae09ebb1c26656c69909d5487cf.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_1e865ae09ebb1c26656c69909d5487cf.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_1e865ae09ebb1c26656c69909d5487cf.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_162bf4e90872ed76c30be47f52d8e439.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_162bf4e90872ed76c30be47f52d8e439.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_162bf4e90872ed76c30be47f52d8e439.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_162bf4e90872ed76c30be47f52d8e439.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_717f55f82806521560b4695bf211b4cf.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_717f55f82806521560b4695bf211b4cf.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_717f55f82806521560b4695bf211b4cf.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_717f55f82806521560b4695bf211b4cf.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_cb889adcfc342f1dc8bca5ab0cefbe6c.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_cb889adcfc342f1dc8bca5ab0cefbe6c.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_cb889adcfc342f1dc8bca5ab0cefbe6c.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_cb889adcfc342f1dc8bca5ab0cefbe6c.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_41c6fa3980e4ca4a47dc3a0f36e627b5.text: El programa era tan aburrido que me dormí.
sense_41c6fa3980e4ca4a47dc3a0f36e627b5.translation: The program was so boring that I fell asleep.

sense_41c6fa3980e4ca4a47dc3a0f36e627b5.text: Me dormí a las 6 de la mañana.
sense_41c6fa3980e4ca4a47dc3a0f36e627b5.translation: I fell asleep at 6 in the morning.

sense_4983b8a2d746185386746ea3fdfdea24.text: No te duermas o no acabarás a tiempo.
sense_4983b8a2d746185386746ea3fdfdea24.translation: Don't slack off or you won't finish in time.

sense_4983b8a2d746185386746ea3fdfdea24.text: Por dormirse se perdió la clave para ganar el premio.
sense_4983b8a2d746185386746ea3fdfdea24.translation: He missed the clue to win the prize because he didn't stay on his toes.

sense_a10c43bc3993e14066057449b1fc096a.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_a10c43bc3993e14066057449b1fc096a.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_4d18750a754f1a878e9fdbf90070a13d.text: Voy andando al colegio todos los días.
sense_4d18750a754f1a878e9fdbf90070a13d.translation: I walk to school every day.

sense_4d18750a754f1a878e9fdbf90070a13d.text: "Cuando ando, me canso mucho", le dijo la anciana a su médico.
sense_4d18750a754f1a878e9fdbf90070a13d.translation: "When I walk, I get very tired," the old woman told her doctor.

sense_b1d65e247c5ad7df26a25f24abb42129.text: En el verano ella anda en bicicleta al trabajo.
sense_b1d65e247c5ad7df26a25f24abb42129.translation: In the summer she takes her bike to work.

sense_b1d65e247c5ad7df26a25f24abb42129.text: Yo siempre ando en tren cuando regreso al hogar.
sense_b1d65e247c5ad7df26a25f24abb42129.translation: I always take the train when returning home.

sense_d118e1baabba34b62e2fc760a9a152aa.text: ¡Qué andar tan raro tienen esos jóvenes!
sense_d118e1baabba34b62e2fc760a9a152aa.translation: The way those youths walk is really strange!

sense_d118e1baabba34b62e2fc760a9a152aa.text: Se le nota en el andar que tiene mucho dolor.
sense_d118e1baabba34b62e2fc760a9a152aa.translation: You can tell by the way she walks that she's in a lot of pain.

sense_e8b82ce6f20b9e89fcf694a92132a648.text: Me gusta todo de ti, hasta los andares.
sense_e8b82ce6f20b9e89fcf694a92132a648.translation: I like everything about you, even the way you walk.

sense_e8b82ce6f20b9e89fcf694a92132a648.text: El Charlot de Charlie Chaplin tiene unos andares totalmente inconfundibles.
sense_e8b82ce6f20b9e89fcf694a92132a648.translation: The way Charlie Chaplin's tramp walks is completely unmistakeable.

sense_2f3c47c0bc816c30a7614920f0a195bb.text: El jinete iba amantado con el tradicional poncho.
sense_2f3c47c0bc816c30a7614920f0a195bb.translation: The rider donned the traditional poncho.

sense_2f3c47c0bc816c30a7614920f0a195bb.text: La mujer sostenía en brazos un bebé amantado.
sense_2f3c47c0bc816c30a7614920f0a195bb.translation: The woman held a baby in her arms who was wrapped up in a blanket.

sense_4dc8be85a4edb08327dff0a3374265b3.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_4dc8be85a4edb08327dff0a3374265b3.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_4dc8be85a4edb08327dff0a3374265b3.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_4dc8be85a4edb08327dff0a3374265b3.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_c70e0a16ecb27d9f3cae95fa08b20f14.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_c70e0a16ecb27d9f3cae95fa08b20f14.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_455f0cfdd6c4e5f813ab74b85f44ec3c.text: Las enfermeras ayudaron a los enfermos y a los heridos.
sense_455f0cfdd6c4e5f813ab74b85f44ec3c.translation: The nurses helped the sick and wounded.

sense_455f0cfdd6c4e5f813ab74b85f44ec3c.text: El enfermero me tomó la presión mientras el doctor leía algo en mi expediente.
sense_455f0cfdd6c4e5f813ab74b85f44ec3c.translation: The nurse took my blood pressure while the doctor read something off my chart.

sense_2759caa7da582fd87a54f6ff6241e4c6.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_2759caa7da582fd87a54f6ff6241e4c6.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_176599163c4f83efe1be49b4eb392a06.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_176599163c4f83efe1be49b4eb392a06.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_176599163c4f83efe1be49b4eb392a06.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_176599163c4f83efe1be49b4eb392a06.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_da0f6e8636214113f32654843de148ce.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_da0f6e8636214113f32654843de148ce.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_da0f6e8636214113f32654843de148ce.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_da0f6e8636214113f32654843de148ce.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_643e57898107133262160ca12082914c.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_643e57898107133262160ca12082914c.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_643e57898107133262160ca12082914c.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_643e57898107133262160ca12082914c.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_dc814de40912b7a37704629926d85eb7.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_dc814de40912b7a37704629926d85eb7.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_a8968a2cb3660573000f7baf920825d6.text: ¡Felicidades en sus bodas de plata! ¡Cómo pasa el tiempo!
sense_a8968a2cb3660573000f7baf920825d6.translation: Congratulations on your silver wedding anniversary! Time flies!

sense_a8968a2cb3660573000f7baf920825d6.text: Nos hemos comprometido, nos casaremos en mayo. - ¡Felicidades! ¡Cuánto me alegro!
sense_a8968a2cb3660573000f7baf920825d6.translation: We're engaged. We're getting married in May. - Congratulations! I'm so glad!

sense_99f9419e7b9b220e7484b5e639fa6a8d.text: Abrazar a tu bebé te hace sentir una felicidad total.
sense_99f9419e7b9b220e7484b5e639fa6a8d.translation: Hugging your baby gives you a feeling of total happiness.

sense_99f9419e7b9b220e7484b5e639fa6a8d.text: Te amo, y tu felicidad es lo único que me importa.
sense_99f9419e7b9b220e7484b5e639fa6a8d.translation: I love you, and your happiness is all that matters to me.

sense_ab08dfc63b6ec86826b10a423e98cd5e.text: ¡Feliz Navidad! - ¡Sí, felicidades! Vendrán a cenar en Nochevieja, ¿verdad?
sense_ab08dfc63b6ec86826b10a423e98cd5e.translation: Merry Christmas! - Yes, Merry Christmas! You're coming for dinner on New Year's Eve, aren't you?

sense_b00ee47f9f95d42ca29eafd1f47d16ec.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_b00ee47f9f95d42ca29eafd1f47d16ec.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_b00ee47f9f95d42ca29eafd1f47d16ec.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_b00ee47f9f95d42ca29eafd1f47d16ec.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_7857f37ee1098b56922d9f7994b29774.text: El partido se canceló tras el primer tiempo.
sense_7857f37ee1098b56922d9f7994b29774.translation: The match was canceled after the first half.

sense_670be4b3af838ba6c7b623571fae58d8.text: Nuestro primer objetivo es reducir gastos.
sense_670be4b3af838ba6c7b623571fae58d8.translation: Our main objective is to reduce expenses.

sense_e3d9ba4112ff43bf2d28348fb031257b.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_e3d9ba4112ff43bf2d28348fb031257b.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_e3d9ba4112ff43bf2d28348fb031257b.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_e3d9ba4112ff43bf2d28348fb031257b.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_195d208bb1ab3cb446ede2759a4d254a.text: Las corrientes de aire pueden ser causadas por muchos factores diferentes.
sense_195d208bb1ab3cb446ede2759a4d254a.translation: Air currents can be caused by many different things.

sense_195d208bb1ab3cb446ede2759a4d254a.text: Ese río tiene una corriente fuerte. Es mejor no nadar en él.
sense_195d208bb1ab3cb446ede2759a4d254a.translation: That river has a strong current. It's best not to swim there.

sense_495422f02d97a3e680199401f19612d2.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_495422f02d97a3e680199401f19612d2.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_c5c93319207eaf96129d3eabf9753754.text: El alumno escribió su ensayo de 20 páginas en una noche.
sense_c5c93319207eaf96129d3eabf9753754.translation: The student wrote his 20-page essay in one night.

sense_1efb12a8532016462f848318b7deea74.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_1efb12a8532016462f848318b7deea74.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_1efb12a8532016462f848318b7deea74.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_1efb12a8532016462f848318b7deea74.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_710aea3cd61688dfb266f35ea62bbeff.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_710aea3cd61688dfb266f35ea62bbeff.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_710aea3cd61688dfb266f35ea62bbeff.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_710aea3cd61688dfb266f35ea62bbeff.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_91418e201ec70b2380e39aa857643e80.text: Voy andando al colegio todos los días.
sense_91418e201ec70b2380e39aa857643e80.translation: I walk to school every day.

sense_91418e201ec70b2380e39aa857643e80.text: "Cuando ando, me canso mucho", le dijo la anciana a su médico.
sense_91418e201ec70b2380e39aa857643e80.translation: "When I walk, I get very tired," the old woman told her doctor.

sense_6628727b4c30b6f0f1cf66916de29e3a.text: En el verano ella anda en bicicleta al trabajo.
sense_6628727b4c30b6f0f1cf66916de29e3a.translation: In the summer she takes her bike to work.

sense_6628727b4c30b6f0f1cf66916de29e3a.text: Yo siempre ando en tren cuando regreso al hogar.
sense_6628727b4c30b6f0f1cf66916de29e3a.translation: I always take the train when returning home.

sense_0d06d819b446fefd6dbdeae14bd66140.text: ¡Qué andar tan raro tienen esos jóvenes!
sense_0d06d819b446fefd6dbdeae14bd66140.translation: The way those youths walk is really strange!

sense_0d06d819b446fefd6dbdeae14bd66140.text: Se le nota en el andar que tiene mucho dolor.
sense_0d06d819b446fefd6dbdeae14bd66140.translation: You can tell by the way she walks that she's in a lot of pain.

sense_9a9a5620ce3d90929e9c091e0cc68fb4.text: Me gusta todo de ti, hasta los andares.
sense_9a9a5620ce3d90929e9c091e0cc68fb4.translation: I like everything about you, even the way you walk.

sense_9a9a5620ce3d90929e9c091e0cc68fb4.text: El Charlot de Charlie Chaplin tiene unos andares totalmente inconfundibles.
sense_9a9a5620ce3d90929e9c091e0cc68fb4.translation: The way Charlie Chaplin's tramp walks is completely unmistakeable.

sense_6afdbc12a9c9d68c9272c71161a0b487.text: Las temperaturas bajas amenazan con helar los cultivos.
sense_6afdbc12a9c9d68c9272c71161a0b487.translation: The low temperatures threaten to freeze the crops.

sense_6afdbc12a9c9d68c9272c71161a0b487.text: El viento helado heló las flores.
sense_6afdbc12a9c9d68c9272c71161a0b487.translation: The frigid wind froze the flowers.

sense_2c21a1a444c708b389da9151ae560600.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
