sense_2c21a1a444c708b389da9151ae560600.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_2c21a1a444c708b389da9151ae560600.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_2c21a1a444c708b389da9151ae560600.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_b24af36e3959192280b8b94f57a2310b.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_d8fde3b3a8b0d088b456ac47c7b56b30.text: Me tomó toda la noche, pero ya terminé de pasar mi tesis a limpio.
sense_d8fde3b3a8b0d088b456ac47c7b56b30.translation: It took all night, but I finished writing the final version of my thesis.

sense_d8fde3b3a8b0d088b456ac47c7b56b30.text: Cuando me corrijas el borrador, voy a pasarlo a limpio para entregárselo mañana al maestro.
sense_d8fde3b3a8b0d088b456ac47c7b56b30.translation: After you correct my rough draft, I am going to print out a clean copy to turn in to my teacher tomorrow.

sense_ba0cd9da7f1d2b4ac8f4141105c40280.text: I don't like Laura's new haircut. - Really? I think she's rocking it.
sense_ba0cd9da7f1d2b4ac8f4141105c40280.translation: No me gusta el nuevo corte de Laura. - ¿En serio? A mí me parece que le queda muy bien.

sense_ba0cd9da7f1d2b4ac8f4141105c40280.text: What are you reading? - It's a list of ten actors who rock the bald look.
sense_ba0cd9da7f1d2b4ac8f4141105c40280.translation: ¿Qué lees? - Es una lista de diez actores que se ven superbién con la cabeza rapada.

sense_390c1b1ec987855381eedbc2d60c38e3.translation: ¡La fiesta de anoche estuvo de lo mejor!

sense_390c1b1ec987855381eedbc2d60c38e3.text: This band rocks. I can't believe I'd never heard of them.
sense_390c1b1ec987855381eedbc2d60c38e3.translation: Esta banda es increíble. No puedo creer que nunca haya escuchado de ellos.

sense_cc760c6d8b8809c1ad65f717e9dc8485.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_cc760c6d8b8809c1ad65f717e9dc8485.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_e5fcc5434b609552d9834713619bba5f.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_e5fcc5434b609552d9834713619bba5f.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_d2a2829225e226fb45afeba9d2e3457f.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_d2a2829225e226fb45afeba9d2e3457f.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_d2a2829225e226fb45afeba9d2e3457f.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_d2a2829225e226fb45afeba9d2e3457f.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_4c7eae3f51040511d97ba855066b3913.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_4c7eae3f51040511d97ba855066b3913.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_cbec1998a6edf15c25fd43b4e8454ab9.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_cbec1998a6edf15c25fd43b4e8454ab9.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_cbec1998a6edf15c25fd43b4e8454ab9.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_cbec1998a6edf15c25fd43b4e8454ab9.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_b3ef7732c342e5bdc57dc0c32a764ccb.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_b3ef7732c342e5bdc57dc0c32a764ccb.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_defe0e9d3cb2a9008d51510b86163597.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_defe0e9d3cb2a9008d51510b86163597.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_ad2363f77998e068e1e9c330ab04e55f.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_ad2363f77998e068e1e9c330ab04e55f.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_ad2363f77998e068e1e9c330ab04e55f.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_ad2363f77998e068e1e9c330ab04e55f.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_26e54c81d1f3b06e0caa9a014be5314d.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_26e54c81d1f3b06e0caa9a014be5314d.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_26e54c81d1f3b06e0caa9a014be5314d.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_26e54c81d1f3b06e0caa9a014be5314d.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_637b4059048393c9619ab1bde66e52b7.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_637b4059048393c9619ab1bde66e52b7.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_e2e5241ef8a08b3b326619d4371523eb.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_e2e5241ef8a08b3b326619d4371523eb.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_e2e5241ef8a08b3b326619d4371523eb.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_e2e5241ef8a08b3b326619d4371523eb.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_cef6b217e96fc2a67c7a83ce50a22c7d.text: ¡Hace un frío del demonio! El bebé necesitará más abrigo.
sense_cef6b217e96fc2a67c7a83ce50a22c7d.translation: It's freezing cold! The baby will need more layers.

sense_00c8faa4188cca55dd81d9cef3e01e91.text: Samu no puede vivir siempre al abrigo de sus padres.
sense_00c8faa4188cca55dd81d9cef3e01e91.translation: Samu can't always live his life relying on his parents to take care of him.

sense_00c8faa4188cca55dd81d9cef3e01e91.text: El grupo político pegó carteles por toda la ciudad al abrigo de la noche.
sense_00c8faa4188cca55dd81d9cef3e01e91.translation: The political group put up posters around the whole city under the cover of darkness.

sense_3ca1cb57d03edc58039564f41503219d.text: Nos abrigamos y salimos a esquiar.
sense_3ca1cb57d03edc58039564f41503219d.translation: We wrapped up and went skiing.

sense_3ca1cb57d03edc58039564f41503219d.text: La temperatura va a bajar 15 grados en la noche, así que abríguense bien.
sense_3ca1cb57d03edc58039564f41503219d.translation: The temperature is going to fall by 15 degrees tonight, so wrap up well.

sense_fbed775d7a8bc83fc1a9782ae7f4f8c4.text: El fiscal se negó a hacer declaraciones a la prensa debido al secreto del sumario.
sense_fbed775d7a8bc83fc1a9782ae7f4f8c4.translation: The district attorney refused to talk to the press because the matter was sub judice.

sense_fbed775d7a8bc83fc1a9782ae7f4f8c4.text: En su última declaración, el actor negó los rumores que lo vinculan con la famosa cantante.
sense_fbed775d7a8bc83fc1a9782ae7f4f8c4.translation: In his last statement, the actor denied the rumors that he was dating the famous singer.

sense_5ed1f5473b7bd56e2229a27942afa25a.text: Se llamó a los testigos del accidente para que prestaran declaración.
sense_5ed1f5473b7bd56e2229a27942afa25a.translation: The witnesses of the car accident were summoned to give evidence.

sense_5ed1f5473b7bd56e2229a27942afa25a.text: Si no vienes de buena gana para prestar declaración, tendremos que citarte.
sense_5ed1f5473b7bd56e2229a27942afa25a.translation: If you don't come forth to testify willingly, we will have to subpoena you.

sense_f3c1e353733dca49e72e1f0ec5c82ced.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_f3c1e353733dca49e72e1f0ec5c82ced.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_f3c1e353733dca49e72e1f0ec5c82ced.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_f3c1e353733dca49e72e1f0ec5c82ced.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_30ec0eca129a0e9ab2cf850ec5e2906d.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_30ec0eca129a0e9ab2cf850ec5e2906d.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_30ec0eca129a0e9ab2cf850ec5e2906d.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_30ec0eca129a0e9ab2cf850ec5e2906d.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_5a2daf7c45faaed0fb74ae724e53df6e.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_5a2daf7c45faaed0fb74ae724e53df6e.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_5a2daf7c45faaed0fb74ae724e53df6e.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_5a2daf7c45faaed0fb74ae724e53df6e.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_c15455c68d800a9fa52881ade2d06f8c.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_c15455c68d800a9fa52881ade2d06f8c.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_c15455c68d800a9fa52881ade2d06f8c.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_c15455c68d800a9fa52881ade2d06f8c.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_fb1e66b4a6626da07ccd1742759bbf63.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_fb1e66b4a6626da07ccd1742759bbf63.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_fb1e66b4a6626da07ccd1742759bbf63.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_fb1e66b4a6626da07ccd1742759bbf63.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_9a816022646cc8ce2656c44c38f0fc15.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_9a816022646cc8ce2656c44c38f0fc15.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_9a816022646cc8ce2656c44c38f0fc15.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_9a816022646cc8ce2656c44c38f0fc15.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_a8640136edfb7de5441308523e18950f.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_a8640136edfb7de5441308523e18950f.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_a8640136edfb7de5441308523e18950f.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_a8640136edfb7de5441308523e18950f.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_10754276f7878a6aa5c9b0996f056f11.text: Cuanto más trabaja, más rico se hace.
sense_10754276f7878a6aa5c9b0996f056f11.translation: The more he works, the richer he gets.
The more he gets, the more he wants.

sense_497568284b02f2c498883c7a68829bcf.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_497568284b02f2c498883c7a68829bcf.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_497568284b02f2c498883c7a68829bcf.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_497568284b02f2c498883c7a68829bcf.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_04f9702b4afd071bb90747392821e393.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_04f9702b4afd071bb90747392821e393.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_ccf8b48b55474ae5fc01f893461ec403.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_ccf8b48b55474ae5fc01f893461ec403.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_fc3d06c777bef8a361443c6c4e4a2a62.text: Disculpa, no te he visto trabajando allí. Me pondré los cascos.
sense_fc3d06c777bef8a361443c6c4e4a2a62.translation: I'm sorry, I didn't see you there working. I'll put headphones in.

sense_fc3d06c777bef8a361443c6c4e4a2a62.text: Disculpe, por favor. ¿Me dice dónde está la parada del metro?
sense_fc3d06c777bef8a361443c6c4e4a2a62.translation: Excuse me, please. Can you tell me where the subway station is?

sense_0736f56d09574df415b8631e7510128c.text: El prisionero no puede moverse porque está atado por cadenas.
sense_0736f56d09574df415b8631e7510128c.translation: The prisoner can't move because he is bound by chains.

sense_0736f56d09574df415b8631e7510128c.text: Ella lleva una cadena de oro alrededor de su cuello para buena suerte.
sense_0736f56d09574df415b8631e7510128c.translation: She wears a gold chain around her neck for good luck.

sense_5fea07c019d12196957986fb40d828ea.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_5fea07c019d12196957986fb40d828ea.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_5fea07c019d12196957986fb40d828ea.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_5fea07c019d12196957986fb40d828ea.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_f71242ee079b0b9b4a019cd9341f5a78.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_f71242ee079b0b9b4a019cd9341f5a78.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_f71242ee079b0b9b4a019cd9341f5a78.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_f71242ee079b0b9b4a019cd9341f5a78.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_d0828aae1596c36cce315470caf2b563.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_d0828aae1596c36cce315470caf2b563.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_d0828aae1596c36cce315470caf2b563.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_d0828aae1596c36cce315470caf2b563.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_8adc3b37a48104e5d549a92d509f9fcd.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_8adc3b37a48104e5d549a92d509f9fcd.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_8adc3b37a48104e5d549a92d509f9fcd.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_8adc3b37a48104e5d549a92d509f9fcd.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_8932cb86496f7d2f6fa08195c37c944e.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_8932cb86496f7d2f6fa08195c37c944e.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_199fa832c5e11748a45b673327bcb77a.text: La fruta enviada en los contenedores llegó en malas condiciones.
sense_199fa832c5e11748a45b673327bcb77a.translation: The fruit shipped in the containers was not fresh.

sense_199fa832c5e11748a45b673327bcb77a.text: El delantero se recuperó de su lesión y está en condiciones de volver a jugar.
sense_199fa832c5e11748a45b673327bcb77a.translation: The forward recovered from the injury and is fit to play again.

sense_4ee670680d860664e69266fa291213d1.text: Tomás está autorizado a transferir empleados en su condición de gerente.
sense_4ee670680d860664e69266fa291213d1.translation: Tomas is allowed to transfer employees as a manager.

sense_4ee670680d860664e69266fa291213d1.text: Su condición de maestra de la escuela le impide dar clases particulares a sus alumnos.
sense_4ee670680d860664e69266fa291213d1.translation: Her capacity as a teacher in this school prevents her from tutoring her students.

sense_1b7b82b17254891e6d1d0c44f516a799.text: En el referéndum se condicionó la decisión al voto de la mayoría.
sense_1b7b82b17254891e6d1d0c44f516a799.translation: In the referendum the decision was dependent on a majority vote.

sense_1b7b82b17254891e6d1d0c44f516a799.text: La universidad condicionó la oferta de la plaza a la consecución de una determinada nota.
sense_1b7b82b17254891e6d1d0c44f516a799.translation: The university made the offer of a place conditional on obtaining a certain grade.

sense_1e1c6d2e6a8a697bf1beb787db0a4ce9.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_1e1c6d2e6a8a697bf1beb787db0a4ce9.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_1e1c6d2e6a8a697bf1beb787db0a4ce9.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_1e1c6d2e6a8a697bf1beb787db0a4ce9.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_484fa4c01e4fd4bc055c89918e97a024.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_484fa4c01e4fd4bc055c89918e97a024.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_484fa4c01e4fd4bc055c89918e97a024.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_484fa4c01e4fd4bc055c89918e97a024.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_a90e7f286e87a10bf3462bfd08427f49.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_a90e7f286e87a10bf3462bfd08427f49.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_a90e7f286e87a10bf3462bfd08427f49.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_a90e7f286e87a10bf3462bfd08427f49.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_67612a4bcac7ec1669aea647ae8c1f82.text: Cuatro presos huyeron de la cárcel el domingo por la tarde.
sense_67612a4bcac7ec1669aea647ae8c1f82.translation: Four inmates escaped from the prison on Sunday afternoon.

sense_67612a4bcac7ec1669aea647ae8c1f82.text: El hada trató de huir, pero el brujo la agarró por las alas.
sense_67612a4bcac7ec1669aea647ae8c1f82.translation: The fairy tried to escape, but the wizard grabbed her by the wings.

sense_2d243c9cc7cbef39a4891740423d5d74.text: Nos metieron un paquete por llegar tarde.
sense_2d243c9cc7cbef39a4891740423d5d74.translation: We got into real trouble for arriving late.

sense_2d243c9cc7cbef39a4891740423d5d74.text: Menudo paquete te va a caer si mamá se entera.
sense_2d243c9cc7cbef39a4891740423d5d74.translation: If Mom finds out, you'll really be in for it.

sense_7cb0f6464b2a86c16c1dcc3360ebe63a.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_b4a5a1469b915268fb0e1766babba7c0.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_b4a5a1469b915268fb0e1766babba7c0.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_b4a5a1469b915268fb0e1766babba7c0.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_b4a5a1469b915268fb0e1766babba7c0.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_b69c515954b267f941ae079c7a730e82.text: Hubo un policía caído durante el tiroteo.
sense_b69c515954b267f941ae079c7a730e82.translation: A policeman was shot dead during the shooting.

sense_b69c515954b267f941ae079c7a730e82.text: Javier me habló de su hijo Esteban, caído en el frente de batalla.
sense_b69c515954b267f941ae079c7a730e82.translation: Javier spoke to me about his son Esteban, who had died on the battlefront.

sense_169a1c3ccbc65fb124794142457725c7.text: Tuvimos que quedarnos en casa porque estaba cayendo un chaparrón.
sense_169a1c3ccbc65fb124794142457725c7.translation: We had to stay home because it was pouring rain.

sense_169a1c3ccbc65fb124794142457725c7.text: Está cayendo una buena nevada. Ponle las cadenas a las ruedas.
sense_169a1c3ccbc65fb124794142457725c7.translation: It's snowing hard. Put the chains on the tires.

sense_d58820810d66c3ddfe82688569df5e90.text: No bebo porque el alcohol me cae mal.
sense_d58820810d66c3ddfe82688569df5e90.translation: I don't drink because alcohol disagrees with me.
You look great in that dress!

sense_a418811aea2a652a3d1ade87b107ab47.text: Me cae muy bien tu hermano; siempre me hace sonreír.
sense_a418811aea2a652a3d1ade87b107ab47.translation: I really like your brother; he always makes me smile.

sense_a418811aea2a652a3d1ade87b107ab47.text: Me marché porque me cae mal tu primo con sus bromas ofensivas.
sense_a418811aea2a652a3d1ade87b107ab47.translation: I had to leave because I can't stand your cousin and his offensive jokes.

sense_95aa705b2fc9e08edb4b81f737bb49fd.text: Que Harvard la hubiera rechazado, le cayó mal.
sense_95aa705b2fc9e08edb4b81f737bb49fd.translation: She wasn't pleased that Harvard rejected her.

sense_95aa705b2fc9e08edb4b81f737bb49fd.text: El embarazo de mi hermana pequeña no cayó bien en la familia.
sense_95aa705b2fc9e08edb4b81f737bb49fd.translation: My little sister's pregnancy shocked the entire family.

sense_0540ea03db44a9ce328041b6719219bb.text: Mi bebé está llorando porque se cae de sueño.
sense_0540ea03db44a9ce328041b6719219bb.translation: My baby is crying because he's very sleepy.

sense_0540ea03db44a9ce328041b6719219bb.text: Me caigo de cansancio, pero tengo que estudiar para el examen de mañana.
sense_0540ea03db44a9ce328041b6719219bb.translation: I am really tired, but I have to study for tomorrow's exam.

sense_3032f9afb8b5f3ee7885a05fd9a8b73d.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_3032f9afb8b5f3ee7885a05fd9a8b73d.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_3032f9afb8b5f3ee7885a05fd9a8b73d.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_3032f9afb8b5f3ee7885a05fd9a8b73d.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_789bf849e45eb93f1dd6b4312c882fa6.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_789bf849e45eb93f1dd6b4312c882fa6.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_789bf849e45eb93f1dd6b4312c882fa6.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_789bf849e45eb93f1dd6b4312c882fa6.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_ac1a4640bf066ed349cb6ea807c3ef88.text: Estos no son mis lentes. Quiero los míos.
sense_ac1a4640bf066ed349cb6ea807c3ef88.translation: These aren't my glasses. I want mine.

sense_ac1a4640bf066ed349cb6ea807c3ef88.text: Este asiento es el mío. El tuyo es ese otro.
sense_ac1a4640bf066ed349cb6ea807c3ef88.translation: This seat is mine. Yours is that one there.

sense_40bed7859e168ac795b84610d2c615c5.text: A cierto individuo se le vio huyendo de la escena del crimen.
sense_40bed7859e168ac795b84610d2c615c5.translation: A certain individual was seen fleeing the scene of the crime.

sense_40bed7859e168ac795b84610d2c615c5.text: La incidencia durante el partido fue obra de ciertas personas, no de todos los fanáticos.
sense_40bed7859e168ac795b84610d2c615c5.translation: The incident during the match was the work of certain individuals, not all the fans.

sense_732838fc741cc79d1bb8f41211492cff.text: Nuestra amistad ha sido fuerte y duradera.
sense_732838fc741cc79d1bb8f41211492cff.translation: Our friendship has been strong and lasting.

sense_732838fc741cc79d1bb8f41211492cff.text: No vamos a dejar que esta pelea arruine una amistad de años.
sense_732838fc741cc79d1bb8f41211492cff.translation: We're not going to let this fight ruin a friendship that has lasted for years.

sense_3e36dcfc52df2cda59bfca76a749b991.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_3e36dcfc52df2cda59bfca76a749b991.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_3e36dcfc52df2cda59bfca76a749b991.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_3e36dcfc52df2cda59bfca76a749b991.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_45fc0535dd6a8475f788870190bf9c0c.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_45fc0535dd6a8475f788870190bf9c0c.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_45fc0535dd6a8475f788870190bf9c0c.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_45fc0535dd6a8475f788870190bf9c0c.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_ddbd434f048bb3dc5ca89d28ec44ee37.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_ddbd434f048bb3dc5ca89d28ec44ee37.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_a4e520136415b7d48d04093442b83f6a.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_a4e520136415b7d48d04093442b83f6a.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_a4e520136415b7d48d04093442b83f6a.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_a4e520136415b7d48d04093442b83f6a.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_3281eb33d2ca1d5f3f4e3665bb22ddfd.translation: I just want to make you happy.
What do you want for Christmas?

sense_f4b8fd7f552d0105591ffd994de85b79.translation: "How can I help you?," asked the butler.
Would you like something to drink?

sense_9cbc4122b2ec3c2735eb67445a5ec4cd.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_9cbc4122b2ec3c2735eb67445a5ec4cd.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_9cbc4122b2ec3c2735eb67445a5ec4cd.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_9cbc4122b2ec3c2735eb67445a5ec4cd.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_7389fa6dbf49704bd0a50a9e651b6aae.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_7389fa6dbf49704bd0a50a9e651b6aae.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_7389fa6dbf49704bd0a50a9e651b6aae.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_7389fa6dbf49704bd0a50a9e651b6aae.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_6408d90c9ea5f24c0843c2161f65e7a2.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_6408d90c9ea5f24c0843c2161f65e7a2.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_c524250fa1af7a68535c84fcbd7d9b4c.text: ¡Apártate de mí! No quiero verte nunca más.
sense_c524250fa1af7a68535c84fcbd7d9b4c.translation: Get away from me! I don't want to see you again.

sense_c524250fa1af7a68535c84fcbd7d9b4c.text: Apártense de la estufa; está caliente.
sense_c524250fa1af7a68535c84fcbd7d9b4c.translation: Get away from the stove; it's hot.

sense_b76f921a6893b8034e5b94a59add0a1c.text: No le tire patadas a su hermano.
Su perro me tiró un mordisco.

sense_114ab7c72f2da56b1c20b201506df138.text: Las fiestas ya no me tiran.
sense_114ab7c72f2da56b1c20b201506df138.translation: Parties don't appeal to me anymore.
He is not interested in studying medicine.

sense_3e9654f4ae2b2ef7eb6918e573cb22cd.text: El plato tiraba a dulce más que nada.
sense_3e9654f4ae2b2ef7eb6918e573cb22cd.translation: The dish was more sweet than anything else.

sense_3e9654f4ae2b2ef7eb6918e573cb22cd.text: Tienes que beberte el té cuando esté tirando a frío.
sense_3e9654f4ae2b2ef7eb6918e573cb22cd.translation: You have to drink the tea when it is cooling down.

sense_55376b1eb8dfba35b42d5eeb4b07f4a4.text: El bebé se tiró un eructo tras tomarse su biberón.
sense_55376b1eb8dfba35b42d5eeb4b07f4a4.translation: The baby burped after having his bottle.

sense_55376b1eb8dfba35b42d5eeb4b07f4a4.text: La primera vez que se tiró un pedo delante de su novio se avergonzó.
sense_55376b1eb8dfba35b42d5eeb4b07f4a4.translation: The first time she farted in front of her boyfriend, she was embarrassed.

sense_c203e59f27675cca500eac56f1bc9e8d.text: No soy muy amigo de la tecnología, pero entiendo su importancia.
sense_c203e59f27675cca500eac56f1bc9e8d.translation: I don't really like technology, but I understand its importance.

sense_c203e59f27675cca500eac56f1bc9e8d.text: Los británicos son muy amigos de hacer bricolaje y siempre están comprando artículos para la casa.
sense_c203e59f27675cca500eac56f1bc9e8d.translation: The British love doing DIY and are always buying articles for the home.

sense_c94f02ef4a05dfc6218b89195283f22a.text: "¡Firmes!", gritó, y los marineros giraron hacia el capitán.
sense_c94f02ef4a05dfc6218b89195283f22a.translation: "Attention!", he shouted, and the soldiers turned toward the captain.

sense_c94f02ef4a05dfc6218b89195283f22a.text: Los soldados estaban en posición de firmes cuando entró el general.
sense_c94f02ef4a05dfc6218b89195283f22a.translation: The soldiers were standing at attention when the general entered.

sense_5f48c83a2158429d55eba772cc91d7dc.text: El tomate es original de América del Sur.
Contrariamente a lo que la gente cree, la pasta es original de Asia y no de Italia.
sense_5f48c83a2158429d55eba772cc91d7dc.translation: Contrary to popular belief, pasta originally comes from Asia and not from Italy.

sense_d84c1cf746cf405bceb1783705973b30.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_d84c1cf746cf405bceb1783705973b30.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_d84c1cf746cf405bceb1783705973b30.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_d84c1cf746cf405bceb1783705973b30.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_b4773672d2cd58e936ea80c5685846db.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_b4773672d2cd58e936ea80c5685846db.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_601d4f8ad935a87b37f958e7e447bf6e.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_601d4f8ad935a87b37f958e7e447bf6e.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_ccafb40213e8f66886e05b7c4e2c6560.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_ccafb40213e8f66886e05b7c4e2c6560.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_ccafb40213e8f66886e05b7c4e2c6560.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_ccafb40213e8f66886e05b7c4e2c6560.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_d76f8e1f05b655e6101dc26ca28be7af.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_d76f8e1f05b655e6101dc26ca28be7af.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_3e0f43d322c511d1b5a4fe871083650c.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_3e0f43d322c511d1b5a4fe871083650c.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_014121f8228b446067d7e6e66490abae.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_014121f8228b446067d7e6e66490abae.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_014121f8228b446067d7e6e66490abae.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_014121f8228b446067d7e6e66490abae.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_c3ad87f86609c96a5329db1718622839.text: Julieta expresó sus deseos claramente en el testamento.
sense_c3ad87f86609c96a5329db1718622839.translation: Julieta expressed her wishes clearly in her will.

sense_c3ad87f86609c96a5329db1718622839.text: La luna no se veía claramente porque el cielo estaba nublado.
sense_c3ad87f86609c96a5329db1718622839.translation: The moon wasn't clearly visible because the sky was clouded over.

sense_b9a1716a9146070957cab4a66ee1117b.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_b9a1716a9146070957cab4a66ee1117b.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_fe51897e9d41d6143cfbb4917a680b3f.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_fe51897e9d41d6143cfbb4917a680b3f.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_fe51897e9d41d6143cfbb4917a680b3f.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_fe51897e9d41d6143cfbb4917a680b3f.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_632d37aebbd7533c0724baf2ac0703d5.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_632d37aebbd7533c0724baf2ac0703d5.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_cbf4115d9c96cccfd6a5d52c835e0ea0.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_cbf4115d9c96cccfd6a5d52c835e0ea0.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_6f1c3cc7b858ff04add01921bdd8302e.text: Nuestro país registra una disminución histórica en deforestación.
sense_6f1c3cc7b858ff04add01921bdd8302e.translation: There has been a dramatic reduction in deforestation in our country.

sense_6f1c3cc7b858ff04add01921bdd8302e.text: El año pasado, el país registró un fuerte aumento de homicidios.
sense_6f1c3cc7b858ff04add01921bdd8302e.translation: There was a significant increase in the number of homicides last year.

sense_74c2059871f6ae5578f49aebcd0fc217.text: Afortunadamente no se registraron heridos en el choque.
sense_74c2059871f6ae5578f49aebcd0fc217.translation: Fortunately, no one was hurt in the accident.

sense_74c2059871f6ae5578f49aebcd0fc217.text: Debido a la fuerte lluvia de hoy, se registraron inundaciones por toda la región.
sense_74c2059871f6ae5578f49aebcd0fc217.translation: There was flooding throughout the region due to today's heavy rain.

sense_3b2fca5aaf1947a73cc80db72d0c615c.text: ¿Ese chico intentó acostarse contigo? Voy a su casa directamente para plantarle cuatro verdades.
sense_3b2fca5aaf1947a73cc80db72d0c615c.translation: That boy tried to sleep with you? I'm going straight to his house to give him a piece of my mind.

sense_3b2fca5aaf1947a73cc80db72d0c615c.text: Cuando ese desgraciado me habló de esa forma tan mal educada, pues yo le planté cuatro frescas.
sense_3b2fca5aaf1947a73cc80db72d0c615c.translation: When that good-for-nothing started talking to me so rudely like that, well I gave him a piece of my mind.

sense_4a4217345966e495c25c7af4375ba30b.text: Me planto en la estación rápidamente.
sense_4a4217345966e495c25c7af4375ba30b.translation: I'll be there at the station in no time.

sense_4a4217345966e495c25c7af4375ba30b.text: Para plantarse aquí en solo dos horas, habrá conducido como un loco.
sense_4a4217345966e495c25c7af4375ba30b.translation: To get her in only two hours, he must have driven like crazy.

sense_ca6f44ece729b1be4fc2941e113f3b93.text: Se plantó y no quiso cambiar su manera de hacer las cosas.
sense_ca6f44ece729b1be4fc2941e113f3b93.translation: She stood firm and wouldn't change her way of doing things.

sense_ca6f44ece729b1be4fc2941e113f3b93.text: Le rogué a mi papá que me dejara salir con mis amigos, pero se plantó en su actitud y no me dejó ir.
sense_ca6f44ece729b1be4fc2941e113f3b93.translation: I begged my dad to let me go out with my friends, but he dug in his heels and wouldn't let me go.

sense_6d8e7bdc43d8848b7868b76c8f08e68c.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_06415af0256775da67e681caf96a6609.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_06415af0256775da67e681caf96a6609.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_06415af0256775da67e681caf96a6609.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_06415af0256775da67e681caf96a6609.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_1f868d73dba2c6b03f10d19140583998.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_1f868d73dba2c6b03f10d19140583998.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_1f868d73dba2c6b03f10d19140583998.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_1f868d73dba2c6b03f10d19140583998.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_54d108000a3330b8c2e00b548cca7fe7.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_54d108000a3330b8c2e00b548cca7fe7.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_e07cd65b8a217eb9bcf9b1bf06ccc03f.text: No somos un equipo profesional y jugamos al fútbol solo por diversión.
sense_e07cd65b8a217eb9bcf9b1bf06ccc03f.translation: We are not a professional team and play football just for fun.

sense_e07cd65b8a217eb9bcf9b1bf06ccc03f.text: El parque de atracciones es la mejor opción para un día de diversión en familia.
sense_e07cd65b8a217eb9bcf9b1bf06ccc03f.translation: The theme park is the best option for a fun day out with the family.

sense_1ea8f931cd72768ab36f93b521a7c8f1.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_1ea8f931cd72768ab36f93b521a7c8f1.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_a847a2a8a2aefcc40be5c9f7e3282a92.text: Los jugadores vienen a este gimnasio para su entrenamiento.
sense_a847a2a8a2aefcc40be5c9f7e3282a92.translation: The players come to this gym for training.

sense_a847a2a8a2aefcc40be5c9f7e3282a92.text: La clave para llegar a ser un atleta profesional es un entrenamiento riguroso.
sense_a847a2a8a2aefcc40be5c9f7e3282a92.translation: The key to becoming a professional athlete is rigorous training.

sense_974828995b30969406987de243063f10.text: Duerme muy poco los fines de semana.
sense_974828995b30969406987de243063f10.translation: He doesn't sleep much on weekends.
We don't see much of each other lately.

sense_d928cd84bf58a7e22b4e90e26b37fdf8.text: Hay pocos que se molestarían en ayudarlo como tú.
sense_d928cd84bf58a7e22b4e90e26b37fdf8.translation: There are few who would bother helping him like you do.

sense_d928cd84bf58a7e22b4e90e26b37fdf8.text: Menos mal que pocos piensan como él.
sense_d928cd84bf58a7e22b4e90e26b37fdf8.translation: It's just as well not many people think like he does.

sense_c2db9197b6b53fa748c1e839ba0e5967.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_c2db9197b6b53fa748c1e839ba0e5967.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_c2db9197b6b53fa748c1e839ba0e5967.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_c2db9197b6b53fa748c1e839ba0e5967.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_4859c06fbdd474b1f8351461a702453f.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_4859c06fbdd474b1f8351461a702453f.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_4859c06fbdd474b1f8351461a702453f.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_4859c06fbdd474b1f8351461a702453f.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_eb35a1c652a3f47b1443bef094660bf2.text: No te preocupes, los niños vendrán ya comidos.
sense_eb35a1c652a3f47b1443bef094660bf2.translation: Don't worry. The children will have eaten before they come.

sense_eb35a1c652a3f47b1443bef094660bf2.text: Será un partido difícil, así que vengan bien comidos y dormidos.
sense_eb35a1c652a3f47b1443bef094660bf2.translation: It will be a tough game, so make sure you eat well and have a good night's sleep.

sense_87149f5538b3386111ff81c55d53c29b.text: Las máximas autoridades en la materia acudirán al congreso.
sense_87149f5538b3386111ff81c55d53c29b.translation: The leading authorities on the subject will attend the conference.

sense_87149f5538b3386111ff81c55d53c29b.text: El máximo dirigente del grupo terrorista ha reivindicado las atrocidades cometidas el pasado jueves.
sense_87149f5538b3386111ff81c55d53c29b.translation: The leader of the terrorist group has claimed responsibility for the atrocities committed last Thursday.

sense_00231ca55ff6105f13c964fe0e9ed682.text: Lo máximo que podemos hacer es compensarlos por el viaje.
sense_00231ca55ff6105f13c964fe0e9ed682.translation: The best we can do is reimburse your travel costs.

sense_00231ca55ff6105f13c964fe0e9ed682.text: Lo máximo que puede esperar es que no lo condenen a años de cárcel.
sense_00231ca55ff6105f13c964fe0e9ed682.translation: The most he can hope for is that he isn't sentenced to years in prison.

sense_36a8498ee93d8a8f89210893172a061d.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_36a8498ee93d8a8f89210893172a061d.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_36a8498ee93d8a8f89210893172a061d.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_36a8498ee93d8a8f89210893172a061d.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_5d84c76c1f1008e238f775b290a46acd.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_5d84c76c1f1008e238f775b290a46acd.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_5d84c76c1f1008e238f775b290a46acd.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_5d84c76c1f1008e238f775b290a46acd.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_0e5a9f21d6ce4011a18cb28fc1c48655.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_2436c18ada4baebf951d67c870051255.text: Pablo ama a su esposa con todo su ser.
sense_2436c18ada4baebf951d67c870051255.translation: Pablo loves his wife with all his heart.

sense_2436c18ada4baebf951d67c870051255.text: Yo te amo, Ana, y quiero pasar el resto de mi vida contigo.
sense_2436c18ada4baebf951d67c870051255.translation: I love you, Ana, and I want to spend the rest of my life with you.

sense_99e83b80f41859560303dfa8f618adef.text: El brujo realizó un conjuro para ahuyentar el mal de ojo.
sense_99e83b80f41859560303dfa8f618adef.translation: The wizard made a spell to ward off the evil eye.

sense_99e83b80f41859560303dfa8f618adef.text: Estas tierras son gobernadas por el brujo malvado que vive en aquella torre.
sense_99e83b80f41859560303dfa8f618adef.translation: These lands are ruled by the evil wizard who lives in that tower.

sense_ebbabbf2e1709209ff2f09f5c1a70c42.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_ebbabbf2e1709209ff2f09f5c1a70c42.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_ebbabbf2e1709209ff2f09f5c1a70c42.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_ebbabbf2e1709209ff2f09f5c1a70c42.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_73a20461bcbb5d64167322727e67e791.text: Había una osa con sus oseznos en el zoo.
sense_73a20461bcbb5d64167322727e67e791.translation: There was a bear with her cubs at the zoo.

sense_73a20461bcbb5d64167322727e67e791.text: Hay osos pardos en aquellas montañas, pero no vimos ninguno.
sense_73a20461bcbb5d64167322727e67e791.translation: There are brown bears in those mountains, but we didn't see any.

sense_632e1f0c10953b42e935deb46cf089ec.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_632e1f0c10953b42e935deb46cf089ec.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_632e1f0c10953b42e935deb46cf089ec.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_632e1f0c10953b42e935deb46cf089ec.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_6e04afd5ff6a98284a39a8c92a75b182.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_6e04afd5ff6a98284a39a8c92a75b182.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_6e04afd5ff6a98284a39a8c92a75b182.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_6e04afd5ff6a98284a39a8c92a75b182.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_aa76aaecd8843ed2c315f3d8e2205474.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_aa76aaecd8843ed2c315f3d8e2205474.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_aa76aaecd8843ed2c315f3d8e2205474.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_aa76aaecd8843ed2c315f3d8e2205474.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_f74f7d076d268dd9e96c2438ea25a692.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_f74f7d076d268dd9e96c2438ea25a692.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_4b8aba371f6dc2a9f6fc5d761aaa0373.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_4b8aba371f6dc2a9f6fc5d761aaa0373.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_c9d897ffd90df19104cc390455f3237f.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_c9d897ffd90df19104cc390455f3237f.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_c9d897ffd90df19104cc390455f3237f.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_c9d897ffd90df19104cc390455f3237f.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_e64282659a6fdb07249d03ff97287faf.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_e64282659a6fdb07249d03ff97287faf.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_ba85c13d09ebcf6cd905f96e655482eb.text: Te apuesto que no lloverá el día de tu boda; no te preocupes.
sense_ba85c13d09ebcf6cd905f96e655482eb.translation: I bet you that it won't rain on your wedding day; don't worry.

sense_ba85c13d09ebcf6cd905f96e655482eb.text: Te apuesto $15 a que no eres capaz de encestar la pelota diez veces seguidas.
sense_ba85c13d09ebcf6cd905f96e655482eb.translation: I'll bet you $15 that you can't sink the ball ten times in a row.

sense_ea5ef02e2b6d93298c16659e77546dce.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_ea5ef02e2b6d93298c16659e77546dce.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_6c29ceb2c4ddbe24f2b52e1c2ba24e20.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_6c29ceb2c4ddbe24f2b52e1c2ba24e20.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_6c29ceb2c4ddbe24f2b52e1c2ba24e20.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_6c29ceb2c4ddbe24f2b52e1c2ba24e20.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_85793012d07f58c603835c86355b257e.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_85793012d07f58c603835c86355b257e.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_85793012d07f58c603835c86355b257e.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_85793012d07f58c603835c86355b257e.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_4686beeaada03baf5620de9760ae9da8.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_4686beeaada03baf5620de9760ae9da8.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_4686beeaada03baf5620de9760ae9da8.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_4686beeaada03baf5620de9760ae9da8.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_ec1acc7ff5f7b359ee6aca3e1d9538b7.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_ec1acc7ff5f7b359ee6aca3e1d9538b7.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_ec1acc7ff5f7b359ee6aca3e1d9538b7.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_ec1acc7ff5f7b359ee6aca3e1d9538b7.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_a6b27a9867c79d0d619d051b667acd28.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_a6b27a9867c79d0d619d051b667acd28.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_a6b27a9867c79d0d619d051b667acd28.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_a6b27a9867c79d0d619d051b667acd28.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_5babc53c76fecaa6b8549d3909bde1ce.text: Ella es una joven promesa del arte de escultura.
sense_5babc53c76fecaa6b8549d3909bde1ce.translation: She brings such young talent to the art of sculpture.

sense_5babc53c76fecaa6b8549d3909bde1ce.text: Villarroel es nuestra promesa del equipo boliviano de fútbol.
sense_5babc53c76fecaa6b8549d3909bde1ce.translation: Villarroel is our new hope for the Bolivian football team.

sense_6d936582b6bb1eae5732b0096f4e53e7.text: Me metieron un puro por fumar en el baño.
sense_6d936582b6bb1eae5732b0096f4e53e7.translation: They threw the book at me for smoking in the bathroom.

sense_6d936582b6bb1eae5732b0096f4e53e7.text: ¿No puedes usar el automóvil por seis meses? ¡Qué puro!
sense_6d936582b6bb1eae5732b0096f4e53e7.translation: You're not allowed to drive the car for six months? That sucks!

sense_dc52b11c4fb836f56a9fd3599ac0b06c.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_dc52b11c4fb836f56a9fd3599ac0b06c.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_dc52b11c4fb836f56a9fd3599ac0b06c.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_dc52b11c4fb836f56a9fd3599ac0b06c.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_86615c9a79a1ce3c968a9ef8fb085bc9.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_86615c9a79a1ce3c968a9ef8fb085bc9.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_86615c9a79a1ce3c968a9ef8fb085bc9.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_86615c9a79a1ce3c968a9ef8fb085bc9.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_70fda3b3aa1727f847f8e9d403c23237.text: No le tire patadas a su hermano.
Su perro me tiró un mordisco.

sense_9aaace1f6e8db36bffbf84a475a848c9.text: Las fiestas ya no me tiran.
sense_9aaace1f6e8db36bffbf84a475a848c9.translation: Parties don't appeal to me anymore.
He is not interested in studying medicine.

sense_cb83ecb0de8e78e27498aa61488e86fc.text: El plato tiraba a dulce más que nada.
sense_cb83ecb0de8e78e27498aa61488e86fc.translation: The dish was more sweet than anything else.

sense_cb83ecb0de8e78e27498aa61488e86fc.text: Tienes que beberte el té cuando esté tirando a frío.
sense_cb83ecb0de8e78e27498aa61488e86fc.translation: You have to drink the tea when it is cooling down.

sense_bfac77da6fef7ed9e4e4e4f409983db6.text: El bebé se tiró un eructo tras tomarse su biberón.
sense_bfac77da6fef7ed9e4e4e4f409983db6.translation: The baby burped after having his bottle.

sense_bfac77da6fef7ed9e4e4e4f409983db6.text: La primera vez que se tiró un pedo delante de su novio se avergonzó.
sense_bfac77da6fef7ed9e4e4e4f409983db6.translation: The first time she farted in front of her boyfriend, she was embarrassed.

sense_06e0281881bde8b5c451923f67f9940b.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_06e0281881bde8b5c451923f67f9940b.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_a356e6d6e61211aa2c8054b3e6273048.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_a356e6d6e61211aa2c8054b3e6273048.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_ed606874c46eec780f8f752fa02e3822.translation: I don't know which one she wants.

sense_acb71056deed1c3b149e1903a2421507.text: Hay que comprar una sartén nueva porque esta ya no sirve.
sense_acb71056deed1c3b149e1903a2421507.translation: We need to buy a new frying pan because this one is no good any more.
Is this one any good to you?

sense_db57a67a170f0200da81f43da43216fd.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_db57a67a170f0200da81f43da43216fd.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_2d00d0dcc4c82c945b327c3ba3ff77c0.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_2d00d0dcc4c82c945b327c3ba3ff77c0.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_3f8760d7da755dee55bdc71d771b8c39.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_3f8760d7da755dee55bdc71d771b8c39.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_3f8760d7da755dee55bdc71d771b8c39.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_3f8760d7da755dee55bdc71d771b8c39.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_16098bd229bf70cbd5ccfddd382d9a00.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_16098bd229bf70cbd5ccfddd382d9a00.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_adc62f18432b20d0838feb42b2cde135.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_adc62f18432b20d0838feb42b2cde135.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_adc62f18432b20d0838feb42b2cde135.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_adc62f18432b20d0838feb42b2cde135.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_b24a7798196b1deaf3d71acaac3bb55d.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_b24a7798196b1deaf3d71acaac3bb55d.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_b24a7798196b1deaf3d71acaac3bb55d.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_b24a7798196b1deaf3d71acaac3bb55d.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_387942c45327cfe285a455da979e4370.text: ¿Averiguaste qué era lo que le pasaba?
sense_387942c45327cfe285a455da979e4370.translation: Did you find out what was wrong with him?

sense_387942c45327cfe285a455da979e4370.text: No me sé el número de Gabriela, pero te lo puedo averiguar.
sense_387942c45327cfe285a455da979e4370.translation: I don't know Gabriela's number, but I can find out for you.

sense_0994a564741e03c7cceeda2b17b9de59.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_0994a564741e03c7cceeda2b17b9de59.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_0994a564741e03c7cceeda2b17b9de59.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_0994a564741e03c7cceeda2b17b9de59.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_09e9994fde1a379f371c6265d3048ac6.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_09e9994fde1a379f371c6265d3048ac6.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_09e9994fde1a379f371c6265d3048ac6.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_09e9994fde1a379f371c6265d3048ac6.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_d227fd33bebb5a99aafa0565962fec64.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_d227fd33bebb5a99aafa0565962fec64.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_d227fd33bebb5a99aafa0565962fec64.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_d227fd33bebb5a99aafa0565962fec64.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_b41ef31e938c110e3b19ff2cf4e5fcec.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_b41ef31e938c110e3b19ff2cf4e5fcec.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_81a6f183573ae1f0a3b4724b1088538c.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_81a6f183573ae1f0a3b4724b1088538c.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_60e93156e64d1c8459a779a73a1b50d6.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_60e93156e64d1c8459a779a73a1b50d6.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_60e93156e64d1c8459a779a73a1b50d6.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_60e93156e64d1c8459a779a73a1b50d6.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_6172150bd20f6892b1d3754acaa6ef3f.text: Jorge cumplió su sueño de convertirse en médico.
sense_6172150bd20f6892b1d3754acaa6ef3f.translation: Jorge achieved his dream of becoming a doctor.

sense_6172150bd20f6892b1d3754acaa6ef3f.text: Hay que tener fuerza de voluntad para cumplir tus metas.
sense_6172150bd20f6892b1d3754acaa6ef3f.translation: You need willpower to achieve your goals.

sense_60bbd8f8547cda35dc305b517f3ae3c7.text: Si me permite, señora, creo que puedo arreglar la puerta.
sense_60bbd8f8547cda35dc305b517f3ae3c7.translation: If I may, ma'am, I think I can fix the door.

sense_d0a5061ddc3f268591428818b09bf3ad.text: Vi una sombra en la ventana y me asusté.
sense_d0a5061ddc3f268591428818b09bf3ad.translation: I saw a shadow in the window and I got scared.

sense_d0a5061ddc3f268591428818b09bf3ad.text: No pude verle la cara al ladrón. Solo vi su sombra.
sense_d0a5061ddc3f268591428818b09bf3ad.translation: I wasn't able to see the thief's face. I only saw his shadow.

sense_cfd05627f6d7f40dc2bf6171e708158e.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_cfd05627f6d7f40dc2bf6171e708158e.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_8262de3a3d6c7da7ccdd23e01d26e4f8.text: Nos casamos y a la vuelta de tres años tuvimos nuestro primer bebé.
sense_8262de3a3d6c7da7ccdd23e01d26e4f8.translation: We got married and three years later we had our first baby.

sense_8262de3a3d6c7da7ccdd23e01d26e4f8.text: A la vuelta de siete meses de vivir en la calle, por fin encontró trabajo.
sense_8262de3a3d6c7da7ccdd23e01d26e4f8.translation: After seven months of living on the streets, he finally found a job.

sense_ca80c81741ba63d0bf11a9ef9243a869.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_ca80c81741ba63d0bf11a9ef9243a869.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_9cd5a3ec738bc8ed9702c19a41df17b6.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_9cd5a3ec738bc8ed9702c19a41df17b6.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_302d6bc0418ae89293e24cb6d24c74b2.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_302d6bc0418ae89293e24cb6d24c74b2.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_302d6bc0418ae89293e24cb6d24c74b2.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_302d6bc0418ae89293e24cb6d24c74b2.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_88e727179633d5793cd7c76b32bfd3f8.text: Mi primo está enamorado de mi mejor amiga.
sense_88e727179633d5793cd7c76b32bfd3f8.translation: My cousin is in love with my best friend.

sense_88e727179633d5793cd7c76b32bfd3f8.text: ¡Estás enamorada y no lo puedes negar!
sense_88e727179633d5793cd7c76b32bfd3f8.translation: You're in love and you can't hide it!

sense_08acebbf75a41dc19113b722b78cb360.text: "Con estos versos, seguro la enamoro," dijo el poeta.
sense_08acebbf75a41dc19113b722b78cb360.translation: "With these verses, I'm sure to make her fall in love," said the poet.

sense_08acebbf75a41dc19113b722b78cb360.text: Enamoré a mi mujer haciéndome pasar por escritor, y en eso me convertí.
sense_08acebbf75a41dc19113b722b78cb360.translation: I made my wife fall in love with me by pretending to be a writer, and that's what I became.

sense_5d3bc615a620967b948917a899a35fd8.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_5d3bc615a620967b948917a899a35fd8.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_5d3bc615a620967b948917a899a35fd8.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_5d3bc615a620967b948917a899a35fd8.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_aaba691309755ef035aedcbab445344a.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_aaba691309755ef035aedcbab445344a.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_aaba691309755ef035aedcbab445344a.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_aaba691309755ef035aedcbab445344a.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_1cf266c42daaf2e961efcb2873eb24e3.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_1cf266c42daaf2e961efcb2873eb24e3.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_1cf266c42daaf2e961efcb2873eb24e3.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_1cf266c42daaf2e961efcb2873eb24e3.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_4793d1b5d6eaf521c5ee0660d7b8d2de.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_4793d1b5d6eaf521c5ee0660d7b8d2de.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_4793d1b5d6eaf521c5ee0660d7b8d2de.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_4793d1b5d6eaf521c5ee0660d7b8d2de.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_5a66da54be3e09990688ebd73cebcea5.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_5a66da54be3e09990688ebd73cebcea5.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_5a66da54be3e09990688ebd73cebcea5.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_5a66da54be3e09990688ebd73cebcea5.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_e052f1ed9204340b3b8b8e39d6f882f8.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_e052f1ed9204340b3b8b8e39d6f882f8.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_bdaa2a33efc1dc9ccf472043079dd22e.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_bdaa2a33efc1dc9ccf472043079dd22e.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_d959559068492011b63a9b5300c549c4.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_d959559068492011b63a9b5300c549c4.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_d959559068492011b63a9b5300c549c4.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_d959559068492011b63a9b5300c549c4.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_aa33ec2ff8bc9cb7453ae75523a5c821.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_aa33ec2ff8bc9cb7453ae75523a5c821.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_aa33ec2ff8bc9cb7453ae75523a5c821.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_aa33ec2ff8bc9cb7453ae75523a5c821.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_615f32281e0c65b1468e2e13f20566c5.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_615f32281e0c65b1468e2e13f20566c5.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_92b5eb2a39686fe1cdf5575859dfb37a.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_92b5eb2a39686fe1cdf5575859dfb37a.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_92b5eb2a39686fe1cdf5575859dfb37a.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_92b5eb2a39686fe1cdf5575859dfb37a.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_cf74091464eb254fe6c788987f6f3991.text: El descubrimiento provocó una división en la comunidad científica.
sense_cf74091464eb254fe6c788987f6f3991.translation: The discovery caused a division within the scientific community.

sense_cf74091464eb254fe6c788987f6f3991.text: Los políticos están buscando cortejar a la comunidad hispana en las próximas elecciones.
sense_cf74091464eb254fe6c788987f6f3991.translation: Politicians are seeking to court the Hispanic community in the upcoming election.

sense_40e74a21a45999df78f00068248592d8.text: Mi hermana me encargó sus hijos este sábado.
sense_40e74a21a45999df78f00068248592d8.translation: My sister's asked me to look after her kids on Saturday.

sense_40e74a21a45999df78f00068248592d8.text: Le encargaron conseguir un restaurante para la fiesta a Marco.
sense_40e74a21a45999df78f00068248592d8.translation: Marco was given the job of finding a restaurant for the party.

sense_f50fa000a700bb72989cee19f245a23b.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_f50fa000a700bb72989cee19f245a23b.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_f50fa000a700bb72989cee19f245a23b.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_f50fa000a700bb72989cee19f245a23b.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_de5c0beb82ffa5ad94d48e362f0025fb.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_de5c0beb82ffa5ad94d48e362f0025fb.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_b92500526da733ece41110a2577b240b.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_b92500526da733ece41110a2577b240b.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_cf5d1c7aa0b406ca180743feca94e080.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_1e550d9861f1cfe7541fd5d5cd93f65e.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_1e550d9861f1cfe7541fd5d5cd93f65e.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_abf06c3dc9ac3a9aa4d35efaaad52a31.text: Hay algunas medidas que podemos tomar en lo que se refiere al presupuesto.
sense_abf06c3dc9ac3a9aa4d35efaaad52a31.translation: There are some measures we can take with regards to the budget.

sense_abf06c3dc9ac3a9aa4d35efaaad52a31.text: En lo que se refiere a los empleados nuevamente contratados, tenemos que estar de acuerdo en cuanto a la capacitación.
sense_abf06c3dc9ac3a9aa4d35efaaad52a31.translation: As far as new hires are concerned, we have to all be on the same page with regard to training.

sense_d81b0fa9c3024ca898b04faeb9ed4df9.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_d81b0fa9c3024ca898b04faeb9ed4df9.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_d81b0fa9c3024ca898b04faeb9ed4df9.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_d81b0fa9c3024ca898b04faeb9ed4df9.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_17cc8f91e8800bc300966f95268d09cb.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_17cc8f91e8800bc300966f95268d09cb.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_17cc8f91e8800bc300966f95268d09cb.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_17cc8f91e8800bc300966f95268d09cb.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_c03feea3cac402a7ef5df5b9c720c993.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_c03feea3cac402a7ef5df5b9c720c993.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_c03feea3cac402a7ef5df5b9c720c993.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_c03feea3cac402a7ef5df5b9c720c993.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_32ac5425dd6fcec5b031f79447492f48.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_c1d5400f71b2ddb25a2f537e37f9ad30.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_c1d5400f71b2ddb25a2f537e37f9ad30.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_c1d5400f71b2ddb25a2f537e37f9ad30.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_c1d5400f71b2ddb25a2f537e37f9ad30.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_548f8783968d5a05fd74a29fbdeabf57.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_548f8783968d5a05fd74a29fbdeabf57.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_548f8783968d5a05fd74a29fbdeabf57.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_548f8783968d5a05fd74a29fbdeabf57.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_8c599e973a85b4b66f0f4b826d575174.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_8c599e973a85b4b66f0f4b826d575174.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_5cf0e634afaa649d49968f1c04f33e3f.text: El barco se quedó atrapado en el hielo del Ártico y un rescate parecía imposible.
sense_5cf0e634afaa649d49968f1c04f33e3f.translation: The boat was trapped in the Arctic ice and rescue seemed impossible.

sense_5cf0e634afaa649d49968f1c04f33e3f.text: Se divorció de su esposo porque tenía la sensación de estar atrapada en un matrimonio infeliz y aburrido.
sense_5cf0e634afaa649d49968f1c04f33e3f.translation: She divorced her husband because she had the feeling of being trapped in an unhappy and boring marriage.

sense_aca50ca35a918e689012e25bda1aa27b.text: Cuanto más trabaja, más rico se hace.
sense_aca50ca35a918e689012e25bda1aa27b.translation: The more he works, the richer he gets.
The more he gets, the more he wants.

sense_20a07af15734224d49e4fab2dde1e1eb.text: Me gusta jugar al bingo por el dinero.
sense_20a07af15734224d49e4fab2dde1e1eb.translation: I love playing Bingo for money.
Does anybody want to play tennis with me?

sense_7551477d119e5cf89792b578b68dcc95.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_7551477d119e5cf89792b578b68dcc95.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_7551477d119e5cf89792b578b68dcc95.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_7551477d119e5cf89792b578b68dcc95.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_9d1f183f1bf7626d2267f92d746c071d.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_9d1f183f1bf7626d2267f92d746c071d.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_9d1f183f1bf7626d2267f92d746c071d.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_9d1f183f1bf7626d2267f92d746c071d.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_f9f56bfd20c015a51d95a37a893e2f66.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_4891142c6fe2bdc8cdee4b55dc93ece2.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_4891142c6fe2bdc8cdee4b55dc93ece2.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_4891142c6fe2bdc8cdee4b55dc93ece2.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_4891142c6fe2bdc8cdee4b55dc93ece2.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_956516026df359c1e857a5a8afbf579f.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_956516026df359c1e857a5a8afbf579f.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_956516026df359c1e857a5a8afbf579f.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_956516026df359c1e857a5a8afbf579f.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_02d73719afed5d641ce11ff714b155f3.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_02d73719afed5d641ce11ff714b155f3.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_02d73719afed5d641ce11ff714b155f3.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_02d73719afed5d641ce11ff714b155f3.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_f727520593ce65b35457c37cd73e6b21.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_f727520593ce65b35457c37cd73e6b21.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_ad8607dc08736bb45d8fc13e7d842bfa.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_ad8607dc08736bb45d8fc13e7d842bfa.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_071a7789399f6232d134633282651ae0.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_071a7789399f6232d134633282651ae0.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_9004ea96aaef98f6e822cf0a23d70469.text: El jugador de baloncesto se lesionó la rodilla.
sense_9004ea96aaef98f6e822cf0a23d70469.translation: The basketball player injured his knee.

sense_9004ea96aaef98f6e822cf0a23d70469.text: Se puso de rodillas para pedir perdón.
sense_9004ea96aaef98f6e822cf0a23d70469.translation: He got down on his knees to ask for forgiveness.

sense_9560d77aa504fca752880da521ced216.text: Estoy muy interesado en el puesto de gerente.
sense_9560d77aa504fca752880da521ced216.translation: I'm very interested in the managing position.

sense_9560d77aa504fca752880da521ced216.text: Siempre estuve interesado en la historia de la Antigua Grecia.
sense_9560d77aa504fca752880da521ced216.translation: I've always been interested in Ancient Greek history.

sense_281a66c27bc417e86a13bf780c2231dd.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_281a66c27bc417e86a13bf780c2231dd.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_3ef5b11ebf5a72ef8ab1be42cc744938.text: El alumno escribió su ensayo de 20 páginas en una noche.
sense_3ef5b11ebf5a72ef8ab1be42cc744938.translation: The student wrote his 20-page essay in one night.

sense_6778b2c20bcd779fa6ee24d192997a7e.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_6778b2c20bcd779fa6ee24d192997a7e.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_706a98173f4c02c0594497d3bf9f3393.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_706a98173f4c02c0594497d3bf9f3393.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_706a98173f4c02c0594497d3bf9f3393.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_706a98173f4c02c0594497d3bf9f3393.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_7bb1cd5ad51e9be632839bb08ead1afd.text: ¡Pedazo de mi alma! Ven a darme un beso.
sense_7bb1cd5ad51e9be632839bb08ead1afd.translation: My darling! Come give me a kiss.

sense_7bb1cd5ad51e9be632839bb08ead1afd.text: Ese pedazo de güey chocó contra la puerta de la cochera.
sense_7bb1cd5ad51e9be632839bb08ead1afd.translation: That idiot crashed into the garage door.

sense_6eb27c13102890431b2e4078707b10fb.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_6eb27c13102890431b2e4078707b10fb.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_e3cb765720a884f43980de9d5470d41a.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_e3cb765720a884f43980de9d5470d41a.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_aee233aefa4dd8c744be921f3af5504f.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_aee233aefa4dd8c744be921f3af5504f.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_aee233aefa4dd8c744be921f3af5504f.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_ce5789c0026ee29ec811b4cf74d51343.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_ce5789c0026ee29ec811b4cf74d51343.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_ce5789c0026ee29ec811b4cf74d51343.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_dbb5576a012e479d0d73e4e3bf9d90bf.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_e0b9c69c6bd0ef5860da5e1129f24a15.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_e0b9c69c6bd0ef5860da5e1129f24a15.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_e0b9c69c6bd0ef5860da5e1129f24a15.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_e0b9c69c6bd0ef5860da5e1129f24a15.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_408039fddc9abbdc87edf7f3b08a9f97.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_408039fddc9abbdc87edf7f3b08a9f97.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_533d1da3d012bd75cebaf70ad47915c3.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_533d1da3d012bd75cebaf70ad47915c3.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_533d1da3d012bd75cebaf70ad47915c3.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_533d1da3d012bd75cebaf70ad47915c3.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_92aa4f9bf4859e3139d9f60fddc4e573.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_92aa4f9bf4859e3139d9f60fddc4e573.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_ea99486cb290ce6488749a36b4f3adbf.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_ea99486cb290ce6488749a36b4f3adbf.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_ea99486cb290ce6488749a36b4f3adbf.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_ea99486cb290ce6488749a36b4f3adbf.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_808954d76995c0b0e2c97c0be14d5338.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_808954d76995c0b0e2c97c0be14d5338.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_808954d76995c0b0e2c97c0be14d5338.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_808954d76995c0b0e2c97c0be14d5338.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_498c422f9f8cdbc1ee2178a3c3fdc5cf.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_498c422f9f8cdbc1ee2178a3c3fdc5cf.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_ec029aec819b808aefc71f62111902c8.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_ec029aec819b808aefc71f62111902c8.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_ec029aec819b808aefc71f62111902c8.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_ec029aec819b808aefc71f62111902c8.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_83c7ab26c33883a6938ebc831ecd0ced.text: Dicen que el alcalde recibió dinero de fuentes sospechosas.
sense_83c7ab26c33883a6938ebc831ecd0ced.translation: They say that the mayor received money from shady sources.

sense_83c7ab26c33883a6938ebc831ecd0ced.text: La víctima recibió un fuerte golpe al lado de la cabeza.
sense_83c7ab26c33883a6938ebc831ecd0ced.translation: The victim received a strong blow to the side of the head.

sense_7dedbf9e0d730c3d6aa8b59ef9d0720a.text: El equipo visitante fue recibido con silbidos y abucheos.
sense_7dedbf9e0d730c3d6aa8b59ef9d0720a.translation: The visiting team was received with whistles and jeers.

sense_7dedbf9e0d730c3d6aa8b59ef9d0720a.text: Nos recibió personalmente en el aeropuerto.
sense_7dedbf9e0d730c3d6aa8b59ef9d0720a.translation: He personally welcomed us at the airport.

sense_1b2635fc51e28ad6db57448eef70876d.text: Mi hermana se recibió de ingeniera en Georgia Tech.
sense_1b2635fc51e28ad6db57448eef70876d.translation: My sister graduated as an engineer from Georgia Tech.
How many students will graduate this year?

sense_2434e995ebb240079bac624bdf564c32.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_2434e995ebb240079bac624bdf564c32.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_2434e995ebb240079bac624bdf564c32.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_2434e995ebb240079bac624bdf564c32.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_ff34956c9a2116378e8e59caac93c8d9.text: Me alarmaron las manchas rojas que Paco tenía en la espalda.
sense_ff34956c9a2116378e8e59caac93c8d9.translation: I was alarmed by the red spots Paco had on his back.

sense_ff34956c9a2116378e8e59caac93c8d9.text: No te quiero alarmar, pero hay una araña enorme justo arriba de ti.
sense_ff34956c9a2116378e8e59caac93c8d9.translation: I don't want to alarm you, but there's a huge spider right above you.

sense_3fdd29d2c62cdfb6bf230997912cd3e5.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_3fdd29d2c62cdfb6bf230997912cd3e5.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_3fdd29d2c62cdfb6bf230997912cd3e5.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_3fdd29d2c62cdfb6bf230997912cd3e5.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_b22dfebe04d0679b25059d560e78ecd2.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_b22dfebe04d0679b25059d560e78ecd2.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_b22dfebe04d0679b25059d560e78ecd2.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_b22dfebe04d0679b25059d560e78ecd2.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_c130322de5d2ffd773c1e68c56ec93fb.text: La artesanía que venden en el mercado está toda hecha a mano.
sense_c130322de5d2ffd773c1e68c56ec93fb.translation: The crafts sold at the market are all handmade.

sense_bbb971976a10357ff7ad3b8ee49cf607.text: Me gustan los filetes bien hechos.
sense_bbb971976a10357ff7ad3b8ee49cf607.translation: I like my steak well done.

sense_08ddf37255ea5a6f59a7f57cf2fcd124.text: Después de la mudanza, estaba hecha polvo.
sense_08ddf37255ea5a6f59a7f57cf2fcd124.translation: I was completely exhausted after we moved.
