sense_08ddf37255ea5a6f59a7f57cf2fcd124.text: Esta casa está hecha un asco.

sense_32c330c90674750d6b75274d64e71652.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_32c330c90674750d6b75274d64e71652.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_59f26728a46fac1805c6f0b21a53e42f.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_59f26728a46fac1805c6f0b21a53e42f.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_7aa45553a039dcc252958d44dad5e626.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_7aa45553a039dcc252958d44dad5e626.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_7aa45553a039dcc252958d44dad5e626.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_7aa45553a039dcc252958d44dad5e626.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_d1914f7c62ceabacfb08da935024cf86.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_d1914f7c62ceabacfb08da935024cf86.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_d1914f7c62ceabacfb08da935024cf86.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_d1914f7c62ceabacfb08da935024cf86.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_453c2700d28b2139c846bd817ee484db.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_453c2700d28b2139c846bd817ee484db.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_ef6080dad8b445dab8318dac2f9765ef.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_ef6080dad8b445dab8318dac2f9765ef.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_ef6080dad8b445dab8318dac2f9765ef.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_ef6080dad8b445dab8318dac2f9765ef.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_936ada7c49d6a42d8386cccb9a03e9fd.text: ¿Me prestas $20? - ¡Claro que no! Todavía me debes $50.
sense_936ada7c49d6a42d8386cccb9a03e9fd.translation: Can I borrow $20? - No, you can't! You still owe me $50.

sense_936ada7c49d6a42d8386cccb9a03e9fd.text: Papá, ¿me ayudarás a hacer la tarea de matemáticas esta noche? - ¡Claro que sí!
sense_936ada7c49d6a42d8386cccb9a03e9fd.translation: Dad, will you help me with my math homework this evening? - Of course I will!

sense_5ea528231d9571a8da399c5fc5d1ac80.text: Margarita se negó a hacerlo. Claro que yo en su lugar también me hubiera negado.
sense_5ea528231d9571a8da399c5fc5d1ac80.translation: Margarita refused to do it. Mind you, I would have refused too in her place.

sense_5ea528231d9571a8da399c5fc5d1ac80.text: ¿Lo haces tú? - Claro, para que si sale mal me eches la culpa a mí.
sense_5ea528231d9571a8da399c5fc5d1ac80.translation: Will you do it? - Oh sure, so you can blame me if it goes wrong.

sense_b5143a192d699e5a6fb28196fe62c5e7.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_b5143a192d699e5a6fb28196fe62c5e7.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_b5143a192d699e5a6fb28196fe62c5e7.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_b5143a192d699e5a6fb28196fe62c5e7.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_5b008a833f83ea024c568f610932fe1e.text: Is it okay if I leave it here?
If you don't feel like going out, that's quite okay.
sense_5b008a833f83ea024c568f610932fe1e.translation: Si no tienes ganas de salir, no hay ningún problema.

sense_866df2987801f587c06c1a942fa1fdab.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_866df2987801f587c06c1a942fa1fdab.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_866df2987801f587c06c1a942fa1fdab.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_866df2987801f587c06c1a942fa1fdab.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_2135c83018d3b879b6a6589394b675c4.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_0b81b5057e70d1689dadc638956e694b.text: Don Bernardo habló con mucha autoridad de la economía.
sense_0b81b5057e70d1689dadc638956e694b.translation: Don Bernardo spoke very authoritatively about the economy.

sense_0b81b5057e70d1689dadc638956e694b.text: Antonio describe con autoridad la situación económica de su país.
sense_0b81b5057e70d1689dadc638956e694b.translation: Antonio gives an authoritative account of his country's economic situation.

sense_e949e99a64029a4daa37cdf2a66a7c35.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_e949e99a64029a4daa37cdf2a66a7c35.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_c9303143c8959c314efe55cbbe77facd.text: A ver qué excusa se inventa ahora.
sense_c9303143c8959c314efe55cbbe77facd.translation: Let's see the excuse she comes up with now.

sense_c9303143c8959c314efe55cbbe77facd.text: Siempre estás buscando excusas para no ir al colegio.
sense_c9303143c8959c314efe55cbbe77facd.translation: You're always looking for any excuse to not go to school.

sense_ac451fbe2657a978938cf67de8572cbc.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_ac451fbe2657a978938cf67de8572cbc.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_ac451fbe2657a978938cf67de8572cbc.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_ac451fbe2657a978938cf67de8572cbc.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_b38d86148ba87aa4055e6964ccfdc6aa.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_b38d86148ba87aa4055e6964ccfdc6aa.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_b38d86148ba87aa4055e6964ccfdc6aa.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_b38d86148ba87aa4055e6964ccfdc6aa.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_d3b69bfc6f83c250691d4ed60267240b.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_d3b69bfc6f83c250691d4ed60267240b.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_d3b69bfc6f83c250691d4ed60267240b.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_d3b69bfc6f83c250691d4ed60267240b.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_d8d3cceb08b38fc886a24492a704f655.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_d8d3cceb08b38fc886a24492a704f655.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_d8d3cceb08b38fc886a24492a704f655.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_d8d3cceb08b38fc886a24492a704f655.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_27cb4953bb144b9007c98d8bc64a7a94.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_27cb4953bb144b9007c98d8bc64a7a94.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_27cb4953bb144b9007c98d8bc64a7a94.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_27cb4953bb144b9007c98d8bc64a7a94.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_abf2183405953db5a550b154f0aa9f07.text: No pongas esa cara después de toda la suerte que has tenido.
sense_abf2183405953db5a550b154f0aa9f07.translation: Don't give me that look after all the luck you've had.

sense_2f951f617ff5f8a93954f06033af317f.text: Recuerden escribir sobre las dos caras del papel.
sense_2f951f617ff5f8a93954f06033af317f.translation: Remember to write on both sides of the piece of paper.

sense_2f951f617ff5f8a93954f06033af317f.text: Son dos caras de la misma moneda.
sense_2f951f617ff5f8a93954f06033af317f.translation: They are two sides of the same coin.

sense_afe53ace647450e65c6e0c397f6a5e62.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_afe53ace647450e65c6e0c397f6a5e62.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_d2a837926d05df79fa89f98f21126c33.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_e133f3d9bf68dea31496bd339af010d5.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_e133f3d9bf68dea31496bd339af010d5.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_e133f3d9bf68dea31496bd339af010d5.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_e133f3d9bf68dea31496bd339af010d5.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_a3c2f2f8a520892bf61ad20b37b24eaf.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_a3c2f2f8a520892bf61ad20b37b24eaf.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_a3c2f2f8a520892bf61ad20b37b24eaf.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_a3c2f2f8a520892bf61ad20b37b24eaf.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_8c626f1330d54b58de9ee9692fbe88dd.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_8c626f1330d54b58de9ee9692fbe88dd.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_3b821515e6a466f390a00de013089cc4.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_3b821515e6a466f390a00de013089cc4.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_3b821515e6a466f390a00de013089cc4.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_3b821515e6a466f390a00de013089cc4.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_e0787e2410e1e54a09b82cd12d0d9e9e.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_e0787e2410e1e54a09b82cd12d0d9e9e.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_e0787e2410e1e54a09b82cd12d0d9e9e.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_e0787e2410e1e54a09b82cd12d0d9e9e.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_1636f52b0faeda8f5186463331bad7eb.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_1636f52b0faeda8f5186463331bad7eb.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_6ea034c749059ef5a3ca7e9667c67933.text: La peluquería está justo enfrente del cine.
sense_6ea034c749059ef5a3ca7e9667c67933.translation: The hairdresser's is opposite the movie theater.
We left the car just opposite.

sense_4ec3c04b4ded5fd324b9447daba2998a.text: ¿Qué le dirías si lo tuvieras enfrente?
sense_4ec3c04b4ded5fd324b9447daba2998a.translation: What would you say to him if he was in front of you?

sense_4ec3c04b4ded5fd324b9447daba2998a.text: Se sentó enfrente de él y le miró a los ojos.
sense_4ec3c04b4ded5fd324b9447daba2998a.translation: She sat down opposite him and looked into his eyes.

sense_afdf8cf0687f16f99d5a80a13a5be457.text: Las autoridades enfrentaron al sospechoso tan pronto como lo encontraron.
sense_afdf8cf0687f16f99d5a80a13a5be457.translation: The authorities confronted the suspect as soon as they found him.

sense_afdf8cf0687f16f99d5a80a13a5be457.text: Tienes que enfrentar tus miedos si quieres avanzar en la vida.
sense_afdf8cf0687f16f99d5a80a13a5be457.translation: You have to confront your fears if you want to advance in life.

sense_3c6ecdb82d7e428c78bc9650590011cf.text: ¿Será que te arrestas a lanzarte en paracaídas?
sense_3c6ecdb82d7e428c78bc9650590011cf.translation: Would you dare to go skydiving?

sense_3c6ecdb82d7e428c78bc9650590011cf.text: Luz es una mujer valiente que se arresta a todo.
sense_3c6ecdb82d7e428c78bc9650590011cf.translation: Luz is a brave woman who's afraid of nothing.

sense_dd5523eca93bb1e4295db964fe319355.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_dd5523eca93bb1e4295db964fe319355.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_dd5523eca93bb1e4295db964fe319355.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_dd5523eca93bb1e4295db964fe319355.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_4659394f9acc35d835476fec4c87e4c7.text: Pablo ama a su esposa con todo su ser.
sense_4659394f9acc35d835476fec4c87e4c7.translation: Pablo loves his wife with all his heart.

sense_4659394f9acc35d835476fec4c87e4c7.text: Yo te amo, Ana, y quiero pasar el resto de mi vida contigo.
sense_4659394f9acc35d835476fec4c87e4c7.translation: I love you, Ana, and I want to spend the rest of my life with you.

sense_93cca478e946eba558c12edae77dab19.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_93cca478e946eba558c12edae77dab19.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_f2474429a9e620d1315992762ba1750a.text: No podré seguir trabajando hoy porque Internet está fuera de línea.
sense_f2474429a9e620d1315992762ba1750a.translation: I won't be able to keep working today because the Internet is down.

sense_f2474429a9e620d1315992762ba1750a.text: Como no vivo cerca de una universidad, hice mis estudios en línea.
sense_f2474429a9e620d1315992762ba1750a.translation: Since I don't live near a university, I did my courses online.

sense_dbef7bddc03b17ce702c1bbe6099d97b.text: Nuestra preferencia sería algo en la línea del diseño original.
sense_dbef7bddc03b17ce702c1bbe6099d97b.translation: Our preference would be something along the lines of the original design.

sense_dbef7bddc03b17ce702c1bbe6099d97b.text: La estrategia de ventas será en líneas generales lo mismo, pero vamos a cambiar algunos detalles.
sense_dbef7bddc03b17ce702c1bbe6099d97b.translation: The sales strategy will be broadly speaking the same, but we're going to change a few details.

sense_84dbb56044993be343ea1ac94fcb47cd.text: ¿No preferirías ir de vacaciones al extranjero este año?
sense_84dbb56044993be343ea1ac94fcb47cd.translation: Wouldn't you rather vacation abroad this year?

sense_84dbb56044993be343ea1ac94fcb47cd.text: Prefiero que se lo digas tú porque a ti te hace más caso.
sense_84dbb56044993be343ea1ac94fcb47cd.translation: I'd rather you told him because he listens to you more.

sense_628e913a469ac0f67bc7e6e4ec12d947.text: Tomás está autorizado a transferir empleados en su condición de gerente.
sense_628e913a469ac0f67bc7e6e4ec12d947.translation: Tomas is allowed to transfer employees as a manager.

sense_628e913a469ac0f67bc7e6e4ec12d947.text: Su condición de maestra de la escuela le impide dar clases particulares a sus alumnos.
sense_628e913a469ac0f67bc7e6e4ec12d947.translation: Her capacity as a teacher in this school prevents her from tutoring her students.

sense_9f72b5d5fd8010150c0f578a9f634485.text: La fruta enviada en los contenedores llegó en malas condiciones.
sense_9f72b5d5fd8010150c0f578a9f634485.translation: The fruit shipped in the containers was not fresh.

sense_9f72b5d5fd8010150c0f578a9f634485.text: El delantero se recuperó de su lesión y está en condiciones de volver a jugar.
sense_9f72b5d5fd8010150c0f578a9f634485.translation: The forward recovered from the injury and is fit to play again.

sense_0c29b686c7c01510598af6419b51f5a3.text: El delincuente fue castigado con cuatro años de cárcel.
sense_0c29b686c7c01510598af6419b51f5a3.translation: The criminal was given a four-year prison sentence.

sense_0c29b686c7c01510598af6419b51f5a3.text: La violación será castigada con una pena de varios años de reclusión.
sense_0c29b686c7c01510598af6419b51f5a3.translation: Rape will be punishable by a prison sentence of several years.

sense_79b9ef2dff2f83349c8f39ea7517fcec.text: Me castigaron a repetir el ejercicio varias veces.
sense_79b9ef2dff2f83349c8f39ea7517fcec.translation: I was made to repeat the exercise several times as a punishment.

sense_79b9ef2dff2f83349c8f39ea7517fcec.text: La castigan con dos semanas sin ver la televisión.
sense_79b9ef2dff2f83349c8f39ea7517fcec.translation: As a punishment, she isn't allowed to watch television for two weeks.

sense_09226ff16b83be6072552ed24ba3a45e.text: El árbitro nos castigó con dos penaltis injustos.
sense_09226ff16b83be6072552ed24ba3a45e.translation: The referee called two unfair penalties on us.

sense_09226ff16b83be6072552ed24ba3a45e.text: El árbitro lo castigó con tarjeta roja.
sense_09226ff16b83be6072552ed24ba3a45e.translation: The referee gave him a red card.

sense_fc450dcb1649102122ba8a675cc8cc08.text: ¡Qué sal tiene para bailar el tango, mano!
sense_fc450dcb1649102122ba8a675cc8cc08.translation: She's an unbelievable tango dancer, man!

sense_fc450dcb1649102122ba8a675cc8cc08.text: Es un tipo con mucha sal. A todo el mundo le cae bien.
sense_fc450dcb1649102122ba8a675cc8cc08.translation: He's a really charming guy. Everyone likes him.

sense_5f4b819ae80f59ac1d6f9c68c5c2480b.text: Al registrarse en un hotel, deberá presentar un documento que pruebe su identidad.
sense_5f4b819ae80f59ac1d6f9c68c5c2480b.translation: When checking into a hotel, you'll need to present a proof of identity.

sense_5f4b819ae80f59ac1d6f9c68c5c2480b.text: Los solicitantes tendrán que presentar documentos que demuestren que carecen de los fondos necesarios.
sense_5f4b819ae80f59ac1d6f9c68c5c2480b.translation: Applicants will need to provide documentary proof that they lack the required funds.

sense_e5d20d420d9b23e4e2d8c257bf821e4b.text: A Pepe le prohibieron las juntas con sus vecinos buscapleitos.
sense_e5d20d420d9b23e4e2d8c257bf821e4b.translation: Pepe was forbidden to hang out with his troublemaking neighbors.

sense_e5d20d420d9b23e4e2d8c257bf821e4b.text: Rosi está preocupada porque cree que su hijo anda con malas juntas.
sense_e5d20d420d9b23e4e2d8c257bf821e4b.translation: Rosi is worried because she thinks her son hangs around with bad company.

sense_556896d1dc4291546ff8a23e7eb08579.text: Este año se me juntaron todas las desgracias.
sense_556896d1dc4291546ff8a23e7eb08579.translation: This year it was just one bad thing after another.

sense_556896d1dc4291546ff8a23e7eb08579.text: Se juntó la tormenta con la explosión de gas.
sense_556896d1dc4291546ff8a23e7eb08579.translation: The storm came right on top of the gas explosion.

sense_9cb2abfac8c23c0638da0e95a4497da6.text: Los techos amanecieron llenos de ramas después del huracán.
sense_9cb2abfac8c23c0638da0e95a4497da6.translation: The morning after the hurricane saw the roofs covered in palm branches.

sense_9cb2abfac8c23c0638da0e95a4497da6.text: Los parques amanecieron cubiertos de cohetes.
sense_9cb2abfac8c23c0638da0e95a4497da6.translation: The parks were full of firecrackers in the morning.

sense_41b7efa73eb9f59deb8c2c78417be95c.text: Mi novio me hartó a regalos el día de mi cumpleaños.
sense_41b7efa73eb9f59deb8c2c78417be95c.translation: My boyfriend gave me a ton of presents for my birthday.

sense_41b7efa73eb9f59deb8c2c78417be95c.text: Por favor no me harten con tantas preguntas. Ya se los voy a explicar todo.
sense_41b7efa73eb9f59deb8c2c78417be95c.translation: Please do not barrage me with so many questions. I am just about to explain everything.

sense_706d2206765e49cd3a981ced43981227.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_706d2206765e49cd3a981ced43981227.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_706d2206765e49cd3a981ced43981227.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_706d2206765e49cd3a981ced43981227.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_076b7ff615b945c5fcd7ef360404c607.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_076b7ff615b945c5fcd7ef360404c607.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_076b7ff615b945c5fcd7ef360404c607.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_076b7ff615b945c5fcd7ef360404c607.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_7f675a7cabd88f55bbf3ad55fd00716f.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_7f675a7cabd88f55bbf3ad55fd00716f.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_7f675a7cabd88f55bbf3ad55fd00716f.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_7f675a7cabd88f55bbf3ad55fd00716f.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_d92849d0c75fb9b863ad32feb1e8d6c6.text: Me parece que el ministro debería dimitir.
sense_d92849d0c75fb9b863ad32feb1e8d6c6.translation: I think the minister should resign.

sense_d92849d0c75fb9b863ad32feb1e8d6c6.text: ¿Qué te pareció la serie sobre la familia real? - Me pareció una tontería.
sense_d92849d0c75fb9b863ad32feb1e8d6c6.translation: What did you think of the series about the royal family? - I thought it was nonsense.

sense_a267b2476d015381fe786ca38adffa55.text: Estaba tan asustado después de ver al fantasma que no podía hablar.
sense_a267b2476d015381fe786ca38adffa55.translation: He was so scared after seeing the ghost that he couldn't speak.

sense_a267b2476d015381fe786ca38adffa55.text: ¿Por qué estás asustado? Es solo un gatito. No te va a hacer nada.
sense_a267b2476d015381fe786ca38adffa55.translation: Why are you scared? It's just a kitten. It's not going to hurt you.

sense_5ab0f13f5417a2d38c9d29c8ebb7b49a.text: ¡Apártate de mí! No quiero verte nunca más.
sense_5ab0f13f5417a2d38c9d29c8ebb7b49a.translation: Get away from me! I don't want to see you again.

sense_5ab0f13f5417a2d38c9d29c8ebb7b49a.text: Apártense de la estufa; está caliente.
sense_5ab0f13f5417a2d38c9d29c8ebb7b49a.translation: Get away from the stove; it's hot.

sense_13515086a1004b5d7f8f7fa70d589bec.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_13515086a1004b5d7f8f7fa70d589bec.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_13515086a1004b5d7f8f7fa70d589bec.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_13515086a1004b5d7f8f7fa70d589bec.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_db95d4c804a7a069500f5198b640aa8b.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_db95d4c804a7a069500f5198b640aa8b.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_db95d4c804a7a069500f5198b640aa8b.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_db95d4c804a7a069500f5198b640aa8b.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_a2c993409e43e99a378bf2e4764e3175.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_a2c993409e43e99a378bf2e4764e3175.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_a2c993409e43e99a378bf2e4764e3175.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_a2c993409e43e99a378bf2e4764e3175.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_c4edfccbd9a0d899b951cf3442f8e02c.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_c4edfccbd9a0d899b951cf3442f8e02c.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_c4edfccbd9a0d899b951cf3442f8e02c.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_c4edfccbd9a0d899b951cf3442f8e02c.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_c72a65df58dfb20eae3fcb2bb854893d.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_c72a65df58dfb20eae3fcb2bb854893d.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_c72a65df58dfb20eae3fcb2bb854893d.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_c72a65df58dfb20eae3fcb2bb854893d.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_62e6a4491a506cd5cbd32209a66452e9.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_62e6a4491a506cd5cbd32209a66452e9.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_62e6a4491a506cd5cbd32209a66452e9.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_62e6a4491a506cd5cbd32209a66452e9.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_3f7bc9fd1e959979d76404c065b49468.text: Me dieron una habitación exterior en el hotel.
sense_3f7bc9fd1e959979d76404c065b49468.translation: The hotel room I was given faced onto the street.
I'm looking for a room that faces on to the street.

sense_df0395495bba398051ad78170dba3121.text: El estacionamiento de visitas está en el exterior de la privada.
sense_df0395495bba398051ad78170dba3121.translation: Visitor parking is located outside of the private driveway.

sense_df0395495bba398051ad78170dba3121.text: La mayoría de nuestros clientes están en el exterior del país.
sense_df0395495bba398051ad78170dba3121.translation: Most of our clients are based outside the country.

sense_55c245c52235731a2cc7680f7c27ddbb.text: La empresa abrirá sucursales en el exterior.
sense_55c245c52235731a2cc7680f7c27ddbb.translation: The company is to open branches abroad.

sense_55c245c52235731a2cc7680f7c27ddbb.text: Se enviará ayuda alimentaria al exterior.
sense_55c245c52235731a2cc7680f7c27ddbb.translation: Food aid will be sent overseas.

sense_22aaa2bc753bbdafa945af9070ebce28.text: Los mirmidones saquearon y quemaron el templo de Apolo.
sense_22aaa2bc753bbdafa945af9070ebce28.translation: The Myrmidons sacked and burned the temple of Apollo.

sense_22aaa2bc753bbdafa945af9070ebce28.text: Las Iglesias, las sinagogas y las mezquitas son templos de culto religioso.
sense_22aaa2bc753bbdafa945af9070ebce28.translation: Churches, synagogues, and mosques are temples for religious worship.

sense_442c16e142dd82b3c64ad0a946a07685.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_442c16e142dd82b3c64ad0a946a07685.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_442c16e142dd82b3c64ad0a946a07685.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_442c16e142dd82b3c64ad0a946a07685.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_ff852d92e80dd8e10b95e9f29049c214.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_ff852d92e80dd8e10b95e9f29049c214.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_ff852d92e80dd8e10b95e9f29049c214.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_ff852d92e80dd8e10b95e9f29049c214.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_3d24830f49930377ce79f903b9857172.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_3d24830f49930377ce79f903b9857172.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_3d24830f49930377ce79f903b9857172.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_3d24830f49930377ce79f903b9857172.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_9c89026ba406ab68ac9d6f021b56905c.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_9c89026ba406ab68ac9d6f021b56905c.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_9c89026ba406ab68ac9d6f021b56905c.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_9c89026ba406ab68ac9d6f021b56905c.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_01f2600558da30217e1058e02af720df.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_01f2600558da30217e1058e02af720df.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_01f2600558da30217e1058e02af720df.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_01f2600558da30217e1058e02af720df.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_798c5f116c9fa2a679bbc1473f318d9f.text: Dicen que el alcalde recibió dinero de fuentes sospechosas.
sense_798c5f116c9fa2a679bbc1473f318d9f.translation: They say that the mayor received money from shady sources.

sense_798c5f116c9fa2a679bbc1473f318d9f.text: La víctima recibió un fuerte golpe al lado de la cabeza.
sense_798c5f116c9fa2a679bbc1473f318d9f.translation: The victim received a strong blow to the side of the head.

sense_0d6a716b2acbc574b411e4ad59df3ac9.text: El equipo visitante fue recibido con silbidos y abucheos.
sense_0d6a716b2acbc574b411e4ad59df3ac9.translation: The visiting team was received with whistles and jeers.

sense_0d6a716b2acbc574b411e4ad59df3ac9.text: Nos recibió personalmente en el aeropuerto.
sense_0d6a716b2acbc574b411e4ad59df3ac9.translation: He personally welcomed us at the airport.

sense_f5cb2bb644cf2618589558fa38fc9ceb.text: Mi hermana se recibió de ingeniera en Georgia Tech.
sense_f5cb2bb644cf2618589558fa38fc9ceb.translation: My sister graduated as an engineer from Georgia Tech.
How many students will graduate this year?

sense_e30f93e0fbc2b4bd4c2aed9431fc3f52.text: Me metieron un puro por fumar en el baño.
sense_e30f93e0fbc2b4bd4c2aed9431fc3f52.translation: They threw the book at me for smoking in the bathroom.

sense_e30f93e0fbc2b4bd4c2aed9431fc3f52.text: ¿No puedes usar el automóvil por seis meses? ¡Qué puro!
sense_e30f93e0fbc2b4bd4c2aed9431fc3f52.translation: You're not allowed to drive the car for six months? That sucks!

sense_bfb78a151190c347092d00df793b564a.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_bfb78a151190c347092d00df793b564a.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_bfb78a151190c347092d00df793b564a.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_bfb78a151190c347092d00df793b564a.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_e0725305cca4bf2482b9c3524dccda26.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_648e9e287abc0c4d14c6f455118159fc.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_648e9e287abc0c4d14c6f455118159fc.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_648e9e287abc0c4d14c6f455118159fc.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_648e9e287abc0c4d14c6f455118159fc.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_6cfa9faffd795be774992485eb81d700.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_6cfa9faffd795be774992485eb81d700.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_6cfa9faffd795be774992485eb81d700.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_6cfa9faffd795be774992485eb81d700.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_b7763ad7c6d68f6beecf065b850408fb.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_b7763ad7c6d68f6beecf065b850408fb.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_3664f8e2dfbef62be9365a59f31e8d47.text: La peli era malísima; solo se salvaba el actor principal.
sense_3664f8e2dfbef62be9365a59f31e8d47.translation: The film was really bad; the main actor was the only one who was ok.

sense_3664f8e2dfbef62be9365a59f31e8d47.text: Los considero a todos unos vagos; no se salva nadie.
sense_3664f8e2dfbef62be9365a59f31e8d47.translation: I consider them all lazy, without exception.

sense_7d123c8264ba010722d3fcdf0d8f010a.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_7d123c8264ba010722d3fcdf0d8f010a.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_7d123c8264ba010722d3fcdf0d8f010a.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_7d123c8264ba010722d3fcdf0d8f010a.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_f08d15f5528dbda9bae914f9b61d8c51.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_f08d15f5528dbda9bae914f9b61d8c51.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_f08d15f5528dbda9bae914f9b61d8c51.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_f08d15f5528dbda9bae914f9b61d8c51.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_0a326729ef39d591c80ef43e125fb786.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_2e1474e51aa3dacdc282b56f236a6ba0.text: ¿Vas a ir a visitar a tu amigo esta noche?
sense_2e1474e51aa3dacdc282b56f236a6ba0.translation: Are you going to visit your friend tonight?

sense_2e1474e51aa3dacdc282b56f236a6ba0.text: El cirujano visitó al paciente el día después de la operación.
sense_2e1474e51aa3dacdc282b56f236a6ba0.translation: The surgeon visited the patient the day after the surgery.

sense_64f3b4a8f221987ee146dfc00f9ac071.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_64f3b4a8f221987ee146dfc00f9ac071.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_555a9e440d9e1ca4314a8ff36520cffc.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_555a9e440d9e1ca4314a8ff36520cffc.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_555a9e440d9e1ca4314a8ff36520cffc.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_555a9e440d9e1ca4314a8ff36520cffc.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_665f9c4e295f2471e11a7532c9576704.text: Estoy encantado con el rendimiento del equipo.
sense_665f9c4e295f2471e11a7532c9576704.translation: I'm delighted with the team's performance.

sense_665f9c4e295f2471e11a7532c9576704.text: Estaría encantado de acompañarte al baile.
sense_665f9c4e295f2471e11a7532c9576704.translation: I would be delighted to accompany you to the ball.

sense_6cc08217257b5c7dea6ba66f44923d2e.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_6cc08217257b5c7dea6ba66f44923d2e.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_6cc08217257b5c7dea6ba66f44923d2e.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_6cc08217257b5c7dea6ba66f44923d2e.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_677a73959b4fdba080a0d2113edac6a1.text: Si te duele la garganta, debes tomar té con miel.
sense_677a73959b4fdba080a0d2113edac6a1.translation: If your throat hurts, you should drink tea with honey.

sense_677a73959b4fdba080a0d2113edac6a1.text: Los síntomas de la gripe incluyen fiebre, congestión nasal y dolor de garganta.
sense_677a73959b4fdba080a0d2113edac6a1.translation: Flu symptoms include fever, nasal congestion, and sore throat.

sense_d504fa791661e136e45e3ae8cc2cd0ee.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_d504fa791661e136e45e3ae8cc2cd0ee.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_d504fa791661e136e45e3ae8cc2cd0ee.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_d504fa791661e136e45e3ae8cc2cd0ee.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_9e6699b6d3a77b20fff504e789b9a02e.text: No te quedes ahí tan fresco. ¡Haz algo!
sense_9e6699b6d3a77b20fff504e789b9a02e.translation: Don't stand there as if nothing was the matter. Do something about it!

sense_9e6699b6d3a77b20fff504e789b9a02e.text: Se entera de que ha suspendido el examen y se queda tan fresca.
sense_9e6699b6d3a77b20fff504e789b9a02e.translation: She finds out that she has failed her exam and couldn't care less.

sense_735e6b2bb56a3398778b6112b5cea6dd.text: Coge una chaqueta, puede que haga fresco fuera.
sense_735e6b2bb56a3398778b6112b5cea6dd.translation: Take a jacket, it may be chilly out there.

sense_735e6b2bb56a3398778b6112b5cea6dd.text: Esperemos que haga un poquito más de fresco junto al mar.
sense_735e6b2bb56a3398778b6112b5cea6dd.translation: Let's hope it's a bit cooler by the seaside.

sense_8d5325437d4446f38a3a20df4c5db89e.text: Tu hermana es una fresca de cuidado. Nunca hace sus deberes.
sense_8d5325437d4446f38a3a20df4c5db89e.translation: Your sister is really cheeky. She never does her homework.

sense_8d5325437d4446f38a3a20df4c5db89e.text: ¡Eres un fresco! ¿No te dije que no utilizaras mi ordenador?
sense_8d5325437d4446f38a3a20df4c5db89e.translation: You have a lot of nerve! Didn't I tell you not to use my computer?

sense_1137a4680b984928ebef0210ae8b78ec.text: El capitán dirigió el buque hacia el faro.
sense_1137a4680b984928ebef0210ae8b78ec.translation: The captain steered the ship toward the lighthouse.

sense_1137a4680b984928ebef0210ae8b78ec.text: Dirigió el coche con cuidado por el borde del acantilado.
sense_1137a4680b984928ebef0210ae8b78ec.translation: He steered the car carefully along the edge of the cliff.

sense_ec184402935fbe496226aca22c854779.text: La camarera es un pato; la hemos visto tirar tres platos ya.
sense_ec184402935fbe496226aca22c854779.translation: The waitress is really clumsy; we've already seen her drop three dishes.
I have two left feet when it comes to dancing.

sense_e1b3939284532e51b98c08308f9e59cb.text: ¡Me encanta tu casa! ¿Tú misma la decoraste?
sense_e1b3939284532e51b98c08308f9e59cb.translation: I love your house! Did you decorate it yourself?

sense_e1b3939284532e51b98c08308f9e59cb.text: Me encanta tomarme un chocolate caliente cuando hace frío afuera.
sense_e1b3939284532e51b98c08308f9e59cb.translation: I love drinking hot chocolate when it's cold out.

sense_7adbfb0c1e07bce5824923fc8acb7c12.text: Cuéntame qué tal las vacaciones. ¿Lo pasaste bien?
sense_7adbfb0c1e07bce5824923fc8acb7c12.translation: Tell me about your vacation. Did you have a good time?

sense_7adbfb0c1e07bce5824923fc8acb7c12.text: ¿No tienes algo que contarme? - ¿Yo? No sé a qué te refieres. - Bueno, un pajarito me dijo que tienes novio.
sense_7adbfb0c1e07bce5824923fc8acb7c12.translation: Don't you have something to tell me? - Me? I don't know what you mean. - Well, a little bird told me that you have a boyfriend.

sense_54aa65b6084cbe6b060760863f24b0cd.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_54aa65b6084cbe6b060760863f24b0cd.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_54aa65b6084cbe6b060760863f24b0cd.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_54aa65b6084cbe6b060760863f24b0cd.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_8722d9c4f3d6c07d591db39fbeb59f9b.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_8722d9c4f3d6c07d591db39fbeb59f9b.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_8722d9c4f3d6c07d591db39fbeb59f9b.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_8722d9c4f3d6c07d591db39fbeb59f9b.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_936ad5814e874efe71895f9c2d3b02ae.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_936ad5814e874efe71895f9c2d3b02ae.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_936ad5814e874efe71895f9c2d3b02ae.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_936ad5814e874efe71895f9c2d3b02ae.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_00a6b545b81810c2778101f3631a5ef5.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_00a6b545b81810c2778101f3631a5ef5.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_00a6b545b81810c2778101f3631a5ef5.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_00a6b545b81810c2778101f3631a5ef5.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_b5ceb167260d629effb7d450d5089798.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_b5ceb167260d629effb7d450d5089798.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_b5ceb167260d629effb7d450d5089798.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_b5ceb167260d629effb7d450d5089798.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_7389d2d8e75f4806b8f26d7f809972c7.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_7389d2d8e75f4806b8f26d7f809972c7.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_7389d2d8e75f4806b8f26d7f809972c7.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_7389d2d8e75f4806b8f26d7f809972c7.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_fc375044aefc686b2fdc3acf7ba7721b.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_fc375044aefc686b2fdc3acf7ba7721b.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_2f2978664fe1d1f31a050d58ed6c00df.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_2f2978664fe1d1f31a050d58ed6c00df.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_2f2978664fe1d1f31a050d58ed6c00df.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_2f2978664fe1d1f31a050d58ed6c00df.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_d98ac675cd514bfc39d058933ed90fad.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_d98ac675cd514bfc39d058933ed90fad.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_d98ac675cd514bfc39d058933ed90fad.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_d98ac675cd514bfc39d058933ed90fad.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_4a500d5cb008b58027ab5bf90abb6683.text: No puede comer pastel porque sufre de diabetes.
sense_4a500d5cb008b58027ab5bf90abb6683.translation: He can't eat cake because he suffers from diabetes.

sense_4a500d5cb008b58027ab5bf90abb6683.text: Mejor corta comunicación con él, no quieres que sufra más.
sense_4a500d5cb008b58027ab5bf90abb6683.translation: You'd better cut off communication with him, you don't want him to suffer anymore.

sense_a5ec7f72d9c84a9e8d495f7da46bd0c4.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_a5ec7f72d9c84a9e8d495f7da46bd0c4.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_a5ec7f72d9c84a9e8d495f7da46bd0c4.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_a5ec7f72d9c84a9e8d495f7da46bd0c4.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_9db29d2fbe19903080237ab488786513.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_b6afdbee3e2542c937800348c0d2f8a3.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_b6afdbee3e2542c937800348c0d2f8a3.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_eec93d914fa86c470615338602a3bcf4.text: La actuación de Manuel fue asombrosa, especialmente porque solo tuvo una semana de ensayo.
sense_eec93d914fa86c470615338602a3bcf4.translation: Manuel's performance was amazing, especially after only one week's rehearsal.

sense_02a617da553edf4a32ed819157a7924d.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_02a617da553edf4a32ed819157a7924d.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_02a617da553edf4a32ed819157a7924d.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_02a617da553edf4a32ed819157a7924d.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_83a5ed71921b49735122d8983429f423.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_83a5ed71921b49735122d8983429f423.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_83a5ed71921b49735122d8983429f423.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_83a5ed71921b49735122d8983429f423.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_5d9368cd9ed383ff357672947eaecbea.text: Esta novela está llena de pasión y romance.
sense_5d9368cd9ed383ff357672947eaecbea.translation: This novel is full of passion and romance.

sense_5d9368cd9ed383ff357672947eaecbea.text: Se apagó la pasión en su relación y decidieron separarse.
sense_5d9368cd9ed383ff357672947eaecbea.translation: The passion in their relationship had faded so they decided to separate.

sense_070e15897ff0f44b159b627fa97940bc.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_070e15897ff0f44b159b627fa97940bc.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_070e15897ff0f44b159b627fa97940bc.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_070e15897ff0f44b159b627fa97940bc.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_bd299087f07dab4ac4967999ccc859b3.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_bd299087f07dab4ac4967999ccc859b3.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_bd299087f07dab4ac4967999ccc859b3.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_bd299087f07dab4ac4967999ccc859b3.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_f763f13d475934b7655026ee10e4b16d.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_f763f13d475934b7655026ee10e4b16d.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_3624f911eba6951da40deb2c0530398b.text: Ayer nos dimos una buena paliza cambiando los muebles de sitio.
sense_3624f911eba6951da40deb2c0530398b.translation: Yesterday we really wore ourselves out moving the furniture around.

sense_3624f911eba6951da40deb2c0530398b.text: Menuda paliza tener que viajar dos horas para ir a trabajar.
sense_3624f911eba6951da40deb2c0530398b.translation: Having to travel two hours to work must be really exhausting.

sense_98c9b3e523b02291b0dad178c7f1a94b.text: Pedro va a concertar una entrevista con los candidatos.
sense_98c9b3e523b02291b0dad178c7f1a94b.translation: Pedro is setting up an interview with the candidates.

sense_98c9b3e523b02291b0dad178c7f1a94b.text: Odio que mi hermana me concierte citas con sus amigos solteros.
sense_98c9b3e523b02291b0dad178c7f1a94b.translation: I hate it when my sister sets up dates for me with her single friends.

sense_c2d9ed521070cddddebe7eb3979f1504.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_c2d9ed521070cddddebe7eb3979f1504.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_c2d9ed521070cddddebe7eb3979f1504.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_c2d9ed521070cddddebe7eb3979f1504.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_1e535626a69a95db289fcb356201bdd7.text: El barrio no es perfecto, pero tiene su encanto.
sense_1e535626a69a95db289fcb356201bdd7.translation: The neighborhood isn't perfect, but it has a certain charm.

sense_1e535626a69a95db289fcb356201bdd7.text: No es el más guapo, pero tiene muchísimo encanto.
sense_1e535626a69a95db289fcb356201bdd7.translation: He's not the handsomest guy, but he's got a ton of charm.

sense_e5e660e87ff8e82a1d1d7efdf8fceecd.text: ¡Me encanta tu casa! ¿Tú misma la decoraste?
sense_e5e660e87ff8e82a1d1d7efdf8fceecd.translation: I love your house! Did you decorate it yourself?

sense_e5e660e87ff8e82a1d1d7efdf8fceecd.text: Me encanta tomarme un chocolate caliente cuando hace frío afuera.
sense_e5e660e87ff8e82a1d1d7efdf8fceecd.translation: I love drinking hot chocolate when it's cold out.

sense_2d6661e348fa85e5abafdce9e04e93a4.text: Casarse cambió el rumbo de su vida.
sense_2d6661e348fa85e5abafdce9e04e93a4.translation: Getting married changed the course of his life.

sense_2d6661e348fa85e5abafdce9e04e93a4.text: Si la economía no cambia de rumbo pronto, el presidente perderá las elecciones.
sense_2d6661e348fa85e5abafdce9e04e93a4.translation: If the economy doesn't change course quickly, the president will lose the election.

sense_c242abdc837a887f93e13547819c6cea.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_c242abdc837a887f93e13547819c6cea.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_49a077799f7c21778c48b4c3de720646.text: Es buena cocinera, pero le falta experiencia.
sense_49a077799f7c21778c48b4c3de720646.translation: She's a good cook, but she lacks experience.

sense_49a077799f7c21778c48b4c3de720646.text: Hubo tantos asistentes que faltaban sillas en la sala.
sense_49a077799f7c21778c48b4c3de720646.translation: There were so many attendants that the room was short of chairs.

sense_1266445e65e3202641c3f532706c5392.text: A la sopa le faltan 10 minutos.
Faltan dos meses para que sea Navidad.
sense_1266445e65e3202641c3f532706c5392.translation: There are two months to go till Christmas.

sense_dcb14fa774609ea9a5251419aae64335.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_dcb14fa774609ea9a5251419aae64335.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_dcb14fa774609ea9a5251419aae64335.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_dcb14fa774609ea9a5251419aae64335.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_c43b527b91180d7b45dfb0e1e8416b60.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_c43b527b91180d7b45dfb0e1e8416b60.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_c43b527b91180d7b45dfb0e1e8416b60.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_c43b527b91180d7b45dfb0e1e8416b60.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_100b68de11432329f1480ff54ab360c2.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_100b68de11432329f1480ff54ab360c2.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_48118eb5edf93be14bfd4301baaad547.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_48118eb5edf93be14bfd4301baaad547.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_48118eb5edf93be14bfd4301baaad547.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_48118eb5edf93be14bfd4301baaad547.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_58ee4093300dad3ebd9a12236a65313f.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_58ee4093300dad3ebd9a12236a65313f.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_58ee4093300dad3ebd9a12236a65313f.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_58ee4093300dad3ebd9a12236a65313f.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_a875c8975b8753b547a738bf1457c084.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_a875c8975b8753b547a738bf1457c084.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_9a8f2d6fd066f0ea1a893a3845273a1d.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_9a8f2d6fd066f0ea1a893a3845273a1d.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_053b68b183bd190f6cd9f86236eb2b6c.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_053b68b183bd190f6cd9f86236eb2b6c.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_86b368bc3bae0111bff6aa8ce368d7b7.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_86b368bc3bae0111bff6aa8ce368d7b7.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_03bb5bfc12e38bab80ac6109bfb534a3.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_03bb5bfc12e38bab80ac6109bfb534a3.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_03bb5bfc12e38bab80ac6109bfb534a3.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_03bb5bfc12e38bab80ac6109bfb534a3.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_0914ecf63c87936671063f23063f6a1b.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_0914ecf63c87936671063f23063f6a1b.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_0914ecf63c87936671063f23063f6a1b.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_0914ecf63c87936671063f23063f6a1b.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_a047fa0648d10a1908e736490ef618ce.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_a047fa0648d10a1908e736490ef618ce.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_8da9a61e8daeaca2b62b065aa8865908.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_8da9a61e8daeaca2b62b065aa8865908.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_8da9a61e8daeaca2b62b065aa8865908.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_8da9a61e8daeaca2b62b065aa8865908.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_f57fbf467f86427b61b2c4e63963d79c.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_f57fbf467f86427b61b2c4e63963d79c.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_f57fbf467f86427b61b2c4e63963d79c.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_f57fbf467f86427b61b2c4e63963d79c.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_d0898088ecdc3ec928376277c4c69061.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_d0898088ecdc3ec928376277c4c69061.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_d0898088ecdc3ec928376277c4c69061.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_d0898088ecdc3ec928376277c4c69061.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_2f976301978f561ce9e4986e32ef5510.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_2f976301978f561ce9e4986e32ef5510.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_2f976301978f561ce9e4986e32ef5510.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_2f976301978f561ce9e4986e32ef5510.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_b925eb1f8885a4061916e0c78e574b26.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_1a2703c3e885a526a3e378c0839d4e73.text: A cierto individuo se le vio huyendo de la escena del crimen.
sense_1a2703c3e885a526a3e378c0839d4e73.translation: A certain individual was seen fleeing the scene of the crime.

sense_1a2703c3e885a526a3e378c0839d4e73.text: La incidencia durante el partido fue obra de ciertas personas, no de todos los fanáticos.
sense_1a2703c3e885a526a3e378c0839d4e73.translation: The incident during the match was the work of certain individuals, not all the fans.

sense_e97153ffe27920849c3c1195c37ebbd9.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_e97153ffe27920849c3c1195c37ebbd9.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_1b406843f660a881ef639b2af990c13c.text: Explícame sin reservas qué fue lo que pasó.
sense_1b406843f660a881ef639b2af990c13c.translation: Explain to me what happened, without keeping anything back.

sense_1b406843f660a881ef639b2af990c13c.text: Ya sabes que conmigo puedes hablar sin reservas.
sense_1b406843f660a881ef639b2af990c13c.translation: You know you can speak freely with me.

sense_ea578a076a6c45f1388b9ffce0c0e1f1.text: Han llevado al paciente a la unidad de cuidados intensivos.
sense_ea578a076a6c45f1388b9ffce0c0e1f1.translation: They've taken the patient to the intensive care unit.

sense_ea578a076a6c45f1388b9ffce0c0e1f1.text: Lean el primer párrafo en la Unidad 11 y respondan a las preguntas.
sense_ea578a076a6c45f1388b9ffce0c0e1f1.translation: Read the first paragraph in Unit 11 and answer the questions.

sense_8a0b72a718e40851e3f99105ed00a686.text: Pablo ama a su esposa con todo su ser.
sense_8a0b72a718e40851e3f99105ed00a686.translation: Pablo loves his wife with all his heart.

sense_8a0b72a718e40851e3f99105ed00a686.text: Yo te amo, Ana, y quiero pasar el resto de mi vida contigo.
sense_8a0b72a718e40851e3f99105ed00a686.translation: I love you, Ana, and I want to spend the rest of my life with you.

sense_5efc1738e3980461cecf5bc7b222af80.text: Allí fue cuando se dio cuenta de que podía cambiar.
sense_5efc1738e3980461cecf5bc7b222af80.translation: That's when he realized he could change.

sense_5efc1738e3980461cecf5bc7b222af80.text: Hasta allí llegamos, pero ese día cambió todo entre nosotras.
sense_5efc1738e3980461cecf5bc7b222af80.translation: We were ok up to then, but that day everything changed between us.

sense_e65c1f74a3f5f442b1c02dd35840d9e7.text: El avión hizo un extraño al despegar.
sense_e65c1f74a3f5f442b1c02dd35840d9e7.translation: The plane made a strange movement while taking off.

sense_e65c1f74a3f5f442b1c02dd35840d9e7.text: El elefante hizo un extraño cuando vio el ratón.
sense_e65c1f74a3f5f442b1c02dd35840d9e7.translation: The elephant shied when he saw a mouse.

sense_d5973acdbdd10a4f65150fe6edeedccf.text: Ricardo es una persona que goza del aprecio de sus vecinos.
sense_d5973acdbdd10a4f65150fe6edeedccf.translation: Ricardo is someone who's highly regarded by his neighbours.

sense_d5973acdbdd10a4f65150fe6edeedccf.text: A pesar de ser mi adversario político, le tengo mucho aprecio por su honestidad.
sense_d5973acdbdd10a4f65150fe6edeedccf.translation: Despite his being a political rival of mine, I think very highly of him because of his integrity.

sense_490b08b5cf416e43e48090b2592e730a.text: Ella misma diseñó su propio vestido de novias.
sense_490b08b5cf416e43e48090b2592e730a.translation: She designed her own wedding dress herself.

sense_490b08b5cf416e43e48090b2592e730a.text: En este mismo sitio, en esta misma fecha, tu madre y yo decidimos casarnos.
sense_490b08b5cf416e43e48090b2592e730a.translation: In this very place, on this same day, your mother and I decided to get married.

sense_b7d69fe8a269c789569ed2fc9e0e1a5d.text: El alumno escribió su ensayo de 20 páginas en una noche.
sense_b7d69fe8a269c789569ed2fc9e0e1a5d.translation: The student wrote his 20-page essay in one night.

sense_396f69ed21d6f2f43c1544ec0a23e8e3.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_396f69ed21d6f2f43c1544ec0a23e8e3.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_e95d0dbeccfcce18c633eff3ae32c2a2.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_e95d0dbeccfcce18c633eff3ae32c2a2.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_e95d0dbeccfcce18c633eff3ae32c2a2.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_e95d0dbeccfcce18c633eff3ae32c2a2.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_265b2c1dd0884b1b0863422face6fc2d.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_265b2c1dd0884b1b0863422face6fc2d.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_beb4b4893dce15fb8ca54d15b6986160.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_beb4b4893dce15fb8ca54d15b6986160.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_c679fbccca5916ae6a8432b070a0b6df.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_c679fbccca5916ae6a8432b070a0b6df.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_3253fd9a5eac035731d10f5ea72b2889.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_3bcbe9084228cf98e0ed5284a7c52904.text: Duerme muy poco los fines de semana.
sense_3bcbe9084228cf98e0ed5284a7c52904.translation: He doesn't sleep much on weekends.
We don't see much of each other lately.

sense_c55fb082b29c143281832c7a081eed10.text: Hay pocos que se molestarían en ayudarlo como tú.
sense_c55fb082b29c143281832c7a081eed10.translation: There are few who would bother helping him like you do.

sense_c55fb082b29c143281832c7a081eed10.text: Menos mal que pocos piensan como él.
sense_c55fb082b29c143281832c7a081eed10.translation: It's just as well not many people think like he does.

sense_307531552838f3fecddb50f8f2f073dc.text: "No tenemos nada que objetar, señoría," dijo el abogado al juez.
sense_307531552838f3fecddb50f8f2f073dc.translation: "We have no objection, Your Honor," said the attorney to the judge.

sense_307531552838f3fecddb50f8f2f073dc.text: Yo me voy con los niños al parque y tú te quedas limpiando la casa. ¿Tienes algo que objetar? - ¡Sí, claro! ¡No es justo!
sense_307531552838f3fecddb50f8f2f073dc.translation: I'm taking the children to the park and you stay in cleaning the house. Do you have any objection? - Of course I have! It's not fair!

sense_d69e574e4c3052f0c6363a33bb5bf109.text: Pablo es el estudiante favorito de la maestra.
sense_d69e574e4c3052f0c6363a33bb5bf109.translation: Pablo is the teacher's favorite student.

sense_d69e574e4c3052f0c6363a33bb5bf109.text: El Sr. Finley es un maestro en la escuela primaria Jefferson.
sense_d69e574e4c3052f0c6363a33bb5bf109.translation: Mr. Finley is a teacher at Jefferson Elementary School.

sense_645ad2984a715c14256dae885114557d.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_645ad2984a715c14256dae885114557d.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_645ad2984a715c14256dae885114557d.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_645ad2984a715c14256dae885114557d.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_d201f6550699e2680ebc4c5eee098d24.text: Me parece que el ministro debería dimitir.
sense_d201f6550699e2680ebc4c5eee098d24.translation: I think the minister should resign.

sense_d201f6550699e2680ebc4c5eee098d24.text: ¿Qué te pareció la serie sobre la familia real? - Me pareció una tontería.
sense_d201f6550699e2680ebc4c5eee098d24.translation: What did you think of the series about the royal family? - I thought it was nonsense.

sense_954208806486d1a910a7982f527babff.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_f1e2a921298ca62f40d813ab1d2884f0.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_f1e2a921298ca62f40d813ab1d2884f0.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_f1e2a921298ca62f40d813ab1d2884f0.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_f1e2a921298ca62f40d813ab1d2884f0.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_df3cb76281930845cb41c7d0e2015826.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_df3cb76281930845cb41c7d0e2015826.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_df3cb76281930845cb41c7d0e2015826.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_df3cb76281930845cb41c7d0e2015826.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_0ac95369295e79d2243055079030e565.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_0ac95369295e79d2243055079030e565.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_3a4d6f5ca5a42ca2a7193fe7a5fb6095.text: Dale saludos de mi parte a tu abuela.
sense_3a4d6f5ca5a42ca2a7193fe7a5fb6095.translation: Say hello to your grandmother from me.
My parents send you their regards.

sense_2dd84c6dc21baa308c7b227a3ffd9116.text: Alfredo me dirigió un saludo con la mano desde el andén.
sense_2dd84c6dc21baa308c7b227a3ffd9116.translation: Alfredo gave me a wave from the platform.

sense_2dd84c6dc21baa308c7b227a3ffd9116.text: Nos saludó con la cabeza del otro lado de la calle.
sense_2dd84c6dc21baa308c7b227a3ffd9116.translation: He nodded at us from across the street.

sense_f5bc6ee2861b28199a8b9721bcbe2bdf.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_f5bc6ee2861b28199a8b9721bcbe2bdf.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_f5bc6ee2861b28199a8b9721bcbe2bdf.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_f5bc6ee2861b28199a8b9721bcbe2bdf.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_37c29e9be80ea5d0a1440022d2ad94cf.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_37c29e9be80ea5d0a1440022d2ad94cf.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_37c29e9be80ea5d0a1440022d2ad94cf.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_37c29e9be80ea5d0a1440022d2ad94cf.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_ba00eb11ee7a0499f139de682e9a316e.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_ba00eb11ee7a0499f139de682e9a316e.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_7df061edff2b35e38065678b64f9240d.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_7df061edff2b35e38065678b64f9240d.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_7df061edff2b35e38065678b64f9240d.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_7df061edff2b35e38065678b64f9240d.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_9a4fc6f8812562ba7c016eaefd64818d.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_9a4fc6f8812562ba7c016eaefd64818d.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_fcf35266be447531795724d99d04b7ef.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_fcf35266be447531795724d99d04b7ef.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_fcf35266be447531795724d99d04b7ef.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_fcf35266be447531795724d99d04b7ef.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_be01c09415379e94ca76cf98b4b07f28.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_be01c09415379e94ca76cf98b4b07f28.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_4f8b92780f469096381d62f862f07326.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_4f8b92780f469096381d62f862f07326.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_f1b31288d7844fe659040d98b3b4cdb7.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_f1b31288d7844fe659040d98b3b4cdb7.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_f1b31288d7844fe659040d98b3b4cdb7.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_f1b31288d7844fe659040d98b3b4cdb7.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_7bf09501bb877fbd87dde578b39e0d84.translation: I just want to make you happy.
What do you want for Christmas?

sense_61c41522d378138281c43c2e73684ceb.translation: "How can I help you?," asked the butler.
Would you like something to drink?

sense_4287935346dc8ee6f35fc44f00111738.text: ¿Te cortaste el cabello? - No, solo las puntas.
sense_4287935346dc8ee6f35fc44f00111738.translation: Did you get a haircut? - No, it was just a trim.

sense_a41122d5945d1a393f15de9db9c35ce2.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_a41122d5945d1a393f15de9db9c35ce2.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_3681f64b4a9eeb40807bf3b099f2e0a3.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_3681f64b4a9eeb40807bf3b099f2e0a3.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_3681f64b4a9eeb40807bf3b099f2e0a3.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_3681f64b4a9eeb40807bf3b099f2e0a3.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_a894293ea06fc62a2381679e41c74115.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_a894293ea06fc62a2381679e41c74115.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_2304e4882c0262aba58002cea3bead04.text: La comida maravillosa del restaurante se une a la decoración modernista lujosa.
sense_2304e4882c0262aba58002cea3bead04.translation: The restaurant's fantastic food is complemented by their luxurious modernist decor.

sense_2304e4882c0262aba58002cea3bead04.text: Ese tipo es un trabajador fantástico. En él se unen la confianza y la habilidad.
sense_2304e4882c0262aba58002cea3bead04.translation: That guy's a fantastic worker. He's the epitome of confidence and skill.

sense_7b0c2ee54a1afd57a14e34b77663d88e.text: Juan Rulfo es su escritor favorito.
sense_7b0c2ee54a1afd57a14e34b77663d88e.translation: Juan Rulfo is his favorite writer.

sense_7b0c2ee54a1afd57a14e34b77663d88e.text: El escritor está trabajando en su octavo libro acerca de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.
sense_7b0c2ee54a1afd57a14e34b77663d88e.translation: The writer is working on his eighth book about World War II.

sense_a55c3b710157b03eb27fb6d10bfaca49.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_a55c3b710157b03eb27fb6d10bfaca49.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_a55c3b710157b03eb27fb6d10bfaca49.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_a55c3b710157b03eb27fb6d10bfaca49.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_ff84c65500788a09d2e1054da9000d60.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_ff84c65500788a09d2e1054da9000d60.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_ff84c65500788a09d2e1054da9000d60.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_ff84c65500788a09d2e1054da9000d60.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_102fa668fa812e64a57aedefaf2048d7.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_102fa668fa812e64a57aedefaf2048d7.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_ba3183e30107b3b2c5dd671b5b011d18.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_ba3183e30107b3b2c5dd671b5b011d18.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_ba3183e30107b3b2c5dd671b5b011d18.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_ba3183e30107b3b2c5dd671b5b011d18.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_f3c0d2b8c5d772da9facac8ce57ae6de.text: La peli era malísima; solo se salvaba el actor principal.
sense_f3c0d2b8c5d772da9facac8ce57ae6de.translation: The film was really bad; the main actor was the only one who was ok.

sense_f3c0d2b8c5d772da9facac8ce57ae6de.text: Los considero a todos unos vagos; no se salva nadie.
sense_f3c0d2b8c5d772da9facac8ce57ae6de.translation: I consider them all lazy, without exception.

sense_f9ce76f48160bad91df314e11368c6a6.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_f9ce76f48160bad91df314e11368c6a6.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_f9ce76f48160bad91df314e11368c6a6.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_f9ce76f48160bad91df314e11368c6a6.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_a718b01e8083e40e706c8aa68b4f837c.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_a718b01e8083e40e706c8aa68b4f837c.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_4613d2ac4f2c2cea37b23166ca513639.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_4613d2ac4f2c2cea37b23166ca513639.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_4613d2ac4f2c2cea37b23166ca513639.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_4613d2ac4f2c2cea37b23166ca513639.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_83a1a94bc63762ceb60830630f740e10.text: Este año voy a correr la maratón.
sense_83a1a94bc63762ceb60830630f740e10.translation: I'm running the marathon this year.

sense_cbd2b93e7921355e134c271c009a533d.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_cbd2b93e7921355e134c271c009a533d.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_812dccc2b11183ceabaa6b76d929548f.text: Este método se seguía usando hasta bien entrado el siglo XX.
sense_812dccc2b11183ceabaa6b76d929548f.translation: This method continued to be used until well into the 20th century.

sense_812dccc2b11183ceabaa6b76d929548f.text: El ladrón se ocultó y, ya entrada la noche, penetró en la casa.
sense_812dccc2b11183ceabaa6b76d929548f.translation: The thief hid and, once night had fallen, he entered the house.

sense_848ee50e4b9d8cb954e775e0099ba7d9.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_848ee50e4b9d8cb954e775e0099ba7d9.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_848ee50e4b9d8cb954e775e0099ba7d9.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_848ee50e4b9d8cb954e775e0099ba7d9.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_df732cda3b3366e43ca0c32b90581a4a.text: No escuché ningún ruido extraño, niños; son imaginaciones de ustedes.
sense_df732cda3b3366e43ca0c32b90581a4a.translation: I didn't hear any strange noises, kids. You're imagining things.

sense_df732cda3b3366e43ca0c32b90581a4a.text: Cuando Tobías dijo que acababa de ver un ovni, todos pensaron que eran imaginaciones suyas y que estaba borracho.
sense_df732cda3b3366e43ca0c32b90581a4a.translation: When Tobias said he'd just seen a UFO, everyone thought it was just all in his mind and that he was drunk.

sense_2378cabc2644a337a732e9b3d1013f13.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_2378cabc2644a337a732e9b3d1013f13.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_2378cabc2644a337a732e9b3d1013f13.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_2378cabc2644a337a732e9b3d1013f13.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_d768fe351d56ab0ee2fbda245920ce2a.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_d768fe351d56ab0ee2fbda245920ce2a.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_d768fe351d56ab0ee2fbda245920ce2a.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_d768fe351d56ab0ee2fbda245920ce2a.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_79b6259133ab778404376c9d8e3ac6a9.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_d10eb42fd58ce9ac38f3599ac032f7be.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_d10eb42fd58ce9ac38f3599ac032f7be.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_d10eb42fd58ce9ac38f3599ac032f7be.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_d10eb42fd58ce9ac38f3599ac032f7be.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_702fbddfae1e758d9bf33412745d724f.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_702fbddfae1e758d9bf33412745d724f.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_702fbddfae1e758d9bf33412745d724f.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_702fbddfae1e758d9bf33412745d724f.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_c41bb52ad39603286ef9550660d8008c.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_c41bb52ad39603286ef9550660d8008c.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_f63a1b25e3ce3a5110c3e4cac7968fce.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_f63a1b25e3ce3a5110c3e4cac7968fce.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_76d5bc7ed814d1e17b2ed1351b1e7e52.text: Ana se sentía realizada con la práctica de actividades benéficas.
sense_76d5bc7ed814d1e17b2ed1351b1e7e52.translation: Ana felt fulfilled doing charity work.

sense_76d5bc7ed814d1e17b2ed1351b1e7e52.text: El plan de salud infantil fomenta la práctica del deporte.
sense_76d5bc7ed814d1e17b2ed1351b1e7e52.translation: The children's healthcare program promotes playing sports.

sense_714e8a904c7f4b8c27b8345b0393fc93.text: Me regaló una porquería de segunda mano.
sense_714e8a904c7f4b8c27b8345b0393fc93.translation: She gave me some second-hand crap.

sense_714e8a904c7f4b8c27b8345b0393fc93.text: Este armario está lleno de porquería.
sense_714e8a904c7f4b8c27b8345b0393fc93.translation: This closet is full of junk.

sense_e60613216c870e8fe898ac4ab9b0a10a.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_e60613216c870e8fe898ac4ab9b0a10a.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_e60613216c870e8fe898ac4ab9b0a10a.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_e60613216c870e8fe898ac4ab9b0a10a.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_0bd6bfb57bd29a276aa103030306064f.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_0bd6bfb57bd29a276aa103030306064f.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_0bd6bfb57bd29a276aa103030306064f.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_0bd6bfb57bd29a276aa103030306064f.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_1da1eff292e4193c7a10ed23bdff0a39.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_1da1eff292e4193c7a10ed23bdff0a39.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_131a59fc54311dae69300a68437463ce.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_131a59fc54311dae69300a68437463ce.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_131a59fc54311dae69300a68437463ce.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_131a59fc54311dae69300a68437463ce.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_8b96e25b10501266e48d37cdd854bf56.text: Te apuesto que no lloverá el día de tu boda; no te preocupes.
sense_8b96e25b10501266e48d37cdd854bf56.translation: I bet you that it won't rain on your wedding day; don't worry.

sense_8b96e25b10501266e48d37cdd854bf56.text: Te apuesto $15 a que no eres capaz de encestar la pelota diez veces seguidas.
sense_8b96e25b10501266e48d37cdd854bf56.translation: I'll bet you $15 that you can't sink the ball ten times in a row.

sense_9a689f3f6d7cf93029adc6fc6681de62.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_9a689f3f6d7cf93029adc6fc6681de62.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_9a689f3f6d7cf93029adc6fc6681de62.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_9a689f3f6d7cf93029adc6fc6681de62.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_9e74b4596c884924c195ab7df2dc1bae.text: Los profesores opinan muy bien de ti.

sense_9e74b4596c884924c195ab7df2dc1bae.translation: I am of the same opinion.

sense_80cca40ecde2960776715cc510e37fae.text: A mi parecer, es un tema que no admite discusión.
sense_80cca40ecde2960776715cc510e37fae.translation: In my opinion, there's no arguing on the subject.

sense_80cca40ecde2960776715cc510e37fae.text: La fiesta de este año no admite comparación con ninguna otra.
sense_80cca40ecde2960776715cc510e37fae.translation: This year's party defies comparison with any other.

sense_94ef364655b9aeff9c7b813c08fef0c8.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_94ef364655b9aeff9c7b813c08fef0c8.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_94ef364655b9aeff9c7b813c08fef0c8.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_94ef364655b9aeff9c7b813c08fef0c8.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_dafe1afd02854b0a85421daf9d19fd14.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_519c5412e001a264983a0d4c4c885fff.text: La peli era malísima; solo se salvaba el actor principal.
sense_519c5412e001a264983a0d4c4c885fff.translation: The film was really bad; the main actor was the only one who was ok.

sense_519c5412e001a264983a0d4c4c885fff.text: Los considero a todos unos vagos; no se salva nadie.
sense_519c5412e001a264983a0d4c4c885fff.translation: I consider them all lazy, without exception.

sense_fbadd98ff119c2c1a31feed29b48c593.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_fbadd98ff119c2c1a31feed29b48c593.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_fbadd98ff119c2c1a31feed29b48c593.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_fbadd98ff119c2c1a31feed29b48c593.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_2973c94e8eb23ca6fcc9d15abf233e34.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_2973c94e8eb23ca6fcc9d15abf233e34.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_99bb3df2586e6fea2da5658ce06dfc38.text: Le han salido unos niños muy guerreros.
sense_99bb3df2586e6fea2da5658ce06dfc38.translation: Her children have turned out to be a real handful.

sense_99bb3df2586e6fea2da5658ce06dfc38.text: De todos mis hijos, los mellizos son los más guerreros.
