sense_99bb3df2586e6fea2da5658ce06dfc38.translation: Of all my children, the twins are the ones who give me the most trouble.

sense_f31dc4f9346695d90145a81f074b8748.text: El día de su alternativa el torero cortó tres orejas.
sense_f31dc4f9346695d90145a81f074b8748.translation: In his public debut, the bullfighter cut three ears.

sense_f31dc4f9346695d90145a81f074b8748.text: El novillero celebrará su alternativa el próximo domingo en la plaza de toros de Sevilla.
sense_f31dc4f9346695d90145a81f074b8748.translation: The novice will become a professional bullfighter next Sunday in Seville's bullfighting arena.

sense_0ffc2c4f2dc24601778f1a54e8857c72.text: Debemos votar por el candidato con las mejores propuestas.
sense_0ffc2c4f2dc24601778f1a54e8857c72.translation: We must vote for the candidate with the best proposals.

sense_0ffc2c4f2dc24601778f1a54e8857c72.text: Yo voté a favor de la propuesta más ecológica.
sense_0ffc2c4f2dc24601778f1a54e8857c72.translation: I voted in favor of the more environmentally-friendly proposal.

sense_2f58d54e19be092cd5aaba1ea79efcf6.text: El recepcionista me pidió que no me retirara.
sense_2f58d54e19be092cd5aaba1ea79efcf6.translation: The receptionist asked me to hold the line.

sense_d28df7718d9c0b5975d3ccbeea2bc585.text: En estos momentos la grúa está retirando el vehículo accidentado de la carretera.
sense_d28df7718d9c0b5975d3ccbeea2bc585.translation: Right now the tow truck is removing the damaged vehicle from the roadway.

sense_ef639059a31de70618878479b814237e.text: Mi marido nunca me retiró la confianza.
sense_ef639059a31de70618878479b814237e.translation: My husband never lost confidence in me.

sense_ef639059a31de70618878479b814237e.text: El partido le retiró la confianza al presidente cuando malversó fondos.
sense_ef639059a31de70618878479b814237e.translation: The president lost the party's confidence when he misappropriated funds.

sense_b2b3bee38c386c5db6976d222e486318.text: La empresa retiró los autobuses más antiguos.
sense_b2b3bee38c386c5db6976d222e486318.translation: The company withdrew the oldest buses.

sense_b2b3bee38c386c5db6976d222e486318.text: Retiraron los billetes falsos de la circulación.
sense_b2b3bee38c386c5db6976d222e486318.translation: The counterfeit notes were withdrawn from circulation.

sense_3a2aff6c21c3aad3e707ecae10ffc3b9.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_3a2aff6c21c3aad3e707ecae10ffc3b9.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_3a2aff6c21c3aad3e707ecae10ffc3b9.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_3a2aff6c21c3aad3e707ecae10ffc3b9.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_ccb5d7776f3c134c0c6a50c6b1271bff.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_ccb5d7776f3c134c0c6a50c6b1271bff.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_ccb5d7776f3c134c0c6a50c6b1271bff.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_ccb5d7776f3c134c0c6a50c6b1271bff.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_4060fc79d6fd83dca97096e05f4a4fce.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_4060fc79d6fd83dca97096e05f4a4fce.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_09d0682017fcedd5042c90c08c74992d.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_09d0682017fcedd5042c90c08c74992d.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_09d0682017fcedd5042c90c08c74992d.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_09d0682017fcedd5042c90c08c74992d.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_75b7a043dfe19843b52c074044b13d5d.translation: I don't know which one she wants.

sense_c6c10d5792772d2fcef638e79ae71052.text: Iba con un escote un poco subidito de tono.
sense_c6c10d5792772d2fcef638e79ae71052.translation: Her neckline was a bit risqué.

sense_c6c10d5792772d2fcef638e79ae71052.text: Ese comentario estuvo fuera de tono. Por favor, pide disculpas.
sense_c6c10d5792772d2fcef638e79ae71052.translation: That remark was uncalled for. Please apologize.

sense_aa32e96807c83b4e9fd42d8b4d6e3900.text: ¿Será que te arrestas a lanzarte en paracaídas?
sense_aa32e96807c83b4e9fd42d8b4d6e3900.translation: Would you dare to go skydiving?

sense_aa32e96807c83b4e9fd42d8b4d6e3900.text: Luz es una mujer valiente que se arresta a todo.
sense_aa32e96807c83b4e9fd42d8b4d6e3900.translation: Luz is a brave woman who's afraid of nothing.

sense_d99c1b177ac603ef0b65c816eb0429ee.text: Se fue sin explicación y me partió el corazón.
sense_d99c1b177ac603ef0b65c816eb0429ee.translation: She left without explanation and broke my heart.

sense_d99c1b177ac603ef0b65c816eb0429ee.text: Le dijeron que si no pagaba la deuda, le iban a partir las piernas.
sense_d99c1b177ac603ef0b65c816eb0429ee.translation: They told him that if he didn't pay the debt, they were going to break his legs.

sense_486cdc5913e13195b47b5ff308f1e5ef.text: Dicen que los vampiros no tienen alma.
sense_486cdc5913e13195b47b5ff308f1e5ef.translation: They say vampires have no soul.

sense_486cdc5913e13195b47b5ff308f1e5ef.text: Siento en mi propia alma que deberíamos estar juntos.
sense_486cdc5913e13195b47b5ff308f1e5ef.translation: I feel it in my soul that we should be together.

sense_cbf53234e47294a96011d4776715326d.text: Este ejercicio es muy bueno para fortalecer los glúteos.
sense_cbf53234e47294a96011d4776715326d.translation: This exercise is really good to strengthen your glutes.

sense_cbf53234e47294a96011d4776715326d.text: Prefiero hacer ejercicio en la mañana para empezar bien el día.
sense_cbf53234e47294a96011d4776715326d.translation: I prefer to do exercise in the morning to start my day off right.

sense_749acbf8b00cef91ba40f1bebc3533f2.text: ¿Por qué la apellidaste como el padre?
sense_749acbf8b00cef91ba40f1bebc3533f2.translation: Why did you give her her father's last name?

sense_749acbf8b00cef91ba40f1bebc3533f2.text: Al ser madre soltera, apellidó a su hijo como ella.
sense_749acbf8b00cef91ba40f1bebc3533f2.translation: As she was a single mother, she gave her son her own surname.

sense_0c2b3de0fcdf1fa1e7439002274d9602.text: Mi mejor amiga se apellida Palacios.
sense_0c2b3de0fcdf1fa1e7439002274d9602.translation: My best friend's last name is Palacios.
Your last name is Hernandez? So is mine!

sense_e83b77a1f71cf530d36e26829a289012.text: ¿Vas a ir a visitar a tu amigo esta noche?
sense_e83b77a1f71cf530d36e26829a289012.translation: Are you going to visit your friend tonight?

sense_e83b77a1f71cf530d36e26829a289012.text: El cirujano visitó al paciente el día después de la operación.
sense_e83b77a1f71cf530d36e26829a289012.translation: The surgeon visited the patient the day after the surgery.

sense_51ecb94fad3da20ec9ccb0f8aaf84d6e.text: Un paramédico buscaba el pulso del accidentado.
sense_51ecb94fad3da20ec9ccb0f8aaf84d6e.translation: A paramedic was trying to find the injured man's pulse.

sense_51ecb94fad3da20ec9ccb0f8aaf84d6e.text: Se me aceleró el pulso al ver un alacrán salir de debajo de mi bolsa.
sense_51ecb94fad3da20ec9ccb0f8aaf84d6e.translation: My pulse sped up when I saw a scorpion crawl out from under my purse.

sense_6ca04a79d158aaaa3de870705a89cf00.text: Hace tiempo que me tiembla el pulso.
sense_6ca04a79d158aaaa3de870705a89cf00.translation: My hand has been shaking for some time now.

sense_6ca04a79d158aaaa3de870705a89cf00.text: Tengo el pulso fatal; me tiembla la mano cuando intento sacar fotos.
sense_6ca04a79d158aaaa3de870705a89cf00.translation: I have an unsteady hand; my hand shakes when I try to take photos.

sense_e5f6970ff73e9aea73e6c073582610a9.text: El gobierno debe actuar con pulso firme y reformar esta legislación.
sense_e5f6970ff73e9aea73e6c073582610a9.translation: The government must act decisively and reform this legislation.

sense_e5f6970ff73e9aea73e6c073582610a9.text: Al ejecutivo no le va a temblar el pulso a la hora de tomar decisiones difíciles sobre la economía.
sense_e5f6970ff73e9aea73e6c073582610a9.translation: The executive won't hesitate when it comes to taking difficult decisions about the economy.

sense_6791b95d699633c7e42a0154088a71df.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_6791b95d699633c7e42a0154088a71df.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_6791b95d699633c7e42a0154088a71df.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_6791b95d699633c7e42a0154088a71df.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_bca50516386bff81a84ca81699ff7566.text: Marisol se acaba de comer una caja entera de pasas.
sense_bca50516386bff81a84ca81699ff7566.translation: Marisol just ate an entire box of raisins.

sense_bca50516386bff81a84ca81699ff7566.text: ¿Por qué le pusiste pasas al relleno? ¡Sabes que las odio!
sense_bca50516386bff81a84ca81699ff7566.translation: Why did you add raisins to the stuffing? You know I hate them!

sense_dfe8c5c359c91e6a87ab6a5ce75b1bd3.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_dfe8c5c359c91e6a87ab6a5ce75b1bd3.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_dfe8c5c359c91e6a87ab6a5ce75b1bd3.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_dfe8c5c359c91e6a87ab6a5ce75b1bd3.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_ec3626ff614997c486da5a4c759b3bc1.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_ec3626ff614997c486da5a4c759b3bc1.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_47bf9981af0eade4d81a051f76c98e88.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_47bf9981af0eade4d81a051f76c98e88.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_47bf9981af0eade4d81a051f76c98e88.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_47bf9981af0eade4d81a051f76c98e88.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_3010b3001bdcf99b32e24fe188e57312.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_3010b3001bdcf99b32e24fe188e57312.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_3010b3001bdcf99b32e24fe188e57312.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_3010b3001bdcf99b32e24fe188e57312.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_6a056a5915dce3594bb5159ad73e517f.text: La disciplina y el honor informan su naturaleza como soldado.
sense_6a056a5915dce3594bb5159ad73e517f.translation: He is a soldier who believes in discipline and honor.
Her silhouette hints at her beauty.

sense_5127cfc1d78d504355d3ef0f9fd66ad2.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_5127cfc1d78d504355d3ef0f9fd66ad2.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_8fe6f8cd58cd5a1b6693cf0e47671fed.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_8fe6f8cd58cd5a1b6693cf0e47671fed.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_e24f58f996bb66d213c8fc442b36460b.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_e24f58f996bb66d213c8fc442b36460b.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_e24f58f996bb66d213c8fc442b36460b.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_e24f58f996bb66d213c8fc442b36460b.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_d6d57a605c8b0e2050f1897ca6fe5b21.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_d6d57a605c8b0e2050f1897ca6fe5b21.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_d6d57a605c8b0e2050f1897ca6fe5b21.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_d6d57a605c8b0e2050f1897ca6fe5b21.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_d3a0bf44db1c11876c53a81c3a124902.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_d3a0bf44db1c11876c53a81c3a124902.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_1208e571d6072ee45ea775f649676977.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_1208e571d6072ee45ea775f649676977.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_1208e571d6072ee45ea775f649676977.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_1208e571d6072ee45ea775f649676977.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_54f175ab2debc9999840dbc3818f273d.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_54f175ab2debc9999840dbc3818f273d.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_54f175ab2debc9999840dbc3818f273d.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_54f175ab2debc9999840dbc3818f273d.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_56596ae62a55bd09287527377ae6232f.text: El muro de los Llantos se ubica en Jerusalén.
sense_56596ae62a55bd09287527377ae6232f.translation: The Wailing Wall is located in Jerusalem.

sense_56596ae62a55bd09287527377ae6232f.text: Los muros de la casa son gruesos.
sense_56596ae62a55bd09287527377ae6232f.translation: The walls of the house are thick.

sense_7e9ffd8ce918c3a858c9ddce167891c6.text: María está muy abandonada desde que la despidieron del trabajo.
sense_7e9ffd8ce918c3a858c9ddce167891c6.translation: Maria has let herself go since she was fired from her job.

sense_7e9ffd8ce918c3a858c9ddce167891c6.text: Patricio es tan abandonado que ya ni siquiera me llama en mi cumpleaños.
sense_7e9ffd8ce918c3a858c9ddce167891c6.translation: Patricio is so slack about things he doesn't even call me on my birthday anymore.

sense_6b712305dc5a99bcd24b08175c451373.text: ¿Quieres ver una película romántica o una de terror?
sense_6b712305dc5a99bcd24b08175c451373.translation: Do you want to watch a romantic movie or a horror flick?

sense_6b712305dc5a99bcd24b08175c451373.text: Pedro es muy romántico y organizó una cena a la luz de las velas para mí.
sense_6b712305dc5a99bcd24b08175c451373.translation: Pedro is very romantic and he organized a candlelit dinner for me.

sense_3856d6e226865321b4d944f40faedbde.text: Tenemos planeado ir a la playa en agosto.
sense_3856d6e226865321b4d944f40faedbde.translation: We're planning to go to the beach in August.

sense_3856d6e226865321b4d944f40faedbde.text: Estamos planeando una fiesta de sorpresa para su cumpleaños.
sense_3856d6e226865321b4d944f40faedbde.translation: We're planning a surprise party for her birthday.

sense_b093f4c5c15a3a428da0d981337aef8c.text: Juan estuvo practicando para darle efecto al balón.
sense_b093f4c5c15a3a428da0d981337aef8c.translation: Juan has been practicing making the ball swerve.

sense_b093f4c5c15a3a428da0d981337aef8c.text: ¿Cómo se le da efecto a la pelota?
sense_b093f4c5c15a3a428da0d981337aef8c.translation: How do you get the ball to swerve?

sense_6138b278b12349d878e96e1ec6bce748.text: La cirugía es la única esperanza que nos queda.
sense_6138b278b12349d878e96e1ec6bce748.translation: Surgery is the only hope we have left.

sense_6138b278b12349d878e96e1ec6bce748.text: Tú eres nuestra última esperanza de ganar.
sense_6138b278b12349d878e96e1ec6bce748.translation: You're our last hope of winning.

sense_4d0ad90b1733263e5fccdc8923d73765.text: La doctora no esperanzó al paciente porque algo podría salir mal.
sense_4d0ad90b1733263e5fccdc8923d73765.translation: The doctor didn't get her patient's hopes up because it was possible something could go wrong.

sense_4d0ad90b1733263e5fccdc8923d73765.text: El hecho de que un señor de 70 años pueda escalar el Everest debería esperanzar a todos los mayores de 60 años.
sense_4d0ad90b1733263e5fccdc8923d73765.translation: The fact that a 70-year-old man can climb Everest should give hope to all over-60s.

sense_42aa05b5536d89fcb845e8373920820b.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_42aa05b5536d89fcb845e8373920820b.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_3b34f716816bcb69a458f8f164a8c15e.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_3b34f716816bcb69a458f8f164a8c15e.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_b158a3b2988892bd20829ee83e77fe36.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_b158a3b2988892bd20829ee83e77fe36.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_b158a3b2988892bd20829ee83e77fe36.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_b158a3b2988892bd20829ee83e77fe36.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_6ed62b922cf6ebbc6a22790aaf31b5ab.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_6ed62b922cf6ebbc6a22790aaf31b5ab.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_6ed62b922cf6ebbc6a22790aaf31b5ab.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_6ed62b922cf6ebbc6a22790aaf31b5ab.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_fb944b6477007e1af54a454feb591b7a.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_fb944b6477007e1af54a454feb591b7a.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_8154071b59ba11d0bd3e8b10f5eda136.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_8154071b59ba11d0bd3e8b10f5eda136.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_8154071b59ba11d0bd3e8b10f5eda136.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_8154071b59ba11d0bd3e8b10f5eda136.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_31c74322c46a039e10f6e5bd79720812.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_31c74322c46a039e10f6e5bd79720812.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_31c74322c46a039e10f6e5bd79720812.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_31c74322c46a039e10f6e5bd79720812.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_52de73d3991717f33cadd17f36c12153.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_52de73d3991717f33cadd17f36c12153.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_d3acddabaf4c5289ce97f2944bb10a8d.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_d3acddabaf4c5289ce97f2944bb10a8d.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_d3acddabaf4c5289ce97f2944bb10a8d.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_d3acddabaf4c5289ce97f2944bb10a8d.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_355ecca90d58e76093b1935029206eff.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_355ecca90d58e76093b1935029206eff.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_355ecca90d58e76093b1935029206eff.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_355ecca90d58e76093b1935029206eff.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_480172c05253a8ef064bb4196d08ce55.text: La chica estaba vendiendo naranjas en el mercado.
sense_480172c05253a8ef064bb4196d08ce55.translation: The girl was selling oranges in the market.

sense_6eb0f537e19bd565e0df382a38e75c6b.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_6eb0f537e19bd565e0df382a38e75c6b.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_6eb0f537e19bd565e0df382a38e75c6b.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_6eb0f537e19bd565e0df382a38e75c6b.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_c3a28fc484182669990c3f19ce1390f5.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_c3a28fc484182669990c3f19ce1390f5.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_c3a28fc484182669990c3f19ce1390f5.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_c3a28fc484182669990c3f19ce1390f5.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_4ffd12712bc0a10da959174d1d54f722.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_4ffd12712bc0a10da959174d1d54f722.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_4ffd12712bc0a10da959174d1d54f722.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_4ffd12712bc0a10da959174d1d54f722.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_b0d0ea841b739db176f77adca1f24078.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_b0d0ea841b739db176f77adca1f24078.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_b0d0ea841b739db176f77adca1f24078.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_b0d0ea841b739db176f77adca1f24078.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_7d214ee06eabe3b45efeabca9e1c79b5.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_7d214ee06eabe3b45efeabca9e1c79b5.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_7d214ee06eabe3b45efeabca9e1c79b5.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_7d214ee06eabe3b45efeabca9e1c79b5.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_4be04adbb48eaeadf7b38cd666cf9bbe.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_4be04adbb48eaeadf7b38cd666cf9bbe.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_4be04adbb48eaeadf7b38cd666cf9bbe.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_4be04adbb48eaeadf7b38cd666cf9bbe.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_c1fcb5b7c30360ed28d0cae0f7fd4190.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_c1fcb5b7c30360ed28d0cae0f7fd4190.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_c1fcb5b7c30360ed28d0cae0f7fd4190.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_c1fcb5b7c30360ed28d0cae0f7fd4190.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_35cc5c8f9073da4a728c5d6c7e33da6b.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_35cc5c8f9073da4a728c5d6c7e33da6b.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_35cc5c8f9073da4a728c5d6c7e33da6b.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_35cc5c8f9073da4a728c5d6c7e33da6b.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_9cf376de0813f141d43ddb036d3d4fac.text: Dicen que el alcalde recibió dinero de fuentes sospechosas.
sense_9cf376de0813f141d43ddb036d3d4fac.translation: They say that the mayor received money from shady sources.

sense_9cf376de0813f141d43ddb036d3d4fac.text: La víctima recibió un fuerte golpe al lado de la cabeza.
sense_9cf376de0813f141d43ddb036d3d4fac.translation: The victim received a strong blow to the side of the head.

sense_92fe3f140948c11da459cc390e0817ee.text: El equipo visitante fue recibido con silbidos y abucheos.
sense_92fe3f140948c11da459cc390e0817ee.translation: The visiting team was received with whistles and jeers.

sense_92fe3f140948c11da459cc390e0817ee.text: Nos recibió personalmente en el aeropuerto.
sense_92fe3f140948c11da459cc390e0817ee.translation: He personally welcomed us at the airport.

sense_0415b2378ea5083df245c01809a7e88b.text: Mi hermana se recibió de ingeniera en Georgia Tech.
sense_0415b2378ea5083df245c01809a7e88b.translation: My sister graduated as an engineer from Georgia Tech.
How many students will graduate this year?

sense_f1dbd3214e9306eb081d63b83ed3b550.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_f1dbd3214e9306eb081d63b83ed3b550.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_f1dbd3214e9306eb081d63b83ed3b550.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_f1dbd3214e9306eb081d63b83ed3b550.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_92d79452319c0e2b5874eff2546eb11d.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_92d79452319c0e2b5874eff2546eb11d.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_92d79452319c0e2b5874eff2546eb11d.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_92d79452319c0e2b5874eff2546eb11d.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_a70f41bb359aa6d6813df4ca61ae6325.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_d5b6cc924c8003e28f8da17922771da7.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_d5b6cc924c8003e28f8da17922771da7.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_d5b6cc924c8003e28f8da17922771da7.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_d5b6cc924c8003e28f8da17922771da7.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_9790f0997f63a141bbfbf34750fad0c1.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_9790f0997f63a141bbfbf34750fad0c1.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_9790f0997f63a141bbfbf34750fad0c1.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_9790f0997f63a141bbfbf34750fad0c1.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_8c627052fea8fe51373ab2924ee6a8bc.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_8c627052fea8fe51373ab2924ee6a8bc.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_f4ca7606e7e4b3a1c13e95d4fa140a41.text: Solo quiero un sorbo. Tú puedes beber el resto.
sense_f4ca7606e7e4b3a1c13e95d4fa140a41.translation: I just want a sip. You can drink the rest.

sense_f4ca7606e7e4b3a1c13e95d4fa140a41.text: Haz lo que tengas que hacer, y olvídate del resto.
sense_f4ca7606e7e4b3a1c13e95d4fa140a41.translation: Do what you have to do, and forget about the rest.

sense_2ffd1726d75c0246064c12978d8af889.text: ¡Estás desconocida con ese corte de pelo!
sense_2ffd1726d75c0246064c12978d8af889.translation: You look very different with that haircut!

sense_2ffd1726d75c0246064c12978d8af889.text: Desde que se casó está desconocido.
sense_2ffd1726d75c0246064c12978d8af889.translation: He's changed a lot since he got married.

sense_389de4e88747c4967e889576e05ee769.text: No tardará en dejar de ser una desconocida.
sense_389de4e88747c4967e889576e05ee769.translation: It won't take long for her to become famous.

sense_389de4e88747c4967e889576e05ee769.text: Se casó con él cuando era todavía un desconocido.
sense_389de4e88747c4967e889576e05ee769.translation: She married him when he was not yet famous.

sense_8b4771e618570dfe39f3e4afd857711e.text: Dicen que el alcalde recibió dinero de fuentes sospechosas.
sense_8b4771e618570dfe39f3e4afd857711e.translation: They say that the mayor received money from shady sources.

sense_8b4771e618570dfe39f3e4afd857711e.text: La víctima recibió un fuerte golpe al lado de la cabeza.
sense_8b4771e618570dfe39f3e4afd857711e.translation: The victim received a strong blow to the side of the head.

sense_d5959ec4856ac27a82ba2af82beef4fb.text: El equipo visitante fue recibido con silbidos y abucheos.
sense_d5959ec4856ac27a82ba2af82beef4fb.translation: The visiting team was received with whistles and jeers.

sense_d5959ec4856ac27a82ba2af82beef4fb.text: Nos recibió personalmente en el aeropuerto.
sense_d5959ec4856ac27a82ba2af82beef4fb.translation: He personally welcomed us at the airport.

sense_fa9c2e361836eba4fb943651531a3ea6.text: Mi hermana se recibió de ingeniera en Georgia Tech.
sense_fa9c2e361836eba4fb943651531a3ea6.translation: My sister graduated as an engineer from Georgia Tech.
How many students will graduate this year?

sense_826c3fabf1b2044ec69d24d2d46638e3.text: Te agarras a tu herida para evitar las tareas en casa.
sense_826c3fabf1b2044ec69d24d2d46638e3.translation: You use your injury to get out of chores around the house.

sense_826c3fabf1b2044ec69d24d2d46638e3.text: Se agarró a los deberes para no tener que lavar los platos.
sense_826c3fabf1b2044ec69d24d2d46638e3.translation: She used her homework as an excuse to not wash the dishes.

sense_a6bd0266cd8ff8f5e5dabac04568cca2.text: La gente usaba máscaras coloridas en la fiesta de disfraces.
sense_a6bd0266cd8ff8f5e5dabac04568cca2.translation: People wore colorful masks at the costume party.

sense_a6bd0266cd8ff8f5e5dabac04568cca2.text: No pude ver las caras de los ladrones porque llevaban máscaras puestas.
sense_a6bd0266cd8ff8f5e5dabac04568cca2.translation: I wasn't able to see the burglars' faces because they were wearing masks.

sense_47505316d54dace2675156efe49984ff.text: Este método se seguía usando hasta bien entrado el siglo XX.
sense_47505316d54dace2675156efe49984ff.translation: This method continued to be used until well into the 20th century.

sense_47505316d54dace2675156efe49984ff.text: El ladrón se ocultó y, ya entrada la noche, penetró en la casa.
sense_47505316d54dace2675156efe49984ff.translation: The thief hid and, once night had fallen, he entered the house.

sense_598fb950c3fc240589a1adcde09763a5.text: Los trabajadores insatisfechos hicieron una sentada.
sense_598fb950c3fc240589a1adcde09763a5.translation: The dissatisfied workers organized a sit-in.

sense_598fb950c3fc240589a1adcde09763a5.text: Participé en muchas sentadas cuando era un estudiante universitario en los años sesenta.
sense_598fb950c3fc240589a1adcde09763a5.translation: I took part in a lot of sit-ins when I was a college student in the sixties.

sense_7c381885528e0baa4045dd4db6830e63.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_560f5815ccaffc59854a80a4c01c59bd.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_560f5815ccaffc59854a80a4c01c59bd.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_560f5815ccaffc59854a80a4c01c59bd.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_560f5815ccaffc59854a80a4c01c59bd.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_f08b46ee1fba157655019686351e346b.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_f08b46ee1fba157655019686351e346b.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_f08b46ee1fba157655019686351e346b.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_f08b46ee1fba157655019686351e346b.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_e8c9b7714a7139d9762da110ccf7e5b4.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_e8c9b7714a7139d9762da110ccf7e5b4.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_79a1180337828fe684628d37aaf95ea7.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_79a1180337828fe684628d37aaf95ea7.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_79a1180337828fe684628d37aaf95ea7.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_79a1180337828fe684628d37aaf95ea7.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_b38c43ad6fa9c41b70b0910f929a27f8.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_b38c43ad6fa9c41b70b0910f929a27f8.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_b38c43ad6fa9c41b70b0910f929a27f8.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_b38c43ad6fa9c41b70b0910f929a27f8.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_c3d55688c81774072f5bcc4a832bed26.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_85dde06505706c9108360d7547d15fb5.text: Cayó un palo de agua que inundó las calles.
sense_85dde06505706c9108360d7547d15fb5.translation: The pouring rain flooded the streets.

sense_85dde06505706c9108360d7547d15fb5.text: Se compró un palo de carro con el dinero que ganó en la lotería.
sense_85dde06505706c9108360d7547d15fb5.translation: He bought the car of cars with the money he won from the lottery.

sense_601257d3cb13304d98220a0249f0d6b6.text: Encontré cinco monedas entre los cojines del sofá.
sense_601257d3cb13304d98220a0249f0d6b6.translation: I found five coins among the cushions on the couch.

sense_601257d3cb13304d98220a0249f0d6b6.text: Necesito monedas para la máquina expendedora.
sense_601257d3cb13304d98220a0249f0d6b6.translation: I need coins for the vending machine.

sense_b99dcc64cbb7af4296be24c0b4f93e47.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_b99dcc64cbb7af4296be24c0b4f93e47.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_b99dcc64cbb7af4296be24c0b4f93e47.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_b99dcc64cbb7af4296be24c0b4f93e47.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_fd6d7381837de9443c39b7bbe55be818.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_fd6d7381837de9443c39b7bbe55be818.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_fd6d7381837de9443c39b7bbe55be818.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_fd6d7381837de9443c39b7bbe55be818.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_86cd8310bdc6785b89ef0e326bcba7f1.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_86cd8310bdc6785b89ef0e326bcba7f1.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_1b5cb13850d4d5afd1564764a48240c0.text: Intenté varias veces pero no fue posible establecer la comunicación.
sense_1b5cb13850d4d5afd1564764a48240c0.translation: I tried several times but I couldn't get through.

sense_1b5cb13850d4d5afd1564764a48240c0.text: Recibí una llamada pero se cortó la comunicación y no supe quién era.
sense_1b5cb13850d4d5afd1564764a48240c0.translation: I had a call but it was cut off so I don't know who it was.

sense_5bf20c7ddea2085e9c66d55e895811d2.text: El alumno escribió su ensayo de 20 páginas en una noche.
sense_5bf20c7ddea2085e9c66d55e895811d2.translation: The student wrote his 20-page essay in one night.

sense_c40af41fdc50f1e6484dbc1e846db38d.text: ¿Quieres participar en una carrera conmigo en abril?
sense_c40af41fdc50f1e6484dbc1e846db38d.translation: Do you want to enter a race with me in April?

sense_c40af41fdc50f1e6484dbc1e846db38d.text: El corredor nigeriano ganó la carrera por un pelo.
sense_c40af41fdc50f1e6484dbc1e846db38d.translation: The Nigerian runner won the race by a hair.

sense_4dca2d1bfa1cbfd9e0ba78f24dc7307b.text: Puede ser que sea médico, pero tiene pinta de delincuente.
sense_4dca2d1bfa1cbfd9e0ba78f24dc7307b.translation: He might be a doctor, but he looks like a crook.

sense_3ccbeac52193001cd4e5192343feeb8e.text: Todavía está mojada. Ten cuidado que no te pinte.
sense_3ccbeac52193001cd4e5192343feeb8e.translation: It’s still wet. Be careful you don't get any on you.

sense_3ccbeac52193001cd4e5192343feeb8e.text: Se rompió mi pluma y me pintó la manos totalmente de azul.
sense_3ccbeac52193001cd4e5192343feeb8e.translation: My pen broke and got blue ink all over my hands.

sense_1a8c2ca8a4016e1ac0581dfbdb26c035.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_1a8c2ca8a4016e1ac0581dfbdb26c035.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_1a8c2ca8a4016e1ac0581dfbdb26c035.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_1a8c2ca8a4016e1ac0581dfbdb26c035.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_ad2feadf767d94f4bff637bce9002d44.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_ad2feadf767d94f4bff637bce9002d44.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_ad2feadf767d94f4bff637bce9002d44.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_ad2feadf767d94f4bff637bce9002d44.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_06f04dfe43f97d8ac7f0a92f7c1b39a3.text: Juan medía 5 pies a los quince años.
sense_06f04dfe43f97d8ac7f0a92f7c1b39a3.translation: Juan was 5 feet tall when he was fifteen.

sense_49ddc8e196470ef6fb16cdac01e32bb9.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_49ddc8e196470ef6fb16cdac01e32bb9.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_1b4e5f8b20ec90f540764ebb4ed773bc.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_1b4e5f8b20ec90f540764ebb4ed773bc.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_1b4e5f8b20ec90f540764ebb4ed773bc.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_1b4e5f8b20ec90f540764ebb4ed773bc.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_a6652239d2ba0197fa7219e602d58c1a.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_a6652239d2ba0197fa7219e602d58c1a.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_7dc1498a78528f39f8ec16cf72e0f7ab.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_7dc1498a78528f39f8ec16cf72e0f7ab.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_6cce74285a0743515b187bfb5f1d8718.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_6cce74285a0743515b187bfb5f1d8718.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_6cce74285a0743515b187bfb5f1d8718.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_6cce74285a0743515b187bfb5f1d8718.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_26477f974f0ef1c4940c060ddfde116f.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_26477f974f0ef1c4940c060ddfde116f.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_26477f974f0ef1c4940c060ddfde116f.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_26477f974f0ef1c4940c060ddfde116f.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_2ee91e1bda6312e06091122d2fc7e551.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_2ee91e1bda6312e06091122d2fc7e551.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_2ee91e1bda6312e06091122d2fc7e551.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_2ee91e1bda6312e06091122d2fc7e551.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_19fecfdbf72b3f2a03b6c8884b6c2241.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_19fecfdbf72b3f2a03b6c8884b6c2241.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_19fecfdbf72b3f2a03b6c8884b6c2241.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_19fecfdbf72b3f2a03b6c8884b6c2241.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_574323d287cfdb661d359e9eacd0dfc9.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_574323d287cfdb661d359e9eacd0dfc9.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_574323d287cfdb661d359e9eacd0dfc9.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_574323d287cfdb661d359e9eacd0dfc9.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_c823e7861f49b8292595c8b16b462e70.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_c823e7861f49b8292595c8b16b462e70.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_c823e7861f49b8292595c8b16b462e70.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_c823e7861f49b8292595c8b16b462e70.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_31268db7154990f3dc2a8d3b85afd4b7.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_31268db7154990f3dc2a8d3b85afd4b7.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_31268db7154990f3dc2a8d3b85afd4b7.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_31268db7154990f3dc2a8d3b85afd4b7.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_60eb34f17dcd25c466368adda79e11fe.text: Nos estamos riendo porque acabas de decir un absurdo.
sense_60eb34f17dcd25c466368adda79e11fe.translation: We are laughing because you just said something absurd.

sense_60eb34f17dcd25c466368adda79e11fe.text: A Miguel le parece un absurdo que me presente en las fiestas sin que me inviten.
sense_60eb34f17dcd25c466368adda79e11fe.translation: Miguel finds it ridiculous that I show up at parties without having been invited.

sense_c20103f1a68a90fef99e88b1d84d3176.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_c20103f1a68a90fef99e88b1d84d3176.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_c20103f1a68a90fef99e88b1d84d3176.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_c20103f1a68a90fef99e88b1d84d3176.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_ceef78116eb8dcfd80ff40007f5a4394.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_ceef78116eb8dcfd80ff40007f5a4394.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_ceef78116eb8dcfd80ff40007f5a4394.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_ceef78116eb8dcfd80ff40007f5a4394.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_46847071f2cb2d2c062707be18fc8977.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_d29b88ac36cb9b3fb0eed0a23830a86f.text: Todos los estudiantes del grupo son muy capaces.
sense_d29b88ac36cb9b3fb0eed0a23830a86f.translation: All the students in the group are very able.

sense_d29b88ac36cb9b3fb0eed0a23830a86f.text: Es sorprendente que sea capaz de levantarme todos los días a las cinco de la mañana para ir a trabajar.
sense_d29b88ac36cb9b3fb0eed0a23830a86f.translation: It's surprising that I'm able to get up every day at five in the morning to go to work.

sense_1c09c8c3b9ebbc9ff4e69d909f8d7ef1.text: ¡Dime tonto otra vez si eres capaz!
sense_1c09c8c3b9ebbc9ff4e69d909f8d7ef1.translation: Call me a fool again if you dare!

sense_1c09c8c3b9ebbc9ff4e69d909f8d7ef1.text: Miguel no fue capaz de decirle al público lo que verdaderamente creía.
sense_1c09c8c3b9ebbc9ff4e69d909f8d7ef1.translation: Miguel could not bring himself to tell the audience what he really believed.

sense_d536e82faaf203164b010502315dfc84.text: Aún no llegó; capaz que esté en un atasco.
sense_d536e82faaf203164b010502315dfc84.translation: He's not here yet; he could be stuck in traffic.

sense_d536e82faaf203164b010502315dfc84.text: Capaz que nieve con el frío que está haciendo.
sense_d536e82faaf203164b010502315dfc84.translation: It might snow with this cold weather.

sense_e234fb362210b6689afc850f2b197bf9.text: Si el tiempo no mejora, posiblemente tengan que aplazar el concierto.
sense_e234fb362210b6689afc850f2b197bf9.translation: If the weather doesn't improve, they may have to postpone the concert.

sense_e234fb362210b6689afc850f2b197bf9.text: Diana parecía triste y habló muy poco. - Posiblemente se haya peleado con Diego.
sense_e234fb362210b6689afc850f2b197bf9.translation: Diana seemed sad and said very little. - She might have had a row with Diego.

sense_77ad0a4d50c542f38e365e5a01b72751.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_77ad0a4d50c542f38e365e5a01b72751.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_f95b9a7c5994d70a043f887b16b0d80f.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_f95b9a7c5994d70a043f887b16b0d80f.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_f95b9a7c5994d70a043f887b16b0d80f.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_f95b9a7c5994d70a043f887b16b0d80f.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_30894ce81bb52967fe2bd8ac86bc57cc.text: Te agarras a tu herida para evitar las tareas en casa.
sense_30894ce81bb52967fe2bd8ac86bc57cc.translation: You use your injury to get out of chores around the house.

sense_30894ce81bb52967fe2bd8ac86bc57cc.text: Se agarró a los deberes para no tener que lavar los platos.
sense_30894ce81bb52967fe2bd8ac86bc57cc.translation: She used her homework as an excuse to not wash the dishes.

sense_c80dab956447a3f306e3b4aaa17b0415.text: El avión hizo un extraño al despegar.
sense_c80dab956447a3f306e3b4aaa17b0415.translation: The plane made a strange movement while taking off.

sense_c80dab956447a3f306e3b4aaa17b0415.text: El elefante hizo un extraño cuando vio el ratón.
sense_c80dab956447a3f306e3b4aaa17b0415.translation: The elephant shied when he saw a mouse.

sense_1d71a850174321aa4984388a89b7ab60.text: Se puso una enojada tremenda cuando lo eliminaron de la competencia.
sense_1d71a850174321aa4984388a89b7ab60.translation: He was really angry when he was eliminated from the competition.

sense_1d71a850174321aa4984388a89b7ab60.text: Hubieras visto la enojada que se dio cuando supo que Luis le había puesto el cuerno.
sense_1d71a850174321aa4984388a89b7ab60.translation: You should have seen how mad she got when she found out Luis had cheated on her.

sense_05292bee0477f619262037fa49506402.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_d4fc157a735be9633ffea22165e61d3b.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_d4fc157a735be9633ffea22165e61d3b.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_d4fc157a735be9633ffea22165e61d3b.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_d4fc157a735be9633ffea22165e61d3b.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_63aeeb5f8a7f5d37a5c683ed07294964.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_63aeeb5f8a7f5d37a5c683ed07294964.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_63aeeb5f8a7f5d37a5c683ed07294964.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_63aeeb5f8a7f5d37a5c683ed07294964.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_3535be5c15776afc780c18abea14cf3b.text: El juez condenó al acusado a cadena perpetua por cometer un delito grave.
sense_3535be5c15776afc780c18abea14cf3b.translation: The judge gave the defendant a life sentence because he committed a serious crime.

sense_3535be5c15776afc780c18abea14cf3b.text: ¿Sabías que es un delito cruzar la calle sin usar el paso de peatones?
sense_3535be5c15776afc780c18abea14cf3b.translation: Did you know that it's a crime to jaywalk?

sense_672e6f5d5075a51d9ae95998e767c68c.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_672e6f5d5075a51d9ae95998e767c68c.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_672e6f5d5075a51d9ae95998e767c68c.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_672e6f5d5075a51d9ae95998e767c68c.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_68570dc7acc160a3144960bce45fdfd6.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_68570dc7acc160a3144960bce45fdfd6.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_68570dc7acc160a3144960bce45fdfd6.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_68570dc7acc160a3144960bce45fdfd6.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_5f51639b0022643a233167a77a5adfe9.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_4148d3627b90d9f6f3099e395dc5ef65.text: Prohibido dar de comer a los patos.
sense_4148d3627b90d9f6f3099e395dc5ef65.translation: Please do not feed the ducks.

sense_4148d3627b90d9f6f3099e395dc5ef65.text: ¡Apaga ese cigarrillo! ¿No viste el cartel de "Prohibido fumar"?
sense_4148d3627b90d9f6f3099e395dc5ef65.translation: Put that cigarette out! Didn't you see the "No smoking" sign?

sense_2f577f22963c0355dfc6cdad34c72246.text: Armó un follón cuando compré una marca diferente de cereal.
sense_2f577f22963c0355dfc6cdad34c72246.translation: She kicked up a real fuss when I bought a different brand of cereal.

sense_2f577f22963c0355dfc6cdad34c72246.text: El comportamiento del cantante en el restaurante ha armado un gran escándalo.
sense_2f577f22963c0355dfc6cdad34c72246.translation: The behavior of the singer in the restaurant has caused a big scandal.

sense_2e4133feb17e562a460a56ce4e9aef42.text: Se armó una discusión sobre quién iba a tomar la última galleta.
sense_2e4133feb17e562a460a56ce4e9aef42.translation: An argument broke out over who was going to get the last cookie.

sense_2e4133feb17e562a460a56ce4e9aef42.text: Ni te imaginas el lío que se armó cuando despidieron a nuestro jefe.
sense_2e4133feb17e562a460a56ce4e9aef42.translation: You can't even imagine the chaos that went down when our boss was fired.

sense_1aa3ef3d8eb89a8db6153600a7c89d99.text: Don Bernardo habló con mucha autoridad de la economía.
sense_1aa3ef3d8eb89a8db6153600a7c89d99.translation: Don Bernardo spoke very authoritatively about the economy.

sense_1aa3ef3d8eb89a8db6153600a7c89d99.text: Antonio describe con autoridad la situación económica de su país.
sense_1aa3ef3d8eb89a8db6153600a7c89d99.translation: Antonio gives an authoritative account of his country's economic situation.

sense_483c6f47b478f3769e6d74ee51f9cda2.text: Hubo un policía caído durante el tiroteo.
sense_483c6f47b478f3769e6d74ee51f9cda2.translation: A policeman was shot dead during the shooting.

sense_483c6f47b478f3769e6d74ee51f9cda2.text: Javier me habló de su hijo Esteban, caído en el frente de batalla.
sense_483c6f47b478f3769e6d74ee51f9cda2.translation: Javier spoke to me about his son Esteban, who had died on the battlefront.

sense_500aa5474d1b6184019b54fe4f745c09.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_500aa5474d1b6184019b54fe4f745c09.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_bc58a0c3a1409a549c7266ac7f813e4b.text: El rey usa su corona en ocasiones especiales.
sense_bc58a0c3a1409a549c7266ac7f813e4b.translation: The king wears his crown on special occasions.

sense_bc58a0c3a1409a549c7266ac7f813e4b.text: La corona de la reina es de oro sólido y está decorada con docenas de esmeraldas y rubíes.
sense_bc58a0c3a1409a549c7266ac7f813e4b.translation: The queen's crown is made of solid gold and is decorated with dozens of emeralds and rubies.

sense_b8b94993ff28d0ab7d2319980406a01c.text: La corona solar puede verse durante un eclipse solar.
sense_b8b94993ff28d0ab7d2319980406a01c.translation: The solar corona can be seen during a solar eclipse.

sense_b8b94993ff28d0ab7d2319980406a01c.text: Nadie se sabe a ciencia cierta por qué la corona del sol es mucho más caliente que su superficie.
sense_b8b94993ff28d0ab7d2319980406a01c.translation: No one knows for certain why the corona of the sun is much hotter than its surface.

sense_518ba66e42cde3af575983267849d801.text: Disculpa, no te he visto trabajando allí. Me pondré los cascos.
sense_518ba66e42cde3af575983267849d801.translation: I'm sorry, I didn't see you there working. I'll put headphones in.

sense_518ba66e42cde3af575983267849d801.text: Disculpe, por favor. ¿Me dice dónde está la parada del metro?
sense_518ba66e42cde3af575983267849d801.translation: Excuse me, please. Can you tell me where the subway station is?

sense_3bed48ec1ae95407dbcf44f89a21968f.text: ¡El camarero es un borde! No le dejaré propina.
sense_3bed48ec1ae95407dbcf44f89a21968f.translation: The waiter is such a jerk! He's not going to get a tip.

sense_3bed48ec1ae95407dbcf44f89a21968f.text: No invitamos a tu primo a la fiesta porque es un borde.
sense_3bed48ec1ae95407dbcf44f89a21968f.translation: We didn't invite your cousin to the party because he is really annoying.

sense_b193b2af6afedce28dfeab9f7c22d78d.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_b193b2af6afedce28dfeab9f7c22d78d.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_b193b2af6afedce28dfeab9f7c22d78d.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_b193b2af6afedce28dfeab9f7c22d78d.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_d601194c0666a20131bef94caa7348b7.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_d601194c0666a20131bef94caa7348b7.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_d601194c0666a20131bef94caa7348b7.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_d601194c0666a20131bef94caa7348b7.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_2b03ec2ee8142cbec4a650ccee837825.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_2b03ec2ee8142cbec4a650ccee837825.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_737f5ae7f03931b4f06395787832bf7b.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_737f5ae7f03931b4f06395787832bf7b.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_3f6fd73ff40444647cde9b488f0d1786.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_3f6fd73ff40444647cde9b488f0d1786.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_3f6fd73ff40444647cde9b488f0d1786.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_3f6fd73ff40444647cde9b488f0d1786.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_25811e80fc8654fd95fa8da43760deb4.text: Mi tía es catedrática de universidad, tiene mucha cultura y siempre está leyendo algo.
sense_25811e80fc8654fd95fa8da43760deb4.translation: My aunt is a university professor; she is very cultured and is always reading something.

sense_25811e80fc8654fd95fa8da43760deb4.text: Dijo que Confucio fue el que inventó la confusión. - ¡Madre mía, qué poca cultura!
sense_25811e80fc8654fd95fa8da43760deb4.translation: She said Confucius invented confusion. - ¡Oh my God, how ignorant!

sense_43016eceef00f5ffa2173fb75e05aa15.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_43016eceef00f5ffa2173fb75e05aa15.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_3c613c01259ed8ea4c5625217ba859e0.text: Elaine es una persona muy alegre.
sense_3c613c01259ed8ea4c5625217ba859e0.translation: Elaine is a very happy person.

sense_3c613c01259ed8ea4c5625217ba859e0.text: La Navidad es una época del año especialmente alegre y divertida.
sense_3c613c01259ed8ea4c5625217ba859e0.translation: Christmastime is an especially happy and fun time of year.

sense_71a026daef9823a17e8000502992b2e2.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_71a026daef9823a17e8000502992b2e2.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_71a026daef9823a17e8000502992b2e2.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_71a026daef9823a17e8000502992b2e2.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_4eebc822a89be29600c6d875c932374a.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_4eebc822a89be29600c6d875c932374a.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_920bbbebee9aa2d855a234f414bbe4da.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_920bbbebee9aa2d855a234f414bbe4da.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_920bbbebee9aa2d855a234f414bbe4da.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_920bbbebee9aa2d855a234f414bbe4da.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_01b12729b91853a2a8a4f75e2783345e.text: ¿Es tuyo el carro que está bloqueando el mío?
sense_01b12729b91853a2a8a4f75e2783345e.translation: Is that car that's blocking mine yours?

sense_01b12729b91853a2a8a4f75e2783345e.text: ¿Esta pulsera es tuya? La encontré en el piso.
sense_01b12729b91853a2a8a4f75e2783345e.translation: Is this bracelet yours? I found it on the floor.

sense_33a7f034462249704ea2716b1af13c57.text: Esta copa de vino es mía. La tuya está en la mesa.
sense_33a7f034462249704ea2716b1af13c57.translation: This glass of wine is mine. Yours is on the table.

sense_e948ba8ba91a6c01cdf2b81a75e844eb.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_e948ba8ba91a6c01cdf2b81a75e844eb.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_c214ec4c03c276ceb7cc891c937935ab.text: Desde muy chiquita le he tenido pavor a los payasos.
sense_c214ec4c03c276ceb7cc891c937935ab.translation: I've been terrified of clowns since I was a little girl.

sense_c214ec4c03c276ceb7cc891c937935ab.text: Los niños en la fiesta se rieron al ver el payaso.
sense_c214ec4c03c276ceb7cc891c937935ab.translation: The children at the party all laughed when they saw the clown.

sense_26cbae5fc974feb643283df6b42dd47c.text: La peli era malísima; solo se salvaba el actor principal.
sense_26cbae5fc974feb643283df6b42dd47c.translation: The film was really bad; the main actor was the only one who was ok.

sense_26cbae5fc974feb643283df6b42dd47c.text: Los considero a todos unos vagos; no se salva nadie.
sense_26cbae5fc974feb643283df6b42dd47c.translation: I consider them all lazy, without exception.

sense_e5307351edc1368aaacf48ee16d0d30c.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_e5307351edc1368aaacf48ee16d0d30c.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_e5307351edc1368aaacf48ee16d0d30c.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_e5307351edc1368aaacf48ee16d0d30c.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_95baab472e1ea20deebe79551bfb43f8.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_95baab472e1ea20deebe79551bfb43f8.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_95baab472e1ea20deebe79551bfb43f8.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_95baab472e1ea20deebe79551bfb43f8.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_1dceced8689402213661f60871741e45.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_8f4dae3fc4ca9232d61d8802d6e91b54.text: El arreglo de la transmisión sale caro.
sense_8f4dae3fc4ca9232d61d8802d6e91b54.translation: Getting the transmission fixed is expensive.

sense_8f4dae3fc4ca9232d61d8802d6e91b54.text: Llevé el pantalón al sastre para que le haga un arreglo.
sense_8f4dae3fc4ca9232d61d8802d6e91b54.translation: I took my pants to the tailor to be mended.

sense_76e34b3665d89183fc0de6ab151e46b5.text: El gobierno se equivocó con esta medida.
sense_76e34b3665d89183fc0de6ab151e46b5.translation: The government got it wrong with this policy.

sense_76e34b3665d89183fc0de6ab151e46b5.text: La empresa reconoce que se equivocó con su respuesta.
sense_76e34b3665d89183fc0de6ab151e46b5.translation: The company recognizes that it got its response wrong.

sense_c9a80ab8123f69a23540f1e577b73097.text: Mi madre se equivocó de tren y, por consiguiente, no llegó aquí hasta la una de la madrugada.
sense_c9a80ab8123f69a23540f1e577b73097.translation: My mother got on the wrong train and, as a result, she didn't get here till one in the morning.

sense_c9a80ab8123f69a23540f1e577b73097.text: Te equivocaste de mes. El cumpleaños de Fernando es el dos de julio y no el dos de junio.
sense_c9a80ab8123f69a23540f1e577b73097.translation: You got the month wrong. Fernando's birthday is the second of July not the second of June.

sense_e86908355078f99afb7e6193b88995b3.text: Los invitados llegaron a las seis y pico.
sense_e86908355078f99afb7e6193b88995b3.translation: The guests got here just after six.

sense_e86908355078f99afb7e6193b88995b3.text: Jorge trabajó en el mismo lugar unos cuarenta y pico de años.
sense_e86908355078f99afb7e6193b88995b3.translation: Jorge worked in the same place for forty odd years.

sense_f0c7be70ea42fbc50f73b8df0afe2d52.text: Las gallinas picaron el pan que les tiré.
sense_f0c7be70ea42fbc50f73b8df0afe2d52.translation: The hens pecked at the bread I threw them.

sense_f0c7be70ea42fbc50f73b8df0afe2d52.text: Los patos picaban peces en el río.
sense_f0c7be70ea42fbc50f73b8df0afe2d52.translation: Ducks were pecking at fish in the river.

sense_69996b6262cc9b1609c5ea60edd3f53a.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_69996b6262cc9b1609c5ea60edd3f53a.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_4784eabbc3578eb89e327d33195b2f7b.text: A mi hija le da terror manejar de noche.
sense_4784eabbc3578eb89e327d33195b2f7b.translation: My daughter's terrified of driving at night

sense_4784eabbc3578eb89e327d33195b2f7b.text: Me da terror tener que ir a ver a la directora.
sense_4784eabbc3578eb89e327d33195b2f7b.translation: The thought of going to see the principal terrifies me.

sense_4795dcc1d6fcbc5fe4f0120b5b33e395.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_4795dcc1d6fcbc5fe4f0120b5b33e395.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_4795dcc1d6fcbc5fe4f0120b5b33e395.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_4795dcc1d6fcbc5fe4f0120b5b33e395.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_e57f4ec269fee194280bd83d2eedf948.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_e57f4ec269fee194280bd83d2eedf948.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_9aba9e31034ce36e29fde7ae718976ab.text: Jorge y yo vivíamos en el mismo vecindario cuando éramos niños.
sense_9aba9e31034ce36e29fde7ae718976ab.translation: Jorge and I lived in the same neighborhood when we were kids.

sense_9aba9e31034ce36e29fde7ae718976ab.text: ¿Viste la nueva pizzería que va a abrir en el vecindario?
sense_9aba9e31034ce36e29fde7ae718976ab.translation: Did you see the new pizzeria that's opening in the neighborhood?

sense_dd31fd8d411221c8f51a2e1afee2b1b8.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_dd31fd8d411221c8f51a2e1afee2b1b8.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_86dd347955832d889dfdd74004c3eeba.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_86dd347955832d889dfdd74004c3eeba.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_86dd347955832d889dfdd74004c3eeba.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_86dd347955832d889dfdd74004c3eeba.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_ac0d5c2cc78748019d2c92b94fa8a44e.text: No le tire patadas a su hermano.
Su perro me tiró un mordisco.

sense_a455f9bb5edf33b5b8fba11aa8bbcc3e.text: Las fiestas ya no me tiran.
sense_a455f9bb5edf33b5b8fba11aa8bbcc3e.translation: Parties don't appeal to me anymore.
He is not interested in studying medicine.

sense_462a07c5def97d0838e6c3632e8d8f65.text: El plato tiraba a dulce más que nada.
sense_462a07c5def97d0838e6c3632e8d8f65.translation: The dish was more sweet than anything else.

sense_462a07c5def97d0838e6c3632e8d8f65.text: Tienes que beberte el té cuando esté tirando a frío.
sense_462a07c5def97d0838e6c3632e8d8f65.translation: You have to drink the tea when it is cooling down.

sense_3bd0e45c23a4b868135d3bbf731ea1bf.text: El bebé se tiró un eructo tras tomarse su biberón.
sense_3bd0e45c23a4b868135d3bbf731ea1bf.translation: The baby burped after having his bottle.

sense_3bd0e45c23a4b868135d3bbf731ea1bf.text: La primera vez que se tiró un pedo delante de su novio se avergonzó.
sense_3bd0e45c23a4b868135d3bbf731ea1bf.translation: The first time she farted in front of her boyfriend, she was embarrassed.

sense_b39ffa5c8c4fd8646fbc1ad62fe3e3a7.text: Mi hermana me encargó sus hijos este sábado.
sense_b39ffa5c8c4fd8646fbc1ad62fe3e3a7.translation: My sister's asked me to look after her kids on Saturday.

sense_b39ffa5c8c4fd8646fbc1ad62fe3e3a7.text: Le encargaron conseguir un restaurante para la fiesta a Marco.
sense_b39ffa5c8c4fd8646fbc1ad62fe3e3a7.translation: Marco was given the job of finding a restaurant for the party.

sense_6e762ca33c4988427461a3850b82e6c2.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_6e762ca33c4988427461a3850b82e6c2.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_0db5787774ff3124a33b1a4b90850c82.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_0db5787774ff3124a33b1a4b90850c82.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_be1d3d26c9b203694dad25962b53013c.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_be1d3d26c9b203694dad25962b53013c.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_be1d3d26c9b203694dad25962b53013c.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_be1d3d26c9b203694dad25962b53013c.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_732194c5d430b3598d042e8271c477b9.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_732194c5d430b3598d042e8271c477b9.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_732194c5d430b3598d042e8271c477b9.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_732194c5d430b3598d042e8271c477b9.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_cdac2caced19acd7d3a01d4b1d5a2d05.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_cdac2caced19acd7d3a01d4b1d5a2d05.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_61c02cb7295e9aff1a2c9057c29068aa.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_61c02cb7295e9aff1a2c9057c29068aa.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_61c02cb7295e9aff1a2c9057c29068aa.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_61c02cb7295e9aff1a2c9057c29068aa.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_f871d9f3e9b0b485a75e63cde4cd0491.text: Me ofrecieron su ayuda para el traslado.
sense_f871d9f3e9b0b485a75e63cde4cd0491.translation: They offered to help me with the move.

sense_f871d9f3e9b0b485a75e63cde4cd0491.text: Tengo confianza que me ofrecerán el trabajo.
sense_f871d9f3e9b0b485a75e63cde4cd0491.translation: I'm confident they'll offer me the job.

sense_79aaf7a71c3efe18855b2c713cef82d8.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_79aaf7a71c3efe18855b2c713cef82d8.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_79aaf7a71c3efe18855b2c713cef82d8.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_79aaf7a71c3efe18855b2c713cef82d8.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_76d1916a49cb38fdcf8fa8c1a049fb00.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_76d1916a49cb38fdcf8fa8c1a049fb00.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_6e0871f9b428920ad6ec18a24d2e95b0.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_6e0871f9b428920ad6ec18a24d2e95b0.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_6e0871f9b428920ad6ec18a24d2e95b0.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_6e0871f9b428920ad6ec18a24d2e95b0.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_c2f310255c8fc1bf3ca1f0e9bcbc4717.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_c2f310255c8fc1bf3ca1f0e9bcbc4717.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_21cde4761ce06059ac0d535ce2a67eb7.text: Voy a enviar cien tarjetas de Navidad.
sense_21cde4761ce06059ac0d535ce2a67eb7.translation: I am going to send out a hundred Christmas cards.

sense_21cde4761ce06059ac0d535ce2a67eb7.text: ¿Puedo pagar con mi tarjeta de débito?
sense_21cde4761ce06059ac0d535ce2a67eb7.translation: Can I pay with my debit card?

sense_c958ca175cfc1f7697f103667eaeecf6.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_c958ca175cfc1f7697f103667eaeecf6.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_c958ca175cfc1f7697f103667eaeecf6.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_c958ca175cfc1f7697f103667eaeecf6.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_8c81a01b8613a7720afa66d4f038a6cf.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_8c81a01b8613a7720afa66d4f038a6cf.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_8c81a01b8613a7720afa66d4f038a6cf.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_8c81a01b8613a7720afa66d4f038a6cf.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_768755043706d55cb534a540c8f78b9b.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_768755043706d55cb534a540c8f78b9b.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_768755043706d55cb534a540c8f78b9b.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_768755043706d55cb534a540c8f78b9b.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_1b8f2802fa3c1098c921443198f160c0.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_1b8f2802fa3c1098c921443198f160c0.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_1b8f2802fa3c1098c921443198f160c0.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_1b8f2802fa3c1098c921443198f160c0.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_dbb8c5c0d6834b8a479de2b1632114a0.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_dbb8c5c0d6834b8a479de2b1632114a0.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_dbb8c5c0d6834b8a479de2b1632114a0.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_dbb8c5c0d6834b8a479de2b1632114a0.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_990513681230269495e51273d79013c3.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_990513681230269495e51273d79013c3.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_990513681230269495e51273d79013c3.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_990513681230269495e51273d79013c3.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_b67e58d3e99594f6c5db0af2ed5fc374.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_b67e58d3e99594f6c5db0af2ed5fc374.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_b67e58d3e99594f6c5db0af2ed5fc374.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_b67e58d3e99594f6c5db0af2ed5fc374.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_0ac0124444ccab8f618012bc5e6cd49a.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_0ac0124444ccab8f618012bc5e6cd49a.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_0ac0124444ccab8f618012bc5e6cd49a.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_0ac0124444ccab8f618012bc5e6cd49a.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_f8fb9dcfe1ed09aaacd8f1f1da32551f.text: Sueño con tener una casa grande y mucho dinero.
sense_f8fb9dcfe1ed09aaacd8f1f1da32551f.translation: I dream of having a big house and lots of money.

sense_f8fb9dcfe1ed09aaacd8f1f1da32551f.text: Ella soñó con el actor famoso.
sense_f8fb9dcfe1ed09aaacd8f1f1da32551f.translation: She dreamed about the famous actor.

sense_71a091c6625abeebabdf656f72e492c6.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_71a091c6625abeebabdf656f72e492c6.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_bf43efbb8cb306ebc57c74a95440d7a6.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_bf43efbb8cb306ebc57c74a95440d7a6.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_872e2e5fb620c6c7da72f3bed26a1f8a.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_872e2e5fb620c6c7da72f3bed26a1f8a.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_fcdae973f42b673db5cd908dfb0fdc27.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_fcdae973f42b673db5cd908dfb0fdc27.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_fcdae973f42b673db5cd908dfb0fdc27.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_fcdae973f42b673db5cd908dfb0fdc27.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_380ebc2c8531992c175ea14ad5dd6969.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_380ebc2c8531992c175ea14ad5dd6969.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_380ebc2c8531992c175ea14ad5dd6969.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_380ebc2c8531992c175ea14ad5dd6969.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_f1cd9731a004af2614c71d147d5ba3ff.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_f1cd9731a004af2614c71d147d5ba3ff.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_2248abe6b5831bea40a8b5a16802daf7.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_2248abe6b5831bea40a8b5a16802daf7.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_2248abe6b5831bea40a8b5a16802daf7.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_2248abe6b5831bea40a8b5a16802daf7.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_b1b639a12691dde43571f64610c2d2e8.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_b1b639a12691dde43571f64610c2d2e8.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_b1b639a12691dde43571f64610c2d2e8.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_b1b639a12691dde43571f64610c2d2e8.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_81413fc6f43a189abd48d7283a1a1352.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_81413fc6f43a189abd48d7283a1a1352.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_81413fc6f43a189abd48d7283a1a1352.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_81413fc6f43a189abd48d7283a1a1352.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_f8b3e022aa6908ec48d2bedbcb5d7db1.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_f8b3e022aa6908ec48d2bedbcb5d7db1.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_f8b3e022aa6908ec48d2bedbcb5d7db1.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_f8b3e022aa6908ec48d2bedbcb5d7db1.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_3e1573cb56fb875a0a8a71f7154006b6.text: Un día en la playa me suena perfecto.
sense_3e1573cb56fb875a0a8a71f7154006b6.translation: A day on the beach sounds perfect.

sense_903ac49fa6782f1b07ed1dff93a075b1.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_903ac49fa6782f1b07ed1dff93a075b1.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_903ac49fa6782f1b07ed1dff93a075b1.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_903ac49fa6782f1b07ed1dff93a075b1.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_0eb2883ef20d95496958085db2c23a90.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_0eb2883ef20d95496958085db2c23a90.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_0eb2883ef20d95496958085db2c23a90.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_0eb2883ef20d95496958085db2c23a90.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_383522807cfb3da0636ac17083af1c69.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_383522807cfb3da0636ac17083af1c69.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_383522807cfb3da0636ac17083af1c69.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_383522807cfb3da0636ac17083af1c69.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_9b67df9d8b9ea3d4bddacbf41cb169a2.text: No me parece sano desayunar pizza sobrante todos los días.
sense_9b67df9d8b9ea3d4bddacbf41cb169a2.translation: I don't think it's healthy to eat leftover pizza for breakfast every day.
We live a very healthy life.

sense_06eb89a05b11a69d06f40215a6e31d2b.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_06eb89a05b11a69d06f40215a6e31d2b.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_e461847b780632c8878741fed9a04f8b.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_e461847b780632c8878741fed9a04f8b.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_03575a715b29fc719bc4e074b695257b.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_03575a715b29fc719bc4e074b695257b.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_03575a715b29fc719bc4e074b695257b.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_03575a715b29fc719bc4e074b695257b.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_feb7c0aa617ce568b00adb4771970d39.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_feb7c0aa617ce568b00adb4771970d39.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_feb7c0aa617ce568b00adb4771970d39.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_feb7c0aa617ce568b00adb4771970d39.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_0b7b77c5e699c0c454f88d3a8de366f1.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_0b7b77c5e699c0c454f88d3a8de366f1.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_f2a4f460b2fa72bcff750dc3f20be86d.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_f2a4f460b2fa72bcff750dc3f20be86d.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_950ee240139d7122a1d04c14fcf4213b.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_950ee240139d7122a1d04c14fcf4213b.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_edd9c84bc83cb590d75ea5cc18607561.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_edd9c84bc83cb590d75ea5cc18607561.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_edd9c84bc83cb590d75ea5cc18607561.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_edd9c84bc83cb590d75ea5cc18607561.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_fa788fa9b983633ac5bade52221ef1dc.text: Hay que comprar una sartén nueva porque esta ya no sirve.
sense_fa788fa9b983633ac5bade52221ef1dc.translation: We need to buy a new frying pan because this one is no good any more.
Is this one any good to you?

sense_1e186d112595bad39e0a6e42080032e2.text: No puede comer pastel porque sufre de diabetes.
sense_1e186d112595bad39e0a6e42080032e2.translation: He can't eat cake because he suffers from diabetes.

sense_1e186d112595bad39e0a6e42080032e2.text: Mejor corta comunicación con él, no quieres que sufra más.
sense_1e186d112595bad39e0a6e42080032e2.translation: You'd better cut off communication with him, you don't want him to suffer anymore.

sense_861afcf9f1617b60068a707c7742fc51.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_861afcf9f1617b60068a707c7742fc51.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_c35f253f45c77fd56d663fad60442033.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_c35f253f45c77fd56d663fad60442033.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_c35f253f45c77fd56d663fad60442033.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_c35f253f45c77fd56d663fad60442033.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.
