sense_eaf55ff760b10557eced03eb74cc2c68.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_eaf55ff760b10557eced03eb74cc2c68.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_b77b549eb1d48716c650c6778bc6c25e.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_b77b549eb1d48716c650c6778bc6c25e.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_74e8cb8636922ddfe41632a1a0bb384f.text: Me ofrecieron su ayuda para el traslado.
sense_74e8cb8636922ddfe41632a1a0bb384f.translation: They offered to help me with the move.

sense_74e8cb8636922ddfe41632a1a0bb384f.text: Tengo confianza que me ofrecerán el trabajo.
sense_74e8cb8636922ddfe41632a1a0bb384f.translation: I'm confident they'll offer me the job.

sense_3f80bd141464b7296f5825f4a1a8f37e.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_3f80bd141464b7296f5825f4a1a8f37e.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_8136f6f4c0553a24d751343b6bd7d9ad.text: La tienda está abierta por si quieres ir a comprar leche.
sense_8136f6f4c0553a24d751343b6bd7d9ad.translation: The store is open in case you want to go buy milk.

sense_ce1e6d473f45884132d6180d9a3d076f.text: Te apuesto que no lloverá el día de tu boda; no te preocupes.
sense_ce1e6d473f45884132d6180d9a3d076f.translation: I bet you that it won't rain on your wedding day; don't worry.

sense_ce1e6d473f45884132d6180d9a3d076f.text: Te apuesto $15 a que no eres capaz de encestar la pelota diez veces seguidas.
sense_ce1e6d473f45884132d6180d9a3d076f.translation: I'll bet you $15 that you can't sink the ball ten times in a row.

sense_f4f92414b360bb84090cfa857bd4eb51.text: Mi hermana me encargó sus hijos este sábado.
sense_f4f92414b360bb84090cfa857bd4eb51.translation: My sister's asked me to look after her kids on Saturday.

sense_f4f92414b360bb84090cfa857bd4eb51.text: Le encargaron conseguir un restaurante para la fiesta a Marco.
sense_f4f92414b360bb84090cfa857bd4eb51.translation: Marco was given the job of finding a restaurant for the party.

sense_80508dd9a3ff976b1b42140170191b76.text: Hoy en día fumar está mal considerado.
Es un cirujano muy bien considerado.
sense_80508dd9a3ff976b1b42140170191b76.translation: He's a very well respected surgeon.

sense_9ecf01bdee4f731d0614ce47490e93cb.text: Es importante que siempre consideres los sentimientos de los demás.
sense_9ecf01bdee4f731d0614ce47490e93cb.translation: It's important that you always consider other people's feelings.

sense_9ecf01bdee4f731d0614ce47490e93cb.text: Siempre hay que considerar a las personas mayores en el autobús y cederles el asiento.
sense_9ecf01bdee4f731d0614ce47490e93cb.translation: You should always show consideration for older people on the bus and give up your seat for them.

sense_02723c97143a46ecf8973cabdb5817ee.text: Hubo demasiadas bajas y tuvieron que cancelar la clase ese semestre.
sense_02723c97143a46ecf8973cabdb5817ee.translation: So many students dropped the class that they had to cancel it for that semester.

sense_02723c97143a46ecf8973cabdb5817ee.text: La empresa ha tenido muchas bajas por las condiciones de trabajo peligrosas.
sense_02723c97143a46ecf8973cabdb5817ee.translation: The company has had a lot of people leave because of dangerous working conditions.

sense_5b89904b9acb7f691d5e3e86dd563a10.text: China es el país más poblado del mundo.
sense_5b89904b9acb7f691d5e3e86dd563a10.translation: China is the world's most populous country.

sense_5b89904b9acb7f691d5e3e86dd563a10.text: Se está invirtiendo mucho dinero en países en vías de desarrollo.
sense_5b89904b9acb7f691d5e3e86dd563a10.translation: A lot of money is being invested in developing countries.

sense_9f8543bf5fb566a0cb6b88d501f56111.text: Me carga que siempre la escojan a ella.
sense_9f8543bf5fb566a0cb6b88d501f56111.translation: It gets on my nerves that they always choose her.

sense_9f8543bf5fb566a0cb6b88d501f56111.text: Me carga tener que aguantar la novia de mi hermano.
sense_9f8543bf5fb566a0cb6b88d501f56111.translation: I can't stand having to put up with my brother's girlfriend.

sense_6d0649b4c1c05a2282effdd0a411be89.text: Armó un follón cuando compré una marca diferente de cereal.
sense_6d0649b4c1c05a2282effdd0a411be89.translation: She kicked up a real fuss when I bought a different brand of cereal.

sense_6d0649b4c1c05a2282effdd0a411be89.text: El comportamiento del cantante en el restaurante ha armado un gran escándalo.
sense_6d0649b4c1c05a2282effdd0a411be89.translation: The behavior of the singer in the restaurant has caused a big scandal.

sense_1f8dacd220b264a7226c21dcdcced138.text: Se armó una discusión sobre quién iba a tomar la última galleta.
sense_1f8dacd220b264a7226c21dcdcced138.translation: An argument broke out over who was going to get the last cookie.

sense_1f8dacd220b264a7226c21dcdcced138.text: Ni te imaginas el lío que se armó cuando despidieron a nuestro jefe.
sense_1f8dacd220b264a7226c21dcdcced138.translation: You can't even imagine the chaos that went down when our boss was fired.

sense_4d5f886575a08318023dc8e249e3265b.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_4d5f886575a08318023dc8e249e3265b.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_4d5f886575a08318023dc8e249e3265b.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_4d5f886575a08318023dc8e249e3265b.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_144c9576e4b1225d9b0b0312a8ef6a95.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_144c9576e4b1225d9b0b0312a8ef6a95.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_144c9576e4b1225d9b0b0312a8ef6a95.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_144c9576e4b1225d9b0b0312a8ef6a95.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_5c726dfa5a8f30bf3eb629423da7e533.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_5c726dfa5a8f30bf3eb629423da7e533.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_5c726dfa5a8f30bf3eb629423da7e533.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_5c726dfa5a8f30bf3eb629423da7e533.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_b8299feb6448bed77feffb7763d384bd.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_b8299feb6448bed77feffb7763d384bd.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_b8299feb6448bed77feffb7763d384bd.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_b8299feb6448bed77feffb7763d384bd.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_61f4706219f30751cf20b056ac07f916.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_61f4706219f30751cf20b056ac07f916.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_61f4706219f30751cf20b056ac07f916.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_61f4706219f30751cf20b056ac07f916.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_cbb69a4f97048b0979e1f781cad9c138.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_cbb69a4f97048b0979e1f781cad9c138.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_75d8de1555e7a713335dbf60d65ac05c.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_75d8de1555e7a713335dbf60d65ac05c.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_dafbf05349f4668650bd1be30b922fba.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_dafbf05349f4668650bd1be30b922fba.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_dafbf05349f4668650bd1be30b922fba.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_dafbf05349f4668650bd1be30b922fba.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_6e14bdb1ad52b3444f71b9949eefb877.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_6e14bdb1ad52b3444f71b9949eefb877.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_6e14bdb1ad52b3444f71b9949eefb877.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_6e14bdb1ad52b3444f71b9949eefb877.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_ee20c3897d5354115eebde3c69d423db.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_ee20c3897d5354115eebde3c69d423db.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_5a1820b4776b55a7913676c6cc82b465.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_5a1820b4776b55a7913676c6cc82b465.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_5a1820b4776b55a7913676c6cc82b465.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_5a1820b4776b55a7913676c6cc82b465.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_ddac108556eeeb4f552c9b395a44c678.text: Jorge cumplió su sueño de convertirse en médico.
sense_ddac108556eeeb4f552c9b395a44c678.translation: Jorge achieved his dream of becoming a doctor.

sense_ddac108556eeeb4f552c9b395a44c678.text: Hay que tener fuerza de voluntad para cumplir tus metas.
sense_ddac108556eeeb4f552c9b395a44c678.translation: You need willpower to achieve your goals.

sense_f2e574146e933b7da517e8a3d13788f4.text: Hay algunas medidas que podemos tomar en lo que se refiere al presupuesto.
sense_f2e574146e933b7da517e8a3d13788f4.translation: There are some measures we can take with regards to the budget.

sense_f2e574146e933b7da517e8a3d13788f4.text: En lo que se refiere a los empleados nuevamente contratados, tenemos que estar de acuerdo en cuanto a la capacitación.
sense_f2e574146e933b7da517e8a3d13788f4.translation: As far as new hires are concerned, we have to all be on the same page with regard to training.

sense_6513f59cf76d772ee06bac8e6ff7991d.text: El día de San José es tradición dejar flores en la gruta.
sense_6513f59cf76d772ee06bac8e6ff7991d.translation: It's traditional to leave flowers at the grotto on St. Joseph's Day.

sense_6513f59cf76d772ee06bac8e6ff7991d.text: Por tradición, en España se comen doce uvas a medianoche el 31 de diciembre.
sense_6513f59cf76d772ee06bac8e6ff7991d.translation: It's customary to eat twelve grapes at midnight on 31 December in Spain.

sense_a70dda1c3bb3a0918985590ff37b0322.text: Necesitas una herramienta nueva para arreglar el estante.
sense_a70dda1c3bb3a0918985590ff37b0322.translation: You need a new tool to fix the shelf.

sense_a70dda1c3bb3a0918985590ff37b0322.text: Tiene hasta un taladro entre sus herramientas.
sense_a70dda1c3bb3a0918985590ff37b0322.translation: She even has a drill in her set of tools.

sense_afd561a4496b18928fde965613dc1dea.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_0ae9b08ac2d1a0853441a16d0cd934fe.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_0ae9b08ac2d1a0853441a16d0cd934fe.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_0ae9b08ac2d1a0853441a16d0cd934fe.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_0ae9b08ac2d1a0853441a16d0cd934fe.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_8b9af5f8815e93cc5f39740aa1f3077b.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_8b9af5f8815e93cc5f39740aa1f3077b.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_8b9af5f8815e93cc5f39740aa1f3077b.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_8b9af5f8815e93cc5f39740aa1f3077b.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_3c86cf8316011dc8085aad1a6352fbc7.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_3c86cf8316011dc8085aad1a6352fbc7.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_999d4600d3ff92d47bf56e5afa7a0690.text: Necesitas un pastor para las ovejas.
sense_999d4600d3ff92d47bf56e5afa7a0690.translation: You need a shepherd for your sheep.

sense_999d4600d3ff92d47bf56e5afa7a0690.text: El trabajo más importante de un pastor es proteger su rebaño.
sense_999d4600d3ff92d47bf56e5afa7a0690.translation: The most important job of a shepherd is to guard his flock.

sense_324abf6d3cdbcef2ea5bffb33723a785.text: Estas viviendas, de construcción tradicional, son muy populares.
sense_324abf6d3cdbcef2ea5bffb33723a785.translation: These traditionally built houses are very popular.

sense_324abf6d3cdbcef2ea5bffb33723a785.text: Se trata de una atractiva casa de construcción en ladrillo.

sense_07139a870b9be5e1781d0f24e0a07a34.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_07139a870b9be5e1781d0f24e0a07a34.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_07139a870b9be5e1781d0f24e0a07a34.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_07139a870b9be5e1781d0f24e0a07a34.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_df127a1292990c8b37fea2da3694d335.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_df127a1292990c8b37fea2da3694d335.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_b4dd45e05abbcd0c695053d7a7e7cb87.text: Encontré cinco monedas entre los cojines del sofá.
sense_b4dd45e05abbcd0c695053d7a7e7cb87.translation: I found five coins among the cushions on the couch.

sense_b4dd45e05abbcd0c695053d7a7e7cb87.text: Necesito monedas para la máquina expendedora.
sense_b4dd45e05abbcd0c695053d7a7e7cb87.translation: I need coins for the vending machine.

sense_f4d467c5a17b584b5710e3611dc285e7.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_f4d467c5a17b584b5710e3611dc285e7.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_f4d467c5a17b584b5710e3611dc285e7.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_f4d467c5a17b584b5710e3611dc285e7.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_eb90c5b9aee261440f8d7f92508418fa.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_eb90c5b9aee261440f8d7f92508418fa.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_eb90c5b9aee261440f8d7f92508418fa.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_eb90c5b9aee261440f8d7f92508418fa.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_862f7cf62a3592892a5f8414fea7cba7.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_862f7cf62a3592892a5f8414fea7cba7.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_862f7cf62a3592892a5f8414fea7cba7.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_862f7cf62a3592892a5f8414fea7cba7.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_c20ff51380ba7463352ab1ecd25f6571.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_c20ff51380ba7463352ab1ecd25f6571.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_0471980c238d401a57df2dd1114c8293.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_0471980c238d401a57df2dd1114c8293.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_bee59098b5a74e821a8bb1624c002310.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_bee59098b5a74e821a8bb1624c002310.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_bee59098b5a74e821a8bb1624c002310.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_bee59098b5a74e821a8bb1624c002310.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_07949fdef674b16fad570b13173e5a65.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_07949fdef674b16fad570b13173e5a65.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_07949fdef674b16fad570b13173e5a65.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_07949fdef674b16fad570b13173e5a65.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_dd2ae4f6ac244149d521c0ec6225ed39.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_dd2ae4f6ac244149d521c0ec6225ed39.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_7555d2c27ffd07e7e77568be74646d50.text: Me encantó el libro pero el final no me convenció.
sense_7555d2c27ffd07e7e77568be74646d50.translation: I loved the book, but the ending wasn't very good.

sense_7555d2c27ffd07e7e77568be74646d50.text: Decidieron eliminar los camarones del menú porque no parecía convencer a los clientes.
sense_7555d2c27ffd07e7e77568be74646d50.translation: They decided to remove shrimp from the menu because customers didn't seem to like them.

sense_a30c5cee82a2d7802a4b17a38d13e5f5.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_a30c5cee82a2d7802a4b17a38d13e5f5.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_a30c5cee82a2d7802a4b17a38d13e5f5.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_a30c5cee82a2d7802a4b17a38d13e5f5.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_9a1bd3e94710565f5bb040f5d5c252e9.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_9a1bd3e94710565f5bb040f5d5c252e9.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_9a1bd3e94710565f5bb040f5d5c252e9.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_9a1bd3e94710565f5bb040f5d5c252e9.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_5819924fd4d071b965843a0b7e794b08.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_5819924fd4d071b965843a0b7e794b08.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_5819924fd4d071b965843a0b7e794b08.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_5819924fd4d071b965843a0b7e794b08.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_11536845bad0746d0ed23bbf500ef782.text: Mi perro es mi amigo más fiel.
sense_11536845bad0746d0ed23bbf500ef782.translation: My dog is my most faithful friend.

sense_11536845bad0746d0ed23bbf500ef782.text: Su novia y él han sido fieles durante toda la relación.
sense_11536845bad0746d0ed23bbf500ef782.translation: He and his girlfriend have remained faithful to each other throughout the relationship.

sense_0624418898991b98b0d34ff193d2dc4a.text: La chica estaba vendiendo naranjas en el mercado.
sense_0624418898991b98b0d34ff193d2dc4a.translation: The girl was selling oranges in the market.

sense_9d30f51e3473eebe21a275d3df796c0c.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_9d30f51e3473eebe21a275d3df796c0c.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_9d30f51e3473eebe21a275d3df796c0c.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_9d30f51e3473eebe21a275d3df796c0c.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_f7a1db84d65e675aa89555e9fced7880.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_f7a1db84d65e675aa89555e9fced7880.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_f7a1db84d65e675aa89555e9fced7880.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_f7a1db84d65e675aa89555e9fced7880.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_ba7e96266a6065305462db19d6d33697.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_ba7e96266a6065305462db19d6d33697.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_ba7e96266a6065305462db19d6d33697.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_ba7e96266a6065305462db19d6d33697.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_f357f85ff269d367d32eada150f0c772.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_f357f85ff269d367d32eada150f0c772.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_f357f85ff269d367d32eada150f0c772.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_f357f85ff269d367d32eada150f0c772.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_347db2d5ba35a0f86001e91b37ad8100.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_347db2d5ba35a0f86001e91b37ad8100.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_347db2d5ba35a0f86001e91b37ad8100.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_347db2d5ba35a0f86001e91b37ad8100.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_9b2dcba7ede5817b4526ffb0d826d6d6.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_9b2dcba7ede5817b4526ffb0d826d6d6.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_8de028761668ebacd68b564018b0c563.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_8de028761668ebacd68b564018b0c563.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_8de028761668ebacd68b564018b0c563.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_8de028761668ebacd68b564018b0c563.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_1ecc23b12e096aea7b9d8b7f9f25c9de.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_1ecc23b12e096aea7b9d8b7f9f25c9de.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_1ecc23b12e096aea7b9d8b7f9f25c9de.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_1ecc23b12e096aea7b9d8b7f9f25c9de.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_62d39be8980d3e69535c5e3b94cb35ca.text: Las piezas se calientan y se sueldan.
sense_62d39be8980d3e69535c5e3b94cb35ca.translation: The parts are heated up and welded together.

sense_62d39be8980d3e69535c5e3b94cb35ca.text: Los circuitos se sueldan con estaño.
sense_62d39be8980d3e69535c5e3b94cb35ca.translation: The circuits are soldered together with solder.

sense_d1bfd4d7465b8485a39ec6503b1c298d.text: Me gusta tomar jugo de naranja en el desayuno.
sense_d1bfd4d7465b8485a39ec6503b1c298d.translation: I like orange juice with my breakfast.

sense_d1bfd4d7465b8485a39ec6503b1c298d.text: No ases el bistec demasiado o se secarán todos los jugos.
sense_d1bfd4d7465b8485a39ec6503b1c298d.translation: Don’t grill the steak too long or the juices will all dry up.

sense_0aa7976a84a58eacad20a27dea5931fb.translation: Put your money away. It's my treat.
Have a drink. It's on us.

sense_175d40beadee9486af4b0843f94b4433.text: Antes de conseguir este trabajo, yo dependía de la caridad de extraños.
sense_175d40beadee9486af4b0843f94b4433.translation: Before I got this job, I depended on the charity of strangers.

sense_175d40beadee9486af4b0843f94b4433.text: Dependemos de la caridad de nuestros miembros para mantener el programa a flote.
sense_175d40beadee9486af4b0843f94b4433.translation: We depend on our members' charity to keep the program afloat.

sense_600fe05f907de7b3ea61d848e759bd4b.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_600fe05f907de7b3ea61d848e759bd4b.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_600fe05f907de7b3ea61d848e759bd4b.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_600fe05f907de7b3ea61d848e759bd4b.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_d90c22d8564f962af527a23f14df1e03.text: Es importante que siempre consideres los sentimientos de los demás.
sense_d90c22d8564f962af527a23f14df1e03.translation: It's important that you always consider other people's feelings.

sense_d90c22d8564f962af527a23f14df1e03.text: Siempre hay que considerar a las personas mayores en el autobús y cederles el asiento.
sense_d90c22d8564f962af527a23f14df1e03.translation: You should always show consideration for older people on the bus and give up your seat for them.

sense_fd98ad07162e9b5432ed454351f94705.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_fd98ad07162e9b5432ed454351f94705.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_fd98ad07162e9b5432ed454351f94705.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_fd98ad07162e9b5432ed454351f94705.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_d94d1a785ab31e2e1bc52b95c227f569.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_d94d1a785ab31e2e1bc52b95c227f569.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_ab80667daa9464da142c326665d66356.text: La disciplina y el honor informan su naturaleza como soldado.
sense_ab80667daa9464da142c326665d66356.translation: He is a soldier who believes in discipline and honor.
Her silhouette hints at her beauty.

sense_bab87d95df5917025b25cb0d7b6750be.text: Es importante que siempre consideres los sentimientos de los demás.
sense_bab87d95df5917025b25cb0d7b6750be.translation: It's important that you always consider other people's feelings.

sense_bab87d95df5917025b25cb0d7b6750be.text: Siempre hay que considerar a las personas mayores en el autobús y cederles el asiento.
sense_bab87d95df5917025b25cb0d7b6750be.translation: You should always show consideration for older people on the bus and give up your seat for them.

sense_81a961d960c4df014d08450a8426ffa5.text: ¡No sabía que Marion y tú se iban a casar! ¡Enhorabuena!
sense_81a961d960c4df014d08450a8426ffa5.translation: I didn't know you and Marion were getting married! Congratulations!

sense_5d0f04980cb199add9141a641f7f8dd3.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_5d0f04980cb199add9141a641f7f8dd3.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_5d0f04980cb199add9141a641f7f8dd3.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_5d0f04980cb199add9141a641f7f8dd3.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_60c3ce23dbb1fe7f5d46f268e7613bcf.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_60c3ce23dbb1fe7f5d46f268e7613bcf.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_60c3ce23dbb1fe7f5d46f268e7613bcf.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_60c3ce23dbb1fe7f5d46f268e7613bcf.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_7f1729128f30d2fff7bc0794742e7071.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_7f1729128f30d2fff7bc0794742e7071.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_61d1647a854e0f6dae3056a56a4e9240.text: Tuvimos que salir escapados porque perdíamos el avión.
sense_61d1647a854e0f6dae3056a56a4e9240.translation: We had to rush off because we were going to miss the plane.

sense_61d1647a854e0f6dae3056a56a4e9240.text: Quiero ver la exposición con tranquilidad, en lugar de hacerlo escapado. - Vayamos el domingo entonces.
sense_61d1647a854e0f6dae3056a56a4e9240.translation: I want to see the exhibition at my leisure, instead of rushing through it. - Let's go on Sunday then.

sense_c3eecf69fd6f84c064326133863c066e.text: Espero que el proyecto progrese considerablemente este año.
sense_c3eecf69fd6f84c064326133863c066e.translation: I hope the project progresses significantly this year.

sense_c3eecf69fd6f84c064326133863c066e.text: A veces me sorprendo pensando que el mundo no ha progresado mucho desde el tiempo de las cavernas.
sense_c3eecf69fd6f84c064326133863c066e.translation: Sometimes I find myself thinking the world has not progressed much since the time of the cavemen.

sense_1a307962f174705dcb8656cb21b2a4aa.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_1a307962f174705dcb8656cb21b2a4aa.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_1a307962f174705dcb8656cb21b2a4aa.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_1a307962f174705dcb8656cb21b2a4aa.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_8cbd3f38915059a1e473ca9a7e108bc8.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_8cbd3f38915059a1e473ca9a7e108bc8.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_8cbd3f38915059a1e473ca9a7e108bc8.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_8cbd3f38915059a1e473ca9a7e108bc8.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_990b55aac37ad70fd0b9293bb655e739.text: La empresa retiró los autobuses más antiguos.
sense_990b55aac37ad70fd0b9293bb655e739.translation: The company withdrew the oldest buses.

sense_990b55aac37ad70fd0b9293bb655e739.text: Retiraron los billetes falsos de la circulación.
sense_990b55aac37ad70fd0b9293bb655e739.translation: The counterfeit notes were withdrawn from circulation.

sense_0c655085ebe9616d26166b286c34e85a.text: En estos momentos la grúa está retirando el vehículo accidentado de la carretera.
sense_0c655085ebe9616d26166b286c34e85a.translation: Right now the tow truck is removing the damaged vehicle from the roadway.

sense_cbecb3b86ceaa4e1a41a5a7393d74642.text: Mi marido nunca me retiró la confianza.
sense_cbecb3b86ceaa4e1a41a5a7393d74642.translation: My husband never lost confidence in me.

sense_cbecb3b86ceaa4e1a41a5a7393d74642.text: El partido le retiró la confianza al presidente cuando malversó fondos.
sense_cbecb3b86ceaa4e1a41a5a7393d74642.translation: The president lost the party's confidence when he misappropriated funds.

sense_419d316683166ac889aac7ac90747a5c.text: El recepcionista me pidió que no me retirara.
sense_419d316683166ac889aac7ac90747a5c.translation: The receptionist asked me to hold the line.

sense_045049ffc77ee130c9d58b76adc8e213.text: Se lo he insinuado varias veces, pero no capta la onda.
sense_045049ffc77ee130c9d58b76adc8e213.translation: I've hinted at it several times, but he's not getting the message.

sense_045049ffc77ee130c9d58b76adc8e213.text: ¿Me explicas otra vez este teorema, por favor? - No consigo agarrarle la onda.
sense_045049ffc77ee130c9d58b76adc8e213.translation: Can you explain this theorem again, please? - I can't get the hang of it.

sense_68e285e7199225db3792c931bec43499.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_68e285e7199225db3792c931bec43499.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_68e285e7199225db3792c931bec43499.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_68e285e7199225db3792c931bec43499.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_bb246ba1a1379ed1ecfd98a8692aea23.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_bb246ba1a1379ed1ecfd98a8692aea23.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_bb246ba1a1379ed1ecfd98a8692aea23.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_bb246ba1a1379ed1ecfd98a8692aea23.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_dc0276a51c1e7ce57fe61ce49fc50dc2.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_dc0276a51c1e7ce57fe61ce49fc50dc2.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_dc0276a51c1e7ce57fe61ce49fc50dc2.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_dc0276a51c1e7ce57fe61ce49fc50dc2.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_dcb34811e2a88fea38c62214ea2b574d.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_dcb34811e2a88fea38c62214ea2b574d.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_dcb34811e2a88fea38c62214ea2b574d.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_dcb34811e2a88fea38c62214ea2b574d.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_569c46a0804a781527e67e289429c29a.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_569c46a0804a781527e67e289429c29a.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_569c46a0804a781527e67e289429c29a.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_569c46a0804a781527e67e289429c29a.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_cd0f34a61b6ac0fe4d25e9f9d1da7f64.text: Los alpinistas quisieron llegar a la cumbre, pero fracasaron por la tormenta.
sense_cd0f34a61b6ac0fe4d25e9f9d1da7f64.translation: The climbers tried to reach the summit, but they failed due to the storm.

sense_cd0f34a61b6ac0fe4d25e9f9d1da7f64.text: No podemos darnos el lujo de fracasar; el futuro de la humanidad está en juego.
sense_cd0f34a61b6ac0fe4d25e9f9d1da7f64.translation: We cannot afford to fail; the fate of humanity is at stake.

sense_e5345c818600a945f1ff5e865e9157fa.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_e5345c818600a945f1ff5e865e9157fa.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_e5345c818600a945f1ff5e865e9157fa.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_e5345c818600a945f1ff5e865e9157fa.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_698fe8fbd65b143ff87ac2d14f511fa2.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_698fe8fbd65b143ff87ac2d14f511fa2.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_698fe8fbd65b143ff87ac2d14f511fa2.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_698fe8fbd65b143ff87ac2d14f511fa2.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_595530b58228956d28923f13f948c439.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_595530b58228956d28923f13f948c439.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_595530b58228956d28923f13f948c439.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_595530b58228956d28923f13f948c439.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_3869e4ccc23c9ea097d0b6d9640a5887.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_3869e4ccc23c9ea097d0b6d9640a5887.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_b1ee5e550383535bce89d43b09135de7.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_b1ee5e550383535bce89d43b09135de7.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_5c9c23dccc18a4069e9296b35249bfa2.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_5c9c23dccc18a4069e9296b35249bfa2.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_5c9c23dccc18a4069e9296b35249bfa2.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_5c9c23dccc18a4069e9296b35249bfa2.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_86d7db3d83d492287ae34d907e3b74e1.text: El saco de tu papá te hace bolsas.
sense_86d7db3d83d492287ae34d907e3b74e1.translation: Your father's coat looks baggy on you.

sense_86d7db3d83d492287ae34d907e3b74e1.text: Cuando te doblas así, se forman bolsas en tu vestido.
sense_86d7db3d83d492287ae34d907e3b74e1.translation: When you bend down like that, your dress bunches up.

sense_12a2c3db18e34811c0acd6a017f1016c.text: Vamos a un tianguis donde venden artesanías. ¿Nos acompañas?
sense_12a2c3db18e34811c0acd6a017f1016c.translation: We're going to a street market where they sell handicrafts. Do you want to go with us?
Can I go with you to the store?

sense_da5175abe1690416dcfc37f6b7f7e4dc.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_da5175abe1690416dcfc37f6b7f7e4dc.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_da5175abe1690416dcfc37f6b7f7e4dc.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_da5175abe1690416dcfc37f6b7f7e4dc.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_79ab7f5979ee93a50e176957a9950231.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_79ab7f5979ee93a50e176957a9950231.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_79ab7f5979ee93a50e176957a9950231.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_79ab7f5979ee93a50e176957a9950231.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_b500754f4c8d5779a264585b708dae71.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_b500754f4c8d5779a264585b708dae71.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_6026a06e97eb2950f37b8da1138316bb.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_6026a06e97eb2950f37b8da1138316bb.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_6026a06e97eb2950f37b8da1138316bb.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_6026a06e97eb2950f37b8da1138316bb.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_cc0ffd6f804dc6b210aa9392fac8cbf6.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_cc0ffd6f804dc6b210aa9392fac8cbf6.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_cc0ffd6f804dc6b210aa9392fac8cbf6.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_cc0ffd6f804dc6b210aa9392fac8cbf6.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_db50b7e7e3e8fc93a81b4b070a5f559e.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_db50b7e7e3e8fc93a81b4b070a5f559e.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_db50b7e7e3e8fc93a81b4b070a5f559e.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_db50b7e7e3e8fc93a81b4b070a5f559e.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_b14643bb73e8c755ba8c622e440435ad.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_b14643bb73e8c755ba8c622e440435ad.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_b14643bb73e8c755ba8c622e440435ad.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_b14643bb73e8c755ba8c622e440435ad.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_270efcab98128ba602d76837c44e6706.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_270efcab98128ba602d76837c44e6706.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_270efcab98128ba602d76837c44e6706.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_270efcab98128ba602d76837c44e6706.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_e291896a206a5411e224a9691ba4d08e.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_e291896a206a5411e224a9691ba4d08e.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_e291896a206a5411e224a9691ba4d08e.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_e291896a206a5411e224a9691ba4d08e.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_54d9b1dcba897e273beb61b04d37c965.text: Tenemos autorización para instalar el puesto en esta esquina.
sense_54d9b1dcba897e273beb61b04d37c965.translation: We have been authorized to set up our stand on this corner.

sense_54d9b1dcba897e273beb61b04d37c965.text: Si no cuenta con la debida autorización, no podrá ingresar al edificio.
sense_54d9b1dcba897e273beb61b04d37c965.translation: If you have not been duly authorized, you may not enter this building.

sense_678b78eebc878beae9d46a31e16e9f8b.text: La chica estaba vendiendo naranjas en el mercado.
sense_678b78eebc878beae9d46a31e16e9f8b.translation: The girl was selling oranges in the market.

sense_a0da095a985274f87b4bfaef76326ebf.text: Los enterados en cine habrán adivinado ya la respuesta.
sense_a0da095a985274f87b4bfaef76326ebf.translation: People who are well-informed about cinema will have already guessed the answer.

sense_a0da095a985274f87b4bfaef76326ebf.text: Parece que la fiesta solo fue para los enterados.
sense_a0da095a985274f87b4bfaef76326ebf.translation: It looks like the party was just for people in the know.

sense_b374eb775a3426d6b721ca2bb7771167.text: A mi parecer, es un tema que no admite discusión.
sense_b374eb775a3426d6b721ca2bb7771167.translation: In my opinion, there's no arguing on the subject.

sense_b374eb775a3426d6b721ca2bb7771167.text: La fiesta de este año no admite comparación con ninguna otra.
sense_b374eb775a3426d6b721ca2bb7771167.translation: This year's party defies comparison with any other.

sense_3e2a171e50693f962d1ac3e3066efccd.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_3e2a171e50693f962d1ac3e3066efccd.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_3e2a171e50693f962d1ac3e3066efccd.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_3e2a171e50693f962d1ac3e3066efccd.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_113540b545e4be206bbc206bd9468e1b.text: Nunca tuvieron intenciones de ayudarnos. Lo dijeron solo para quedar bien.
sense_113540b545e4be206bbc206bd9468e1b.translation: They never intended to help us. They said it just to make themselves look good.

sense_113540b545e4be206bbc206bd9468e1b.text: Teníamos intenciones de ir al cine, pero acabamos en la disco.
sense_113540b545e4be206bbc206bd9468e1b.translation: We intended to go to the movies, but ended up in the disco.

sense_fd930d83b7140ef27d44743035bc7077.text: Creo que su intención era viajar y trabajar en el extranjero.
sense_fd930d83b7140ef27d44743035bc7077.translation: I think traveling and working abroad were part of her plans.

sense_fd930d83b7140ef27d44743035bc7077.text: Lo siento. No era mi intención faltarle el respeto a tu padre.
sense_fd930d83b7140ef27d44743035bc7077.translation: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to disrespect your father.

sense_46d764b42c1950f906e241e471d9ba0c.text: ¿No preferirías ir de vacaciones al extranjero este año?
sense_46d764b42c1950f906e241e471d9ba0c.translation: Wouldn't you rather vacation abroad this year?

sense_46d764b42c1950f906e241e471d9ba0c.text: Prefiero que se lo digas tú porque a ti te hace más caso.
sense_46d764b42c1950f906e241e471d9ba0c.translation: I'd rather you told him because he listens to you more.

sense_b4f07cbe96c182ec1e7b23d8648b72f6.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_b4f07cbe96c182ec1e7b23d8648b72f6.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_b4f07cbe96c182ec1e7b23d8648b72f6.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_b4f07cbe96c182ec1e7b23d8648b72f6.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_bedb8441e9b263dc31e2d7b6a93e2335.text: La presentación de las noticias correrá a cargo de Juan Olivera.
sense_bedb8441e9b263dc31e2d7b6a93e2335.translation: The news will be presented by Juan Olivera.

sense_bedb8441e9b263dc31e2d7b6a93e2335.text: La presentación del acto estará a cargo de una persona a quien todos conocemos.
sense_bedb8441e9b263dc31e2d7b6a93e2335.translation: The event will be hosted by someone we all know.

sense_fc2c0fecd1b3a62efaee3d41fafee26a.text: El estudiante debe justificar su inasistencia mediante la presentación del certificado médico correspondiente.
sense_fc2c0fecd1b3a62efaee3d41fafee26a.translation: The student must justify his or her inattendance by presenting the relevant medical certificate.

sense_fc2c0fecd1b3a62efaee3d41fafee26a.text: El plazo para la presentación del trabajo se ha ampliado hasta el 9 de mayo.
sense_fc2c0fecd1b3a62efaee3d41fafee26a.translation: The deadline for submitting work has been extended till May 9th.

sense_9803e79eef9f90abef9f0b041d4bb516.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_9803e79eef9f90abef9f0b041d4bb516.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_9803e79eef9f90abef9f0b041d4bb516.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_9803e79eef9f90abef9f0b041d4bb516.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_a4b4b5ad9a993982572f53ed2fb5e1e7.text: Ese cuadro de Van Gogh es hermoso.
sense_a4b4b5ad9a993982572f53ed2fb5e1e7.translation: That Van Gogh painting is beautiful.

sense_a4b4b5ad9a993982572f53ed2fb5e1e7.text: Es hermoso cómo el paisaje se une con el mar al amanecer.
sense_a4b4b5ad9a993982572f53ed2fb5e1e7.translation: It's beautiful how the landscape meets the sea at dawn.

sense_e44902b3b8221fb7302dcb6ef6bd4d1a.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_9a4c8549ab54be690c16d86d66e88095.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_9a4c8549ab54be690c16d86d66e88095.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_9a4c8549ab54be690c16d86d66e88095.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_9a4c8549ab54be690c16d86d66e88095.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_b4f9cd2866cb733853ee0b68afbe1ecb.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_b4f9cd2866cb733853ee0b68afbe1ecb.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_b4f9cd2866cb733853ee0b68afbe1ecb.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_b4f9cd2866cb733853ee0b68afbe1ecb.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_d56373362f9201e1a03696b28c9f5f48.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_d56373362f9201e1a03696b28c9f5f48.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_db351c5b9fafdce98dc78d57d057bf6e.text: Vi una sombra en la ventana y me asusté.
sense_db351c5b9fafdce98dc78d57d057bf6e.translation: I saw a shadow in the window and I got scared.

sense_db351c5b9fafdce98dc78d57d057bf6e.text: No pude verle la cara al ladrón. Solo vi su sombra.
sense_db351c5b9fafdce98dc78d57d057bf6e.translation: I wasn't able to see the thief's face. I only saw his shadow.

sense_a10bb61907d94049d0a01c64867c34bd.text: Pedro estaba pidiendo pon a la estación del tren.
sense_a10bb61907d94049d0a01c64867c34bd.translation: Peter was asking for a ride to the train station.

sense_a10bb61907d94049d0a01c64867c34bd.text: ¿Me das pon a casa? Se me dañó el carro y me quedé a pie.
sense_a10bb61907d94049d0a01c64867c34bd.translation: Can you give me a ride home? My car broke down and I'm stuck.

sense_d4524aa4417d245b140458313ec8e6e2.text: La peli era malísima; solo se salvaba el actor principal.
sense_d4524aa4417d245b140458313ec8e6e2.translation: The film was really bad; the main actor was the only one who was ok.

sense_d4524aa4417d245b140458313ec8e6e2.text: Los considero a todos unos vagos; no se salva nadie.
sense_d4524aa4417d245b140458313ec8e6e2.translation: I consider them all lazy, without exception.

sense_f6f8db19418f6f85d2fb5ce06106ed5e.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_f6f8db19418f6f85d2fb5ce06106ed5e.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_f6f8db19418f6f85d2fb5ce06106ed5e.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_f6f8db19418f6f85d2fb5ce06106ed5e.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_420b028283af114b26a107669eeea592.text: La peli era malísima; solo se salvaba el actor principal.
sense_420b028283af114b26a107669eeea592.translation: The film was really bad; the main actor was the only one who was ok.

sense_420b028283af114b26a107669eeea592.text: Los considero a todos unos vagos; no se salva nadie.
sense_420b028283af114b26a107669eeea592.translation: I consider them all lazy, without exception.

sense_c1b0ff320cc0658128714baeb2961a1f.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_c1b0ff320cc0658128714baeb2961a1f.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_20f7b000744d75383769d1b565ea0639.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_20f7b000744d75383769d1b565ea0639.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_18828ad8e12369ba707d5996478f188e.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_18828ad8e12369ba707d5996478f188e.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_18828ad8e12369ba707d5996478f188e.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_18828ad8e12369ba707d5996478f188e.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_e102f0200776762cdc811e204bbe4ce4.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_e102f0200776762cdc811e204bbe4ce4.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_d6d26490d01111c9aea7dd1313652310.text: ¿No preferirías ir de vacaciones al extranjero este año?
sense_d6d26490d01111c9aea7dd1313652310.translation: Wouldn't you rather vacation abroad this year?

sense_d6d26490d01111c9aea7dd1313652310.text: Prefiero que se lo digas tú porque a ti te hace más caso.
sense_d6d26490d01111c9aea7dd1313652310.translation: I'd rather you told him because he listens to you more.

sense_4b2d2c0e0395e79ff4f00d89ae24eaaf.text: Quiero reunir a toda la familia para celebrar Navidad juntos.
sense_4b2d2c0e0395e79ff4f00d89ae24eaaf.translation: I want to gather the whole family to celebrate Christmas together.

sense_4b2d2c0e0395e79ff4f00d89ae24eaaf.text: Mi papá nos reunió alrededor de la fogata para relatarnos cuentos.
sense_4b2d2c0e0395e79ff4f00d89ae24eaaf.translation: Dad gathered us around the campfire to tell us stories.

sense_4e244490a4a44b5cf27731f759eb688b.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_4e244490a4a44b5cf27731f759eb688b.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_4e244490a4a44b5cf27731f759eb688b.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_4e244490a4a44b5cf27731f759eb688b.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_252805e878c52ae081e0a8ff471c2ad3.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_252805e878c52ae081e0a8ff471c2ad3.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_252805e878c52ae081e0a8ff471c2ad3.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_252805e878c52ae081e0a8ff471c2ad3.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_1666b061a252032cbe6e609963558300.text: Se cerró la recepción de fotografías para el concurso.
sense_1666b061a252032cbe6e609963558300.translation: The deadline for submitting photos to the competition has now passed.

sense_1666b061a252032cbe6e609963558300.text: La recepción de certificados será de lunes a viernes, de 9 a 2 pm.
sense_1666b061a252032cbe6e609963558300.translation: Certificates will be admitted between 9 and 2 pm from Monday to Friday.

sense_2fba2fdd7b51c72479ff79cf8248afcc.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_2fba2fdd7b51c72479ff79cf8248afcc.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_2fba2fdd7b51c72479ff79cf8248afcc.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_2fba2fdd7b51c72479ff79cf8248afcc.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_5dd424edf5f940abf1494f4dcd3251cc.text: El programa era tan aburrido que me dormí.
sense_5dd424edf5f940abf1494f4dcd3251cc.translation: The program was so boring that I fell asleep.

sense_5dd424edf5f940abf1494f4dcd3251cc.text: Me dormí a las 6 de la mañana.
sense_5dd424edf5f940abf1494f4dcd3251cc.translation: I fell asleep at 6 in the morning.

sense_f865e53d39b1d65afd32b205a372993c.text: No te duermas o no acabarás a tiempo.
sense_f865e53d39b1d65afd32b205a372993c.translation: Don't slack off or you won't finish in time.

sense_f865e53d39b1d65afd32b205a372993c.text: Por dormirse se perdió la clave para ganar el premio.
sense_f865e53d39b1d65afd32b205a372993c.translation: He missed the clue to win the prize because he didn't stay on his toes.

sense_f87282f9cdc9ceb0146c578f938aa0a1.text: El músico callejero atrajo a una gran multitud.
sense_f87282f9cdc9ceb0146c578f938aa0a1.translation: The street musician attracted a big crowd.

sense_f87282f9cdc9ceb0146c578f938aa0a1.text: Hay una multitud afuera del teatro esperando a que salga la actriz.
sense_f87282f9cdc9ceb0146c578f938aa0a1.translation: There's a crowd outside the theater waiting for the actress to come out.

sense_a612eb57cc79d89c57a38b7c5baa44fd.text: Estoy releyendo el tercer capítulo del libro.
sense_a612eb57cc79d89c57a38b7c5baa44fd.translation: I'm rereading the third chapter of the book.

sense_a612eb57cc79d89c57a38b7c5baa44fd.text: Al autor le tardó dos años escribir el capítulo final del libro.
sense_a612eb57cc79d89c57a38b7c5baa44fd.translation: It took the author two years to finish the final chapter of the book.

sense_7d593a8de9163d5a6853269de4c83724.text: A cierto individuo se le vio huyendo de la escena del crimen.
sense_7d593a8de9163d5a6853269de4c83724.translation: A certain individual was seen fleeing the scene of the crime.

sense_7d593a8de9163d5a6853269de4c83724.text: La incidencia durante el partido fue obra de ciertas personas, no de todos los fanáticos.
sense_7d593a8de9163d5a6853269de4c83724.translation: The incident during the match was the work of certain individuals, not all the fans.

sense_7eb04edba6752003bd21532e678b71a7.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_7eb04edba6752003bd21532e678b71a7.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_7eb04edba6752003bd21532e678b71a7.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_7eb04edba6752003bd21532e678b71a7.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_f2fa3de498926c2bd495c3a1e8fcdd99.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_f2fa3de498926c2bd495c3a1e8fcdd99.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_f2fa3de498926c2bd495c3a1e8fcdd99.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_f2fa3de498926c2bd495c3a1e8fcdd99.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_2046a31cc8997ac425c5b007a091cd3a.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_2046a31cc8997ac425c5b007a091cd3a.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_2046a31cc8997ac425c5b007a091cd3a.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_2046a31cc8997ac425c5b007a091cd3a.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_a488277bebd7f8b76a9bbb8824ebefc7.text: Estos no son mis lentes. Quiero los míos.
sense_a488277bebd7f8b76a9bbb8824ebefc7.translation: These aren't my glasses. I want mine.

sense_a488277bebd7f8b76a9bbb8824ebefc7.text: Este asiento es el mío. El tuyo es ese otro.
sense_a488277bebd7f8b76a9bbb8824ebefc7.translation: This seat is mine. Yours is that one there.

sense_552dcc2418291060a94a4c0bc30f8125.text: Esta silla es la mía. La tuya es esa otra.
sense_552dcc2418291060a94a4c0bc30f8125.translation: This chair is mine. Yours is that one there.

sense_552dcc2418291060a94a4c0bc30f8125.text: Esta no es mi raqueta; la mía lleva mi nombre escrito.
sense_552dcc2418291060a94a4c0bc30f8125.translation: This isn't my racket; mine has my name written on it.

sense_8b4c3f4d480f86c2c3dcfa3408adb487.text: Me ofrecieron su ayuda para el traslado.
sense_8b4c3f4d480f86c2c3dcfa3408adb487.translation: They offered to help me with the move.

sense_8b4c3f4d480f86c2c3dcfa3408adb487.text: Tengo confianza que me ofrecerán el trabajo.
sense_8b4c3f4d480f86c2c3dcfa3408adb487.translation: I'm confident they'll offer me the job.

sense_9ec453134e42789913729c31d547ff42.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_9ec453134e42789913729c31d547ff42.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_9ec453134e42789913729c31d547ff42.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_9ec453134e42789913729c31d547ff42.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_b92418627b4a03ca8db2db6cbe7c52dd.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_b92418627b4a03ca8db2db6cbe7c52dd.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_b92418627b4a03ca8db2db6cbe7c52dd.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_b92418627b4a03ca8db2db6cbe7c52dd.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_9b692db4f734f3960bf39c4b33f297c8.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_b2ebbc18ac96ba1d3c3193d8fff279d1.text: Ganar de nuevo la confianza del pueblo será un gran desafío para la primera ministra.
sense_b2ebbc18ac96ba1d3c3193d8fff279d1.translation: Winning back the people's trust will be a huge challenge for the prime minister.

sense_b2ebbc18ac96ba1d3c3193d8fff279d1.text: Es un verdadero desafío para mí mudarme a otro país y dejar atrás a mi familia.
sense_b2ebbc18ac96ba1d3c3193d8fff279d1.translation: It's a real challenge for me to move to another country and leave my family behind.

sense_5e47128647f586011a1020cbb1227a4c.text: Si me permite, señora, creo que puedo arreglar la puerta.
sense_5e47128647f586011a1020cbb1227a4c.translation: If I may, ma'am, I think I can fix the door.

sense_7711bff0aad11f8fa44a5b990360909d.text: Tenemos planeado ir a la playa en agosto.
sense_7711bff0aad11f8fa44a5b990360909d.translation: We're planning to go to the beach in August.

sense_7711bff0aad11f8fa44a5b990360909d.text: Estamos planeando una fiesta de sorpresa para su cumpleaños.
sense_7711bff0aad11f8fa44a5b990360909d.translation: We're planning a surprise party for her birthday.

sense_92b90c324885ebd6f1c53afcd60d94aa.text: Juan medía 5 pies a los quince años.
sense_92b90c324885ebd6f1c53afcd60d94aa.translation: Juan was 5 feet tall when he was fifteen.

sense_bd24bbef6735048ae6feda7831c05847.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_bd24bbef6735048ae6feda7831c05847.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_be53dd6e6c6d35e86d218e1b4cf63a7a.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_be53dd6e6c6d35e86d218e1b4cf63a7a.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_be53dd6e6c6d35e86d218e1b4cf63a7a.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_be53dd6e6c6d35e86d218e1b4cf63a7a.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_be65d02e85b433ae2ea715e3ff4b7cbe.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_be65d02e85b433ae2ea715e3ff4b7cbe.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_63596fef7b22bfcffee8448cb3d24fe3.text: Le han salido unos niños muy guerreros.
sense_63596fef7b22bfcffee8448cb3d24fe3.translation: Her children have turned out to be a real handful.

sense_63596fef7b22bfcffee8448cb3d24fe3.text: De todos mis hijos, los mellizos son los más guerreros.
sense_63596fef7b22bfcffee8448cb3d24fe3.translation: Of all my children, the twins are the ones who give me the most trouble.

sense_0ef17bbe6b6871c7259f9ec8532f9c60.text: Hay que comprar una sartén nueva porque esta ya no sirve.
sense_0ef17bbe6b6871c7259f9ec8532f9c60.translation: We need to buy a new frying pan because this one is no good any more.
Is this one any good to you?

sense_8843272861d859ec220f5bb9daac6cbb.text: El jinete iba amantado con el tradicional poncho.
sense_8843272861d859ec220f5bb9daac6cbb.translation: The rider donned the traditional poncho.

sense_8843272861d859ec220f5bb9daac6cbb.text: La mujer sostenía en brazos un bebé amantado.
sense_8843272861d859ec220f5bb9daac6cbb.translation: The woman held a baby in her arms who was wrapped up in a blanket.

sense_8f84e7bc7149b2cc9d74f00e50befcf5.text: Tuvimos que quedarnos en casa porque estaba cayendo un chaparrón.
sense_8f84e7bc7149b2cc9d74f00e50befcf5.translation: We had to stay home because it was pouring rain.

sense_8f84e7bc7149b2cc9d74f00e50befcf5.text: Está cayendo una buena nevada. Ponle las cadenas a las ruedas.
sense_8f84e7bc7149b2cc9d74f00e50befcf5.translation: It's snowing hard. Put the chains on the tires.

sense_0d19ef14a407ef647e38ab0c60e646c7.text: No bebo porque el alcohol me cae mal.
sense_0d19ef14a407ef647e38ab0c60e646c7.translation: I don't drink because alcohol disagrees with me.
You look great in that dress!

sense_8a1914e74f25159db0e84543a76a07c7.text: Me cae muy bien tu hermano; siempre me hace sonreír.
sense_8a1914e74f25159db0e84543a76a07c7.translation: I really like your brother; he always makes me smile.

sense_8a1914e74f25159db0e84543a76a07c7.text: Me marché porque me cae mal tu primo con sus bromas ofensivas.
sense_8a1914e74f25159db0e84543a76a07c7.translation: I had to leave because I can't stand your cousin and his offensive jokes.

sense_5a70cfbc50b953e5d54684a031492fff.text: Que Harvard la hubiera rechazado, le cayó mal.
sense_5a70cfbc50b953e5d54684a031492fff.translation: She wasn't pleased that Harvard rejected her.

sense_5a70cfbc50b953e5d54684a031492fff.text: El embarazo de mi hermana pequeña no cayó bien en la familia.
sense_5a70cfbc50b953e5d54684a031492fff.translation: My little sister's pregnancy shocked the entire family.

sense_4a889f754657599c618a5f768fa05299.text: Mi bebé está llorando porque se cae de sueño.
sense_4a889f754657599c618a5f768fa05299.translation: My baby is crying because he's very sleepy.

sense_4a889f754657599c618a5f768fa05299.text: Me caigo de cansancio, pero tengo que estudiar para el examen de mañana.
sense_4a889f754657599c618a5f768fa05299.translation: I am really tired, but I have to study for tomorrow's exam.

sense_828b67d7967182e0d48a18d6692c98e0.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_828b67d7967182e0d48a18d6692c98e0.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_47ec25347af4baf860084430b24b3ce9.text: Es importante que siempre consideres los sentimientos de los demás.
sense_47ec25347af4baf860084430b24b3ce9.translation: It's important that you always consider other people's feelings.

sense_47ec25347af4baf860084430b24b3ce9.text: Siempre hay que considerar a las personas mayores en el autobús y cederles el asiento.
sense_47ec25347af4baf860084430b24b3ce9.translation: You should always show consideration for older people on the bus and give up your seat for them.

sense_d985d975617c20e002516c9186e3141a.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_d985d975617c20e002516c9186e3141a.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_1f6d4d6f92159d477dae44b28878784d.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_1f6d4d6f92159d477dae44b28878784d.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_fdd3409c52d79883036829605aaed335.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_fdd3409c52d79883036829605aaed335.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_fdd3409c52d79883036829605aaed335.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_fdd3409c52d79883036829605aaed335.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_a7820583ee992a475f274687b16e62ea.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_a7820583ee992a475f274687b16e62ea.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_a7820583ee992a475f274687b16e62ea.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_a7820583ee992a475f274687b16e62ea.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_33397ed7eb4a94513c0b2f5d2c618c7a.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_33397ed7eb4a94513c0b2f5d2c618c7a.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_8b83899bbd2231c72bcd734c7056fb43.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_8b83899bbd2231c72bcd734c7056fb43.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_8b83899bbd2231c72bcd734c7056fb43.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_8b83899bbd2231c72bcd734c7056fb43.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_a0e4e62ba29d4a42614d034e69c10802.text: El libro santo de los judíos es la Tora.
sense_a0e4e62ba29d4a42614d034e69c10802.translation: The holy book of the Jewish people is the Torah.

sense_a0e4e62ba29d4a42614d034e69c10802.text: Dicen que el sótano de la catedral está lleno de reliquias santas.
sense_a0e4e62ba29d4a42614d034e69c10802.translation: They say that the basement of the cathedral is full of holy relics.

sense_9aeabf4d0eef8bb6e364cf987ddb6413.text: Si me permite, señora, creo que puedo arreglar la puerta.
sense_9aeabf4d0eef8bb6e364cf987ddb6413.translation: If I may, ma'am, I think I can fix the door.

sense_e57fcd14e46e85a734537e55f991176e.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_e57fcd14e46e85a734537e55f991176e.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_e57fcd14e46e85a734537e55f991176e.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_e57fcd14e46e85a734537e55f991176e.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_fb4b78c77ef884e9abbb41ac1099658a.text: La camarera es un pato; la hemos visto tirar tres platos ya.
sense_fb4b78c77ef884e9abbb41ac1099658a.translation: The waitress is really clumsy; we've already seen her drop three dishes.
I have two left feet when it comes to dancing.

sense_3445b6b80d2da91172277cd8abde64bc.text: No sabía que su esposa estuvo presa por fraude.
sense_3445b6b80d2da91172277cd8abde64bc.translation: I didn't know his wife had been in prison for fraud.

sense_3445b6b80d2da91172277cd8abde64bc.text: Toda la oficina se quedó mirando cuando llevaron presa a la jefa.
sense_3445b6b80d2da91172277cd8abde64bc.translation: The whole office stared when they took the boss away in handcuffs.

sense_09b2a3393e1a444370e1bf5f397bf253.text: Lo metieron preso por manejar en estado de embriaguez.
sense_09b2a3393e1a444370e1bf5f397bf253.translation: He was jailed for drunk driving.

sense_09b2a3393e1a444370e1bf5f397bf253.text: Creo que el marido de Maite estuvo preso por unos cinco años.
sense_09b2a3393e1a444370e1bf5f397bf253.translation: I think Maite's husband was in prison for about five years.

sense_238166354e9cae59b64b4cbcc54aa09b.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_238166354e9cae59b64b4cbcc54aa09b.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_238166354e9cae59b64b4cbcc54aa09b.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_238166354e9cae59b64b4cbcc54aa09b.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_654bdd0cebfae5b3fc0e0196a541ab54.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_654bdd0cebfae5b3fc0e0196a541ab54.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_654bdd0cebfae5b3fc0e0196a541ab54.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_654bdd0cebfae5b3fc0e0196a541ab54.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_c1756d3a4d4c536b9e5557f32aad3b24.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_dc573cc8f3e346f9156227c60cb3fa09.text: La gente se dirigía al panteón para velar a sus seres queridos difuntos.
sense_dc573cc8f3e346f9156227c60cb3fa09.translation: The crowd was headed toward the cemetery to keep vigil over their deceased loved ones.

sense_dc573cc8f3e346f9156227c60cb3fa09.text: Rafael murió en la mañana, y por la tarde lo vamos a velar.
sense_dc573cc8f3e346f9156227c60cb3fa09.translation: Rafael died this morning, and this afternoon we are going to keep vigil over him.

sense_6aa786ff5f46116999fc2e94c00dd145.text: Me encantó el libro pero el final no me convenció.
sense_6aa786ff5f46116999fc2e94c00dd145.translation: I loved the book, but the ending wasn't very good.

sense_6aa786ff5f46116999fc2e94c00dd145.text: Decidieron eliminar los camarones del menú porque no parecía convencer a los clientes.
sense_6aa786ff5f46116999fc2e94c00dd145.translation: They decided to remove shrimp from the menu because customers didn't seem to like them.

sense_821f999f3f12533f3437149b81d08ec7.text: Te agarras a tu herida para evitar las tareas en casa.
sense_821f999f3f12533f3437149b81d08ec7.translation: You use your injury to get out of chores around the house.

sense_821f999f3f12533f3437149b81d08ec7.text: Se agarró a los deberes para no tener que lavar los platos.
sense_821f999f3f12533f3437149b81d08ec7.translation: She used her homework as an excuse to not wash the dishes.

sense_03bbc86309e8b15d48ec54b757ee9300.text: El capitán dirigió el buque hacia el faro.
sense_03bbc86309e8b15d48ec54b757ee9300.translation: The captain steered the ship toward the lighthouse.

sense_03bbc86309e8b15d48ec54b757ee9300.text: Dirigió el coche con cuidado por el borde del acantilado.
sense_03bbc86309e8b15d48ec54b757ee9300.translation: He steered the car carefully along the edge of the cliff.

sense_04fdd196f15c8e1195db57e1837f41b3.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_04fdd196f15c8e1195db57e1837f41b3.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_04fdd196f15c8e1195db57e1837f41b3.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_04fdd196f15c8e1195db57e1837f41b3.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_533972e80537d7ae5eb3cb3ad7a6eaf2.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_533972e80537d7ae5eb3cb3ad7a6eaf2.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_533972e80537d7ae5eb3cb3ad7a6eaf2.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_533972e80537d7ae5eb3cb3ad7a6eaf2.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_52f3fad3ef1e79171814c00cd99d14b0.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_52f3fad3ef1e79171814c00cd99d14b0.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_52f3fad3ef1e79171814c00cd99d14b0.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_52f3fad3ef1e79171814c00cd99d14b0.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_7473a14630820665d791cf65cda4cc13.text: La culpa es tuya. - ¿Mía? ¡Hay que joderse! ¡Pero si yo ni siquiera estaba aquí!
sense_7473a14630820665d791cf65cda4cc13.translation: It's your fault. - My fault? For fuck's sake! But I wasn't even here!

sense_7473a14630820665d791cf65cda4cc13.text: No me dejaron ustedes nada de comida. - ¡Te jodes! Es tu culpa por llegar tarde.
sense_7473a14630820665d791cf65cda4cc13.translation: You didn't leave any food for me. - Tough shit! It's your fault for being late.

sense_c8b113cac6361533dba9962b5953ec43.text: No le tire patadas a su hermano.
Su perro me tiró un mordisco.

sense_22ae54c85fc951d3f6cc506b6d1ee1f5.text: Las fiestas ya no me tiran.
sense_22ae54c85fc951d3f6cc506b6d1ee1f5.translation: Parties don't appeal to me anymore.
He is not interested in studying medicine.

sense_0a7fbb69726e1c967381a6765843338e.text: El plato tiraba a dulce más que nada.
sense_0a7fbb69726e1c967381a6765843338e.translation: The dish was more sweet than anything else.

sense_0a7fbb69726e1c967381a6765843338e.text: Tienes que beberte el té cuando esté tirando a frío.
sense_0a7fbb69726e1c967381a6765843338e.translation: You have to drink the tea when it is cooling down.

sense_f3fb17c3361753c5ba12df4f123c2bf5.text: El bebé se tiró un eructo tras tomarse su biberón.
sense_f3fb17c3361753c5ba12df4f123c2bf5.translation: The baby burped after having his bottle.

sense_f3fb17c3361753c5ba12df4f123c2bf5.text: La primera vez que se tiró un pedo delante de su novio se avergonzó.
sense_f3fb17c3361753c5ba12df4f123c2bf5.translation: The first time she farted in front of her boyfriend, she was embarrassed.

sense_6d1ee60b184b2e72b3cd22afe6ff48b6.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_6d1ee60b184b2e72b3cd22afe6ff48b6.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_6d1ee60b184b2e72b3cd22afe6ff48b6.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_6d1ee60b184b2e72b3cd22afe6ff48b6.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_b7441491030f8de194fbfdea9767d26c.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_b7441491030f8de194fbfdea9767d26c.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_dddaa07b7bd2943d241e610d55e4e138.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_dddaa07b7bd2943d241e610d55e4e138.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_dddaa07b7bd2943d241e610d55e4e138.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_dddaa07b7bd2943d241e610d55e4e138.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_a02ca087240714a6c2320831459aae98.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_a02ca087240714a6c2320831459aae98.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_a02ca087240714a6c2320831459aae98.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_a02ca087240714a6c2320831459aae98.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_0b569dd4efefdededf5a2f0c07ff61a3.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_0b569dd4efefdededf5a2f0c07ff61a3.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_0b569dd4efefdededf5a2f0c07ff61a3.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_0b569dd4efefdededf5a2f0c07ff61a3.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_e5168f3c3550cf26a3e9db12792f8c53.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_e5168f3c3550cf26a3e9db12792f8c53.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_e5168f3c3550cf26a3e9db12792f8c53.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_e5168f3c3550cf26a3e9db12792f8c53.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_cdc23992785e207f4ab3dddd3fb20503.text: Este deporte es de extremo peligro para los participantes.
sense_cdc23992785e207f4ab3dddd3fb20503.translation: This sport is extremely dangerous for those taking part.

sense_cdc23992785e207f4ab3dddd3fb20503.text: Esta situación es de extrema gravedad

sense_6c63a0a8bc445b999b3eb2092c490eb6.text: Su comportamiento ha llegado al extremo. Tendremos que despedirlo.
sense_6c63a0a8bc445b999b3eb2092c490eb6.translation: His behavior has gone too far. We'll have to fire him.

sense_6c63a0a8bc445b999b3eb2092c490eb6.text: Hemos llegado al extremo de que tengo miedo de contestar el teléfono en caso de que sea Silvia.
sense_6c63a0a8bc445b999b3eb2092c490eb6.translation: It's got to the point where I'm afraid to answer the telephone in case it's Silvia.

sense_aa204c98f6ac99c30c1ca3ed59d2d332.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_aa204c98f6ac99c30c1ca3ed59d2d332.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_aa204c98f6ac99c30c1ca3ed59d2d332.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_aa204c98f6ac99c30c1ca3ed59d2d332.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_03dc3af11bbf7e1ef01c69218853e693.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_03dc3af11bbf7e1ef01c69218853e693.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_03dc3af11bbf7e1ef01c69218853e693.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_03dc3af11bbf7e1ef01c69218853e693.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_0d92e931939fc178936ee167d8378e86.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_0d92e931939fc178936ee167d8378e86.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_fe19fe69736072e47ba9e82e6ec62cee.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_fe19fe69736072e47ba9e82e6ec62cee.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_fe19fe69736072e47ba9e82e6ec62cee.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_fe19fe69736072e47ba9e82e6ec62cee.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_cf25f1beeff7dc29afee5ee845389d32.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_cf25f1beeff7dc29afee5ee845389d32.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_cf25f1beeff7dc29afee5ee845389d32.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_cf25f1beeff7dc29afee5ee845389d32.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_cee8379f4d063758d8a73ee5c73dab24.text: Cuando vio el ratón, pegó un grito.
sense_cee8379f4d063758d8a73ee5c73dab24.translation: When she saw the mouse, she screamed.

sense_cee8379f4d063758d8a73ee5c73dab24.text: Está en el hospital después de que le hayan pegado un tiro.
sense_cee8379f4d063758d8a73ee5c73dab24.translation: He's in the hospital after having been shot.

sense_18437d049280a3b715d952297b8e11b5.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_18437d049280a3b715d952297b8e11b5.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_18437d049280a3b715d952297b8e11b5.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_18437d049280a3b715d952297b8e11b5.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_faa51d87b787849ff57f1ae442cf7211.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_faa51d87b787849ff57f1ae442cf7211.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_faa51d87b787849ff57f1ae442cf7211.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_faa51d87b787849ff57f1ae442cf7211.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_f9feca09611b1cf72487eed39cc1f3c0.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_f9feca09611b1cf72487eed39cc1f3c0.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_f9feca09611b1cf72487eed39cc1f3c0.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_f9feca09611b1cf72487eed39cc1f3c0.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_95eeac6bd06d68e5a8f81db7eb0becd2.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_95eeac6bd06d68e5a8f81db7eb0becd2.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_2b736196d58036e2d2ccea7182d70364.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_2b736196d58036e2d2ccea7182d70364.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_2b736196d58036e2d2ccea7182d70364.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_2b736196d58036e2d2ccea7182d70364.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_973f0a6b15d3285c675f8e0564c7bfae.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_973f0a6b15d3285c675f8e0564c7bfae.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_6f7bbec59db8d83445a1a2a54d504a65.text: Me gusta jugar al bingo por el dinero.
sense_6f7bbec59db8d83445a1a2a54d504a65.translation: I love playing Bingo for money.
Does anybody want to play tennis with me?

sense_d150d4a78c87a76af347b91745325653.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_d150d4a78c87a76af347b91745325653.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_d150d4a78c87a76af347b91745325653.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
