sense_d150d4a78c87a76af347b91745325653.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_25e828565443f86752507db837266776.translation: So many people have come to the party!
It's taken you ages to get here!

sense_9c338141a4efcee10f1391d78c4b721d.text: ¡Cuánto quiero que me lleves a ese restaurante de nuevo!
sense_9c338141a4efcee10f1391d78c4b721d.translation: I want you to take me back to that restaurant so badly!

sense_4d6db09d7af4d5c80ebbc76382d1c348.text: El resplandeciente sol agostará las plantas en la huerta.
sense_4d6db09d7af4d5c80ebbc76382d1c348.translation: The blazing sun will parch the plants in the kitchen garden.

sense_4d6db09d7af4d5c80ebbc76382d1c348.text: La reciente ola de calor agostó todas las plantas de mi jardín.
sense_4d6db09d7af4d5c80ebbc76382d1c348.translation: The recent heatwave parched all the plants in my yard.

sense_a95fa5d7e342038e2fc91dbbc5c897de.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_a95fa5d7e342038e2fc91dbbc5c897de.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_a95fa5d7e342038e2fc91dbbc5c897de.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_a95fa5d7e342038e2fc91dbbc5c897de.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_54baf66a8381be3b3e17d9f31b196f23.text: Lávate bien las manos antes de tocarte los ojos.
sense_54baf66a8381be3b3e17d9f31b196f23.translation: Wash your hands thoroughly before touching your eyes.

sense_54baf66a8381be3b3e17d9f31b196f23.text: ¡Lávate bien! Vienes muy sucio del partido.
sense_54baf66a8381be3b3e17d9f31b196f23.translation: Wash properly! You're really dirty from the game.

sense_64cac0449807a49028ead367259ad9ae.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_64cac0449807a49028ead367259ad9ae.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_64cac0449807a49028ead367259ad9ae.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_64cac0449807a49028ead367259ad9ae.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_1e2ebc0f11996bfea32e19acdbed3e2b.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_1e2ebc0f11996bfea32e19acdbed3e2b.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_1e2ebc0f11996bfea32e19acdbed3e2b.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_1e2ebc0f11996bfea32e19acdbed3e2b.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_978197167badfde03507df232829ac99.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_dbc9e924176ca29a7073f045a4127e46.text: Cuatro presos huyeron de la cárcel el domingo por la tarde.
sense_dbc9e924176ca29a7073f045a4127e46.translation: Four inmates escaped from the prison on Sunday afternoon.

sense_dbc9e924176ca29a7073f045a4127e46.text: El hada trató de huir, pero el brujo la agarró por las alas.
sense_dbc9e924176ca29a7073f045a4127e46.translation: The fairy tried to escape, but the wizard grabbed her by the wings.

sense_f2cb0f46119b89e1a86fcb92b7eeee5f.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_f2cb0f46119b89e1a86fcb92b7eeee5f.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_f2cb0f46119b89e1a86fcb92b7eeee5f.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_f2cb0f46119b89e1a86fcb92b7eeee5f.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_b386f636929003a90cce9e092852e7d0.text: El gobierno se equivocó con esta medida.
sense_b386f636929003a90cce9e092852e7d0.translation: The government got it wrong with this policy.

sense_b386f636929003a90cce9e092852e7d0.text: La empresa reconoce que se equivocó con su respuesta.
sense_b386f636929003a90cce9e092852e7d0.translation: The company recognizes that it got its response wrong.

sense_f919d2819caa10e83938b5a55e1096db.text: Mi madre se equivocó de tren y, por consiguiente, no llegó aquí hasta la una de la madrugada.
sense_f919d2819caa10e83938b5a55e1096db.translation: My mother got on the wrong train and, as a result, she didn't get here till one in the morning.

sense_f919d2819caa10e83938b5a55e1096db.text: Te equivocaste de mes. El cumpleaños de Fernando es el dos de julio y no el dos de junio.
sense_f919d2819caa10e83938b5a55e1096db.translation: You got the month wrong. Fernando's birthday is the second of July not the second of June.

sense_a87f9312e797d627a83b03c4ac591e06.text: Mi bisabuelo era un vaquero en el Viejo Oeste.
sense_a87f9312e797d627a83b03c4ac591e06.translation: My great-grandfather was a cowboy in the Old West.

sense_a87f9312e797d627a83b03c4ac591e06.text: ¿De qué te vas a vestir para Halloween? - De vaquero.
sense_a87f9312e797d627a83b03c4ac591e06.translation: What are you dressing up as for Halloween? - A cowboy.

sense_fa39ab42cb88cfc705236be1576e13ff.text: La peli era malísima; solo se salvaba el actor principal.
sense_fa39ab42cb88cfc705236be1576e13ff.translation: The film was really bad; the main actor was the only one who was ok.

sense_fa39ab42cb88cfc705236be1576e13ff.text: Los considero a todos unos vagos; no se salva nadie.
sense_fa39ab42cb88cfc705236be1576e13ff.translation: I consider them all lazy, without exception.

sense_773d57aa514bb659c71f072bfe784779.text: Este curso les servirá de introducción a las matemáticas aplicadas.
sense_773d57aa514bb659c71f072bfe784779.translation: This course will give you an introduction into applied mathematics.

sense_773d57aa514bb659c71f072bfe784779.text: Las matemáticas han avanzado mucho desde la época de Newton y Leibniz.
sense_773d57aa514bb659c71f072bfe784779.translation: Mathematics have progressed a lot since Newton and Leibniz's times.

sense_74eb0dc2c5a04bb95ffc5095c047c8af.text: Si me permite, señora, creo que puedo arreglar la puerta.
sense_74eb0dc2c5a04bb95ffc5095c047c8af.translation: If I may, ma'am, I think I can fix the door.

sense_c843be0a1fe6c12466fe8e73e85e6583.text: Rodolfo se niega a aceptar que la boda está cancelada.
sense_c843be0a1fe6c12466fe8e73e85e6583.translation: Rodolfo refuses to believe that the wedding is canceled.

sense_c843be0a1fe6c12466fe8e73e85e6583.text: Me niego a pagar cinco dólares de envío por algo que solo cuesta un dólar.
sense_c843be0a1fe6c12466fe8e73e85e6583.translation: I refuse to pay five dollars to ship something that only costs a dollar.

sense_0dae9fa1b07b3529183a1244281fea5f.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_0dae9fa1b07b3529183a1244281fea5f.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_0dae9fa1b07b3529183a1244281fea5f.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_0dae9fa1b07b3529183a1244281fea5f.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_7bfaf63af37b7891ea3c9a96d3fd121d.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_7bfaf63af37b7891ea3c9a96d3fd121d.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_7bfaf63af37b7891ea3c9a96d3fd121d.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_7bfaf63af37b7891ea3c9a96d3fd121d.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_fe8b7403c91c8ec256647e6bfdbd3199.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_fe8b7403c91c8ec256647e6bfdbd3199.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_91c63fc59c476f520ea32ddbfd7a8f37.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_91c63fc59c476f520ea32ddbfd7a8f37.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_91c63fc59c476f520ea32ddbfd7a8f37.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_91c63fc59c476f520ea32ddbfd7a8f37.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_6d48aec6ce90f600fe88a5c91a844080.text: Ana siente que tiene cenizo a la hora de buscar empleo.
sense_6d48aec6ce90f600fe88a5c91a844080.translation: Ana feels she's jinxed when it comes to finding a job.

sense_6d48aec6ce90f600fe88a5c91a844080.text: ¡Madre mía, es la tercera vez que venimos y está cerrado el restaurante! Tenemos el cenizo.
sense_6d48aec6ce90f600fe88a5c91a844080.translation: Oh no! This is the third time we've come to this restaurant and it's been closed! We're jinxed.

sense_6867ce171065d6e675751e79e509cf9b.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_6867ce171065d6e675751e79e509cf9b.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_7ca2b3c47b7fff920f6f21b6bfba2a93.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_7ca2b3c47b7fff920f6f21b6bfba2a93.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_7ca2b3c47b7fff920f6f21b6bfba2a93.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_7ca2b3c47b7fff920f6f21b6bfba2a93.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_34feeaa485a4a6e92a7e9019b5957c9b.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_34feeaa485a4a6e92a7e9019b5957c9b.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_41926fc52b204b7d70ed2e630df70848.text: Mi novio me hartó a regalos el día de mi cumpleaños.
sense_41926fc52b204b7d70ed2e630df70848.translation: My boyfriend gave me a ton of presents for my birthday.

sense_41926fc52b204b7d70ed2e630df70848.text: Por favor no me harten con tantas preguntas. Ya se los voy a explicar todo.
sense_41926fc52b204b7d70ed2e630df70848.translation: Please do not barrage me with so many questions. I am just about to explain everything.

sense_9860999c1a466735091db32024af7ecf.text: Javier es el alumno más aplicado de la clase.
sense_9860999c1a466735091db32024af7ecf.translation: Javier is the most hardworking student in the class.

sense_9860999c1a466735091db32024af7ecf.text: Solo 12 alumnos consiguieron licenciarse en Física.
sense_9860999c1a466735091db32024af7ecf.translation: Only 12 students managed to graduate in Physics.

sense_a80afe0794b49f1868917604d91ae1f5.text: El barco se quedó atrapado en el hielo del Ártico y un rescate parecía imposible.
sense_a80afe0794b49f1868917604d91ae1f5.translation: The boat was trapped in the Arctic ice and rescue seemed impossible.

sense_a80afe0794b49f1868917604d91ae1f5.text: Se divorció de su esposo porque tenía la sensación de estar atrapada en un matrimonio infeliz y aburrido.
sense_a80afe0794b49f1868917604d91ae1f5.translation: She divorced her husband because she had the feeling of being trapped in an unhappy and boring marriage.

sense_a8cafb43b3b7d93b916a72e1d933c89a.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_a8cafb43b3b7d93b916a72e1d933c89a.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_4412f62e83d78d42ff37d0d40b994700.text: Señor Presidente, ¿quiere usted explicarnos lo que pasó allí dentro? - Sin comentarios.
sense_4412f62e83d78d42ff37d0d40b994700.translation: Mr President, would you like to explain to us what happened in there? - No comment.

sense_4412f62e83d78d42ff37d0d40b994700.text: Un portavoz de la empresa dijo que la subida de precios no es culpa de ellos. Sin comentario.
sense_4412f62e83d78d42ff37d0d40b994700.translation: A spokesperson for the company said that the rise in prices wasn't their fault. What can you say?

sense_79e358ab4f2d6012fc9d1e723dbc7474.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_79e358ab4f2d6012fc9d1e723dbc7474.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_d740aec53ef277f570df1256c6636cd5.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_d740aec53ef277f570df1256c6636cd5.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_d740aec53ef277f570df1256c6636cd5.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_d740aec53ef277f570df1256c6636cd5.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_1f2a3831411df554cae566a33adb94f3.text: Al registrarse en un hotel, deberá presentar un documento que pruebe su identidad.
sense_1f2a3831411df554cae566a33adb94f3.translation: When checking into a hotel, you'll need to present a proof of identity.

sense_1f2a3831411df554cae566a33adb94f3.text: Los solicitantes tendrán que presentar documentos que demuestren que carecen de los fondos necesarios.
sense_1f2a3831411df554cae566a33adb94f3.translation: Applicants will need to provide documentary proof that they lack the required funds.

sense_2a7dc6dafca7e51e0536a8e7cae21dfd.text: Es importante no perder el contacto con la realidad.
sense_2a7dc6dafca7e51e0536a8e7cae21dfd.translation: It's important not to lose touch with reality.

sense_2a7dc6dafca7e51e0536a8e7cae21dfd.text: Nuestro hijo adoptivo quiere ponerse en contacto con su madre biológica.
sense_2a7dc6dafca7e51e0536a8e7cae21dfd.translation: Our adopted son wants to get in touch with his biological mother.

sense_318a380af10b9f6986bba881ae1676d0.translation: You really could have told him.

sense_318a380af10b9f6986bba881ae1676d0.text: Se hace el tonto pero bien sabía que no nos había pagado.
sense_318a380af10b9f6986bba881ae1676d0.translation: He's pretending he didn't, but he knew full well he hadn't paid us.

sense_e3a9a0109670946a466fc55f79bf85b6.text: Bien nos vamos, bien no, pero hay que decidirlo ya.
sense_e3a9a0109670946a466fc55f79bf85b6.translation: We either go or we don't, but we need to decide.

sense_e3a9a0109670946a466fc55f79bf85b6.text: Tenemos que mudarnos, bien este año, bien el que viene.
sense_e3a9a0109670946a466fc55f79bf85b6.translation: We have to move, whether it's this year or next.

sense_9e105a498d9b39c0a192f64cac6a58f4.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_9e105a498d9b39c0a192f64cac6a58f4.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_ad281e1aa618a49f526cf2aec8e5d335.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_ad281e1aa618a49f526cf2aec8e5d335.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_ad281e1aa618a49f526cf2aec8e5d335.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_ad281e1aa618a49f526cf2aec8e5d335.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_79c5636b8a38b1bdd0c15ca09a04cc2b.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_79c5636b8a38b1bdd0c15ca09a04cc2b.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_79c5636b8a38b1bdd0c15ca09a04cc2b.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_79c5636b8a38b1bdd0c15ca09a04cc2b.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_a22bf35a99039f43eb21776b0df266fc.text: La peli era malísima; solo se salvaba el actor principal.
sense_a22bf35a99039f43eb21776b0df266fc.translation: The film was really bad; the main actor was the only one who was ok.

sense_a22bf35a99039f43eb21776b0df266fc.text: Los considero a todos unos vagos; no se salva nadie.
sense_a22bf35a99039f43eb21776b0df266fc.translation: I consider them all lazy, without exception.

sense_5919235b7bad556ceb89fa70d010569f.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_5919235b7bad556ceb89fa70d010569f.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_543477578e69583aa3eb4b3536335477.text: Las máximas autoridades en la materia acudirán al congreso.
sense_543477578e69583aa3eb4b3536335477.translation: The leading authorities on the subject will attend the conference.

sense_543477578e69583aa3eb4b3536335477.text: El máximo dirigente del grupo terrorista ha reivindicado las atrocidades cometidas el pasado jueves.
sense_543477578e69583aa3eb4b3536335477.translation: The leader of the terrorist group has claimed responsibility for the atrocities committed last Thursday.

sense_1d8b8099204d8338b4606e3fc182786c.text: Lo máximo que podemos hacer es compensarlos por el viaje.
sense_1d8b8099204d8338b4606e3fc182786c.translation: The best we can do is reimburse your travel costs.

sense_1d8b8099204d8338b4606e3fc182786c.text: Lo máximo que puede esperar es que no lo condenen a años de cárcel.
sense_1d8b8099204d8338b4606e3fc182786c.translation: The most he can hope for is that he isn't sentenced to years in prison.

sense_ca2b474348005c69101f90d50987021c.text: "No hay nada que temer", dijo el mago.
sense_ca2b474348005c69101f90d50987021c.translation: "There's nothing to fear," said the magician.

sense_ca2b474348005c69101f90d50987021c.text: "Yo no le temo a la muerte", dijo el temerario motociclista.
sense_ca2b474348005c69101f90d50987021c.translation: "I don't fear death," said the daredevil motorcyclist.

sense_6ab5a80b00d38a06734ab9dbb5cf1eb8.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_6ab5a80b00d38a06734ab9dbb5cf1eb8.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_6ab5a80b00d38a06734ab9dbb5cf1eb8.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_6ab5a80b00d38a06734ab9dbb5cf1eb8.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_c9160620fa01faafc5009a7dc0bf2c35.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_c9160620fa01faafc5009a7dc0bf2c35.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_c9160620fa01faafc5009a7dc0bf2c35.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_c9160620fa01faafc5009a7dc0bf2c35.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_ef409c726d7f1026c9d94be00f56cff7.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_eced4bcda8960ab222eb093739c31a8a.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_eced4bcda8960ab222eb093739c31a8a.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_eced4bcda8960ab222eb093739c31a8a.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_eced4bcda8960ab222eb093739c31a8a.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_454a2d13b085de549c4524c69de82cc9.text: Me ofrecieron su ayuda para el traslado.
sense_454a2d13b085de549c4524c69de82cc9.translation: They offered to help me with the move.

sense_454a2d13b085de549c4524c69de82cc9.text: Tengo confianza que me ofrecerán el trabajo.
sense_454a2d13b085de549c4524c69de82cc9.translation: I'm confident they'll offer me the job.

sense_cd280aab9abfaa1cfbe597579cd885ee.text: Mi prima estudió por muchos años para llegar a ser una cirujana cardíaca.
sense_cd280aab9abfaa1cfbe597579cd885ee.translation: My cousin studied for many years to become a heart surgeon.

sense_cd280aab9abfaa1cfbe597579cd885ee.text: El cirujano plástico le informó al paciente que su seguro no cubrirá su operación.
sense_cd280aab9abfaa1cfbe597579cd885ee.translation: The plastic surgeon informed the patient that his insurance will not cover his procedure.

sense_b9f6c61665890b1ef4e3c5694bde8010.text: No te quedes ahí tan fresco. ¡Haz algo!
sense_b9f6c61665890b1ef4e3c5694bde8010.translation: Don't stand there as if nothing was the matter. Do something about it!

sense_b9f6c61665890b1ef4e3c5694bde8010.text: Se entera de que ha suspendido el examen y se queda tan fresca.
sense_b9f6c61665890b1ef4e3c5694bde8010.translation: She finds out that she has failed her exam and couldn't care less.

sense_24719695182782fc7bbd16439aab0969.text: Coge una chaqueta, puede que haga fresco fuera.
sense_24719695182782fc7bbd16439aab0969.translation: Take a jacket, it may be chilly out there.

sense_24719695182782fc7bbd16439aab0969.text: Esperemos que haga un poquito más de fresco junto al mar.
sense_24719695182782fc7bbd16439aab0969.translation: Let's hope it's a bit cooler by the seaside.

sense_f8e3edb5eeb98267298363eeae79188c.text: Tu hermana es una fresca de cuidado. Nunca hace sus deberes.
sense_f8e3edb5eeb98267298363eeae79188c.translation: Your sister is really cheeky. She never does her homework.

sense_f8e3edb5eeb98267298363eeae79188c.text: ¡Eres un fresco! ¿No te dije que no utilizaras mi ordenador?
sense_f8e3edb5eeb98267298363eeae79188c.translation: You have a lot of nerve! Didn't I tell you not to use my computer?

sense_f43176c35f3c540073726efcc918e8c7.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_f43176c35f3c540073726efcc918e8c7.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_f43176c35f3c540073726efcc918e8c7.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_f43176c35f3c540073726efcc918e8c7.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_001885c08af30eab47c4eb8fe818a723.text: Esa mujer es pariente lejana mía.
sense_001885c08af30eab47c4eb8fe818a723.translation: That woman is a distant relative of mine.

sense_001885c08af30eab47c4eb8fe818a723.text: Vamos a pasar Navidad con unos parientes de mi esposo este año.
sense_001885c08af30eab47c4eb8fe818a723.translation: We're spending Christmas with some of my husband's relatives this year.

sense_6b7161e5552d7a6aa05e505269cbe008.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_6b7161e5552d7a6aa05e505269cbe008.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_6b7161e5552d7a6aa05e505269cbe008.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_6b7161e5552d7a6aa05e505269cbe008.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_47ad53fa4bbcd6719857c69b5a6ab8a8.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_47ad53fa4bbcd6719857c69b5a6ab8a8.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_47ad53fa4bbcd6719857c69b5a6ab8a8.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_47ad53fa4bbcd6719857c69b5a6ab8a8.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_f615379f3ed22745c0f05552d904ac3c.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_f615379f3ed22745c0f05552d904ac3c.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_f615379f3ed22745c0f05552d904ac3c.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_f615379f3ed22745c0f05552d904ac3c.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_452a0a06852b6060095ee6a96cf0d294.text: Las autoridades enfrentaron al sospechoso tan pronto como lo encontraron.
sense_452a0a06852b6060095ee6a96cf0d294.translation: The authorities confronted the suspect as soon as they found him.

sense_452a0a06852b6060095ee6a96cf0d294.text: Tienes que enfrentar tus miedos si quieres avanzar en la vida.
sense_452a0a06852b6060095ee6a96cf0d294.translation: You have to confront your fears if you want to advance in life.

sense_57c553f8ee5bb5ff9f30340fd65611eb.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_57c553f8ee5bb5ff9f30340fd65611eb.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_57c553f8ee5bb5ff9f30340fd65611eb.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_57c553f8ee5bb5ff9f30340fd65611eb.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_ce3b1ddb1b8e71ad729e0602ddd19675.text: "No hay nada que temer", dijo el mago.
sense_ce3b1ddb1b8e71ad729e0602ddd19675.translation: "There's nothing to fear," said the magician.

sense_ce3b1ddb1b8e71ad729e0602ddd19675.text: "Yo no le temo a la muerte", dijo el temerario motociclista.
sense_ce3b1ddb1b8e71ad729e0602ddd19675.translation: "I don't fear death," said the daredevil motorcyclist.

sense_39131fa7d2f3c82d0c2049b66109d774.text: La camarera es un pato; la hemos visto tirar tres platos ya.
sense_39131fa7d2f3c82d0c2049b66109d774.translation: The waitress is really clumsy; we've already seen her drop three dishes.
I have two left feet when it comes to dancing.

sense_c027aba8b95c78d204634b53b8577a8d.text: ¿Dónde acostumbrabas almorzar cuando trabajabas en el banco?
sense_c027aba8b95c78d204634b53b8577a8d.translation: Where did you use to have lunch when you worked at the bank?

sense_c027aba8b95c78d204634b53b8577a8d.text: Acostumbraba cortarme el cabello con José.
sense_c027aba8b95c78d204634b53b8577a8d.translation: I used to get my hair cut by Jose.

sense_d183e5e5cdf1257fd59444633cb3ca1b.text: Hay que acostumbrar al bebé a comer comida sólida poco a poco.
sense_d183e5e5cdf1257fd59444633cb3ca1b.translation: We need to get the baby used to eating solid food little by little.

sense_d183e5e5cdf1257fd59444633cb3ca1b.text: Antes de sacar la planta de la maceta, debes acostumbrarla al lugar donde se va a plantar.
sense_d183e5e5cdf1257fd59444633cb3ca1b.translation: Before you take the plant out of the pot, you should get it used to the place where it is going to be planted.

sense_e4fb1d2c0d93796f4f024dd791dfcb6d.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_e4fb1d2c0d93796f4f024dd791dfcb6d.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_d523903b8e59731a104855eeb906188a.text: El escritorio está pegado a la pared.
sense_d523903b8e59731a104855eeb906188a.translation: The desk was up against the wall.

sense_d523903b8e59731a104855eeb906188a.text: Su casa está pegada a la mía, así que puedo oír todas sus conversaciones por la pared.
sense_d523903b8e59731a104855eeb906188a.translation: Her house is right next to mine, so I can hear all her conversations through the wall.

sense_477d5ccb3e33edb23be5eb01c5ee24f6.text: Cuando vio el ratón, pegó un grito.
sense_477d5ccb3e33edb23be5eb01c5ee24f6.translation: When she saw the mouse, she screamed.

sense_477d5ccb3e33edb23be5eb01c5ee24f6.text: Está en el hospital después de que le hayan pegado un tiro.
sense_477d5ccb3e33edb23be5eb01c5ee24f6.translation: He's in the hospital after having been shot.

sense_9c4ed0ff6939ff68aab11126ac2ebdef.text: Se vieron obligados a hacer sus necesidades en un balde.
sense_9c4ed0ff6939ff68aab11126ac2ebdef.translation: They were obliged to relieve themselves in a bucket.
Has the dog done his business?

sense_856b00233e8c15d1968d10a559514e25.text: Lo metieron preso por manejar en estado de embriaguez.
sense_856b00233e8c15d1968d10a559514e25.translation: He was jailed for drunk driving.

sense_856b00233e8c15d1968d10a559514e25.text: Creo que el marido de Maite estuvo preso por unos cinco años.
sense_856b00233e8c15d1968d10a559514e25.translation: I think Maite's husband was in prison for about five years.

sense_a96d61ac72b54312afdf2f997b3bbdbd.text: Este cuento está lleno de seres mágicos y paisajes místicos.
sense_a96d61ac72b54312afdf2f997b3bbdbd.translation: This story is full of magical beings and mystical settings.

sense_a96d61ac72b54312afdf2f997b3bbdbd.text: Al beber la poción mágica, el ogro se convirtió en el príncipe que siempre había querido ser.
sense_a96d61ac72b54312afdf2f997b3bbdbd.translation: Upon drinking the magic potion, the ogre became the prince he had always wanted to be.

sense_5a913cb3786a1c820ea4d828bc40f9de.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_5a913cb3786a1c820ea4d828bc40f9de.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_5a913cb3786a1c820ea4d828bc40f9de.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_5a913cb3786a1c820ea4d828bc40f9de.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_9fc0ddf5de73f32893930840ccfcf693.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_9fc0ddf5de73f32893930840ccfcf693.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_386b5281e1cbf9038b1d8a05f0c262b6.text: Siento afecto por ti, pero no te quiero.
sense_386b5281e1cbf9038b1d8a05f0c262b6.translation: I'm fond of you, but I don't love you.

sense_386b5281e1cbf9038b1d8a05f0c262b6.text: Claro que los gatos sienten afecto por sus dueños; yo diría que nos aman.
sense_386b5281e1cbf9038b1d8a05f0c262b6.translation: Of course cats are fond of their owners; I'd say they love us.

sense_cb1b303ebed87a2554f469a22a7dcf2a.text: Había un horror de pizza en la fiesta.
sense_cb1b303ebed87a2554f469a22a7dcf2a.translation: There was an awful lot of pizza at the party.

sense_cb1b303ebed87a2554f469a22a7dcf2a.text: Había un horror de peces varados en la playa.
sense_cb1b303ebed87a2554f469a22a7dcf2a.translation: There was a tremendous amount of fish stranded on the beach.

sense_3ebda6f0ad92d4b76d0ecd6362a4172f.text: Mi hermana me encargó sus hijos este sábado.
sense_3ebda6f0ad92d4b76d0ecd6362a4172f.translation: My sister's asked me to look after her kids on Saturday.

sense_3ebda6f0ad92d4b76d0ecd6362a4172f.text: Le encargaron conseguir un restaurante para la fiesta a Marco.
sense_3ebda6f0ad92d4b76d0ecd6362a4172f.translation: Marco was given the job of finding a restaurant for the party.

sense_a40bfd9bd2f2c29f52d5916d22883e21.text: En Ramadán, los musulmanes deben observar el ayuno durante el día.
sense_a40bfd9bd2f2c29f52d5916d22883e21.translation: In Ramadan, muslims must fast during the day while it is light.

sense_a40bfd9bd2f2c29f52d5916d22883e21.text: Me extrañó el comentario de Gloria, porque hasta ahora había observado una conducta respetuosa.
sense_a40bfd9bd2f2c29f52d5916d22883e21.translation: I was surprised by Gloria's comment because up until now she had behaved respectfully.

sense_d7cfa3b1955320f91d53e49a812a46eb.text: Pablo ama a su esposa con todo su ser.
sense_d7cfa3b1955320f91d53e49a812a46eb.translation: Pablo loves his wife with all his heart.

sense_d7cfa3b1955320f91d53e49a812a46eb.text: Yo te amo, Ana, y quiero pasar el resto de mi vida contigo.
sense_d7cfa3b1955320f91d53e49a812a46eb.translation: I love you, Ana, and I want to spend the rest of my life with you.

sense_0d8d0d0a06529701697bced5f0f08930.text: Dicen que el alcalde recibió dinero de fuentes sospechosas.
sense_0d8d0d0a06529701697bced5f0f08930.translation: They say that the mayor received money from shady sources.

sense_0d8d0d0a06529701697bced5f0f08930.text: La víctima recibió un fuerte golpe al lado de la cabeza.
sense_0d8d0d0a06529701697bced5f0f08930.translation: The victim received a strong blow to the side of the head.

sense_a57351a5ba4381834bebf5ef935a69c5.text: El equipo visitante fue recibido con silbidos y abucheos.
sense_a57351a5ba4381834bebf5ef935a69c5.translation: The visiting team was received with whistles and jeers.

sense_a57351a5ba4381834bebf5ef935a69c5.text: Nos recibió personalmente en el aeropuerto.
sense_a57351a5ba4381834bebf5ef935a69c5.translation: He personally welcomed us at the airport.

sense_3433e2ac48ade064705015049a722a19.text: Mi hermana se recibió de ingeniera en Georgia Tech.
sense_3433e2ac48ade064705015049a722a19.translation: My sister graduated as an engineer from Georgia Tech.
How many students will graduate this year?

sense_dc6ce78e5ecedb739494466385bae3cd.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_dc6ce78e5ecedb739494466385bae3cd.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_a09ef3dd22059f129d59d5d17be0e167.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_a09ef3dd22059f129d59d5d17be0e167.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_b74005b52b02d462b6f478bf0dae39b4.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_b74005b52b02d462b6f478bf0dae39b4.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_b74005b52b02d462b6f478bf0dae39b4.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_b74005b52b02d462b6f478bf0dae39b4.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_e079b1161924e3f97f85062c0ac48c42.text: Me gusta jugar al bingo por el dinero.
sense_e079b1161924e3f97f85062c0ac48c42.translation: I love playing Bingo for money.
Does anybody want to play tennis with me?

sense_98f44f27e54569e19ae29bb4654f6106.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_98f44f27e54569e19ae29bb4654f6106.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_1eb307828469a57abcf8b620336cd120.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_1eb307828469a57abcf8b620336cd120.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_1eb307828469a57abcf8b620336cd120.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_1eb307828469a57abcf8b620336cd120.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_4cb8f9ed244351dcbd73b6e77dae35f1.text: Desde luego, eres digna hija de tu madre.
sense_4cb8f9ed244351dcbd73b6e77dae35f1.translation: There's no doubt you're your mother's daughter.

sense_4cb8f9ed244351dcbd73b6e77dae35f1.text: Nada le parece digno de su categoría.

sense_42d9830d4710f62618b4c5bb5ac8d1f9.text: El gobierno se equivocó con esta medida.
sense_42d9830d4710f62618b4c5bb5ac8d1f9.translation: The government got it wrong with this policy.

sense_42d9830d4710f62618b4c5bb5ac8d1f9.text: La empresa reconoce que se equivocó con su respuesta.
sense_42d9830d4710f62618b4c5bb5ac8d1f9.translation: The company recognizes that it got its response wrong.

sense_d13bebc9081a16b8895c2a367d120be4.text: Mi madre se equivocó de tren y, por consiguiente, no llegó aquí hasta la una de la madrugada.
sense_d13bebc9081a16b8895c2a367d120be4.translation: My mother got on the wrong train and, as a result, she didn't get here till one in the morning.

sense_d13bebc9081a16b8895c2a367d120be4.text: Te equivocaste de mes. El cumpleaños de Fernando es el dos de julio y no el dos de junio.
sense_d13bebc9081a16b8895c2a367d120be4.translation: You got the month wrong. Fernando's birthday is the second of July not the second of June.

sense_5827dc86dc005e5ab567f4d50cd509ac.text: Se me perdió la pareja de este arete.
sense_5827dc86dc005e5ab567f4d50cd509ac.translation: I've lost the earring that goes with this one.

sense_5827dc86dc005e5ab567f4d50cd509ac.text: ¿Por qué solo llevas un calcetín? - No encuentro la pareja.
sense_5827dc86dc005e5ab567f4d50cd509ac.translation: Why are you only wearing one sock? - I can't find the other one.

sense_5c4f57a8d38d70df28f94757bcbf33a8.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_5c4f57a8d38d70df28f94757bcbf33a8.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_5c4f57a8d38d70df28f94757bcbf33a8.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_5c4f57a8d38d70df28f94757bcbf33a8.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_feddca9758e18268afb657ff6f8988a8.text: Armó un follón cuando compré una marca diferente de cereal.
sense_feddca9758e18268afb657ff6f8988a8.translation: She kicked up a real fuss when I bought a different brand of cereal.

sense_feddca9758e18268afb657ff6f8988a8.text: El comportamiento del cantante en el restaurante ha armado un gran escándalo.
sense_feddca9758e18268afb657ff6f8988a8.translation: The behavior of the singer in the restaurant has caused a big scandal.

sense_d1ed55aa5ee385ba666247b38fe6aafc.text: Se armó una discusión sobre quién iba a tomar la última galleta.
sense_d1ed55aa5ee385ba666247b38fe6aafc.translation: An argument broke out over who was going to get the last cookie.

sense_d1ed55aa5ee385ba666247b38fe6aafc.text: Ni te imaginas el lío que se armó cuando despidieron a nuestro jefe.
sense_d1ed55aa5ee385ba666247b38fe6aafc.translation: You can't even imagine the chaos that went down when our boss was fired.

sense_cf40810109d673e699dfef9bf21e8745.text: ¡Apártate de mí! No quiero verte nunca más.
sense_cf40810109d673e699dfef9bf21e8745.translation: Get away from me! I don't want to see you again.

sense_cf40810109d673e699dfef9bf21e8745.text: Apártense de la estufa; está caliente.
sense_cf40810109d673e699dfef9bf21e8745.translation: Get away from the stove; it's hot.

sense_ec34d20d5805b8dfa8798f850c650688.text: Me ofrecieron su ayuda para el traslado.
sense_ec34d20d5805b8dfa8798f850c650688.translation: They offered to help me with the move.

sense_ec34d20d5805b8dfa8798f850c650688.text: Tengo confianza que me ofrecerán el trabajo.
sense_ec34d20d5805b8dfa8798f850c650688.translation: I'm confident they'll offer me the job.

sense_1473d51ae904a5feeb3351e8aa59cfdf.text: Creo que esto es lo que conviene hacer.
sense_1473d51ae904a5feeb3351e8aa59cfdf.translation: I think this is what we should do.

sense_1473d51ae904a5feeb3351e8aa59cfdf.text: Conviene que no se pierda de vista lo que queremos conseguir.
sense_1473d51ae904a5feeb3351e8aa59cfdf.translation: We should not lose sight of what we want to achieve.

sense_7a09f8239b0346aa1c639472d2d1beaa.text: A Enrique le podría convenir probar estos remedios naturales.
sense_7a09f8239b0346aa1c639472d2d1beaa.translation: Enrique might find it worth his while trying these natural remedies
I could do with some relaxation.

sense_a214b46eb643f7f85359828117fbf90c.text: Vendo libro de segunda mano. Precio a convenir.
sense_a214b46eb643f7f85359828117fbf90c.translation: Second-hand book for sale. Price negotiable.

sense_a214b46eb643f7f85359828117fbf90c.text: Horario a convenir entre la empresa y el estudiante.
sense_a214b46eb643f7f85359828117fbf90c.translation: Hours to be agreed between the company and the student.

sense_35fa98d766e8f91e034056db2b19fe5e.text: Cómo me desespera el tráfico en esta ciudad.
sense_35fa98d766e8f91e034056db2b19fe5e.translation: The traffic in this city drives me crazy.

sense_35fa98d766e8f91e034056db2b19fe5e.text: La lentitud de mi conexión de Internet me desespera.
sense_35fa98d766e8f91e034056db2b19fe5e.translation: The slowness of my Internet connection drives me crazy.

sense_61feb9c4e41e281f6dbd430c0dca55bf.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_61feb9c4e41e281f6dbd430c0dca55bf.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_58ad7facad4eac11020818df437582ed.text: El cuerpo humano está formado por millones de células.
sense_58ad7facad4eac11020818df437582ed.translation: The human body is made up of millions of cells.

sense_58ad7facad4eac11020818df437582ed.text: El núcleo de la célula contiene su ácido desoxirribonucleico.
sense_58ad7facad4eac11020818df437582ed.translation: The nucleus of the cell contains its deoxyribonucleic acid.

sense_cc070c77c71bb0181cd02572feb2d5e1.text: "No hay nada que temer", dijo el mago.
sense_cc070c77c71bb0181cd02572feb2d5e1.translation: "There's nothing to fear," said the magician.

sense_cc070c77c71bb0181cd02572feb2d5e1.text: "Yo no le temo a la muerte", dijo el temerario motociclista.
sense_cc070c77c71bb0181cd02572feb2d5e1.translation: "I don't fear death," said the daredevil motorcyclist.

sense_8d27d30be20211b708813e2072ecba44.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_8d27d30be20211b708813e2072ecba44.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_8d27d30be20211b708813e2072ecba44.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_8d27d30be20211b708813e2072ecba44.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_1cff0bed95ce5a2e8b832b40ad64ffb7.translation: Put your money away. It's my treat.
Have a drink. It's on us.

sense_3ded2d2e866c4ea1c33bc42427c42006.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_3ded2d2e866c4ea1c33bc42427c42006.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_3ded2d2e866c4ea1c33bc42427c42006.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_3ded2d2e866c4ea1c33bc42427c42006.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_900879df2fec8352ccd849cfaad0699d.text: La revolución separó el partido en dos facciones.
sense_900879df2fec8352ccd849cfaad0699d.translation: The revolution separated the party into two factions.

sense_900879df2fec8352ccd849cfaad0699d.text: Separé la clase en grupos de cuatro alumnos cada uno.
sense_900879df2fec8352ccd849cfaad0699d.translation: I divided the class into groups of four students each.

sense_f7e3a7ae2708605b0c32c89dda8b5444.text: Un ala se separó del transbordador espacial al entrar la atmósfera de la tierra.
sense_f7e3a7ae2708605b0c32c89dda8b5444.translation: A wing came off the space shuttle upon entering the Earth's atmosphere.

sense_f7e3a7ae2708605b0c32c89dda8b5444.text: Durante una tormenta, una rama se separó del árbol y cayó encima de mi automóvil.
sense_f7e3a7ae2708605b0c32c89dda8b5444.translation: A branch of the tree was ripped off during a storm and landed on my car.

sense_244ac1a09d721c6d6d8bbf794aa3b27a.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_244ac1a09d721c6d6d8bbf794aa3b27a.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_244ac1a09d721c6d6d8bbf794aa3b27a.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_244ac1a09d721c6d6d8bbf794aa3b27a.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_e38d61aa7586a0785b057fd851f82121.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_e38d61aa7586a0785b057fd851f82121.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_e38d61aa7586a0785b057fd851f82121.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_e38d61aa7586a0785b057fd851f82121.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_524b97a4153ff779b95d517ab3043304.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_50499f61030174a7a7f14e1299f5bf36.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_50499f61030174a7a7f14e1299f5bf36.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_50499f61030174a7a7f14e1299f5bf36.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_50499f61030174a7a7f14e1299f5bf36.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_c68f542c454e10f2073cc8d2706afec9.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_c68f542c454e10f2073cc8d2706afec9.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_c68f542c454e10f2073cc8d2706afec9.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_c68f542c454e10f2073cc8d2706afec9.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_4af2d8845ceaaadcf8e4042e6ddf3673.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_4af2d8845ceaaadcf8e4042e6ddf3673.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_3d78fd5be5fdc1de7468fc7d27051a00.text: El programa era tan aburrido que me dormí.
sense_3d78fd5be5fdc1de7468fc7d27051a00.translation: The program was so boring that I fell asleep.

sense_3d78fd5be5fdc1de7468fc7d27051a00.text: Me dormí a las 6 de la mañana.
sense_3d78fd5be5fdc1de7468fc7d27051a00.translation: I fell asleep at 6 in the morning.

sense_5c9cb16dcd6178263a3988cd3bc218cc.text: No te duermas o no acabarás a tiempo.
sense_5c9cb16dcd6178263a3988cd3bc218cc.translation: Don't slack off or you won't finish in time.

sense_5c9cb16dcd6178263a3988cd3bc218cc.text: Por dormirse se perdió la clave para ganar el premio.
sense_5c9cb16dcd6178263a3988cd3bc218cc.translation: He missed the clue to win the prize because he didn't stay on his toes.

sense_3941dbf4c43c0fa58841c404a6e6a0a0.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_f2b141f23ea315581abe34b4b2a33e82.text: Intenté varias veces pero no fue posible establecer la comunicación.
sense_f2b141f23ea315581abe34b4b2a33e82.translation: I tried several times but I couldn't get through.

sense_f2b141f23ea315581abe34b4b2a33e82.text: Recibí una llamada pero se cortó la comunicación y no supe quién era.
sense_f2b141f23ea315581abe34b4b2a33e82.translation: I had a call but it was cut off so I don't know who it was.

sense_c5848bb3c4ebb3da0fed02ddd42e6ec9.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_c5848bb3c4ebb3da0fed02ddd42e6ec9.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_c5848bb3c4ebb3da0fed02ddd42e6ec9.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_c5848bb3c4ebb3da0fed02ddd42e6ec9.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_ac0b9befc5dd663f3af4b50c90075327.translation: I think he's Italian. - I suspected as much!

sense_ac0b9befc5dd663f3af4b50c90075327.text: La señora Jones sospecha que su esposo le es infiel.
sense_ac0b9befc5dd663f3af4b50c90075327.translation: Mrs. Jones suspects that her husband is cheating on her.

sense_dba13f64bdd426c096d644acdab00974.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_dba13f64bdd426c096d644acdab00974.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_dba13f64bdd426c096d644acdab00974.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_dba13f64bdd426c096d644acdab00974.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_dc8f907c0dbb12dfd0895d1f9a212bd1.text: El alumno escribió su ensayo de 20 páginas en una noche.
sense_dc8f907c0dbb12dfd0895d1f9a212bd1.translation: The student wrote his 20-page essay in one night.

sense_4f95665adcdfe516a9e891c7b8d7cb76.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_4f95665adcdfe516a9e891c7b8d7cb76.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_73d93646d040188fbbf9977e99d0f4e1.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_73d93646d040188fbbf9977e99d0f4e1.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_89ffb9e9ac8275e3742059f1cba1df63.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_89ffb9e9ac8275e3742059f1cba1df63.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_89ffb9e9ac8275e3742059f1cba1df63.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_89ffb9e9ac8275e3742059f1cba1df63.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_2246fbd715434ec15955ec1c14097725.text: Mi hermana me encargó sus hijos este sábado.
sense_2246fbd715434ec15955ec1c14097725.translation: My sister's asked me to look after her kids on Saturday.

sense_2246fbd715434ec15955ec1c14097725.text: Le encargaron conseguir un restaurante para la fiesta a Marco.
sense_2246fbd715434ec15955ec1c14097725.translation: Marco was given the job of finding a restaurant for the party.

sense_9df4ef831e3cceffa08c14c3a4d56ddf.text: El Dr. Howard recetó antibióticos para la infección.
sense_9df4ef831e3cceffa08c14c3a4d56ddf.translation: Dr. Howard prescribed antibiotics for the infection.

sense_9df4ef831e3cceffa08c14c3a4d56ddf.text: ¿El doctor te recetó algo para tu dolor de espalda?
sense_9df4ef831e3cceffa08c14c3a4d56ddf.translation: Did the doctor prescribe you anything for your back pain?

sense_314b6d51011ce4b6a87cb49e16e3b5de.text: Todavía está mojada. Ten cuidado que no te pinte.
sense_314b6d51011ce4b6a87cb49e16e3b5de.translation: It’s still wet. Be careful you don't get any on you.

sense_314b6d51011ce4b6a87cb49e16e3b5de.text: Se rompió mi pluma y me pintó la manos totalmente de azul.
sense_314b6d51011ce4b6a87cb49e16e3b5de.translation: My pen broke and got blue ink all over my hands.

sense_8c303c51917c37636538bf80a0d5b3c7.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_5083701e5e58aaa5fd9b5a1311c86acb.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_5083701e5e58aaa5fd9b5a1311c86acb.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_5083701e5e58aaa5fd9b5a1311c86acb.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_5083701e5e58aaa5fd9b5a1311c86acb.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_61e2aaa1d45b6a2f2cc86af0df8571a0.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_61e2aaa1d45b6a2f2cc86af0df8571a0.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_61e2aaa1d45b6a2f2cc86af0df8571a0.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_61e2aaa1d45b6a2f2cc86af0df8571a0.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_a26ca78b516451e56243fe84a3dff4e7.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_a26ca78b516451e56243fe84a3dff4e7.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_8d466fb35106ab7eeb605f95ba1bf8e8.text: En casa no somos muy comedores.
sense_8d466fb35106ab7eeb605f95ba1bf8e8.translation: We aren't big eaters at home.

sense_4a007ee6d879878be0f8e24cfb4cd857.text: La chica estaba vendiendo naranjas en el mercado.
sense_4a007ee6d879878be0f8e24cfb4cd857.translation: The girl was selling oranges in the market.

sense_7a93b8ea129bdb22e5b726ab7309a9ca.text: Nadie se va a beneficiar de estas reformas.
Habrá nuevos servicios de los que se beneficiarán miles de familias.
sense_7a93b8ea129bdb22e5b726ab7309a9ca.translation: There will be new services that will benefit thousands of families.

sense_eb9fe4d1daed30631c3eee45e17e442c.text: De los rosales del jardín han brotado capullos nuevos.
sense_eb9fe4d1daed30631c3eee45e17e442c.translation: There are some new buds on the rose bushes in the garden.

sense_eb9fe4d1daed30631c3eee45e17e442c.text: Le salieron capullos al rosal que está al lado de la reja.
sense_eb9fe4d1daed30631c3eee45e17e442c.translation: Buds have come out on the rose bush that's by the gate.

sense_5c9460e354a9c3e8908067d5b56ebfaf.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_5c9460e354a9c3e8908067d5b56ebfaf.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_5c9460e354a9c3e8908067d5b56ebfaf.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_5c9460e354a9c3e8908067d5b56ebfaf.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_075d6a02dead003630943b5cdbc34d8c.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_075d6a02dead003630943b5cdbc34d8c.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_075d6a02dead003630943b5cdbc34d8c.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_075d6a02dead003630943b5cdbc34d8c.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_85bc77c6847f1a565a14f46e0c1c8afb.text: Los niños de la vecina son muy bien enseñados.
sense_85bc77c6847f1a565a14f46e0c1c8afb.translation: The neighbors' children are very well brought up.

sense_85bc77c6847f1a565a14f46e0c1c8afb.text: No soporto a los niños mal enseñados.
sense_85bc77c6847f1a565a14f46e0c1c8afb.translation: I can't stand badly brought-up children.

sense_89a95a86f572ee71442e27d1e283f62c.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_89a95a86f572ee71442e27d1e283f62c.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_3c6df15f2b05ede0c8166e2ee5358567.text: Ya casi llegas. Estás muy cerca. ¡Caliente, caliente!
sense_3c6df15f2b05ede0c8166e2ee5358567.translation: You're almost there. You're really close. You're getting warm!

sense_c6add048ca422aeb40be728f1d38326c.text: Dicen que el alcalde recibió dinero de fuentes sospechosas.
sense_c6add048ca422aeb40be728f1d38326c.translation: They say that the mayor received money from shady sources.

sense_c6add048ca422aeb40be728f1d38326c.text: La víctima recibió un fuerte golpe al lado de la cabeza.
sense_c6add048ca422aeb40be728f1d38326c.translation: The victim received a strong blow to the side of the head.

sense_125f21a6b4d202217016235e1bc6b49a.text: El equipo visitante fue recibido con silbidos y abucheos.
sense_125f21a6b4d202217016235e1bc6b49a.translation: The visiting team was received with whistles and jeers.

sense_125f21a6b4d202217016235e1bc6b49a.text: Nos recibió personalmente en el aeropuerto.
sense_125f21a6b4d202217016235e1bc6b49a.translation: He personally welcomed us at the airport.

sense_f6eca6bf02d51eb167c770875cb3908a.text: Mi hermana se recibió de ingeniera en Georgia Tech.
sense_f6eca6bf02d51eb167c770875cb3908a.translation: My sister graduated as an engineer from Georgia Tech.
How many students will graduate this year?

sense_22d2f1793813d9490f8105d22fbd831e.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_22d2f1793813d9490f8105d22fbd831e.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_22d2f1793813d9490f8105d22fbd831e.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_22d2f1793813d9490f8105d22fbd831e.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_8e2464ee59cb0b447f6fa88ea618a26e.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_8e2464ee59cb0b447f6fa88ea618a26e.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_8e2464ee59cb0b447f6fa88ea618a26e.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_8e2464ee59cb0b447f6fa88ea618a26e.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_cccd7ab3bf7b43d586ae2dd9c2748dce.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_cccd7ab3bf7b43d586ae2dd9c2748dce.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_cccd7ab3bf7b43d586ae2dd9c2748dce.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_cccd7ab3bf7b43d586ae2dd9c2748dce.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_e953ea9c6ebb0517dfe407027581ed12.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_e953ea9c6ebb0517dfe407027581ed12.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_daccfd1574ead816f61e5b8bb7837e87.text: Le sobra improvisación y le falta método.
sense_daccfd1574ead816f61e5b8bb7837e87.translation: He improvises too much and is not methodical enough.

sense_daccfd1574ead816f61e5b8bb7837e87.text: Para diagnosticar una enfermedad es necesario proceder con método.
sense_daccfd1574ead816f61e5b8bb7837e87.translation: In order to diagnose a disease you need to proceed methodically.

sense_67ddc2b65316b6f4cd1d0c26188f6382.text: Uno de los motores falló y el piloto tuvo que hacer un aterrizaje forzoso.
sense_67ddc2b65316b6f4cd1d0c26188f6382.translation: One of the jet engines failed, and the pilot had to make an emergency landing.

sense_67ddc2b65316b6f4cd1d0c26188f6382.text: La asistente de vuelo les pidió a los pasajeros abrocharse los cinturones y prepararse para el aterrizaje.
sense_67ddc2b65316b6f4cd1d0c26188f6382.translation: The flight attendant asked the passengers to fasten their seat belts and prepare for landing.

sense_8e725f9aadbda4b4adf813e869dd62a8.text: Tuvimos que quedarnos en casa porque estaba cayendo un chaparrón.
sense_8e725f9aadbda4b4adf813e869dd62a8.translation: We had to stay home because it was pouring rain.

sense_8e725f9aadbda4b4adf813e869dd62a8.text: Está cayendo una buena nevada. Ponle las cadenas a las ruedas.
sense_8e725f9aadbda4b4adf813e869dd62a8.translation: It's snowing hard. Put the chains on the tires.

sense_01074c661c43afaf3a2ecefa0288dc76.text: No bebo porque el alcohol me cae mal.
sense_01074c661c43afaf3a2ecefa0288dc76.translation: I don't drink because alcohol disagrees with me.
You look great in that dress!

sense_88d0b2c8fd126dc47da13d0040ea41d7.text: Me cae muy bien tu hermano; siempre me hace sonreír.
sense_88d0b2c8fd126dc47da13d0040ea41d7.translation: I really like your brother; he always makes me smile.

sense_88d0b2c8fd126dc47da13d0040ea41d7.text: Me marché porque me cae mal tu primo con sus bromas ofensivas.
sense_88d0b2c8fd126dc47da13d0040ea41d7.translation: I had to leave because I can't stand your cousin and his offensive jokes.

sense_806be1b08de05b5443960493221b8eb3.text: Que Harvard la hubiera rechazado, le cayó mal.
sense_806be1b08de05b5443960493221b8eb3.translation: She wasn't pleased that Harvard rejected her.

sense_806be1b08de05b5443960493221b8eb3.text: El embarazo de mi hermana pequeña no cayó bien en la familia.
sense_806be1b08de05b5443960493221b8eb3.translation: My little sister's pregnancy shocked the entire family.

sense_437b58dd33fec3d77bf059964c49be51.text: Mi bebé está llorando porque se cae de sueño.
sense_437b58dd33fec3d77bf059964c49be51.translation: My baby is crying because he's very sleepy.

sense_437b58dd33fec3d77bf059964c49be51.text: Me caigo de cansancio, pero tengo que estudiar para el examen de mañana.
sense_437b58dd33fec3d77bf059964c49be51.translation: I am really tired, but I have to study for tomorrow's exam.

sense_78672d946567b4803d704b4b921c6126.translation: The revolution separated the party into two factions.

sense_272093521c209b1c8510c36b007b46f6.translation: I don't drink because alcohol disagrees with me.

sense_80af86d5ad0eebbd6db7f67d2839d528.translation: I had to leave because I can't stand your cousin and his offensive jokes.

sense_97fdfaf358afa58791d2b9b210a28376.text: Que Harvard la hubiera rechazado, le cayó mal.
sense_97fdfaf358afa58791d2b9b210a28376.translation: She wasn't pleased that Harvard rejected her.

sense_97fdfaf358afa58791d2b9b210a28376.text: El embarazo de mi hermana pequeña no cayó bien en la familia.
sense_97fdfaf358afa58791d2b9b210a28376.translation: My little sister's pregnancy shocked the entire family.

sense_93d4fe984ce08da4f9ecb52fce9dd616.text: Mi bebé está llorando porque se cae de sueño.
sense_93d4fe984ce08da4f9ecb52fce9dd616.translation: My baby is crying because he's very sleepy.

sense_93d4fe984ce08da4f9ecb52fce9dd616.text: Me caigo de cansancio, pero tengo que estudiar para el examen de mañana.
sense_93d4fe984ce08da4f9ecb52fce9dd616.translation: I am really tired, but I have to study for tomorrow's exam.

sense_35e26fb110b452ee9380cad10b094510.text: Fue un trago para nosotros cuando se murió mi abuelo.
sense_35e26fb110b452ee9380cad10b094510.translation: It was a hard for us when my grandfather passed.

sense_35e26fb110b452ee9380cad10b094510.text: Vivir en una ciudad sin buena transportación pública fue un trago.
sense_35e26fb110b452ee9380cad10b094510.translation: Living in a city without good public transportation was terrible.

sense_3016ea697f27cfa2947865664da6128d.text: No me molesta que fumen, pero no en plena cara.
sense_3016ea697f27cfa2947865664da6128d.translation: I don't mind them smoking, but not right in my face.

sense_3016ea697f27cfa2947865664da6128d.text: Desviar el tráfico en plena temporada turística fue una mala idea.
sense_3016ea697f27cfa2947865664da6128d.translation: Diverting the traffic at the height of the tourist season was a bad idea.

sense_8926c339550388fc36e3a98f94d08df6.text: El museo presentó una gran exposición de las obras del pintor.
sense_8926c339550388fc36e3a98f94d08df6.translation: The museum hosted a large exhibition of the painter's work.

sense_8926c339550388fc36e3a98f94d08df6.text: La nueva exposición en el Museo Nacional de Arte celebra al muralista y pintor mexicano Diego Rivera.
sense_8926c339550388fc36e3a98f94d08df6.translation: The new exhibition at the National Art Museum celebrates the Mexican muralist and painter Diego Rivera.

sense_3b5dc2e0548bc57fa66c9dbf28c62a84.text: Con la exposición de una estrategia clara, el gobierno espera ganarse votantes.
sense_3b5dc2e0548bc57fa66c9dbf28c62a84.translation: By setting out a clear strategy, the government hopes to win over voters.

sense_3b5dc2e0548bc57fa66c9dbf28c62a84.text: El autor construye una realidad compleja para hacer la exposición de sus ideas.
sense_3b5dc2e0548bc57fa66c9dbf28c62a84.translation: The author constructs a complex reality to set out his ideas.

sense_901f7da09852eba559ace4dd16de36c1.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_901f7da09852eba559ace4dd16de36c1.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_ac358839fe1b4c358643d9f87ced7eaa.text: Las autoridades enfrentaron al sospechoso tan pronto como lo encontraron.
sense_ac358839fe1b4c358643d9f87ced7eaa.translation: The authorities confronted the suspect as soon as they found him.

sense_ac358839fe1b4c358643d9f87ced7eaa.text: Tienes que enfrentar tus miedos si quieres avanzar en la vida.
sense_ac358839fe1b4c358643d9f87ced7eaa.translation: You have to confront your fears if you want to advance in life.

sense_854322030dd6180457a6a504014564ba.text: No puede comer pastel porque sufre de diabetes.
sense_854322030dd6180457a6a504014564ba.translation: He can't eat cake because he suffers from diabetes.

sense_854322030dd6180457a6a504014564ba.text: Mejor corta comunicación con él, no quieres que sufra más.
sense_854322030dd6180457a6a504014564ba.translation: You'd better cut off communication with him, you don't want him to suffer anymore.

sense_d2a966a4e26dcdd3a6e25e51c736f8db.translation: I don't want to see you again. Go to hell!
If you ask me, she can go to hell.

sense_bd3eac768ad6dcbb89edeadc27d6e2e1.text: Sus continuas quejas terminaron pudriendo a su esposa.
sense_bd3eac768ad6dcbb89edeadc27d6e2e1.translation: His wife finally became fed up with his endless complaints.
I'm fed up with his stupidity.

sense_3ac1fac243e7131fbe7b265636ea016c.text: Si vienes conmigo a esa reunión, vas a pudrirte.
sense_3ac1fac243e7131fbe7b265636ea016c.translation: If you come with me to that meeting, you are going to die of boredom.

sense_3ac1fac243e7131fbe7b265636ea016c.text: Dejó a la novia porque se pudrió de sus demandas continuas.
sense_3ac1fac243e7131fbe7b265636ea016c.translation: He left his girlfriend because he got sick and tired of her constant demands.

sense_310b2645688b49811cea13237328c41e.text: La peli era malísima; solo se salvaba el actor principal.
sense_310b2645688b49811cea13237328c41e.translation: The film was really bad; the main actor was the only one who was ok.

sense_310b2645688b49811cea13237328c41e.text: Los considero a todos unos vagos; no se salva nadie.
sense_310b2645688b49811cea13237328c41e.translation: I consider them all lazy, without exception.

sense_c05d50a99c0c48e7c7484044929370f7.text: Mi novio conectó de maravilla con mis padres.
sense_c05d50a99c0c48e7c7484044929370f7.translation: My boyfriend really clicked with my parents.

sense_c05d50a99c0c48e7c7484044929370f7.text: Federica conecta rápidamente con los niños; los hace reír en cuestión de minutos.
sense_c05d50a99c0c48e7c7484044929370f7.translation: Federica is an instant hit with children; she has them laughing in a matter of minutes.

sense_474bb7adff7b33ea6c07f6c0686458e9.text: Viaje con nosotros para conectar rápidamente con todas las ciudades europeas.
sense_474bb7adff7b33ea6c07f6c0686458e9.translation: Travel with us to connect fast with all European cities.

sense_474bb7adff7b33ea6c07f6c0686458e9.text: Compramos el billete equivocado; este vuelo no conecta con el de Bangkok.
sense_474bb7adff7b33ea6c07f6c0686458e9.translation: We bought the wrong ticket; this flight doesn't connect with the Bangkok one.

sense_276b17062e8dea33ec54940892ef183b.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_276b17062e8dea33ec54940892ef183b.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_276b17062e8dea33ec54940892ef183b.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_276b17062e8dea33ec54940892ef183b.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_2f30999d5dd868a58d9c8af5ea040813.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_2f30999d5dd868a58d9c8af5ea040813.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_2f30999d5dd868a58d9c8af5ea040813.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_2f30999d5dd868a58d9c8af5ea040813.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_a4145dd713f321b933e20a0c29479514.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_a4145dd713f321b933e20a0c29479514.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_a4145dd713f321b933e20a0c29479514.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_a4145dd713f321b933e20a0c29479514.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_84b2222e9b4f5869ae3c2de27d3085df.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_84b2222e9b4f5869ae3c2de27d3085df.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_84b2222e9b4f5869ae3c2de27d3085df.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_84b2222e9b4f5869ae3c2de27d3085df.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_44519c7b65afede02e6eb9259c340ea7.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_f1e43ee5312b599a6f4b03b14b2c23b1.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_f1e43ee5312b599a6f4b03b14b2c23b1.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_f1e43ee5312b599a6f4b03b14b2c23b1.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_f1e43ee5312b599a6f4b03b14b2c23b1.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_e488d0838c214b9851a368470223e9c9.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_e488d0838c214b9851a368470223e9c9.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_e488d0838c214b9851a368470223e9c9.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_e488d0838c214b9851a368470223e9c9.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_d5a31882629f8ffc88ffc72fc783f833.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_d5a31882629f8ffc88ffc72fc783f833.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_d5a31882629f8ffc88ffc72fc783f833.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_d5a31882629f8ffc88ffc72fc783f833.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_0aabd5e7ff94dbb2ce362f0c945272c6.text: El brujo realizó un conjuro para ahuyentar el mal de ojo.
sense_0aabd5e7ff94dbb2ce362f0c945272c6.translation: The wizard made a spell to ward off the evil eye.

sense_0aabd5e7ff94dbb2ce362f0c945272c6.text: Estas tierras son gobernadas por el brujo malvado que vive en aquella torre.
sense_0aabd5e7ff94dbb2ce362f0c945272c6.translation: These lands are ruled by the evil wizard who lives in that tower.

sense_48768cdd1698651446b5c5ea9717708e.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_48768cdd1698651446b5c5ea9717708e.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_48768cdd1698651446b5c5ea9717708e.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_48768cdd1698651446b5c5ea9717708e.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_5b74fe49610c42d5cab9c7b50bad6b52.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_5b74fe49610c42d5cab9c7b50bad6b52.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_5b74fe49610c42d5cab9c7b50bad6b52.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_5b74fe49610c42d5cab9c7b50bad6b52.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_d6c699a4078a2c6a2d7cdaa2ddc61cc5.text: No puede comer pastel porque sufre de diabetes.
sense_d6c699a4078a2c6a2d7cdaa2ddc61cc5.translation: He can't eat cake because he suffers from diabetes.

sense_d6c699a4078a2c6a2d7cdaa2ddc61cc5.text: Mejor corta comunicación con él, no quieres que sufra más.
sense_d6c699a4078a2c6a2d7cdaa2ddc61cc5.translation: You'd better cut off communication with him, you don't want him to suffer anymore.

sense_3f891094070fa3b69450706b1ef98ba0.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_3f891094070fa3b69450706b1ef98ba0.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_3f891094070fa3b69450706b1ef98ba0.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_3f891094070fa3b69450706b1ef98ba0.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_1832a3b0516ae288ebf2db1dbf402d88.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_1832a3b0516ae288ebf2db1dbf402d88.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_1832a3b0516ae288ebf2db1dbf402d88.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_1832a3b0516ae288ebf2db1dbf402d88.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_67d915714f7d719b792ff666a21db1c2.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_67d915714f7d719b792ff666a21db1c2.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_67d915714f7d719b792ff666a21db1c2.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_67d915714f7d719b792ff666a21db1c2.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_22d58c6177c240f88c9e3fe5d3b7129c.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_22d58c6177c240f88c9e3fe5d3b7129c.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_22d58c6177c240f88c9e3fe5d3b7129c.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_22d58c6177c240f88c9e3fe5d3b7129c.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_b5bca0da021b498c17c6f56661befa60.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_b5bca0da021b498c17c6f56661befa60.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_b5bca0da021b498c17c6f56661befa60.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_b5bca0da021b498c17c6f56661befa60.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_121ef7a1370b3e11ecb70629fb715c29.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_121ef7a1370b3e11ecb70629fb715c29.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_121ef7a1370b3e11ecb70629fb715c29.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_121ef7a1370b3e11ecb70629fb715c29.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_f71592d277fa0934faf3f7f726accc06.text: La comida maravillosa del restaurante se une a la decoración modernista lujosa.
sense_f71592d277fa0934faf3f7f726accc06.translation: The restaurant's fantastic food is complemented by their luxurious modernist decor.

sense_f71592d277fa0934faf3f7f726accc06.text: Ese tipo es un trabajador fantástico. En él se unen la confianza y la habilidad.
sense_f71592d277fa0934faf3f7f726accc06.translation: That guy's a fantastic worker. He's the epitome of confidence and skill.

sense_387022a5d650a6d9d5a15d0412d4dc22.text: En Ramadán, los musulmanes deben observar el ayuno durante el día.
sense_387022a5d650a6d9d5a15d0412d4dc22.translation: In Ramadan, muslims must fast during the day while it is light.

sense_387022a5d650a6d9d5a15d0412d4dc22.text: Me extrañó el comentario de Gloria, porque hasta ahora había observado una conducta respetuosa.
sense_387022a5d650a6d9d5a15d0412d4dc22.translation: I was surprised by Gloria's comment because up until now she had behaved respectfully.

sense_115034a5707d9243389a3e661b4ce2b4.text: La comida maravillosa del restaurante se une a la decoración modernista lujosa.
sense_115034a5707d9243389a3e661b4ce2b4.translation: The restaurant's fantastic food is complemented by their luxurious modernist decor.

sense_115034a5707d9243389a3e661b4ce2b4.text: Ese tipo es un trabajador fantástico. En él se unen la confianza y la habilidad.
sense_115034a5707d9243389a3e661b4ce2b4.translation: That guy's a fantastic worker. He's the epitome of confidence and skill.

sense_606622a4d7a921d2cfe9e53c45a3121d.text: El levante del viernes me persigue porque quiere otra cita.
sense_606622a4d7a921d2cfe9e53c45a3121d.translation: The guy I picked up on Friday keeps chasing me for another date.

sense_606622a4d7a921d2cfe9e53c45a3121d.text: Tienes que decirle a ese levante tuyo que se vaya.
sense_606622a4d7a921d2cfe9e53c45a3121d.translation: You need to tell that guy you picked up to get out.

sense_c75be66448219132339299daa1e165b2.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_c75be66448219132339299daa1e165b2.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_c75be66448219132339299daa1e165b2.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_c75be66448219132339299daa1e165b2.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_ea89fa52a1e85ad31c52cd12a0334239.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_ea89fa52a1e85ad31c52cd12a0334239.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_ea89fa52a1e85ad31c52cd12a0334239.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_ea89fa52a1e85ad31c52cd12a0334239.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_d8533bee53c4d7aff938cc50eab0de13.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_d8533bee53c4d7aff938cc50eab0de13.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_c57ae6f4952ce1e5a4f1f041a9245d9f.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_c57ae6f4952ce1e5a4f1f041a9245d9f.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_c57ae6f4952ce1e5a4f1f041a9245d9f.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_c57ae6f4952ce1e5a4f1f041a9245d9f.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_4c393761f65842b2375e28b5ae147c4a.text: Se encontró rodeada por taxis en Times Square.
sense_4c393761f65842b2375e28b5ae147c4a.translation: She found herself surrounded by taxis in Time Square.

sense_4c393761f65842b2375e28b5ae147c4a.text: Se asustó al ver que estaba rodeado de tiburones.
sense_4c393761f65842b2375e28b5ae147c4a.translation: He was startled to see that he was surrounded by sharks.

sense_98933e262061d1eb792be7fa7dd17c5c.translation: I just want to make you happy.
What do you want for Christmas?

sense_51bbaef8b91470e11db5b432809972d8.translation: "How can I help you?," asked the butler.
Would you like something to drink?

sense_05fcfe69137c69b6181874128e814ce1.text: Cuando vio el ratón, pegó un grito.
sense_05fcfe69137c69b6181874128e814ce1.translation: When she saw the mouse, she screamed.

sense_05fcfe69137c69b6181874128e814ce1.text: Está en el hospital después de que le hayan pegado un tiro.
sense_05fcfe69137c69b6181874128e814ce1.translation: He's in the hospital after having been shot.

sense_4b5641e1ffe7b2db10032ee74d201ce3.text: A mi parecer, es un tema que no admite discusión.
sense_4b5641e1ffe7b2db10032ee74d201ce3.translation: In my opinion, there's no arguing on the subject.

sense_4b5641e1ffe7b2db10032ee74d201ce3.text: La fiesta de este año no admite comparación con ninguna otra.
sense_4b5641e1ffe7b2db10032ee74d201ce3.translation: This year's party defies comparison with any other.

sense_3360825a87e6ebba610610631acd64aa.text: Ella es una joven promesa del arte de escultura.
sense_3360825a87e6ebba610610631acd64aa.translation: She brings such young talent to the art of sculpture.

sense_3360825a87e6ebba610610631acd64aa.text: Villarroel es nuestra promesa del equipo boliviano de fútbol.
sense_3360825a87e6ebba610610631acd64aa.translation: Villarroel is our new hope for the Bolivian football team.

sense_c16a47c39a348a877ac6b7fa2e5a0ad9.text: Hay tres millones de dólares en mercancía dentro de este camión.
sense_c16a47c39a348a877ac6b7fa2e5a0ad9.translation: There's three million dollars' worth of merchandise in this truck.

sense_c16a47c39a348a877ac6b7fa2e5a0ad9.text: Por fortuna, la bodega no tenía mercancía cuando sucedió el incendio.
sense_c16a47c39a348a877ac6b7fa2e5a0ad9.translation: Fortunately, there was no merchandise in the warehouse when the fire broke out.

sense_cdffa684971b518a3c7429038632d425.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_cdffa684971b518a3c7429038632d425.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_cdffa684971b518a3c7429038632d425.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_cdffa684971b518a3c7429038632d425.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_2981b33a3d7e2b6ce679940cad65a7a8.text: ¿Están pensando tú y Jorge en tener un bebe?
sense_2981b33a3d7e2b6ce679940cad65a7a8.translation: Are you and Jorge planning to have a baby?

sense_2981b33a3d7e2b6ce679940cad65a7a8.text: La mujer sostenía una beba recién nacida entre sus brazos.
sense_2981b33a3d7e2b6ce679940cad65a7a8.translation: The woman was holding a newborn baby in her arms.

sense_f9c9861814e9e67cf130557f214ff8a8.text: Hay que comprar una sartén nueva porque esta ya no sirve.
sense_f9c9861814e9e67cf130557f214ff8a8.translation: We need to buy a new frying pan because this one is no good any more.
Is this one any good to you?

sense_8fdcc13e00f0c88d9955ddcc532c522e.text: Antonio dice que no se acuerda de ella.
sense_8fdcc13e00f0c88d9955ddcc532c522e.translation: Antonio says he doesn't remember her.

sense_8fdcc13e00f0c88d9955ddcc532c522e.text: Me acuerdo que la primera vez que vi "El imperio contraataca", lloré al final.
sense_8fdcc13e00f0c88d9955ddcc532c522e.translation: I remember that the first time I saw "The Empire Strikes Back", I cried at the end.

sense_1294cb4402c86edbef2b39012b6ebdeb.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_1294cb4402c86edbef2b39012b6ebdeb.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_7ce69586b5e98c8488b8a4f3e6b34fe3.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_7ce69586b5e98c8488b8a4f3e6b34fe3.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_722dd80b8bc8b53516300f4ede69c003.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_722dd80b8bc8b53516300f4ede69c003.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_722dd80b8bc8b53516300f4ede69c003.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_722dd80b8bc8b53516300f4ede69c003.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_2eb260f435fa4b59cd6c280cd9e2e7a4.text: ¡Me pone negra que la gente sea tan maleducada!
sense_2eb260f435fa4b59cd6c280cd9e2e7a4.translation: It drives me crazy when people are so rude!

sense_644b363b5a651149df54344064e9c30d.translation: I just want to make you happy.
What do you want for Christmas?

sense_d695f2d81a44fdc2edae05428c759f4c.translation: "How can I help you?," asked the butler.
Would you like something to drink?

sense_254848b584c1c82952148877ee7eae28.text: Huele a gas en este cuarto.
sense_254848b584c1c82952148877ee7eae28.translation: It smells like gas in this room.

sense_01d87e6476bbf1bafce6b63a2acce208.text: Este acuerdo me huele a corrupción.
A mi papá le huele que el vecino se está robando sus periódicos.
sense_01d87e6476bbf1bafce6b63a2acce208.translation: My father suspects that the neighbor is stealing his newspapers.

sense_39a62f8e07890cd834afebd05e37605b.text: Los profesores opinan muy bien de ti.

sense_39a62f8e07890cd834afebd05e37605b.translation: I am of the same opinion.

sense_d6272508fbb3ee6723bb3afde6b925ec.translation: Put your money away. It's my treat.
Have a drink. It's on us.

sense_7f6443237e8c96ca4f97325c6ab9fd16.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_7f6443237e8c96ca4f97325c6ab9fd16.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_7f6443237e8c96ca4f97325c6ab9fd16.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_7f6443237e8c96ca4f97325c6ab9fd16.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_b7251ba747645559954791f86ddb9b52.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_b7251ba747645559954791f86ddb9b52.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.
