sense_b7251ba747645559954791f86ddb9b52.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_b7251ba747645559954791f86ddb9b52.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_33c1b6c7dad6c192489fbc45f4592d3d.text: Atravesaron las montañas al amparo de la noche.
sense_33c1b6c7dad6c192489fbc45f4592d3d.translation: They crossed the mountains under cover of night.

sense_33c1b6c7dad6c192489fbc45f4592d3d.text: Siempre debes mirar en ambas direcciones antes de atravesar la carretera.
sense_33c1b6c7dad6c192489fbc45f4592d3d.translation: You should always look both ways before crossing the highway.

sense_70424771a1b2312ac45ff3cbaba67a30.text: Paul ganó el torneo nacional de pesca deportiva dos años consecutivos.
sense_70424771a1b2312ac45ff3cbaba67a30.translation: Paul won the national sport fishing tournament two years in a row.

sense_70424771a1b2312ac45ff3cbaba67a30.text: El ganador del torneo de tenis se llevará a casa un premio en efectivo de un millón de dólares.
sense_70424771a1b2312ac45ff3cbaba67a30.translation: The winner of the tennis tournament will take home one million dollars in prize money.

sense_b7c1af4a6fafadd04a604924c8382f29.text: Si me permite, señora, creo que puedo arreglar la puerta.
sense_b7c1af4a6fafadd04a604924c8382f29.translation: If I may, ma'am, I think I can fix the door.

sense_99c6835cfbb1b678c9f9d80d5e99a400.text: La disciplina y el honor informan su naturaleza como soldado.
sense_99c6835cfbb1b678c9f9d80d5e99a400.translation: He is a soldier who believes in discipline and honor.
Her silhouette hints at her beauty.

sense_188c84c77a49884b2c9f749fbdc4529a.text: No puede comer pastel porque sufre de diabetes.
sense_188c84c77a49884b2c9f749fbdc4529a.translation: He can't eat cake because he suffers from diabetes.

sense_188c84c77a49884b2c9f749fbdc4529a.text: Mejor corta comunicación con él, no quieres que sufra más.
sense_188c84c77a49884b2c9f749fbdc4529a.translation: You'd better cut off communication with him, you don't want him to suffer anymore.

sense_f611b3902a0f510966bae38553db4c9e.text: Si te consuela, yo tampoco lo entiendo.
sense_f611b3902a0f510966bae38553db4c9e.translation: If it's any consolation, I don't understand it either.

sense_f611b3902a0f510966bae38553db4c9e.text: Me consuela saber que no sufrió.
sense_f611b3902a0f510966bae38553db4c9e.translation: It's some comfort to know that he didn't suffer.

sense_3385a530a2777cca7e501ce50383f632.text: Mi marido está muerto, y no me consuelo con nada.
sense_3385a530a2777cca7e501ce50383f632.translation: My husband is dead, and there is nothing I can do to make it better.

sense_3385a530a2777cca7e501ce50383f632.text: No hay nada con lo que pueda consolarse mi hermana después de esta tragedia.
sense_3385a530a2777cca7e501ce50383f632.translation: My sister is inconsolable after this tragedy.

sense_efa9f4fd5d5470fc21b98e89dc964cfa.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_efa9f4fd5d5470fc21b98e89dc964cfa.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_cf331c8f5b3eef8ab63df8e08cfafa90.text: Los elefantes utilizan sus largas trompas para agarrar la comida.
sense_cf331c8f5b3eef8ab63df8e08cfafa90.translation: Elephants use their long trunks to pick up their food.

sense_cf331c8f5b3eef8ab63df8e08cfafa90.text: Vi cómo una elefanta utilizó los colmillos para proteger a sus crías cuando estuve de safari.
sense_cf331c8f5b3eef8ab63df8e08cfafa90.translation: I saw how an elephant used her tusks to protect her young when I was on safari.

sense_526ee3fcb37cf97d320a9aa010c4135f.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_526ee3fcb37cf97d320a9aa010c4135f.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_526ee3fcb37cf97d320a9aa010c4135f.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_526ee3fcb37cf97d320a9aa010c4135f.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_bdd9f20f839c9d1f2a74892eba92e441.text: La vida nocturna en Nueva Orleans es muy animada.
sense_bdd9f20f839c9d1f2a74892eba92e441.translation: The night life in New Orleans is very lively.

sense_bdd9f20f839c9d1f2a74892eba92e441.text: Anoche la patrulla nocturna atrapó a dos vándalos que pintaban grafitis en las paredes.
sense_bdd9f20f839c9d1f2a74892eba92e441.translation: Last night, the night patrol caught two vandals spraying graffiti on the walls.

sense_8643bd5cc9a6c63ecacb30819d189773.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_8643bd5cc9a6c63ecacb30819d189773.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_8643bd5cc9a6c63ecacb30819d189773.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_8643bd5cc9a6c63ecacb30819d189773.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_01dd3fdd25234139d22ca1acef6829d2.text: Acudimos al sindicato porque nuestros gerentes no nos están haciendo caso.
sense_01dd3fdd25234139d22ca1acef6829d2.translation: We turned to the labor union because our managers aren't taking us seriously.

sense_01dd3fdd25234139d22ca1acef6829d2.text: El sindicato decidió no respaldar a ningún candidato en esta elección.
sense_01dd3fdd25234139d22ca1acef6829d2.translation: The labor union decided not to endorse a candidate in this election.

sense_1d01ad90813f5fde36cd3def44214470.text: La culpa es tuya. - ¿Mía? ¡Hay que joderse! ¡Pero si yo ni siquiera estaba aquí!
sense_1d01ad90813f5fde36cd3def44214470.translation: It's your fault. - My fault? For fuck's sake! But I wasn't even here!

sense_1d01ad90813f5fde36cd3def44214470.text: No me dejaron ustedes nada de comida. - ¡Te jodes! Es tu culpa por llegar tarde.
sense_1d01ad90813f5fde36cd3def44214470.translation: You didn't leave any food for me. - Tough shit! It's your fault for being late.

sense_3eb02e681eba707479f18ca4756cbb67.text: Esta es la segunda permanente que me hago este año.
sense_3eb02e681eba707479f18ca4756cbb67.translation: This is the second time I've had my hair permed this year.

sense_3eb02e681eba707479f18ca4756cbb67.text: Mi hermana se hizo una permanente antes de la boda.
sense_3eb02e681eba707479f18ca4756cbb67.translation: My sister had her hair permed before her wedding.

sense_30aa9e42a969f1e7e2ac60d541289e9e.text: ¿Es tuyo el carro que está bloqueando el mío?
sense_30aa9e42a969f1e7e2ac60d541289e9e.translation: Is that car that's blocking mine yours?

sense_30aa9e42a969f1e7e2ac60d541289e9e.text: ¿Esta pulsera es tuya? La encontré en el piso.
sense_30aa9e42a969f1e7e2ac60d541289e9e.translation: Is this bracelet yours? I found it on the floor.

sense_6c992df6f60618b12a67ae54acd6de38.text: Esta copa de vino es mía. La tuya está en la mesa.
sense_6c992df6f60618b12a67ae54acd6de38.translation: This glass of wine is mine. Yours is on the table.

sense_77a3031b3b17e0e30387cadeba4877f7.text: Estoy muy interesado en el puesto de gerente.
sense_77a3031b3b17e0e30387cadeba4877f7.translation: I'm very interested in the managing position.

sense_77a3031b3b17e0e30387cadeba4877f7.text: Siempre estuve interesado en la historia de la Antigua Grecia.
sense_77a3031b3b17e0e30387cadeba4877f7.translation: I've always been interested in Ancient Greek history.

sense_44f54db614da271c8d5ea56dafd4f821.text: La empresa se enfrentaba a una absorción corporativa pero nos resistimos.
sense_44f54db614da271c8d5ea56dafd4f821.translation: The company was faced with a corporate takeover but we resisted.

sense_44f54db614da271c8d5ea56dafd4f821.text: La policía tuvo que usar la fuerza porque el ladrón se resistió al arresto.
sense_44f54db614da271c8d5ea56dafd4f821.translation: The police had to use force because the thief resisted arrest.

sense_fa37f30fd60649f6747c2902dd110df1.text: Ya no resisto más; quiero escapar de todo esto.
sense_fa37f30fd60649f6747c2902dd110df1.translation: I can't stand it anymore; I want to escape all this.

sense_fa37f30fd60649f6747c2902dd110df1.text: Laura dice que ya no resiste más y que quiere dejar sus estudios.
sense_fa37f30fd60649f6747c2902dd110df1.translation: Laura says she can't take anymore and wants to give up her studies.

sense_c954161cbc701662a59c5fb3efd72b5f.text: Pablo toma clases particulares porque se le resisten las matemáticas.
sense_c954161cbc701662a59c5fb3efd72b5f.translation: Pablo takes private lessons because he finds math difficult.

sense_c954161cbc701662a59c5fb3efd72b5f.text: Por más que lo intento, se me resiste esta materia.
sense_c954161cbc701662a59c5fb3efd72b5f.translation: However hard I try, this subject is beyond me.

sense_2fbf85f43c888b0423c44bf36d48258d.text: Creo que mi jefe me tiene rabia, pero no sé por qué.
sense_2fbf85f43c888b0423c44bf36d48258d.translation: I think my boss dislikes me, but I don't know why.

sense_2fbf85f43c888b0423c44bf36d48258d.text: Desde que su amiga no le pagó el dinero que le debía, él le tiene rabia.
sense_2fbf85f43c888b0423c44bf36d48258d.translation: Ever since his friend didn't pay back the money she owed him, he's had it in for her.

sense_de5735bc4ede2b3a48fc16176820860e.text: ¡Ay! El café está que rabia y me quemé los labios.
sense_de5735bc4ede2b3a48fc16176820860e.translation: Ouch! The coffee is hot and I burned my lips.

sense_de5735bc4ede2b3a48fc16176820860e.text: Yo si tú no hablaría con Jaime en este momento. Le pusieron los cuernos y está que rabia.
sense_de5735bc4ede2b3a48fc16176820860e.translation: If I were you, I wouldn't talk to Jaime right now. He got cheated on and he's crazy angry.

sense_f53f3649a6df9af8e2d630370153e0aa.text: Señor Presidente, ¿quiere usted explicarnos lo que pasó allí dentro? - Sin comentarios.
sense_f53f3649a6df9af8e2d630370153e0aa.translation: Mr President, would you like to explain to us what happened in there? - No comment.

sense_f53f3649a6df9af8e2d630370153e0aa.text: Un portavoz de la empresa dijo que la subida de precios no es culpa de ellos. Sin comentario.
sense_f53f3649a6df9af8e2d630370153e0aa.translation: A spokesperson for the company said that the rise in prices wasn't their fault. What can you say?

sense_97d696877f9313fa0f793d772d936bc6.text: El hada movió su varita y convirtió al príncipe en una rana.
sense_97d696877f9313fa0f793d772d936bc6.translation: The fairy moved her wand and turned the prince into a frog.

sense_97d696877f9313fa0f793d772d936bc6.text: La viejecita le dijo a la niña que en realidad era un hada con poderes mágicos.
sense_97d696877f9313fa0f793d772d936bc6.translation: The little old lady told the girl that she was really a fairy with magical powers.

sense_e03d743443b444957e1a3363c6761b2f.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_e03d743443b444957e1a3363c6761b2f.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_5f6b7a03df5f3f1de9af4199910a7142.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_5f6b7a03df5f3f1de9af4199910a7142.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_5f6b7a03df5f3f1de9af4199910a7142.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_5f6b7a03df5f3f1de9af4199910a7142.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_e3bb638c295ffd4843c4ec5a4fa10057.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_e3bb638c295ffd4843c4ec5a4fa10057.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_727d634c3c12263ea1f15a65e0431538.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_727d634c3c12263ea1f15a65e0431538.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_0e4403f062389c0448c930df08aafc86.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_0e4403f062389c0448c930df08aafc86.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_81c16846d1af3ff1a6e76936f57b6320.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_81c16846d1af3ff1a6e76936f57b6320.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_91982dbd1d0a3e107df063e68ada0492.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_91982dbd1d0a3e107df063e68ada0492.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_91982dbd1d0a3e107df063e68ada0492.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_91982dbd1d0a3e107df063e68ada0492.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_96e48ca4db5cf10b102a648da4aabe54.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_96e48ca4db5cf10b102a648da4aabe54.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_96e48ca4db5cf10b102a648da4aabe54.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_96e48ca4db5cf10b102a648da4aabe54.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_37ef9c4f9cd54ad4879ffcccdf1084cf.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_37ef9c4f9cd54ad4879ffcccdf1084cf.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_61ae063dce8ec4de9dc165a1f56bea88.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_61ae063dce8ec4de9dc165a1f56bea88.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_61ae063dce8ec4de9dc165a1f56bea88.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_61ae063dce8ec4de9dc165a1f56bea88.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_bb97afd13416ad2e0ffa1ac22e8d2a82.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_bb97afd13416ad2e0ffa1ac22e8d2a82.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_bb97afd13416ad2e0ffa1ac22e8d2a82.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_bb97afd13416ad2e0ffa1ac22e8d2a82.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_d059206e08b44c6d4dc8cbfc54a6a6c7.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_d059206e08b44c6d4dc8cbfc54a6a6c7.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_d059206e08b44c6d4dc8cbfc54a6a6c7.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_d059206e08b44c6d4dc8cbfc54a6a6c7.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_67b48fe4af2617c34a3069ce7592890b.text: El artista es famoso por las criaturas espantosas que pinta.
sense_67b48fe4af2617c34a3069ce7592890b.translation: The artist is famous for the horrifying creatures he paints.

sense_67b48fe4af2617c34a3069ce7592890b.text: ¿En verdad vas a ir a la fiesta con esa máscara espantosa?
sense_67b48fe4af2617c34a3069ce7592890b.translation: Are you really going to wear that horrifying mask to the party?

sense_48bc19a54554ef50383796cbff60cc37.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_48bc19a54554ef50383796cbff60cc37.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_48bc19a54554ef50383796cbff60cc37.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_48bc19a54554ef50383796cbff60cc37.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_dfcdce6257f21a714dfdd1cddb817eba.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_dfcdce6257f21a714dfdd1cddb817eba.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_a9bc0ad3ec050f54618b536ba7c5015a.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_8597c5c64552660b40b9c237ad065181.text: No debemos extraer ninguna conclusión hasta conocer todos los hechos.
sense_8597c5c64552660b40b9c237ad065181.translation: We shouldn't draw any conclusions until we know all the facts.

sense_8597c5c64552660b40b9c237ad065181.text: Cuando di la vuelta al mundo, llegué a la conclusión de que es mejor viajar ligero de equipaje.
sense_8597c5c64552660b40b9c237ad065181.translation: When I went round the world, I came to the conclusion that it's best to travel light.

sense_0c4b4ccaeb80a455a26fc98d03153735.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_0c4b4ccaeb80a455a26fc98d03153735.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_0c4b4ccaeb80a455a26fc98d03153735.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_0c4b4ccaeb80a455a26fc98d03153735.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_007cd14c0a39cba668e943fa80491df8.text: Sueño con tener una casa grande y mucho dinero.
sense_007cd14c0a39cba668e943fa80491df8.translation: I dream of having a big house and lots of money.

sense_007cd14c0a39cba668e943fa80491df8.text: Ella soñó con el actor famoso.
sense_007cd14c0a39cba668e943fa80491df8.translation: She dreamed about the famous actor.

sense_3da3600372689166547f33231e1831a1.text: Los obreros están martillando el tejado para poner tejas nuevas.
sense_3da3600372689166547f33231e1831a1.translation: The workers are hammering the roof to put new tiles in.

sense_3da3600372689166547f33231e1831a1.text: El herrero sacó la espada de la fragua y comenzó a martillarla.
sense_3da3600372689166547f33231e1831a1.translation: The blacksmith took the sword out of the forge and started to hammer it.

sense_0b171dfa26a31dd11b9a8b9269827b8b.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_0b171dfa26a31dd11b9a8b9269827b8b.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_0b171dfa26a31dd11b9a8b9269827b8b.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_0b171dfa26a31dd11b9a8b9269827b8b.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_7b415f5b41dc3a6f075d5f223ad8878d.text: Se fue sin explicación y me partió el corazón.
sense_7b415f5b41dc3a6f075d5f223ad8878d.translation: She left without explanation and broke my heart.

sense_7b415f5b41dc3a6f075d5f223ad8878d.text: Le dijeron que si no pagaba la deuda, le iban a partir las piernas.
sense_7b415f5b41dc3a6f075d5f223ad8878d.translation: They told him that if he didn't pay the debt, they were going to break his legs.

sense_99fb75b39482d59d50a3e26da885b808.text: Le sobra improvisación y le falta método.
sense_99fb75b39482d59d50a3e26da885b808.translation: He improvises too much and is not methodical enough.

sense_99fb75b39482d59d50a3e26da885b808.text: Para diagnosticar una enfermedad es necesario proceder con método.
sense_99fb75b39482d59d50a3e26da885b808.translation: In order to diagnose a disease you need to proceed methodically.

sense_c94183e028af7b05d08867de71e70d43.translation: Have you been referred to a specialist?

sense_c94183e028af7b05d08867de71e70d43.text: Voy a pedirle un volante al médico para ver al reumatólogo.
sense_c94183e028af7b05d08867de71e70d43.translation: I'm going to ask the doctor to refer me to a rheumatologist.

sense_8814d67c5b85c239bcb2c6d9cf4a1a2a.text: Huele a gas en este cuarto.
sense_8814d67c5b85c239bcb2c6d9cf4a1a2a.translation: It smells like gas in this room.

sense_90c4565990c58f1f33e75a0efb2db144.text: Este acuerdo me huele a corrupción.
A mi papá le huele que el vecino se está robando sus periódicos.
sense_90c4565990c58f1f33e75a0efb2db144.translation: My father suspects that the neighbor is stealing his newspapers.

sense_540311b66ff12a93849ce5e166209131.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_540311b66ff12a93849ce5e166209131.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_540311b66ff12a93849ce5e166209131.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_540311b66ff12a93849ce5e166209131.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_b7904a99ce38646831be24bede08b693.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_b7904a99ce38646831be24bede08b693.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_191df4bf3194e6bdcbe93338582b0ce7.text: La chica estaba vendiendo naranjas en el mercado.
sense_191df4bf3194e6bdcbe93338582b0ce7.translation: The girl was selling oranges in the market.

sense_07b724a7a9e99134ee6b64390f8336ab.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_07b724a7a9e99134ee6b64390f8336ab.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_eb30b335303b025707f55c4c3c167433.text: A ver qué excusa se inventa ahora.
sense_eb30b335303b025707f55c4c3c167433.translation: Let's see the excuse she comes up with now.

sense_eb30b335303b025707f55c4c3c167433.text: Siempre estás buscando excusas para no ir al colegio.
sense_eb30b335303b025707f55c4c3c167433.translation: You're always looking for any excuse to not go to school.

sense_efcc955cce6a04140189892a38fbb06c.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_efcc955cce6a04140189892a38fbb06c.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_efcc955cce6a04140189892a38fbb06c.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_efcc955cce6a04140189892a38fbb06c.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_bc3cd54c7a2e98450a1ec0ac8b0cf790.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_bc3cd54c7a2e98450a1ec0ac8b0cf790.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_bc3cd54c7a2e98450a1ec0ac8b0cf790.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_bc3cd54c7a2e98450a1ec0ac8b0cf790.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_3f79182a1d89a17178cd3c9e2b517891.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_3f79182a1d89a17178cd3c9e2b517891.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_670e1e9215cf5a2b7fde0e9ecd926d8e.translation: I don't have anywhere to write this down.
Ready to take notes? Jot this down.

sense_2718e0f4bd0db3c781a94d67e775d28f.text: Se apuntó un tanto cuando ganó la apuesta.
sense_2718e0f4bd0db3c781a94d67e775d28f.translation: He chalked up a point when he won the bet.

sense_2718e0f4bd0db3c781a94d67e775d28f.text: El equipo azul se apuntó una victoria en la primera prueba.
sense_2718e0f4bd0db3c781a94d67e775d28f.translation: The blue team scored a win in the first heat.

sense_958a170b42e0479c8b97460c081e6363.text: Cuando vio el ratón, pegó un grito.
sense_958a170b42e0479c8b97460c081e6363.translation: When she saw the mouse, she screamed.

sense_958a170b42e0479c8b97460c081e6363.text: Está en el hospital después de que le hayan pegado un tiro.
sense_958a170b42e0479c8b97460c081e6363.translation: He's in the hospital after having been shot.

sense_f42bd1a341ee4bf17657a3a3b528d1a3.text: No permiten el uso de celulares inteligentes en el museo.
sense_f42bd1a341ee4bf17657a3a3b528d1a3.translation: They don't allow smart phones in the museum.

sense_f42bd1a341ee4bf17657a3a3b528d1a3.text: El nuevo edificio inteligente en el centro usa la mitad de la energía de un edificio normal.
sense_f42bd1a341ee4bf17657a3a3b528d1a3.translation: The new smart building downtown uses half of the energy of a regular building.

sense_4ad6ef351a460daa4db481026f2871ba.text: Tuvimos que quedarnos en casa porque estaba cayendo un chaparrón.
sense_4ad6ef351a460daa4db481026f2871ba.translation: We had to stay home because it was pouring rain.

sense_4ad6ef351a460daa4db481026f2871ba.text: Está cayendo una buena nevada. Ponle las cadenas a las ruedas.
sense_4ad6ef351a460daa4db481026f2871ba.translation: It's snowing hard. Put the chains on the tires.

sense_f060aa53b86ba39cbd49d795e5184db3.text: No bebo porque el alcohol me cae mal.
sense_f060aa53b86ba39cbd49d795e5184db3.translation: I don't drink because alcohol disagrees with me.
You look great in that dress!

sense_7771d3ef405f66b7f4b84e69f5caeb98.text: Me cae muy bien tu hermano; siempre me hace sonreír.
sense_7771d3ef405f66b7f4b84e69f5caeb98.translation: I really like your brother; he always makes me smile.

sense_7771d3ef405f66b7f4b84e69f5caeb98.text: Me marché porque me cae mal tu primo con sus bromas ofensivas.
sense_7771d3ef405f66b7f4b84e69f5caeb98.translation: I had to leave because I can't stand your cousin and his offensive jokes.

sense_861b9adde41016aca7829b8d5c30c5b0.text: Que Harvard la hubiera rechazado, le cayó mal.
sense_861b9adde41016aca7829b8d5c30c5b0.translation: She wasn't pleased that Harvard rejected her.

sense_861b9adde41016aca7829b8d5c30c5b0.text: El embarazo de mi hermana pequeña no cayó bien en la familia.
sense_861b9adde41016aca7829b8d5c30c5b0.translation: My little sister's pregnancy shocked the entire family.

sense_22363e9438aa714eb86d9299fe76de7c.text: Mi bebé está llorando porque se cae de sueño.
sense_22363e9438aa714eb86d9299fe76de7c.translation: My baby is crying because he's very sleepy.

sense_22363e9438aa714eb86d9299fe76de7c.text: Me caigo de cansancio, pero tengo que estudiar para el examen de mañana.
sense_22363e9438aa714eb86d9299fe76de7c.translation: I am really tired, but I have to study for tomorrow's exam.

sense_78c77dfbd10ccfc94430d44b4772c32e.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_78c77dfbd10ccfc94430d44b4772c32e.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_78c77dfbd10ccfc94430d44b4772c32e.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_78c77dfbd10ccfc94430d44b4772c32e.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_171f926a3a207c870a8d070de511e265.translation: I won a trip to France! - Cool!

sense_171f926a3a207c870a8d070de511e265.text: ¿Quieres que veamos la peli en mi ordenador? - ¡Guay, tío!
sense_171f926a3a207c870a8d070de511e265.translation: Do you want to watch the movie on my computer? - Cool, man!

sense_e1e61449dbc64ab15f4178857a17b336.text: Tus amigos son guays, Roberto. ¿Dónde los conociste?
sense_e1e61449dbc64ab15f4178857a17b336.translation: Your friends are cool, Roberto. Where did you meet them?

sense_e1e61449dbc64ab15f4178857a17b336.text: La fiesta de anoche estuvo muy guay.
sense_e1e61449dbc64ab15f4178857a17b336.translation: Last night's party was really cool.

sense_d388e2873adb60d5a0a342ab55bf63c5.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_d388e2873adb60d5a0a342ab55bf63c5.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_d388e2873adb60d5a0a342ab55bf63c5.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_d388e2873adb60d5a0a342ab55bf63c5.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_d6fd103b699a699837e10b71a3fd1507.text: Este cuento está lleno de seres mágicos y paisajes místicos.
sense_d6fd103b699a699837e10b71a3fd1507.translation: This story is full of magical beings and mystical settings.

sense_d6fd103b699a699837e10b71a3fd1507.text: Al beber la poción mágica, el ogro se convirtió en el príncipe que siempre había querido ser.
sense_d6fd103b699a699837e10b71a3fd1507.translation: Upon drinking the magic potion, the ogre became the prince he had always wanted to be.

sense_50a4549dfe8a93391d924d3d9f29eba0.text: El programa era tan aburrido que me dormí.
sense_50a4549dfe8a93391d924d3d9f29eba0.translation: The program was so boring that I fell asleep.

sense_50a4549dfe8a93391d924d3d9f29eba0.text: Me dormí a las 6 de la mañana.
sense_50a4549dfe8a93391d924d3d9f29eba0.translation: I fell asleep at 6 in the morning.

sense_f7115a0bb4206ec9d76313fe6d2aeb26.text: No te duermas o no acabarás a tiempo.
sense_f7115a0bb4206ec9d76313fe6d2aeb26.translation: Don't slack off or you won't finish in time.

sense_f7115a0bb4206ec9d76313fe6d2aeb26.text: Por dormirse se perdió la clave para ganar el premio.
sense_f7115a0bb4206ec9d76313fe6d2aeb26.translation: He missed the clue to win the prize because he didn't stay on his toes.

sense_53eb198b197f6504b4d9c62a7ce4e645.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_53eb198b197f6504b4d9c62a7ce4e645.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_27b9a014a4bbc546ebd0190f0a14de88.text: Debemos votar por el candidato con las mejores propuestas.
sense_27b9a014a4bbc546ebd0190f0a14de88.translation: We must vote for the candidate with the best proposals.

sense_27b9a014a4bbc546ebd0190f0a14de88.text: Yo voté a favor de la propuesta más ecológica.
sense_27b9a014a4bbc546ebd0190f0a14de88.translation: I voted in favor of the more environmentally-friendly proposal.

sense_76aaf09c5b555cf08930627c94af1414.text: El jugador de baloncesto se lesionó la rodilla.
sense_76aaf09c5b555cf08930627c94af1414.translation: The basketball player injured his knee.

sense_76aaf09c5b555cf08930627c94af1414.text: Se puso de rodillas para pedir perdón.
sense_76aaf09c5b555cf08930627c94af1414.translation: He got down on his knees to ask for forgiveness.

sense_e270f9126911b12dbd8939591b27ade5.text: Desafortunadamente, suspendí mi examen final de historia y me queda la asignatura colgada.
sense_e270f9126911b12dbd8939591b27ade5.translation: Unfortunately, I failed my final exam in history and have to retake the course.

sense_e270f9126911b12dbd8939591b27ade5.text: Mi profesor debe de guardarme rencor porque me dejó la química colgada este año.
sense_e270f9126911b12dbd8939591b27ade5.translation: My teacher must hold a grudge against me, because he failed me in chemistry this year.

sense_bcdfbafd5e2fd64052767d75b41ca341.text: ¡Me encanta tu casa! ¿Tú misma la decoraste?
sense_bcdfbafd5e2fd64052767d75b41ca341.translation: I love your house! Did you decorate it yourself?

sense_bcdfbafd5e2fd64052767d75b41ca341.text: Me encanta tomarme un chocolate caliente cuando hace frío afuera.
sense_bcdfbafd5e2fd64052767d75b41ca341.translation: I love drinking hot chocolate when it's cold out.

sense_52ef551190882eead8ac6a54f7efa865.text: Voy andando al colegio todos los días.
sense_52ef551190882eead8ac6a54f7efa865.translation: I walk to school every day.

sense_52ef551190882eead8ac6a54f7efa865.text: "Cuando ando, me canso mucho", le dijo la anciana a su médico.
sense_52ef551190882eead8ac6a54f7efa865.translation: "When I walk, I get very tired," the old woman told her doctor.

sense_fbf2bfa73a0f140556ba64e38deaad8b.text: En el verano ella anda en bicicleta al trabajo.
sense_fbf2bfa73a0f140556ba64e38deaad8b.translation: In the summer she takes her bike to work.

sense_fbf2bfa73a0f140556ba64e38deaad8b.text: Yo siempre ando en tren cuando regreso al hogar.
sense_fbf2bfa73a0f140556ba64e38deaad8b.translation: I always take the train when returning home.

sense_28cd77b4f794ecb78de16caf1f595516.text: ¡Qué andar tan raro tienen esos jóvenes!
sense_28cd77b4f794ecb78de16caf1f595516.translation: The way those youths walk is really strange!

sense_28cd77b4f794ecb78de16caf1f595516.text: Se le nota en el andar que tiene mucho dolor.
sense_28cd77b4f794ecb78de16caf1f595516.translation: You can tell by the way she walks that she's in a lot of pain.

sense_89bb2ca870ec5dda3cf5a525c0175df7.text: Me gusta todo de ti, hasta los andares.
sense_89bb2ca870ec5dda3cf5a525c0175df7.translation: I like everything about you, even the way you walk.

sense_89bb2ca870ec5dda3cf5a525c0175df7.text: El Charlot de Charlie Chaplin tiene unos andares totalmente inconfundibles.
sense_89bb2ca870ec5dda3cf5a525c0175df7.translation: The way Charlie Chaplin's tramp walks is completely unmistakeable.

sense_12a9947da630cf696ed4cf7ca0b981bc.text: El sistema escolar tiene que modernizarse.
sense_12a9947da630cf696ed4cf7ca0b981bc.translation: The school system needs to be modernized.

sense_12a9947da630cf696ed4cf7ca0b981bc.text: Por ley, todos los buses escolares en el país deben estar pintados de amarillo.
sense_12a9947da630cf696ed4cf7ca0b981bc.translation: By law, all school buses in the country must be painted yellow.

sense_4cd5776c970222683b1493d290d5f60c.text: Por la presente le comunico que ha sido aceptado en nuestra facultad.
sense_4cd5776c970222683b1493d290d5f60c.translation: I am writing to inform you that you have been accepted as a member of our faculty.

sense_4cd5776c970222683b1493d290d5f60c.text: Por medio de la presente le informo que renuncio a mi puesto como contador.
sense_4cd5776c970222683b1493d290d5f60c.translation: I hereby inform you that I am resigning from my position as accountant.

sense_b188737943510906d4bbc6e0fd6c7f58.text: La ropa de corte boho me llama la atención.
sense_b188737943510906d4bbc6e0fd6c7f58.translation: I think boho-style clothing is very striking.

sense_b188737943510906d4bbc6e0fd6c7f58.text: Le gustan los muebles de corte modernista.

sense_c887b339007f39b4ff3f6e3b9b6bb4be.text: Menudo corte; no me lo esperaba.
sense_c887b339007f39b4ff3f6e3b9b6bb4be.translation: He practically bit my head off; I wasn't expecting that.

sense_c887b339007f39b4ff3f6e3b9b6bb4be.text: ¡Vaya corte que me dio la actriz cuando le pedí su autógrafo!
sense_c887b339007f39b4ff3f6e3b9b6bb4be.translation: The actress practically snapped my head off when I asked her for her autograph.

sense_8901dc79ae05337a05c1b59b8cd1bffb.text: ¡Qué corte estar desnuda delante del médico!
sense_8901dc79ae05337a05c1b59b8cd1bffb.translation: How embarrassing being naked in front of the doctor!

sense_8901dc79ae05337a05c1b59b8cd1bffb.text: Es un corte estar con gente cuando se muestran escenas de sexo en la tele.
sense_8901dc79ae05337a05c1b59b8cd1bffb.translation: It's embarrassing to have other people there when there are sex scenes on television.

sense_adf50e457043bd59ae26a8b4d0c41cb0.translation: I just want to make you happy.
What do you want for Christmas?

sense_b1f2cebc1ef4e4f777236aa124534ac3.translation: "How can I help you?," asked the butler.
Would you like something to drink?

sense_540dc1a316133e36c19cdba1b747448b.text: No le tire patadas a su hermano.
Su perro me tiró un mordisco.

sense_2e971883adf8de1316b17d3dd6e0a63b.text: Las fiestas ya no me tiran.
sense_2e971883adf8de1316b17d3dd6e0a63b.translation: Parties don't appeal to me anymore.
He is not interested in studying medicine.

sense_8bdc9f49c5d4f00eb80a63442662be5a.text: El plato tiraba a dulce más que nada.
sense_8bdc9f49c5d4f00eb80a63442662be5a.translation: The dish was more sweet than anything else.

sense_8bdc9f49c5d4f00eb80a63442662be5a.text: Tienes que beberte el té cuando esté tirando a frío.
sense_8bdc9f49c5d4f00eb80a63442662be5a.translation: You have to drink the tea when it is cooling down.

sense_3ff9d8a2980676cf4886ef69436a4ef7.text: El bebé se tiró un eructo tras tomarse su biberón.
sense_3ff9d8a2980676cf4886ef69436a4ef7.translation: The baby burped after having his bottle.

sense_3ff9d8a2980676cf4886ef69436a4ef7.text: La primera vez que se tiró un pedo delante de su novio se avergonzó.
sense_3ff9d8a2980676cf4886ef69436a4ef7.translation: The first time she farted in front of her boyfriend, she was embarrassed.

sense_d7b70593efc0f0fcee6d9a1c033678ca.text: Me carga que siempre la escojan a ella.
sense_d7b70593efc0f0fcee6d9a1c033678ca.translation: It gets on my nerves that they always choose her.

sense_d7b70593efc0f0fcee6d9a1c033678ca.text: Me carga tener que aguantar la novia de mi hermano.
sense_d7b70593efc0f0fcee6d9a1c033678ca.translation: I can't stand having to put up with my brother's girlfriend.

sense_354fde6a0f667aae4674007bc7fb44f0.text: Ese tío iba con un globo en la fiesta anoche.
sense_354fde6a0f667aae4674007bc7fb44f0.translation: That guy was stoned at the party last night.

sense_354fde6a0f667aae4674007bc7fb44f0.text: Te va a matar tu papá si te ve con ese globo.
sense_354fde6a0f667aae4674007bc7fb44f0.translation: Your dad's going to kill you if he sees how high you are.

sense_a7055d4a8887fe4ef072221b1bfe122c.text: Siento afecto por ti, pero no te quiero.
sense_a7055d4a8887fe4ef072221b1bfe122c.translation: I'm fond of you, but I don't love you.

sense_a7055d4a8887fe4ef072221b1bfe122c.text: Claro que los gatos sienten afecto por sus dueños; yo diría que nos aman.
sense_a7055d4a8887fe4ef072221b1bfe122c.translation: Of course cats are fond of their owners; I'd say they love us.

sense_16ab23d0517e46cc2818c4b9d2d30e99.text: Pablo ama a su esposa con todo su ser.
sense_16ab23d0517e46cc2818c4b9d2d30e99.translation: Pablo loves his wife with all his heart.

sense_16ab23d0517e46cc2818c4b9d2d30e99.text: Yo te amo, Ana, y quiero pasar el resto de mi vida contigo.
sense_16ab23d0517e46cc2818c4b9d2d30e99.translation: I love you, Ana, and I want to spend the rest of my life with you.

sense_f478a9eafd26ab531a99766c567b1aad.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_f478a9eafd26ab531a99766c567b1aad.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_f478a9eafd26ab531a99766c567b1aad.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_f478a9eafd26ab531a99766c567b1aad.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_32bda66a797787a2623cb54cee689f08.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_32bda66a797787a2623cb54cee689f08.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_32bda66a797787a2623cb54cee689f08.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_32bda66a797787a2623cb54cee689f08.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_fc40a72ee4ae73fc743200ea3ca382f9.text: Ese cuadro de Van Gogh es hermoso.
sense_fc40a72ee4ae73fc743200ea3ca382f9.translation: That Van Gogh painting is beautiful.

sense_fc40a72ee4ae73fc743200ea3ca382f9.text: Es hermoso cómo el paisaje se une con el mar al amanecer.
sense_fc40a72ee4ae73fc743200ea3ca382f9.translation: It's beautiful how the landscape meets the sea at dawn.

sense_0324fa899ae9183aa6c497465451f62d.text: Me gusta jugar al bingo por el dinero.
sense_0324fa899ae9183aa6c497465451f62d.translation: I love playing Bingo for money.
Does anybody want to play tennis with me?

sense_6c7f8de8b449aa432d060b0e55b8994d.text: Los alpinistas quisieron llegar a la cumbre, pero fracasaron por la tormenta.
sense_6c7f8de8b449aa432d060b0e55b8994d.translation: The climbers tried to reach the summit, but they failed due to the storm.

sense_6c7f8de8b449aa432d060b0e55b8994d.text: No podemos darnos el lujo de fracasar; el futuro de la humanidad está en juego.
sense_6c7f8de8b449aa432d060b0e55b8994d.translation: We cannot afford to fail; the fate of humanity is at stake.

sense_50d40ea1c29435dc9f31142d9e02939b.text: You need to keep going to the gym until it becomes habitual.
sense_50d40ea1c29435dc9f31142d9e02939b.translation: Tienes que seguir yendo al gimnasio hasta que se vuelva una rutina.

sense_50d40ea1c29435dc9f31142d9e02939b.text: It is habitual for my family to go to Christmas Eve church services.
sense_50d40ea1c29435dc9f31142d9e02939b.translation: Para mi familia, es costumbre ir a la iglesia en vísperas de Navidad.

sense_d2d06dd2104525a11de0d257ceb8128b.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_d2d06dd2104525a11de0d257ceb8128b.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_d2d06dd2104525a11de0d257ceb8128b.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_d2d06dd2104525a11de0d257ceb8128b.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_a5c154014cd8f45edaf4437721cd76a1.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_eb77611aa21f4377382f77a7ffaa93a4.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_eb77611aa21f4377382f77a7ffaa93a4.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_eb77611aa21f4377382f77a7ffaa93a4.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_eb77611aa21f4377382f77a7ffaa93a4.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_29e8330ece869631d3525ebc5a8fab2a.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_29e8330ece869631d3525ebc5a8fab2a.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_29e8330ece869631d3525ebc5a8fab2a.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_29e8330ece869631d3525ebc5a8fab2a.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_7987bb7c2c196dae10a88eb8864f63fa.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_7987bb7c2c196dae10a88eb8864f63fa.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_dd870e3b2d6bf45beb2397af54937653.text: Marte era el dios romano de la guerra.
sense_dd870e3b2d6bf45beb2397af54937653.translation: Mars was the Roman god of war.

sense_dd870e3b2d6bf45beb2397af54937653.text: Los antiguos griegos creían en muchos dioses.
sense_dd870e3b2d6bf45beb2397af54937653.translation: The ancient Greeks believed in many gods.

sense_256d3bb4cdb50ba3b971e5b32d1f0a98.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_256d3bb4cdb50ba3b971e5b32d1f0a98.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_256d3bb4cdb50ba3b971e5b32d1f0a98.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_256d3bb4cdb50ba3b971e5b32d1f0a98.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_ed431ef5880c42205bcb96f3f1018bf6.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_ed431ef5880c42205bcb96f3f1018bf6.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_ed431ef5880c42205bcb96f3f1018bf6.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_ed431ef5880c42205bcb96f3f1018bf6.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_bae215f69a1daa6a6ddf1e777c595d53.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_bae215f69a1daa6a6ddf1e777c595d53.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_f8da216fe05b8d9239279cd9a77ba564.text: En estos momentos la grúa está retirando el vehículo accidentado de la carretera.
sense_f8da216fe05b8d9239279cd9a77ba564.translation: Right now the tow truck is removing the damaged vehicle from the roadway.

sense_5c924dbb08d97caab52193e755d61f3e.text: Mi marido nunca me retiró la confianza.
sense_5c924dbb08d97caab52193e755d61f3e.translation: My husband never lost confidence in me.

sense_5c924dbb08d97caab52193e755d61f3e.text: El partido le retiró la confianza al presidente cuando malversó fondos.
sense_5c924dbb08d97caab52193e755d61f3e.translation: The president lost the party's confidence when he misappropriated funds.

sense_1d45fc70d0daa71d79998a5c4d47a0d4.text: La empresa retiró los autobuses más antiguos.
sense_1d45fc70d0daa71d79998a5c4d47a0d4.translation: The company withdrew the oldest buses.

sense_1d45fc70d0daa71d79998a5c4d47a0d4.text: Retiraron los billetes falsos de la circulación.
sense_1d45fc70d0daa71d79998a5c4d47a0d4.translation: The counterfeit notes were withdrawn from circulation.

sense_22763e2f69f7302b18f515e5116e70b6.text: El recepcionista me pidió que no me retirara.
sense_22763e2f69f7302b18f515e5116e70b6.translation: The receptionist asked me to hold the line.

sense_1a0622548e90dbc711ac36de641feca8.text: Quiero reunir a toda la familia para celebrar Navidad juntos.
sense_1a0622548e90dbc711ac36de641feca8.translation: I want to gather the whole family to celebrate Christmas together.

sense_1a0622548e90dbc711ac36de641feca8.text: Mi papá nos reunió alrededor de la fogata para relatarnos cuentos.
sense_1a0622548e90dbc711ac36de641feca8.translation: Dad gathered us around the campfire to tell us stories.

sense_083577e363e8e555c625d05da98cb380.text: Fueron amigos durante años y después se hicieron novios.
sense_083577e363e8e555c625d05da98cb380.translation: They were friends for years and then they started going out.
How long have they been dating?

sense_378e0595b0b27d090f65db856386e170.text: Vamos a un tianguis donde venden artesanías. ¿Nos acompañas?
sense_378e0595b0b27d090f65db856386e170.translation: We're going to a street market where they sell handicrafts. Do you want to go with us?
Can I go with you to the store?

sense_88ae51e1d62bdf35d68e2ab6bcf6a7f1.text: La chica estaba vendiendo naranjas en el mercado.
sense_88ae51e1d62bdf35d68e2ab6bcf6a7f1.translation: The girl was selling oranges in the market.

sense_3e990154d6bcbb60a051806aca93511e.text: Mi abuela tejió un suéter para la bebé.
sense_3e990154d6bcbb60a051806aca93511e.translation: My grandma knitted a sweater for the baby.

sense_3e990154d6bcbb60a051806aca93511e.text: Las medias que llevo puestas me las tejió mi madrina.
sense_3e990154d6bcbb60a051806aca93511e.translation: My godmother knitted the socks I'm wearing.

sense_31ac5f0419aa1213a6664e11ad8af0b9.translation: Put your money away. It's my treat.
Have a drink. It's on us.

sense_e90aeef0e0e1970a200b76adf786ffb9.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_e90aeef0e0e1970a200b76adf786ffb9.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_e90aeef0e0e1970a200b76adf786ffb9.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_e90aeef0e0e1970a200b76adf786ffb9.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_7eec524ff468042a3564ce3e59aedb02.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_7eec524ff468042a3564ce3e59aedb02.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_7eec524ff468042a3564ce3e59aedb02.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_7eec524ff468042a3564ce3e59aedb02.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_6931ee296676b3a4611be4249f39ccf5.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_6931ee296676b3a4611be4249f39ccf5.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_6931ee296676b3a4611be4249f39ccf5.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_6931ee296676b3a4611be4249f39ccf5.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_1ea349f2b586ca620beb6724d0b83602.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_1ea349f2b586ca620beb6724d0b83602.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_1ea349f2b586ca620beb6724d0b83602.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_1ea349f2b586ca620beb6724d0b83602.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_5b844c023c9f161c89fb11b13b4d1cd5.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_5b844c023c9f161c89fb11b13b4d1cd5.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_5b844c023c9f161c89fb11b13b4d1cd5.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_5b844c023c9f161c89fb11b13b4d1cd5.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_6174ec1644dae0af676370c80a103cf1.text: Volvimos a hablar, pero todavía hay algunos asuntos pendientes.
sense_6174ec1644dae0af676370c80a103cf1.translation: We started talking again, but there are still some issues to sort out.
Did you sort everything out or is there still stuff to do?

sense_6d7672b447ad20a5e2ecadfa8b463ad4.text: Estaban pendientes de noticias del pueblo después del tornado.
sense_6d7672b447ad20a5e2ecadfa8b463ad4.translation: They were waiting on news from the town after the tornado.
We'll keep an eye on your son.

sense_092ef075f648e58f2585b47355b23131.text: Hay diferentes tipos de tortugas en el océano.
sense_092ef075f648e58f2585b47355b23131.translation: There are different kinds of turtles in the ocean.

sense_092ef075f648e58f2585b47355b23131.text: Algunas tortugas pueden vivir cientos de años.
sense_092ef075f648e58f2585b47355b23131.translation: Some turtles can live over hundreds of years.

sense_c53fbfd7341d2945f467504901037b01.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_c53fbfd7341d2945f467504901037b01.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_c53fbfd7341d2945f467504901037b01.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_c53fbfd7341d2945f467504901037b01.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_a1b11bb1a573684c065658670122eeea.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_a1b11bb1a573684c065658670122eeea.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_66ac70a595c244d8939621d9c115d632.text: Fueron a rescatar el pájaro, pero ya estaba muerto.
sense_66ac70a595c244d8939621d9c115d632.translation: They went to rescue the bird, but it was already dead.

sense_66ac70a595c244d8939621d9c115d632.text: Aunque mi autora preferida está muerta, siento que la conozco a través de sus cuentos.
sense_66ac70a595c244d8939621d9c115d632.translation: Although my favorite author is dead, I feel like I know her through her stories.

sense_dba715ddf107a665a97534f888535fdc.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_dba715ddf107a665a97534f888535fdc.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_dba715ddf107a665a97534f888535fdc.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_dba715ddf107a665a97534f888535fdc.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_3ba76994c3adad8421e97060452d2855.text: El prisionero no puede moverse porque está atado por cadenas.
sense_3ba76994c3adad8421e97060452d2855.translation: The prisoner can't move because he is bound by chains.

sense_3ba76994c3adad8421e97060452d2855.text: Ella lleva una cadena de oro alrededor de su cuello para buena suerte.
sense_3ba76994c3adad8421e97060452d2855.translation: She wears a gold chain around her neck for good luck.

sense_4c7c52fd56e087642c07c504719715fd.text: Pablo es el estudiante favorito de la maestra.
sense_4c7c52fd56e087642c07c504719715fd.translation: Pablo is the teacher's favorite student.

sense_4c7c52fd56e087642c07c504719715fd.text: El Sr. Finley es un maestro en la escuela primaria Jefferson.
sense_4c7c52fd56e087642c07c504719715fd.translation: Mr. Finley is a teacher at Jefferson Elementary School.

sense_0c0fa94344d88d7c51397bf2c200aa2e.text: Cuando vio el ratón, pegó un grito.
sense_0c0fa94344d88d7c51397bf2c200aa2e.translation: When she saw the mouse, she screamed.

sense_0c0fa94344d88d7c51397bf2c200aa2e.text: Está en el hospital después de que le hayan pegado un tiro.
sense_0c0fa94344d88d7c51397bf2c200aa2e.translation: He's in the hospital after having been shot.

sense_4bbfe9ab51c5020faf10836624917306.text: Se ha encerrado a trabajar en su libro porque está con el creativo subido.
sense_4bbfe9ab51c5020faf10836624917306.translation: He locked himself in his office to work on his book because he's feeling very creative.

sense_4bbfe9ab51c5020faf10836624917306.text: Yo de ti no le hablaría hoy, está de un antipático subido y solo responde groserías.
sense_4bbfe9ab51c5020faf10836624917306.translation: If I were you, I wouldn't address him today. He's being really mean and rude.

sense_a81c8380ae5ea854bf8986ddeae37fe9.text: En Ramadán, los musulmanes deben observar el ayuno durante el día.
sense_a81c8380ae5ea854bf8986ddeae37fe9.translation: In Ramadan, muslims must fast during the day while it is light.

sense_a81c8380ae5ea854bf8986ddeae37fe9.text: Me extrañó el comentario de Gloria, porque hasta ahora había observado una conducta respetuosa.
sense_a81c8380ae5ea854bf8986ddeae37fe9.translation: I was surprised by Gloria's comment because up until now she had behaved respectfully.

sense_3f20bf464930136a61541353dabb022e.text: Hay que comprar una sartén nueva porque esta ya no sirve.
sense_3f20bf464930136a61541353dabb022e.translation: We need to buy a new frying pan because this one is no good any more.
Is this one any good to you?

sense_b7c4e1d1fe19c17d82c0ac191635afc0.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_b7c4e1d1fe19c17d82c0ac191635afc0.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_b7c4e1d1fe19c17d82c0ac191635afc0.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_b7c4e1d1fe19c17d82c0ac191635afc0.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_89b61a411c0b577ebace9032faad43f3.text: Hablé con un señor del ayuntamiento, un tal Rodríguez.
sense_89b61a411c0b577ebace9032faad43f3.translation: I spoke with a gentleman from city hall, a man named Rodriguez.

sense_89b61a411c0b577ebace9032faad43f3.text: Un tal señor Martín ha llamado preguntando por ti.
sense_89b61a411c0b577ebace9032faad43f3.translation: A Mr. Martin called for you.

sense_7d3525ff72a506f3c0de76dfee135f7f.text: Mi primo está enamorado de mi mejor amiga.
sense_7d3525ff72a506f3c0de76dfee135f7f.translation: My cousin is in love with my best friend.

sense_7d3525ff72a506f3c0de76dfee135f7f.text: ¡Estás enamorada y no lo puedes negar!
sense_7d3525ff72a506f3c0de76dfee135f7f.translation: You're in love and you can't hide it!

sense_f0996e789b3452c515e21d007908ef02.text: "Con estos versos, seguro la enamoro," dijo el poeta.
sense_f0996e789b3452c515e21d007908ef02.translation: "With these verses, I'm sure to make her fall in love," said the poet.

sense_f0996e789b3452c515e21d007908ef02.text: Enamoré a mi mujer haciéndome pasar por escritor, y en eso me convertí.
sense_f0996e789b3452c515e21d007908ef02.translation: I made my wife fall in love with me by pretending to be a writer, and that's what I became.

sense_729d10383d6fa25794037cdf4c0ed1ba.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_729d10383d6fa25794037cdf4c0ed1ba.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_2f3fd5cfe92802c10025ef683d8741dd.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_2f3fd5cfe92802c10025ef683d8741dd.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_c3c5edfe2ab3f6575f2485deb10d82c0.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_c3c5edfe2ab3f6575f2485deb10d82c0.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_c3c5edfe2ab3f6575f2485deb10d82c0.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_c3c5edfe2ab3f6575f2485deb10d82c0.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_4aa0cc7566eeef4463bca7e8e8e53bdf.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_4aa0cc7566eeef4463bca7e8e8e53bdf.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_4aa0cc7566eeef4463bca7e8e8e53bdf.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_4aa0cc7566eeef4463bca7e8e8e53bdf.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_1d1b97d5eeaac90dae8ce8f74e5d517d.text: El leopardo del Amur es una especie protegida en Rusia.
sense_1d1b97d5eeaac90dae8ce8f74e5d517d.translation: The Amur leopard is a protected species in Russia.

sense_1d1b97d5eeaac90dae8ce8f74e5d517d.text: En la isla no hay humanos y constituye un entorno protegido para varias especies.
sense_1d1b97d5eeaac90dae8ce8f74e5d517d.translation: The island is human-free and serves as a protected environment for many species.

sense_92303185801789e2ff0086ac5e503e72.text: Voy a organizar una fiesta sorpresa para mi hermana.
sense_92303185801789e2ff0086ac5e503e72.translation: I'm going to organize a surprise party for my sister.

sense_92303185801789e2ff0086ac5e503e72.text: Me urge ya organizar la recepción para la nueva directora ejecutiva.
sense_92303185801789e2ff0086ac5e503e72.translation: I really need to organize the reception for the new CEO.

sense_59917f30dc87e7d7808e68c46bf696f0.text: Se organizó una pelea afuera del bar.
sense_59917f30dc87e7d7808e68c46bf696f0.translation: There was a fight outside the bar.

sense_59917f30dc87e7d7808e68c46bf696f0.text: Cuando el jugador del Real Madrid se fue al Barcelona, se organizó menudo escándalo.
sense_59917f30dc87e7d7808e68c46bf696f0.translation: When the Real Madrid player left for Barcelona, all hell broke loose.

sense_c9a4897cadeba26ba9617d799f54dec7.translation: Put your money away. It's my treat.
Have a drink. It's on us.

sense_227582d561ec7ced5a528e1475ebe142.text: La supervivencia de esta especie se ve amenazada por la deforestación.
sense_227582d561ec7ced5a528e1475ebe142.translation: The survival of this species is threatened by deforestation.

sense_227582d561ec7ced5a528e1475ebe142.text: Nuestra supervivencia como especie depende de qué tan bien cuidemos de nuestro planeta.
sense_227582d561ec7ced5a528e1475ebe142.translation: Our survival as a species depends on how well we take care of our planet.

sense_42f5820efb79e86716443c6fcfa26def.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_42f5820efb79e86716443c6fcfa26def.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_295cc401ed7f28a9a46edcccf8ee1e80.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_295cc401ed7f28a9a46edcccf8ee1e80.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_cc8771ccd8df845023f2f87d477df72f.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_cc8771ccd8df845023f2f87d477df72f.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_92ba17ac31f3ca8408c24d333df6d9be.text: Cuando yo era joven, no estaba bien mirado que una pareja se juntase sin estar casada.
sense_92ba17ac31f3ca8408c24d333df6d9be.translation: When I was young, it was frowned upon for a couple to live together without being married.

sense_92ba17ac31f3ca8408c24d333df6d9be.text: Si es lo que de verdad quieres hacer, no deberías preocuparte de si está bien o mal mirado.
sense_92ba17ac31f3ca8408c24d333df6d9be.translation: If that's what you really want to do, you shouldn't worry whether it's something people approve or don't approve of.

sense_8cff1b8d99e5314a72ae3e8c7de74afb.text: Me ofrecieron su ayuda para el traslado.
sense_8cff1b8d99e5314a72ae3e8c7de74afb.translation: They offered to help me with the move.

sense_8cff1b8d99e5314a72ae3e8c7de74afb.text: Tengo confianza que me ofrecerán el trabajo.
sense_8cff1b8d99e5314a72ae3e8c7de74afb.translation: I'm confident they'll offer me the job.

sense_ba27bc7f1343fbecc9040d4c19e605f5.text: No tuvimos problemas en la ida, pero de regreso experimentamos muchos retrasos.
sense_ba27bc7f1343fbecc9040d4c19e605f5.translation: We didn't have any problems getting there, but we experienced a lot of delays on the way back.

sense_ba27bc7f1343fbecc9040d4c19e605f5.text: La ida la vamos a hacer por bicicleta, pero de regreso tomaremos el tren.
sense_ba27bc7f1343fbecc9040d4c19e605f5.translation: We're going to go there by bicycle, but we'll return by train.

sense_b7a6db58508f8255f7f10d71acd92712.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_b7a6db58508f8255f7f10d71acd92712.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_7ae1d6e1b44db6386d11b2b92dd2c0ec.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_7ae1d6e1b44db6386d11b2b92dd2c0ec.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_a6521e1e7f67a2756c48a2c03d7b5b4c.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_a6521e1e7f67a2756c48a2c03d7b5b4c.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_a6521e1e7f67a2756c48a2c03d7b5b4c.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_a6521e1e7f67a2756c48a2c03d7b5b4c.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_9246beecb84dc9ca0d0b48dd12cbd9ef.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_9246beecb84dc9ca0d0b48dd12cbd9ef.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_9246beecb84dc9ca0d0b48dd12cbd9ef.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_9246beecb84dc9ca0d0b48dd12cbd9ef.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_31e2e17877bf8b5779f992c462603d4a.text: Admiro profundamente a las personas que hacen trabajo de voluntariado.
sense_31e2e17877bf8b5779f992c462603d4a.translation: I really admire people who do volunteer work.

sense_31e2e17877bf8b5779f992c462603d4a.text: Los colegas del profesor lo admiran por sus contribuciones al campo.
sense_31e2e17877bf8b5779f992c462603d4a.translation: The professor's colleagues admire him for his contributions to the field.

sense_78cdd1f4bbcd3d3602b786af7eb878d9.text: Me encantó el libro pero el final no me convenció.
sense_78cdd1f4bbcd3d3602b786af7eb878d9.translation: I loved the book, but the ending wasn't very good.

sense_78cdd1f4bbcd3d3602b786af7eb878d9.text: Decidieron eliminar los camarones del menú porque no parecía convencer a los clientes.
sense_78cdd1f4bbcd3d3602b786af7eb878d9.translation: They decided to remove shrimp from the menu because customers didn't seem to like them.

sense_3905a17356ce5d9ce810b23b1b7c4248.text: Una mariposa posó en el lomo de la oveja.
sense_3905a17356ce5d9ce810b23b1b7c4248.translation: A butterfly landed on the sheep's back.

sense_c36d0f26b3a5eceb73557614d1e373b2.text: Lávate bien las manos antes de tocarte los ojos.
sense_c36d0f26b3a5eceb73557614d1e373b2.translation: Wash your hands thoroughly before touching your eyes.

sense_c36d0f26b3a5eceb73557614d1e373b2.text: ¡Lávate bien! Vienes muy sucio del partido.
sense_c36d0f26b3a5eceb73557614d1e373b2.translation: Wash properly! You're really dirty from the game.

sense_2ec1c0a8bcfc2f40bee25f3970db0ac3.text: Nunca se me graban los números de teléfono de mis amigos.
sense_2ec1c0a8bcfc2f40bee25f3970db0ac3.translation: I can never remember my friends' telephone numbers.

sense_2ec1c0a8bcfc2f40bee25f3970db0ac3.text: Hoy es un día que se me grabará por siempre en la memoria.
sense_2ec1c0a8bcfc2f40bee25f3970db0ac3.translation: Today is a day that will be forever etched in my mind.

sense_44bdd389c10b9c89d00f9a44f818cc5b.text: Cuando vio el ratón, pegó un grito.
sense_44bdd389c10b9c89d00f9a44f818cc5b.translation: When she saw the mouse, she screamed.

sense_44bdd389c10b9c89d00f9a44f818cc5b.text: Está en el hospital después de que le hayan pegado un tiro.
sense_44bdd389c10b9c89d00f9a44f818cc5b.translation: He's in the hospital after having been shot.

sense_b5f849822eb0c1320c9109bc18b181ab.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_b5f849822eb0c1320c9109bc18b181ab.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_12040beba73617809b6314b55b3bf87e.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_12040beba73617809b6314b55b3bf87e.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_12040beba73617809b6314b55b3bf87e.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_12040beba73617809b6314b55b3bf87e.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_e36610131bdf1f266240fc605d89ee07.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_e36610131bdf1f266240fc605d89ee07.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_e36610131bdf1f266240fc605d89ee07.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_e36610131bdf1f266240fc605d89ee07.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_61bc12e599b1c1471f4e04e032a56f15.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_61bc12e599b1c1471f4e04e032a56f15.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_61bc12e599b1c1471f4e04e032a56f15.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_61bc12e599b1c1471f4e04e032a56f15.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_4cf6958f858620273349b49149d92d59.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_4cf6958f858620273349b49149d92d59.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_4cf6958f858620273349b49149d92d59.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_4cf6958f858620273349b49149d92d59.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_8ff74a034e615f3f5aebec2d33154664.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_8ff74a034e615f3f5aebec2d33154664.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_8ff74a034e615f3f5aebec2d33154664.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_8ff74a034e615f3f5aebec2d33154664.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_b31294ba7105fc6922133ae36551f0d3.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_b31294ba7105fc6922133ae36551f0d3.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_b31294ba7105fc6922133ae36551f0d3.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_b31294ba7105fc6922133ae36551f0d3.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_a7aa0ae07e275e0afd7336b5e86382f2.text: Es buena cocinera, pero le falta experiencia.
sense_a7aa0ae07e275e0afd7336b5e86382f2.translation: She's a good cook, but she lacks experience.

sense_a7aa0ae07e275e0afd7336b5e86382f2.text: Hubo tantos asistentes que faltaban sillas en la sala.
sense_a7aa0ae07e275e0afd7336b5e86382f2.translation: There were so many attendants that the room was short of chairs.

sense_4538e33eb1ddfc19c7126f7c4daafbab.text: A la sopa le faltan 10 minutos.
Faltan dos meses para que sea Navidad.
sense_4538e33eb1ddfc19c7126f7c4daafbab.translation: There are two months to go till Christmas.

sense_88b5c3c698fcd66afc2cef17ebc73af9.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_88b5c3c698fcd66afc2cef17ebc73af9.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_32b130368425eefaeb642a907525c8af.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_32b130368425eefaeb642a907525c8af.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_24e12ca987134506c908e364dacd92df.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_24e12ca987134506c908e364dacd92df.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_24e12ca987134506c908e364dacd92df.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_24e12ca987134506c908e364dacd92df.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_2c32d4d706c1a0557523127ebcb88acb.text: Sueño con tener una casa grande y mucho dinero.
sense_2c32d4d706c1a0557523127ebcb88acb.translation: I dream of having a big house and lots of money.

sense_2c32d4d706c1a0557523127ebcb88acb.text: Ella soñó con el actor famoso.
sense_2c32d4d706c1a0557523127ebcb88acb.translation: She dreamed about the famous actor.

sense_3b2c7cd57f88aed3dc3943bd121c20ae.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_3b2c7cd57f88aed3dc3943bd121c20ae.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_3b2c7cd57f88aed3dc3943bd121c20ae.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_3b2c7cd57f88aed3dc3943bd121c20ae.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_34eaa6387f26f0c987710a361eaab712.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_34eaa6387f26f0c987710a361eaab712.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_ca5b1bb2ebb65c236a751775275e3908.text: Sueño con tener una casa grande y mucho dinero.
sense_ca5b1bb2ebb65c236a751775275e3908.translation: I dream of having a big house and lots of money.

sense_ca5b1bb2ebb65c236a751775275e3908.text: Ella soñó con el actor famoso.
sense_ca5b1bb2ebb65c236a751775275e3908.translation: She dreamed about the famous actor.

sense_3a38063fc2fc3a44bbf110a1dbeb5638.text: El alumno escribió su ensayo de 20 páginas en una noche.
sense_3a38063fc2fc3a44bbf110a1dbeb5638.translation: The student wrote his 20-page essay in one night.

sense_7497a14fe327e0d058427e8660626cc3.text: No hay margen de error en este estudio.
sense_7497a14fe327e0d058427e8660626cc3.translation: There's no margin for error in this study.

sense_7497a14fe327e0d058427e8660626cc3.text: Los cuatro márgenes de la hoja deben ser de 1.5 cm.
sense_7497a14fe327e0d058427e8660626cc3.translation: The four margins on the page should be of 1.5 cm.

sense_8d7b462196adeb7ccd62128d922af1eb.text: El barco se quedó atrapado en el hielo del Ártico y un rescate parecía imposible.
sense_8d7b462196adeb7ccd62128d922af1eb.translation: The boat was trapped in the Arctic ice and rescue seemed impossible.

sense_8d7b462196adeb7ccd62128d922af1eb.text: Se divorció de su esposo porque tenía la sensación de estar atrapada en un matrimonio infeliz y aburrido.
sense_8d7b462196adeb7ccd62128d922af1eb.translation: She divorced her husband because she had the feeling of being trapped in an unhappy and boring marriage.

sense_07cdb5f08584db05342690a5bcd90e92.text: La artesanía que venden en el mercado está toda hecha a mano.
sense_07cdb5f08584db05342690a5bcd90e92.translation: The crafts sold at the market are all handmade.

sense_157995b94230c3ccde06aebf7e495862.text: Me gustan los filetes bien hechos.
sense_157995b94230c3ccde06aebf7e495862.translation: I like my steak well done.

sense_7e7f572da2c1a8e49e36787c3f25bd98.text: Después de la mudanza, estaba hecha polvo.
sense_7e7f572da2c1a8e49e36787c3f25bd98.translation: I was completely exhausted after we moved.

sense_7e7f572da2c1a8e49e36787c3f25bd98.text: Esta casa está hecha un asco.

sense_35e49fabc8aae36bbab4e7c4edadb84e.text: Había una osa con sus oseznos en el zoo.
sense_35e49fabc8aae36bbab4e7c4edadb84e.translation: There was a bear with her cubs at the zoo.

sense_35e49fabc8aae36bbab4e7c4edadb84e.text: Hay osos pardos en aquellas montañas, pero no vimos ninguno.
sense_35e49fabc8aae36bbab4e7c4edadb84e.translation: There are brown bears in those mountains, but we didn't see any.

sense_41e2535dc8becc7278ad8f452d9eb3df.text: ¿Vas a ir a visitar a tu amigo esta noche?
sense_41e2535dc8becc7278ad8f452d9eb3df.translation: Are you going to visit your friend tonight?

sense_41e2535dc8becc7278ad8f452d9eb3df.text: El cirujano visitó al paciente el día después de la operación.
sense_41e2535dc8becc7278ad8f452d9eb3df.translation: The surgeon visited the patient the day after the surgery.

sense_b51dbb6d45bd3911194df986e717c3ce.text: Hay que comprar una sartén nueva porque esta ya no sirve.
sense_b51dbb6d45bd3911194df986e717c3ce.translation: We need to buy a new frying pan because this one is no good any more.
Is this one any good to you?

sense_63a6c7f12ef2a8b8801cd510404e71ad.text: Qué talla más loca lo de ayer, ¿no?
sense_63a6c7f12ef2a8b8801cd510404e71ad.translation: Man, that was crazy what happened yesterday, wasn't it?

sense_63a6c7f12ef2a8b8801cd510404e71ad.text: Oye, te tengo una talla ahí. - Sí, dime, mi hermano. ¿Qué hay?
sense_63a6c7f12ef2a8b8801cd510404e71ad.translation: Hey, I've got something I want to run by you. - Yeah, sure thing, man. What's up?

sense_064d0ecdc35444e84753675e5e262771.text: Mi abuelo me enseñó a tallar estatuillas en madera.
sense_064d0ecdc35444e84753675e5e262771.translation: My grandfather taught me how to carve wood figurines.

sense_064d0ecdc35444e84753675e5e262771.text: Los escultores tallaron unas palabras en latín en el monumento.
sense_064d0ecdc35444e84753675e5e262771.translation: The sculptors carved some words in latin on the monument.

sense_516cf45d3a811ee09a030566f6976694.text: El autobús es una lotería; nunca se sabe cuándo va a venir.
sense_516cf45d3a811ee09a030566f6976694.translation: The bus is a lottery; you never know when it's coming.

sense_516cf45d3a811ee09a030566f6976694.text: Por las dudas, lleva tu documento de identidad. Casi nunca piden que lo muestres, pero es una lotería.
sense_516cf45d3a811ee09a030566f6976694.translation: Bring your identification card just in case. They rarely ask for it, but it's a bit of a gamble.

sense_e8feeafc9d28a54ab72c8560c0811d18.text: Espero estar a tu vera toda la vida, mi amor.
sense_e8feeafc9d28a54ab72c8560c0811d18.translation: I hope to be with you all my life, my love.

sense_e8feeafc9d28a54ab72c8560c0811d18.text: Tenía que quedarme quieto y sentarme a la vera de mi madre durante la misa.
sense_e8feeafc9d28a54ab72c8560c0811d18.translation: I had to stay put and sit next to my mother during the mass.

sense_e96b88fcc46db4d50796b12d7dfcf86d.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_e96b88fcc46db4d50796b12d7dfcf86d.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_b20c473a66eaa5524c61878a385857df.text: Algunos miembros del equipo se produjeron heridas graves.
sense_b20c473a66eaa5524c61878a385857df.translation: Several members of the team were seriously injured.

sense_b20c473a66eaa5524c61878a385857df.text: Se produjo varios cortes en el brazo cuando se cayó del árbol.
sense_b20c473a66eaa5524c61878a385857df.translation: He got several cuts on his arm when he fell from the tree.

sense_dfd6591d72389eb16cf18a093978f8c3.text: David lleva una vida aburrida, sin el menor accidente.
sense_dfd6591d72389eb16cf18a093978f8c3.translation: David leads a boring, uneventful life.

sense_dfd6591d72389eb16cf18a093978f8c3.text: El resto del día pasó sin accidentes, lo que me alivió mucho.
sense_dfd6591d72389eb16cf18a093978f8c3.translation: The rest of the day passed uneventfully, which was a great relief.

sense_e9d789f5f02e12d1daefccf3b6481a3e.text: Por favor, cepíllate los dientes; tu aliento apesta.
sense_e9d789f5f02e12d1daefccf3b6481a3e.translation: Please brush your teeth; your breath stinks.

sense_e9d789f5f02e12d1daefccf3b6481a3e.text: Mi hermana tiene un diente de oro.
sense_e9d789f5f02e12d1daefccf3b6481a3e.translation: My sister has a gold tooth.

sense_612205a3d0e78d38d1c8a9d89201db93.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_612205a3d0e78d38d1c8a9d89201db93.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_a143e889fc0e19704254edf20b55a779.text: Huele a gas en este cuarto.
sense_a143e889fc0e19704254edf20b55a779.translation: It smells like gas in this room.

sense_335fc92496b37ac6f4bb271cb0dfb311.text: Este acuerdo me huele a corrupción.
A mi papá le huele que el vecino se está robando sus periódicos.
sense_335fc92496b37ac6f4bb271cb0dfb311.translation: My father suspects that the neighbor is stealing his newspapers.

sense_a40246246c36b94c3cc8796baaadd057.text: ¡Me encanta tu casa! ¿Tú misma la decoraste?
sense_a40246246c36b94c3cc8796baaadd057.translation: I love your house! Did you decorate it yourself?

sense_a40246246c36b94c3cc8796baaadd057.text: Me encanta tomarme un chocolate caliente cuando hace frío afuera.
sense_a40246246c36b94c3cc8796baaadd057.translation: I love drinking hot chocolate when it's cold out.

sense_9a73b17c91112604dd195efad7346942.text: Tengo unas ganas tremendas de conocerte.
sense_9a73b17c91112604dd195efad7346942.translation: I'm really looking forward to meeting you.

sense_9a73b17c91112604dd195efad7346942.text: Para cuando llegamos a casa yo ya tenía un hambre tremenda.
sense_9a73b17c91112604dd195efad7346942.translation: By the time we got home I was real hungry.

sense_c1725d38d87cd001b30147f2fc9c8345.text: Aquella noche, sentimos la furia de la tormenta.
sense_c1725d38d87cd001b30147f2fc9c8345.translation: We felt the full force of the storm that night.

sense_c1725d38d87cd001b30147f2fc9c8345.text: La furia del vendaval fue tanta que tuve que refugiarme en casa del profesor.
sense_c1725d38d87cd001b30147f2fc9c8345.translation: The gale was so strong that I had to take shelter at the teacher's house.

sense_8d00195f3edc91543209cea79fd461d1.text: Tuvimos que quedarnos en casa porque estaba cayendo un chaparrón.
sense_8d00195f3edc91543209cea79fd461d1.translation: We had to stay home because it was pouring rain.

sense_8d00195f3edc91543209cea79fd461d1.text: Está cayendo una buena nevada. Ponle las cadenas a las ruedas.
sense_8d00195f3edc91543209cea79fd461d1.translation: It's snowing hard. Put the chains on the tires.

sense_3523a713c43e14b0e7a1638b70f9b91b.text: No bebo porque el alcohol me cae mal.
sense_3523a713c43e14b0e7a1638b70f9b91b.translation: I don't drink because alcohol disagrees with me.
You look great in that dress!

sense_58e301c548c4f624e0bdaf6bb8fcb1d1.text: Me cae muy bien tu hermano; siempre me hace sonreír.
sense_58e301c548c4f624e0bdaf6bb8fcb1d1.translation: I really like your brother; he always makes me smile.

sense_58e301c548c4f624e0bdaf6bb8fcb1d1.text: Me marché porque me cae mal tu primo con sus bromas ofensivas.
sense_58e301c548c4f624e0bdaf6bb8fcb1d1.translation: I had to leave because I can't stand your cousin and his offensive jokes.

sense_468dc7a62803a9cbb2b262a5c95336ee.text: Que Harvard la hubiera rechazado, le cayó mal.
sense_468dc7a62803a9cbb2b262a5c95336ee.translation: She wasn't pleased that Harvard rejected her.

sense_468dc7a62803a9cbb2b262a5c95336ee.text: El embarazo de mi hermana pequeña no cayó bien en la familia.
sense_468dc7a62803a9cbb2b262a5c95336ee.translation: My little sister's pregnancy shocked the entire family.

sense_5c0e274f4989db72e49ca0c60fc995d2.text: Mi bebé está llorando porque se cae de sueño.
sense_5c0e274f4989db72e49ca0c60fc995d2.translation: My baby is crying because he's very sleepy.

sense_5c0e274f4989db72e49ca0c60fc995d2.text: Me caigo de cansancio, pero tengo que estudiar para el examen de mañana.
sense_5c0e274f4989db72e49ca0c60fc995d2.translation: I am really tired, but I have to study for tomorrow's exam.

sense_a73cc8427c640797e82f6501d2440059.text: "No hay nada que temer", dijo el mago.
sense_a73cc8427c640797e82f6501d2440059.translation: "There's nothing to fear," said the magician.

sense_a73cc8427c640797e82f6501d2440059.text: "Yo no le temo a la muerte", dijo el temerario motociclista.
sense_a73cc8427c640797e82f6501d2440059.translation: "I don't fear death," said the daredevil motorcyclist.

sense_c9b159353722f0ff70e4b09296f2f829.text: ¿En qué dirección está orientado el apartamento?
sense_c9b159353722f0ff70e4b09296f2f829.translation: Which way does the apartment face?

sense_c9b159353722f0ff70e4b09296f2f829.text: El balcón está orientado hacia el sur y le da el sol toda la tarde.
sense_c9b159353722f0ff70e4b09296f2f829.translation: The balcony is south-facing and gets the sun all afternoon.

sense_e94b49e14889171230546467a075f1bd.text: Si los alimentos crían moho, deshágase de ellos inmediatamente.
sense_e94b49e14889171230546467a075f1bd.translation: If food goes moldy, get rid of it straight away.

sense_e94b49e14889171230546467a075f1bd.text: El hombre aullaba mientras sus manos y sus brazos empezaban a criar vello.
sense_e94b49e14889171230546467a075f1bd.translation: The man howled as his hands and arms started to become hairy.

sense_c882d212cb30ce16532addce5e6fd138.text: La comida maravillosa del restaurante se une a la decoración modernista lujosa.
sense_c882d212cb30ce16532addce5e6fd138.translation: The restaurant's fantastic food is complemented by their luxurious modernist decor.

sense_c882d212cb30ce16532addce5e6fd138.text: Ese tipo es un trabajador fantástico. En él se unen la confianza y la habilidad.
sense_c882d212cb30ce16532addce5e6fd138.translation: That guy's a fantastic worker. He's the epitome of confidence and skill.

sense_73d60c80332b5032fa67c795fa79d895.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_73d60c80332b5032fa67c795fa79d895.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_73d60c80332b5032fa67c795fa79d895.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_73d60c80332b5032fa67c795fa79d895.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_4d285d17d4262f7a58c23b6fd4a2f633.text: El tren no pudo pasar por culpa de un árbol cruzado en la vía.
sense_4d285d17d4262f7a58c23b6fd4a2f633.translation: The train couldn't pass because of a tree blocking the line.

sense_4d285d17d4262f7a58c23b6fd4a2f633.text: Nuria vio a su hija cruzada sobre la cama y la tapó con una manta para que durmiera tranquila.
sense_4d285d17d4262f7a58c23b6fd4a2f633.translation: Nuria saw her daughter lying across the bed and covered her with a blanket so she could sleep peacefully.

sense_ef08c728eb8e909b4f6654b40ea3120c.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_ef08c728eb8e909b4f6654b40ea3120c.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_ef08c728eb8e909b4f6654b40ea3120c.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_ef08c728eb8e909b4f6654b40ea3120c.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_34e57fb679b045042475b5b0414f088b.translation: My father always had a mustache.
