sense_34e57fb679b045042475b5b0414f088b.text: Durante el mes de noviembre, miles de hombres alrededor del país se dejan crecer el bigote.
sense_34e57fb679b045042475b5b0414f088b.translation: During the month of November, thousands of men around the country grow a mustache.

sense_126ea4e039238bd8f1520ef9fc70ec6e.text: Este altar se construyó para honrar a nuestros antepasados.
sense_126ea4e039238bd8f1520ef9fc70ec6e.translation: This altar was built to honor our ancestors.

sense_126ea4e039238bd8f1520ef9fc70ec6e.text: Es habitual honrar a los muertos llevando flores a su tumba.
sense_126ea4e039238bd8f1520ef9fc70ec6e.translation: It's common to honor the dead by bringing flowers to their graves.

sense_052e2496b1672291e8c49dd0e210e776.text: Fue tanta la asistencia que tuvimos que quedarnos de pie.
sense_052e2496b1672291e8c49dd0e210e776.translation: There were so many people there that we had to stand.

sense_052e2496b1672291e8c49dd0e210e776.text: La asistencia fue bastante reducida, y los cantantes se sintieron decepcionados.
sense_052e2496b1672291e8c49dd0e210e776.translation: Not many people came and the singers were disappointed.

sense_732cc0e4483eef55325e6fd44a440ffc.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_732cc0e4483eef55325e6fd44a440ffc.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_732cc0e4483eef55325e6fd44a440ffc.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_732cc0e4483eef55325e6fd44a440ffc.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_c3e1fc24a64310909ab647fbb27d252b.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_c3e1fc24a64310909ab647fbb27d252b.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_c3e1fc24a64310909ab647fbb27d252b.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_c3e1fc24a64310909ab647fbb27d252b.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_2e9ead06da42fad00152649c5ca416b6.text: En estos momentos la grúa está retirando el vehículo accidentado de la carretera.
sense_2e9ead06da42fad00152649c5ca416b6.translation: Right now the tow truck is removing the damaged vehicle from the roadway.

sense_978eeb341b58fd3f06a53a5bd3421751.text: La empresa retiró los autobuses más antiguos.
sense_978eeb341b58fd3f06a53a5bd3421751.translation: The company withdrew the oldest buses.

sense_978eeb341b58fd3f06a53a5bd3421751.text: Retiraron los billetes falsos de la circulación.
sense_978eeb341b58fd3f06a53a5bd3421751.translation: The counterfeit notes were withdrawn from circulation.

sense_de70f1db8e717e45a128d2cfbedf5846.text: Mi marido nunca me retiró la confianza.
sense_de70f1db8e717e45a128d2cfbedf5846.translation: My husband never lost confidence in me.

sense_de70f1db8e717e45a128d2cfbedf5846.text: El partido le retiró la confianza al presidente cuando malversó fondos.
sense_de70f1db8e717e45a128d2cfbedf5846.translation: The president lost the party's confidence when he misappropriated funds.

sense_4c1e0a6ced3a3f0e7626e0a13f021f12.text: El recepcionista me pidió que no me retirara.
sense_4c1e0a6ced3a3f0e7626e0a13f021f12.translation: The receptionist asked me to hold the line.

sense_f644ab01f83e455592a7165a95d92746.text: Cuando vio el ratón, pegó un grito.
sense_f644ab01f83e455592a7165a95d92746.translation: When she saw the mouse, she screamed.

sense_f644ab01f83e455592a7165a95d92746.text: Está en el hospital después de que le hayan pegado un tiro.
sense_f644ab01f83e455592a7165a95d92746.translation: He's in the hospital after having been shot.

sense_4cc0769d226344fef04521a0a5bf757e.text: El avance de los piratas dejó desolada la ciudad amurallada.
sense_4cc0769d226344fef04521a0a5bf757e.translation: The pirates' looting laid waste to the walled city.

sense_4cc0769d226344fef04521a0a5bf757e.text: Perdió todas sus joyas durante el avance de los pillos en su casa.
sense_4cc0769d226344fef04521a0a5bf757e.translation: She lost all her jewelry during the pillaging of her house.

sense_ae3bdf3a0b7ff9b74249e0a1493223ca.text: Tuvimos que quedarnos en casa porque estaba cayendo un chaparrón.
sense_ae3bdf3a0b7ff9b74249e0a1493223ca.translation: We had to stay home because it was pouring rain.

sense_ae3bdf3a0b7ff9b74249e0a1493223ca.text: Está cayendo una buena nevada. Ponle las cadenas a las ruedas.
sense_ae3bdf3a0b7ff9b74249e0a1493223ca.translation: It's snowing hard. Put the chains on the tires.

sense_ea0637995904522d073a88826278a211.text: No bebo porque el alcohol me cae mal.
sense_ea0637995904522d073a88826278a211.translation: I don't drink because alcohol disagrees with me.
You look great in that dress!

sense_abd7da4003e76a8c97648c2b3ce28bbd.text: Me cae muy bien tu hermano; siempre me hace sonreír.
sense_abd7da4003e76a8c97648c2b3ce28bbd.translation: I really like your brother; he always makes me smile.

sense_abd7da4003e76a8c97648c2b3ce28bbd.text: Me marché porque me cae mal tu primo con sus bromas ofensivas.
sense_abd7da4003e76a8c97648c2b3ce28bbd.translation: I had to leave because I can't stand your cousin and his offensive jokes.

sense_b13b5f4704864fb2a5b1a0035faafc27.text: Que Harvard la hubiera rechazado, le cayó mal.
sense_b13b5f4704864fb2a5b1a0035faafc27.translation: She wasn't pleased that Harvard rejected her.

sense_b13b5f4704864fb2a5b1a0035faafc27.text: El embarazo de mi hermana pequeña no cayó bien en la familia.
sense_b13b5f4704864fb2a5b1a0035faafc27.translation: My little sister's pregnancy shocked the entire family.

sense_f5bae5a3d40e52ab1d2bd48afceb604f.text: Mi bebé está llorando porque se cae de sueño.
sense_f5bae5a3d40e52ab1d2bd48afceb604f.translation: My baby is crying because he's very sleepy.

sense_f5bae5a3d40e52ab1d2bd48afceb604f.text: Me caigo de cansancio, pero tengo que estudiar para el examen de mañana.
sense_f5bae5a3d40e52ab1d2bd48afceb604f.translation: I am really tired, but I have to study for tomorrow's exam.

sense_0e741b7b576777ff54911720fd430739.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_0e741b7b576777ff54911720fd430739.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_3a2e46737afb653111cae3e2e3f4a967.text: El alzhéimer suele ser una enfermedad generadora de conflictos en las familias.
sense_3a2e46737afb653111cae3e2e3f4a967.translation: Alzheimer's is a disease that's apt to create conflict within families.

sense_3a2e46737afb653111cae3e2e3f4a967.text: Para ti, ¿cuáles son las situaciones generadoras de estrés en el trabajo?
sense_3a2e46737afb653111cae3e2e3f4a967.translation: What for you are the situations that generate stress at work?

sense_25badc8c14cd9932ae2a8e2bdf2c8965.text: Me gusta jugar al bingo por el dinero.
sense_25badc8c14cd9932ae2a8e2bdf2c8965.translation: I love playing Bingo for money.
Does anybody want to play tennis with me?

sense_14738b50335b443a7c2171de1dadad96.text: Voy a organizar una fiesta sorpresa para mi hermana.
sense_14738b50335b443a7c2171de1dadad96.translation: I'm going to organize a surprise party for my sister.

sense_14738b50335b443a7c2171de1dadad96.text: Me urge ya organizar la recepción para la nueva directora ejecutiva.
sense_14738b50335b443a7c2171de1dadad96.translation: I really need to organize the reception for the new CEO.

sense_5ece5b6fc2bd6eda0ebd1e1c63892fc7.text: Se organizó una pelea afuera del bar.
sense_5ece5b6fc2bd6eda0ebd1e1c63892fc7.translation: There was a fight outside the bar.

sense_5ece5b6fc2bd6eda0ebd1e1c63892fc7.text: Cuando el jugador del Real Madrid se fue al Barcelona, se organizó menudo escándalo.
sense_5ece5b6fc2bd6eda0ebd1e1c63892fc7.translation: When the Real Madrid player left for Barcelona, all hell broke loose.

sense_3b01d1cad53f6b56817fe16888c8f82a.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_3b01d1cad53f6b56817fe16888c8f82a.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_b76a79c2e60ccfb2be4b0361af30351f.text: Pablo ama a su esposa con todo su ser.
sense_b76a79c2e60ccfb2be4b0361af30351f.translation: Pablo loves his wife with all his heart.

sense_b76a79c2e60ccfb2be4b0361af30351f.text: Yo te amo, Ana, y quiero pasar el resto de mi vida contigo.
sense_b76a79c2e60ccfb2be4b0361af30351f.translation: I love you, Ana, and I want to spend the rest of my life with you.

sense_ed37fa208060a66cc94aecb88799d3f5.text: ¿No preferirías ir de vacaciones al extranjero este año?
sense_ed37fa208060a66cc94aecb88799d3f5.translation: Wouldn't you rather vacation abroad this year?

sense_ed37fa208060a66cc94aecb88799d3f5.text: Prefiero que se lo digas tú porque a ti te hace más caso.
sense_ed37fa208060a66cc94aecb88799d3f5.translation: I'd rather you told him because he listens to you more.

sense_f9b0d80c4e2b417ca50328f9ce87be7a.text: ¿Cuánto cuesta la liberación de un celular?
sense_f9b0d80c4e2b417ca50328f9ce87be7a.translation: How much is it to unlock a cellphone?

sense_f9b0d80c4e2b417ca50328f9ce87be7a.text: En la tienda había un cartel que decía: "Liberación de celulares".
sense_f9b0d80c4e2b417ca50328f9ce87be7a.translation: A sign in the shop said "We free your cellphone."

sense_790ead90935904da6a5150bd920428aa.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_790ead90935904da6a5150bd920428aa.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_790ead90935904da6a5150bd920428aa.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_790ead90935904da6a5150bd920428aa.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_b3f4abc61c7fbe62d2cce72482f31fe7.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_b3f4abc61c7fbe62d2cce72482f31fe7.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_b3f4abc61c7fbe62d2cce72482f31fe7.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_b3f4abc61c7fbe62d2cce72482f31fe7.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_ac02b3e661a7db0d18b60c3a576ccdf3.text: Rodolfo se niega a aceptar que la boda está cancelada.
sense_ac02b3e661a7db0d18b60c3a576ccdf3.translation: Rodolfo refuses to believe that the wedding is canceled.

sense_ac02b3e661a7db0d18b60c3a576ccdf3.text: Me niego a pagar cinco dólares de envío por algo que solo cuesta un dólar.
sense_ac02b3e661a7db0d18b60c3a576ccdf3.translation: I refuse to pay five dollars to ship something that only costs a dollar.

sense_dedef8c21bc87071c89f179bf6191fd3.text: Los meteorólogos pronostican la continuación de las lluvias.
sense_dedef8c21bc87071c89f179bf6191fd3.translation: Meteorologists forecast that the rains will continue.

sense_dedef8c21bc87071c89f179bf6191fd3.text: Manuel dice que la falta de dinero le impide la continuación de sus estudios de posgrado.
sense_dedef8c21bc87071c89f179bf6191fd3.translation: Manuel says that lack of money is preventing him from continuing his postgraduate studies.

sense_026927fa6f53e7d0a0ecefdefcb3a5f0.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_026927fa6f53e7d0a0ecefdefcb3a5f0.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_026927fa6f53e7d0a0ecefdefcb3a5f0.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_026927fa6f53e7d0a0ecefdefcb3a5f0.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_653b282ad584631e0b6659736dd007b4.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_653b282ad584631e0b6659736dd007b4.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_653b282ad584631e0b6659736dd007b4.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_653b282ad584631e0b6659736dd007b4.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_a2503e0f52b3b02ab1740791ad788dab.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_a2503e0f52b3b02ab1740791ad788dab.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_0fcacc377d01c1959bac9534037f208d.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_0fcacc377d01c1959bac9534037f208d.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_0fcacc377d01c1959bac9534037f208d.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_0fcacc377d01c1959bac9534037f208d.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_c1c3729a9f50fc332135e72bf6ea06aa.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_c1c3729a9f50fc332135e72bf6ea06aa.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_c1c3729a9f50fc332135e72bf6ea06aa.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_c1c3729a9f50fc332135e72bf6ea06aa.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_bd396fb751d24405e926dba34d48c719.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_bd396fb751d24405e926dba34d48c719.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_bd396fb751d24405e926dba34d48c719.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_bd396fb751d24405e926dba34d48c719.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_a4dc27bb8d816efc429deb975557c5b0.text: Cuatro presos huyeron de la cárcel el domingo por la tarde.
sense_a4dc27bb8d816efc429deb975557c5b0.translation: Four inmates escaped from the prison on Sunday afternoon.

sense_a4dc27bb8d816efc429deb975557c5b0.text: El hada trató de huir, pero el brujo la agarró por las alas.
sense_a4dc27bb8d816efc429deb975557c5b0.translation: The fairy tried to escape, but the wizard grabbed her by the wings.

sense_d70dbbb827b3034fdde971c4bf413c4b.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_d70dbbb827b3034fdde971c4bf413c4b.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_d70dbbb827b3034fdde971c4bf413c4b.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_d70dbbb827b3034fdde971c4bf413c4b.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_62c96eeec20b0ec966f9160d1e9cee59.text: La revolución separó el partido en dos facciones.
sense_62c96eeec20b0ec966f9160d1e9cee59.translation: The revolution separated the party into two factions.

sense_62c96eeec20b0ec966f9160d1e9cee59.text: Separé la clase en grupos de cuatro alumnos cada uno.
sense_62c96eeec20b0ec966f9160d1e9cee59.translation: I divided the class into groups of four students each.

sense_b9445c7c37566f43bbf045e85c7663b3.text: Un ala se separó del transbordador espacial al entrar la atmósfera de la tierra.
sense_b9445c7c37566f43bbf045e85c7663b3.translation: A wing came off the space shuttle upon entering the Earth's atmosphere.

sense_b9445c7c37566f43bbf045e85c7663b3.text: Durante una tormenta, una rama se separó del árbol y cayó encima de mi automóvil.
sense_b9445c7c37566f43bbf045e85c7663b3.translation: A branch of the tree was ripped off during a storm and landed on my car.

sense_1b11da1b070f83c9cd8cdada04b3533e.text: Rodolfo se niega a aceptar que la boda está cancelada.
sense_1b11da1b070f83c9cd8cdada04b3533e.translation: Rodolfo refuses to believe that the wedding is canceled.

sense_1b11da1b070f83c9cd8cdada04b3533e.text: Me niego a pagar cinco dólares de envío por algo que solo cuesta un dólar.
sense_1b11da1b070f83c9cd8cdada04b3533e.translation: I refuse to pay five dollars to ship something that only costs a dollar.

sense_f58fab4ef5e10c5aef8fb806d91996cf.text: Nuestra universidad beca a los alumnos de familias de bajos recursos.
sense_f58fab4ef5e10c5aef8fb806d91996cf.translation: Our university gives a scholarship to students from poor families.

sense_f58fab4ef5e10c5aef8fb806d91996cf.text: De ahora en adelante, este instituto se compromete a becar a cualquier estudiante que lo necesite.
sense_f58fab4ef5e10c5aef8fb806d91996cf.translation: From now on, this institute promises to give a scholarship to any student who needs one.

sense_c78a08732ba63f1ef9dc90c7c8d325b8.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_c78a08732ba63f1ef9dc90c7c8d325b8.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_c78a08732ba63f1ef9dc90c7c8d325b8.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_c78a08732ba63f1ef9dc90c7c8d325b8.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_5c0301eed7dab57e35dfb27ff38e67ed.text: ¡Carajo con esta cafetera! Necesitamos comprar otra.
sense_5c0301eed7dab57e35dfb27ff38e67ed.translation: This damn coffeemaker! We need to buy another one.
Where the hell did I put my wallet?

sense_511efe184c9c3cd07b37d8b85bb14834.text: Esos son los churros más deliciosos de toda la ciudad.
sense_511efe184c9c3cd07b37d8b85bb14834.translation: Those are the most delicious churros in the whole city.

sense_9b31707117bfc8fb9f18fc2eee1269fe.text: He visto esta película pero esas no todavía.
sense_9b31707117bfc8fb9f18fc2eee1269fe.translation: I've seen this movie but not those ones yet.

sense_9b31707117bfc8fb9f18fc2eee1269fe.text: ¿Has probado estos caramelos? - ¡Sí, esos me encantan!
sense_9b31707117bfc8fb9f18fc2eee1269fe.translation: Have you tried these chocolates? - Yes, I love those ones!

sense_4a12e7791fdc4a1347c3362f84c9a919.text: La culpa es tuya. - ¿Mía? ¡Hay que joderse! ¡Pero si yo ni siquiera estaba aquí!
sense_4a12e7791fdc4a1347c3362f84c9a919.translation: It's your fault. - My fault? For fuck's sake! But I wasn't even here!

sense_4a12e7791fdc4a1347c3362f84c9a919.text: No me dejaron ustedes nada de comida. - ¡Te jodes! Es tu culpa por llegar tarde.
sense_4a12e7791fdc4a1347c3362f84c9a919.translation: You didn't leave any food for me. - Tough shit! It's your fault for being late.

sense_4bc3705cf021badd643eb81562c2e69d.text: Fue una boda magnífica; no repararon en gastos.
sense_4bc3705cf021badd643eb81562c2e69d.translation: It was a fantastic wedding; they spared no expense.

sense_4bc3705cf021badd643eb81562c2e69d.text: Cuando Elsa va de vacaciones, no repara en gastos.
sense_4bc3705cf021badd643eb81562c2e69d.translation: When Elsa goes on vacation, she spares no expense.

sense_da8cf257b9a1ad4d19e1e69e285dba98.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_da8cf257b9a1ad4d19e1e69e285dba98.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_4c4737f72988809a176bbfeae75925d6.text: Jorge cumplió su sueño de convertirse en médico.
sense_4c4737f72988809a176bbfeae75925d6.translation: Jorge achieved his dream of becoming a doctor.

sense_4c4737f72988809a176bbfeae75925d6.text: Hay que tener fuerza de voluntad para cumplir tus metas.
sense_4c4737f72988809a176bbfeae75925d6.translation: You need willpower to achieve your goals.

sense_4da2ab483cc0451f169f8a66c75c199e.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_4da2ab483cc0451f169f8a66c75c199e.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_d8d0d18e8e2aac898690be47a1e8d8fc.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_d8d0d18e8e2aac898690be47a1e8d8fc.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_31836fede2295bde1b6ebc6725455391.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_31836fede2295bde1b6ebc6725455391.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_31836fede2295bde1b6ebc6725455391.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_31836fede2295bde1b6ebc6725455391.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_29e6b923a06befbd6b42e8f53a236d7b.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_29e6b923a06befbd6b42e8f53a236d7b.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_29e6b923a06befbd6b42e8f53a236d7b.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_29e6b923a06befbd6b42e8f53a236d7b.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_b18ed602089a3c1bc0743bbbfdf9092a.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_b18ed602089a3c1bc0743bbbfdf9092a.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_b18ed602089a3c1bc0743bbbfdf9092a.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_b18ed602089a3c1bc0743bbbfdf9092a.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_7507182e9626c5e04618483109a9b7a6.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_7a481bd8e6a35351e603156d84a0613d.text: Es importante que siempre consideres los sentimientos de los demás.
sense_7a481bd8e6a35351e603156d84a0613d.translation: It's important that you always consider other people's feelings.

sense_7a481bd8e6a35351e603156d84a0613d.text: Siempre hay que considerar a las personas mayores en el autobús y cederles el asiento.
sense_7a481bd8e6a35351e603156d84a0613d.translation: You should always show consideration for older people on the bus and give up your seat for them.

sense_3a85fbdbbd535bae9719eb02699dd6ee.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_3a85fbdbbd535bae9719eb02699dd6ee.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_3a85fbdbbd535bae9719eb02699dd6ee.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_3a85fbdbbd535bae9719eb02699dd6ee.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_d01a178eedf49a4879c2bdde99672198.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_d01a178eedf49a4879c2bdde99672198.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_f5a9b4063302122f1ac5ec21cb271482.text: La chica estaba vendiendo naranjas en el mercado.
sense_f5a9b4063302122f1ac5ec21cb271482.translation: The girl was selling oranges in the market.

sense_300515324dab1b4518892232eff9c25f.text: Llevas todo el día danzando. Siéntate y descanso un rato.
sense_300515324dab1b4518892232eff9c25f.translation: You've been on the go all day! Sit down and have a rest.

sense_300515324dab1b4518892232eff9c25f.text: Me pasé todo el día danzando con los preparativos de la fiesta sorpresa.
sense_300515324dab1b4518892232eff9c25f.translation: I was on the go all day getting the surprise party ready.

sense_7187f4ce3b4956ba50f44e7621a6da04.text: Caminé toda la tarde con botas y tengo los pies destrozados.
sense_7187f4ce3b4956ba50f44e7621a6da04.translation: I walked the entire afternoon in boots and now my feet are killing me.

sense_7187f4ce3b4956ba50f44e7621a6da04.text: No pienso comprar ese sillón porque es muy viejo y está destrozado.
sense_7187f4ce3b4956ba50f44e7621a6da04.translation: I don't plan on buying that armchair, because it's very old and is falling apart.

sense_6f3921e0bcb50d67bee768919f70d6e8.text: Dicen que el alcalde recibió dinero de fuentes sospechosas.
sense_6f3921e0bcb50d67bee768919f70d6e8.translation: They say that the mayor received money from shady sources.

sense_6f3921e0bcb50d67bee768919f70d6e8.text: La víctima recibió un fuerte golpe al lado de la cabeza.
sense_6f3921e0bcb50d67bee768919f70d6e8.translation: The victim received a strong blow to the side of the head.

sense_2f50111216b65a7fab74c0ab5bf91d34.text: El equipo visitante fue recibido con silbidos y abucheos.
sense_2f50111216b65a7fab74c0ab5bf91d34.translation: The visiting team was received with whistles and jeers.

sense_2f50111216b65a7fab74c0ab5bf91d34.text: Nos recibió personalmente en el aeropuerto.
sense_2f50111216b65a7fab74c0ab5bf91d34.translation: He personally welcomed us at the airport.

sense_b19a538771fb738d2a55a6fc95e787b5.text: Mi hermana se recibió de ingeniera en Georgia Tech.
sense_b19a538771fb738d2a55a6fc95e787b5.translation: My sister graduated as an engineer from Georgia Tech.
How many students will graduate this year?

sense_80e1575a16e9db01fe8604b0cad93667.text: Se desarrolló un nuevo tratamiento salvador de vidas.
sense_80e1575a16e9db01fe8604b0cad93667.translation: A new life-saving treatment has been developed.

sense_80e1575a16e9db01fe8604b0cad93667.text: Las decisiones tomadas por los médicos pueden ser salvadoras de vidas.
sense_80e1575a16e9db01fe8604b0cad93667.translation: Decisions taken by doctors can be life-saving.

sense_48c513c60b5e641f657310588821906b.text: No me parece sano desayunar pizza sobrante todos los días.
sense_48c513c60b5e641f657310588821906b.translation: I don't think it's healthy to eat leftover pizza for breakfast every day.
We live a very healthy life.

sense_135a5bff8e510f43f2e0c6d4c3174ba5.text: Dicen que el alcalde recibió dinero de fuentes sospechosas.
sense_135a5bff8e510f43f2e0c6d4c3174ba5.translation: They say that the mayor received money from shady sources.

sense_135a5bff8e510f43f2e0c6d4c3174ba5.text: La víctima recibió un fuerte golpe al lado de la cabeza.
sense_135a5bff8e510f43f2e0c6d4c3174ba5.translation: The victim received a strong blow to the side of the head.

sense_42b6e6ad621c201ee16162f3e344a85e.text: El equipo visitante fue recibido con silbidos y abucheos.
sense_42b6e6ad621c201ee16162f3e344a85e.translation: The visiting team was received with whistles and jeers.

sense_42b6e6ad621c201ee16162f3e344a85e.text: Nos recibió personalmente en el aeropuerto.
sense_42b6e6ad621c201ee16162f3e344a85e.translation: He personally welcomed us at the airport.

sense_88bb8eaf032ed016df56a795f8fc0828.text: Mi hermana se recibió de ingeniera en Georgia Tech.
sense_88bb8eaf032ed016df56a795f8fc0828.translation: My sister graduated as an engineer from Georgia Tech.
How many students will graduate this year?

sense_d42912a2944eabbd6b42fc7660774ef5.text: Esa mujer es pariente lejana mía.
sense_d42912a2944eabbd6b42fc7660774ef5.translation: That woman is a distant relative of mine.

sense_d42912a2944eabbd6b42fc7660774ef5.text: Vamos a pasar Navidad con unos parientes de mi esposo este año.
sense_d42912a2944eabbd6b42fc7660774ef5.translation: We're spending Christmas with some of my husband's relatives this year.

sense_ba4c62408bbb98e74c6d1a04dc59b557.text: La disciplina y el honor informan su naturaleza como soldado.
sense_ba4c62408bbb98e74c6d1a04dc59b557.translation: He is a soldier who believes in discipline and honor.
Her silhouette hints at her beauty.

sense_9d284a405a99c963241e788c2bfac88b.text: Parece que el alcalde suicida tenía un cáncer.
sense_9d284a405a99c963241e788c2bfac88b.translation: Apparently the mayor who committed suicide was suffering from cancer.

sense_9d284a405a99c963241e788c2bfac88b.text: En primera plana había una foto de la pobre actriz suicida.
sense_9d284a405a99c963241e788c2bfac88b.translation: On the front page was a photo of the poor actress who'd taken her own life.

sense_f8484c5dd182c6d39a678f326b8507c8.text: El atentado fue llevado a cabo por dos jóvenes suicidas.
sense_f8484c5dd182c6d39a678f326b8507c8.translation: The attack was carried out by two young suicide bombers.

sense_f8484c5dd182c6d39a678f326b8507c8.text: Un niño suicida hizo estallar una bomba fuera de la comisaría.
sense_f8484c5dd182c6d39a678f326b8507c8.translation: A child suicide bomber set off a bomb outside the police station.

sense_fae0b8c1d63529e10da9fb45b1c93cb9.text: Me parece que hacer eso sería un acto suicida.
sense_fae0b8c1d63529e10da9fb45b1c93cb9.translation: I think it would be suicidal to do that.

sense_feb0ceca75fd49e3e1c36f7709f6e9e9.translation: This is a fine mess you've got us into!

sense_3e91d75c2b37c88cce635ea7d908ff1d.translation: I just want to make you happy.
What do you want for Christmas?

sense_e1acd58df7c96d89230222934c07c65e.translation: "How can I help you?," asked the butler.
Would you like something to drink?

sense_010b05484867c0188e621d90a6ed3f3a.text: Si los alimentos crían moho, deshágase de ellos inmediatamente.
sense_010b05484867c0188e621d90a6ed3f3a.translation: If food goes moldy, get rid of it straight away.

sense_010b05484867c0188e621d90a6ed3f3a.text: El hombre aullaba mientras sus manos y sus brazos empezaban a criar vello.
sense_010b05484867c0188e621d90a6ed3f3a.translation: The man howled as his hands and arms started to become hairy.

sense_88789fb58d10d718f495f4015c4c941f.text: El hotel tiene una situación ideal cerca de la playa.
sense_88789fb58d10d718f495f4015c4c941f.translation: The hotel is ideally situated near the beach.

sense_88789fb58d10d718f495f4015c4c941f.text: La situación del restaurante es céntrica.

sense_d0fd9c2c92b5634ade2034dcba2ec8b8.text: La tecnología extraterrestre es mucho más adelantada que la nuestra.
sense_d0fd9c2c92b5634ade2034dcba2ec8b8.translation: Alien technology is much more advanced than ours.

sense_d0fd9c2c92b5634ade2034dcba2ec8b8.text: En cuanto a sus opiniones sobre el cuidado de los niños, es cierto que fue un hombre adelantado a su tiempo.
sense_d0fd9c2c92b5634ade2034dcba2ec8b8.translation: In his views on childcare he was certainly ahead of his time.

sense_052b5cd0c797a0671f078b5fa50b9ce3.text: Se adelantó a sus dudas y tenía listas las respuestas.
sense_052b5cd0c797a0671f078b5fa50b9ce3.translation: He anticipated their doubts and he had answers ready.

sense_052b5cd0c797a0671f078b5fa50b9ce3.text: Iba a ordenar la casa esta tarde, pero mi mujer se me adelantó.
sense_052b5cd0c797a0671f078b5fa50b9ce3.translation: I was going to tidy the house this afternoon, but my wife beat me to it.

sense_c0295e5c27b0df3bb2401cf558561367.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_c0295e5c27b0df3bb2401cf558561367.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_378f90c880b7e6f1f6c3751232d2db68.text: ¿Será que te arrestas a lanzarte en paracaídas?
sense_378f90c880b7e6f1f6c3751232d2db68.translation: Would you dare to go skydiving?

sense_378f90c880b7e6f1f6c3751232d2db68.text: Luz es una mujer valiente que se arresta a todo.
sense_378f90c880b7e6f1f6c3751232d2db68.translation: Luz is a brave woman who's afraid of nothing.

sense_5c0d4d56a8ba6df5f2e0ab709551e847.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_5c0d4d56a8ba6df5f2e0ab709551e847.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_5c0d4d56a8ba6df5f2e0ab709551e847.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_5c0d4d56a8ba6df5f2e0ab709551e847.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_00fd3163a579994987d4cdf61858a58a.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_00fd3163a579994987d4cdf61858a58a.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_e8d7bf7e5fc781a323b698dd6dadeb15.text: Si me permite, señora, creo que puedo arreglar la puerta.
sense_e8d7bf7e5fc781a323b698dd6dadeb15.translation: If I may, ma'am, I think I can fix the door.

sense_dc578c4f18ec7900f0fc17ca9e7c361e.text: Todas las noches cubre su auto con un protector de plástico.
sense_dc578c4f18ec7900f0fc17ca9e7c361e.translation: Every night he puts a protective plastic cover over his car.

sense_dc578c4f18ec7900f0fc17ca9e7c361e.text: Es importante usar protectores (como guantes, batas y mascarillas) en este ambiente.
sense_dc578c4f18ec7900f0fc17ca9e7c361e.translation: It's important to wear protective clothing (such as gloves, coveralls and masks) in this environment.

sense_42375aede63b314906746d4437eced59.text: Le di un baño de chocolate a las galletas.
sense_42375aede63b314906746d4437eced59.translation: I covered the cookies with a chocolate coating.

sense_42375aede63b314906746d4437eced59.text: Se le da un baño de almíbar al bizcocho antes de rellenarlo.
sense_42375aede63b314906746d4437eced59.translation: The sponge cake is soaked in syrup before filling it.

sense_27a485a260040aced8f51105731dd2e5.text: La primera edición del concurso de baile tuvo lugar en 2014.
sense_27a485a260040aced8f51105731dd2e5.translation: The dance contest first took place in 2014.

sense_27a485a260040aced8f51105731dd2e5.text: La edición de los Premios Goya de este año se celebrará en Barcelona.
sense_27a485a260040aced8f51105731dd2e5.translation: This year's Goya Awards will be held in Barcelona.

sense_d9e71cdb8c8c8d4f26967118a905f888.text: Los corderos nacieron con cinco minutos de diferencia.
sense_d9e71cdb8c8c8d4f26967118a905f888.translation: The lambs were born within five minutes of each other.

sense_d9e71cdb8c8c8d4f26967118a905f888.text: Al cordero que acaba de nacer le vamos a poner Cornelio.
sense_d9e71cdb8c8c8d4f26967118a905f888.translation: We're going to name the lamb that was just born Cornelius.

sense_a8730a167cfd043beb978565341e5a69.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_a8730a167cfd043beb978565341e5a69.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_cbb65c42cad8ddaa71be4c3d0024969d.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_cbb65c42cad8ddaa71be4c3d0024969d.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_cbb65c42cad8ddaa71be4c3d0024969d.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_cbb65c42cad8ddaa71be4c3d0024969d.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_802fd44db31e453433ff9c88ec2d3a40.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_802fd44db31e453433ff9c88ec2d3a40.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_3bfffeea647251f158834adb46c557b0.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_3bfffeea647251f158834adb46c557b0.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_283ef60a1c5a7edd8a7795d2c9bfc125.text: Las olas eran muy grandes, pero los expertos surfistas fueron dueños de la situación.
sense_283ef60a1c5a7edd8a7795d2c9bfc125.translation: The waves were very big, but the expert surfers were in control of the situation.

sense_283ef60a1c5a7edd8a7795d2c9bfc125.text: La reunión empezó a desmoronarse hasta que el abogado habló y se hizo dueño de la situación.
sense_283ef60a1c5a7edd8a7795d2c9bfc125.translation: The meeting was starting to fall apart until the lawyer spoke and took control of the situation.

sense_c8b7f1f308ed32a20053a05ed250ace3.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_c8b7f1f308ed32a20053a05ed250ace3.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_c8b7f1f308ed32a20053a05ed250ace3.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_c8b7f1f308ed32a20053a05ed250ace3.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_203f8762a778e7af5a74ffacf0174264.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_203f8762a778e7af5a74ffacf0174264.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_203f8762a778e7af5a74ffacf0174264.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_203f8762a778e7af5a74ffacf0174264.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_1aea964cad38865923c5ba08f079a19c.translation: Put your money away. It's my treat.
Have a drink. It's on us.

sense_2a81e695c0c26bee014822e190d7475d.text: Vamos a un tianguis donde venden artesanías. ¿Nos acompañas?
sense_2a81e695c0c26bee014822e190d7475d.translation: We're going to a street market where they sell handicrafts. Do you want to go with us?
Can I go with you to the store?

sense_9d2987e6f30f4f38541fd26b7275313a.text: No te preocupes, los niños vendrán ya comidos.
sense_9d2987e6f30f4f38541fd26b7275313a.translation: Don't worry. The children will have eaten before they come.

sense_9d2987e6f30f4f38541fd26b7275313a.text: Será un partido difícil, así que vengan bien comidos y dormidos.
sense_9d2987e6f30f4f38541fd26b7275313a.translation: It will be a tough game, so make sure you eat well and have a good night's sleep.

sense_99fe785ac3742e714de8b9e7bba59e14.text: Esta carne de cerdo está muy tierna.
Este pollo es muy tierno; iría muy bien con mole.
sense_99fe785ac3742e714de8b9e7bba59e14.translation: This chicken is very tender; it'd go great with mole sauce.

sense_be5acae69c9fa72530533b605e9971b7.text: Cada vez que lavo la ropa, pierdo un calcetín.
sense_be5acae69c9fa72530533b605e9971b7.translation: Every time I do laundry, I lose a sock.
I can't find my blue socks.

sense_241f8fc508910c20924759bdf6fca83f.text: Esto me parece el billete de lotería ganador o ¿me traicionan los ojos?
sense_241f8fc508910c20924759bdf6fca83f.translation: Do my eyes deceive me, or am I holding the winning lottery ticket?

sense_241f8fc508910c20924759bdf6fca83f.text: Si no me traiciona la memoria, aquí es el lugar donde enterré el tesoro.
sense_241f8fc508910c20924759bdf6fca83f.translation: If memory serves me right, here is the place where I buried the treasure.

sense_8a8d7b87caf5350a691b05903771d91e.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_8a8d7b87caf5350a691b05903771d91e.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_8a8d7b87caf5350a691b05903771d91e.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_8a8d7b87caf5350a691b05903771d91e.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_6fa24db57af71bacf3a32fb51cb491ec.text: Ella hace la cama todas las mañanas.
sense_6fa24db57af71bacf3a32fb51cb491ec.translation: She makes the bed every morning.

sense_6fa24db57af71bacf3a32fb51cb491ec.text: El espacio que tengo en mi cama doble es tan lujoso.
sense_6fa24db57af71bacf3a32fb51cb491ec.translation: The space I have in my double bed is so luxurious.

sense_38577dae2800e6f4048cbd2477308e46.text: Cuando vio el ratón, pegó un grito.
sense_38577dae2800e6f4048cbd2477308e46.translation: When she saw the mouse, she screamed.

sense_38577dae2800e6f4048cbd2477308e46.text: Está en el hospital después de que le hayan pegado un tiro.
sense_38577dae2800e6f4048cbd2477308e46.translation: He's in the hospital after having been shot.

sense_c3644c28bbaaf1cb1f995bbe678906b5.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_c3644c28bbaaf1cb1f995bbe678906b5.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_410cbed6b8dedcd620f81819c9b2ad27.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_410cbed6b8dedcd620f81819c9b2ad27.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_de552b52ae79db3841c7070840471edd.text: Voy andando al colegio todos los días.
sense_de552b52ae79db3841c7070840471edd.translation: I walk to school every day.

sense_de552b52ae79db3841c7070840471edd.text: "Cuando ando, me canso mucho", le dijo la anciana a su médico.
sense_de552b52ae79db3841c7070840471edd.translation: "When I walk, I get very tired," the old woman told her doctor.

sense_f591290ff9abb04aa536ec98964381fa.text: En el verano ella anda en bicicleta al trabajo.
sense_f591290ff9abb04aa536ec98964381fa.translation: In the summer she takes her bike to work.

sense_f591290ff9abb04aa536ec98964381fa.text: Yo siempre ando en tren cuando regreso al hogar.
sense_f591290ff9abb04aa536ec98964381fa.translation: I always take the train when returning home.

sense_58eec842297d805df94fcb22e9573a44.text: ¡Qué andar tan raro tienen esos jóvenes!
sense_58eec842297d805df94fcb22e9573a44.translation: The way those youths walk is really strange!

sense_58eec842297d805df94fcb22e9573a44.text: Se le nota en el andar que tiene mucho dolor.
sense_58eec842297d805df94fcb22e9573a44.translation: You can tell by the way she walks that she's in a lot of pain.

sense_f97615ada75342bd24c27f37205b94fe.text: Me gusta todo de ti, hasta los andares.
sense_f97615ada75342bd24c27f37205b94fe.translation: I like everything about you, even the way you walk.

sense_f97615ada75342bd24c27f37205b94fe.text: El Charlot de Charlie Chaplin tiene unos andares totalmente inconfundibles.
sense_f97615ada75342bd24c27f37205b94fe.translation: The way Charlie Chaplin's tramp walks is completely unmistakeable.

sense_e19d80e62880fd06b30a6641a36360f6.text: La asociación propietaria de la web no se responsabiliza de nada.
sense_e19d80e62880fd06b30a6641a36360f6.translation: The association which owns the website takes no responsibility for anything.

sense_e19d80e62880fd06b30a6641a36360f6.text: Se ruega a las personas propietarias de viviendas vacías que se pongan en contacto con el ayuntamiento.
sense_e19d80e62880fd06b30a6641a36360f6.translation: Anyone who owns an empty property is asked to contact the town hall.

sense_72349dd261d540ecc388c6d8fa36cc69.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_72349dd261d540ecc388c6d8fa36cc69.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_72349dd261d540ecc388c6d8fa36cc69.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_72349dd261d540ecc388c6d8fa36cc69.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_4b894c7c6bde0395d8fbef6ae12bf4be.text: Dale saludos de mi parte a tu abuela.
sense_4b894c7c6bde0395d8fbef6ae12bf4be.translation: Say hello to your grandmother from me.
My parents send you their regards.

sense_628a1c21f6421ada0c42a9ed04cffd6e.text: Alfredo me dirigió un saludo con la mano desde el andén.
sense_628a1c21f6421ada0c42a9ed04cffd6e.translation: Alfredo gave me a wave from the platform.

sense_628a1c21f6421ada0c42a9ed04cffd6e.text: Nos saludó con la cabeza del otro lado de la calle.
sense_628a1c21f6421ada0c42a9ed04cffd6e.translation: He nodded at us from across the street.

sense_ec86336bf3730555e5e7e8f8e891527d.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_ec86336bf3730555e5e7e8f8e891527d.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_ec86336bf3730555e5e7e8f8e891527d.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_ec86336bf3730555e5e7e8f8e891527d.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_5300feab395f90b0be575b03e7accbeb.text: Mi padre nos dejó una casa en herencia.
sense_5300feab395f90b0be575b03e7accbeb.translation: We inherited a house from my father.

sense_5300feab395f90b0be575b03e7accbeb.text: Quiero dejarle mis joyas a mi sobrina en herencia.
sense_5300feab395f90b0be575b03e7accbeb.translation: I want to bequeath my jewelry to my niece.

sense_c1f56e8f39a5f2f09165149228c498d0.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_c1f56e8f39a5f2f09165149228c498d0.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_c1f56e8f39a5f2f09165149228c498d0.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_c1f56e8f39a5f2f09165149228c498d0.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_39258210e5b925586ce4ea13954ef965.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_39258210e5b925586ce4ea13954ef965.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_4405f04555766ec3639c6371cdbeb3d0.translation: Could I see a menu, please?
Can you pass me that pencil?

sense_7047061576a416c7a236805ac73d48d7.text: Muchos militantes anónimos de izquierda sufrieron persecuciones y el exilio.
sense_7047061576a416c7a236805ac73d48d7.translation: Many anonymous members of the left were persecuted and exiled.

sense_7047061576a416c7a236805ac73d48d7.text: El pueblo gitano fue objeto de persecución durante el período previo a la Segunda Guerra Mundial.
sense_7047061576a416c7a236805ac73d48d7.translation: The gypsy population was persecuted during the period prior to the Second World War.

sense_e388931e9f3dba7f143c5b868fecf9e3.text: El programa era tan aburrido que me dormí.
sense_e388931e9f3dba7f143c5b868fecf9e3.translation: The program was so boring that I fell asleep.

sense_e388931e9f3dba7f143c5b868fecf9e3.text: Me dormí a las 6 de la mañana.
sense_e388931e9f3dba7f143c5b868fecf9e3.translation: I fell asleep at 6 in the morning.

sense_85971e398dba4124b5d74cd9f9baeae7.text: No te duermas o no acabarás a tiempo.
sense_85971e398dba4124b5d74cd9f9baeae7.translation: Don't slack off or you won't finish in time.

sense_85971e398dba4124b5d74cd9f9baeae7.text: Por dormirse se perdió la clave para ganar el premio.
sense_85971e398dba4124b5d74cd9f9baeae7.translation: He missed the clue to win the prize because he didn't stay on his toes.

sense_c96d8d1e899497636917d24ab3c4a2f6.text: Nunca se me graban los números de teléfono de mis amigos.
sense_c96d8d1e899497636917d24ab3c4a2f6.translation: I can never remember my friends' telephone numbers.

sense_c96d8d1e899497636917d24ab3c4a2f6.text: Hoy es un día que se me grabará por siempre en la memoria.
sense_c96d8d1e899497636917d24ab3c4a2f6.translation: Today is a day that will be forever etched in my mind.

sense_72950bfe76f0c8a083d6095fca843c88.text: ¿Averiguaste qué era lo que le pasaba?
sense_72950bfe76f0c8a083d6095fca843c88.translation: Did you find out what was wrong with him?

sense_72950bfe76f0c8a083d6095fca843c88.text: No me sé el número de Gabriela, pero te lo puedo averiguar.
sense_72950bfe76f0c8a083d6095fca843c88.translation: I don't know Gabriela's number, but I can find out for you.

sense_ea1645e52e3ed28303abaf8c7ac70631.text: Solía sentarme en el rincón del salón de clases.
sense_ea1645e52e3ed28303abaf8c7ac70631.translation: I used to sit in the corner of the classroom.

sense_ea1645e52e3ed28303abaf8c7ac70631.text: ¿Quién es ese hombre misterioso en la mesa del rincón?
sense_ea1645e52e3ed28303abaf8c7ac70631.translation: Who is that mysterious man at that table in the corner?

sense_d24613c94f9f7571c75ef5d6c98074f7.text: La celebración de la reunión ha sido pospuesta indefinidamente.
sense_d24613c94f9f7571c75ef5d6c98074f7.translation: The meeting has been indefinitely postponed.

sense_d24613c94f9f7571c75ef5d6c98074f7.text: Todo quedará paralizado hasta la celebración de las elecciones.
sense_d24613c94f9f7571c75ef5d6c98074f7.translation: Nothing will get done until the elections are held.

sense_10be1238149cd00a3348a33ff463895b.text: ¡Este postre está riquísimo! ¿Cómo sabía que me chiflaban las avellanas?
sense_10be1238149cd00a3348a33ff463895b.translation: This dessert is delicious! How did you know I was crazy about hazelnuts?

sense_10be1238149cd00a3348a33ff463895b.text: No hay nada más emocionante que aprender de un profesor al que le chifla lo que enseña.
sense_10be1238149cd00a3348a33ff463895b.translation: There's nothing more exciting than learning from a professor who's mad about what he teaches.

sense_4380d48afcbac748935cc99c96fa4b9f.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_4380d48afcbac748935cc99c96fa4b9f.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_9e03f5d8731285ca88abdd64857248a7.text: La empresa se enfrentaba a una absorción corporativa pero nos resistimos.
sense_9e03f5d8731285ca88abdd64857248a7.translation: The company was faced with a corporate takeover but we resisted.

sense_9e03f5d8731285ca88abdd64857248a7.text: La policía tuvo que usar la fuerza porque el ladrón se resistió al arresto.
sense_9e03f5d8731285ca88abdd64857248a7.translation: The police had to use force because the thief resisted arrest.

sense_c3e45363c796d7ebfe921aa943df72a2.text: Ya no resisto más; quiero escapar de todo esto.
sense_c3e45363c796d7ebfe921aa943df72a2.translation: I can't stand it anymore; I want to escape all this.

sense_c3e45363c796d7ebfe921aa943df72a2.text: Laura dice que ya no resiste más y que quiere dejar sus estudios.
sense_c3e45363c796d7ebfe921aa943df72a2.translation: Laura says she can't take anymore and wants to give up her studies.

sense_caff5d89d2ea521d33822f1673584f1d.text: Pablo toma clases particulares porque se le resisten las matemáticas.
sense_caff5d89d2ea521d33822f1673584f1d.translation: Pablo takes private lessons because he finds math difficult.

sense_caff5d89d2ea521d33822f1673584f1d.text: Por más que lo intento, se me resiste esta materia.
sense_caff5d89d2ea521d33822f1673584f1d.translation: However hard I try, this subject is beyond me.

sense_79c298e5bd02244f96acca2565122deb.text: Laura estimaba en poco a su jefe.
sense_79c298e5bd02244f96acca2565122deb.translation: Laura didn't have a high opinion of her boss.

sense_79c298e5bd02244f96acca2565122deb.text: Mi padre siempre ha estimado mucho a mi novio, afortunadamente.
sense_79c298e5bd02244f96acca2565122deb.translation: Fortunately, my father has always thought highly of my boyfriend.

sense_b891b7919377924fddadc5348120b1c7.text: Ese champú te deja un brillo increíble en el pelo.
sense_b891b7919377924fddadc5348120b1c7.translation: That shampoo gives your hair an incredible shine.

sense_b891b7919377924fddadc5348120b1c7.text: Para conseguir ese brillo en los zapatos, necesitas un betún especial.
sense_b891b7919377924fddadc5348120b1c7.translation: You need a special shoe polish to get that shine on your shoes.

sense_13c88dd93282dc334e2f09dc675ae460.text: Si me permite, señora, creo que puedo arreglar la puerta.
sense_13c88dd93282dc334e2f09dc675ae460.translation: If I may, ma'am, I think I can fix the door.

sense_d84f440639d368dd979bab1debd3ca1a.text: Aquel coche estacionado allá es mío.
sense_d84f440639d368dd979bab1debd3ca1a.translation: That car parked over there is mine.

sense_d84f440639d368dd979bab1debd3ca1a.text: Me gusta mucho aquella casa que hay en lo alto de la colina.
sense_d84f440639d368dd979bab1debd3ca1a.translation: I really like that house on top of the hill.

sense_86cedf7bd60363e3fabfeb902959f32b.text: No sé tú pero yo prefiero aquel.
sense_86cedf7bd60363e3fabfeb902959f32b.translation: I don't know about you but I prefer that one.

sense_86cedf7bd60363e3fabfeb902959f32b.text: Aquella es más grande que esta.
sense_86cedf7bd60363e3fabfeb902959f32b.translation: That one is bigger than this one.

sense_37c476dd49179d3ee9e5a1c6f50121d8.text: Nací en 1920 y, en aquellos días, no teníamos televisión.
sense_37c476dd49179d3ee9e5a1c6f50121d8.translation: I was born in 1920, and in those days, we didn't have television.

sense_37c476dd49179d3ee9e5a1c6f50121d8.text: Aquellas montañas a lo lejos son las más altas del país.
sense_37c476dd49179d3ee9e5a1c6f50121d8.translation: Those mountains in the distance are the tallest in the country.

sense_2003735bf1186c1a97751d835ed2e501.text: Vi unas camisas parecidas a estas hace un tiempo, pero me gustaron más aquellas.
sense_2003735bf1186c1a97751d835ed2e501.translation: I saw some shirts like these ones a while ago, but I liked those more.

sense_2003735bf1186c1a97751d835ed2e501.text: ¿Te acuerdas de los sánduches que hacían aquí antes? - Sí, aquellos eran muy buenos.
sense_2003735bf1186c1a97751d835ed2e501.translation: Do you remember the sandwiches they used to make here? - Yeah, those were really good.

sense_1ab5fc2264d470e095533ce2beab61d5.text: Estas sillas son baratas, pero aquellas son más bonitas.
sense_1ab5fc2264d470e095533ce2beab61d5.translation: These chairs are cheap, but those ones are nicer.

sense_1ab5fc2264d470e095533ce2beab61d5.text: No quiero estos melocotones. Quiero aquellos.
sense_1ab5fc2264d470e095533ce2beab61d5.translation: I don't want these peaches. I want those ones.

sense_d0e9c5287f13d548fd1a7a4689eccd55.text: Nuestro país registra una disminución histórica en deforestación.
sense_d0e9c5287f13d548fd1a7a4689eccd55.translation: There has been a dramatic reduction in deforestation in our country.

sense_d0e9c5287f13d548fd1a7a4689eccd55.text: El año pasado, el país registró un fuerte aumento de homicidios.
sense_d0e9c5287f13d548fd1a7a4689eccd55.translation: There was a significant increase in the number of homicides last year.

sense_61a487dbebb11287588d7ae7279285df.text: Afortunadamente no se registraron heridos en el choque.
sense_61a487dbebb11287588d7ae7279285df.translation: Fortunately, no one was hurt in the accident.

sense_61a487dbebb11287588d7ae7279285df.text: Debido a la fuerte lluvia de hoy, se registraron inundaciones por toda la región.
sense_61a487dbebb11287588d7ae7279285df.translation: There was flooding throughout the region due to today's heavy rain.

sense_36d6f2ea912c74b9de5405149e59d7ad.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_36d6f2ea912c74b9de5405149e59d7ad.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_36d6f2ea912c74b9de5405149e59d7ad.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_36d6f2ea912c74b9de5405149e59d7ad.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_083e8b9f3b24a5a50fd43ae16cf6bec5.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_083e8b9f3b24a5a50fd43ae16cf6bec5.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_083e8b9f3b24a5a50fd43ae16cf6bec5.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_083e8b9f3b24a5a50fd43ae16cf6bec5.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_c5234088bd30ce967785e83d02669d4e.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_c5234088bd30ce967785e83d02669d4e.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_c5234088bd30ce967785e83d02669d4e.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_c5234088bd30ce967785e83d02669d4e.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_2466c915d263091a9eef4f03b8914f48.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_2466c915d263091a9eef4f03b8914f48.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_2466c915d263091a9eef4f03b8914f48.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_2466c915d263091a9eef4f03b8914f48.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_d16e2855a1a398f62a290c10d3ec3ae1.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_d16e2855a1a398f62a290c10d3ec3ae1.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_d16e2855a1a398f62a290c10d3ec3ae1.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_d16e2855a1a398f62a290c10d3ec3ae1.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_369e0d902fc4798a1469cf741f894245.text: Hicimos un recorrido por los Cayos de Florida el año pasado.
sense_369e0d902fc4798a1469cf741f894245.translation: We took a trip through the Florida Keys last year.

sense_369e0d902fc4798a1469cf741f894245.text: Vamos a hacer un recorrido por el sur de Italia esta primavera.
sense_369e0d902fc4798a1469cf741f894245.translation: We are going to take a trip through southern Italy this spring.

sense_af1647e838a0818fd89f0b89b358e3bc.text: Las enfermeras ayudaron a los enfermos y a los heridos.
sense_af1647e838a0818fd89f0b89b358e3bc.translation: The nurses helped the sick and wounded.

sense_af1647e838a0818fd89f0b89b358e3bc.text: El enfermero me tomó la presión mientras el doctor leía algo en mi expediente.
sense_af1647e838a0818fd89f0b89b358e3bc.translation: The nurse took my blood pressure while the doctor read something off my chart.

sense_a4e6b0d94fdab33c0447c8d0da5153c3.text: Los líderes del ejército derrotado le pidieron a nuestro general que tuviera misericordia de ellos.
sense_a4e6b0d94fdab33c0447c8d0da5153c3.translation: The leaders of the defeated army asked our general to have mercy on them.

sense_a4e6b0d94fdab33c0447c8d0da5153c3.text: El rey quería mostrar misericordia frente a su pueblo, así que perdonó a los tres prisioneros.
sense_a4e6b0d94fdab33c0447c8d0da5153c3.translation: The king wanted to show mercy in front of his people, so he pardoned the three prisoners.

sense_5bf042252ed1ed87c6e8621287f60d2f.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_5bf042252ed1ed87c6e8621287f60d2f.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_5bf042252ed1ed87c6e8621287f60d2f.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_5bf042252ed1ed87c6e8621287f60d2f.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_a019c392e191aafdb1e3b67048d8bd60.text: Cuatro presos huyeron de la cárcel el domingo por la tarde.
sense_a019c392e191aafdb1e3b67048d8bd60.translation: Four inmates escaped from the prison on Sunday afternoon.

sense_a019c392e191aafdb1e3b67048d8bd60.text: El hada trató de huir, pero el brujo la agarró por las alas.
sense_a019c392e191aafdb1e3b67048d8bd60.translation: The fairy tried to escape, but the wizard grabbed her by the wings.

sense_61d33950b4d64ef14ce0d8b5fd3b5423.text: La primera novela del autor fue originalmente escrita en irlandés.
sense_61d33950b4d64ef14ce0d8b5fd3b5423.translation: The author's first novel was originally written in Irish.

sense_61d33950b4d64ef14ce0d8b5fd3b5423.text: En Dublín, las señales están escritas tanto en irlandés como en inglés.
sense_61d33950b4d64ef14ce0d8b5fd3b5423.translation: In Dublin, the road signs are written in both Irish and English.

sense_baf92d6afdb640b463c5729b47ad12c0.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_baf92d6afdb640b463c5729b47ad12c0.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_be588625c72e8c448d82506bf4b681d5.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_be588625c72e8c448d82506bf4b681d5.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_be588625c72e8c448d82506bf4b681d5.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_be588625c72e8c448d82506bf4b681d5.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_28847aa11dd5ad6b0cab3bb39fdd4879.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_28847aa11dd5ad6b0cab3bb39fdd4879.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_60b82eec8b93bfc2ea939574b99ec97b.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_60b82eec8b93bfc2ea939574b99ec97b.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_60b82eec8b93bfc2ea939574b99ec97b.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_60b82eec8b93bfc2ea939574b99ec97b.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_75148c697ab2bfe6ba07b4afd0903a01.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_75148c697ab2bfe6ba07b4afd0903a01.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_70b32bd9a6fba988013d6d668ca6b53e.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_70b32bd9a6fba988013d6d668ca6b53e.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_70b32bd9a6fba988013d6d668ca6b53e.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_70b32bd9a6fba988013d6d668ca6b53e.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_cd12d805d102652d96b3d17ddf880971.text: Miguel me flechó cuando me dijo que quería casarse conmigo.
sense_cd12d805d102652d96b3d17ddf880971.translation: Miguel swept me off my feet when he told me he wanted to marry me.

sense_cd12d805d102652d96b3d17ddf880971.text: Raúl quedó flechado por Rosita desde que un amigo común los presentó.
sense_cd12d805d102652d96b3d17ddf880971.translation: Raúl fell for Rosita ever since a mutual friend had introduced them to each other.

sense_2a5e053243de5663660156241479844d.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_2a5e053243de5663660156241479844d.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_69103d4816f622a7fab417a90612300a.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_69103d4816f622a7fab417a90612300a.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_d70e20d6b493a51425229fdc57fc7c11.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_d70e20d6b493a51425229fdc57fc7c11.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_d70e20d6b493a51425229fdc57fc7c11.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_d70e20d6b493a51425229fdc57fc7c11.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_a60dfec62d224cbb701157438eb002f2.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_a60dfec62d224cbb701157438eb002f2.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_a60dfec62d224cbb701157438eb002f2.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_a60dfec62d224cbb701157438eb002f2.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_99f4303146ee90a9907e62d887cdb3dd.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_99f4303146ee90a9907e62d887cdb3dd.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_c0b219d5f2192196da4f1aa0fad249e9.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_c0b219d5f2192196da4f1aa0fad249e9.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_c0b219d5f2192196da4f1aa0fad249e9.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_c0b219d5f2192196da4f1aa0fad249e9.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_785fe5c7f952991edb8dcfe418a71790.text: Estamos pensando en tomar un crucero por el mar Báltico el próximo año.
sense_785fe5c7f952991edb8dcfe418a71790.translation: We're thinking of taking a cruise around the Baltic Sea next year.

sense_785fe5c7f952991edb8dcfe418a71790.text: Mi esposo y yo nos fuimos de crucero a las Bahamas para nuestra luna de miel.
sense_785fe5c7f952991edb8dcfe418a71790.translation: My husband and I took a cruise to the Bahamas for our honeymoon.

sense_775114aee9c4806f454a5212f47437d5.text: Tuvimos que quedarnos en casa porque estaba cayendo un chaparrón.
sense_775114aee9c4806f454a5212f47437d5.translation: We had to stay home because it was pouring rain.

sense_775114aee9c4806f454a5212f47437d5.text: Está cayendo una buena nevada. Ponle las cadenas a las ruedas.
sense_775114aee9c4806f454a5212f47437d5.translation: It's snowing hard. Put the chains on the tires.

sense_5414345fbe9ddb6e4cecf5820247ed55.text: No bebo porque el alcohol me cae mal.
sense_5414345fbe9ddb6e4cecf5820247ed55.translation: I don't drink because alcohol disagrees with me.
You look great in that dress!

sense_35f704ee0a9404adab2e7c5b191f1aeb.text: Me cae muy bien tu hermano; siempre me hace sonreír.
sense_35f704ee0a9404adab2e7c5b191f1aeb.translation: I really like your brother; he always makes me smile.

sense_35f704ee0a9404adab2e7c5b191f1aeb.text: Me marché porque me cae mal tu primo con sus bromas ofensivas.
sense_35f704ee0a9404adab2e7c5b191f1aeb.translation: I had to leave because I can't stand your cousin and his offensive jokes.

sense_c8c07c432e3aaaff9465162c95338414.text: Que Harvard la hubiera rechazado, le cayó mal.
sense_c8c07c432e3aaaff9465162c95338414.translation: She wasn't pleased that Harvard rejected her.

sense_c8c07c432e3aaaff9465162c95338414.text: El embarazo de mi hermana pequeña no cayó bien en la familia.
sense_c8c07c432e3aaaff9465162c95338414.translation: My little sister's pregnancy shocked the entire family.

sense_f72cb9e742874d2400eae55a2bf6d4eb.text: Mi bebé está llorando porque se cae de sueño.
sense_f72cb9e742874d2400eae55a2bf6d4eb.translation: My baby is crying because he's very sleepy.

sense_f72cb9e742874d2400eae55a2bf6d4eb.text: Me caigo de cansancio, pero tengo que estudiar para el examen de mañana.
sense_f72cb9e742874d2400eae55a2bf6d4eb.translation: I am really tired, but I have to study for tomorrow's exam.

sense_e1487df778790afed65a98c179a207b6.text: "¡Firmes!", gritó, y los marineros giraron hacia el capitán.
sense_e1487df778790afed65a98c179a207b6.translation: "Attention!", he shouted, and the soldiers turned toward the captain.

sense_e1487df778790afed65a98c179a207b6.text: Los soldados estaban en posición de firmes cuando entró el general.
sense_e1487df778790afed65a98c179a207b6.translation: The soldiers were standing at attention when the general entered.

sense_5cfad061f1d0fae68dac065bc1dbe4a6.text: Come otro burrito si te cabe.
sense_5cfad061f1d0fae68dac065bc1dbe4a6.translation: Have another burrito if you can manage it.

sense_5cfad061f1d0fae68dac065bc1dbe4a6.text: ¿Quieres otro trozo de pastel? - Está delicioso, pero no me cabe nada más.
sense_5cfad061f1d0fae68dac065bc1dbe4a6.translation: Do you want another slice of cake? - It's delicious, but I couldn't eat another thing.

sense_8e6eb53a11f1dbbba7583020e9604516.text: Cabe preguntarse si esto es lo que queremos que recuerden de nosotros.
sense_8e6eb53a11f1dbbba7583020e9604516.translation: It might be worth questioning if this what we'd like to be remembered for.

sense_8e6eb53a11f1dbbba7583020e9604516.text: Cabe la posibilidad de que la banda cancele la presentación si el cantante no se recupera.
sense_8e6eb53a11f1dbbba7583020e9604516.translation: It's possible the band will cancel the show if the singer doesn't recover.

sense_0ddb683ffab9e824b1a998274091030c.text: El padre organizó una fantástica velada para toda la familia.
sense_0ddb683ffab9e824b1a998274091030c.translation: The father organized a wonderful evening for the whole family.

sense_0ddb683ffab9e824b1a998274091030c.text: Pasamos una velada muy agradable en la casa de Olga el domingo pasado.
sense_0ddb683ffab9e824b1a998274091030c.translation: We had a very pleasant evening at Olga's last Sunday.

sense_1f04e82df320ba98cdb010b5daefefd5.text: El alumno escribió su ensayo de 20 páginas en una noche.
sense_1f04e82df320ba98cdb010b5daefefd5.translation: The student wrote his 20-page essay in one night.

sense_56c31346e2fac9e6bd7ed4cd6127a3f0.text: El programa era tan aburrido que me dormí.
sense_56c31346e2fac9e6bd7ed4cd6127a3f0.translation: The program was so boring that I fell asleep.

sense_56c31346e2fac9e6bd7ed4cd6127a3f0.text: Me dormí a las 6 de la mañana.
sense_56c31346e2fac9e6bd7ed4cd6127a3f0.translation: I fell asleep at 6 in the morning.

sense_45f8baa52929ae662e3795de66b1a787.text: No te duermas o no acabarás a tiempo.
sense_45f8baa52929ae662e3795de66b1a787.translation: Don't slack off or you won't finish in time.

sense_45f8baa52929ae662e3795de66b1a787.text: Por dormirse se perdió la clave para ganar el premio.
sense_45f8baa52929ae662e3795de66b1a787.translation: He missed the clue to win the prize because he didn't stay on his toes.

sense_cc0b72d12892f01547199b00923be1a0.text: La peli era malísima; solo se salvaba el actor principal.
sense_cc0b72d12892f01547199b00923be1a0.translation: The film was really bad; the main actor was the only one who was ok.

sense_cc0b72d12892f01547199b00923be1a0.text: Los considero a todos unos vagos; no se salva nadie.
sense_cc0b72d12892f01547199b00923be1a0.translation: I consider them all lazy, without exception.

sense_24e9b7e9c823cffc2f1c33a8b356d9ee.text: ¿Será que te arrestas a lanzarte en paracaídas?
sense_24e9b7e9c823cffc2f1c33a8b356d9ee.translation: Would you dare to go skydiving?

sense_24e9b7e9c823cffc2f1c33a8b356d9ee.text: Luz es una mujer valiente que se arresta a todo.
sense_24e9b7e9c823cffc2f1c33a8b356d9ee.translation: Luz is a brave woman who's afraid of nothing.

sense_a62b7a674c6ee12057e263047f4dd655.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_a62b7a674c6ee12057e263047f4dd655.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_a62b7a674c6ee12057e263047f4dd655.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_a62b7a674c6ee12057e263047f4dd655.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_d4ff2a6bb16f87f928ab37157ff26bd5.text: Quiero reunir a toda la familia para celebrar Navidad juntos.
sense_d4ff2a6bb16f87f928ab37157ff26bd5.translation: I want to gather the whole family to celebrate Christmas together.

sense_d4ff2a6bb16f87f928ab37157ff26bd5.text: Mi papá nos reunió alrededor de la fogata para relatarnos cuentos.
sense_d4ff2a6bb16f87f928ab37157ff26bd5.translation: Dad gathered us around the campfire to tell us stories.

sense_e293d5ba2a841b711aa981bbb856f8f2.text: ¿Quién tiene que pagar la instalación del ascensor?
sense_e293d5ba2a841b711aa981bbb856f8f2.translation: Who's responsible for paying for the lift to be installed?

sense_e293d5ba2a841b711aa981bbb856f8f2.text: Aunque la instalación de paneles solares es costosa, vale la pena hacerlo.
sense_e293d5ba2a841b711aa981bbb856f8f2.translation: Even though putting in solar panels is expensive, it's worth doing.

sense_3546fbe116135f305752a1e01e8291ba.text: En estos momentos la grúa está retirando el vehículo accidentado de la carretera.
sense_3546fbe116135f305752a1e01e8291ba.translation: Right now the tow truck is removing the damaged vehicle from the roadway.

sense_e9167376b7b3daa59360c337ca22e155.text: Mi marido nunca me retiró la confianza.
sense_e9167376b7b3daa59360c337ca22e155.translation: My husband never lost confidence in me.

sense_e9167376b7b3daa59360c337ca22e155.text: El partido le retiró la confianza al presidente cuando malversó fondos.
sense_e9167376b7b3daa59360c337ca22e155.translation: The president lost the party's confidence when he misappropriated funds.

sense_559459c3f66717438875754b9d6b9bab.text: La empresa retiró los autobuses más antiguos.
sense_559459c3f66717438875754b9d6b9bab.translation: The company withdrew the oldest buses.

sense_559459c3f66717438875754b9d6b9bab.text: Retiraron los billetes falsos de la circulación.
sense_559459c3f66717438875754b9d6b9bab.translation: The counterfeit notes were withdrawn from circulation.

sense_f15a486c4e8e84febf68529094bf6635.text: El recepcionista me pidió que no me retirara.
sense_f15a486c4e8e84febf68529094bf6635.translation: The receptionist asked me to hold the line.

sense_2fae6d9867954e32027a8a8ff719e5d5.text: Los novios son muy entregados uno al otro.
sense_2fae6d9867954e32027a8a8ff719e5d5.translation: The bride and groom are very devoted to one another.

sense_2fae6d9867954e32027a8a8ff719e5d5.text: María fue una monja entregada que ayudaba a los más necesitados.
sense_2fae6d9867954e32027a8a8ff719e5d5.translation: Maria was a devoted nun who helped the less fortunate.

sense_08043624abd000ffb398d04b375d2846.text: ¡Apártate de mí! No quiero verte nunca más.
sense_08043624abd000ffb398d04b375d2846.translation: Get away from me! I don't want to see you again.

sense_08043624abd000ffb398d04b375d2846.text: Apártense de la estufa; está caliente.
sense_08043624abd000ffb398d04b375d2846.translation: Get away from the stove; it's hot.

sense_f341458bc7694a89858ab93e811d5546.text: Hay que comprar una sartén nueva porque esta ya no sirve.
sense_f341458bc7694a89858ab93e811d5546.translation: We need to buy a new frying pan because this one is no good any more.
Is this one any good to you?

sense_b1cb803391a18886c61d52e967a63c80.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_b1cb803391a18886c61d52e967a63c80.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_b1cb803391a18886c61d52e967a63c80.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_b1cb803391a18886c61d52e967a63c80.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_6ae715d87d7a39d2b14e36da734b9fed.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_6ae715d87d7a39d2b14e36da734b9fed.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_6ae715d87d7a39d2b14e36da734b9fed.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_6ae715d87d7a39d2b14e36da734b9fed.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_c90a7434b31502f38b98fb1a65b64e9c.text: En estos momentos la grúa está retirando el vehículo accidentado de la carretera.
sense_c90a7434b31502f38b98fb1a65b64e9c.translation: Right now the tow truck is removing the damaged vehicle from the roadway.

sense_6375738c1d8f39332ba7d9924ea9ce4a.text: La empresa retiró los autobuses más antiguos.
sense_6375738c1d8f39332ba7d9924ea9ce4a.translation: The company withdrew the oldest buses.

sense_6375738c1d8f39332ba7d9924ea9ce4a.text: Retiraron los billetes falsos de la circulación.
sense_6375738c1d8f39332ba7d9924ea9ce4a.translation: The counterfeit notes were withdrawn from circulation.

sense_2a7cc9832f096579e246a9806a5ccb7f.text: Mi marido nunca me retiró la confianza.
sense_2a7cc9832f096579e246a9806a5ccb7f.translation: My husband never lost confidence in me.

sense_2a7cc9832f096579e246a9806a5ccb7f.text: El partido le retiró la confianza al presidente cuando malversó fondos.
sense_2a7cc9832f096579e246a9806a5ccb7f.translation: The president lost the party's confidence when he misappropriated funds.

sense_86b68cae2d8dc28e4461b32804d0ed63.text: El recepcionista me pidió que no me retirara.
sense_86b68cae2d8dc28e4461b32804d0ed63.translation: The receptionist asked me to hold the line.

sense_7a40b99c3fde38105408d4e6946798b0.text: Me carga que siempre la escojan a ella.
sense_7a40b99c3fde38105408d4e6946798b0.translation: It gets on my nerves that they always choose her.

sense_7a40b99c3fde38105408d4e6946798b0.text: Me carga tener que aguantar la novia de mi hermano.
sense_7a40b99c3fde38105408d4e6946798b0.translation: I can't stand having to put up with my brother's girlfriend.

sense_b2811d55ddf3efacc1c3f602dc9f8ec8.text: Ofrecemos un menú simple que le agrada al común de la gente.
sense_b2811d55ddf3efacc1c3f602dc9f8ec8.translation: We offer a simple menu that pleases most people.

sense_b2811d55ddf3efacc1c3f602dc9f8ec8.text: En diez años pasará al olvido, como el común de los actores secundarios.
sense_b2811d55ddf3efacc1c3f602dc9f8ec8.translation: In ten years he will be forgotten, just like any other supporting actor.

sense_90d9879a87cf4139bfa66592bd2046bf.text: ¡Estás desconocida con ese corte de pelo!
sense_90d9879a87cf4139bfa66592bd2046bf.translation: You look very different with that haircut!

sense_90d9879a87cf4139bfa66592bd2046bf.text: Desde que se casó está desconocido.
sense_90d9879a87cf4139bfa66592bd2046bf.translation: He's changed a lot since he got married.

sense_c5a489ead08eb804957dbf7efc51a231.text: No tardará en dejar de ser una desconocida.
sense_c5a489ead08eb804957dbf7efc51a231.translation: It won't take long for her to become famous.

sense_c5a489ead08eb804957dbf7efc51a231.text: Se casó con él cuando era todavía un desconocido.
sense_c5a489ead08eb804957dbf7efc51a231.translation: She married him when he was not yet famous.

sense_f11594b579e25b981bf4b095b2c37ac2.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_f11594b579e25b981bf4b095b2c37ac2.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_7497ac2d4abb9dd95e0e77d7d237ea20.text: No le tire patadas a su hermano.
Su perro me tiró un mordisco.

sense_fabaad68df16335078776da863f0a295.text: Las fiestas ya no me tiran.
sense_fabaad68df16335078776da863f0a295.translation: Parties don't appeal to me anymore.
He is not interested in studying medicine.

sense_18e7278283a180696cf3c2c108fcdc57.text: El plato tiraba a dulce más que nada.
sense_18e7278283a180696cf3c2c108fcdc57.translation: The dish was more sweet than anything else.

sense_18e7278283a180696cf3c2c108fcdc57.text: Tienes que beberte el té cuando esté tirando a frío.
sense_18e7278283a180696cf3c2c108fcdc57.translation: You have to drink the tea when it is cooling down.

sense_b4b9c78e44e557a2bb7c52a1faf4db5c.text: El bebé se tiró un eructo tras tomarse su biberón.
sense_b4b9c78e44e557a2bb7c52a1faf4db5c.translation: The baby burped after having his bottle.

sense_b4b9c78e44e557a2bb7c52a1faf4db5c.text: La primera vez que se tiró un pedo delante de su novio se avergonzó.
sense_b4b9c78e44e557a2bb7c52a1faf4db5c.translation: The first time she farted in front of her boyfriend, she was embarrassed.

sense_e88235692e3fa95b8d3d34e8099b0603.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_e88235692e3fa95b8d3d34e8099b0603.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_ed52b229e90cf8710af9bceb3384bcd6.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_ed52b229e90cf8710af9bceb3384bcd6.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_c996ef4229a73e594848800ed4121db5.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_c996ef4229a73e594848800ed4121db5.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_c996ef4229a73e594848800ed4121db5.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_c996ef4229a73e594848800ed4121db5.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_6500b02218b8c8bec97455571777b52b.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_6500b02218b8c8bec97455571777b52b.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_6500b02218b8c8bec97455571777b52b.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_6500b02218b8c8bec97455571777b52b.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_079c78346a40acdea7db31916b20c276.text: El gobierno se equivocó con esta medida.
sense_079c78346a40acdea7db31916b20c276.translation: The government got it wrong with this policy.

sense_079c78346a40acdea7db31916b20c276.text: La empresa reconoce que se equivocó con su respuesta.
sense_079c78346a40acdea7db31916b20c276.translation: The company recognizes that it got its response wrong.

sense_cb5651cff970bee3e4bb7d2a060011f4.text: Mi madre se equivocó de tren y, por consiguiente, no llegó aquí hasta la una de la madrugada.
sense_cb5651cff970bee3e4bb7d2a060011f4.translation: My mother got on the wrong train and, as a result, she didn't get here till one in the morning.

sense_cb5651cff970bee3e4bb7d2a060011f4.text: Te equivocaste de mes. El cumpleaños de Fernando es el dos de julio y no el dos de junio.
sense_cb5651cff970bee3e4bb7d2a060011f4.translation: You got the month wrong. Fernando's birthday is the second of July not the second of June.

sense_6e568f85b6f6f5ee55a22a08ad27553b.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_6e568f85b6f6f5ee55a22a08ad27553b.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_642a03c3dd742f613ed7a442715318ac.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_642a03c3dd742f613ed7a442715318ac.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_a0952f3f17d7e7bd952ff350353bb1ef.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_a0952f3f17d7e7bd952ff350353bb1ef.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_a0952f3f17d7e7bd952ff350353bb1ef.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_a0952f3f17d7e7bd952ff350353bb1ef.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_3ee282d40ef899b49e32a401f751264f.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_3ee282d40ef899b49e32a401f751264f.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_3ee282d40ef899b49e32a401f751264f.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_3ee282d40ef899b49e32a401f751264f.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_d609e848014252eed8e26e3aba2ae932.text: Te agarras a tu herida para evitar las tareas en casa.
sense_d609e848014252eed8e26e3aba2ae932.translation: You use your injury to get out of chores around the house.

sense_d609e848014252eed8e26e3aba2ae932.text: Se agarró a los deberes para no tener que lavar los platos.
sense_d609e848014252eed8e26e3aba2ae932.translation: She used her homework as an excuse to not wash the dishes.

sense_21713f14f27a5a0b799bd30cead17f04.text: Abrir una cuenta de banco requiere demasiado papeleo.
sense_21713f14f27a5a0b799bd30cead17f04.translation: Opening a bank account requires too much paperwork.

sense_21713f14f27a5a0b799bd30cead17f04.text: Para empezar a trabajar en Estados Unidos, necesito hacer mucho papeleo.
sense_21713f14f27a5a0b799bd30cead17f04.translation: To start working in the United States, I need to do a lot of paperwork.

sense_405934b6ccf3ceffbfeaeab21510cf50.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_405934b6ccf3ceffbfeaeab21510cf50.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_405934b6ccf3ceffbfeaeab21510cf50.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_405934b6ccf3ceffbfeaeab21510cf50.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_94429bc82bd17f189013ff70602f2b38.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
