sense_94429bc82bd17f189013ff70602f2b38.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_94429bc82bd17f189013ff70602f2b38.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_94429bc82bd17f189013ff70602f2b38.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_51026d83526705f6f76dcbfa608d1bfc.text: Estoy obsesionado con tu perro. ¡Es tan lindo!
sense_51026d83526705f6f76dcbfa608d1bfc.translation: I'm obsessed with your dog. He's so cute!

sense_51026d83526705f6f76dcbfa608d1bfc.text: ¿Por qué estás tan obsesionada con La guerra de las galaxias?
sense_51026d83526705f6f76dcbfa608d1bfc.translation: Why are you so obsessed with Star Wars?

sense_49b9e6e9b52aed88e682f9f8f195624e.text: El tema de qué hará con su vida obsesiona a Ana.
sense_49b9e6e9b52aed88e682f9f8f195624e.translation: Ana obsesses over the question of what will she do with her life.

sense_49b9e6e9b52aed88e682f9f8f195624e.text: Al autor le obsesiona el tema de viajar a través del tiempo.
sense_49b9e6e9b52aed88e682f9f8f195624e.translation: The author is obsessed with the theme of time travel.

sense_38a169dab248d21f4508f3d6c310df0e.text: No le tire patadas a su hermano.
Su perro me tiró un mordisco.

sense_0463424e938cccd742e5f5fcb2f70c9c.text: Las fiestas ya no me tiran.
sense_0463424e938cccd742e5f5fcb2f70c9c.translation: Parties don't appeal to me anymore.
He is not interested in studying medicine.

sense_58cc027997b06e30a2ffb6576a6fba1f.text: El plato tiraba a dulce más que nada.
sense_58cc027997b06e30a2ffb6576a6fba1f.translation: The dish was more sweet than anything else.

sense_58cc027997b06e30a2ffb6576a6fba1f.text: Tienes que beberte el té cuando esté tirando a frío.
sense_58cc027997b06e30a2ffb6576a6fba1f.translation: You have to drink the tea when it is cooling down.

sense_b65b22591dfca655605b28370b883a4e.text: El bebé se tiró un eructo tras tomarse su biberón.
sense_b65b22591dfca655605b28370b883a4e.translation: The baby burped after having his bottle.

sense_b65b22591dfca655605b28370b883a4e.text: La primera vez que se tiró un pedo delante de su novio se avergonzó.
sense_b65b22591dfca655605b28370b883a4e.translation: The first time she farted in front of her boyfriend, she was embarrassed.

sense_4474a6f8a870ea36a4d2a64054beddb7.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_4474a6f8a870ea36a4d2a64054beddb7.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_4f893f0c5cae710c8bff38e7af92ee39.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_4f893f0c5cae710c8bff38e7af92ee39.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_4f893f0c5cae710c8bff38e7af92ee39.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_4f893f0c5cae710c8bff38e7af92ee39.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_a6dc5bc26b108c0be0499691ba4bbabf.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_a6dc5bc26b108c0be0499691ba4bbabf.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_c92893ddd01d055635152fc50abfb50e.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_c92893ddd01d055635152fc50abfb50e.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_8903f7f2ba2cda0e35577850624a6676.text: El delincuente fue castigado con cuatro años de cárcel.
sense_8903f7f2ba2cda0e35577850624a6676.translation: The criminal was given a four-year prison sentence.

sense_8903f7f2ba2cda0e35577850624a6676.text: La violación será castigada con una pena de varios años de reclusión.
sense_8903f7f2ba2cda0e35577850624a6676.translation: Rape will be punishable by a prison sentence of several years.

sense_b24a6e9f443f9ba18a442cdffb101be4.text: Me castigaron a repetir el ejercicio varias veces.
sense_b24a6e9f443f9ba18a442cdffb101be4.translation: I was made to repeat the exercise several times as a punishment.

sense_b24a6e9f443f9ba18a442cdffb101be4.text: La castigan con dos semanas sin ver la televisión.
sense_b24a6e9f443f9ba18a442cdffb101be4.translation: As a punishment, she isn't allowed to watch television for two weeks.

sense_fd80a604262b059576da5ccb0eddf92e.text: El árbitro nos castigó con dos penaltis injustos.
sense_fd80a604262b059576da5ccb0eddf92e.translation: The referee called two unfair penalties on us.

sense_fd80a604262b059576da5ccb0eddf92e.text: El árbitro lo castigó con tarjeta roja.
sense_fd80a604262b059576da5ccb0eddf92e.translation: The referee gave him a red card.

sense_9ce9c7ddc0fa2129ccf8796ed5dc7b67.text: Le dejé una propina de $15 al mesero.
sense_9ce9c7ddc0fa2129ccf8796ed5dc7b67.translation: I left a $15 tip for the waiter.

sense_9ce9c7ddc0fa2129ccf8796ed5dc7b67.text: Yo pago la comida. - Está bien. Yo me encargo de la propina, entonces.
sense_9ce9c7ddc0fa2129ccf8796ed5dc7b67.translation: The food is on me. - OK, I'll take care of the tip, then.

sense_3b9f45e11eeac1c47e01011c8736a5e5.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_3b9f45e11eeac1c47e01011c8736a5e5.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_3b9f45e11eeac1c47e01011c8736a5e5.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_3b9f45e11eeac1c47e01011c8736a5e5.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_b6473e1161626d7f8e3382ba2dfa2179.text: ¡Me encanta tu casa! ¿Tú misma la decoraste?
sense_b6473e1161626d7f8e3382ba2dfa2179.translation: I love your house! Did you decorate it yourself?

sense_b6473e1161626d7f8e3382ba2dfa2179.text: Me encanta tomarme un chocolate caliente cuando hace frío afuera.
sense_b6473e1161626d7f8e3382ba2dfa2179.translation: I love drinking hot chocolate when it's cold out.

sense_190534d2b340da28e171b176da8aae61.text: ¡Las entradas al cine son un robo, che!
sense_190534d2b340da28e171b176da8aae61.translation: Wow, these movie tickets are a total rip-off!

sense_190534d2b340da28e171b176da8aae61.text: Que frío que hace acá, che. ¿Se puede prender la calefacción?
sense_190534d2b340da28e171b176da8aae61.translation: Phew, it's so cold in here. Can you turn on the heating?

sense_a3f24a90d7c2e800b7202c54fbc72d8a.text: El alumno escribió su ensayo de 20 páginas en una noche.
sense_a3f24a90d7c2e800b7202c54fbc72d8a.translation: The student wrote his 20-page essay in one night.

sense_0505bdb19d7445fbe016c6f3a5e4682e.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_0505bdb19d7445fbe016c6f3a5e4682e.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_0505bdb19d7445fbe016c6f3a5e4682e.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_0505bdb19d7445fbe016c6f3a5e4682e.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_d7ad23b5013df465c2f8483ed3e979e1.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_d7ad23b5013df465c2f8483ed3e979e1.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_d7ad23b5013df465c2f8483ed3e979e1.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_d7ad23b5013df465c2f8483ed3e979e1.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_a73dff627f14a39720111ff878c9f1a9.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_a73dff627f14a39720111ff878c9f1a9.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_a73dff627f14a39720111ff878c9f1a9.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_a73dff627f14a39720111ff878c9f1a9.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_35fcc1aed021b7afbd3bfc1767c5406b.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_35fcc1aed021b7afbd3bfc1767c5406b.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_35fcc1aed021b7afbd3bfc1767c5406b.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_35fcc1aed021b7afbd3bfc1767c5406b.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_b57be7a279ed97f93af2cfc26e2b4751.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_b57be7a279ed97f93af2cfc26e2b4751.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_b57be7a279ed97f93af2cfc26e2b4751.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_b57be7a279ed97f93af2cfc26e2b4751.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_0c2684692cd10ad7d1e5959551fdfd19.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_0c2684692cd10ad7d1e5959551fdfd19.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_0c2684692cd10ad7d1e5959551fdfd19.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_0c2684692cd10ad7d1e5959551fdfd19.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_54339e81f3ced79635db7c70eabc594a.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_54339e81f3ced79635db7c70eabc594a.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_ee312037cf6a2d294e33359eebbbe7ba.text: Antonio dice que no se acuerda de ella.
sense_ee312037cf6a2d294e33359eebbbe7ba.translation: Antonio says he doesn't remember her.

sense_ee312037cf6a2d294e33359eebbbe7ba.text: Me acuerdo que la primera vez que vi "El imperio contraataca", lloré al final.
sense_ee312037cf6a2d294e33359eebbbe7ba.translation: I remember that the first time I saw "The Empire Strikes Back", I cried at the end.

sense_6816512c402a1cf5084b274bdda257de.text: ¡Me encanta tu casa! ¿Tú misma la decoraste?
sense_6816512c402a1cf5084b274bdda257de.translation: I love your house! Did you decorate it yourself?

sense_6816512c402a1cf5084b274bdda257de.text: Me encanta tomarme un chocolate caliente cuando hace frío afuera.
sense_6816512c402a1cf5084b274bdda257de.translation: I love drinking hot chocolate when it's cold out.

sense_243a206b2d80b93d52fe8eecd62d85c6.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_243a206b2d80b93d52fe8eecd62d85c6.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_b9e180d4c0c8f8434723c03c4d1efed6.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_b9e180d4c0c8f8434723c03c4d1efed6.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_b9e180d4c0c8f8434723c03c4d1efed6.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_b9e180d4c0c8f8434723c03c4d1efed6.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_8193b0c8e7c914a3003e96c205d6a360.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_8193b0c8e7c914a3003e96c205d6a360.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_b55d1f99315d8a9fbab9ffb9d28fa074.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_b55d1f99315d8a9fbab9ffb9d28fa074.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_97c279eda98b788a86584985465ca88a.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_97c279eda98b788a86584985465ca88a.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_97c279eda98b788a86584985465ca88a.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_97c279eda98b788a86584985465ca88a.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_08000d9b4d4b3a3e685c0471f901b362.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_08000d9b4d4b3a3e685c0471f901b362.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_08000d9b4d4b3a3e685c0471f901b362.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_08000d9b4d4b3a3e685c0471f901b362.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_31a7446398a3ed3c4e3b6e802b85c26c.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_31a7446398a3ed3c4e3b6e802b85c26c.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_67ae606395a101740ea3e2b9df49ecba.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_67ae606395a101740ea3e2b9df49ecba.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_67ae606395a101740ea3e2b9df49ecba.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_67ae606395a101740ea3e2b9df49ecba.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_59bf41c7df9adcda6813dc4d54bf9516.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_59bf41c7df9adcda6813dc4d54bf9516.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_59bf41c7df9adcda6813dc4d54bf9516.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_59bf41c7df9adcda6813dc4d54bf9516.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_08f433ba78028c8b81cb26f4cefd7c89.text: Si los alimentos crían moho, deshágase de ellos inmediatamente.
sense_08f433ba78028c8b81cb26f4cefd7c89.translation: If food goes moldy, get rid of it straight away.

sense_08f433ba78028c8b81cb26f4cefd7c89.text: El hombre aullaba mientras sus manos y sus brazos empezaban a criar vello.
sense_08f433ba78028c8b81cb26f4cefd7c89.translation: The man howled as his hands and arms started to become hairy.

sense_17997acc7ae02b44e0a37911b491b6a6.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_17997acc7ae02b44e0a37911b491b6a6.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_17997acc7ae02b44e0a37911b491b6a6.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_17997acc7ae02b44e0a37911b491b6a6.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_67cac5ec2bbbcd1f25b5be7a53f1057a.text: Me parece que el ministro debería dimitir.
sense_67cac5ec2bbbcd1f25b5be7a53f1057a.translation: I think the minister should resign.

sense_67cac5ec2bbbcd1f25b5be7a53f1057a.text: ¿Qué te pareció la serie sobre la familia real? - Me pareció una tontería.
sense_67cac5ec2bbbcd1f25b5be7a53f1057a.translation: What did you think of the series about the royal family? - I thought it was nonsense.

sense_25ab79a89d1229be1284b2afa43ee899.text: Ya es hora de rendirte a la evidencia y admitir que te equivocaste.
sense_25ab79a89d1229be1284b2afa43ee899.translation: It's time to bow to the evidence and admit that you are wrong.

sense_25ab79a89d1229be1284b2afa43ee899.text: Ramírez se rindió ante la evidencia, se dio cuenta de que lo habían atrapado y confesó que era culpable.
sense_25ab79a89d1229be1284b2afa43ee899.translation: Ramirez faced the facts, realized that he'd been caught, and confessed he was guilty.

sense_d87fae0c079d6815d669cc07eaa611b5.text: El entrevistador dejó al político en evidencia con preguntas incisivas.
sense_d87fae0c079d6815d669cc07eaa611b5.translation: The interviewer showed the politician up with incisive questions.

sense_d87fae0c079d6815d669cc07eaa611b5.text: Una investigación científica puso en evidencia la falsedad de la supuesta cura.
sense_d87fae0c079d6815d669cc07eaa611b5.translation: A scientific investigation demonstrated the falsity of the alleged cure.

sense_25ad026e40153034d7224d448ad32d7e.text: Si quieres aprovechar el día, levántate más temprano.
sense_25ad026e40153034d7224d448ad32d7e.translation: If you want to take advantage of the day, get up earlier.

sense_25ad026e40153034d7224d448ad32d7e.text: Aprovecharon el descuento para comprar los regalos de Navidad.
sense_25ad026e40153034d7224d448ad32d7e.translation: They took advantage of the discount to buy Christmas presents.

sense_528bc75426cbe01a135c3a55cffc2334.text: El arreglo de la transmisión sale caro.
sense_528bc75426cbe01a135c3a55cffc2334.translation: Getting the transmission fixed is expensive.

sense_528bc75426cbe01a135c3a55cffc2334.text: Llevé el pantalón al sastre para que le haga un arreglo.
sense_528bc75426cbe01a135c3a55cffc2334.translation: I took my pants to the tailor to be mended.

sense_b1245d4defce1aabd3f91b50863c4eec.text: Explícame sin reservas qué fue lo que pasó.
sense_b1245d4defce1aabd3f91b50863c4eec.translation: Explain to me what happened, without keeping anything back.

sense_b1245d4defce1aabd3f91b50863c4eec.text: Ya sabes que conmigo puedes hablar sin reservas.
sense_b1245d4defce1aabd3f91b50863c4eec.translation: You know you can speak freely with me.

sense_fce2b1caf30e972be0f3329280498f50.text: La caballería atacó a la infantería enemiga por el flanco izquierdo.
sense_fce2b1caf30e972be0f3329280498f50.translation: The cavalry charged the enemy infantry from the left flank.

sense_fce2b1caf30e972be0f3329280498f50.text: La caballería británica sufrió una famosa derrota durante la batalla de Balaclava.
sense_fce2b1caf30e972be0f3329280498f50.translation: The British cavalry suffered a famous defeat during the Battle of Balaclava.

sense_90bb13685484cf8c1923845995e05e28.text: You have to learn how to bate your temper.
sense_90bb13685484cf8c1923845995e05e28.translation: Tiene que aprender a controlar tu mal genio.

sense_90bb13685484cf8c1923845995e05e28.text: An injury to its best player has bated the team's hopes of winning the game.
sense_90bb13685484cf8c1923845995e05e28.translation: La lesión de su mejor jugador ha dificultado las posibilidades del equipo de ganar el partido.

sense_c2194b1d4c392ad979e13405328b1555.text: Voy andando al colegio todos los días.
sense_c2194b1d4c392ad979e13405328b1555.translation: I walk to school every day.

sense_c2194b1d4c392ad979e13405328b1555.text: "Cuando ando, me canso mucho", le dijo la anciana a su médico.
sense_c2194b1d4c392ad979e13405328b1555.translation: "When I walk, I get very tired," the old woman told her doctor.

sense_f57f7cd4dc335ebf1cf4f3fdd830537a.text: En el verano ella anda en bicicleta al trabajo.
sense_f57f7cd4dc335ebf1cf4f3fdd830537a.translation: In the summer she takes her bike to work.

sense_f57f7cd4dc335ebf1cf4f3fdd830537a.text: Yo siempre ando en tren cuando regreso al hogar.
sense_f57f7cd4dc335ebf1cf4f3fdd830537a.translation: I always take the train when returning home.

sense_a42da2842ac1f1dbecf44172e3c0995b.text: ¡Qué andar tan raro tienen esos jóvenes!
sense_a42da2842ac1f1dbecf44172e3c0995b.translation: The way those youths walk is really strange!

sense_a42da2842ac1f1dbecf44172e3c0995b.text: Se le nota en el andar que tiene mucho dolor.
sense_a42da2842ac1f1dbecf44172e3c0995b.translation: You can tell by the way she walks that she's in a lot of pain.

sense_e227da5da311e1b7d6e68f61322768e1.text: Me gusta todo de ti, hasta los andares.
sense_e227da5da311e1b7d6e68f61322768e1.translation: I like everything about you, even the way you walk.

sense_e227da5da311e1b7d6e68f61322768e1.text: El Charlot de Charlie Chaplin tiene unos andares totalmente inconfundibles.
sense_e227da5da311e1b7d6e68f61322768e1.translation: The way Charlie Chaplin's tramp walks is completely unmistakeable.

sense_e47dd283fdd334487c993ebe7ae85e7d.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_e47dd283fdd334487c993ebe7ae85e7d.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_23e480b806910ceade2b19bfab8a1870.text: Their assumptions about this matter have no basis in science.
sense_23e480b806910ceade2b19bfab8a1870.translation: Sus presupuestos sobre el tema no se fundamentan en la ciencia.

sense_23e480b806910ceade2b19bfab8a1870.text: On the basis of your credentials, we've decided to offer you the job.
sense_23e480b806910ceade2b19bfab8a1870.translation: Basándonos en sus referencias, hemos decidido ofrecerle el trabajo.

sense_085e56da713c78ef6cee9be35a6b1815.text: Hannah has started meditating on a daily basis.
sense_085e56da713c78ef6cee9be35a6b1815.translation: Hannah ha empezado a meditar diariamente.

sense_085e56da713c78ef6cee9be35a6b1815.text: We cooperate with other groups on an informal basis.
sense_085e56da713c78ef6cee9be35a6b1815.translation: Cooperamos con otros grupos de manera informal.

sense_26905a3dd4b2d8cf7839025bf4a6898b.text: Disculpa, no te he visto trabajando allí. Me pondré los cascos.
sense_26905a3dd4b2d8cf7839025bf4a6898b.translation: I'm sorry, I didn't see you there working. I'll put headphones in.

sense_26905a3dd4b2d8cf7839025bf4a6898b.text: Disculpe, por favor. ¿Me dice dónde está la parada del metro?
sense_26905a3dd4b2d8cf7839025bf4a6898b.translation: Excuse me, please. Can you tell me where the subway station is?

sense_07c5e40e6e171686edd266682e1fdff9.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_07c5e40e6e171686edd266682e1fdff9.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_07c5e40e6e171686edd266682e1fdff9.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_07c5e40e6e171686edd266682e1fdff9.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_fc0910081f68cd1587ac8c1a3ac59cc4.text: Lo metieron preso por manejar en estado de embriaguez.
sense_fc0910081f68cd1587ac8c1a3ac59cc4.translation: He was jailed for drunk driving.

sense_fc0910081f68cd1587ac8c1a3ac59cc4.text: Creo que el marido de Maite estuvo preso por unos cinco años.
sense_fc0910081f68cd1587ac8c1a3ac59cc4.translation: I think Maite's husband was in prison for about five years.

sense_28ba0f0f195b15b2b89a806f24f9ae4d.text: Un día en la playa me suena perfecto.
sense_28ba0f0f195b15b2b89a806f24f9ae4d.translation: A day on the beach sounds perfect.

sense_3006cd37217eb31ab68866f89b3ec2e2.text: No le tire patadas a su hermano.
Su perro me tiró un mordisco.

sense_dba41dd8a8f84d6abafe0be1ae4789aa.text: Las fiestas ya no me tiran.
sense_dba41dd8a8f84d6abafe0be1ae4789aa.translation: Parties don't appeal to me anymore.
He is not interested in studying medicine.

sense_62649923721117eedaf012331b421f45.text: El plato tiraba a dulce más que nada.
sense_62649923721117eedaf012331b421f45.translation: The dish was more sweet than anything else.

sense_62649923721117eedaf012331b421f45.text: Tienes que beberte el té cuando esté tirando a frío.
sense_62649923721117eedaf012331b421f45.translation: You have to drink the tea when it is cooling down.

sense_839fd6b4d169d2300790092a531d6012.text: El bebé se tiró un eructo tras tomarse su biberón.
sense_839fd6b4d169d2300790092a531d6012.translation: The baby burped after having his bottle.

sense_839fd6b4d169d2300790092a531d6012.text: La primera vez que se tiró un pedo delante de su novio se avergonzó.
sense_839fd6b4d169d2300790092a531d6012.translation: The first time she farted in front of her boyfriend, she was embarrassed.

sense_a0243b0bde2749aced4e8162d371d206.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_a0243b0bde2749aced4e8162d371d206.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_a0243b0bde2749aced4e8162d371d206.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_a0243b0bde2749aced4e8162d371d206.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_e04d481a9af9106f90b8150f2124c145.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_e04d481a9af9106f90b8150f2124c145.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_29455268bb82b07bacf5a92a7e466417.text: El muro de los Llantos se ubica en Jerusalén.
sense_29455268bb82b07bacf5a92a7e466417.translation: The Wailing Wall is located in Jerusalem.

sense_29455268bb82b07bacf5a92a7e466417.text: Los muros de la casa son gruesos.
sense_29455268bb82b07bacf5a92a7e466417.translation: The walls of the house are thick.

sense_a212e3f0c48cf272372f369113ff3936.text: Me encanta observar la salida de las estrellas en una noche despejada.
sense_a212e3f0c48cf272372f369113ff3936.translation: I love watching the stars come out on a clear night.

sense_a212e3f0c48cf272372f369113ff3936.text: Esa salida del sol que vimos en Grecia fue la más hermosa que he visto en mi vida.
sense_a212e3f0c48cf272372f369113ff3936.translation: That sunrise that we saw in Greece was the most beautiful I have ever seen.

sense_5651966a1ea0b87a964456f8a52d36a8.text: Siempre nos partimos de risa con las salidas de Samu.
sense_5651966a1ea0b87a964456f8a52d36a8.translation: Samu always cracks up with the hilarious things he says.
She comes out with some really funny things.

sense_8aea8a5c92933db2914faa959d58c618.translation: You really could have told him.

sense_8aea8a5c92933db2914faa959d58c618.text: Se hace el tonto pero bien sabía que no nos había pagado.
sense_8aea8a5c92933db2914faa959d58c618.translation: He's pretending he didn't, but he knew full well he hadn't paid us.

sense_bb7dd92729a1c78467a085fdbdc9171f.text: Bien nos vamos, bien no, pero hay que decidirlo ya.
sense_bb7dd92729a1c78467a085fdbdc9171f.translation: We either go or we don't, but we need to decide.

sense_bb7dd92729a1c78467a085fdbdc9171f.text: Tenemos que mudarnos, bien este año, bien el que viene.
sense_bb7dd92729a1c78467a085fdbdc9171f.translation: We have to move, whether it's this year or next.

sense_0d56e283b68b1417fcce0962eca4b710.text: La revolución separó el partido en dos facciones.
sense_0d56e283b68b1417fcce0962eca4b710.translation: The revolution separated the party into two factions.

sense_0d56e283b68b1417fcce0962eca4b710.text: Separé la clase en grupos de cuatro alumnos cada uno.
sense_0d56e283b68b1417fcce0962eca4b710.translation: I divided the class into groups of four students each.

sense_94b133cf1e42b338751eac04c747628f.text: Un ala se separó del transbordador espacial al entrar la atmósfera de la tierra.
sense_94b133cf1e42b338751eac04c747628f.translation: A wing came off the space shuttle upon entering the Earth's atmosphere.

sense_94b133cf1e42b338751eac04c747628f.text: Durante una tormenta, una rama se separó del árbol y cayó encima de mi automóvil.
sense_94b133cf1e42b338751eac04c747628f.translation: A branch of the tree was ripped off during a storm and landed on my car.

sense_a0f6d72ef6046d32923b6bd115d03011.text: ¿Quieres ver una película romántica o una de terror?
sense_a0f6d72ef6046d32923b6bd115d03011.translation: Do you want to watch a romantic movie or a horror flick?

sense_a0f6d72ef6046d32923b6bd115d03011.text: Pedro es muy romántico y organizó una cena a la luz de las velas para mí.
sense_a0f6d72ef6046d32923b6bd115d03011.translation: Pedro is very romantic and he organized a candlelit dinner for me.

sense_7af3e8be09f551596174058ee4ef92b0.text: Vamos a un tianguis donde venden artesanías. ¿Nos acompañas?
sense_7af3e8be09f551596174058ee4ef92b0.translation: We're going to a street market where they sell handicrafts. Do you want to go with us?
Can I go with you to the store?

sense_fde3911bfc29beec4ffe9c4688045ff2.text: Tenemos planeado ir a la playa en agosto.
sense_fde3911bfc29beec4ffe9c4688045ff2.translation: We're planning to go to the beach in August.

sense_fde3911bfc29beec4ffe9c4688045ff2.text: Estamos planeando una fiesta de sorpresa para su cumpleaños.
sense_fde3911bfc29beec4ffe9c4688045ff2.translation: We're planning a surprise party for her birthday.

sense_11b51739ecec6c061f031b2c3695ad52.text: La chica estaba vendiendo naranjas en el mercado.
sense_11b51739ecec6c061f031b2c3695ad52.translation: The girl was selling oranges in the market.

sense_f9710a7bdbcee7b09e47a4cacbadc327.text: Me tomó toda la noche, pero ya terminé de pasar mi tesis a limpio.
sense_f9710a7bdbcee7b09e47a4cacbadc327.translation: It took all night, but I finished writing the final version of my thesis.

sense_f9710a7bdbcee7b09e47a4cacbadc327.text: Cuando me corrijas el borrador, voy a pasarlo a limpio para entregárselo mañana al maestro.
sense_f9710a7bdbcee7b09e47a4cacbadc327.translation: After you correct my rough draft, I am going to print out a clean copy to turn in to my teacher tomorrow.

sense_02c65b6f6073bbe11633ce1e640257ed.text: Me parece que el ministro debería dimitir.
sense_02c65b6f6073bbe11633ce1e640257ed.translation: I think the minister should resign.

sense_02c65b6f6073bbe11633ce1e640257ed.text: ¿Qué te pareció la serie sobre la familia real? - Me pareció una tontería.
sense_02c65b6f6073bbe11633ce1e640257ed.translation: What did you think of the series about the royal family? - I thought it was nonsense.

sense_fb6b3f23daaf90b22e6f32dca91ed87f.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_fb6b3f23daaf90b22e6f32dca91ed87f.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_fb6b3f23daaf90b22e6f32dca91ed87f.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_fb6b3f23daaf90b22e6f32dca91ed87f.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_318f1218e1fd86b57dd5810b86ffeef5.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_318f1218e1fd86b57dd5810b86ffeef5.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_318f1218e1fd86b57dd5810b86ffeef5.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_318f1218e1fd86b57dd5810b86ffeef5.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_132953ee30a67e46994ffb7ba76fc261.text: Me ofrecieron su ayuda para el traslado.
sense_132953ee30a67e46994ffb7ba76fc261.translation: They offered to help me with the move.

sense_132953ee30a67e46994ffb7ba76fc261.text: Tengo confianza que me ofrecerán el trabajo.
sense_132953ee30a67e46994ffb7ba76fc261.translation: I'm confident they'll offer me the job.

sense_87b1074388f109229dde7e7a4f57b447.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_87b1074388f109229dde7e7a4f57b447.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_87b1074388f109229dde7e7a4f57b447.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_87b1074388f109229dde7e7a4f57b447.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_e2fdd024629cf6defdc6518b10ce9d91.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_e2fdd024629cf6defdc6518b10ce9d91.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_d15944b875c3b29540d42b3eeff85520.text: El hada movió su varita y convirtió al príncipe en una rana.
sense_d15944b875c3b29540d42b3eeff85520.translation: The fairy moved her wand and turned the prince into a frog.

sense_d15944b875c3b29540d42b3eeff85520.text: La viejecita le dijo a la niña que en realidad era un hada con poderes mágicos.
sense_d15944b875c3b29540d42b3eeff85520.translation: The little old lady told the girl that she was really a fairy with magical powers.

sense_1c03e60dd4f9fa705a8f81b41090ce2f.text: Las madres siempre se preocupan por el bienestar de sus hijos.
sense_1c03e60dd4f9fa705a8f81b41090ce2f.translation: Mothers always worry about their children's well-being.

sense_1c03e60dd4f9fa705a8f81b41090ce2f.text: La preocupación principal del gobierno debe ser el bienestar de los ciudadanos.
sense_1c03e60dd4f9fa705a8f81b41090ce2f.translation: The main concern of the government should be the well-being of its citizens.

sense_50f64d17d4d167a4d8caaba368828119.text: Mi bisabuelo era un vaquero en el Viejo Oeste.
sense_50f64d17d4d167a4d8caaba368828119.translation: My great-grandfather was a cowboy in the Old West.

sense_50f64d17d4d167a4d8caaba368828119.text: ¿De qué te vas a vestir para Halloween? - De vaquero.
sense_50f64d17d4d167a4d8caaba368828119.translation: What are you dressing up as for Halloween? - A cowboy.

sense_141a85db2970b3bd0f579e9595737f46.text: Mis abuelos son naturales de Italia, pero emigraron a Nueva York en los años 40.
sense_141a85db2970b3bd0f579e9595737f46.translation: My grandparents are natives of Italy, but they emigrated to New York in the 1940s.

sense_141a85db2970b3bd0f579e9595737f46.text: He vivido aquí desde que era un niño, pero, en realidad, soy natural de las Islas Canarias.
sense_141a85db2970b3bd0f579e9595737f46.translation: I've been living here since I was a kid, but I actually come from the Canary Islands.

sense_a2c4c82e5e8e70803f192ab6bd59cf7f.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_a2c4c82e5e8e70803f192ab6bd59cf7f.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_a98fde58fcadc3b10bc360751dfa041d.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_a98fde58fcadc3b10bc360751dfa041d.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_a98fde58fcadc3b10bc360751dfa041d.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_a98fde58fcadc3b10bc360751dfa041d.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_693c883e94fae095e0cda533f1fd7747.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_693c883e94fae095e0cda533f1fd7747.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_d83f3fec2c8e91dc1c47f0fc1a875289.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_d83f3fec2c8e91dc1c47f0fc1a875289.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_bc4934679d883a774b826910ce3610a3.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_bc4934679d883a774b826910ce3610a3.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_bc4934679d883a774b826910ce3610a3.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_bc4934679d883a774b826910ce3610a3.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_2ba87f012372681221879398aed1e0d1.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_2ba87f012372681221879398aed1e0d1.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_d3992d41aa7e42747d31c235b32e1342.translation: I just want to make you happy.
What do you want for Christmas?

sense_7b92cfd41adf15adc40d2272bd5069d2.translation: "How can I help you?," asked the butler.
Would you like something to drink?

sense_d11af776c63e8d15c0c18c9d40e8f212.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_d11af776c63e8d15c0c18c9d40e8f212.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_ac31993d78220b45c78807d2dae886c8.text: Se lo he insinuado varias veces, pero no capta la onda.
sense_ac31993d78220b45c78807d2dae886c8.translation: I've hinted at it several times, but he's not getting the message.

sense_ac31993d78220b45c78807d2dae886c8.text: ¿Me explicas otra vez este teorema, por favor? - No consigo agarrarle la onda.
sense_ac31993d78220b45c78807d2dae886c8.translation: Can you explain this theorem again, please? - I can't get the hang of it.

sense_781e3d1ed2bce4d29dcbc2061c364f55.text: El capitán dirigió el buque hacia el faro.
sense_781e3d1ed2bce4d29dcbc2061c364f55.translation: The captain steered the ship toward the lighthouse.

sense_781e3d1ed2bce4d29dcbc2061c364f55.text: Dirigió el coche con cuidado por el borde del acantilado.
sense_781e3d1ed2bce4d29dcbc2061c364f55.translation: He steered the car carefully along the edge of the cliff.

sense_4445d9d57336e1ed8540f1fbad78aba1.text: Las legumbres son un ingrediente básico de la cocina tradicional española.
sense_4445d9d57336e1ed8540f1fbad78aba1.translation: Legumes are a basic ingredient in traditional Spanish cooking.

sense_4445d9d57336e1ed8540f1fbad78aba1.text: Es tradicional tener representaciones de los cuatro elementos en un altar de muerto.
sense_4445d9d57336e1ed8540f1fbad78aba1.translation: It's traditional to have representations of the four elements in a Day of the Dead altar.

sense_efa7d6425d8ab70cd0f764f67a7d1f0f.text: Me carga que siempre la escojan a ella.
sense_efa7d6425d8ab70cd0f764f67a7d1f0f.translation: It gets on my nerves that they always choose her.

sense_efa7d6425d8ab70cd0f764f67a7d1f0f.text: Me carga tener que aguantar la novia de mi hermano.
sense_efa7d6425d8ab70cd0f764f67a7d1f0f.translation: I can't stand having to put up with my brother's girlfriend.

sense_ab7fa23c99318b46036bdd627c17b041.text: Me viene la desesperación al ver lo tranquila que es.
sense_ab7fa23c99318b46036bdd627c17b041.translation: It drives me mad to see how calm she is.

sense_ab7fa23c99318b46036bdd627c17b041.text: A Marta le entra la desesperación cuando camina por calles donde la gente anda despacio.
sense_ab7fa23c99318b46036bdd627c17b041.translation: It drives Marta mad when she goes along streets where people are walking slowly.

sense_683ba81e88ac1d8f5a5a9e222b19fe58.text: Estas cosas llevan su tiempo. ¡Y es una desesperación esperar!
sense_683ba81e88ac1d8f5a5a9e222b19fe58.translation: These things take time - and it is maddening to wait!

sense_683ba81e88ac1d8f5a5a9e222b19fe58.text: ¡Qué desesperación ver que nadie entendía el peligro que corríamos!
sense_683ba81e88ac1d8f5a5a9e222b19fe58.translation: It was infuriating to see that nobody understood the danger we were in.

sense_af67f3f34fac66e4cb448305023dcbd0.text: El castillo parece vulnerable a ataques enemigos.
sense_af67f3f34fac66e4cb448305023dcbd0.translation: The castle seems vulnerable to enemy attacks.

sense_af67f3f34fac66e4cb448305023dcbd0.text: La organización busca ayudar a los más vulnerables en la sociedad.
sense_af67f3f34fac66e4cb448305023dcbd0.translation: The organization seeks to help the most vulnerable in society.

sense_5c2d5c4ac13b14f22753961d7697e5a0.text: Cayó un palo de agua que inundó las calles.
sense_5c2d5c4ac13b14f22753961d7697e5a0.translation: The pouring rain flooded the streets.

sense_5c2d5c4ac13b14f22753961d7697e5a0.text: Se compró un palo de carro con el dinero que ganó en la lotería.
sense_5c2d5c4ac13b14f22753961d7697e5a0.translation: He bought the car of cars with the money he won from the lottery.

sense_913246a99b1d7192b3e0eaf66c91f30a.text: A diferencia del funeral, el sepelio tuvo lugar en la intimidad, sin participación de los medios.
sense_913246a99b1d7192b3e0eaf66c91f30a.translation: Unlike the funeral, the burial was a private affair with the media excluded.

sense_913246a99b1d7192b3e0eaf66c91f30a.text: Lo que el actor es en la intimidad, lo es en gran medida en el escenario.
sense_913246a99b1d7192b3e0eaf66c91f30a.translation: What the actor is in private life, he is to a large extent on the stage.

sense_e5a9465acf6d4f913c6cef928fb0542d.text: La tormenta se está acercando; mejor apretemos.
sense_e5a9465acf6d4f913c6cef928fb0542d.translation: The storm is coming; we'd better run.

sense_e5a9465acf6d4f913c6cef928fb0542d.text: Cuando la alarma de incendios empezó a sonar, todos apretaron hacia la salida.
sense_e5a9465acf6d4f913c6cef928fb0542d.translation: When the fire alarm began to sound, everybody made a dash for the exit.

sense_db27004dd6f6d8714dbae4a267f2b088.text: Hay un nido en una de las ramas de ese árbol.
sense_db27004dd6f6d8714dbae4a267f2b088.translation: There is a nest in one of the branches of that tree.

sense_db27004dd6f6d8714dbae4a267f2b088.text: Un pájaro se posó sobre una rama del olivar y empezó a cantar.
sense_db27004dd6f6d8714dbae4a267f2b088.translation: A bird perched on a branch of the olive tree and began to sing.

sense_dddf5f7d5dac71b0064f16dd13862538.text: En la junta discutiremos cómo reducir los gastos generales.
sense_dddf5f7d5dac71b0064f16dd13862538.translation: In the meeting, we'll discuss how to reduce our overhead costs.

sense_dddf5f7d5dac71b0064f16dd13862538.text: Puedes seguir unos pasos sencillos para reducir tus impuestos federales.
sense_dddf5f7d5dac71b0064f16dd13862538.translation: You can take simple steps to reduce your federal taxes.

sense_1dc5df2eebe3a8977610a98268ed51ca.text: Hay que reducir la marcha en estas curvas.
sense_1dc5df2eebe3a8977610a98268ed51ca.translation: You need to downshift on these bends.

sense_1dc5df2eebe3a8977610a98268ed51ca.text: Reduce la marcha antes del semáforo.

sense_e7e180dc8bfb89fa54d22fbc1003b5c9.text: El bienestar familiar debe de estar en el seno de la sociedad.
sense_e7e180dc8bfb89fa54d22fbc1003b5c9.translation: The welfare of families should be at the heart of society.

sense_e7e180dc8bfb89fa54d22fbc1003b5c9.text: El origen de la crisis se encontraba en el mismísimo seno del departamento.
sense_e7e180dc8bfb89fa54d22fbc1003b5c9.translation: The origin of the crisis was in the very heart of the department.

sense_a56f680389540087e4fb5d8b0ae1b918.text: Aquel coche estacionado allá es mío.
sense_a56f680389540087e4fb5d8b0ae1b918.translation: That car parked over there is mine.

sense_a56f680389540087e4fb5d8b0ae1b918.text: Me gusta mucho aquella casa que hay en lo alto de la colina.
sense_a56f680389540087e4fb5d8b0ae1b918.translation: I really like that house on top of the hill.

sense_527c7e047d87530447a58a1f32afe08e.text: No sé tú pero yo prefiero aquel.
sense_527c7e047d87530447a58a1f32afe08e.translation: I don't know about you but I prefer that one.

sense_527c7e047d87530447a58a1f32afe08e.text: Aquella es más grande que esta.
sense_527c7e047d87530447a58a1f32afe08e.translation: That one is bigger than this one.

sense_da79280abd1d294bae03aecf59993eb9.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_da79280abd1d294bae03aecf59993eb9.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_da79280abd1d294bae03aecf59993eb9.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_da79280abd1d294bae03aecf59993eb9.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_dbee3bcf6c762db3c6cf9b1d9059e776.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_dbee3bcf6c762db3c6cf9b1d9059e776.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_abd4cc1babd455e625674753d5d1998f.text: El fiscal se negó a hacer declaraciones a la prensa debido al secreto del sumario.
sense_abd4cc1babd455e625674753d5d1998f.translation: The district attorney refused to talk to the press because the matter was sub judice.

sense_abd4cc1babd455e625674753d5d1998f.text: En su última declaración, el actor negó los rumores que lo vinculan con la famosa cantante.
sense_abd4cc1babd455e625674753d5d1998f.translation: In his last statement, the actor denied the rumors that he was dating the famous singer.

sense_d66af128a0d4bf166b5055b5cfbe5475.text: Se llamó a los testigos del accidente para que prestaran declaración.
sense_d66af128a0d4bf166b5055b5cfbe5475.translation: The witnesses of the car accident were summoned to give evidence.

sense_d66af128a0d4bf166b5055b5cfbe5475.text: Si no vienes de buena gana para prestar declaración, tendremos que citarte.
sense_d66af128a0d4bf166b5055b5cfbe5475.translation: If you don't come forth to testify willingly, we will have to subpoena you.

sense_0a340cc045ee5ff6cf904dd6c333cb9b.text: Quisiera agradecerte la amabilidad y consideración que nos has mostrado.
sense_0a340cc045ee5ff6cf904dd6c333cb9b.translation: I would like to thank you for the kindness and consideration you have shown us.

sense_0a340cc045ee5ff6cf904dd6c333cb9b.text: Si tratas a las personas con amabilidad y respeto, harás muchos amigos y pocos enemigos.
sense_0a340cc045ee5ff6cf904dd6c333cb9b.translation: If you treat people with kindness and respect, you'll make many friends and few enemies.

sense_b3278c369338161d49dea717fae6d16d.text: Rodolfo se niega a aceptar que la boda está cancelada.
sense_b3278c369338161d49dea717fae6d16d.translation: Rodolfo refuses to believe that the wedding is canceled.

sense_b3278c369338161d49dea717fae6d16d.text: Me niego a pagar cinco dólares de envío por algo que solo cuesta un dólar.
sense_b3278c369338161d49dea717fae6d16d.translation: I refuse to pay five dollars to ship something that only costs a dollar.

sense_2c63ff67d73d0b6681a5116e26967ee5.translation: I think he's Italian. - I suspected as much!

sense_2c63ff67d73d0b6681a5116e26967ee5.text: La señora Jones sospecha que su esposo le es infiel.
sense_2c63ff67d73d0b6681a5116e26967ee5.translation: Mrs. Jones suspects that her husband is cheating on her.

sense_c77cc1c1a96fc1fb907768ac22a5a230.text: Volvimos a hablar, pero todavía hay algunos asuntos pendientes.
sense_c77cc1c1a96fc1fb907768ac22a5a230.translation: We started talking again, but there are still some issues to sort out.
Did you sort everything out or is there still stuff to do?

sense_fdb8292892575d359329ae65efa1fa5a.text: Estaban pendientes de noticias del pueblo después del tornado.
sense_fdb8292892575d359329ae65efa1fa5a.translation: They were waiting on news from the town after the tornado.
We'll keep an eye on your son.

sense_fb9231609cae9bff8b254ca2e95258e4.text: Julia ignoraba por completo que estaba embarazada.
sense_fb9231609cae9bff8b254ca2e95258e4.translation: Julia had absolutely no idea that she was pregnant.

sense_fb9231609cae9bff8b254ca2e95258e4.text: Qué hace Marta en este grupo, lo ignoro por completo.
sense_fb9231609cae9bff8b254ca2e95258e4.translation: What Marta is doing in this group I have no idea.

sense_c8a553ad00adb770b862dd37bdd0753c.text: Los soldados cayeron en una emboscada que les había tendido la guerrilla.
sense_c8a553ad00adb770b862dd37bdd0753c.translation: The soldiers walked into an ambush the guerrilla had laid for them.

sense_c8a553ad00adb770b862dd37bdd0753c.text: El general le dijo al rey que sus tropas estaban dirigiéndose a una emboscada.
sense_c8a553ad00adb770b862dd37bdd0753c.translation: The general told the king that his troops were heading into an ambush.

sense_c7300550c5a9f368087ed799bafa2aaf.translation: I just want to make you happy.
What do you want for Christmas?

sense_e17b67c013de925a37b43a35a91838ef.translation: "How can I help you?," asked the butler.
Would you like something to drink?

sense_806d30d226ef02374f7a5a58a837a947.text: Me parece que el ministro debería dimitir.
sense_806d30d226ef02374f7a5a58a837a947.translation: I think the minister should resign.

sense_806d30d226ef02374f7a5a58a837a947.text: ¿Qué te pareció la serie sobre la familia real? - Me pareció una tontería.
sense_806d30d226ef02374f7a5a58a837a947.translation: What did you think of the series about the royal family? - I thought it was nonsense.

sense_21cd0bc2a1bfb1ba67b3f5d08db2fbc0.translation: That restaurant is too far for me.

sense_21cd0bc2a1bfb1ba67b3f5d08db2fbc0.text: Yo iré a la imprenta. Me pilla de camino a casa.
sense_21cd0bc2a1bfb1ba67b3f5d08db2fbc0.translation: I'll go to the printer. It's on my way home.

sense_ee8f3a9446bc1260cdcde1f6068d031d.text: La tienda está abierta por si quieres ir a comprar leche.
sense_ee8f3a9446bc1260cdcde1f6068d031d.translation: The store is open in case you want to go buy milk.

sense_16b933e0e4cf3ae0a8bddc11bf560776.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_16b933e0e4cf3ae0a8bddc11bf560776.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_16b933e0e4cf3ae0a8bddc11bf560776.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_16b933e0e4cf3ae0a8bddc11bf560776.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_467150934d1a097cd942abf3f8746d4f.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_467150934d1a097cd942abf3f8746d4f.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_467150934d1a097cd942abf3f8746d4f.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_467150934d1a097cd942abf3f8746d4f.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_ef37a0c13f621c9072f0312b7bc12cb7.text: Algunos miembros del equipo se produjeron heridas graves.
sense_ef37a0c13f621c9072f0312b7bc12cb7.translation: Several members of the team were seriously injured.

sense_ef37a0c13f621c9072f0312b7bc12cb7.text: Se produjo varios cortes en el brazo cuando se cayó del árbol.
sense_ef37a0c13f621c9072f0312b7bc12cb7.translation: He got several cuts on his arm when he fell from the tree.

sense_b15173f805d892578475a6cf88037494.text: Nos lo pasamos fenomenal en la playa.
sense_b15173f805d892578475a6cf88037494.translation: We had a fantastic time at the seaside.
Things are working out brilliantly for them in France.

sense_8e9d1efffd6b0585d085ba5c3b9bc6f6.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_8e9d1efffd6b0585d085ba5c3b9bc6f6.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_8e9d1efffd6b0585d085ba5c3b9bc6f6.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_8e9d1efffd6b0585d085ba5c3b9bc6f6.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_216ae0c9d30cbd4ea3b2d81f591053ac.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_216ae0c9d30cbd4ea3b2d81f591053ac.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_216ae0c9d30cbd4ea3b2d81f591053ac.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_216ae0c9d30cbd4ea3b2d81f591053ac.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_544330f025102e17669faa302570effe.text: Nos metieron un paquete por llegar tarde.
sense_544330f025102e17669faa302570effe.translation: We got into real trouble for arriving late.

sense_544330f025102e17669faa302570effe.text: Menudo paquete te va a caer si mamá se entera.
sense_544330f025102e17669faa302570effe.translation: If Mom finds out, you'll really be in for it.

sense_09311d82bf3a965350e59f8211bbfbbb.text: Estos exámenes están causándome bastante ansiedad.
sense_09311d82bf3a965350e59f8211bbfbbb.translation: These exams are causing me a lot of anxiety.

sense_09311d82bf3a965350e59f8211bbfbbb.text: Pensar en todas las cosas que tengo que hacer esta semana me causa ansiedad.
sense_09311d82bf3a965350e59f8211bbfbbb.translation: Thinking about all the things I have to do this week gives me anxiety.

sense_3a5144b82641ce56be7a258c933cf7ce.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_3a5144b82641ce56be7a258c933cf7ce.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_ceaa56a59ad06e31a8a082376ddc016b.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_ceaa56a59ad06e31a8a082376ddc016b.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_ceaa56a59ad06e31a8a082376ddc016b.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_ceaa56a59ad06e31a8a082376ddc016b.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_75a9512c1cd216dbc9c3850fa8f16eae.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_75a9512c1cd216dbc9c3850fa8f16eae.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_90ba355b6bde0e10f69a785e39f36fd5.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_90ba355b6bde0e10f69a785e39f36fd5.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_90ba355b6bde0e10f69a785e39f36fd5.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_90ba355b6bde0e10f69a785e39f36fd5.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_5b7012faebc731cb06a5915f600a18e9.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_5b7012faebc731cb06a5915f600a18e9.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_5b7012faebc731cb06a5915f600a18e9.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_5b7012faebc731cb06a5915f600a18e9.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_87c14aa14938009b435a9a2ad53732b3.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_87c14aa14938009b435a9a2ad53732b3.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_108e3ffbfc36ddf8f4a26b9dcdfa3c8e.text: La culpa es tuya. - ¿Mía? ¡Hay que joderse! ¡Pero si yo ni siquiera estaba aquí!
sense_108e3ffbfc36ddf8f4a26b9dcdfa3c8e.translation: It's your fault. - My fault? For fuck's sake! But I wasn't even here!

sense_108e3ffbfc36ddf8f4a26b9dcdfa3c8e.text: No me dejaron ustedes nada de comida. - ¡Te jodes! Es tu culpa por llegar tarde.
sense_108e3ffbfc36ddf8f4a26b9dcdfa3c8e.translation: You didn't leave any food for me. - Tough shit! It's your fault for being late.

sense_edb2981f2ff2eea08e1519bd03b9d4fc.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_edb2981f2ff2eea08e1519bd03b9d4fc.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_edb2981f2ff2eea08e1519bd03b9d4fc.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_edb2981f2ff2eea08e1519bd03b9d4fc.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_ed076deed9e5a360903993a81a6b9918.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_ed076deed9e5a360903993a81a6b9918.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_d74ae73a8f3f2ac8a22fec817fb4eb0a.text: La chica estaba vendiendo naranjas en el mercado.
sense_d74ae73a8f3f2ac8a22fec817fb4eb0a.translation: The girl was selling oranges in the market.

sense_1cdfdcd1727691f62b0693a16db69879.text: Este año voy a correr la maratón.
sense_1cdfdcd1727691f62b0693a16db69879.translation: I'm running the marathon this year.

sense_2a1792e5786059fcc505239c63e7c4c1.text: Me provocan unas palomitas cuando voy al cine.
sense_2a1792e5786059fcc505239c63e7c4c1.translation: I feel like having some popcorn when I go to the movies.
Would you like something to eat?

sense_407362a7db79b5a8dd4dc0fd325c6039.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_407362a7db79b5a8dd4dc0fd325c6039.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_1efee6fd7e42369ee14fae49329f2de0.text: El programa era tan aburrido que me dormí.
sense_1efee6fd7e42369ee14fae49329f2de0.translation: The program was so boring that I fell asleep.

sense_1efee6fd7e42369ee14fae49329f2de0.text: Me dormí a las 6 de la mañana.
sense_1efee6fd7e42369ee14fae49329f2de0.translation: I fell asleep at 6 in the morning.

sense_9b57d28ef6fe107b3314c17930d222f7.text: No te duermas o no acabarás a tiempo.
sense_9b57d28ef6fe107b3314c17930d222f7.translation: Don't slack off or you won't finish in time.

sense_9b57d28ef6fe107b3314c17930d222f7.text: Por dormirse se perdió la clave para ganar el premio.
sense_9b57d28ef6fe107b3314c17930d222f7.translation: He missed the clue to win the prize because he didn't stay on his toes.

sense_9bee6212168f98e3bab6a5a0e312ec27.text: El programa era tan aburrido que me dormí.
sense_9bee6212168f98e3bab6a5a0e312ec27.translation: The program was so boring that I fell asleep.

sense_9bee6212168f98e3bab6a5a0e312ec27.text: Me dormí a las 6 de la mañana.
sense_9bee6212168f98e3bab6a5a0e312ec27.translation: I fell asleep at 6 in the morning.

sense_7cc5ef3566d7386792d6329d468bd38a.text: No te duermas o no acabarás a tiempo.
sense_7cc5ef3566d7386792d6329d468bd38a.translation: Don't slack off or you won't finish in time.

sense_7cc5ef3566d7386792d6329d468bd38a.text: Por dormirse se perdió la clave para ganar el premio.
sense_7cc5ef3566d7386792d6329d468bd38a.translation: He missed the clue to win the prize because he didn't stay on his toes.

sense_c72686bc434f66c6e876d28af37a8462.text: Dicen que el alcalde recibió dinero de fuentes sospechosas.
sense_c72686bc434f66c6e876d28af37a8462.translation: They say that the mayor received money from shady sources.

sense_c72686bc434f66c6e876d28af37a8462.text: La víctima recibió un fuerte golpe al lado de la cabeza.
sense_c72686bc434f66c6e876d28af37a8462.translation: The victim received a strong blow to the side of the head.

sense_0ec35e7b6cfc898cd94eacefea27f920.text: El equipo visitante fue recibido con silbidos y abucheos.
sense_0ec35e7b6cfc898cd94eacefea27f920.translation: The visiting team was received with whistles and jeers.

sense_0ec35e7b6cfc898cd94eacefea27f920.text: Nos recibió personalmente en el aeropuerto.
sense_0ec35e7b6cfc898cd94eacefea27f920.translation: He personally welcomed us at the airport.

sense_a09f60c80fe09b1a4909ab5e42b4b45a.text: Mi hermana se recibió de ingeniera en Georgia Tech.
sense_a09f60c80fe09b1a4909ab5e42b4b45a.translation: My sister graduated as an engineer from Georgia Tech.
How many students will graduate this year?

sense_5fe92eda403c1c3391476ee76c6b5a33.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
sense_5fe92eda403c1c3391476ee76c6b5a33.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

sense_5fe92eda403c1c3391476ee76c6b5a33.text: Escucha al profesor siempre que te dé instrucciones.
sense_5fe92eda403c1c3391476ee76c6b5a33.translation: Always listen to the teacher when you are given instructions.

sense_211526adb8b2097324bbb97890a0b902.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
sense_211526adb8b2097324bbb97890a0b902.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

sense_211526adb8b2097324bbb97890a0b902.text: Mi jefa no para de hablar en reuniones porque que le encanta escucharse.
sense_211526adb8b2097324bbb97890a0b902.translation: My boss never stops talking in meetings because she loves the sound of her own voice.

sense_7a6c3a3c24dd6c7d855efb7b4444278c.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_7a6c3a3c24dd6c7d855efb7b4444278c.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_4f431566662bd4038ca006d06a0f94ab.text: El alumno escribió su ensayo de 20 páginas en una noche.
sense_4f431566662bd4038ca006d06a0f94ab.translation: The student wrote his 20-page essay in one night.

sense_3057da6e3694c4ffede8894dfa2d083a.text: Un día en la playa me suena perfecto.
sense_3057da6e3694c4ffede8894dfa2d083a.translation: A day on the beach sounds perfect.

sense_b6b3fb33a2db3b01055c3110a5dbb1c1.text: La comida maravillosa del restaurante se une a la decoración modernista lujosa.
sense_b6b3fb33a2db3b01055c3110a5dbb1c1.translation: The restaurant's fantastic food is complemented by their luxurious modernist decor.

sense_b6b3fb33a2db3b01055c3110a5dbb1c1.text: Ese tipo es un trabajador fantástico. En él se unen la confianza y la habilidad.
sense_b6b3fb33a2db3b01055c3110a5dbb1c1.translation: That guy's a fantastic worker. He's the epitome of confidence and skill.

sense_9d4291e769eb6c0787e47094dd2f441b.text: Este ejercicio es muy bueno para fortalecer los glúteos.
sense_9d4291e769eb6c0787e47094dd2f441b.translation: This exercise is really good to strengthen your glutes.

sense_9d4291e769eb6c0787e47094dd2f441b.text: Prefiero hacer ejercicio en la mañana para empezar bien el día.
sense_9d4291e769eb6c0787e47094dd2f441b.translation: I prefer to do exercise in the morning to start my day off right.

sense_f60f10e0c1837ad02d6eac5395b79ffa.text: Tu hija siempre está atenta en clase.
sense_f60f10e0c1837ad02d6eac5395b79ffa.translation: Your daughter is always attentive in class.

sense_f60f10e0c1837ad02d6eac5395b79ffa.text: Nuestro perro se pone muy atento cuando pasa el cartero.
sense_f60f10e0c1837ad02d6eac5395b79ffa.translation: Our dog becomes very attentive when the letter carrier comes by.

sense_f7bda6e9786f5a0973b3fc41f5f26f8b.text: Voy andando al colegio todos los días.
sense_f7bda6e9786f5a0973b3fc41f5f26f8b.translation: I walk to school every day.

sense_f7bda6e9786f5a0973b3fc41f5f26f8b.text: "Cuando ando, me canso mucho", le dijo la anciana a su médico.
sense_f7bda6e9786f5a0973b3fc41f5f26f8b.translation: "When I walk, I get very tired," the old woman told her doctor.

sense_9667f35042055c5179a1fad57cf72fb4.text: En el verano ella anda en bicicleta al trabajo.
sense_9667f35042055c5179a1fad57cf72fb4.translation: In the summer she takes her bike to work.

sense_9667f35042055c5179a1fad57cf72fb4.text: Yo siempre ando en tren cuando regreso al hogar.
sense_9667f35042055c5179a1fad57cf72fb4.translation: I always take the train when returning home.

sense_e374021b45361fb152b8bb70f17f5064.text: ¡Qué andar tan raro tienen esos jóvenes!
sense_e374021b45361fb152b8bb70f17f5064.translation: The way those youths walk is really strange!

sense_e374021b45361fb152b8bb70f17f5064.text: Se le nota en el andar que tiene mucho dolor.
sense_e374021b45361fb152b8bb70f17f5064.translation: You can tell by the way she walks that she's in a lot of pain.

sense_de0ed05ae48091c4bd4ac6b7da679765.text: Me gusta todo de ti, hasta los andares.
sense_de0ed05ae48091c4bd4ac6b7da679765.translation: I like everything about you, even the way you walk.

sense_de0ed05ae48091c4bd4ac6b7da679765.text: El Charlot de Charlie Chaplin tiene unos andares totalmente inconfundibles.
sense_de0ed05ae48091c4bd4ac6b7da679765.translation: The way Charlie Chaplin's tramp walks is completely unmistakeable.

sense_43a7e287548223a54f3d4d10fe8e609a.text: Sentí mucha pena cuando se murió mi actor preferido.
sense_43a7e287548223a54f3d4d10fe8e609a.translation: I felt really sad when my favorite actor died.

sense_43a7e287548223a54f3d4d10fe8e609a.text: Me da mucha pena verlos partir.
sense_43a7e287548223a54f3d4d10fe8e609a.translation: It makes me so sad to see them leave.

sense_3a155a35c18ddcf208b48698837f020f.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_3a155a35c18ddcf208b48698837f020f.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_3a155a35c18ddcf208b48698837f020f.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_3a155a35c18ddcf208b48698837f020f.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_14f8aa9d232ce84e01759e8053b62f36.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_14f8aa9d232ce84e01759e8053b62f36.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_14f8aa9d232ce84e01759e8053b62f36.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_14f8aa9d232ce84e01759e8053b62f36.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_f3ee2780bded34b0157962e652db9da1.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_f3ee2780bded34b0157962e652db9da1.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_f3ee2780bded34b0157962e652db9da1.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_f3ee2780bded34b0157962e652db9da1.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_847408c853ec1410c24ab15cbfbe15e5.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_847408c853ec1410c24ab15cbfbe15e5.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_847408c853ec1410c24ab15cbfbe15e5.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_847408c853ec1410c24ab15cbfbe15e5.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_da27305b3431160594ef475c746127aa.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_da27305b3431160594ef475c746127aa.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_da27305b3431160594ef475c746127aa.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_da27305b3431160594ef475c746127aa.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_27863036ef556a6f0a7232f1826b37a3.text: Javier es el alumno más aplicado de la clase.
sense_27863036ef556a6f0a7232f1826b37a3.translation: Javier is the most hardworking student in the class.

sense_27863036ef556a6f0a7232f1826b37a3.text: Solo 12 alumnos consiguieron licenciarse en Física.
sense_27863036ef556a6f0a7232f1826b37a3.translation: Only 12 students managed to graduate in Physics.

sense_b5b0be9d466ddf62da4a99a6feb409fe.text: El programa era tan aburrido que me dormí.
sense_b5b0be9d466ddf62da4a99a6feb409fe.translation: The program was so boring that I fell asleep.

sense_b5b0be9d466ddf62da4a99a6feb409fe.text: Me dormí a las 6 de la mañana.
sense_b5b0be9d466ddf62da4a99a6feb409fe.translation: I fell asleep at 6 in the morning.

sense_31ff5ff34ef97f55ebe0edf561959549.text: No te duermas o no acabarás a tiempo.
sense_31ff5ff34ef97f55ebe0edf561959549.translation: Don't slack off or you won't finish in time.

sense_31ff5ff34ef97f55ebe0edf561959549.text: Por dormirse se perdió la clave para ganar el premio.
sense_31ff5ff34ef97f55ebe0edf561959549.translation: He missed the clue to win the prize because he didn't stay on his toes.

sense_277830ffd59199accf605a855b4447f7.text: Un día en la playa me suena perfecto.
sense_277830ffd59199accf605a855b4447f7.translation: A day on the beach sounds perfect.

sense_2e37d78b8b165a7dcc13fb5d0dcb9334.text: Podemos lograr esta meta, pero nos costará sudores.
sense_2e37d78b8b165a7dcc13fb5d0dcb9334.translation: We can accomplish this goal, but it'll take blood, sweat, and tears.

sense_2e37d78b8b165a7dcc13fb5d0dcb9334.text: Después de muchos sudores, por fin conseguimos construir la casa.
sense_2e37d78b8b165a7dcc13fb5d0dcb9334.translation: After much toil, we finally managed to build the house.

sense_d65c2c718b8736e7954d1bc9cc4ad663.text: El capitán dirigió el buque hacia el faro.
sense_d65c2c718b8736e7954d1bc9cc4ad663.translation: The captain steered the ship toward the lighthouse.

sense_d65c2c718b8736e7954d1bc9cc4ad663.text: Dirigió el coche con cuidado por el borde del acantilado.
sense_d65c2c718b8736e7954d1bc9cc4ad663.translation: He steered the car carefully along the edge of the cliff.

sense_f309ecb38f35c4b1830022746bc7dd6a.text: Me gusta jugar al bingo por el dinero.
sense_f309ecb38f35c4b1830022746bc7dd6a.translation: I love playing Bingo for money.
Does anybody want to play tennis with me?

sense_27a0b1fce39238acba9dc1de4bd75eb6.text: Tienen todo lleno de mierda. Nunca limpian nada.
sense_27a0b1fce39238acba9dc1de4bd75eb6.translation: Their place is disgusting. They never clean.

sense_27a0b1fce39238acba9dc1de4bd75eb6.text: La casa está hecha una mierda. A ver cuando nos ponemos a limpiar un poco.
sense_27a0b1fce39238acba9dc1de4bd75eb6.translation: The house is filthy. We need to get down to some cleaning.

sense_b4a2bf1e69f970c6e6de0ebb76c06bb9.text: "Con estos versos, seguro la enamoro," dijo el poeta.
sense_b4a2bf1e69f970c6e6de0ebb76c06bb9.translation: "With these verses, I'm sure to make her fall in love," said the poet.

sense_b4a2bf1e69f970c6e6de0ebb76c06bb9.text: Enamoré a mi mujer haciéndome pasar por escritor, y en eso me convertí.
sense_b4a2bf1e69f970c6e6de0ebb76c06bb9.translation: I made my wife fall in love with me by pretending to be a writer, and that's what I became.

sense_ce645886d8bc546d3a6a934369e01974.translation: I think he's Italian. - I suspected as much!

sense_ce645886d8bc546d3a6a934369e01974.text: La señora Jones sospecha que su esposo le es infiel.
sense_ce645886d8bc546d3a6a934369e01974.translation: Mrs. Jones suspects that her husband is cheating on her.

sense_2ae9a89fd10eb700e43255ed70f6fc8b.text: Un día en la playa me suena perfecto.
sense_2ae9a89fd10eb700e43255ed70f6fc8b.translation: A day on the beach sounds perfect.

sense_d9f0d55dd6adde5155087554ee6572d9.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_d9f0d55dd6adde5155087554ee6572d9.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_d9f0d55dd6adde5155087554ee6572d9.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_d9f0d55dd6adde5155087554ee6572d9.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_fb3ed77b5873f8644734de7c1542c851.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_fb3ed77b5873f8644734de7c1542c851.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_fb3ed77b5873f8644734de7c1542c851.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_fb3ed77b5873f8644734de7c1542c851.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_fff27ef637d3f551ac6594de98f0ebbf.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_63d34b39bcb1d2a7e795667ecec64c99.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_63d34b39bcb1d2a7e795667ecec64c99.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_63d34b39bcb1d2a7e795667ecec64c99.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_63d34b39bcb1d2a7e795667ecec64c99.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_5b54ea3c0152ab5590a77643025e220b.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_5b54ea3c0152ab5590a77643025e220b.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_5b54ea3c0152ab5590a77643025e220b.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_5b54ea3c0152ab5590a77643025e220b.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_691b183723cccb58496cac18cd1adf85.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_691b183723cccb58496cac18cd1adf85.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_691b183723cccb58496cac18cd1adf85.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_691b183723cccb58496cac18cd1adf85.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_5d0508591e79b5b0dd125a3e064dfdbc.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_5d0508591e79b5b0dd125a3e064dfdbc.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_56e955629de2d165d51fe98c279f0a30.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_56e955629de2d165d51fe98c279f0a30.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_56e955629de2d165d51fe98c279f0a30.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_56e955629de2d165d51fe98c279f0a30.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_1fbe25cf2dcc6781887ad640f2b2bc14.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_1fbe25cf2dcc6781887ad640f2b2bc14.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_1fbe25cf2dcc6781887ad640f2b2bc14.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_1fbe25cf2dcc6781887ad640f2b2bc14.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_e0a2a4fc028cf7e973432c26def27dc0.text: ¡Estás desconocida con ese corte de pelo!
sense_e0a2a4fc028cf7e973432c26def27dc0.translation: You look very different with that haircut!

sense_e0a2a4fc028cf7e973432c26def27dc0.text: Desde que se casó está desconocido.
sense_e0a2a4fc028cf7e973432c26def27dc0.translation: He's changed a lot since he got married.

sense_a75b1f5b95fc4c2283ad3efcdd50fd30.text: No tardará en dejar de ser una desconocida.
sense_a75b1f5b95fc4c2283ad3efcdd50fd30.translation: It won't take long for her to become famous.

sense_a75b1f5b95fc4c2283ad3efcdd50fd30.text: Se casó con él cuando era todavía un desconocido.
sense_a75b1f5b95fc4c2283ad3efcdd50fd30.translation: She married him when he was not yet famous.

sense_622f94433cbd85e153609ccf7acb364d.text: Me gusta jugar al bingo por el dinero.
sense_622f94433cbd85e153609ccf7acb364d.translation: I love playing Bingo for money.
Does anybody want to play tennis with me?

sense_284f3a8edee57fba20838570122c1f6a.text: Desde muy chiquita le he tenido pavor a los payasos.
sense_284f3a8edee57fba20838570122c1f6a.translation: I've been terrified of clowns since I was a little girl.

sense_284f3a8edee57fba20838570122c1f6a.text: Los niños en la fiesta se rieron al ver el payaso.
sense_284f3a8edee57fba20838570122c1f6a.translation: The children at the party all laughed when they saw the clown.

sense_d92f416fcd218272807ddccaa8585a86.text: Juan medía 5 pies a los quince años.
sense_d92f416fcd218272807ddccaa8585a86.translation: Juan was 5 feet tall when he was fifteen.

sense_b861273caeb8b206e938b304a5391042.text: Me tomó toda la noche, pero ya terminé de pasar mi tesis a limpio.
sense_b861273caeb8b206e938b304a5391042.translation: It took all night, but I finished writing the final version of my thesis.

sense_b861273caeb8b206e938b304a5391042.text: Cuando me corrijas el borrador, voy a pasarlo a limpio para entregárselo mañana al maestro.
sense_b861273caeb8b206e938b304a5391042.translation: After you correct my rough draft, I am going to print out a clean copy to turn in to my teacher tomorrow.

sense_63eaf00744258b0d5e9823e03557f7cc.text: Si me permite, señora, creo que puedo arreglar la puerta.
sense_63eaf00744258b0d5e9823e03557f7cc.translation: If I may, ma'am, I think I can fix the door.

sense_9e3be9c5bdb4658be5658848434c3117.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_9e3be9c5bdb4658be5658848434c3117.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_618f59722d13840ae4962d090009abe4.text: Este año voy a correr la maratón.
sense_618f59722d13840ae4962d090009abe4.translation: I'm running the marathon this year.

sense_3c0de09a9f19d7e085c9ec788600eb96.text: Dicen que el alcalde recibió dinero de fuentes sospechosas.
sense_3c0de09a9f19d7e085c9ec788600eb96.translation: They say that the mayor received money from shady sources.

sense_3c0de09a9f19d7e085c9ec788600eb96.text: La víctima recibió un fuerte golpe al lado de la cabeza.
sense_3c0de09a9f19d7e085c9ec788600eb96.translation: The victim received a strong blow to the side of the head.

sense_407b8b3d51cdd45a709398a06508835a.text: Mi hermana se recibió de ingeniera en Georgia Tech.
sense_407b8b3d51cdd45a709398a06508835a.translation: My sister graduated as an engineer from Georgia Tech.
How many students will graduate this year?

sense_8503c50aff1c54de7795972c765ac26c.text: El equipo visitante fue recibido con silbidos y abucheos.
sense_8503c50aff1c54de7795972c765ac26c.translation: The visiting team was received with whistles and jeers.

sense_8503c50aff1c54de7795972c765ac26c.text: Nos recibió personalmente en el aeropuerto.
sense_8503c50aff1c54de7795972c765ac26c.translation: He personally welcomed us at the airport.

sense_71dce61d978d7f11383c7964f3831cff.text: El candidato ilusionó a los votantes con sus promesas de mejoras económicas.
sense_71dce61d978d7f11383c7964f3831cff.translation: The candidate built up voters' expectations with promises of economic improvement.

sense_71dce61d978d7f11383c7964f3831cff.text: El profesor ilusionó a los alumnos al decirles que el examen no era difícil.
sense_71dce61d978d7f11383c7964f3831cff.translation: The teacher got the students' hopes up when he said the exam wouldn't be difficult.

sense_55037a491f141113da8b646a81357ad3.text: Después de tres años de separación, John y su hermano casi no se reconocieron.
sense_55037a491f141113da8b646a81357ad3.translation: After three years of not having seen each other, John and his brother almost didn't recognize each other.

sense_55037a491f141113da8b646a81357ad3.text: Este semestre, estaba en el extranjero, por lo que estoy entusiasmado por ver a mis amigos tras tantos meses de separación.
sense_55037a491f141113da8b646a81357ad3.translation: I was abroad this semester, so I'm excited to see my friends after so many months of having been apart.

sense_dccda9da9bed30341807c6b574a6e99d.text: Roberto tiene el hábito de despertarse temprano.
sense_dccda9da9bed30341807c6b574a6e99d.translation: Roberto is in the habit of waking up early.

sense_dccda9da9bed30341807c6b574a6e99d.text: Ya sé que ver tanta tele es un mal hábito, pero me está costando mucho trabajo dejarlo.
sense_dccda9da9bed30341807c6b574a6e99d.translation: I know watching so much TV is a bad habit, but giving it up is proving really difficult.

sense_06cadaaf5d849487454e34aa26fe1c42.text: Este medicamento no crea hábito, así que no tienes que preocuparte.
sense_06cadaaf5d849487454e34aa26fe1c42.translation: This drug isn't habit-forming, so there's no need to worry.

sense_6c92318cf8b4500ab73a1f44dddbb9f5.text: El euro entró en circulación en 2002.
sense_6c92318cf8b4500ab73a1f44dddbb9f5.translation: The euro was put into circulation in 2002.

sense_6c92318cf8b4500ab73a1f44dddbb9f5.text: El sofá me costó solo 200 euros.
sense_6c92318cf8b4500ab73a1f44dddbb9f5.translation: I paid only 200 euros for the couch.

sense_2a9496b9139be805e2c49c83e89f48fa.text: Tuvimos que quedarnos en casa porque estaba cayendo un chaparrón.
sense_2a9496b9139be805e2c49c83e89f48fa.translation: We had to stay home because it was pouring rain.

sense_2a9496b9139be805e2c49c83e89f48fa.text: Está cayendo una buena nevada. Ponle las cadenas a las ruedas.
sense_2a9496b9139be805e2c49c83e89f48fa.translation: It's snowing hard. Put the chains on the tires.

sense_5b01364cee1974f0d085a77d88d12aa0.text: No bebo porque el alcohol me cae mal.
sense_5b01364cee1974f0d085a77d88d12aa0.translation: I don't drink because alcohol disagrees with me.
You look great in that dress!

sense_d6c8eb92c165ddcd9ca5e7d2382e0d48.text: Me cae muy bien tu hermano; siempre me hace sonreír.
sense_d6c8eb92c165ddcd9ca5e7d2382e0d48.translation: I really like your brother; he always makes me smile.

sense_d6c8eb92c165ddcd9ca5e7d2382e0d48.text: Me marché porque me cae mal tu primo con sus bromas ofensivas.
sense_d6c8eb92c165ddcd9ca5e7d2382e0d48.translation: I had to leave because I can't stand your cousin and his offensive jokes.

sense_be2da9b69194096fa6c751554b9dbdeb.text: Que Harvard la hubiera rechazado, le cayó mal.
sense_be2da9b69194096fa6c751554b9dbdeb.translation: She wasn't pleased that Harvard rejected her.

sense_be2da9b69194096fa6c751554b9dbdeb.text: El embarazo de mi hermana pequeña no cayó bien en la familia.
sense_be2da9b69194096fa6c751554b9dbdeb.translation: My little sister's pregnancy shocked the entire family.

sense_8d3f0518580c01d57a1addd7f05b07fe.text: Mi bebé está llorando porque se cae de sueño.
sense_8d3f0518580c01d57a1addd7f05b07fe.translation: My baby is crying because he's very sleepy.

sense_8d3f0518580c01d57a1addd7f05b07fe.text: Me caigo de cansancio, pero tengo que estudiar para el examen de mañana.
sense_8d3f0518580c01d57a1addd7f05b07fe.translation: I am really tired, but I have to study for tomorrow's exam.

sense_18f0632d4ce617ebafb8e41e50152a51.text: Hay que comprar una sartén nueva porque esta ya no sirve.
sense_18f0632d4ce617ebafb8e41e50152a51.translation: We need to buy a new frying pan because this one is no good any more.
Is this one any good to you?

sense_9b0a455f011f4db0b34c5de39bbe23c7.text: "No hay nada que temer", dijo el mago.
sense_9b0a455f011f4db0b34c5de39bbe23c7.translation: "There's nothing to fear," said the magician.

sense_9b0a455f011f4db0b34c5de39bbe23c7.text: "Yo no le temo a la muerte", dijo el temerario motociclista.
sense_9b0a455f011f4db0b34c5de39bbe23c7.translation: "I don't fear death," said the daredevil motorcyclist.

sense_6d4b11c7ce919c863cad552955f01379.text: De no ser por la valentía de la dependienta, los ladrones habrían escapado.
sense_6d4b11c7ce919c863cad552955f01379.translation: If it weren't for the shop assistant's bravery, the thieves would have escaped.

sense_6d4b11c7ce919c863cad552955f01379.text: El caballero era conocido por su valentía y liderazgo en el campo de batalla.
sense_6d4b11c7ce919c863cad552955f01379.translation: The knight was known for his bravery and leadership on the battlefield.

sense_956868bb7a1d0410ea901538f2485e83.text: ¡Apártate de mí! No quiero verte nunca más.
sense_956868bb7a1d0410ea901538f2485e83.translation: Get away from me! I don't want to see you again.

sense_956868bb7a1d0410ea901538f2485e83.text: Apártense de la estufa; está caliente.
sense_956868bb7a1d0410ea901538f2485e83.translation: Get away from the stove; it's hot.

sense_f60d4e41869a122c44313c55064cc072.text: El ahorro de energía ayuda a reducir tu huella de carbono.
sense_f60d4e41869a122c44313c55064cc072.translation: Saving electricity helps to reduce your carbon footprint.

sense_f60d4e41869a122c44313c55064cc072.text: Los dos estudiantes dieron una presentación acerca de lo importante que es el ahorro del agua.
sense_f60d4e41869a122c44313c55064cc072.translation: The two students gave a presentation about the importance of saving water.

sense_0b9bd1355aeab56b4577b9eaf0def426.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_0b9bd1355aeab56b4577b9eaf0def426.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_0b9bd1355aeab56b4577b9eaf0def426.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
