sense_0b9bd1355aeab56b4577b9eaf0def426.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_e29a31eb32ad52d248e318a36b587679.text: El programa era tan aburrido que me dormí.
sense_e29a31eb32ad52d248e318a36b587679.translation: The program was so boring that I fell asleep.

sense_e29a31eb32ad52d248e318a36b587679.text: Me dormí a las 6 de la mañana.
sense_e29a31eb32ad52d248e318a36b587679.translation: I fell asleep at 6 in the morning.

sense_52b84a261a1645ee63cd6b7873ade614.text: No te duermas o no acabarás a tiempo.
sense_52b84a261a1645ee63cd6b7873ade614.translation: Don't slack off or you won't finish in time.

sense_52b84a261a1645ee63cd6b7873ade614.text: Por dormirse se perdió la clave para ganar el premio.
sense_52b84a261a1645ee63cd6b7873ade614.translation: He missed the clue to win the prize because he didn't stay on his toes.

sense_4699aeb387f2ec15148c9377db23a9fe.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_4699aeb387f2ec15148c9377db23a9fe.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_4699aeb387f2ec15148c9377db23a9fe.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_4699aeb387f2ec15148c9377db23a9fe.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_14a69cd0850a42b3fd102eb95e2e2601.text: Fueron amigos durante años y después se hicieron novios.
sense_14a69cd0850a42b3fd102eb95e2e2601.translation: They were friends for years and then they started going out.
How long have they been dating?

sense_e70f1103e0eb1e4f88bd494f5bf33dc8.text: Desde mi casa se escuchaba el alboroto de los jóvenes festejando.
sense_e70f1103e0eb1e4f88bd494f5bf33dc8.translation: From my house, I could hear the racket from the teenagers celebrating.

sense_e70f1103e0eb1e4f88bd494f5bf33dc8.text: Si siguen con ese alboroto, los vecinos llamarán a la policía.
sense_e70f1103e0eb1e4f88bd494f5bf33dc8.translation: If you keep up that racket, the neighbors are going to call the cops.

sense_beb10890fab9c80b80ec29fc73331da2.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_beb10890fab9c80b80ec29fc73331da2.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_beb10890fab9c80b80ec29fc73331da2.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_beb10890fab9c80b80ec29fc73331da2.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_afe18d95459b312453d3b6d4579cdab6.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_afe18d95459b312453d3b6d4579cdab6.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_afe18d95459b312453d3b6d4579cdab6.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_afe18d95459b312453d3b6d4579cdab6.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_d3b3cd1e4dece6bd6b0a0c00ff80bec4.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_d3b3cd1e4dece6bd6b0a0c00ff80bec4.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_d3b3cd1e4dece6bd6b0a0c00ff80bec4.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_d3b3cd1e4dece6bd6b0a0c00ff80bec4.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_acc48f74b972e26c7bd9d95f8fc34c1c.text: Buenos días, doña Carmen. ¿Cómo está usted hoy?
sense_acc48f74b972e26c7bd9d95f8fc34c1c.translation: Good morning, Carmen. How are you today, madam?
I'll be with you in a moment, Gloria.

sense_0f923470064113d4929a88f18f341e5f.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_0f923470064113d4929a88f18f341e5f.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_0f923470064113d4929a88f18f341e5f.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_0f923470064113d4929a88f18f341e5f.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_a6e53cb43d654e7a1dca34ac64888a3c.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_a6e53cb43d654e7a1dca34ac64888a3c.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_a6e53cb43d654e7a1dca34ac64888a3c.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_a6e53cb43d654e7a1dca34ac64888a3c.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_96d6a5f47cc023768685639e0b89e513.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_e95af52375684e160c2486bb1dc5f408.text: El ejercicio es de vital importancia para la salud.
sense_e95af52375684e160c2486bb1dc5f408.translation: Exercise is vitally important for your health.

sense_e95af52375684e160c2486bb1dc5f408.text: La salud y seguridad de los empleados es un asunto de vital interés para la compañía.
sense_e95af52375684e160c2486bb1dc5f408.translation: The company is vitally interested in the health and safety of all its employees.

sense_16f1e3a34fbbe3a5d40966d8980a8018.text: Si llegaras a ir al restaurante, tienes que probar la tarta de fresa.
sense_16f1e3a34fbbe3a5d40966d8980a8018.translation: If you end up going to the restaurant, you must try the strawberry tart.

sense_16f1e3a34fbbe3a5d40966d8980a8018.text: Si llego a saber que tendrían nuevos episodios, no hubiera cancelado mi membresía.
sense_16f1e3a34fbbe3a5d40966d8980a8018.translation: Had I known that they were going to have new episodes, I never would have cancelled my membership.

sense_d6a7c6221670dcae964f955286872255.text: Mis abuelos tienen 40 años de casados.
sense_d6a7c6221670dcae964f955286872255.translation: My grandparents have been married for 40 years.
I haven't seen him for two years.

sense_13e0a9ab4fec0660b84841685fd7f952.text: Tenemos entendido que piensas dejar la escuela.
sense_13e0a9ab4fec0660b84841685fd7f952.translation: We understand that you're thinking of leaving school.

sense_13e0a9ab4fec0660b84841685fd7f952.text: Tengo pensado ir al mercado mañana.
sense_13e0a9ab4fec0660b84841685fd7f952.translation: I think I'll go to the market tomorrow.

sense_a3be9a9993569636980dbc0ab0874939.text: Estaba tan mareado que no me tenía de pie.
sense_a3be9a9993569636980dbc0ab0874939.translation: I was so dizzy that I couldn't stand up.
I'm so tired I can barely stand.

sense_888bdef7500138ab9a96f296d2455d8b.text: Este muchacho se tiene por muy guapo.
sense_888bdef7500138ab9a96f296d2455d8b.translation: That kid thinks he's so attractive.
Who does your cousin think she is?

sense_255ae8fdecc3b337b55f1f282e5cd7bc.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_255ae8fdecc3b337b55f1f282e5cd7bc.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_255ae8fdecc3b337b55f1f282e5cd7bc.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_255ae8fdecc3b337b55f1f282e5cd7bc.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_2032b46b5897bb6d11541d7a25ef861f.text: Sara expresó su agradecimiento por la honestidad de Melissa.
sense_2032b46b5897bb6d11541d7a25ef861f.translation: Sara expressed her gratitude for Melissa's honesty.

sense_2032b46b5897bb6d11541d7a25ef861f.text: Por favor acepta este regalo como un símbolo de agradecimiento por todo lo que has hecho por nosotros.
sense_2032b46b5897bb6d11541d7a25ef861f.translation: Please accept this gift as a sign of gratitude for everything you've done for us.

sense_4cb869e8dca5c0f6f4f2e1a7c598dddf.text: ¿Quién tiene que pagar la instalación del ascensor?
sense_4cb869e8dca5c0f6f4f2e1a7c598dddf.translation: Who's responsible for paying for the lift to be installed?

sense_4cb869e8dca5c0f6f4f2e1a7c598dddf.text: Aunque la instalación de paneles solares es costosa, vale la pena hacerlo.
sense_4cb869e8dca5c0f6f4f2e1a7c598dddf.translation: Even though putting in solar panels is expensive, it's worth doing.

sense_07ef4ea463392d14bc6a48368cf34c9b.text: La vida nocturna en Nueva Orleans es muy animada.
sense_07ef4ea463392d14bc6a48368cf34c9b.translation: The night life in New Orleans is very lively.

sense_07ef4ea463392d14bc6a48368cf34c9b.text: Anoche la patrulla nocturna atrapó a dos vándalos que pintaban grafitis en las paredes.
sense_07ef4ea463392d14bc6a48368cf34c9b.translation: Last night, the night patrol caught two vandals spraying graffiti on the walls.

sense_b798a4ec277432af231e88031a83bc99.text: Este año voy a correr la maratón.
sense_b798a4ec277432af231e88031a83bc99.translation: I'm running the marathon this year.

sense_02a1e02ff797326c5909436f48bc13e1.text: No me molesta que fumen, pero no en plena cara.
sense_02a1e02ff797326c5909436f48bc13e1.translation: I don't mind them smoking, but not right in my face.

sense_02a1e02ff797326c5909436f48bc13e1.text: Desviar el tráfico en plena temporada turística fue una mala idea.
sense_02a1e02ff797326c5909436f48bc13e1.translation: Diverting the traffic at the height of the tourist season was a bad idea.

sense_c4f0f912ae5547811948f16d981a7bd2.text: No le tire patadas a su hermano.
Su perro me tiró un mordisco.

sense_b7314817b8457e2d00f936f6c00ed20b.text: Las fiestas ya no me tiran.
sense_b7314817b8457e2d00f936f6c00ed20b.translation: Parties don't appeal to me anymore.
He is not interested in studying medicine.

sense_4743a827ef42dba7f558948e9fe27286.text: El plato tiraba a dulce más que nada.
sense_4743a827ef42dba7f558948e9fe27286.translation: The dish was more sweet than anything else.

sense_4743a827ef42dba7f558948e9fe27286.text: Tienes que beberte el té cuando esté tirando a frío.
sense_4743a827ef42dba7f558948e9fe27286.translation: You have to drink the tea when it is cooling down.

sense_d68e5c35bafd68c536595c0a01d6394f.text: El bebé se tiró un eructo tras tomarse su biberón.
sense_d68e5c35bafd68c536595c0a01d6394f.translation: The baby burped after having his bottle.

sense_d68e5c35bafd68c536595c0a01d6394f.text: La primera vez que se tiró un pedo delante de su novio se avergonzó.
sense_d68e5c35bafd68c536595c0a01d6394f.translation: The first time she farted in front of her boyfriend, she was embarrassed.

sense_7d0d6b16db3aebe700cb692de1cd4264.text: Las olas eran muy grandes, pero los expertos surfistas fueron dueños de la situación.
sense_7d0d6b16db3aebe700cb692de1cd4264.translation: The waves were very big, but the expert surfers were in control of the situation.

sense_7d0d6b16db3aebe700cb692de1cd4264.text: La reunión empezó a desmoronarse hasta que el abogado habló y se hizo dueño de la situación.
sense_7d0d6b16db3aebe700cb692de1cd4264.translation: The meeting was starting to fall apart until the lawyer spoke and took control of the situation.

sense_ad0171025ac9374f819412f4c66479ac.text: Mi bebé está llorando porque se cae de sueño.
sense_ad0171025ac9374f819412f4c66479ac.translation: My baby is crying because he's very sleepy.

sense_ad0171025ac9374f819412f4c66479ac.text: Me caigo de cansancio, pero tengo que estudiar para el examen de mañana.
sense_ad0171025ac9374f819412f4c66479ac.translation: I am really tired, but I have to study for tomorrow's exam.

sense_85bb45a4437e32a28d54b484b6cda56a.text: Tuvimos que quedarnos en casa porque estaba cayendo un chaparrón.
sense_85bb45a4437e32a28d54b484b6cda56a.translation: We had to stay home because it was pouring rain.

sense_85bb45a4437e32a28d54b484b6cda56a.text: Está cayendo una buena nevada. Ponle las cadenas a las ruedas.
sense_85bb45a4437e32a28d54b484b6cda56a.translation: It's snowing hard. Put the chains on the tires.

sense_a38ad65ac491a7d8aebd85cb4665c9ec.text: No bebo porque el alcohol me cae mal.
sense_a38ad65ac491a7d8aebd85cb4665c9ec.translation: I don't drink because alcohol disagrees with me.
You look great in that dress!

sense_6fef4ca40226de2ae2016261a8ab0194.text: Me cae muy bien tu hermano; siempre me hace sonreír.
sense_6fef4ca40226de2ae2016261a8ab0194.translation: I really like your brother; he always makes me smile.

sense_6fef4ca40226de2ae2016261a8ab0194.text: Me marché porque me cae mal tu primo con sus bromas ofensivas.
sense_6fef4ca40226de2ae2016261a8ab0194.translation: I had to leave because I can't stand your cousin and his offensive jokes.

sense_883723aaac6a1e0555292610c510893f.text: Que Harvard la hubiera rechazado, le cayó mal.
sense_883723aaac6a1e0555292610c510893f.translation: She wasn't pleased that Harvard rejected her.

sense_883723aaac6a1e0555292610c510893f.text: El embarazo de mi hermana pequeña no cayó bien en la familia.
sense_883723aaac6a1e0555292610c510893f.translation: My little sister's pregnancy shocked the entire family.

sense_6b1b5b3238606b234318af9209a381ac.text: Me gusta jugar al bingo por el dinero.
sense_6b1b5b3238606b234318af9209a381ac.translation: I love playing Bingo for money.
Does anybody want to play tennis with me?

sense_1ca7ff29c006635a18779b6ce875e721.text: La revolución separó el partido en dos facciones.
sense_1ca7ff29c006635a18779b6ce875e721.translation: The revolution separated the party into two factions.

sense_1ca7ff29c006635a18779b6ce875e721.text: Separé la clase en grupos de cuatro alumnos cada uno.
sense_1ca7ff29c006635a18779b6ce875e721.translation: I divided the class into groups of four students each.

sense_691da2857ecd27558c4ef1ca442c8797.text: Un ala se separó del transbordador espacial al entrar la atmósfera de la tierra.
sense_691da2857ecd27558c4ef1ca442c8797.translation: A wing came off the space shuttle upon entering the Earth's atmosphere.

sense_691da2857ecd27558c4ef1ca442c8797.text: Durante una tormenta, una rama se separó del árbol y cayó encima de mi automóvil.
sense_691da2857ecd27558c4ef1ca442c8797.translation: A branch of the tree was ripped off during a storm and landed on my car.

sense_ef987f7f4fa630829aa0a69c7d240957.text: Necesito comprar una tijera, una regla y unos plumones en la papelería.
sense_ef987f7f4fa630829aa0a69c7d240957.translation: I need to buy scissors, a ruler, and some markers at the stationery store.

sense_ef987f7f4fa630829aa0a69c7d240957.text: Pásame unas tijeras para cortar la etiqueta de mi blusa, por favor.
sense_ef987f7f4fa630829aa0a69c7d240957.translation: Hand me the scissors so I can cut the tag off my blouse, please.

sense_536df33bea2d186dc2e18e67a0ca5809.text: Este es un broche precioso. ¿Dónde lo compraste?
sense_536df33bea2d186dc2e18e67a0ca5809.translation: This is a beautiful brooch. Where did you buy it?

sense_536df33bea2d186dc2e18e67a0ca5809.text: La vista desde la peña está preciosa.
sense_536df33bea2d186dc2e18e67a0ca5809.translation: The view from the cliff is beautiful.

sense_e6b2ce7410b61bb5092924b5e5322dbb.text: La culpa es tuya. - ¿Mía? ¡Hay que joderse! ¡Pero si yo ni siquiera estaba aquí!
sense_e6b2ce7410b61bb5092924b5e5322dbb.translation: It's your fault. - My fault? For fuck's sake! But I wasn't even here!

sense_e6b2ce7410b61bb5092924b5e5322dbb.text: No me dejaron ustedes nada de comida. - ¡Te jodes! Es tu culpa por llegar tarde.
sense_e6b2ce7410b61bb5092924b5e5322dbb.translation: You didn't leave any food for me. - Tough shit! It's your fault for being late.

sense_5d97ad14ef4727e4dcdb62753434fd1f.text: En compras superiores a los $50 descontamos un 15%.
sense_5d97ad14ef4727e4dcdb62753434fd1f.translation: On purchases over $50, we give a discount of 15%.

sense_5d97ad14ef4727e4dcdb62753434fd1f.text: Me descontaron 30% porque conozco al dueño.
sense_5d97ad14ef4727e4dcdb62753434fd1f.translation: I got 30% off because I know the owner.

sense_7e518f7ab7978c6a6b532a2b37a6f447.text: Estoy resfriado y tengo un dolor de cabeza horrible.
sense_7e518f7ab7978c6a6b532a2b37a6f447.translation: I have a cold and a terrible headache.

sense_7e518f7ab7978c6a6b532a2b37a6f447.text: Si estás resfriada, ¡no te me acerques!
sense_7e518f7ab7978c6a6b532a2b37a6f447.translation: If you've got a cold, stay away from me!

sense_bc9a1506555732cdf4ddc4c4c40d7e1b.text: Nunca se me graban los números de teléfono de mis amigos.
sense_bc9a1506555732cdf4ddc4c4c40d7e1b.translation: I can never remember my friends' telephone numbers.

sense_bc9a1506555732cdf4ddc4c4c40d7e1b.text: Hoy es un día que se me grabará por siempre en la memoria.
sense_bc9a1506555732cdf4ddc4c4c40d7e1b.translation: Today is a day that will be forever etched in my mind.

sense_f46f625467b47ea4838632198e64e089.text: Si me permite, señora, creo que puedo arreglar la puerta.
sense_f46f625467b47ea4838632198e64e089.translation: If I may, ma'am, I think I can fix the door.

sense_b4f11b9b926f154026e5823d02bf3130.text: Vamos a alquilar un apartamento hasta que podamos permitirnos comprar una casa.
sense_b4f11b9b926f154026e5823d02bf3130.translation: We are going to rent an apartment until we can afford to buy a house.

sense_b4f11b9b926f154026e5823d02bf3130.text: El apartamento que quiero alquilar queda en el tercer piso de este edificio.
sense_b4f11b9b926f154026e5823d02bf3130.translation: The apartment I want to rent is on the third floor of this building.

sense_b580fe1f8a9cf4c7afb7236964614804.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_b580fe1f8a9cf4c7afb7236964614804.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_b580fe1f8a9cf4c7afb7236964614804.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_b580fe1f8a9cf4c7afb7236964614804.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_37129fa9d10dae63c8d80e6164822971.text: Esto me parece el billete de lotería ganador o ¿me traicionan los ojos?
sense_37129fa9d10dae63c8d80e6164822971.translation: Do my eyes deceive me, or am I holding the winning lottery ticket?

sense_37129fa9d10dae63c8d80e6164822971.text: Si no me traiciona la memoria, aquí es el lugar donde enterré el tesoro.
sense_37129fa9d10dae63c8d80e6164822971.translation: If memory serves me right, here is the place where I buried the treasure.

sense_6c07646f05d6a2daf244fb861e325cd7.text: ¿Me prestas $20? - ¡Claro que no! Todavía me debes $50.
sense_6c07646f05d6a2daf244fb861e325cd7.translation: Can I borrow $20? - No, you can't! You still owe me $50.

sense_6c07646f05d6a2daf244fb861e325cd7.text: Papá, ¿me ayudarás a hacer la tarea de matemáticas esta noche? - ¡Claro que sí!
sense_6c07646f05d6a2daf244fb861e325cd7.translation: Dad, will you help me with my math homework this evening? - Of course I will!

sense_108bbdf07a42bb83a5c1a10615ae5990.text: Margarita se negó a hacerlo. Claro que yo en su lugar también me hubiera negado.
sense_108bbdf07a42bb83a5c1a10615ae5990.translation: Margarita refused to do it. Mind you, I would have refused too in her place.

sense_108bbdf07a42bb83a5c1a10615ae5990.text: ¿Lo haces tú? - Claro, para que si sale mal me eches la culpa a mí.
sense_108bbdf07a42bb83a5c1a10615ae5990.translation: Will you do it? - Oh sure, so you can blame me if it goes wrong.

sense_f6ba0a79e71f652847856f1529b57b64.text: Me parece que el ministro debería dimitir.
sense_f6ba0a79e71f652847856f1529b57b64.translation: I think the minister should resign.

sense_f6ba0a79e71f652847856f1529b57b64.text: ¿Qué te pareció la serie sobre la familia real? - Me pareció una tontería.
sense_f6ba0a79e71f652847856f1529b57b64.translation: What did you think of the series about the royal family? - I thought it was nonsense.

sense_58c8afdba4b4c30c048125367fdd6580.text: Tengo unas ganas tremendas de conocerte.
sense_58c8afdba4b4c30c048125367fdd6580.translation: I'm really looking forward to meeting you.

sense_58c8afdba4b4c30c048125367fdd6580.text: Para cuando llegamos a casa yo ya tenía un hambre tremenda.
sense_58c8afdba4b4c30c048125367fdd6580.translation: By the time we got home I was real hungry.

sense_9cd615dae9620aa8bd48de32ee2876e9.text: Es cierto que me pilló en un renuncio, pero no hubo intención de engañar a nadie.
sense_9cd615dae9620aa8bd48de32ee2876e9.translation: It's true I told a lie and he caught me out, but there was no intent to deceive anyone.

sense_9cd615dae9620aa8bd48de32ee2876e9.text: Ella siempre se cuida mucho en lo que dice y nunca la vas a pescar en renuncios de ese tenor.
sense_9cd615dae9620aa8bd48de32ee2876e9.translation: She's always very careful what she says and you'll never catch her contradicting herself like that.

sense_b61288b15d106742bc2cfa71a3e0ce5a.text: ¡Mira esa cosita! - Órale. ¿Eso es perro o ratón?
sense_b61288b15d106742bc2cfa71a3e0ce5a.translation: Look at that little thing! - Woah. Is that a dog or a rat?

sense_b61288b15d106742bc2cfa71a3e0ce5a.text: Te compré esta cosita en el mercado de pulgas el fin de semana pasado.
sense_b61288b15d106742bc2cfa71a3e0ce5a.translation: I bought this little thing for you at the flea market last weekend.

sense_de966f2390509ff9c542455850ec8ddb.text: Si se van a hacer cositas tu compañero de cuarto y su novia, mejor salgamos.
sense_de966f2390509ff9c542455850ec8ddb.translation: If your roommate and his girlfriend are going to have sex, let's go out somewhere.

sense_de966f2390509ff9c542455850ec8ddb.text: Vi dos chavos haciéndose cositas en el parque y les dije, "¡Mejor renten un cuarto!"
sense_de966f2390509ff9c542455850ec8ddb.translation: I saw two kids getting it on in the park, and I told them, "Get a room!"

sense_071e5952ca54683af36e1ca2d478ac76.text: Estas áreas protegidas aportan beneficios importantes para el bienestar humano.
sense_071e5952ca54683af36e1ca2d478ac76.translation: These protected areas offer significant benefits for human well-being.

sense_071e5952ca54683af36e1ca2d478ac76.text: Nuestras oficinas están dentro del área metropolitana de Washington DC.
sense_071e5952ca54683af36e1ca2d478ac76.translation: Our offices are located within the metropolitan area of Washington DC.

sense_b1f13267d021c12306055c195222e42c.text: El arquitecto quiere acelerar la construcción del puente.
sense_b1f13267d021c12306055c195222e42c.translation: The architect wants to speed up construction of the bridge.

sense_b1f13267d021c12306055c195222e42c.text: El gerente de la empresa nos pidió que aceleráramos el proceso de selección de personal.
sense_b1f13267d021c12306055c195222e42c.translation: The company's CEO asked us to speed up the hiring process.

sense_7960deebd7be410cdfa98bf96b5087aa.text: La pintora tiene muchos admiradores porque sus cuadros son magníficos.
sense_7960deebd7be410cdfa98bf96b5087aa.translation: The painter has many admirers because her paintings are wonderful.

sense_a62db6e9d862e12d9f23e81381287854.text: El programa era tan aburrido que me dormí.
sense_a62db6e9d862e12d9f23e81381287854.translation: The program was so boring that I fell asleep.

sense_a62db6e9d862e12d9f23e81381287854.text: Me dormí a las 6 de la mañana.
sense_a62db6e9d862e12d9f23e81381287854.translation: I fell asleep at 6 in the morning.

sense_b9345965211463b44bd5d741301e0a89.text: No te duermas o no acabarás a tiempo.
sense_b9345965211463b44bd5d741301e0a89.translation: Don't slack off or you won't finish in time.

sense_b9345965211463b44bd5d741301e0a89.text: Por dormirse se perdió la clave para ganar el premio.
sense_b9345965211463b44bd5d741301e0a89.translation: He missed the clue to win the prize because he didn't stay on his toes.

sense_f9f8a82f3a16c869f75436552088726c.text: Sacaron al jugador herido del estadio en una camilla.
sense_f9f8a82f3a16c869f75436552088726c.translation: They took the injured player out of the stadium on a stretcher.

sense_f9f8a82f3a16c869f75436552088726c.text: Los paramédicos pusieron al herido en una camilla y lo metieron en la ambulancia.
sense_f9f8a82f3a16c869f75436552088726c.translation: The paramedics laid the wounded man on a stretcher and put him in the ambulance.

sense_0789599c02b6ca0130e97b58e02d24ff.text: Si vas a la tienda, necesito que compres pañales y fórmula para bebés.
sense_0789599c02b6ca0130e97b58e02d24ff.translation: If you're going to the store, I need you to buy diapers and baby formula.

sense_0789599c02b6ca0130e97b58e02d24ff.text: Juan compró pañales muy absorbentes para que el bebé pudiera dormir toda la noche.
sense_0789599c02b6ca0130e97b58e02d24ff.translation: Juan bought some very absorbent diapers so that the baby could sleep through the night.

sense_245305b4ca72b395131fcd43ce048b5d.text: Si los alimentos crían moho, deshágase de ellos inmediatamente.
sense_245305b4ca72b395131fcd43ce048b5d.translation: If food goes moldy, get rid of it straight away.

sense_245305b4ca72b395131fcd43ce048b5d.text: El hombre aullaba mientras sus manos y sus brazos empezaban a criar vello.
sense_245305b4ca72b395131fcd43ce048b5d.translation: The man howled as his hands and arms started to become hairy.

sense_9aef3d5784ee4b4c202738d673b67bd5.text: La comida maravillosa del restaurante se une a la decoración modernista lujosa.
sense_9aef3d5784ee4b4c202738d673b67bd5.translation: The restaurant's fantastic food is complemented by their luxurious modernist decor.

sense_9aef3d5784ee4b4c202738d673b67bd5.text: Ese tipo es un trabajador fantástico. En él se unen la confianza y la habilidad.
sense_9aef3d5784ee4b4c202738d673b67bd5.translation: That guy's a fantastic worker. He's the epitome of confidence and skill.

sense_b3c8ef1be2ce8a258fbc211ff006aae5.translation: Put your money away. It's my treat.
Have a drink. It's on us.

sense_9dba3b6fb6381db7801f023575d4b906.translation: I don't have anywhere to write this down.
Ready to take notes? Jot this down.

sense_d8b3caef230ef48962f7c5909521fdd5.text: Se apuntó un tanto cuando ganó la apuesta.
sense_d8b3caef230ef48962f7c5909521fdd5.translation: He chalked up a point when he won the bet.

sense_d8b3caef230ef48962f7c5909521fdd5.text: El equipo azul se apuntó una victoria en la primera prueba.
sense_d8b3caef230ef48962f7c5909521fdd5.translation: The blue team scored a win in the first heat.

sense_07859a43abd247b17d78eeb8a1dbc32b.text: Eramos el huerto para sembrar nuestras primeras semillas.
sense_07859a43abd247b17d78eeb8a1dbc32b.translation: We've laid out the beds in our vegetable garden to plant our first seeds.

sense_07859a43abd247b17d78eeb8a1dbc32b.text: Don Pedro ya eró el jardín para que pongamos las semillas de tomate.
sense_07859a43abd247b17d78eeb8a1dbc32b.translation: Don Pedro has already prepared the ground for us to sow the tomato seeds.

sense_928e119edfdfb80cc9154cedc4d03082.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_928e119edfdfb80cc9154cedc4d03082.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_928e119edfdfb80cc9154cedc4d03082.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_928e119edfdfb80cc9154cedc4d03082.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_5f1a458938eb4aac33a14a8d4d9b006b.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_5f1a458938eb4aac33a14a8d4d9b006b.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_5f1a458938eb4aac33a14a8d4d9b006b.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_5f1a458938eb4aac33a14a8d4d9b006b.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_cc0e7a1c04c2319398b782bf2b30f913.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_cc0e7a1c04c2319398b782bf2b30f913.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_cc0e7a1c04c2319398b782bf2b30f913.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_cc0e7a1c04c2319398b782bf2b30f913.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_79f12d828f9291897a774103b5bd7784.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_79f12d828f9291897a774103b5bd7784.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_79f12d828f9291897a774103b5bd7784.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_79f12d828f9291897a774103b5bd7784.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_b69bccf5a04017aead4e2a7390c70f62.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_b69bccf5a04017aead4e2a7390c70f62.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_b69bccf5a04017aead4e2a7390c70f62.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_b69bccf5a04017aead4e2a7390c70f62.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_b5a1e89724563675adb7807bb67b5281.text: Los vecinos se reunieron para disfrutar la matanza.
sense_b5a1e89724563675adb7807bb67b5281.translation: The neighbors got together to enjoy the pork products from the slaughter.

sense_b5a1e89724563675adb7807bb67b5281.text: Las mujeres prepararon los productos tradicionales con la matanza para la fiesta del pueblo.
sense_b5a1e89724563675adb7807bb67b5281.translation: The women prepared the traditional pork products for the village feast.

sense_c575defd3d511b14bdc5ecdd42499751.text: Armó un follón cuando compré una marca diferente de cereal.
sense_c575defd3d511b14bdc5ecdd42499751.translation: She kicked up a real fuss when I bought a different brand of cereal.

sense_c575defd3d511b14bdc5ecdd42499751.text: El comportamiento del cantante en el restaurante ha armado un gran escándalo.
sense_c575defd3d511b14bdc5ecdd42499751.translation: The behavior of the singer in the restaurant has caused a big scandal.

sense_dce2d9a8d29556bb6e2723007d0cf4c5.text: Se armó una discusión sobre quién iba a tomar la última galleta.
sense_dce2d9a8d29556bb6e2723007d0cf4c5.translation: An argument broke out over who was going to get the last cookie.

sense_dce2d9a8d29556bb6e2723007d0cf4c5.text: Ni te imaginas el lío que se armó cuando despidieron a nuestro jefe.
sense_dce2d9a8d29556bb6e2723007d0cf4c5.translation: You can't even imagine the chaos that went down when our boss was fired.

sense_50fc4f8a2c73c2966c59c0f4e926848d.text: Estoy muy interesado en el puesto de gerente.
sense_50fc4f8a2c73c2966c59c0f4e926848d.translation: I'm very interested in the managing position.

sense_50fc4f8a2c73c2966c59c0f4e926848d.text: Siempre estuve interesado en la historia de la Antigua Grecia.
sense_50fc4f8a2c73c2966c59c0f4e926848d.translation: I've always been interested in Ancient Greek history.

sense_00bed86d4de97d1c3ab70d98589d8ac6.text: El día del estreno de su nuevo coche, lo estrelló contra un árbol.
sense_00bed86d4de97d1c3ab70d98589d8ac6.translation: The day he drove his new car for the first time, he crashed it into a tree.

sense_00bed86d4de97d1c3ab70d98589d8ac6.text: ¡Me acabo de comprar este par de zapatos y ya voy de estreno!
sense_00bed86d4de97d1c3ab70d98589d8ac6.translation: I just bought this pair of shoes, and I'm already wearing them!

sense_36cf43594a5e7c59127b692f4685d015.translation: Is that a new car you're driving?

sense_9e7e0e48248a301005f7a490966c19b9.text: El del puesto de enfrente se ha estrenado a primera hora.
sense_9e7e0e48248a301005f7a490966c19b9.translation: The man in the stall opposite had his first customer first thing this morning.

sense_9e7e0e48248a301005f7a490966c19b9.text: Él lleva vendidos dos coches este mes; yo aún no me he estrenado.
sense_9e7e0e48248a301005f7a490966c19b9.translation: He's already sold two cars this month; I haven't got off the ground yet.

sense_0aed312af9520f31fd69f09d1033ce5c.text: Mi padre era víctima de una rara dolencia.
sense_0aed312af9520f31fd69f09d1033ce5c.translation: My father suffered from a rare illness.

sense_0aed312af9520f31fd69f09d1033ce5c.text: Falleció víctima de un accidente cerebrovascular.

sense_6bc85841dc3bd106756d1e86cb447773.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_6bc85841dc3bd106756d1e86cb447773.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_6bc85841dc3bd106756d1e86cb447773.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_6bc85841dc3bd106756d1e86cb447773.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_aedb30135dd97df927bdc28fec1faf4c.text: La peli era malísima; solo se salvaba el actor principal.
sense_aedb30135dd97df927bdc28fec1faf4c.translation: The film was really bad; the main actor was the only one who was ok.

sense_aedb30135dd97df927bdc28fec1faf4c.text: Los considero a todos unos vagos; no se salva nadie.
sense_aedb30135dd97df927bdc28fec1faf4c.translation: I consider them all lazy, without exception.

sense_19967bd0a0a0e58d91830351de2b63d6.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_19967bd0a0a0e58d91830351de2b63d6.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_19967bd0a0a0e58d91830351de2b63d6.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_19967bd0a0a0e58d91830351de2b63d6.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_d37940a06d0392b8e5ac9514b33183fa.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_d37940a06d0392b8e5ac9514b33183fa.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_d37940a06d0392b8e5ac9514b33183fa.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_d37940a06d0392b8e5ac9514b33183fa.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_18287da8a9ae7dc221d562204403e561.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_18287da8a9ae7dc221d562204403e561.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_2142ecc7620dae1f502fca7f5c36890a.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_2142ecc7620dae1f502fca7f5c36890a.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_0bce0c125ece9fe70e7ba3a636fd334b.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_0bce0c125ece9fe70e7ba3a636fd334b.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_0bce0c125ece9fe70e7ba3a636fd334b.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_0bce0c125ece9fe70e7ba3a636fd334b.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_9ea403e27fb0b2eb33cc81e9556cecca.text: Si crees que eso funcionará, eres más tronco de lo que pensaba.
sense_9ea403e27fb0b2eb33cc81e9556cecca.translation: If you think that will work, you're more of a bonehead than I thought.

sense_9ea403e27fb0b2eb33cc81e9556cecca.text: No seas tan tronca. Si no quiere a tus hijos, mándalo a volar.
sense_9ea403e27fb0b2eb33cc81e9556cecca.translation: Don't be so dense. If he doesn't like your kids, send him packing.

sense_facf217ce21b934ca4115c3e8cd393eb.text: A mi parecer, es un tema que no admite discusión.
sense_facf217ce21b934ca4115c3e8cd393eb.translation: In my opinion, there's no arguing on the subject.

sense_facf217ce21b934ca4115c3e8cd393eb.text: La fiesta de este año no admite comparación con ninguna otra.
sense_facf217ce21b934ca4115c3e8cd393eb.translation: This year's party defies comparison with any other.

sense_3344790b304fa65eff783a741e9d73a3.text: Me carga que siempre la escojan a ella.
sense_3344790b304fa65eff783a741e9d73a3.translation: It gets on my nerves that they always choose her.

sense_3344790b304fa65eff783a741e9d73a3.text: Me carga tener que aguantar la novia de mi hermano.
sense_3344790b304fa65eff783a741e9d73a3.translation: I can't stand having to put up with my brother's girlfriend.

sense_1e53d31ddc331b2a1a3777646689b098.text: Mis camisetas tiene mucha carga sentimental para mí.
sense_1e53d31ddc331b2a1a3777646689b098.translation: My T-shirts hold a lot of sentimental value for me.

sense_1e53d31ddc331b2a1a3777646689b098.text: Por su carga violenta, no podemos recomendar esta película a familias.
sense_1e53d31ddc331b2a1a3777646689b098.translation: Because of its violent content, we cannot recommend this movie for families.

sense_ef45e37d7011ce5fc97a4539f44273fb.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_ef45e37d7011ce5fc97a4539f44273fb.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_ef45e37d7011ce5fc97a4539f44273fb.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_ef45e37d7011ce5fc97a4539f44273fb.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_daed87198ed3c8d49c2d0aa16b4aec0a.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_daed87198ed3c8d49c2d0aa16b4aec0a.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_daed87198ed3c8d49c2d0aa16b4aec0a.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_daed87198ed3c8d49c2d0aa16b4aec0a.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_d351f783f17e3b0535e65fdcc7a77b69.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_cffba4b94dedc46328ffb0732472f480.text: Si estás pensando en tus merecidas vacaciones, mira nuestras ofertas para el verano.
sense_cffba4b94dedc46328ffb0732472f480.translation: If you're thinking about that well-deserved vacation, just take a look at our summer offers.

sense_cffba4b94dedc46328ffb0732472f480.text: Este monumento es un merecido homenaje a los soldados que dieron sus vidas para este país.
sense_cffba4b94dedc46328ffb0732472f480.translation: This monument is a well-deserved tribute to the soldiers who gave their lives for this country.

sense_f1f8ab20b68c1ec3d3c65cf46cee8a1e.text: ¿Así que Nico reprobó el examen? Se lo tiene bien merecido por vago.
sense_f1f8ab20b68c1ec3d3c65cf46cee8a1e.translation: So Nico failed the exam, did he? It serves him right for being so lazy.

sense_f1f8ab20b68c1ec3d3c65cf46cee8a1e.text: ¡Me quedé sin entradas para el recital! - Te lo tienes merecido, te dije que tenías que comprarlas rápido.
sense_f1f8ab20b68c1ec3d3c65cf46cee8a1e.translation: I couldn't get any tickets for the concert! - It serves you right; I told you you'd need to get a move on with buying them.

sense_20b35907f2c2aa6d2ebec9b9e31f578b.text: Nos han insultado, y les voy a dar su merecido.
sense_20b35907f2c2aa6d2ebec9b9e31f578b.translation: They've insulted us, and I'm going to give them what they deserve.

sense_20b35907f2c2aa6d2ebec9b9e31f578b.text: ¡No llores! Este chico recibirá su merecido por lo que te hizo.
sense_20b35907f2c2aa6d2ebec9b9e31f578b.translation: Don't cry! That boy will get what he deserves for what he did to you.

sense_68510bfa2299665065a134b29f921899.text: La familia del paciente difunto está demandando al hospital donde murió.
sense_68510bfa2299665065a134b29f921899.translation: The family of the deceased patient is suing the hospital where he died.

sense_68510bfa2299665065a134b29f921899.text: El artista hace figuras de músicos difuntos para adornar los altares de muertos.
sense_68510bfa2299665065a134b29f921899.translation: The artist makes figures of deceased musicians to decorate Day of the Dead altars.

sense_e1b0fbcc1a33f67a28934339a420ed01.text: La demora del vuelo se debe al huracán que está pasando por la costa.
sense_e1b0fbcc1a33f67a28934339a420ed01.translation: The flight delay is due to the hurricane passing through the coast.

sense_e1b0fbcc1a33f67a28934339a420ed01.text: Perdón por la demora; se me olvidaron las llaves y tuve que regresar por ellas.
sense_e1b0fbcc1a33f67a28934339a420ed01.translation: I'm sorry for the delay; I forgot my keys and had to go back for them.

sense_47e41f4aa5fe6059c0289f36e747bafc.text: Nuestra competencia nos lleva la delantera en el servicio de atención al cliente.
sense_47e41f4aa5fe6059c0289f36e747bafc.translation: Our competition has a lead over us in customer service.

sense_47e41f4aa5fe6059c0289f36e747bafc.text: El coche rojo nos llevaba un minuto de delantera, pero el conductor quiso adelantarlo.
sense_47e41f4aa5fe6059c0289f36e747bafc.translation: The red car was a minute ahead of us, but the driver wanted to overtake it.

sense_cf9d1385f8bd064d485b0d00e752bf43.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_cf9d1385f8bd064d485b0d00e752bf43.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_cf9d1385f8bd064d485b0d00e752bf43.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_cf9d1385f8bd064d485b0d00e752bf43.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_f57d1844f622da8f20933cd436cc0622.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_f57d1844f622da8f20933cd436cc0622.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_f57d1844f622da8f20933cd436cc0622.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_f57d1844f622da8f20933cd436cc0622.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_a41421ddec90fe12d6b28452b1e2ac4f.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_a41421ddec90fe12d6b28452b1e2ac4f.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_a41421ddec90fe12d6b28452b1e2ac4f.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_a41421ddec90fe12d6b28452b1e2ac4f.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_57ce7fc516455ade5054c8d57f93ad66.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_57ce7fc516455ade5054c8d57f93ad66.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_57ce7fc516455ade5054c8d57f93ad66.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_57ce7fc516455ade5054c8d57f93ad66.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_e23650a2cdcfdbf1e11330a4d0c58e5d.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_e23650a2cdcfdbf1e11330a4d0c58e5d.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_e23650a2cdcfdbf1e11330a4d0c58e5d.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_e23650a2cdcfdbf1e11330a4d0c58e5d.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_bf178cd462aa58bc53c507fb8b31d1cb.text: El pueblo andino no está bien comunicado. Solo se puede llegar a caballo.
sense_bf178cd462aa58bc53c507fb8b31d1cb.translation: The Andean town doesn't have good transport connections. The only way to get there is on horseback.

sense_bf178cd462aa58bc53c507fb8b31d1cb.text: No podría vivir en un pueblo tan remoto. Prefiero vivir en una ciudad que esté bien comunicada.
sense_bf178cd462aa58bc53c507fb8b31d1cb.translation: I couldn't live in a village that remote. I prefer living in a city that is well connected.

sense_eee393613fd61dd3651192b6ed4f292a.text: Verónica tenía puesto corpiño y calzón rojos.
sense_eee393613fd61dd3651192b6ed4f292a.translation: Veronica was wearing a red bra and panties.

sense_eee393613fd61dd3651192b6ed4f292a.text: Me voy al centro comercial; necesito comprar calzones y corpiños.
sense_eee393613fd61dd3651192b6ed4f292a.translation: I'm going to the mall; I need to buy panties and bras.

sense_644e932c5629f6ecfcfc6b8b3a721f45.text: Lavé mis calzones y faldas en la lavadora.
sense_644e932c5629f6ecfcfc6b8b3a721f45.translation: I washed my knickers and skirts in the washing machine.

sense_644e932c5629f6ecfcfc6b8b3a721f45.text: ¿De dónde salieron estos calzones, Manuel? ¡No son míos!
sense_644e932c5629f6ecfcfc6b8b3a721f45.translation: Where did these knickers come from, Manuel? They're not mine!

sense_9e40ee45132b55c7028a2efa03d14e7e.text: El coche está bien acondicionado para correr un rally.
sense_9e40ee45132b55c7028a2efa03d14e7e.translation: The car is in good condition to run a rally.

sense_9e40ee45132b55c7028a2efa03d14e7e.text: El refugio animal está mal acondicionado y no puede recibir más animales.
sense_9e40ee45132b55c7028a2efa03d14e7e.translation: The animal shelter is in bad condition and cannot take any more animals.

sense_3ea940bd25ec17d14f3652aae39b0166.text: El establecimiento está acondicionado para ser utilizado como salón de fiestas.
sense_3ea940bd25ec17d14f3652aae39b0166.translation: The establishment can be used as a dance hall.

sense_3ea940bd25ec17d14f3652aae39b0166.text: El apartamento está bien acondicionado con muebles, televisor plasma, refrigerador y lavadora.
sense_3ea940bd25ec17d14f3652aae39b0166.translation: The apartment is well-equipped with furniture, a plasma television, a fridge, and a washing machine.

sense_8735c792626ee3983b2dee0bddd2c1a8.text: El frío intenso en la cumbre le congeló dos dedos de la mano derecha.
sense_8735c792626ee3983b2dee0bddd2c1a8.translation: Two fingers on her right hand were frostbitten by the intense cold on the summit.

sense_8735c792626ee3983b2dee0bddd2c1a8.text: Se volvieron al campamento base para evitar que la bajada extrema de la temperatura les congelara las extremidades.
sense_8735c792626ee3983b2dee0bddd2c1a8.translation: They returned to base camp to avoid their extremities being affected by frostbite because of the sharp drop in temperature.

sense_5624a488c2038339aeacf535a1b22b1f.text: Este año se me juntaron todas las desgracias.
sense_5624a488c2038339aeacf535a1b22b1f.translation: This year it was just one bad thing after another.

sense_5624a488c2038339aeacf535a1b22b1f.text: Se juntó la tormenta con la explosión de gas.
sense_5624a488c2038339aeacf535a1b22b1f.translation: The storm came right on top of the gas explosion.

sense_94743c9734d0a87ae6283d316db5f59a.text: No le tire patadas a su hermano.
Su perro me tiró un mordisco.

sense_5d6e19fa780fbd41fb521387bfbc2ad2.text: Las fiestas ya no me tiran.
sense_5d6e19fa780fbd41fb521387bfbc2ad2.translation: Parties don't appeal to me anymore.
He is not interested in studying medicine.

sense_76414af83e0b0ab1a242b8c6f77455e3.text: El plato tiraba a dulce más que nada.
sense_76414af83e0b0ab1a242b8c6f77455e3.translation: The dish was more sweet than anything else.

sense_76414af83e0b0ab1a242b8c6f77455e3.text: Tienes que beberte el té cuando esté tirando a frío.
sense_76414af83e0b0ab1a242b8c6f77455e3.translation: You have to drink the tea when it is cooling down.

sense_84a29ab7e60e495da2be881b386b8efd.text: El bebé se tiró un eructo tras tomarse su biberón.
sense_84a29ab7e60e495da2be881b386b8efd.translation: The baby burped after having his bottle.

sense_84a29ab7e60e495da2be881b386b8efd.text: La primera vez que se tiró un pedo delante de su novio se avergonzó.
sense_84a29ab7e60e495da2be881b386b8efd.translation: The first time she farted in front of her boyfriend, she was embarrassed.

sense_54760b8c78369b9b237c113c905be68c.text: Te agarras a tu herida para evitar las tareas en casa.
sense_54760b8c78369b9b237c113c905be68c.translation: You use your injury to get out of chores around the house.

sense_54760b8c78369b9b237c113c905be68c.text: Se agarró a los deberes para no tener que lavar los platos.
sense_54760b8c78369b9b237c113c905be68c.translation: She used her homework as an excuse to not wash the dishes.

sense_0c5093169d2bec87e6f64d6f39a608bd.text: El detective se puso a maquinar una trampa para atrapar a su enemigo.
sense_0c5093169d2bec87e6f64d6f39a608bd.translation: The detective began to plot a set-up to catch his enemy.

sense_0c5093169d2bec87e6f64d6f39a608bd.text: Capturaron al ladrón, pero aún no encuentran a la persona que maquinó el asalto.
sense_0c5093169d2bec87e6f64d6f39a608bd.translation: The thief was captured, but the person who plotted the robbery hasn't been found.

sense_0ca82e47173cbb68dc04721120f6b4d8.text: Volverá a llover este fin de semana.
sense_0ca82e47173cbb68dc04721120f6b4d8.translation: It will rain again this weekend.
I have to clean everything again!

sense_5015146c7bcc188e22185bc011f471e9.text: En enero empieza el rodaje de la película.
sense_5015146c7bcc188e22185bc011f471e9.translation: The shooting of the movie starts in January.

sense_5015146c7bcc188e22185bc011f471e9.text: El rodaje de la película tuvo que ser pausado debido a problemas con el presupuesto.
sense_5015146c7bcc188e22185bc011f471e9.translation: The shooting of the movie had to be paused due to budget issues.

sense_b6851835c174da198d4525ecfa375996.text: Ana se sentía realizada con la práctica de actividades benéficas.
sense_b6851835c174da198d4525ecfa375996.translation: Ana felt fulfilled doing charity work.

sense_b6851835c174da198d4525ecfa375996.text: El plan de salud infantil fomenta la práctica del deporte.
sense_b6851835c174da198d4525ecfa375996.translation: The children's healthcare program promotes playing sports.

sense_ddcdcb08aa73e251c81cc5653f701253.text: Me provocan unas palomitas cuando voy al cine.
sense_ddcdcb08aa73e251c81cc5653f701253.translation: I feel like having some popcorn when I go to the movies.
Would you like something to eat?

sense_3d6c6e93c6238c7a5bb19cb32413c461.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_3d6c6e93c6238c7a5bb19cb32413c461.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_3d6c6e93c6238c7a5bb19cb32413c461.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_3d6c6e93c6238c7a5bb19cb32413c461.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_1453c8f024bbbac7ad12ffa4e29ebae1.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_1453c8f024bbbac7ad12ffa4e29ebae1.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_1453c8f024bbbac7ad12ffa4e29ebae1.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_1453c8f024bbbac7ad12ffa4e29ebae1.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_1b4dc1d7ac7adad3dd00679866fa6406.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_1b4dc1d7ac7adad3dd00679866fa6406.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_1b4dc1d7ac7adad3dd00679866fa6406.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_1b4dc1d7ac7adad3dd00679866fa6406.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_dd5e1cdfe13eb884165e83ac76a16642.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_dd5e1cdfe13eb884165e83ac76a16642.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_369e6dc62a07c8b3d21afd16cbefa3d7.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_369e6dc62a07c8b3d21afd16cbefa3d7.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_369e6dc62a07c8b3d21afd16cbefa3d7.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_369e6dc62a07c8b3d21afd16cbefa3d7.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_52656c624f560d24b542bfdd040f6bb5.text: Dicen que el alcalde recibió dinero de fuentes sospechosas.
sense_52656c624f560d24b542bfdd040f6bb5.translation: They say that the mayor received money from shady sources.

sense_52656c624f560d24b542bfdd040f6bb5.text: La víctima recibió un fuerte golpe al lado de la cabeza.
sense_52656c624f560d24b542bfdd040f6bb5.translation: The victim received a strong blow to the side of the head.

sense_11905b70e9664c6b7fe1bc4b783d4879.text: El equipo visitante fue recibido con silbidos y abucheos.
sense_11905b70e9664c6b7fe1bc4b783d4879.translation: The visiting team was received with whistles and jeers.

sense_11905b70e9664c6b7fe1bc4b783d4879.text: Nos recibió personalmente en el aeropuerto.
sense_11905b70e9664c6b7fe1bc4b783d4879.translation: He personally welcomed us at the airport.

sense_ba9984e97d1afdb82328665491bfd44f.text: Mi hermana se recibió de ingeniera en Georgia Tech.
sense_ba9984e97d1afdb82328665491bfd44f.translation: My sister graduated as an engineer from Georgia Tech.
How many students will graduate this year?

sense_2942768d6b10d377cc754abf5c06c121.text: El cartero trajo un recado para usted, señor.
sense_2942768d6b10d377cc754abf5c06c121.translation: The mailman brought a message for you, sir.

sense_2942768d6b10d377cc754abf5c06c121.text: Me temo que el Sr. González no se encuentra. ¿Quisiera dejarle algún recado?
sense_2942768d6b10d377cc754abf5c06c121.translation: I'm afraid Mr. Gonzalez isn't in. Would you like to leave him a message?

sense_51714328e22d627048d1cf31b071fcfa.text: Antonio dice que no se acuerda de ella.
sense_51714328e22d627048d1cf31b071fcfa.translation: Antonio says he doesn't remember her.

sense_51714328e22d627048d1cf31b071fcfa.text: Me acuerdo que la primera vez que vi "El imperio contraataca", lloré al final.
sense_51714328e22d627048d1cf31b071fcfa.translation: I remember that the first time I saw "The Empire Strikes Back", I cried at the end.

sense_baf26b8a7bd01fb4ed35c1edfe58a794.text: Hay que comprar una sartén nueva porque esta ya no sirve.
sense_baf26b8a7bd01fb4ed35c1edfe58a794.translation: We need to buy a new frying pan because this one is no good any more.
Is this one any good to you?

sense_4b39dd6fe17e44039c1a4c804318aef8.text: El prisionero escapó del calabozo mientras el guardia dormía.
sense_4b39dd6fe17e44039c1a4c804318aef8.translation: The prisoner escaped from the dungeon while the guard slept.

sense_4b39dd6fe17e44039c1a4c804318aef8.text: Encerraron a los traidores en el calabozo del castillo.
sense_4b39dd6fe17e44039c1a4c804318aef8.translation: The traitors were locked up in the castle dungeon.

sense_704c1b5d0ed4d8443dd8d011cfc5c2db.text: La revolución separó el partido en dos facciones.
sense_704c1b5d0ed4d8443dd8d011cfc5c2db.translation: The revolution separated the party into two factions.

sense_704c1b5d0ed4d8443dd8d011cfc5c2db.text: Separé la clase en grupos de cuatro alumnos cada uno.
sense_704c1b5d0ed4d8443dd8d011cfc5c2db.translation: I divided the class into groups of four students each.

sense_01a6ce5859b8a828794239d9b003ef7b.text: Un ala se separó del transbordador espacial al entrar la atmósfera de la tierra.
sense_01a6ce5859b8a828794239d9b003ef7b.translation: A wing came off the space shuttle upon entering the Earth's atmosphere.

sense_01a6ce5859b8a828794239d9b003ef7b.text: Durante una tormenta, una rama se separó del árbol y cayó encima de mi automóvil.
sense_01a6ce5859b8a828794239d9b003ef7b.translation: A branch of the tree was ripped off during a storm and landed on my car.

sense_10ec375ea367ed5abcceea2709f9933e.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_10ec375ea367ed5abcceea2709f9933e.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_10ec375ea367ed5abcceea2709f9933e.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_10ec375ea367ed5abcceea2709f9933e.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_896eadddf2b2e593d3d5e35d3d75022f.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_896eadddf2b2e593d3d5e35d3d75022f.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_896eadddf2b2e593d3d5e35d3d75022f.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_896eadddf2b2e593d3d5e35d3d75022f.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_801234a7b6e540cb5ca923db591583d8.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_801234a7b6e540cb5ca923db591583d8.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_c3e1c18f8832f42f85a2dedb617e4b65.text: Dolores no es muy buena administradora de su tiempo.
sense_c3e1c18f8832f42f85a2dedb617e4b65.translation: Dolores is not very good at managing her time.

sense_c3e1c18f8832f42f85a2dedb617e4b65.text: Mi padre es buen administrador y siempre hemos podido permitirnos ir de vacaciones en verano.
sense_c3e1c18f8832f42f85a2dedb617e4b65.translation: My father is really good with money and we've always been able to go away on summer vacation.

sense_32660bddba5bcd9951c4f7fe0dd0242d.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_32660bddba5bcd9951c4f7fe0dd0242d.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_23aac80bf38156cb3a88e45b0dcd4897.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_23aac80bf38156cb3a88e45b0dcd4897.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_00a6ce16febbc232641abdb488d43e7d.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_00a6ce16febbc232641abdb488d43e7d.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_00a6ce16febbc232641abdb488d43e7d.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_00a6ce16febbc232641abdb488d43e7d.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_5029f518eb440f97333d2106e9bb4415.text: La disciplina y el honor informan su naturaleza como soldado.
sense_5029f518eb440f97333d2106e9bb4415.translation: He is a soldier who believes in discipline and honor.
Her silhouette hints at her beauty.

sense_46d68fa74f5b1f3d6f74d65dc9d20b9a.text: La actuación de Manuel fue asombrosa, especialmente porque solo tuvo una semana de ensayo.
sense_46d68fa74f5b1f3d6f74d65dc9d20b9a.translation: Manuel's performance was amazing, especially after only one week's rehearsal.

sense_3eb8e5f299ae9b1d345fe253731e5258.text: Es un honor ser el aprendiz de un chef profesional.
sense_3eb8e5f299ae9b1d345fe253731e5258.translation: It's an honor to be apprenticed to a professional chef.

sense_3eb8e5f299ae9b1d345fe253731e5258.text: A los catorce años, Leonardo fue aprendiz de Verrocchio, uno de los artistas más exitosos de su época.
sense_3eb8e5f299ae9b1d345fe253731e5258.translation: At the age of fourteen, Leonardo was apprenticed to Verrocchio, one of the most successful artists of his day.

sense_e0aa29d7893c3718ada7f65a27fe5d9e.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_e0aa29d7893c3718ada7f65a27fe5d9e.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_e0aa29d7893c3718ada7f65a27fe5d9e.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_e0aa29d7893c3718ada7f65a27fe5d9e.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_503ac73b6f9ff6cfc7aeead18a39ca70.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_503ac73b6f9ff6cfc7aeead18a39ca70.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_503ac73b6f9ff6cfc7aeead18a39ca70.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_503ac73b6f9ff6cfc7aeead18a39ca70.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_fa62fd05f766019d076797070efe825e.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_fa62fd05f766019d076797070efe825e.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_fa62fd05f766019d076797070efe825e.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_fa62fd05f766019d076797070efe825e.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_9baa24afab3b825d723feb3cc030ac24.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_9baa24afab3b825d723feb3cc030ac24.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_9baa24afab3b825d723feb3cc030ac24.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_9baa24afab3b825d723feb3cc030ac24.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_c4c89dabf6702ddb356d29a1a38e09a3.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_c4c89dabf6702ddb356d29a1a38e09a3.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_c4c89dabf6702ddb356d29a1a38e09a3.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_c4c89dabf6702ddb356d29a1a38e09a3.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_f94cdc717f02663bfb97d05d8c8daf4f.text: Los pasajeros en tránsito deben permanecer en esta zona del aeropuerto.
sense_f94cdc717f02663bfb97d05d8c8daf4f.translation: Transit passengers must remain in this area of the airport.

sense_f94cdc717f02663bfb97d05d8c8daf4f.text: No podremos asistir a la función el sábado porque solo estamos de tránsito.
sense_f94cdc717f02663bfb97d05d8c8daf4f.translation: We won't be able to go to the show on Saturday because we're just passing through.

sense_70bfc23a20cba8ada5677202d06bbb99.text: Nos mudamos mañana y todavía no hemos empacado nada.
sense_70bfc23a20cba8ada5677202d06bbb99.translation: We move tomorrow, and we still haven't packed anything.

sense_70bfc23a20cba8ada5677202d06bbb99.text: El hotel donde nos vamos a quedar tiene piscina, así que no te olvides de empacar un vestido de baño.
sense_70bfc23a20cba8ada5677202d06bbb99.translation: The hotel we're staying in has a pool, so don't forget to pack a swimsuit.

sense_4c823f85a9a77aab6fd75a35bfc6e920.text: Según este árbol genealógico, Cervantes fue mi antepasado.
sense_4c823f85a9a77aab6fd75a35bfc6e920.translation: According to this family tree, Cervantes was my ancestor.

sense_4c823f85a9a77aab6fd75a35bfc6e920.text: Los antepasados de mi familia llegaron aquí en 1870.
sense_4c823f85a9a77aab6fd75a35bfc6e920.translation: My family's ancestors came here in 1870.

sense_9be9237bd06e97498d9ed81b6b4c3cc8.text: Tengo calor y estoy sudado, así que voy a tomar una ducha para refrescarme.
sense_9be9237bd06e97498d9ed81b6b4c3cc8.translation: I'm hot and sweaty, so I'm going to take a shower to cool down.

sense_9be9237bd06e97498d9ed81b6b4c3cc8.text: En verano, a Sara le gusta ir a la playa para poder refrescarse en el mar.
sense_9be9237bd06e97498d9ed81b6b4c3cc8.translation: In the summer, Sara likes to go to the beach so she can cool down in the ocean.

sense_f6149ef916b8c1d67ec5901c76fc8cec.text: Este pastel de chocolate está delicioso.

sense_ad55ec8ac60869e1c24ffbb77f58526f.text: No quiero que camines sola por la noche, ¿está?
sense_ad55ec8ac60869e1c24ffbb77f58526f.translation: I don't want you walking alone at night, understood?

sense_ad55ec8ac60869e1c24ffbb77f58526f.text: Nos encontraremos a las siete para ir al cine, ¿estamos?
sense_ad55ec8ac60869e1c24ffbb77f58526f.translation: We'll meet at seven to go to the movie, all right?

sense_a678bd0752c0d6d911f2b68314141815.text: Estoy sin comer desde temprano esta mañana.
sense_a678bd0752c0d6d911f2b68314141815.translation: I haven't eaten anything since early this morning.

sense_a678bd0752c0d6d911f2b68314141815.text: Tengo tres libros que están sin terminar.
sense_a678bd0752c0d6d911f2b68314141815.translation: I have three books that I still have to finish reading.

sense_296eca44ccf596b1871f8a963b9b29db.text: Estate atento porque solo llaman el número una vez.
sense_296eca44ccf596b1871f8a963b9b29db.translation: Pay attention because they only call out the number once.
Don't worry; I'll sort it out.

sense_0e26742250037cffd1e1162189383342.translation: I just want to make you happy.
What do you want for Christmas?

sense_a63fe755bcc70c514d9f04be3697634d.translation: "How can I help you?," asked the butler.
Would you like something to drink?

sense_a6602e7d25e801f170a492ff1e27339d.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_a6602e7d25e801f170a492ff1e27339d.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_a6602e7d25e801f170a492ff1e27339d.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_a6602e7d25e801f170a492ff1e27339d.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_c49cf3c613a720446811738cdbb03dac.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_c49cf3c613a720446811738cdbb03dac.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_1b59e18b5e6f3412c9419e5053ff9c34.text: Tengo a mi hijo con la voz tomada por una laringitis.
sense_1b59e18b5e6f3412c9419e5053ff9c34.translation: My son's lost his voice due to laryngitis.

sense_1b59e18b5e6f3412c9419e5053ff9c34.text: Tengo la voz tomada y no sé cómo voy a dar la presentación esta tarde.
sense_1b59e18b5e6f3412c9419e5053ff9c34.translation: I've lost my voice and don't know how I'm going to give the presentation this afternoon.

sense_9316e5aabee37a1433701d710c1156fa.text: La preparación de la boda significó un enorme esfuerzo.
sense_9316e5aabee37a1433701d710c1156fa.translation: Preparing for the wedding required a great deal of effort.

sense_9316e5aabee37a1433701d710c1156fa.text: Tomar este examen sin una preparación de al menos dos semanas es poco serio.
sense_9316e5aabee37a1433701d710c1156fa.translation: Administering this exam without giving us at least two weeks to study is unreasonable.

sense_1a0e58dcd2256c205e2a824f2edc85f5.text: La gente se dirigía al panteón para velar a sus seres queridos difuntos.
sense_1a0e58dcd2256c205e2a824f2edc85f5.translation: The crowd was headed toward the cemetery to keep vigil over their deceased loved ones.

sense_1a0e58dcd2256c205e2a824f2edc85f5.text: Rafael murió en la mañana, y por la tarde lo vamos a velar.
sense_1a0e58dcd2256c205e2a824f2edc85f5.translation: Rafael died this morning, and this afternoon we are going to keep vigil over him.

sense_ecc9672a25c88acc50e96daf884a21b9.text: Todo el mundo en la oficina respeta el entorno laboral.
sense_ecc9672a25c88acc50e96daf884a21b9.translation: Everybody in the office respects the work environment.

sense_ecc9672a25c88acc50e96daf884a21b9.text: Fuimos al desierto para ver las biznagas en su entorno natural.
sense_ecc9672a25c88acc50e96daf884a21b9.translation: We went to the desert to see bisnaga cacti in their natural environment.

sense_6e866d632a709b150f36cd08279169c9.text: Te agarras a tu herida para evitar las tareas en casa.
sense_6e866d632a709b150f36cd08279169c9.translation: You use your injury to get out of chores around the house.

sense_6e866d632a709b150f36cd08279169c9.text: Se agarró a los deberes para no tener que lavar los platos.
sense_6e866d632a709b150f36cd08279169c9.translation: She used her homework as an excuse to not wash the dishes.

sense_8b1125722532b2f8f46b84ad597573b9.text: Nuestro país registra una disminución histórica en deforestación.
sense_8b1125722532b2f8f46b84ad597573b9.translation: There has been a dramatic reduction in deforestation in our country.

sense_8b1125722532b2f8f46b84ad597573b9.text: El año pasado, el país registró un fuerte aumento de homicidios.
sense_8b1125722532b2f8f46b84ad597573b9.translation: There was a significant increase in the number of homicides last year.

sense_affc5bd9009d3966a382d2361fde0573.text: Afortunadamente no se registraron heridos en el choque.
sense_affc5bd9009d3966a382d2361fde0573.translation: Fortunately, no one was hurt in the accident.

sense_affc5bd9009d3966a382d2361fde0573.text: Debido a la fuerte lluvia de hoy, se registraron inundaciones por toda la región.
sense_affc5bd9009d3966a382d2361fde0573.translation: There was flooding throughout the region due to today's heavy rain.

sense_c58b30b92142afb9e1646ece3364ef9f.text: No hubo tiempo para saludar a todos en la fiesta.
sense_c58b30b92142afb9e1646ece3364ef9f.translation: There wasn't enough time to say hi to everyone at the party.

sense_e666f1aedce71cd3f6b7bc7e2947ce7f.text: No sé si habrá tiempo para comer algo.
sense_e666f1aedce71cd3f6b7bc7e2947ce7f.translation: I don't know if there will be enough time to eat something.
The earthquake occurred a long time ago.

sense_245f1973fde1b5aafcf9aca1cf55d368.text: El accidente habido ayer resultó en dos fatalidades.
sense_245f1973fde1b5aafcf9aca1cf55d368.translation: Yesterday's accident resulted in two fatalities.

sense_245f1973fde1b5aafcf9aca1cf55d368.text: El espectáculo habido esta semana está completamente vendido.
sense_245f1973fde1b5aafcf9aca1cf55d368.translation: This week's performance is totally sold out.

sense_55956df1ffc1be9399ecdf2de56e95da.text: Mi novio conectó de maravilla con mis padres.
sense_55956df1ffc1be9399ecdf2de56e95da.translation: My boyfriend really clicked with my parents.

sense_55956df1ffc1be9399ecdf2de56e95da.text: Federica conecta rápidamente con los niños; los hace reír en cuestión de minutos.
sense_55956df1ffc1be9399ecdf2de56e95da.translation: Federica is an instant hit with children; she has them laughing in a matter of minutes.

sense_1fffdc230669e3fab1d723418bc56342.text: Viaje con nosotros para conectar rápidamente con todas las ciudades europeas.
sense_1fffdc230669e3fab1d723418bc56342.translation: Travel with us to connect fast with all European cities.

sense_1fffdc230669e3fab1d723418bc56342.text: Compramos el billete equivocado; este vuelo no conecta con el de Bangkok.
sense_1fffdc230669e3fab1d723418bc56342.translation: We bought the wrong ticket; this flight doesn't connect with the Bangkok one.

sense_57e4886bfe3a49543adae2a224a3a665.text: El término jaque mate proviene del persa y significa "el rey está controlado".
sense_57e4886bfe3a49543adae2a224a3a665.translation: The term checkmate comes from Persian and means "the king is checked."

sense_57e4886bfe3a49543adae2a224a3a665.text: ¿De dónde proviene esta costumbre y en qué siglo se instauró en este país?
sense_57e4886bfe3a49543adae2a224a3a665.translation: Where does this custom come from and in what century was it established in this country?

sense_047b5c3404d2f13b90d7995dc5a01445.text: El error provino de una falta de información.
sense_047b5c3404d2f13b90d7995dc5a01445.translation: The mistake was the result of a lack of information.

sense_047b5c3404d2f13b90d7995dc5a01445.text: ¿De quién provino la iniciativa de llevar a cabo el proyecto?
sense_047b5c3404d2f13b90d7995dc5a01445.translation: Whose was the initiative to carry out the project?

sense_46932aad7a16067f745afc5474892b3b.text: Un arroyo brotaba de las rocas musgosas.
sense_46932aad7a16067f745afc5474892b3b.translation: A stream sprang from the mossy rocks.

sense_46932aad7a16067f745afc5474892b3b.text: Cuando era niño, solía venir a este arroyo con mi papá a pescar truchas.
sense_46932aad7a16067f745afc5474892b3b.translation: When I was a kid, I used to come to this stream with my dad to fish for trout.

sense_da69621b8a8d141820f7b5bb68e1ee5c.text: Mi novio conectó de maravilla con mis padres.
sense_da69621b8a8d141820f7b5bb68e1ee5c.translation: My boyfriend really clicked with my parents.

sense_da69621b8a8d141820f7b5bb68e1ee5c.text: Federica conecta rápidamente con los niños; los hace reír en cuestión de minutos.
sense_da69621b8a8d141820f7b5bb68e1ee5c.translation: Federica is an instant hit with children; she has them laughing in a matter of minutes.

sense_75b0bbe860f84845eedf240dcd42b4b6.text: Viaje con nosotros para conectar rápidamente con todas las ciudades europeas.
sense_75b0bbe860f84845eedf240dcd42b4b6.translation: Travel with us to connect fast with all European cities.

sense_75b0bbe860f84845eedf240dcd42b4b6.text: Compramos el billete equivocado; este vuelo no conecta con el de Bangkok.
sense_75b0bbe860f84845eedf240dcd42b4b6.translation: We bought the wrong ticket; this flight doesn't connect with the Bangkok one.

sense_8c0d26df8c731ddffd31aea0cd5a1769.text: Me ofrecieron su ayuda para el traslado.
sense_8c0d26df8c731ddffd31aea0cd5a1769.translation: They offered to help me with the move.

sense_8c0d26df8c731ddffd31aea0cd5a1769.text: Tengo confianza que me ofrecerán el trabajo.
sense_8c0d26df8c731ddffd31aea0cd5a1769.translation: I'm confident they'll offer me the job.

sense_e3b176b2ab1e13f21bf739e49ae09117.text: Estaba tan asustado después de ver al fantasma que no podía hablar.
sense_e3b176b2ab1e13f21bf739e49ae09117.translation: He was so scared after seeing the ghost that he couldn't speak.

sense_e3b176b2ab1e13f21bf739e49ae09117.text: ¿Por qué estás asustado? Es solo un gatito. No te va a hacer nada.
sense_e3b176b2ab1e13f21bf739e49ae09117.translation: Why are you scared? It's just a kitten. It's not going to hurt you.

sense_c5b9f4383c7fa18c956392d3afbcd6dd.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_c5b9f4383c7fa18c956392d3afbcd6dd.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_c5b9f4383c7fa18c956392d3afbcd6dd.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_c5b9f4383c7fa18c956392d3afbcd6dd.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_dea6b3922b6b270664a435c5388cd01f.text: Hay que tener en cuenta siempre nuestros camaradas ausentes.
sense_dea6b3922b6b270664a435c5388cd01f.translation: We must always remember our brothers-in-arms who are no longer with us.

sense_dea6b3922b6b270664a435c5388cd01f.text: Dijo que no era necesario tomar en cuenta a los ausentes.
sense_dea6b3922b6b270664a435c5388cd01f.translation: He said it wasn't necessary to consider those who were not present.

sense_bf47c56155e6f8a1ccf1a75a3e00f840.text: El tomate es original de América del Sur.
Contrariamente a lo que la gente cree, la pasta es original de Asia y no de Italia.
sense_bf47c56155e6f8a1ccf1a75a3e00f840.translation: Contrary to popular belief, pasta originally comes from Asia and not from Italy.

sense_d29ac9f5f77514df0e31485f0f235173.text: Eliza no tiene trato con Ben desde que rompieron.
sense_d29ac9f5f77514df0e31485f0f235173.translation: Eliza has had nothing to do with Ben since they broke up.

sense_d29ac9f5f77514df0e31485f0f235173.text: Rob tiene poco trato con sus compañeros de trabajo porque él está casado y ellos están solteros.
sense_d29ac9f5f77514df0e31485f0f235173.translation: Rob doesn't really interact with his coworkers because he's married and they're single.

sense_069e13d07b7356c1256ee645641ce336.text: Trabajó sin tregua en su tesis la semana antes de entregarlo.
sense_069e13d07b7356c1256ee645641ce336.translation: She worked tirelessly on her thesis the week before it was due.

sense_069e13d07b7356c1256ee645641ce336.text: Los soldados seguían luchando sin tregua en los últimos días de la guerra.
sense_069e13d07b7356c1256ee645641ce336.translation: The soldiers continued fighting relentlessly in the final days of the war.

sense_2a2131dd4fe80cdbd7935622f89b60cd.text: Los niños siempre están al cuidado de una empleada doméstica.
sense_2a2131dd4fe80cdbd7935622f89b60cd.translation: The children are always in a maid's care.

sense_2a2131dd4fe80cdbd7935622f89b60cd.text: Contratamos a un enfermero para estar al cuidado de mi suegro.
sense_2a2131dd4fe80cdbd7935622f89b60cd.translation: We hired a nurse to look after my father-in-law.

sense_5f5d5e6b641fb4fba6e3b5ed783f57ad.text: Me trae sin cuidado lo que digas.
sense_5f5d5e6b641fb4fba6e3b5ed783f57ad.translation: I don't care what you say.

sense_5f5d5e6b641fb4fba6e3b5ed783f57ad.text: Pierde cuidado: yo me ocupo de que llegue a tiempo.
sense_5f5d5e6b641fb4fba6e3b5ed783f57ad.translation: Don't worry! I will see to it that he arrives in time.

sense_79c7a8a39fc507c26e42cce9aeadb74f.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_79c7a8a39fc507c26e42cce9aeadb74f.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_79c7a8a39fc507c26e42cce9aeadb74f.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_79c7a8a39fc507c26e42cce9aeadb74f.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_2eb258efece3d340626158c78a85c51b.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_2eb258efece3d340626158c78a85c51b.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_2eb258efece3d340626158c78a85c51b.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_2eb258efece3d340626158c78a85c51b.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_b516eccad191b684e709b3cb9484dfa5.text: Me metieron un puro por fumar en el baño.
sense_b516eccad191b684e709b3cb9484dfa5.translation: They threw the book at me for smoking in the bathroom.

sense_b516eccad191b684e709b3cb9484dfa5.text: ¿No puedes usar el automóvil por seis meses? ¡Qué puro!
sense_b516eccad191b684e709b3cb9484dfa5.translation: You're not allowed to drive the car for six months? That sucks!

sense_91777a07bf5c633bc0281facc976a302.text: Esos policías perros nos pidieron una mordida.
sense_91777a07bf5c633bc0281facc976a302.translation: Those lowlife cops asked us for a bribe.

sense_91777a07bf5c633bc0281facc976a302.text: La compañera de Ricardo es bien perra; siempre lo pone en evidencia frente a la jefa.
sense_91777a07bf5c633bc0281facc976a302.translation: Ricardo's coworker is a piece of garbage; she always calls him out in front of their boss.

sense_94ba1ba03837e43a85f98cefecca86f9.text: Este año voy a correr la maratón.
sense_94ba1ba03837e43a85f98cefecca86f9.translation: I'm running the marathon this year.

sense_62a2b639f6648c0e806bfd2789c26576.text: El monstruo, vencido, se precipitó al abismo.
sense_62a2b639f6648c0e806bfd2789c26576.translation: The monster, vanquished, plunged into the abyss.

sense_62a2b639f6648c0e806bfd2789c26576.text: "En el fondo del abismo solo hay oscuridad," dijo el viejo monje.
sense_62a2b639f6648c0e806bfd2789c26576.translation: "At the bottom of the abyss there's only darkness," said the old monk.

sense_e1a26ba239e8f7a0a39d8986c35a6006.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_e1a26ba239e8f7a0a39d8986c35a6006.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_057b5ecf1ea584eb10cf413ad6c28370.text: Si quieres una entrada, ya sabes dónde conseguirla.
sense_057b5ecf1ea584eb10cf413ad6c28370.translation: If you want a ticket, you know where to get it.

sense_057b5ecf1ea584eb10cf413ad6c28370.text: Consiguió su licencia de conducir en junio.
sense_057b5ecf1ea584eb10cf413ad6c28370.translation: He got his driver's license in June.

sense_304958a96ca9b009b6d88bf60bc94476.text: Hay productos especiales para aislar de la humedad.
sense_304958a96ca9b009b6d88bf60bc94476.translation: There are special products for keeping the humidity out.

sense_304958a96ca9b009b6d88bf60bc94476.text: Tendremos que poner más aislamiento en el edificio para aislar mejor del frío.
sense_304958a96ca9b009b6d88bf60bc94476.translation: We'll have to add new insulation to the building to better insulate against the cold.

sense_c5ed2e5d8ff06a74d01a7068895b845e.text: Las danzas se presentarán en el pabellón principal de la feria.
sense_c5ed2e5d8ff06a74d01a7068895b845e.translation: The dance show will take place in the fair's main pavilion.

sense_c5ed2e5d8ff06a74d01a7068895b845e.text: En los días que llueva, las clases de yoga se llevarán a cabo en el pabellón cerca de la entrada del parque.
sense_c5ed2e5d8ff06a74d01a7068895b845e.translation: On rainy days, yoga classes will take place in the pavilion near the entrance of the park.

sense_bf0e557c6087a58849264987edad0ce2.translation: That restaurant is too far for me.

sense_bf0e557c6087a58849264987edad0ce2.text: Yo iré a la imprenta. Me pilla de camino a casa.
sense_bf0e557c6087a58849264987edad0ce2.translation: I'll go to the printer. It's on my way home.

sense_4e1dfb06df5bb6c5e84ac60b26c6a037.text: Disculpa, no te he visto trabajando allí. Me pondré los cascos.
sense_4e1dfb06df5bb6c5e84ac60b26c6a037.translation: I'm sorry, I didn't see you there working. I'll put headphones in.

sense_4e1dfb06df5bb6c5e84ac60b26c6a037.text: Disculpe, por favor. ¿Me dice dónde está la parada del metro?
sense_4e1dfb06df5bb6c5e84ac60b26c6a037.translation: Excuse me, please. Can you tell me where the subway station is?

sense_f706b34ca8d99f71bf37d7a55df6968a.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_f706b34ca8d99f71bf37d7a55df6968a.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_f706b34ca8d99f71bf37d7a55df6968a.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_f706b34ca8d99f71bf37d7a55df6968a.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_829a561b2dc9c745f24d154ca5e47f87.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_829a561b2dc9c745f24d154ca5e47f87.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_829a561b2dc9c745f24d154ca5e47f87.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_829a561b2dc9c745f24d154ca5e47f87.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_18e0a1ec630a8b37e5b93f189d9da98f.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_18e0a1ec630a8b37e5b93f189d9da98f.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_18e0a1ec630a8b37e5b93f189d9da98f.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_18e0a1ec630a8b37e5b93f189d9da98f.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_5b36be0e19d502fe87532f83198690e8.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
