sense_5b36be0e19d502fe87532f83198690e8.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_5b36be0e19d502fe87532f83198690e8.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_5b36be0e19d502fe87532f83198690e8.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_e0bd4414e6ae71c834c6a5b32a5f0999.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_e0bd4414e6ae71c834c6a5b32a5f0999.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_e0bd4414e6ae71c834c6a5b32a5f0999.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_e0bd4414e6ae71c834c6a5b32a5f0999.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_67cc2170170c4fbc31dd27544fb2fc72.text: El capitán dirigió el buque hacia el faro.
sense_67cc2170170c4fbc31dd27544fb2fc72.translation: The captain steered the ship toward the lighthouse.

sense_67cc2170170c4fbc31dd27544fb2fc72.text: Dirigió el coche con cuidado por el borde del acantilado.
sense_67cc2170170c4fbc31dd27544fb2fc72.translation: He steered the car carefully along the edge of the cliff.

sense_950479f04d5c6d0dcf6599920aed7944.text: La gente usaba máscaras coloridas en la fiesta de disfraces.
sense_950479f04d5c6d0dcf6599920aed7944.translation: People wore colorful masks at the costume party.

sense_950479f04d5c6d0dcf6599920aed7944.text: No pude ver las caras de los ladrones porque llevaban máscaras puestas.
sense_950479f04d5c6d0dcf6599920aed7944.translation: I wasn't able to see the burglars' faces because they were wearing masks.

sense_08c67ca315bc83321dd460ed17641940.text: Hoy no estoy muy católica; me duele mucho la cabeza.
sense_08c67ca315bc83321dd460ed17641940.translation: I'm feeling rather under the weather today; I have a terrible headache.

sense_08c67ca315bc83321dd460ed17641940.text: Creo que la gata no está muy católica. No quiere ronronear.
sense_08c67ca315bc83321dd460ed17641940.translation: I think the cat is a little out of sorts. She won't purr.

sense_0fbb200ebf18f85696a743c9518c3bfb.text: El sospechoso estaba fichado por una ofensa anterior.
sense_0fbb200ebf18f85696a743c9518c3bfb.translation: The suspect had a record for a previous offense.

sense_89df37e9ce71a7677926784a9e417166.text: Pablo ama a su esposa con todo su ser.
sense_89df37e9ce71a7677926784a9e417166.translation: Pablo loves his wife with all his heart.

sense_89df37e9ce71a7677926784a9e417166.text: Yo te amo, Ana, y quiero pasar el resto de mi vida contigo.
sense_89df37e9ce71a7677926784a9e417166.translation: I love you, Ana, and I want to spend the rest of my life with you.

sense_39d46fce5536e7ee0627a9af0d004240.text: La novia iba muy bien peinada.
sense_39d46fce5536e7ee0627a9af0d004240.translation: The bride had a very nice hairstyle.

sense_39d46fce5536e7ee0627a9af0d004240.text: A lo que ellos llaman ir a la moda, yo lo llamo ir mal peinado.
sense_39d46fce5536e7ee0627a9af0d004240.translation: What they call being fashionable I call going around with your hair in a mess.

sense_7cbe70752204a4fb0fcf11855f46efbb.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_7cbe70752204a4fb0fcf11855f46efbb.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_7cbe70752204a4fb0fcf11855f46efbb.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_7cbe70752204a4fb0fcf11855f46efbb.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_7e6c8480998a7020fa382b30541d7584.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_7e6c8480998a7020fa382b30541d7584.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_7e6c8480998a7020fa382b30541d7584.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_7e6c8480998a7020fa382b30541d7584.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_d263421a217a286874e808931418d17f.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_d263421a217a286874e808931418d17f.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_d263421a217a286874e808931418d17f.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_d263421a217a286874e808931418d17f.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_e9895e502be297fd2a7b098ff1c49ef7.text: Las temperaturas bajas amenazan con helar los cultivos.
sense_e9895e502be297fd2a7b098ff1c49ef7.translation: The low temperatures threaten to freeze the crops.

sense_e9895e502be297fd2a7b098ff1c49ef7.text: El viento helado heló las flores.
sense_e9895e502be297fd2a7b098ff1c49ef7.translation: The frigid wind froze the flowers.

sense_d411d7e32dde9c1f599d088ffed3ea93.text: María está muy abandonada desde que la despidieron del trabajo.
sense_d411d7e32dde9c1f599d088ffed3ea93.translation: Maria has let herself go since she was fired from her job.

sense_d411d7e32dde9c1f599d088ffed3ea93.text: Patricio es tan abandonado que ya ni siquiera me llama en mi cumpleaños.
sense_d411d7e32dde9c1f599d088ffed3ea93.translation: Patricio is so slack about things he doesn't even call me on my birthday anymore.

sense_a5976427fedb715ed3c8f43f7687c1a4.text: El profesor me ha concedido otra semana para terminar de escribir el ensayo.
sense_a5976427fedb715ed3c8f43f7687c1a4.translation: The teacher has given me another week to finish writing the essay.

sense_a5976427fedb715ed3c8f43f7687c1a4.text: El rey le concedió a mi familia el derecho de cultivar estas tierras.
sense_a5976427fedb715ed3c8f43f7687c1a4.translation: The king gave my family the right to farm these lands.

sense_bae8a2cec24b21f91ffcb047e67ebdc2.text: Me dieron una habitación exterior en el hotel.
sense_bae8a2cec24b21f91ffcb047e67ebdc2.translation: The hotel room I was given faced onto the street.
I'm looking for a room that faces on to the street.

sense_d9f17b2ad8790e28cff27238ae20c9ae.text: El estacionamiento de visitas está en el exterior de la privada.
sense_d9f17b2ad8790e28cff27238ae20c9ae.translation: Visitor parking is located outside of the private driveway.

sense_d9f17b2ad8790e28cff27238ae20c9ae.text: La mayoría de nuestros clientes están en el exterior del país.
sense_d9f17b2ad8790e28cff27238ae20c9ae.translation: Most of our clients are based outside the country.

sense_24854888b1293c9f3e8c881184203f70.text: La empresa abrirá sucursales en el exterior.
sense_24854888b1293c9f3e8c881184203f70.translation: The company is to open branches abroad.

sense_24854888b1293c9f3e8c881184203f70.text: Se enviará ayuda alimentaria al exterior.
sense_24854888b1293c9f3e8c881184203f70.translation: Food aid will be sent overseas.

sense_e349bbf27f4c03b8fd36cb7fd154c344.text: Necesitas una herramienta nueva para arreglar el estante.
sense_e349bbf27f4c03b8fd36cb7fd154c344.translation: You need a new tool to fix the shelf.

sense_e349bbf27f4c03b8fd36cb7fd154c344.text: Tiene hasta un taladro entre sus herramientas.
sense_e349bbf27f4c03b8fd36cb7fd154c344.translation: She even has a drill in her set of tools.

sense_0f6590045f095dc6ef91118be9ed3cbb.text: Este es un broche precioso. ¿Dónde lo compraste?
sense_0f6590045f095dc6ef91118be9ed3cbb.translation: This is a beautiful brooch. Where did you buy it?

sense_0f6590045f095dc6ef91118be9ed3cbb.text: La vista desde la peña está preciosa.
sense_0f6590045f095dc6ef91118be9ed3cbb.translation: The view from the cliff is beautiful.

sense_5590ad0cbc8d954cf4040b5fbe69eae1.text: No debemos extraer ninguna conclusión hasta conocer todos los hechos.
sense_5590ad0cbc8d954cf4040b5fbe69eae1.translation: We shouldn't draw any conclusions until we know all the facts.

sense_5590ad0cbc8d954cf4040b5fbe69eae1.text: Cuando di la vuelta al mundo, llegué a la conclusión de que es mejor viajar ligero de equipaje.
sense_5590ad0cbc8d954cf4040b5fbe69eae1.translation: When I went round the world, I came to the conclusion that it's best to travel light.

sense_3aeab3b112eded68c5b53b2b78d06d5f.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_3aeab3b112eded68c5b53b2b78d06d5f.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_3aeab3b112eded68c5b53b2b78d06d5f.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_3aeab3b112eded68c5b53b2b78d06d5f.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_244d68bc7d14345928f101aa20c77b07.text: For my sake, I hope you win today because I bet $10,000 on the game.
sense_244d68bc7d14345928f101aa20c77b07.translation: Por lo que más quieras, espero que ganes hoy porque aposté $10,000 en el partido.

sense_244d68bc7d14345928f101aa20c77b07.text: I hope you didn't bake a chocolate cake just for my sake, because I'm allergic to chocolate.
sense_244d68bc7d14345928f101aa20c77b07.translation: Espero que no hayas hecho un pastel de chocolate solo por mí, porque tengo alergia al chocolate.

sense_fba8fb7441ba72e677a2e1032e6526fe.text: Let's eliminate this last sentence for clarity's sake.
sense_fba8fb7441ba72e677a2e1032e6526fe.translation: Eliminemos esta última frase para mayor claridad.

sense_fba8fb7441ba72e677a2e1032e6526fe.text: For safety's sake, no one but me has access to these documents.
sense_fba8fb7441ba72e677a2e1032e6526fe.translation: Por razones de seguridad, solamente yo tengo acceso a estos documentos.

sense_fa369b31f6d0a49d738aa32dc79c4849.text: For God's sake! Stop complaining so much!
sense_fa369b31f6d0a49d738aa32dc79c4849.translation: ¡Por el amor de Dios! ¡No te quejes tanto!

sense_fa369b31f6d0a49d738aa32dc79c4849.text: For heaven's sake! Pay attention when I talk to you!
sense_fa369b31f6d0a49d738aa32dc79c4849.translation: ¡Por todos los cielos! ¡Pon atención cuando te estoy hablando!

sense_44405cae312e0fe42a303336ded218dc.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_44405cae312e0fe42a303336ded218dc.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_44405cae312e0fe42a303336ded218dc.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_44405cae312e0fe42a303336ded218dc.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_fbec45e119602513f1e841ad555dc44d.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_fbec45e119602513f1e841ad555dc44d.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_fbec45e119602513f1e841ad555dc44d.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_fbec45e119602513f1e841ad555dc44d.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_91a2dd289cf467747c3df6bbd5c659c2.text: Ese tío iba con un globo en la fiesta anoche.
sense_91a2dd289cf467747c3df6bbd5c659c2.translation: That guy was stoned at the party last night.

sense_91a2dd289cf467747c3df6bbd5c659c2.text: Te va a matar tu papá si te ve con ese globo.
sense_91a2dd289cf467747c3df6bbd5c659c2.translation: Your dad's going to kill you if he sees how high you are.

sense_5a09ed6f9e07811204bfd79e445c7318.text: Tuvimos que quedarnos en casa porque estaba cayendo un chaparrón.
sense_5a09ed6f9e07811204bfd79e445c7318.translation: We had to stay home because it was pouring rain.

sense_5a09ed6f9e07811204bfd79e445c7318.text: Está cayendo una buena nevada. Ponle las cadenas a las ruedas.
sense_5a09ed6f9e07811204bfd79e445c7318.translation: It's snowing hard. Put the chains on the tires.

sense_28c4e17a3eb92ce6536b385099e2e352.text: No bebo porque el alcohol me cae mal.
sense_28c4e17a3eb92ce6536b385099e2e352.translation: I don't drink because alcohol disagrees with me.
You look great in that dress!

sense_84012b820a0d432252bb4981fbb8d3bc.text: Me cae muy bien tu hermano; siempre me hace sonreír.
sense_84012b820a0d432252bb4981fbb8d3bc.translation: I really like your brother; he always makes me smile.

sense_84012b820a0d432252bb4981fbb8d3bc.text: Me marché porque me cae mal tu primo con sus bromas ofensivas.
sense_84012b820a0d432252bb4981fbb8d3bc.translation: I had to leave because I can't stand your cousin and his offensive jokes.

sense_aef83af27ee496cd7c5e6cc105e34ccc.text: Que Harvard la hubiera rechazado, le cayó mal.
sense_aef83af27ee496cd7c5e6cc105e34ccc.translation: She wasn't pleased that Harvard rejected her.

sense_aef83af27ee496cd7c5e6cc105e34ccc.text: El embarazo de mi hermana pequeña no cayó bien en la familia.
sense_aef83af27ee496cd7c5e6cc105e34ccc.translation: My little sister's pregnancy shocked the entire family.

sense_b1d3bd13614a7e3935152605beb340da.text: Mi bebé está llorando porque se cae de sueño.
sense_b1d3bd13614a7e3935152605beb340da.translation: My baby is crying because he's very sleepy.

sense_b1d3bd13614a7e3935152605beb340da.text: Me caigo de cansancio, pero tengo que estudiar para el examen de mañana.
sense_b1d3bd13614a7e3935152605beb340da.translation: I am really tired, but I have to study for tomorrow's exam.

sense_2c33528d49c22f7c5ea4f8c5e4da1996.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_2c33528d49c22f7c5ea4f8c5e4da1996.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_2c33528d49c22f7c5ea4f8c5e4da1996.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_2c33528d49c22f7c5ea4f8c5e4da1996.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_7517fc12b0d70ba65028ea9ebc3dc11e.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_7517fc12b0d70ba65028ea9ebc3dc11e.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_7517fc12b0d70ba65028ea9ebc3dc11e.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_7517fc12b0d70ba65028ea9ebc3dc11e.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_a6a852405d8525cd14a4ca68fb9a5845.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_a6a852405d8525cd14a4ca68fb9a5845.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_a6a852405d8525cd14a4ca68fb9a5845.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_a6a852405d8525cd14a4ca68fb9a5845.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_745065715d59634e26f86198e6bc6ef3.text: Ten cuidado, Scott. No quieres lesionarte antes del partido.
sense_745065715d59634e26f86198e6bc6ef3.translation: Be careful, Scott. You don't want to injure yourself before the game.

sense_0f05c1b07f6a75bb0f1f99ed4d6c2275.text: Si los alimentos crían moho, deshágase de ellos inmediatamente.
sense_0f05c1b07f6a75bb0f1f99ed4d6c2275.translation: If food goes moldy, get rid of it straight away.

sense_0f05c1b07f6a75bb0f1f99ed4d6c2275.text: El hombre aullaba mientras sus manos y sus brazos empezaban a criar vello.
sense_0f05c1b07f6a75bb0f1f99ed4d6c2275.translation: The man howled as his hands and arms started to become hairy.

sense_369b65ea547b2db976f1bd8f237c08fd.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_369b65ea547b2db976f1bd8f237c08fd.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_369b65ea547b2db976f1bd8f237c08fd.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_369b65ea547b2db976f1bd8f237c08fd.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_f4fd41435c7f84e102b0d5ec98190f2a.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_f4fd41435c7f84e102b0d5ec98190f2a.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_968dc0edca6a134132871d008faca61f.translation: I don't have anywhere to write this down.
Ready to take notes? Jot this down.

sense_0312855d2bca398132df612327ef0af0.text: Se apuntó un tanto cuando ganó la apuesta.
sense_0312855d2bca398132df612327ef0af0.translation: He chalked up a point when he won the bet.

sense_0312855d2bca398132df612327ef0af0.text: El equipo azul se apuntó una victoria en la primera prueba.
sense_0312855d2bca398132df612327ef0af0.translation: The blue team scored a win in the first heat.

sense_5cf07551b3c7f7c1a6ed15921bbc389c.text: Soy optimista que la fiesta va a ser un gran éxito.
sense_5cf07551b3c7f7c1a6ed15921bbc389c.translation: I'm optimistic that the party will be a big success.

sense_5cf07551b3c7f7c1a6ed15921bbc389c.text: Se dice que la nueva escuela no estará lista para abrirse este año, pero me mantengo optimista.
sense_5cf07551b3c7f7c1a6ed15921bbc389c.translation: They say the new school won't be ready to open this year, but I remain optimistic.

sense_8550195df7d03c518abfd89bfb797716.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
sense_8550195df7d03c518abfd89bfb797716.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

sense_8550195df7d03c518abfd89bfb797716.text: No me sentó bien tu actitud. Un poco de respeto, por favor.
sense_8550195df7d03c518abfd89bfb797716.translation: I don't appreciate your attitude. Show a little respect, please.

sense_40d61ea3fc377cc2c68da417877a6168.text: Todavía existen los casamientos por conveniencia.
El casamiento de los Reyes Católicos cementó la unión entre Castilla y Aragón.
sense_40d61ea3fc377cc2c68da417877a6168.translation: The marriage of the Catholic Monarchs cemented the union between Castile and Aragon.

sense_336e7d5577112905eeb97028a23ef14d.text: La chica estaba vendiendo naranjas en el mercado.
sense_336e7d5577112905eeb97028a23ef14d.translation: The girl was selling oranges in the market.

sense_00d6ea87b2b2da265fb9e724640b3b2d.text: Las gallinas picaron el pan que les tiré.
sense_00d6ea87b2b2da265fb9e724640b3b2d.translation: The hens pecked at the bread I threw them.

sense_00d6ea87b2b2da265fb9e724640b3b2d.text: Los patos picaban peces en el río.
sense_00d6ea87b2b2da265fb9e724640b3b2d.translation: Ducks were pecking at fish in the river.

sense_f089b9cc2f775c9f19834c50557701cc.text: Antonio dice que no se acuerda de ella.
sense_f089b9cc2f775c9f19834c50557701cc.translation: Antonio says he doesn't remember her.

sense_f089b9cc2f775c9f19834c50557701cc.text: Me acuerdo que la primera vez que vi "El imperio contraataca", lloré al final.
sense_f089b9cc2f775c9f19834c50557701cc.translation: I remember that the first time I saw "The Empire Strikes Back", I cried at the end.

sense_e305e4e0a2317ea3f4c3bdf9820465c3.text: De acuerdo, le avisaré cuando estemos sobrevolando la ciudad. Cambio y corto.
sense_e305e4e0a2317ea3f4c3bdf9820465c3.translation: Ok, I'll let you know when we're flying over the city. Over and out.

sense_e305e4e0a2317ea3f4c3bdf9820465c3.text: ¿Nos puede indicar su posición? Cambio. - Sí, estamos a cinco millas de la costa en dirección este. Cambio.
sense_e305e4e0a2317ea3f4c3bdf9820465c3.translation: Can you give us your position? Over. - Yes, we are five miles east of the coast. Over.

sense_5d6d8889ddb226a221b790fc4ccb4a85.text: Pablo ama a su esposa con todo su ser.
sense_5d6d8889ddb226a221b790fc4ccb4a85.translation: Pablo loves his wife with all his heart.

sense_5d6d8889ddb226a221b790fc4ccb4a85.text: Yo te amo, Ana, y quiero pasar el resto de mi vida contigo.
sense_5d6d8889ddb226a221b790fc4ccb4a85.translation: I love you, Ana, and I want to spend the rest of my life with you.

sense_7331235e972ee6c69b8eac13f8d9641f.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_7331235e972ee6c69b8eac13f8d9641f.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_7331235e972ee6c69b8eac13f8d9641f.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_7331235e972ee6c69b8eac13f8d9641f.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_2d260ebfc702ab23c2770f8c460fd84e.text: Son las siete de la mañana.
sense_2d260ebfc702ab23c2770f8c460fd84e.translation: It is seven in the morning.
It was night when they arrived.

sense_2bdc19a9ddce9f9b4e2d373caa2720a7.text: El lobo soplaba con todas sus fuerzas, pero la casa ni se movía.
sense_2bdc19a9ddce9f9b4e2d373caa2720a7.translation: The wolf blew with all his strength, but the house wouldn't move.

sense_2bdc19a9ddce9f9b4e2d373caa2720a7.text: Fabiola vigilaba a los niños mientras estos jugaban y soplaban burbujas de jabón en el área de juegos.
sense_2bdc19a9ddce9f9b4e2d373caa2720a7.translation: Fabiola kept an eye on the children as they were playing and blowing soap bubbles in the playground.

sense_8ae9a2002f28fa0d9f3b243e02060de1.text: Estoy mirando un documental sobre Nelson Mandela.
sense_8ae9a2002f28fa0d9f3b243e02060de1.translation: I'm watching a documentary about Nelson Mandela.

sense_8ae9a2002f28fa0d9f3b243e02060de1.text: Este cineasta ganó un Óscar por su documental acerca de la guerra de Secesión americana.
sense_8ae9a2002f28fa0d9f3b243e02060de1.translation: This filmmaker won an Oscar for his documentary about the American Civil War.

sense_f4997289a48a374e8cc2ed0bdcbc84a6.text: Fue una falta de consideración de su parte irse sin avisar.
sense_f4997289a48a374e8cc2ed0bdcbc84a6.translation: It was desconsiderate of her to leave without giving notice.

sense_f4997289a48a374e8cc2ed0bdcbc84a6.text: El personal del aeropuerto tuvo gran consideración con los familiares de las víctimas
sense_f4997289a48a374e8cc2ed0bdcbc84a6.translation: The airport staff were very considerate to the victims' relatives.

sense_cf3bcc22a17f0149678d19ff8ddd5c24.text: Me ofrecieron su ayuda para el traslado.
sense_cf3bcc22a17f0149678d19ff8ddd5c24.translation: They offered to help me with the move.

sense_cf3bcc22a17f0149678d19ff8ddd5c24.text: Tengo confianza que me ofrecerán el trabajo.
sense_cf3bcc22a17f0149678d19ff8ddd5c24.translation: I'm confident they'll offer me the job.

sense_c52d2f3f92b3271e03a5d47e210b8f20.text: Ese actor no es de mal ver, pero a mí no me gusta.
sense_c52d2f3f92b3271e03a5d47e210b8f20.translation: That actor isn't bad-looking, but I don't find him attractive.

sense_c52d2f3f92b3271e03a5d47e210b8f20.text: ¿Cómo es tu prima? - Es inteligente, trabajadora, y además tiene buen ver.
sense_c52d2f3f92b3271e03a5d47e210b8f20.translation: What's your cousin like? - She's smart, hardworking, and she's also good-looking.

sense_9eea6c963f048c758d2fdc025150506e.text: Tenemos planeado ir a la playa en agosto.
sense_9eea6c963f048c758d2fdc025150506e.translation: We're planning to go to the beach in August.

sense_9eea6c963f048c758d2fdc025150506e.text: Estamos planeando una fiesta de sorpresa para su cumpleaños.
sense_9eea6c963f048c758d2fdc025150506e.translation: We're planning a surprise party for her birthday.

sense_f789d838ba50cf8fcb483a3fbfd019bc.text: Llegamos al pueblo justo antes del anochecer.
sense_f789d838ba50cf8fcb483a3fbfd019bc.translation: We arrived at the town just before dusk.

sense_f789d838ba50cf8fcb483a3fbfd019bc.text: El cielo siempre se ve hermoso por aquí al anochecer.
sense_f789d838ba50cf8fcb483a3fbfd019bc.translation: The sky always looks beautiful around here at dusk.

sense_b445b616f482e9fbb7ebccfd8cfeb391.text: En el verano puedes ver luciérnagas cuando anochece.
sense_b445b616f482e9fbb7ebccfd8cfeb391.translation: You can see lightning bugs in the summer when the sun goes down.
Bats come out when night falls.

sense_b097d415738cc90b22471f8b462e4087.translation: Night fell as we were on our way home.

sense_b097d415738cc90b22471f8b462e4087.text: Es un viaje de dos días y tenemos planeado anochecer en Hermosillo.
sense_b097d415738cc90b22471f8b462e4087.translation: It's a two day trip and we plan to make it to Hermosillo by nightfall.

sense_4a85d1a1463664caf2670a2138a77b8a.text: Me encantó el libro pero el final no me convenció.
sense_4a85d1a1463664caf2670a2138a77b8a.translation: I loved the book, but the ending wasn't very good.

sense_4a85d1a1463664caf2670a2138a77b8a.text: Decidieron eliminar los camarones del menú porque no parecía convencer a los clientes.
sense_4a85d1a1463664caf2670a2138a77b8a.translation: They decided to remove shrimp from the menu because customers didn't seem to like them.

sense_4d2836dad6327c4fd92a1a967415954c.text: Las autoridades enfrentaron al sospechoso tan pronto como lo encontraron.
sense_4d2836dad6327c4fd92a1a967415954c.translation: The authorities confronted the suspect as soon as they found him.

sense_4d2836dad6327c4fd92a1a967415954c.text: Tienes que enfrentar tus miedos si quieres avanzar en la vida.
sense_4d2836dad6327c4fd92a1a967415954c.translation: You have to confront your fears if you want to advance in life.

sense_b3746cb4379edfe2a1409e36d8c5ace1.text: La tormenta se está acercando; mejor apretemos.
sense_b3746cb4379edfe2a1409e36d8c5ace1.translation: The storm is coming; we'd better run.

sense_b3746cb4379edfe2a1409e36d8c5ace1.text: Cuando la alarma de incendios empezó a sonar, todos apretaron hacia la salida.
sense_b3746cb4379edfe2a1409e36d8c5ace1.translation: When the fire alarm began to sound, everybody made a dash for the exit.

sense_f8cef40e953add71b3efddf67fb117ec.text: Este año voy a correr la maratón.
sense_f8cef40e953add71b3efddf67fb117ec.translation: I'm running the marathon this year.

sense_096e098ea9b41f2ae74904d90b12457e.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_096e098ea9b41f2ae74904d90b12457e.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_096e098ea9b41f2ae74904d90b12457e.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_096e098ea9b41f2ae74904d90b12457e.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_7a43a08c47821790f1a127416a248d71.text: En estos momentos la grúa está retirando el vehículo accidentado de la carretera.
sense_7a43a08c47821790f1a127416a248d71.translation: Right now the tow truck is removing the damaged vehicle from the roadway.

sense_a0128dc7b28027b40b1ffefb6a35783d.text: La empresa retiró los autobuses más antiguos.
sense_a0128dc7b28027b40b1ffefb6a35783d.translation: The company withdrew the oldest buses.

sense_a0128dc7b28027b40b1ffefb6a35783d.text: Retiraron los billetes falsos de la circulación.
sense_a0128dc7b28027b40b1ffefb6a35783d.translation: The counterfeit notes were withdrawn from circulation.

sense_b29b6a1d7988624330181118a916e7ce.text: Mi marido nunca me retiró la confianza.
sense_b29b6a1d7988624330181118a916e7ce.translation: My husband never lost confidence in me.

sense_b29b6a1d7988624330181118a916e7ce.text: El partido le retiró la confianza al presidente cuando malversó fondos.
sense_b29b6a1d7988624330181118a916e7ce.translation: The president lost the party's confidence when he misappropriated funds.

sense_fb078d957159c53075cdef2c76ff063e.text: El recepcionista me pidió que no me retirara.
sense_fb078d957159c53075cdef2c76ff063e.translation: The receptionist asked me to hold the line.

sense_6b3b007130eac961b81671b1f6d20ccb.text: El retorno de los libros se puede hacer hasta las 7 pm.
sense_6b3b007130eac961b81671b1f6d20ccb.translation: Books can be returned up till 7 pm.

sense_6b3b007130eac961b81671b1f6d20ccb.text: Puedes hacer el retorno de la mercancía dentro de los siguientes 15 días.
sense_6b3b007130eac961b81671b1f6d20ccb.translation: You can return goods within 15 days of purchase.

sense_e274ee56ddaa521e6bb23ed972974cd3.text: No me gusta que me mangonee una mocosa malcriada.
sense_e274ee56ddaa521e6bb23ed972974cd3.translation: I don't like to be bossed around by a spoiled madam.

sense_822a0b52eab7982afff0492878c132f3.text: ¿Cómo dejas que esa mocosa te hable así?
sense_822a0b52eab7982afff0492878c132f3.translation: How can you let that chit of a girl talk to you like that?

sense_711b2977e994856d430c9086e81924d1.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_711b2977e994856d430c9086e81924d1.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_711b2977e994856d430c9086e81924d1.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_711b2977e994856d430c9086e81924d1.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_69189da9d39d6d24dfe45c7803b22c8d.text: El rodaje sufrió un paro forzado debido al mal tiempo.
sense_69189da9d39d6d24dfe45c7803b22c8d.translation: They were forced to suspend filming due to bad weather.

sense_69189da9d39d6d24dfe45c7803b22c8d.text: El aeropuerto se vio forzado a cerrar ayer debido a la tormenta.
sense_69189da9d39d6d24dfe45c7803b22c8d.translation: The airport was forced to close yesterday because of the storm.

sense_267867b73567918d2f0da155c8c01ae0.text: Nos hicimos con este restaurante en régimen de traspaso.
sense_267867b73567918d2f0da155c8c01ae0.translation: We got the transfer of the lease of this restaurant as an ongoing concern.

sense_267867b73567918d2f0da155c8c01ae0.text: Los clientes del hotel que estén en régimen de media pensión pueden escoger entre el almuerzo o la cena.
sense_267867b73567918d2f0da155c8c01ae0.translation: Hotel guests who have purchased the breakfast-plus-one meal package may choose between lunch or dinner.

sense_d846508be530b6812fb83045a6f4e688.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_d846508be530b6812fb83045a6f4e688.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_b60d480a04383377fbde9fb7eedb0f4b.text: Pablo ama a su esposa con todo su ser.
sense_b60d480a04383377fbde9fb7eedb0f4b.translation: Pablo loves his wife with all his heart.

sense_b60d480a04383377fbde9fb7eedb0f4b.text: Yo te amo, Ana, y quiero pasar el resto de mi vida contigo.
sense_b60d480a04383377fbde9fb7eedb0f4b.translation: I love you, Ana, and I want to spend the rest of my life with you.

sense_b6cd0c6a909bd9047f47916f6ecf455d.text: El pronóstico dice que caerá una helada esta noche.
sense_b6cd0c6a909bd9047f47916f6ecf455d.translation: According to the forecast, there will be a frost tonight.

sense_b6cd0c6a909bd9047f47916f6ecf455d.text: Tenemos que meter las plantas adentro de la casa antes de la primera helada.
sense_b6cd0c6a909bd9047f47916f6ecf455d.translation: We need to take the plants inside before the first frost.

sense_28180eed1ac97715d1df4efcf3011277.text: Las temperaturas bajas amenazan con helar los cultivos.
sense_28180eed1ac97715d1df4efcf3011277.translation: The low temperatures threaten to freeze the crops.

sense_28180eed1ac97715d1df4efcf3011277.text: El viento helado heló las flores.
sense_28180eed1ac97715d1df4efcf3011277.translation: The frigid wind froze the flowers.

sense_d601dfe78fb1bb6435b6606e30e5be00.text: Juan Rulfo es su escritor favorito.
sense_d601dfe78fb1bb6435b6606e30e5be00.translation: Juan Rulfo is his favorite writer.

sense_d601dfe78fb1bb6435b6606e30e5be00.text: El escritor está trabajando en su octavo libro acerca de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.
sense_d601dfe78fb1bb6435b6606e30e5be00.translation: The writer is working on his eighth book about World War II.

sense_843fbe5dbb6b4b01b233829f317b63e7.text: Si has dejado de fumar al menos un poco ya es un mérito.
sense_843fbe5dbb6b4b01b233829f317b63e7.translation: It's commendable that you've at least gone some way toward cutting down on smoking.

sense_843fbe5dbb6b4b01b233829f317b63e7.text: El actor hizo muchos méritos en su última película para conseguir el prestigioso galardón.
sense_843fbe5dbb6b4b01b233829f317b63e7.translation: The actor did a lot in his last movie that helped him achieve this prestigious award.

sense_11b3701540dfeb032a032af8e156b83f.text: Me ofrecieron su ayuda para el traslado.
sense_11b3701540dfeb032a032af8e156b83f.translation: They offered to help me with the move.

sense_11b3701540dfeb032a032af8e156b83f.text: Tengo confianza que me ofrecerán el trabajo.
sense_11b3701540dfeb032a032af8e156b83f.translation: I'm confident they'll offer me the job.

sense_631e6b5b38b962b764dd25e52f8a0b1a.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_631e6b5b38b962b764dd25e52f8a0b1a.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_631e6b5b38b962b764dd25e52f8a0b1a.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_631e6b5b38b962b764dd25e52f8a0b1a.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_a38c3058138960b87b039b76020e461f.text: La disciplina y el honor informan su naturaleza como soldado.
sense_a38c3058138960b87b039b76020e461f.translation: He is a soldier who believes in discipline and honor.
Her silhouette hints at her beauty.

sense_7f09ff7bc9953d1dde68772e311a7fa8.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_7f09ff7bc9953d1dde68772e311a7fa8.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_7f09ff7bc9953d1dde68772e311a7fa8.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_7f09ff7bc9953d1dde68772e311a7fa8.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_ff3ad5d6aa6eef4b5c42242259b5bb03.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_ff3ad5d6aa6eef4b5c42242259b5bb03.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_ff3ad5d6aa6eef4b5c42242259b5bb03.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_ff3ad5d6aa6eef4b5c42242259b5bb03.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_8a5048ce0d3acfc99d20f4ec675f32f7.text: Tu hija siempre está atenta en clase.
sense_8a5048ce0d3acfc99d20f4ec675f32f7.translation: Your daughter is always attentive in class.

sense_8a5048ce0d3acfc99d20f4ec675f32f7.text: Nuestro perro se pone muy atento cuando pasa el cartero.
sense_8a5048ce0d3acfc99d20f4ec675f32f7.translation: Our dog becomes very attentive when the letter carrier comes by.

sense_13e6d4f426cc15c5c1365284c24b8382.text: Cuatro presos huyeron de la cárcel el domingo por la tarde.
sense_13e6d4f426cc15c5c1365284c24b8382.translation: Four inmates escaped from the prison on Sunday afternoon.

sense_13e6d4f426cc15c5c1365284c24b8382.text: El hada trató de huir, pero el brujo la agarró por las alas.
sense_13e6d4f426cc15c5c1365284c24b8382.translation: The fairy tried to escape, but the wizard grabbed her by the wings.

sense_b8052b17675aee6b544f17d00c0e8f8f.text: No le tire patadas a su hermano.
Su perro me tiró un mordisco.

sense_9e2b8bf350eee8cc56fee4e6a6b1e57a.text: Las fiestas ya no me tiran.
sense_9e2b8bf350eee8cc56fee4e6a6b1e57a.translation: Parties don't appeal to me anymore.
He is not interested in studying medicine.

sense_1355d7c824ff582ed586b18345c7ff4d.text: El plato tiraba a dulce más que nada.
sense_1355d7c824ff582ed586b18345c7ff4d.translation: The dish was more sweet than anything else.

sense_1355d7c824ff582ed586b18345c7ff4d.text: Tienes que beberte el té cuando esté tirando a frío.
sense_1355d7c824ff582ed586b18345c7ff4d.translation: You have to drink the tea when it is cooling down.

sense_346fbabd1104682b322c7647a5da2a64.text: El bebé se tiró un eructo tras tomarse su biberón.
sense_346fbabd1104682b322c7647a5da2a64.translation: The baby burped after having his bottle.

sense_346fbabd1104682b322c7647a5da2a64.text: La primera vez que se tiró un pedo delante de su novio se avergonzó.
sense_346fbabd1104682b322c7647a5da2a64.translation: The first time she farted in front of her boyfriend, she was embarrassed.

sense_a51faa0c8a0c29fef0834aca9bf947b0.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_a51faa0c8a0c29fef0834aca9bf947b0.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_a51faa0c8a0c29fef0834aca9bf947b0.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_a51faa0c8a0c29fef0834aca9bf947b0.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_7a5014d0447f1312163c09a301df65d0.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_7a5014d0447f1312163c09a301df65d0.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_b6cbc568dfde48817b58fbfc6fa196e0.text: No es infrecuente tener hongos en los pies si vas mucho a la piscina.
sense_b6cbc568dfde48817b58fbfc6fa196e0.translation: It's not uncommon to get athlete's foot if you go to the pool a lot.

sense_b6cbc568dfde48817b58fbfc6fa196e0.text: Lo más eficaz para los hongos de los pies es seguir un tratamiento simultáneamente oral y tópico.
sense_b6cbc568dfde48817b58fbfc6fa196e0.translation: The most effective treatment for athlete's foot is a simultaneous oral and topical treatment.

sense_891fa45fa83c17ed864255c2585a93da.text: Las autoridades enfrentaron al sospechoso tan pronto como lo encontraron.
sense_891fa45fa83c17ed864255c2585a93da.translation: The authorities confronted the suspect as soon as they found him.

sense_891fa45fa83c17ed864255c2585a93da.text: Tienes que enfrentar tus miedos si quieres avanzar en la vida.
sense_891fa45fa83c17ed864255c2585a93da.translation: You have to confront your fears if you want to advance in life.

sense_157b7e4ba096426b4627a9edf634067b.text: Cuéntame más de las aventuras de Blancanieves y los siete enanitos.
sense_157b7e4ba096426b4627a9edf634067b.translation: Tell me more of the adventures of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
How did it go? Tell me everything!

sense_f23228a67039a47420dffdbc93362d0a.text: Quiero reunir a toda la familia para celebrar Navidad juntos.
sense_f23228a67039a47420dffdbc93362d0a.translation: I want to gather the whole family to celebrate Christmas together.

sense_f23228a67039a47420dffdbc93362d0a.text: Mi papá nos reunió alrededor de la fogata para relatarnos cuentos.
sense_f23228a67039a47420dffdbc93362d0a.translation: Dad gathered us around the campfire to tell us stories.

sense_0937236210073211247d19f6cc818f4d.text: El cuerpo humano está formado por millones de células.
sense_0937236210073211247d19f6cc818f4d.translation: The human body is made up of millions of cells.

sense_0937236210073211247d19f6cc818f4d.text: El núcleo de la célula contiene su ácido desoxirribonucleico.
sense_0937236210073211247d19f6cc818f4d.translation: The nucleus of the cell contains its deoxyribonucleic acid.

sense_9830df6b9de0ec67edabe42b3b11a34b.text: Te agarras a tu herida para evitar las tareas en casa.
sense_9830df6b9de0ec67edabe42b3b11a34b.translation: You use your injury to get out of chores around the house.

sense_9830df6b9de0ec67edabe42b3b11a34b.text: Se agarró a los deberes para no tener que lavar los platos.
sense_9830df6b9de0ec67edabe42b3b11a34b.translation: She used her homework as an excuse to not wash the dishes.

sense_9ba2d32b3a3d98340ba3982614a6317a.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
sense_9ba2d32b3a3d98340ba3982614a6317a.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

sense_9ba2d32b3a3d98340ba3982614a6317a.text: No me da pena porque él mismo se la buscó.
sense_9ba2d32b3a3d98340ba3982614a6317a.translation: I don't feel sorry for him because he was asking for it.

sense_822492816f423a4da64ec604c21c54ca.text: Eché un vistazo a mi alrededor para divisar mi paradero.
sense_822492816f423a4da64ec604c21c54ca.translation: I looked around me to work out my whereabouts.

sense_822492816f423a4da64ec604c21c54ca.text: Mira a tu alrededor; este es uno de los lugares más bonitos de la Tierra.
sense_822492816f423a4da64ec604c21c54ca.translation: Look around you; this is one of the most beautiful places on earth.

sense_3e65970cb8f5a17f51d4503d35623c3b.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_3e65970cb8f5a17f51d4503d35623c3b.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_3e65970cb8f5a17f51d4503d35623c3b.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_3e65970cb8f5a17f51d4503d35623c3b.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_27bb9eb3297a5ef54267cb99f938f04c.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_27bb9eb3297a5ef54267cb99f938f04c.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_27bb9eb3297a5ef54267cb99f938f04c.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_27bb9eb3297a5ef54267cb99f938f04c.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_6c74bcda86fb839078c3a0d018af81a1.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_6c74bcda86fb839078c3a0d018af81a1.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_3f112ff85bdee87b6de1661f2042ac05.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_3f112ff85bdee87b6de1661f2042ac05.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_3f112ff85bdee87b6de1661f2042ac05.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_3f112ff85bdee87b6de1661f2042ac05.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_22ff5d6a3ef449588e6a1f1b02f02f57.text: Lucía se cayó y tiene una fractura en la muñeca.
sense_22ff5d6a3ef449588e6a1f1b02f02f57.translation: Lucia fell down and broke her wrist.

sense_22ff5d6a3ef449588e6a1f1b02f02f57.text: Lorenzo sufrió una fractura del cráneo tras caer de su caballo.
sense_22ff5d6a3ef449588e6a1f1b02f02f57.translation: Lorenzo fractured his skull when he fell off his horse.

sense_61a492741a95819475ff9ce5e94a7330.text: Conociéndolo mejor, veo que es buena persona.
sense_61a492741a95819475ff9ce5e94a7330.translation: Getting to know him better, I can see he's a good person.

sense_61a492741a95819475ff9ce5e94a7330.text: Cuando llegamos a Madrid, salimos a caminar para conocer la ciudad.
sense_61a492741a95819475ff9ce5e94a7330.translation: When we got to Madrid, we went out to walk around and get to know the city.

sense_903dc53facab0b2336e83de7b38de4ba.text: No conozco Nueva Zelanda, pero me encantaría ir.
sense_903dc53facab0b2336e83de7b38de4ba.translation: I've never been to New Zealand, but I'd love to go.
Have you ever been to London?

sense_4566f6c96e9b4c5d68107d8497c30581.text: En la junta discutiremos cómo reducir los gastos generales.
sense_4566f6c96e9b4c5d68107d8497c30581.translation: In the meeting, we'll discuss how to reduce our overhead costs.

sense_4566f6c96e9b4c5d68107d8497c30581.text: Puedes seguir unos pasos sencillos para reducir tus impuestos federales.
sense_4566f6c96e9b4c5d68107d8497c30581.translation: You can take simple steps to reduce your federal taxes.

sense_773fff086979dff890f353a3492c3086.text: Hay que reducir la marcha en estas curvas.
sense_773fff086979dff890f353a3492c3086.translation: You need to downshift on these bends.

sense_773fff086979dff890f353a3492c3086.text: Reduce la marcha antes del semáforo.

sense_5778ad6bb1bfd5f1977f2f2ec9dae7cd.text: La peli era malísima; solo se salvaba el actor principal.
sense_5778ad6bb1bfd5f1977f2f2ec9dae7cd.translation: The film was really bad; the main actor was the only one who was ok.

sense_5778ad6bb1bfd5f1977f2f2ec9dae7cd.text: Los considero a todos unos vagos; no se salva nadie.
sense_5778ad6bb1bfd5f1977f2f2ec9dae7cd.translation: I consider them all lazy, without exception.

sense_d9edc399126e74ee67d4a7695a58fc58.translation: I don't have anywhere to write this down.
Ready to take notes? Jot this down.

sense_345cb5feea20c178b9158f69e27d302e.text: Se apuntó un tanto cuando ganó la apuesta.
sense_345cb5feea20c178b9158f69e27d302e.translation: He chalked up a point when he won the bet.

sense_345cb5feea20c178b9158f69e27d302e.text: El equipo azul se apuntó una victoria en la primera prueba.
sense_345cb5feea20c178b9158f69e27d302e.translation: The blue team scored a win in the first heat.

sense_a1815dafa90a3b8bd2dc90b22b4b3f4c.text: La mandíbula hizo al paleontólogo sospechar que el fósil era de un Neandertal.
sense_a1815dafa90a3b8bd2dc90b22b4b3f4c.translation: The jaw made the paleontologist think the fossil was from a Neanderthal.

sense_a1815dafa90a3b8bd2dc90b22b4b3f4c.text: Mi hijo quedó impresionado con el tamaño de la mandíbula del tiburón que vimos en el acuario.
sense_a1815dafa90a3b8bd2dc90b22b4b3f4c.translation: My son was impressed by the size of the shark jaw we saw at the aquarium.

sense_a55b7e4b870bb41b01b899855b6809e5.text: Te agarras a tu herida para evitar las tareas en casa.
sense_a55b7e4b870bb41b01b899855b6809e5.translation: You use your injury to get out of chores around the house.

sense_a55b7e4b870bb41b01b899855b6809e5.text: Se agarró a los deberes para no tener que lavar los platos.
sense_a55b7e4b870bb41b01b899855b6809e5.translation: She used her homework as an excuse to not wash the dishes.

sense_2063e774dae03ec9c21932e37916cf36.text: Esta mala noticia hace un flaco favor a la Bolsa.
sense_2063e774dae03ec9c21932e37916cf36.translation: This bad news does the Stock Market no favors.

sense_2063e774dae03ec9c21932e37916cf36.text: Hizo un flaco servicio a su familia comprando esas tierras.
sense_2063e774dae03ec9c21932e37916cf36.translation: He did a disservice to his family by buying that land.

sense_d87e666adfdd431f78072762b2509dce.text: Le prometí que iría, pero ahora me arrepiento.
sense_d87e666adfdd431f78072762b2509dce.translation: I promised I'd go, but now I regret it.

sense_d87e666adfdd431f78072762b2509dce.text: No me arrepiento por haberme comido todo el pastel; ¡estuvo riquísimo!
sense_d87e666adfdd431f78072762b2509dce.translation: I don't regret eating the whole cake; it was delicious!

sense_68ea944d6569de106bf1f79ff04726d2.text: El perro se vino sin ser llamado.
sense_68ea944d6569de106bf1f79ff04726d2.translation: The dog came without being called.

sense_68ea944d6569de106bf1f79ff04726d2.text: Se vino una tormenta mientras nadábamos en la playa.
sense_68ea944d6569de106bf1f79ff04726d2.translation: A storm came upon us when we were swimming at the beach.

sense_a7c354ec36cce7c39cee6367aae66807.text: A nosotros nos vino una gripe terrible.
Me viene sueño en el trabajo después de almorzar.
sense_a7c354ec36cce7c39cee6367aae66807.translation: I get drowsy at work after having lunch.

sense_474a6cadd5d3e168eebdfd7d5a14dc72.text: Ahora viene la escena que me gusta.
sense_474a6cadd5d3e168eebdfd7d5a14dc72.translation: The scene I like is coming up.
The best is yet to come.

sense_31c5b0ad5151d1b86679597c1ed0c18a.text: La semana que viene estaré trabajando desde casa.
sense_31c5b0ad5151d1b86679597c1ed0c18a.translation: I'll be working from home next week.

sense_31c5b0ad5151d1b86679597c1ed0c18a.text: El año que viene visitaremos Japón.
sense_31c5b0ad5151d1b86679597c1ed0c18a.translation: Next year we're traveling to Japan.

sense_7f1ab25845e8fba95f56619fff8a747b.text: Estas botas me vendrán bien cuando haya mucha nieve.
sense_7f1ab25845e8fba95f56619fff8a747b.translation: These boots will come in handy when it's very snowy.

sense_7f1ab25845e8fba95f56619fff8a747b.text: Unas largas vacaciones ahora me vendrían bien.
sense_7f1ab25845e8fba95f56619fff8a747b.translation: A long vacation now would do me nicely.

sense_6a750cbc42c354fe432735cbb4d9587c.text: ¿Vino el mensajero a por el contrato?
sense_6a750cbc42c354fe432735cbb4d9587c.translation: Has the messenger been to pick up the contract?
We're here to collect the dog.

sense_4a363813866b475e571841a4afafc0c9.text: Los bailarines movían las caderas con la música.
sense_4a363813866b475e571841a4afafc0c9.translation: The dancers moved their hips to the music.

sense_4a363813866b475e571841a4afafc0c9.text: La señora Paz se cayó y se rompió la cadera tratando de poner un foco.
sense_4a363813866b475e571841a4afafc0c9.translation: Mrs. Paz fell and broke her hip trying to replace a light bulb.

sense_40ea10506e5511337824acd039116298.text: Me ofrecieron su ayuda para el traslado.
sense_40ea10506e5511337824acd039116298.translation: They offered to help me with the move.

sense_40ea10506e5511337824acd039116298.text: Tengo confianza que me ofrecerán el trabajo.
sense_40ea10506e5511337824acd039116298.translation: I'm confident they'll offer me the job.

sense_b36e777fc3e4a80d91bd38bd9ab90620.text: Sueño con tener una casa grande y mucho dinero.
sense_b36e777fc3e4a80d91bd38bd9ab90620.translation: I dream of having a big house and lots of money.

sense_b36e777fc3e4a80d91bd38bd9ab90620.text: Ella soñó con el actor famoso.
sense_b36e777fc3e4a80d91bd38bd9ab90620.translation: She dreamed about the famous actor.

sense_520fe457dad3593d27a8cb0007e4d63d.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_520fe457dad3593d27a8cb0007e4d63d.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_520fe457dad3593d27a8cb0007e4d63d.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_520fe457dad3593d27a8cb0007e4d63d.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_96391646de30f16ee4d683e0035da5ca.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_96391646de30f16ee4d683e0035da5ca.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_231ad86b2380d1d5efa95452eca8a1ea.text: Los bailarines movían las caderas con la música.
sense_231ad86b2380d1d5efa95452eca8a1ea.translation: The dancers moved their hips to the music.

sense_231ad86b2380d1d5efa95452eca8a1ea.text: La señora Paz se cayó y se rompió la cadera tratando de poner un foco.
sense_231ad86b2380d1d5efa95452eca8a1ea.translation: Mrs. Paz fell and broke her hip trying to replace a light bulb.

sense_86e31ad5e93b688fa62e61d9ef418b03.text: Desde que atracaron a Margarita, siempre carga gas pimienta.
sense_86e31ad5e93b688fa62e61d9ef418b03.translation: Ever since Margarita was robbed, she always carries pepper spray.

sense_86e31ad5e93b688fa62e61d9ef418b03.text: Guido está preso porque atracó una joyería.
sense_86e31ad5e93b688fa62e61d9ef418b03.translation: Guido is in jail because he robbed a jewelry store.

sense_b533489bd2b38e175843d5d37ce390c0.text: Jorge cumplió su sueño de convertirse en médico.
sense_b533489bd2b38e175843d5d37ce390c0.translation: Jorge achieved his dream of becoming a doctor.

sense_b533489bd2b38e175843d5d37ce390c0.text: Hay que tener fuerza de voluntad para cumplir tus metas.
sense_b533489bd2b38e175843d5d37ce390c0.translation: You need willpower to achieve your goals.

sense_e99fcccd071df211a5d40f4c4df17073.text: Sus continuas quejas terminaron pudriendo a su esposa.
sense_e99fcccd071df211a5d40f4c4df17073.translation: His wife finally became fed up with his endless complaints.
I'm fed up with his stupidity.

sense_c592c007052be4f4073e2d44701f5825.text: Si vienes conmigo a esa reunión, vas a pudrirte.
sense_c592c007052be4f4073e2d44701f5825.translation: If you come with me to that meeting, you are going to die of boredom.

sense_c592c007052be4f4073e2d44701f5825.text: Dejó a la novia porque se pudrió de sus demandas continuas.
sense_c592c007052be4f4073e2d44701f5825.translation: He left his girlfriend because he got sick and tired of her constant demands.

sense_b78248655c81f72bb17db29b838e6b68.translation: I don't want to see you again. Go to hell!
If you ask me, she can go to hell.

sense_6fbb81018df315b1e356a33a4a7f7bc6.text: La estrella se cubrió el rostro con una bufanda.
sense_6fbb81018df315b1e356a33a4a7f7bc6.translation: The star covered her face with a scarf.

sense_6fbb81018df315b1e356a33a4a7f7bc6.text: Ese bebé tiene el rostro como un querubín de Botticelli.
sense_6fbb81018df315b1e356a33a4a7f7bc6.translation: That baby has a face like a Botticelli cherub.

sense_8a33cbb73330cc499bfeae5df17b36e7.text: El gobierno se equivocó con esta medida.
sense_8a33cbb73330cc499bfeae5df17b36e7.translation: The government got it wrong with this policy.

sense_8a33cbb73330cc499bfeae5df17b36e7.text: La empresa reconoce que se equivocó con su respuesta.
sense_8a33cbb73330cc499bfeae5df17b36e7.translation: The company recognizes that it got its response wrong.

sense_dc70a3a2bba70a559177a54bebbbf79e.text: Mi madre se equivocó de tren y, por consiguiente, no llegó aquí hasta la una de la madrugada.
sense_dc70a3a2bba70a559177a54bebbbf79e.translation: My mother got on the wrong train and, as a result, she didn't get here till one in the morning.

sense_dc70a3a2bba70a559177a54bebbbf79e.text: Te equivocaste de mes. El cumpleaños de Fernando es el dos de julio y no el dos de junio.
sense_dc70a3a2bba70a559177a54bebbbf79e.translation: You got the month wrong. Fernando's birthday is the second of July not the second of June.

sense_cf0acf4f1828a90f0b136e4c9b815a65.text: Hay un nido en una de las ramas de ese árbol.
sense_cf0acf4f1828a90f0b136e4c9b815a65.translation: There is a nest in one of the branches of that tree.

sense_cf0acf4f1828a90f0b136e4c9b815a65.text: Un pájaro se posó sobre una rama del olivar y empezó a cantar.
sense_cf0acf4f1828a90f0b136e4c9b815a65.translation: A bird perched on a branch of the olive tree and began to sing.

sense_c143728c3126600011ec72c523bda737.text: Se fue sin explicación y me partió el corazón.
sense_c143728c3126600011ec72c523bda737.translation: She left without explanation and broke my heart.

sense_c143728c3126600011ec72c523bda737.text: Le dijeron que si no pagaba la deuda, le iban a partir las piernas.
sense_c143728c3126600011ec72c523bda737.translation: They told him that if he didn't pay the debt, they were going to break his legs.

sense_ed44126af67c4c7e6d20e88a2ddc9366.text: Pablo ama a su esposa con todo su ser.
sense_ed44126af67c4c7e6d20e88a2ddc9366.translation: Pablo loves his wife with all his heart.

sense_ed44126af67c4c7e6d20e88a2ddc9366.text: Yo te amo, Ana, y quiero pasar el resto de mi vida contigo.
sense_ed44126af67c4c7e6d20e88a2ddc9366.translation: I love you, Ana, and I want to spend the rest of my life with you.

sense_37d8a67030d657024983b937fec178db.text: Saquen sus cuadernos y tomen notas.
sense_37d8a67030d657024983b937fec178db.translation: Take out your notebooks and take notes.

sense_37d8a67030d657024983b937fec178db.text: Lo que voy a explicar a continuación viene en el examen, así que abran sus cuadernos y tomen notas.
sense_37d8a67030d657024983b937fec178db.translation: What I'm about to explain will be on the test, so open your notebooks and take notes.

sense_631d1f6996b52e48792c920b3ba6b3f7.text: Los profesores opinan muy bien de ti.

sense_631d1f6996b52e48792c920b3ba6b3f7.translation: I am of the same opinion.

sense_5d2a98510e2f8417867dcfa6f5417729.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_5d2a98510e2f8417867dcfa6f5417729.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_bb55f5b35a778d2d4fa711dc41dca61e.text: La langosta se escondió bajo unas rocas.
sense_bb55f5b35a778d2d4fa711dc41dca61e.translation: The lobster hid under some rocks.

sense_bb55f5b35a778d2d4fa711dc41dca61e.text: Sé que es gracioso, pero cuando era niño tenía una langosta de mascota.
sense_bb55f5b35a778d2d4fa711dc41dca61e.translation: I know it's funny, but when I was little I kept a lobster as a pet.

sense_34b81883a0574171b05301ff2ba504eb.text: Se encontró rodeada por taxis en Times Square.
sense_34b81883a0574171b05301ff2ba504eb.translation: She found herself surrounded by taxis in Time Square.

sense_34b81883a0574171b05301ff2ba504eb.text: Se asustó al ver que estaba rodeado de tiburones.
sense_34b81883a0574171b05301ff2ba504eb.translation: He was startled to see that he was surrounded by sharks.

sense_b38857ba18f10fb96d45d76ae41d811b.text: Tengo que comer algo. Me muero de hambre.
sense_b38857ba18f10fb96d45d76ae41d811b.translation: I need to eat something. I'm starving.

sense_b38857ba18f10fb96d45d76ae41d811b.text: Siempre nos morimos de risa con él.
sense_b38857ba18f10fb96d45d76ae41d811b.translation: We always laugh our heads off with him.

sense_41abab9c23c001a8ba82680c9c586bee.text: El levante del viernes me persigue porque quiere otra cita.
sense_41abab9c23c001a8ba82680c9c586bee.translation: The guy I picked up on Friday keeps chasing me for another date.

sense_41abab9c23c001a8ba82680c9c586bee.text: Tienes que decirle a ese levante tuyo que se vaya.
sense_41abab9c23c001a8ba82680c9c586bee.translation: You need to tell that guy you picked up to get out.

sense_6d8660ce213fbe9fce3fb1a0c5f77cf8.text: La tormenta se está acercando; mejor apretemos.
sense_6d8660ce213fbe9fce3fb1a0c5f77cf8.translation: The storm is coming; we'd better run.

sense_6d8660ce213fbe9fce3fb1a0c5f77cf8.text: Cuando la alarma de incendios empezó a sonar, todos apretaron hacia la salida.
sense_6d8660ce213fbe9fce3fb1a0c5f77cf8.translation: When the fire alarm began to sound, everybody made a dash for the exit.

sense_35cd67bd60538a950f8c8aa586e0f425.text: Los oficiales brindaron por el general que los llevó a la victoria.
sense_35cd67bd60538a950f8c8aa586e0f425.translation: The officers toasted to the general that took them to victory.

sense_35cd67bd60538a950f8c8aa586e0f425.text: Después del discurso del padrino de boda, los invitados brindaron por los recién casados.
sense_35cd67bd60538a950f8c8aa586e0f425.translation: After the best man's speech, the guests toasted to the newlyweds.

sense_27908f63a9a1dd105cf7f020095268e0.text: Yo tengo muy buena memoria para las caras.
sense_27908f63a9a1dd105cf7f020095268e0.translation: I have a very good memory for faces.

sense_27908f63a9a1dd105cf7f020095268e0.text: Con la edad, cada vez me falla más la memoria.
sense_27908f63a9a1dd105cf7f020095268e0.translation: With age, my memory is failing me more and more.

sense_b4d196e94aa36f25f673812584d7283b.text: Miguel me flechó cuando me dijo que quería casarse conmigo.
sense_b4d196e94aa36f25f673812584d7283b.translation: Miguel swept me off my feet when he told me he wanted to marry me.

sense_b4d196e94aa36f25f673812584d7283b.text: Raúl quedó flechado por Rosita desde que un amigo común los presentó.
sense_b4d196e94aa36f25f673812584d7283b.translation: Raúl fell for Rosita ever since a mutual friend had introduced them to each other.

sense_7beee8556662a8637e2df196652feea0.text: Tenemos planeado ir a la playa en agosto.
sense_7beee8556662a8637e2df196652feea0.translation: We're planning to go to the beach in August.

sense_7beee8556662a8637e2df196652feea0.text: Estamos planeando una fiesta de sorpresa para su cumpleaños.
sense_7beee8556662a8637e2df196652feea0.translation: We're planning a surprise party for her birthday.

sense_c84418123d6c5b05b21fc149976ae70d.text: Resulta oportuno destacar que el proyecto será financiado con fondos privados.
sense_c84418123d6c5b05b21fc149976ae70d.translation: We should point out that the project will be financed with private funds.

sense_c84418123d6c5b05b21fc149976ae70d.text: Sería oportuno que Méndez explicara el inesperado anuncio de su renuncia.
sense_c84418123d6c5b05b21fc149976ae70d.translation: It would be best if Mendez explained the unexpected announcement of his resignation.

sense_e9668ccc0a6548f5e7744495034d0ec1.text: ¡Siempre tan oportuna, tu madre, llamando a la hora de la cena!
sense_e9668ccc0a6548f5e7744495034d0ec1.translation: You can always count on your mother to phone at dinner time!

sense_e9668ccc0a6548f5e7744495034d0ec1.text: Siempre tan oportunos, los niños, que piden ir al baño cuando acabas de entrar al cine.
sense_e9668ccc0a6548f5e7744495034d0ec1.translation: Children are always so reliable! They'll ask to go to the bathroom the moment you step into the movie theater.

sense_aac20e5851c29a2a9da6597e6081e672.text: Un día en la playa me suena perfecto.
sense_aac20e5851c29a2a9da6597e6081e672.translation: A day on the beach sounds perfect.

sense_92113721be16dd15dc75deafc96eb6b2.translation: How many people went missing in the tsunami?

sense_92113721be16dd15dc75deafc96eb6b2.text: Las madres de los desaparecidos durante la dictadura hicieron todo lo posible para que los culpables fueran procesados.
sense_92113721be16dd15dc75deafc96eb6b2.translation: The mothers of those who disappeared during the dictatorship did everything possible to bring the culprits to justice.

sense_9203d7b4218c22d6d08fd69c3adc24cc.text: Agarra una escoba y ayúdame a barrer este desastre.
sense_9203d7b4218c22d6d08fd69c3adc24cc.translation: Grab a broom and help me sweep up this mess.

sense_9203d7b4218c22d6d08fd69c3adc24cc.text: La bruja se montó en su escoba y se fue volando a su casa en el bosque.
sense_9203d7b4218c22d6d08fd69c3adc24cc.translation: The witch got on her broom and flew to her house in the woods.

sense_b10ad2d7330b9027596f2da55e66ff04.text: El velero levó anclas y desapareció en la niebla.
sense_b10ad2d7330b9027596f2da55e66ff04.translation: The sailboat weighed anchor and disappeared in the mist.

sense_b10ad2d7330b9027596f2da55e66ff04.text: La tripulación levó anclas y el barco zarpó hacia Tenerife.
sense_b10ad2d7330b9027596f2da55e66ff04.translation: The crew weighed anchor and the ship set sail for Tenerife.

sense_ed2df48d739fee86e45588f886d31885.text: ¡Me sabe genial recibir un 10 en el examen!
sense_ed2df48d739fee86e45588f886d31885.translation: I feel great getting a 10 on the exam!

sense_ed2df48d739fee86e45588f886d31885.text: Me supo muy mal cómo te hablaron en la junta.
sense_ed2df48d739fee86e45588f886d31885.translation: I really disliked the way they talked to you in the meeting.

sense_8710c6a99b5f95cbb25935a1bdf81698.text: Este año voy a correr la maratón.
sense_8710c6a99b5f95cbb25935a1bdf81698.translation: I'm running the marathon this year.

sense_0b1b010a20f00850a16ba673d2bd4aa5.text: Corro el peligro de volverme loca planificando esta boda.
sense_0b1b010a20f00850a16ba673d2bd4aa5.translation: I'm in danger of going crazy planning this wedding.

sense_0b1b010a20f00850a16ba673d2bd4aa5.text: Ten en cuenta el peligro que supone conducir una motocicleta.
sense_0b1b010a20f00850a16ba673d2bd4aa5.translation: Take into account how dangerous it is to ride a motorcycle.

sense_ea0980114b790c91186407c321a7e151.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_ea0980114b790c91186407c321a7e151.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_ea0980114b790c91186407c321a7e151.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_ea0980114b790c91186407c321a7e151.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_c98c2ec13a1fa27bbdc1bce204d33b45.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_c98c2ec13a1fa27bbdc1bce204d33b45.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_c98c2ec13a1fa27bbdc1bce204d33b45.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_c98c2ec13a1fa27bbdc1bce204d33b45.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_9926a84822691ff3deb347050c8f989c.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_9926a84822691ff3deb347050c8f989c.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_9926a84822691ff3deb347050c8f989c.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_9926a84822691ff3deb347050c8f989c.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_d98a339a7c30154b6101a517537c3025.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_d98a339a7c30154b6101a517537c3025.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_d98a339a7c30154b6101a517537c3025.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_d98a339a7c30154b6101a517537c3025.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_9f8e80c14f0f42ea2799adc45a9d04bb.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_9f8e80c14f0f42ea2799adc45a9d04bb.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_9f8e80c14f0f42ea2799adc45a9d04bb.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_9f8e80c14f0f42ea2799adc45a9d04bb.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_256e3c9204c912ba2698713aad06d78f.text: El programa era tan aburrido que me dormí.
sense_256e3c9204c912ba2698713aad06d78f.translation: The program was so boring that I fell asleep.

sense_256e3c9204c912ba2698713aad06d78f.text: Me dormí a las 6 de la mañana.
sense_256e3c9204c912ba2698713aad06d78f.translation: I fell asleep at 6 in the morning.

sense_f4090343ae7fb85b277e107c1cd803aa.text: No te duermas o no acabarás a tiempo.
sense_f4090343ae7fb85b277e107c1cd803aa.translation: Don't slack off or you won't finish in time.

sense_f4090343ae7fb85b277e107c1cd803aa.text: Por dormirse se perdió la clave para ganar el premio.
sense_f4090343ae7fb85b277e107c1cd803aa.translation: He missed the clue to win the prize because he didn't stay on his toes.

sense_1c9a7e66afc4de5acfe0c9cfd1c41e7a.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_1c9a7e66afc4de5acfe0c9cfd1c41e7a.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_1c9a7e66afc4de5acfe0c9cfd1c41e7a.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_1c9a7e66afc4de5acfe0c9cfd1c41e7a.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_3cd33f79c2e14649447386c1b4116283.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_3cd33f79c2e14649447386c1b4116283.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_3cd33f79c2e14649447386c1b4116283.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_3cd33f79c2e14649447386c1b4116283.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_d0873b1cc731cce1dbea623068795894.text: El sospechoso estaba fichado por una ofensa anterior.
sense_d0873b1cc731cce1dbea623068795894.translation: The suspect had a record for a previous offense.

sense_772c0831a0ff0fa3b257d81dab702459.text: Hoy no estoy muy católica; me duele mucho la cabeza.
sense_772c0831a0ff0fa3b257d81dab702459.translation: I'm feeling rather under the weather today; I have a terrible headache.

sense_772c0831a0ff0fa3b257d81dab702459.text: Creo que la gata no está muy católica. No quiere ronronear.
sense_772c0831a0ff0fa3b257d81dab702459.translation: I think the cat is a little out of sorts. She won't purr.

sense_ee358743961a7d7d8ad0958e3d211ca3.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_ee358743961a7d7d8ad0958e3d211ca3.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_354c6d7d11e2037f85a1182417ce7fba.text: Isabel sentía náuseas y se fue a casa.
sense_354c6d7d11e2037f85a1182417ce7fba.translation: Isabel was feeling nauseous so she went home.

sense_354c6d7d11e2037f85a1182417ce7fba.text: Tengo náuseas. Creo que voy a vomitar.
sense_354c6d7d11e2037f85a1182417ce7fba.translation: I feel sick. I think I'm going to vomit.

sense_74ba954a985c6f9d7d23d5a7be508d2d.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_74ba954a985c6f9d7d23d5a7be508d2d.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_74ba954a985c6f9d7d23d5a7be508d2d.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_74ba954a985c6f9d7d23d5a7be508d2d.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_bca26fee0bde1c82712aab162f0888aa.text: La revolución separó el partido en dos facciones.
sense_bca26fee0bde1c82712aab162f0888aa.translation: The revolution separated the party into two factions.

sense_bca26fee0bde1c82712aab162f0888aa.text: Separé la clase en grupos de cuatro alumnos cada uno.
sense_bca26fee0bde1c82712aab162f0888aa.translation: I divided the class into groups of four students each.

sense_39c050e187bbae8b4f2f20ab3921d092.text: Un ala se separó del transbordador espacial al entrar la atmósfera de la tierra.
sense_39c050e187bbae8b4f2f20ab3921d092.translation: A wing came off the space shuttle upon entering the Earth's atmosphere.

sense_39c050e187bbae8b4f2f20ab3921d092.text: Durante una tormenta, una rama se separó del árbol y cayó encima de mi automóvil.
sense_39c050e187bbae8b4f2f20ab3921d092.translation: A branch of the tree was ripped off during a storm and landed on my car.

sense_ab754a52e9c6a24092c16590d5a9b6c2.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_ab754a52e9c6a24092c16590d5a9b6c2.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_ab754a52e9c6a24092c16590d5a9b6c2.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_ab754a52e9c6a24092c16590d5a9b6c2.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_ec78a4a4cd2a8a3649ef14b4ee0f72e1.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_ec78a4a4cd2a8a3649ef14b4ee0f72e1.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_ec78a4a4cd2a8a3649ef14b4ee0f72e1.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_ec78a4a4cd2a8a3649ef14b4ee0f72e1.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_5d0ab43d1a8c163d77a49e1ec8495222.text: ¿Me prestas $20? - ¡Claro que no! Todavía me debes $50.
sense_5d0ab43d1a8c163d77a49e1ec8495222.translation: Can I borrow $20? - No, you can't! You still owe me $50.

sense_5d0ab43d1a8c163d77a49e1ec8495222.text: Papá, ¿me ayudarás a hacer la tarea de matemáticas esta noche? - ¡Claro que sí!
sense_5d0ab43d1a8c163d77a49e1ec8495222.translation: Dad, will you help me with my math homework this evening? - Of course I will!

sense_d21ec454dd00bcc436ae3d04a4fb574c.text: Margarita se negó a hacerlo. Claro que yo en su lugar también me hubiera negado.
sense_d21ec454dd00bcc436ae3d04a4fb574c.translation: Margarita refused to do it. Mind you, I would have refused too in her place.

sense_d21ec454dd00bcc436ae3d04a4fb574c.text: ¿Lo haces tú? - Claro, para que si sale mal me eches la culpa a mí.
sense_d21ec454dd00bcc436ae3d04a4fb574c.translation: Will you do it? - Oh sure, so you can blame me if it goes wrong.

sense_1cd27b621fa72db662bd3cbe927cc26e.translation: I don't have anywhere to write this down.
Ready to take notes? Jot this down.

sense_03398f4f0c52b6275e353a2b3b457604.text: Se apuntó un tanto cuando ganó la apuesta.
sense_03398f4f0c52b6275e353a2b3b457604.translation: He chalked up a point when he won the bet.

sense_03398f4f0c52b6275e353a2b3b457604.text: El equipo azul se apuntó una victoria en la primera prueba.
sense_03398f4f0c52b6275e353a2b3b457604.translation: The blue team scored a win in the first heat.

sense_66f4bcc1da79c7ad45e036d077073809.text: Este año voy a correr la maratón.
sense_66f4bcc1da79c7ad45e036d077073809.translation: I'm running the marathon this year.

sense_ee082343177983da8daa2555ea846a97.text: Lo siento. Ya no hay lugar en esta posada.
sense_ee082343177983da8daa2555ea846a97.translation: I'm sorry. There's no room at this inn.

sense_ee082343177983da8daa2555ea846a97.text: Está oscureciendo; deberíamos parar en esa posada y dormir un poco.
sense_ee082343177983da8daa2555ea846a97.translation: It's getting dark. We should stop at that inn and get some sleep.

sense_671ba16b48c8946b122e92d9ac1f7db9.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_671ba16b48c8946b122e92d9ac1f7db9.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_671ba16b48c8946b122e92d9ac1f7db9.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_671ba16b48c8946b122e92d9ac1f7db9.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_3ecb6ce110c3f466bf1f8e724f19c6ed.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_3ecb6ce110c3f466bf1f8e724f19c6ed.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_3ecb6ce110c3f466bf1f8e724f19c6ed.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_3ecb6ce110c3f466bf1f8e724f19c6ed.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_3aec3abecd606a0d5199df7c061c55f3.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_3aec3abecd606a0d5199df7c061c55f3.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_3aec3abecd606a0d5199df7c061c55f3.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_3aec3abecd606a0d5199df7c061c55f3.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_4f66df03fbdbbbdefdb33c17b64a8bab.text: La chica estaba vendiendo naranjas en el mercado.
sense_4f66df03fbdbbbdefdb33c17b64a8bab.translation: The girl was selling oranges in the market.

sense_f3f627bcf13e81e396d6dd72a9e4d1c8.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_f3f627bcf13e81e396d6dd72a9e4d1c8.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_f3f627bcf13e81e396d6dd72a9e4d1c8.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_f3f627bcf13e81e396d6dd72a9e4d1c8.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_8b685c47e4a5d220248c08ff6a87f7f2.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_8b685c47e4a5d220248c08ff6a87f7f2.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_8b685c47e4a5d220248c08ff6a87f7f2.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_8b685c47e4a5d220248c08ff6a87f7f2.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_852f2c680cc1b622e7db7637bbc60ce0.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_852f2c680cc1b622e7db7637bbc60ce0.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_852f2c680cc1b622e7db7637bbc60ce0.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_852f2c680cc1b622e7db7637bbc60ce0.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_44e5c79611867c621a695fdfe863b203.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_44e5c79611867c621a695fdfe863b203.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_44e5c79611867c621a695fdfe863b203.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_44e5c79611867c621a695fdfe863b203.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_5eba00d3aa3875a23c90b74ae6717e1c.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_5eba00d3aa3875a23c90b74ae6717e1c.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_5eba00d3aa3875a23c90b74ae6717e1c.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_5eba00d3aa3875a23c90b74ae6717e1c.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_473d9c241fafb18ceb22caf6d9da3572.text: Los beisboleros estaban determinados a dominar la liga menor.
sense_473d9c241fafb18ceb22caf6d9da3572.translation: The baseball players were determined to dominate the minor league.

sense_473d9c241fafb18ceb22caf6d9da3572.text: Ivana estaba determinada a ganar el certamen a toda costa.
sense_473d9c241fafb18ceb22caf6d9da3572.translation: Ivana was determined to win the competition at all costs.

sense_672549db343026a1e3667c10713da44f.text: En estos momentos la grúa está retirando el vehículo accidentado de la carretera.
sense_672549db343026a1e3667c10713da44f.translation: Right now the tow truck is removing the damaged vehicle from the roadway.

sense_b993aead3bb595735b7714547d5d55b2.text: Mi marido nunca me retiró la confianza.
sense_b993aead3bb595735b7714547d5d55b2.translation: My husband never lost confidence in me.

sense_b993aead3bb595735b7714547d5d55b2.text: El partido le retiró la confianza al presidente cuando malversó fondos.
sense_b993aead3bb595735b7714547d5d55b2.translation: The president lost the party's confidence when he misappropriated funds.

sense_0fb456652e3e523f2f266f0ee1f9269e.text: La empresa retiró los autobuses más antiguos.
sense_0fb456652e3e523f2f266f0ee1f9269e.translation: The company withdrew the oldest buses.

sense_0fb456652e3e523f2f266f0ee1f9269e.text: Retiraron los billetes falsos de la circulación.
sense_0fb456652e3e523f2f266f0ee1f9269e.translation: The counterfeit notes were withdrawn from circulation.

sense_3499dda980366821547970ff925613fd.text: El recepcionista me pidió que no me retirara.
sense_3499dda980366821547970ff925613fd.translation: The receptionist asked me to hold the line.

sense_252515613a58aba51d93538607701e5b.text: Ponte el salvavidas antes de subirte a la balsa.
sense_252515613a58aba51d93538607701e5b.translation: Put on your life jacket before you get into the raft.

sense_252515613a58aba51d93538607701e5b.text: La aeromoza le estaba enseñando a los pasajeros cómo ponerse el salvavidas en caso de una emergencia.
sense_252515613a58aba51d93538607701e5b.translation: The flight attendant was showing the passengers how to put on their life jacket in case of an emergency.

sense_5175d4b79a299a28cd7d382d7564b124.text: No se ahogó gracias a que llevaba chaleco salvavidas.
sense_5175d4b79a299a28cd7d382d7564b124.translation: She didn't drown only because she was wearing her life jacket.

sense_5175d4b79a299a28cd7d382d7564b124.text: Un torpedo impactó el barco pero pudimos subirnos a un bote salvavidas.
sense_5175d4b79a299a28cd7d382d7564b124.translation: A torpedo struck the ship but we were able to get into a lifeboat.

sense_327a4f0eb7279f5b96588b09daa5b5e3.text: ¿No preferirías ir de vacaciones al extranjero este año?
sense_327a4f0eb7279f5b96588b09daa5b5e3.translation: Wouldn't you rather vacation abroad this year?

sense_327a4f0eb7279f5b96588b09daa5b5e3.text: Prefiero que se lo digas tú porque a ti te hace más caso.
sense_327a4f0eb7279f5b96588b09daa5b5e3.translation: I'd rather you told him because he listens to you more.

sense_0b69a4d292c7e12beef38f1f4bb3532e.text: Prefiero los bolígrafos a los lápices.
sense_0b69a4d292c7e12beef38f1f4bb3532e.translation: I prefer ballpoint pens over pencils.

sense_0b69a4d292c7e12beef38f1f4bb3532e.text: El artista usa bolígrafos para crear versiones modernas de obras clásicas del Renacimiento.
sense_0b69a4d292c7e12beef38f1f4bb3532e.translation: The artist uses ballpoint pens to create modern versions of classic Renaissance paintings.

sense_47d7648d4782b53c02f72d722fee29da.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_47d7648d4782b53c02f72d722fee29da.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_47d7648d4782b53c02f72d722fee29da.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_47d7648d4782b53c02f72d722fee29da.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?
