sense_d4e0f6be2e83b251b608f399d8c8d327.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_d4e0f6be2e83b251b608f399d8c8d327.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_d4e0f6be2e83b251b608f399d8c8d327.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_988982a7faf0e1321f9bc3e80b04da74.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_988982a7faf0e1321f9bc3e80b04da74.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_988982a7faf0e1321f9bc3e80b04da74.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_988982a7faf0e1321f9bc3e80b04da74.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_31bdac431486c1e28aff3c840f6686b4.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_31bdac431486c1e28aff3c840f6686b4.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_31bdac431486c1e28aff3c840f6686b4.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_31bdac431486c1e28aff3c840f6686b4.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_4e606f13542254f243e9e12a510f1d35.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_4e606f13542254f243e9e12a510f1d35.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_4e606f13542254f243e9e12a510f1d35.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_4e606f13542254f243e9e12a510f1d35.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_9425c8f026e00cc6912e95e9007f96ce.text: La primera novela del autor fue originalmente escrita en irlandés.
sense_9425c8f026e00cc6912e95e9007f96ce.translation: The author's first novel was originally written in Irish.

sense_9425c8f026e00cc6912e95e9007f96ce.text: En Dublín, las señales están escritas tanto en irlandés como en inglés.
sense_9425c8f026e00cc6912e95e9007f96ce.translation: In Dublin, the road signs are written in both Irish and English.

sense_cd78c5074c8e7a1b792f97bb1669abd9.text: En lugar de ayudarnos, nuestro abogado nos chupó todo el dinero.
sense_cd78c5074c8e7a1b792f97bb1669abd9.translation: Instead of helping us, our lawyer milked us dry.

sense_cd78c5074c8e7a1b792f97bb1669abd9.text: Lara pensaba chuparle todo el dinero que pudiera a la empresa.
sense_cd78c5074c8e7a1b792f97bb1669abd9.translation: Lara intended to milk as much money out of the company as she could.

sense_b0c6d427161c78d30c2ac6c6d09dfd38.text: Es importante que siempre consideres los sentimientos de los demás.
sense_b0c6d427161c78d30c2ac6c6d09dfd38.translation: It's important that you always consider other people's feelings.

sense_b0c6d427161c78d30c2ac6c6d09dfd38.text: Siempre hay que considerar a las personas mayores en el autobús y cederles el asiento.
sense_b0c6d427161c78d30c2ac6c6d09dfd38.translation: You should always show consideration for older people on the bus and give up your seat for them.

sense_cc0dd0a12743b73c5399d79c0c545324.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
sense_cc0dd0a12743b73c5399d79c0c545324.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

sense_cc0dd0a12743b73c5399d79c0c545324.text: ¿Se te antoja un helado? Disparo yo.
sense_cc0dd0a12743b73c5399d79c0c545324.translation: Do you want an ice cream? My treat.

sense_f2d3c2385f2c498a1f244652224b9ad8.text: Disculpa, no te he visto trabajando allí. Me pondré los cascos.
sense_f2d3c2385f2c498a1f244652224b9ad8.translation: I'm sorry, I didn't see you there working. I'll put headphones in.

sense_f2d3c2385f2c498a1f244652224b9ad8.text: Disculpe, por favor. ¿Me dice dónde está la parada del metro?
sense_f2d3c2385f2c498a1f244652224b9ad8.translation: Excuse me, please. Can you tell me where the subway station is?

sense_0360b73125d4259557d6abfa704769fc.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_0360b73125d4259557d6abfa704769fc.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_0360b73125d4259557d6abfa704769fc.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_0360b73125d4259557d6abfa704769fc.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_21b568c5f419793cbfdd21f17e0a91cb.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_21b568c5f419793cbfdd21f17e0a91cb.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_21b568c5f419793cbfdd21f17e0a91cb.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_21b568c5f419793cbfdd21f17e0a91cb.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_4afc2ffa19b51fb7ab04af688dda8895.text: Deja el libro en la mesa cuando acabes de leerlo.
sense_4afc2ffa19b51fb7ab04af688dda8895.translation: Leave the book on the table when you are finished reading it.

sense_4afc2ffa19b51fb7ab04af688dda8895.text: Dejé la llave en tu buzón, como me pediste que hiciera.
sense_4afc2ffa19b51fb7ab04af688dda8895.translation: I left the key in your mailbox, as you asked me to do.

sense_f2dfd902b5622d6596a6b586352c2dbe.text: Déjame terminar esta tarea y nos vamos.
sense_f2dfd902b5622d6596a6b586352c2dbe.translation: Let me finish this homework and we can go.

sense_f2dfd902b5622d6596a6b586352c2dbe.text: ¿Vas a dejar que acabe de hablar?
sense_f2dfd902b5622d6596a6b586352c2dbe.translation: Would you let me finish talking?

sense_3cf232b2ff955126b5c2f5a8c887d0dc.text: Huele a gas en este cuarto.
sense_3cf232b2ff955126b5c2f5a8c887d0dc.translation: It smells like gas in this room.

sense_fcda4a0c806d7180cc632a71a5215bc9.text: Este acuerdo me huele a corrupción.
A mi papá le huele que el vecino se está robando sus periódicos.
sense_fcda4a0c806d7180cc632a71a5215bc9.translation: My father suspects that the neighbor is stealing his newspapers.

sense_bf86451706fb32a78665558974283e36.text: Le dije que sí sin pensármelo dos veces.
sense_bf86451706fb32a78665558974283e36.translation: I agreed without giving it a second thought.

sense_bf86451706fb32a78665558974283e36.text: Tendrás que pensártelo, ¿no? No tienes porque decidirte ya.
sense_bf86451706fb32a78665558974283e36.translation: You'll have to think it over, won't you? You don't have to decide yet.

sense_7a896842b4806c840ab6eb2426a0fb89.text: Hay que comprar una sartén nueva porque esta ya no sirve.
sense_7a896842b4806c840ab6eb2426a0fb89.translation: We need to buy a new frying pan because this one is no good any more.
Is this one any good to you?

sense_3743d1a3d1213203d58bba8168694397.text: La peli era malísima; solo se salvaba el actor principal.
sense_3743d1a3d1213203d58bba8168694397.translation: The film was really bad; the main actor was the only one who was ok.

sense_3743d1a3d1213203d58bba8168694397.text: Los considero a todos unos vagos; no se salva nadie.
sense_3743d1a3d1213203d58bba8168694397.translation: I consider them all lazy, without exception.

sense_8801ebcdcea5a917832dc2eb1e70b2fd.text: Yo me quité una espina cuando por fin les ganamos el domingo.
sense_8801ebcdcea5a917832dc2eb1e70b2fd.translation: I got over my grudge when we beat them on Sunday.

sense_8801ebcdcea5a917832dc2eb1e70b2fd.text: Tiene una espina clavada con eso de que no pudo ir de viaje con su familia.
sense_8801ebcdcea5a917832dc2eb1e70b2fd.translation: The fact that she couldn't go on vacation with her family is a thorn in her side.

sense_29ad26beeda2af9f4a132a0edb23866a.text: Hay algo en todo este asunto que me da muy mala espina.
sense_29ad26beeda2af9f4a132a0edb23866a.translation: There's something about the whole thing that makes me very uneasy.

sense_29ad26beeda2af9f4a132a0edb23866a.text: Me juró que no había sido ella, pero me quedé con la espina.
sense_29ad26beeda2af9f4a132a0edb23866a.translation: She swore it wasn't her, but I had my suspicions.

sense_1276ee27d4abb4fd8fb2f39e1c1e79e7.text: Las bragas y los sostenes están en oferta.
sense_1276ee27d4abb4fd8fb2f39e1c1e79e7.translation: Panties and bras are on sale.

sense_1276ee27d4abb4fd8fb2f39e1c1e79e7.text: Hola, ¿me diría dónde puedo encontrar unas bragas? - Sí, señora, allí mismo, en el departamento de ropa interior.
sense_1276ee27d4abb4fd8fb2f39e1c1e79e7.translation: Hey, could you tell me where I could find some panties? - Yes, ma'am, right there, in the underwear department.

sense_731502d6ba321fa6e084443f09674ccf.text: Tenemos tangas y bragas sexy para todas las ocasiones.
sense_731502d6ba321fa6e084443f09674ccf.translation: We have sexy thongs and knickers for every occasion.

sense_731502d6ba321fa6e084443f09674ccf.text: Las bragas y las medias están en el mismo cajón.
sense_731502d6ba321fa6e084443f09674ccf.translation: The knickers and the stockings are in the same drawer.

sense_ae2608caec9280e26fa420b46e67bc12.text: Dame cinco minutos; quiero darle una pasada al vestido antes de irnos.
sense_ae2608caec9280e26fa420b46e67bc12.translation: Give me five minutes; I want to iron the dress really quickly before we leave.

sense_ae2608caec9280e26fa420b46e67bc12.text: Perdón por mi aspecto algo desaliñado, pero estaba apurado y no tuve tiempo de darle una pasada a la camisa.
sense_ae2608caec9280e26fa420b46e67bc12.translation: Sorry that I look a little scruffy, but I was in a hurry and didn't have time to run the iron over my shirt.

sense_a97a5a7733b33737b85d08d753530ba5.text: La fiesta de Mari fue una pasada.
El restaurante nos cobró un recargo por llegar tarde. - ¡Qué pasada!
sense_a97a5a7733b33737b85d08d753530ba5.translation: The restaurant added on a charge for being late. - What a rip off!

sense_7a9a123826e7146bc6a2d56aae21b9d2.text: Cuanto más trabaja, más rico se hace.
sense_7a9a123826e7146bc6a2d56aae21b9d2.translation: The more he works, the richer he gets.
The more he gets, the more he wants.

sense_9e16c78187e4e044785a846a54b6b504.text: Tuvimos que quedarnos en casa porque estaba cayendo un chaparrón.
sense_9e16c78187e4e044785a846a54b6b504.translation: We had to stay home because it was pouring rain.

sense_9e16c78187e4e044785a846a54b6b504.text: Está cayendo una buena nevada. Ponle las cadenas a las ruedas.
sense_9e16c78187e4e044785a846a54b6b504.translation: It's snowing hard. Put the chains on the tires.

sense_d276dc9712919e37624038b3f2696a81.text: No bebo porque el alcohol me cae mal.
sense_d276dc9712919e37624038b3f2696a81.translation: I don't drink because alcohol disagrees with me.
You look great in that dress!

sense_1390fb9c6c826e150707320e9ea755a5.text: Me cae muy bien tu hermano; siempre me hace sonreír.
sense_1390fb9c6c826e150707320e9ea755a5.translation: I really like your brother; he always makes me smile.

sense_1390fb9c6c826e150707320e9ea755a5.text: Me marché porque me cae mal tu primo con sus bromas ofensivas.
sense_1390fb9c6c826e150707320e9ea755a5.translation: I had to leave because I can't stand your cousin and his offensive jokes.

sense_ab0c838659d520e7cd703e0ab5a2c752.text: Que Harvard la hubiera rechazado, le cayó mal.
sense_ab0c838659d520e7cd703e0ab5a2c752.translation: She wasn't pleased that Harvard rejected her.

sense_ab0c838659d520e7cd703e0ab5a2c752.text: El embarazo de mi hermana pequeña no cayó bien en la familia.
sense_ab0c838659d520e7cd703e0ab5a2c752.translation: My little sister's pregnancy shocked the entire family.

sense_8ae296b2513b03ee54db0d87dff63a88.text: Mi bebé está llorando porque se cae de sueño.
sense_8ae296b2513b03ee54db0d87dff63a88.translation: My baby is crying because he's very sleepy.

sense_8ae296b2513b03ee54db0d87dff63a88.text: Me caigo de cansancio, pero tengo que estudiar para el examen de mañana.
sense_8ae296b2513b03ee54db0d87dff63a88.translation: I am really tired, but I have to study for tomorrow's exam.

sense_66224cd6e7313bc6c8b713aab612d3ff.text: Entré en este sector hace algunos años.
sense_66224cd6e7313bc6c8b713aab612d3ff.translation: I started in this sector some years ago.

sense_66224cd6e7313bc6c8b713aab612d3ff.text: Entro a mi clase de yoga a las 6 am.
sense_66224cd6e7313bc6c8b713aab612d3ff.translation: I start my yoga class at 6 am.

sense_8f2a95217a79528d370191e7ce40b84a.text: Gira el botón hasta llegar al tope.
sense_8f2a95217a79528d370191e7ce40b84a.translation: Turn the knob until it won't go any further.

sense_8f2a95217a79528d370191e7ce40b84a.text: Dio varias vueltas de llave hasta que llegó al tope.
sense_8f2a95217a79528d370191e7ce40b84a.translation: He turned the key a number of times until it wouldn't go any further.

sense_8273db91092de4ad1a967553cdef4c16.text: Le di un tope a un carro al estacionarme.
sense_8273db91092de4ad1a967553cdef4c16.translation: I bumped into a car when I was parking.

sense_8273db91092de4ad1a967553cdef4c16.text: Le di un tope a mi auto con un poste.
sense_8273db91092de4ad1a967553cdef4c16.translation: I bumped into a post in my car.

sense_f96c4e78d68ebc7bc296a693346abda0.text: La edad tope para aplicar es de 30 años.
sense_f96c4e78d68ebc7bc296a693346abda0.translation: The upper age limit for applications is 30.

sense_f96c4e78d68ebc7bc296a693346abda0.text: No hay edad tope para conducir.
sense_f96c4e78d68ebc7bc296a693346abda0.translation: There is no upper age limit for driving.

sense_1bfd867e228a1804550fddb1290d587a.text: Roberto tiene el hábito de despertarse temprano.
sense_1bfd867e228a1804550fddb1290d587a.translation: Roberto is in the habit of waking up early.

sense_1bfd867e228a1804550fddb1290d587a.text: Ya sé que ver tanta tele es un mal hábito, pero me está costando mucho trabajo dejarlo.
sense_1bfd867e228a1804550fddb1290d587a.translation: I know watching so much TV is a bad habit, but giving it up is proving really difficult.

sense_f75b31acfb636f41f2a4c2eb63db0e94.text: Este medicamento no crea hábito, así que no tienes que preocuparte.
sense_f75b31acfb636f41f2a4c2eb63db0e94.translation: This drug isn't habit-forming, so there's no need to worry.

sense_5d0b1a2042ee68e5eab1126f380d50f0.text: La chica estaba vendiendo naranjas en el mercado.
sense_5d0b1a2042ee68e5eab1126f380d50f0.translation: The girl was selling oranges in the market.

sense_afd6b859da78986d7cc977e1b6d2ce85.text: Jorge cumplió su sueño de convertirse en médico.
sense_afd6b859da78986d7cc977e1b6d2ce85.translation: Jorge achieved his dream of becoming a doctor.

sense_afd6b859da78986d7cc977e1b6d2ce85.text: Hay que tener fuerza de voluntad para cumplir tus metas.
sense_afd6b859da78986d7cc977e1b6d2ce85.translation: You need willpower to achieve your goals.

sense_59fef7bd0923781b7190f6276a227080.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_59fef7bd0923781b7190f6276a227080.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_59fef7bd0923781b7190f6276a227080.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_59fef7bd0923781b7190f6276a227080.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_31cc26af03a603ee2d71ed96a7b933ce.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_31cc26af03a603ee2d71ed96a7b933ce.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_31cc26af03a603ee2d71ed96a7b933ce.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_31cc26af03a603ee2d71ed96a7b933ce.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_6f495336a16105be6df0e23989189601.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_6f495336a16105be6df0e23989189601.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_5b044f3bd67e83af69197380b90511c5.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_5b044f3bd67e83af69197380b90511c5.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_5b044f3bd67e83af69197380b90511c5.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_5b044f3bd67e83af69197380b90511c5.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_6ffe566d3ed000dc77ce7a1e3f33075e.text: Este altar se construyó para honrar a nuestros antepasados.
sense_6ffe566d3ed000dc77ce7a1e3f33075e.translation: This altar was built to honor our ancestors.

sense_6ffe566d3ed000dc77ce7a1e3f33075e.text: Es habitual honrar a los muertos llevando flores a su tumba.
sense_6ffe566d3ed000dc77ce7a1e3f33075e.translation: It's common to honor the dead by bringing flowers to their graves.

sense_a50d2282a42b1c3ec1a3dc4a35fe70a6.text: La comida maravillosa del restaurante se une a la decoración modernista lujosa.
sense_a50d2282a42b1c3ec1a3dc4a35fe70a6.translation: The restaurant's fantastic food is complemented by their luxurious modernist decor.

sense_a50d2282a42b1c3ec1a3dc4a35fe70a6.text: Ese tipo es un trabajador fantástico. En él se unen la confianza y la habilidad.
sense_a50d2282a42b1c3ec1a3dc4a35fe70a6.translation: That guy's a fantastic worker. He's the epitome of confidence and skill.

sense_6cf5a4d71278be5d4b7c758308ea340e.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_6cf5a4d71278be5d4b7c758308ea340e.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_6cf5a4d71278be5d4b7c758308ea340e.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_6cf5a4d71278be5d4b7c758308ea340e.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_2f7cffab6d365350f027bd589074a83e.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_2f7cffab6d365350f027bd589074a83e.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_2f7cffab6d365350f027bd589074a83e.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_2f7cffab6d365350f027bd589074a83e.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_a1e1a6e21b711c45a613420272a1b244.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_a1e1a6e21b711c45a613420272a1b244.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_0018fdfa1d0f5957f07e17f3082bcb4b.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_0018fdfa1d0f5957f07e17f3082bcb4b.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_0018fdfa1d0f5957f07e17f3082bcb4b.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_0018fdfa1d0f5957f07e17f3082bcb4b.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_28f4c96359022a25bb925a29eeb01a33.text: Mi perro es mi amigo más fiel.
sense_28f4c96359022a25bb925a29eeb01a33.translation: My dog is my most faithful friend.

sense_28f4c96359022a25bb925a29eeb01a33.text: Su novia y él han sido fieles durante toda la relación.
sense_28f4c96359022a25bb925a29eeb01a33.translation: He and his girlfriend have remained faithful to each other throughout the relationship.

sense_9b07a4732679cb2a282c1ef5c8fb76aa.text: Las paredes están húmedas porque arriba hay una filtración.
sense_9b07a4732679cb2a282c1ef5c8fb76aa.translation: The walls are damp because there is a leak upstairs.

sense_9b07a4732679cb2a282c1ef5c8fb76aa.text: La ropa que tendimos ayer sigue húmeda porque anoche llovió.
sense_9b07a4732679cb2a282c1ef5c8fb76aa.translation: The clothes we hung to dry yesterday are still damp because it rained last night.

sense_8295a91932633f437dc78a088c266492.text: Mi hermana me encargó sus hijos este sábado.
sense_8295a91932633f437dc78a088c266492.translation: My sister's asked me to look after her kids on Saturday.

sense_8295a91932633f437dc78a088c266492.text: Le encargaron conseguir un restaurante para la fiesta a Marco.
sense_8295a91932633f437dc78a088c266492.translation: Marco was given the job of finding a restaurant for the party.

sense_7a0aef595c30fa524e05134c9b9857c5.text: He told me to shut up! - And quite rightly too!
sense_7a0aef595c30fa524e05134c9b9857c5.translation: ¡Me ha mandado a callar! - ¡Y con razón!

sense_2a0e70dfa925440ffaa0cc89f9b1748c.text: This heat is unbearable. - Quite so.
sense_2a0e70dfa925440ffaa0cc89f9b1748c.translation: Este calor no hay quién lo aguante. - Desde luego.

sense_2a0e70dfa925440ffaa0cc89f9b1748c.text: I'm afraid I cannot take you to the airport. - That's quite all right. I'll take a taxi.
sense_2a0e70dfa925440ffaa0cc89f9b1748c.translation: Lo siento pero no puedo llevarte al aeropuerto. - No hay ningún problema. Tomaré un taxi.

sense_55a49526fe5c7305d8448cd7d61b9c1c.text: Había la hostia de trago. ¡Y todo gratis!
sense_55a49526fe5c7305d8448cd7d61b9c1c.translation: There was tons of booze. And all of it free!
What the hell are we going to do now?

sense_9cdead9e8b6053506f37d4e696c8fb4c.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_9cdead9e8b6053506f37d4e696c8fb4c.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_9cdead9e8b6053506f37d4e696c8fb4c.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_9cdead9e8b6053506f37d4e696c8fb4c.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_578a7fc6d6c73272b48fe449588deffd.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_578a7fc6d6c73272b48fe449588deffd.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_8d18c8429fa4a48f7447f04825d987ba.text: Es una tienda de moda que se especializa en ropa juvenil.
sense_8d18c8429fa4a48f7447f04825d987ba.translation: It's a fashion store that specializes in children's and teenage clothing.

sense_8d18c8429fa4a48f7447f04825d987ba.text: Elisa trabaja en la sección de literatura infantil y juvenil de una editorial.
sense_8d18c8429fa4a48f7447f04825d987ba.translation: Elisa works in the children and young people's literature section of a publishing house.

sense_705b7061202b5f261016f1eae36d709b.text: Te agarras a tu herida para evitar las tareas en casa.
sense_705b7061202b5f261016f1eae36d709b.translation: You use your injury to get out of chores around the house.

sense_705b7061202b5f261016f1eae36d709b.text: Se agarró a los deberes para no tener que lavar los platos.
sense_705b7061202b5f261016f1eae36d709b.translation: She used her homework as an excuse to not wash the dishes.

sense_ebc8ab955df3694b6c02ec7082e73ebc.text: Por fin las ballenas tornan a surcar las aguas de nuestras costas.
sense_ebc8ab955df3694b6c02ec7082e73ebc.translation: Now at long last, whales are once again plying the waters around our coast.

sense_53d31f3d8ac524b77182111c2223a5e2.text: Pasé toda la noche con vómitos.
sense_53d31f3d8ac524b77182111c2223a5e2.translation: I was up all night being sick.

sense_53d31f3d8ac524b77182111c2223a5e2.text: Creo que fue el marisco lo que me causó esos vómitos.
sense_53d31f3d8ac524b77182111c2223a5e2.translation: I think it was the seafood that made me sick.

sense_e710c8723c53f0fd3bbe3eddb904d622.text: Vamos a un tianguis donde venden artesanías. ¿Nos acompañas?
sense_e710c8723c53f0fd3bbe3eddb904d622.translation: We're going to a street market where they sell handicrafts. Do you want to go with us?
Can I go with you to the store?

sense_6e7083ffed3d0884cc620c092538dbc6.text: Supongo que es normal atrasarse durante la perimenopausia.
sense_6e7083ffed3d0884cc620c092538dbc6.translation: I guess it's normal to have late periods during the perimenopause.

sense_6e7083ffed3d0884cc620c092538dbc6.text: Muchas veces me atraso; no quiere decir que esté embarazada.
sense_6e7083ffed3d0884cc620c092538dbc6.translation: My period's often late; it doesn't mean I'm pregnant.

sense_edaff92c0299e84516fd744f1f4a57c6.translation: I just want to make you happy.
What do you want for Christmas?

sense_980ff2277b3561cd004ff86b289b0931.translation: "How can I help you?," asked the butler.
Would you like something to drink?

sense_e08e351b0020ee114a94b562afe381bf.text: El bebé se tiró un eructo tras tomarse su biberón.
sense_e08e351b0020ee114a94b562afe381bf.translation: The baby burped after having his bottle.

sense_e08e351b0020ee114a94b562afe381bf.text: La primera vez que se tiró un pedo delante de su novio se avergonzó.
sense_e08e351b0020ee114a94b562afe381bf.translation: The first time she farted in front of her boyfriend, she was embarrassed.

sense_611daa4bc408937c6e8259c00b29af60.text: No le tire patadas a su hermano.
Su perro me tiró un mordisco.

sense_7a54e8b147f496587fc0f5d70ce1426f.text: Las fiestas ya no me tiran.
sense_7a54e8b147f496587fc0f5d70ce1426f.translation: Parties don't appeal to me anymore.
He is not interested in studying medicine.

sense_9a95c2943fab612f79262b9f12920e96.text: El plato tiraba a dulce más que nada.
sense_9a95c2943fab612f79262b9f12920e96.translation: The dish was more sweet than anything else.

sense_9a95c2943fab612f79262b9f12920e96.text: Tienes que beberte el té cuando esté tirando a frío.
sense_9a95c2943fab612f79262b9f12920e96.translation: You have to drink the tea when it is cooling down.

sense_949ca0e67d0c8aa0ea45db67bc622c92.text: El capitán dirigió el buque hacia el faro.
sense_949ca0e67d0c8aa0ea45db67bc622c92.translation: The captain steered the ship toward the lighthouse.

sense_949ca0e67d0c8aa0ea45db67bc622c92.text: Dirigió el coche con cuidado por el borde del acantilado.
sense_949ca0e67d0c8aa0ea45db67bc622c92.translation: He steered the car carefully along the edge of the cliff.

sense_4f9e8ca580a22219d5572ca8c9c12db7.text: Se adelantó a sus dudas y tenía listas las respuestas.
sense_4f9e8ca580a22219d5572ca8c9c12db7.translation: He anticipated their doubts and he had answers ready.

sense_4f9e8ca580a22219d5572ca8c9c12db7.text: Iba a ordenar la casa esta tarde, pero mi mujer se me adelantó.
sense_4f9e8ca580a22219d5572ca8c9c12db7.translation: I was going to tidy the house this afternoon, but my wife beat me to it.

sense_545a3341f3c7754f156c66bcbc77d92e.text: Vamos a hacernos pintar la casa después del verano.
sense_545a3341f3c7754f156c66bcbc77d92e.translation: We're going to have the house painted after the summer.

sense_545a3341f3c7754f156c66bcbc77d92e.text: Ya va siendo hora de que se haga cortar el pelo.
sense_545a3341f3c7754f156c66bcbc77d92e.translation: It's about time he had his hair cut.

sense_73c3608c3b493be315dc448442d19566.text: Daniela solo ayuda en clase para hacerse ver.
sense_73c3608c3b493be315dc448442d19566.translation: Daniela only helps out in class to get noticed.

sense_73c3608c3b493be315dc448442d19566.text: Deberíamos darle una oportunidad para hacerse oír.
sense_73c3608c3b493be315dc448442d19566.translation: We should give him a chance to be heard.

sense_0e009ac28084b5fd24b2faecf50832f8.text: El curso se me está haciendo aburrido.
La película se me hizo interminable.

sense_ea90225637f49f4c66ccd0e30397bc3e.text: Te agarras a tu herida para evitar las tareas en casa.
sense_ea90225637f49f4c66ccd0e30397bc3e.translation: You use your injury to get out of chores around the house.

sense_ea90225637f49f4c66ccd0e30397bc3e.text: Se agarró a los deberes para no tener que lavar los platos.
sense_ea90225637f49f4c66ccd0e30397bc3e.translation: She used her homework as an excuse to not wash the dishes.

sense_426b2c28e2f8668c41e244d1198b3ad0.text: Yo me limito a hacer lo que me mandan.
sense_426b2c28e2f8668c41e244d1198b3ad0.translation: I just do as I am told.

sense_426b2c28e2f8668c41e244d1198b3ad0.text: Limítate a mirar y no digas nada por el momento.
sense_426b2c28e2f8668c41e244d1198b3ad0.translation: Just watch and don't say anything for a moment.

sense_7db67ae370a36eb1f41e8998bf6e35a7.text: Mi hermana me encargó sus hijos este sábado.
sense_7db67ae370a36eb1f41e8998bf6e35a7.translation: My sister's asked me to look after her kids on Saturday.

sense_7db67ae370a36eb1f41e8998bf6e35a7.text: Le encargaron conseguir un restaurante para la fiesta a Marco.
sense_7db67ae370a36eb1f41e8998bf6e35a7.translation: Marco was given the job of finding a restaurant for the party.

sense_e31fd590fbc7fcbfa519243885fe41a7.text: Rodolfo se niega a aceptar que la boda está cancelada.
sense_e31fd590fbc7fcbfa519243885fe41a7.translation: Rodolfo refuses to believe that the wedding is canceled.

sense_e31fd590fbc7fcbfa519243885fe41a7.text: Me niego a pagar cinco dólares de envío por algo que solo cuesta un dólar.
sense_e31fd590fbc7fcbfa519243885fe41a7.translation: I refuse to pay five dollars to ship something that only costs a dollar.

sense_c9831aa5d93a97aecc1b2e6c08f628fa.text: Mi padre es un negado en asuntos de tecnología.
sense_c9831aa5d93a97aecc1b2e6c08f628fa.translation: My dad's useless when it comes to technology.

sense_c9831aa5d93a97aecc1b2e6c08f628fa.text: No te molestes en preguntarle a Mario que te ayude con la tarea. Es un negado para los idiomas
sense_c9831aa5d93a97aecc1b2e6c08f628fa.translation: Don't bother asking Mario to help you with your homework. He's hopeless at languages.

sense_7bef3a66b9943b73389b1e9fd93a2d17.text: Se encontró rodeada por taxis en Times Square.
sense_7bef3a66b9943b73389b1e9fd93a2d17.translation: She found herself surrounded by taxis in Time Square.

sense_7bef3a66b9943b73389b1e9fd93a2d17.text: Se asustó al ver que estaba rodeado de tiburones.
sense_7bef3a66b9943b73389b1e9fd93a2d17.translation: He was startled to see that he was surrounded by sharks.

sense_b66cc98991ca7161a822185962277370.text: Mi ex novio era una paloma. Necesito alguien más fogoso.
sense_b66cc98991ca7161a822185962277370.translation: My ex-boyfriend was too mild-mannered. I need someone fierier.

sense_b66cc98991ca7161a822185962277370.text: Ella se queja de que su jefe es una paloma y necesita demostrar más liderazgo.
sense_b66cc98991ca7161a822185962277370.translation: She complains that her boss is too docile and needs to demonstrate more leadership.

sense_39640d9b2897208974f689eb9bd4e196.text: Atravesaron las montañas al amparo de la noche.
sense_39640d9b2897208974f689eb9bd4e196.translation: They crossed the mountains under cover of night.

sense_39640d9b2897208974f689eb9bd4e196.text: Siempre debes mirar en ambas direcciones antes de atravesar la carretera.
sense_39640d9b2897208974f689eb9bd4e196.translation: You should always look both ways before crossing the highway.

sense_aceff0699379990a8d05f1d4a9cad56b.text: Me parece que el ministro debería dimitir.
sense_aceff0699379990a8d05f1d4a9cad56b.translation: I think the minister should resign.

sense_aceff0699379990a8d05f1d4a9cad56b.text: ¿Qué te pareció la serie sobre la familia real? - Me pareció una tontería.
sense_aceff0699379990a8d05f1d4a9cad56b.translation: What did you think of the series about the royal family? - I thought it was nonsense.

sense_0f7fdaf54a75b6a123f80f9dc11df19e.text: Cómo me desespera el tráfico en esta ciudad.
sense_0f7fdaf54a75b6a123f80f9dc11df19e.translation: The traffic in this city drives me crazy.

sense_0f7fdaf54a75b6a123f80f9dc11df19e.text: La lentitud de mi conexión de Internet me desespera.
sense_0f7fdaf54a75b6a123f80f9dc11df19e.translation: The slowness of my Internet connection drives me crazy.

sense_b7272b316273d1b700d14937ab3bc2f4.text: Me gusta jugar al bingo por el dinero.
sense_b7272b316273d1b700d14937ab3bc2f4.translation: I love playing Bingo for money.
Does anybody want to play tennis with me?

sense_b6b3a09326d334c177caeae9ca9b8b7f.text: Si los alimentos crían moho, deshágase de ellos inmediatamente.
sense_b6b3a09326d334c177caeae9ca9b8b7f.translation: If food goes moldy, get rid of it straight away.

sense_b6b3a09326d334c177caeae9ca9b8b7f.text: El hombre aullaba mientras sus manos y sus brazos empezaban a criar vello.
sense_b6b3a09326d334c177caeae9ca9b8b7f.translation: The man howled as his hands and arms started to become hairy.

sense_72a52036e5a6bab7ae31d80e04d9cfb7.text: Lo que más amo del carnaval de Panamá son los desfiles.
sense_72a52036e5a6bab7ae31d80e04d9cfb7.translation: What I love the most about the Panama carnival are the parades.

sense_72a52036e5a6bab7ae31d80e04d9cfb7.text: Sería muy divertido ir al carnaval de Río y ver los disfraces y carrozas.
sense_72a52036e5a6bab7ae31d80e04d9cfb7.translation: It would be a lot of fun to go to the Rio carnival and see the costumes and floats.

sense_741d2df1fb23739c6257d6abf78a6848.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
sense_741d2df1fb23739c6257d6abf78a6848.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

sense_741d2df1fb23739c6257d6abf78a6848.text: Deja de jugar tantos videojuegos y sal a tomar el sol.
sense_741d2df1fb23739c6257d6abf78a6848.translation: Stop playing so many video games and go out and get some sun.

sense_f49ed514e6e54bcb5753d6717baa1917.text: No te lo tomes a pecho, pero no me gusta tu corte de pelo.
sense_f49ed514e6e54bcb5753d6717baa1917.translation: Don't take it to heart, but I don't like your haircut.

sense_74513c1aaf2a8e948ff6714ea9650814.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
sense_74513c1aaf2a8e948ff6714ea9650814.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

sense_74513c1aaf2a8e948ff6714ea9650814.text: Los niños siguieron a su padre hasta el parque.
sense_74513c1aaf2a8e948ff6714ea9650814.translation: The children followed their dad to the park.

sense_785030286583b15f9e9d7d8aac3e49a6.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
sense_785030286583b15f9e9d7d8aac3e49a6.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

sense_785030286583b15f9e9d7d8aac3e49a6.text: Seguimos bailando hasta no poder más.
sense_785030286583b15f9e9d7d8aac3e49a6.translation: We kept dancing until we couldn't go on anymore.

sense_42f2e16191340b75f94b71368b861507.text: Mejor que aplacemos la salida porque sigue nevando.
sense_42f2e16191340b75f94b71368b861507.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

sense_42f2e16191340b75f94b71368b861507.text: Seguimos sin saber si van a venir a la boda o no.
sense_42f2e16191340b75f94b71368b861507.translation: We still don't know if they're coming to the wedding or not.

sense_6b25d72dd088fa4de513695815da9c00.text: Dicen que el alcalde recibió dinero de fuentes sospechosas.
sense_6b25d72dd088fa4de513695815da9c00.translation: They say that the mayor received money from shady sources.

sense_6b25d72dd088fa4de513695815da9c00.text: La víctima recibió un fuerte golpe al lado de la cabeza.
sense_6b25d72dd088fa4de513695815da9c00.translation: The victim received a strong blow to the side of the head.

sense_5a6a957975859c3174fbe87736e0a1c4.text: El equipo visitante fue recibido con silbidos y abucheos.
sense_5a6a957975859c3174fbe87736e0a1c4.translation: The visiting team was received with whistles and jeers.

sense_5a6a957975859c3174fbe87736e0a1c4.text: Nos recibió personalmente en el aeropuerto.
sense_5a6a957975859c3174fbe87736e0a1c4.translation: He personally welcomed us at the airport.

sense_5d2eedd5bea6df7d57d00b6251088662.text: Mi hermana se recibió de ingeniera en Georgia Tech.
sense_5d2eedd5bea6df7d57d00b6251088662.translation: My sister graduated as an engineer from Georgia Tech.
How many students will graduate this year?

sense_64139535d2c7324c642232259a9bf5de.text: Sueño con tener una casa grande y mucho dinero.
sense_64139535d2c7324c642232259a9bf5de.translation: I dream of having a big house and lots of money.

sense_64139535d2c7324c642232259a9bf5de.text: Ella soñó con el actor famoso.
sense_64139535d2c7324c642232259a9bf5de.translation: She dreamed about the famous actor.

sense_0568416329a711ac6336c2409ac8ac72.text: Dejé a mi hijo en la guardería antes de ir a trabajar.
sense_0568416329a711ac6336c2409ac8ac72.translation: I dropped my son off at the daycare center before I went to work.

sense_0568416329a711ac6336c2409ac8ac72.text: Dejar a tu hijo en una guardería es mucho más barato que contratar a una niñera.
sense_0568416329a711ac6336c2409ac8ac72.translation: Leaving your kid at a daycare center is much cheaper than hiring a nanny.

sense_ac5d58746b75cd82d7844c01e3c99fea.text: En esta economía, los trabajos seguros no abundan.
sense_ac5d58746b75cd82d7844c01e3c99fea.translation: In this economy, there aren't a lot of secure jobs.

sense_ac5d58746b75cd82d7844c01e3c99fea.text: No te encarames en esa silla, ¡no es segura!
sense_ac5d58746b75cd82d7844c01e3c99fea.translation: Don't climb up on that chair. It isn't secure!

sense_c3135f8904928202e8d77cb921485129.text: La culpa es tuya. - ¿Mía? ¡Hay que joderse! ¡Pero si yo ni siquiera estaba aquí!
sense_c3135f8904928202e8d77cb921485129.translation: It's your fault. - My fault? For fuck's sake! But I wasn't even here!

sense_c3135f8904928202e8d77cb921485129.text: No me dejaron ustedes nada de comida. - ¡Te jodes! Es tu culpa por llegar tarde.
sense_c3135f8904928202e8d77cb921485129.translation: You didn't leave any food for me. - Tough shit! It's your fault for being late.

sense_b885047e265cfecb99fea77e091cc68a.translation: How do you get so brown?

sense_b885047e265cfecb99fea77e091cc68a.text: Me puse morena después de un par de días en la playa.
sense_b885047e265cfecb99fea77e091cc68a.translation: I got a tan after two days at the beach.

sense_a85a9ae7103517499b5b1d6c64af5a43.text: Me dio mucha tristeza saber que este niñito es huérfano de madre.
sense_a85a9ae7103517499b5b1d6c64af5a43.translation: I felt so sad when I learned that this little boy is a motherless child.

sense_a85a9ae7103517499b5b1d6c64af5a43.text: Mi amiga Helena vive solo con su mamá, porque es huérfana de padre.
sense_a85a9ae7103517499b5b1d6c64af5a43.translation: My friend Helena lives only with her mom, because she has lost her father.

sense_29e341be24fdb431cb67f01cf5b4a8f2.text: Cuando tenemos exámenes, pasamos mucho tiempo estudiando.
sense_29e341be24fdb431cb67f01cf5b4a8f2.translation: When we have exams, we spend a lot of time studying.

sense_29e341be24fdb431cb67f01cf5b4a8f2.text: ¿Qué hiciste durante las vacaciones? - Pasé el mes entero en casa de mis abuelos.
sense_29e341be24fdb431cb67f01cf5b4a8f2.translation: What did you do during the vacation? - I spent the whole month at my grandparents'.

sense_8fecbf9030612345f66ba9deb53c0641.text: No llamé a Mamá. Se me pasó por completo.
sense_8fecbf9030612345f66ba9deb53c0641.translation: I haven't called Mom; it completely slipped my mind.

sense_8fecbf9030612345f66ba9deb53c0641.text: ¿Por qué no compraste pan? - Tenía prisa y se me pasó.
sense_8fecbf9030612345f66ba9deb53c0641.translation: Why didn't you buy some bread? - I was in a hurry and it slipped my mind.

sense_ce2fc587fb078004fbad73fcbd7222d3.text: Lo siento, me pasé con la pimienta.
sense_ce2fc587fb078004fbad73fcbd7222d3.translation: I'm sorry. I overdid it with the pepper.
Don't put too much sugar in it!

sense_8b6e1ec79e2eefe2f516c3027bf4abc8.text: No te preocupes por mí. Ya se me pasó el mareo.
sense_8b6e1ec79e2eefe2f516c3027bf4abc8.translation: Don't worry about me. I'm no longer feeling seasick.

sense_8b6e1ec79e2eefe2f516c3027bf4abc8.text: No necesito una aspirina. Ya se me pasó el dolor de cabeza.
sense_8b6e1ec79e2eefe2f516c3027bf4abc8.translation: I don't need an aspirin. My headache is gone.

sense_8e6d4850e29c368fd53bd7effddba927.text: El ladrón miró hacia atrás a ver si lo perseguían.
sense_8e6d4850e29c368fd53bd7effddba927.translation: The thief looked back to see if he was being followed.

sense_f8d4a69171c482ce45a9578cd1b9a568.text: Mi padre era víctima de una rara dolencia.
sense_f8d4a69171c482ce45a9578cd1b9a568.translation: My father suffered from a rare illness.

sense_f8d4a69171c482ce45a9578cd1b9a568.text: Falleció víctima de un accidente cerebrovascular.

sense_040bf7d4b26d9dad2d1ce716c52f2a89.text: Un rayo de luz apareció en las tinieblas.
sense_040bf7d4b26d9dad2d1ce716c52f2a89.translation: A ray of light appeared in the dark.

sense_040bf7d4b26d9dad2d1ce716c52f2a89.text: Por más que lo intentaba, Jasón no podía ver nada en las tinieblas.
sense_040bf7d4b26d9dad2d1ce716c52f2a89.translation: Hard as he tried, Jason couldn't see anything in the dark.

sense_10f36377320e2b1240dcba794fcd6ba6.text: Los oficiales brindaron por el general que los llevó a la victoria.
sense_10f36377320e2b1240dcba794fcd6ba6.translation: The officers toasted to the general that took them to victory.

sense_10f36377320e2b1240dcba794fcd6ba6.text: Después del discurso del padrino de boda, los invitados brindaron por los recién casados.
sense_10f36377320e2b1240dcba794fcd6ba6.translation: After the best man's speech, the guests toasted to the newlyweds.

sense_a397287b02ace0363d268c4ebc1e4635.text: El leopardo del Amur es una especie protegida en Rusia.
sense_a397287b02ace0363d268c4ebc1e4635.translation: The Amur leopard is a protected species in Russia.

sense_a397287b02ace0363d268c4ebc1e4635.text: En la isla no hay humanos y constituye un entorno protegido para varias especies.
sense_a397287b02ace0363d268c4ebc1e4635.translation: The island is human-free and serves as a protected environment for many species.

sense_cb1c8ca72da34022fc4576d4413ed155.text: ¿Será que te arrestas a lanzarte en paracaídas?
sense_cb1c8ca72da34022fc4576d4413ed155.translation: Would you dare to go skydiving?

sense_cb1c8ca72da34022fc4576d4413ed155.text: Luz es una mujer valiente que se arresta a todo.
sense_cb1c8ca72da34022fc4576d4413ed155.translation: Luz is a brave woman who's afraid of nothing.

sense_1b7464b2fb387494d06449d3eb6434a5.text: Si me permite, señora, creo que puedo arreglar la puerta.
sense_1b7464b2fb387494d06449d3eb6434a5.translation: If I may, ma'am, I think I can fix the door.

sense_540c56a08549f050a5900a0e2060b47d.text: Me ofrecieron su ayuda para el traslado.
sense_540c56a08549f050a5900a0e2060b47d.translation: They offered to help me with the move.

sense_540c56a08549f050a5900a0e2060b47d.text: Tengo confianza que me ofrecerán el trabajo.
sense_540c56a08549f050a5900a0e2060b47d.translation: I'm confident they'll offer me the job.

sense_67f9cdae64fb196ae4aae76b388292cc.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
sense_67f9cdae64fb196ae4aae76b388292cc.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

sense_67f9cdae64fb196ae4aae76b388292cc.text: A ver, espera. No hace falta ser tan severo con ellos.
sense_67f9cdae64fb196ae4aae76b388292cc.translation: Hold on a minute. There's no need to be so harsh with them.

sense_63900625e3ce4501cef716ceffd3f617.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
sense_63900625e3ce4501cef716ceffd3f617.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.
Wait for them to call us.

sense_52e94b5b35a0623070eac2f78f9b97a6.text: Mi novio conectó de maravilla con mis padres.
sense_52e94b5b35a0623070eac2f78f9b97a6.translation: My boyfriend really clicked with my parents.

sense_52e94b5b35a0623070eac2f78f9b97a6.text: Federica conecta rápidamente con los niños; los hace reír en cuestión de minutos.
sense_52e94b5b35a0623070eac2f78f9b97a6.translation: Federica is an instant hit with children; she has them laughing in a matter of minutes.

sense_b7126ef2b12642505e59382f625f5577.text: Viaje con nosotros para conectar rápidamente con todas las ciudades europeas.
sense_b7126ef2b12642505e59382f625f5577.translation: Travel with us to connect fast with all European cities.

sense_b7126ef2b12642505e59382f625f5577.text: Compramos el billete equivocado; este vuelo no conecta con el de Bangkok.
sense_b7126ef2b12642505e59382f625f5577.translation: We bought the wrong ticket; this flight doesn't connect with the Bangkok one.

sense_133fcfd2afc40a32597075e9c59ee48e.text: El perro siempre se pone feliz al verte.
sense_133fcfd2afc40a32597075e9c59ee48e.translation: The dog's always happy to see you.
It makes me mad to think about it.

sense_455ee5bae437bfa7fbd703e455b66be2.text: Una vara equivale a casi una yarda.
sense_455ee5bae437bfa7fbd703e455b66be2.translation: A vara is approximately one yard.

sense_455ee5bae437bfa7fbd703e455b66be2.text: Necesito dos varas de esa tela.
sense_455ee5bae437bfa7fbd703e455b66be2.translation: I need two varas of that fabric.

sense_60501401dbd1235d4814cc4decb8741c.text: Las corrientes de aire pueden ser causadas por muchos factores diferentes.
sense_60501401dbd1235d4814cc4decb8741c.translation: Air currents can be caused by many different things.

sense_60501401dbd1235d4814cc4decb8741c.text: Ese río tiene una corriente fuerte. Es mejor no nadar en él.
sense_60501401dbd1235d4814cc4decb8741c.translation: That river has a strong current. It's best not to swim there.

sense_015c58ee9c7f9b461002a6ea8a33073c.text: Estoy mareado con todas estas instrucciones.
sense_015c58ee9c7f9b461002a6ea8a33073c.translation: I'm in a muddle with so many instructions.

sense_015c58ee9c7f9b461002a6ea8a33073c.text: Me tienes mareada con tanta pregunta.
sense_015c58ee9c7f9b461002a6ea8a33073c.translation: I can't think straight with all your questions.

sense_2368068905630b0e4b7e356d51757070.text: Es importante que siempre consideres los sentimientos de los demás.
sense_2368068905630b0e4b7e356d51757070.translation: It's important that you always consider other people's feelings.

sense_2368068905630b0e4b7e356d51757070.text: Siempre hay que considerar a las personas mayores en el autobús y cederles el asiento.
sense_2368068905630b0e4b7e356d51757070.translation: You should always show consideration for older people on the bus and give up your seat for them.

sense_866c0749b3e504580803fedfe3fdea05.text: Este año voy a correr la maratón.
sense_866c0749b3e504580803fedfe3fdea05.translation: I'm running the marathon this year.

sense_53f0bde3a0642f7f58259ba1e33cbf3e.text: ¿Cuántos tomates quiere? - Deme dos kilos, por favor.
sense_53f0bde3a0642f7f58259ba1e33cbf3e.translation: How many tomatoes do you want? - I'll take two kilos, please.

sense_53f0bde3a0642f7f58259ba1e33cbf3e.text: ¿Me das una libra de queso y dos libras de jamón?
sense_53f0bde3a0642f7f58259ba1e33cbf3e.translation: Can I have one pound of cheese and two pounds of ham?

sense_8872b9c5d251ac4b4145536e17a6b861.text: Esta pared necesita que le des otra pasada de pintura.
sense_8872b9c5d251ac4b4145536e17a6b861.translation: This wall needs another coat of paint.

sense_8872b9c5d251ac4b4145536e17a6b861.text: Le voy a dar otra capa de barniz a esta mesa.
sense_8872b9c5d251ac4b4145536e17a6b861.translation: I'm going to give this table another coat of varnish.

sense_332acd982051a3fd5e6356b7e0af2ef4.text: Me da miedo quedarme sola en la casa.
sense_332acd982051a3fd5e6356b7e0af2ef4.translation: I get scared staying at home alone.

sense_332acd982051a3fd5e6356b7e0af2ef4.text: No puedo tomar café caliente en este clima; me da demasiado calor.
sense_332acd982051a3fd5e6356b7e0af2ef4.translation: I can't drink hot coffee in this weather; it makes me too hot.

sense_487301bd0ab210adae819e21348909d9.text: Me da igual si comemos pasta o pescado esta noche.
sense_487301bd0ab210adae819e21348909d9.translation: It doesn't matter to me whether we have pasta or fish tonight.

sense_487301bd0ab210adae819e21348909d9.text: ¿Quieres ir a la playa o a la piscina? - Me da lo mismo.
sense_487301bd0ab210adae819e21348909d9.translation: Do you want to go to the beach or to the pool? - It's all the same to me.

sense_742ae2dc06c32377b66468c25468ff25.text: Me ha dado con tomarme una copa de vino con la cena.
sense_742ae2dc06c32377b66468c25468ff25.translation: I've started having a glass of wine with my dinner.

sense_742ae2dc06c32377b66468c25468ff25.text: Desde que supo que consiguió el trabajo, le ha dado con ir de compras todo el tiempo.
sense_742ae2dc06c32377b66468c25468ff25.translation: Ever since he found out that he got the job, he's taken to nonstop shopping.

sense_afd75ef459454f569736595e22abb62a.text: A la llanta se le fue el aire.
A la piscina se le fue todo el agua.
sense_afd75ef459454f569736595e22abb62a.translation: All the water leaked from the pool.

sense_67f12131c1795fcaeaa4913eb63a8f67.text: Quiero reunir a toda la familia para celebrar Navidad juntos.
sense_67f12131c1795fcaeaa4913eb63a8f67.translation: I want to gather the whole family to celebrate Christmas together.

sense_67f12131c1795fcaeaa4913eb63a8f67.text: Mi papá nos reunió alrededor de la fogata para relatarnos cuentos.
sense_67f12131c1795fcaeaa4913eb63a8f67.translation: Dad gathered us around the campfire to tell us stories.

sense_8e7cb7c4df9075e7c4bdc9c9811514a1.text: La revolución separó el partido en dos facciones.
sense_8e7cb7c4df9075e7c4bdc9c9811514a1.translation: The revolution separated the party into two factions.

sense_8e7cb7c4df9075e7c4bdc9c9811514a1.text: Separé la clase en grupos de cuatro alumnos cada uno.
sense_8e7cb7c4df9075e7c4bdc9c9811514a1.translation: I divided the class into groups of four students each.

sense_2522a8eaca1ab6ae9bba7e1f47f4aeeb.text: Un ala se separó del transbordador espacial al entrar la atmósfera de la tierra.
sense_2522a8eaca1ab6ae9bba7e1f47f4aeeb.translation: A wing came off the space shuttle upon entering the Earth's atmosphere.

sense_2522a8eaca1ab6ae9bba7e1f47f4aeeb.text: Durante una tormenta, una rama se separó del árbol y cayó encima de mi automóvil.
sense_2522a8eaca1ab6ae9bba7e1f47f4aeeb.translation: A branch of the tree was ripped off during a storm and landed on my car.
